title: Excellent travel insurance!
body: I was recently in hospital in Indonesia due to an unforeseen medical emergency. I was admitted to Siloam Hospital where I underwent surgery. The team from Cover-More spoke to me twice in the hospital, once before the procedure and once after the procedure by one of Cover-More's caring medical team. I was also sent an email with a claims number within 1 hour of reporting the emergency. I could not have asked for better service or care. I received my claim in less than two weeks. The team at Cover-More are efficient, friendly, helpful and professional. I am a frequent traveler and I always use Cover-More when I travel overseas. I highly recommend this product.

title: Avoid Insure And Go. Useless Travel Insurance
body:

body:
had two policies, the first for 2 weeks in Bali, the second for 8 weeks cruise and Canada for 2 people
I've lost well over $1000 as I can't get a refund as it was purchased and I only had a 2 week time frame to change my mind...I didn't change my mind, the holidays are no longer available. title: Great fast online claim!
body: Amazing service for the online claims system, easy to use and paid super quick! Would never use any other travel insurance company other than Covermore! Highly recommend to take out through Flight Centre as they help with everything too!

title: Never, ever, ever use CoverMore
body:
So you go on a holiday to Fiji to attend a friend's wedding on an outlying island. Upon landing a cyclone moves in and you are taken directly from the Nadi airport and dumped at a dingy hotel 10 minutes away where you stay for the next two nights. You are not supposed to be at this hotel. In fact you are supposed to connect with an inter-island flight and and be enjoying the delights of a luxury resort. However, weather conditions closed the airport so you are stuck - you can't leave the hotel and you can't leave Fiji. These things happen, but any reasonable person would expect their insurer to cover the cost of their flights to and from Fiji plus the accommodation you have prepaid at the resort and also the hotel where you have been dumped. Well, think again. Because CoverMore DOES NOT DO THIS. Expect to be out of pocket in a huge way and expect to have to fight every day to get even the smallest part of your claim recognised. It has taken us 19 months to get to a point where we have had enough of fighting and just have to accept that CoverMore will not pay up. We remain over $4000 out of pocket. So our only recourse is to NEVER, EVER, EVER USE COVERMORE again ... and the smartest thing you can do on any future trip is not to use them either.

Extraordinary bad and slow service.

title: Yearly Coverage for Cruising Australia and the South Pacific
body: Policy was easy to set up, staff were very clear, good to read PDF prior to paying, I get 3 quotes, this policy was very good value for money, Chris advised that the 12 monthly policy the best option.  We have had  individual policies, this is the 1st bulk policy,

title: People who have claimed = unhappy, people who have just purchased insurance = happy!!
body:

Hopefully the Royal commission revealing the activities of the insurance companies will have some effect.  They certainly know how to hide the devil in the detail with their PDS!

title: Absolutely Disgraceful!!!!
body:
My husband and son travelling to China and Hong Kong recently. On the return trip, they were scheduled to travel Shanghai - Sydney through Hong Kong (2 separate airlines). There was 3 hours layover in the middle.  They boarded their Shanghai-Hong Kong flight, only to sit on the tarmac for almost 2 hours prior to take off.  Hence, they missed their Hong Kong-Sydney flight.  On calling Insure and Go at the time he was still waiting for his luggage, I was informed he would need to get a letter from the Chinese airline.  He went back to the counter, and was issued a card identifying that there was a problem with Air Traffic Control in Shanghai, and the flight was indeed, late.  I called back Insure and Go, and read back what they had been given, and she instructed that would suffice as she would send out the paperwork.  In the meantime, we had to purchase brand new airline tickets for them both, as well as a nights accommodation in Hong Kong Airport.  On their return, however - Insure&Go advised that they are actually not covered for this at all.  So, basically, unless you can afford to buy your airline tickets TWICE, then don't travel.  This was clearly OUT OF OUR CONTROL, and we purchase Travel Insurance whenever we travel for this type of scenario.  
The level of service and assistance from Insure&Go is nothing short of appalling ... I cannot recommend enough, that you NEVER EVER BUY AN INSURANCE POLICY FROM THIS COMPANY !!!!  I, too would have given them a good rating, UNTIL I NEEDED TO MAKE A CLAIM !!!  I will NEVER EVER EVER EVER EVER(x10000) BE TEMPTED TO BUY FROM THEM AGAIN ...   It's unAustralian and deceitful for them to treat people like this.  Disgusted .....
The Price and Service Before you need to claim
Appalling ..   Will not ever pay your claim.  Don't ever be tempted to take a policy from these people.

title: Disappointed
body:
I had a tooth breakage on a cruise that was just leaving New Zealand. There are no dentists on board. First port of call after the accident was Melbourne. So I'm told I can't claim as the treatment is in Australia. So for me the policy was of nil or negative value. Customer Service took 3 days to respond. Not good.
I thought it was interesting that you needed to remind people "Don't use aggressive language and don't post personal details." I'd say on my experience, you must get a lot of negative comments. 
I know I won't be insuring with you again.

body: Easy to log on to website and organise immediate insurance, never had to use it so I don't know how things go at that end but hopefully never need to use cover, this is the 2nd time I've had purchase one cover and will use again.

title: The blindfold has been removed!!
body:
Twice now I have traveled with Cover-More holding my insurance. Unfortunately twice I've had to make a claim.  The response both times has been outstanding.  My first claim was medical - I had my thumb jammed in the door on a cruise ship and needed the on board Doctor to pierce my nail to relieve the pressure and it cost $138. Cover-More refunded the full amount and all I had to do was fill out the claim form and submit it.  

My second claim was for loosing my prescription multi-focal glasses. Again I filled out the claim form, submitted it and Cover-More refunded the amount I claimed less a small amount for depreciation. I'll be using Cover-More again next year if they still want to cover me!!
Cover-More's quick response to my claim, ease with which my claim was made.

body: Easy to set up,comphrensive cover at a competitive price.This is the second time we have chosen insureandGo. So far we have not needed to make a claim.l would recommend this insurance to other travelers.

title: Super efficient service
body: We always use Southern Cross when we travel. Good value, easy to set up. This was our first claim & it was handled super efficiently. The staff on the phone were friendly & helpful, the online claiming easy to complete. We posted the paperwork off on Monday and our account was credited on Friday. Southern Cross were recommended to us initially & we always recommend them to our friends & family planning to travel. Great service :)

title: Other companies with $0 excess work out cheaper
body:
Took out a domestic cruise policy. As far as I could see the excess was $200 and I couldn't see how to change it. I got sick on board and with the medical bills being slightly less than the excess, I would have been better off going through a company with $0 excess. The policy is more, but given what I paid 1Cover, the policy from another company with $0 excess would have had me ahead in terms of what I paid for the policy plus bills. The 1Cover cabin confinement is also when you are confined for more than 48 hours. Ships confine you for 48 hours when you are sick. So you lose 2 days of enjoyment with other arrangements paid for and aren't covered.

Pros - I have found the staff helpful and quick to respond. When I put my claim in, I was contacted 72 hours later to say it was rejected. When I went back for clarification, I had a response within 24 hours. 

So 5 stars for staff and 1 star for value for money equals 3 stars.

title: Easy as

Peace of mind = insurance

No more words needed

I thought that was excellent customer service and recommend the company wholeheartedly.

body:

body: Purchased Gold insurance for my trip to South Africa. We were robbed (about $1,500 worth stolen) and had a police report on the day of the incident. title: **WARNING** DOES NOT COVER CORONAVIRUS
body:
I was surprised and disappointed to learn that my sons travelling in Vietnam would not be covered for any claims attributable to coronavirus. This is despite only 8 cases of infection to date in the country, hardly an epidemic, and less than Australia. This is despite the insurance having been purchased months ago, way before coronavirus was widely known about.

I'm assuming cancelled flights and any other events that can be attributed to the virus would also not be covered.

I recommend you look elsewhere and read the PDS carefully before handing over money for a cheap but useless product.

title: Excellent service

title: No Relief for Annual Policy!  BUYERS BEWARE
body: I contacted insureandGO last week. I took out an annual policy just prior to Covad 19 and clearly can't travel.  The generic response received twice refers to non annual policy. body: Bought Gold domestic cover for elderly parents and tried to get refund as the Australian government advised people over 70 not to travel due to the corona virus pandemic. My parents had not travelled and i even called their call centre within the 14 days cancellation period to get through and cancel but they rejected any refund or credit.  It's amazing how the airlines, hotels and rental car providers can give a refund but these guys don't... AVOID! Will be taking the matter to fair trading to resolve.

title: Medibank Travel insurance does what it should - you can rely on it
body: My wife and I have just received the good news that our claim for the cost of a holiday to China cancelled for medical reasons had been paid in full by Medibank Travel Insurance. We had expected delays, red tape and a long list of questions, but there was none of that. The claim, for just under $3000, was paid without fuss and without red tape, in remarkably quick time. The insurance policy turned out to have been excellent value and well worth the money. I have only ever had one previous claim, more than 20 years ago for a theft from a hire car, and that was refused. So my expectations this time were not high. Since that claim, with another company, we have only ever used Medibank Travel and we thoroughly recommend it. It takes the stress out of travel.

title: Heartless and incompassionate
body:
We paid a $5300 deposit for flights, travel insurance and accommodation thru a travel agent for our very rare family holiday.

Weeks later my son was diagnosed with cancer. As you can imagine this was the worst time of our lives. The trip was cancelled as my child needed 6 mnths chemo and radiation to save his life. 

We undertook the time and energy consuming task of a travel insurance claim.

Covermore denied our claim because they said he had a pre existing medical condition as we had taken him to our GP within 90 days before taking out the policy. Our GP spent so much time filling out claims forms as requested by covermore. She clearly told them that at no time did she or us know that our child had a life threatening illness at the time of taking out the policy. Even with medical reports from a hospital showing a diagnosis was made weeks later was not enough for Covermore!!
Who would book and pay for a holiday knowing their child had cancer and would need to cancel it!

This was the most distressing time we have ever encountered in our lives and having to "battle" an insurance company too was exhausting.

I have no trouble not recommending this company to anyone.

FYI... we went to Jetstar direct and they showed tremendous compassion and returned the money we paid for the flights to us very quickly. My son is now in remission and in a few weeks we are going to go on our family holiday ( a much smaller domestic one ) with the money Jetstar returned to us. Oh and Im not using Covermore travel insurance

I feel that we did the right thing but will be penalized for taking it out too early as that means while we are travelling if anything happens to do with the Corona Virus we won't be covered!  Come on Insureandgo - I am an existing customer who has done the right thing, how about doing the right thing by us and allow us to RENEW the exisiting policy

title: Don't go skiing without 1Cover
body: Redcieved a medical diagnosis that prevented me from travelling on my ski trip. 1Cover made it easy to claim and the moment I completed the documentation, re-imbursed me in full. The policy was great value, easy to set up and I  will definitely would use them again. Extremely satisfied with 1Cover. They were excellent.

title: Wouldnt leave home without it!
body:
The claims gang have been brilliant, friendly and very helpful. Getting our claim through has been an absolute relief.  Having travelled the World extensively and always taking out travel insurance you sometimes think why, but when you have to claim you certainly don't question the premium.  TID has literally saved us financially as we incurred costs and losses in the thousands, needing to borrow money from family to get home from South America.  Had we not implemented insurance we would have being paying back family for years!  Thanks so much!
Competitive premiums, great service and very fair claims team.

title: Excellent travel insurance
body:
I've used 1cover for all overseas trips & 80% of domestic trips since 2008.
I mainly get travel insurance for domestic trips due to getting hire cars.
I made my first claim last month due to my phone being stolen in Tahiti as I was flying out at the airport. 
The process to make a claim was so easy and requirements were very reasonable. And the claim was approved and funds sent to me within 30 days. I paid roughly $40 for a 7 day trip to Tahiti and $100 excess.
I had to do a prior claim with Aami travel insurance in 2008 and it was a horrible process of going backwards and forwards of needing this document that document then photos of the item and why wasn't the receipt in my name even though it was in my partners name and I had documents with both our names on it showing we were a couple. Then I was told the items had to be itemised so individual excess's in the end it wasn't worth putting a claim through.. so I've tried to be cautious since that experience with my travel insurer.. my main concern is that I'm covered health wise if anything is to happen whilst overseas. 

I had no issues with this 1cover ! so really happy to know that after 8 years of 1cover they truely do make a claims process really easy. Customer service is great and they also are very reasonably priced and not a cheap and nasty company.
Thank you 1cover !

title: Excellent value & service
body: I have used 1Cover several times when travelling both domestically & internationally. Good value for money, easy site when setting up, providing peace of mind, and great customer service. Highly recommended.

title: Value for money.
body: This is the second time. As a senior I found them to be competive and the process to apply was simple.

title: Excellent

title: Haven't had to make a claim yet
body:

Easy as to get policy, I like that is cruise specific insurance
Have not had to deal with customer service so I can't comment on their performance

title: Terrible
body:
Both my bags were lost when in europe. Was left for remaining three days without bags. 1 bag turned up 1 week after arriving home and the other almost 6 weeks. Had many items stolen. 6 months later Covermore refuses to pay claim even for the 3 days we had to buy cloths, toiletries new bag etc. Pathetic insurers. NEVER AGAIN USE THEM. WARNING TO ALL, DONT USE COVERMORE!
NOTHING AT ALL

title: NO PROBLEMS
body: The policy was perfect value for money, I felt at ease knowing I was covered, the policy was very easy to set up.   The only thing wrong is that the phone number to ring if something goes wrong (hopefully it does not) was only available to ring certain of the hours of the day - consequently you could go a couple of days before you knew you were covered or not, there should be an easier way to contact them in case of a claim.  otherwise no complaints at all, will continue to use Allianz

title: Absolutely terrible
body:
Child gets bitten by a cat in Vietnam and they only pay for one injection out of 5!!! Apparently when you have a medical issue you need to stay in the country to get all the treatment. What a load of stupidity. That would cost more to the insurance company for our change in flights and new accommodation. Argh!!! Read the document carefully because you fill find you are covered for very little. Also the claims process was very hard, I wanted to do it on the phone with help, but was told to do it on the internet. Horrible experience.
You get it through Flight Centre

title: Don't use if you expect a payout on claim.....
body:
We have used this company many times & recommended to our friends, based on the great reviews. Unfortunately this company was great until a claim was made. The insurance was taken out at the same time as the trip was paid, which was about 10 months prior to travelling.  Unfortunately 5 days prior to the trip my husband had an accident & broke his arm, but as this did not affect his ability to fly we did not advise the insurance company of his accident. Big mistake!  My husband had paid for a tour in Europe, which cost $6,000.00, but due to his accident he was unable to go on this tour. On arrival in Europe, 6 days after the accident, we advised the insurance company of the accident, in the expectation that any claim we made would be honoured. We completed the paperwork when we arrived back home only to discover that NO, they wouldn't cover because we didn't advise of the accident before the trip & also any accident that happens before you go, that doesn't cause cancellation of the trip, isn't covered, They sent copies of their documents which states this is so. I have to say I did read the PDF document when the insurance was taken out but I didn't take note of that point. It's obviously a case of buyer beware & believe me I'm very aware now.
Because of all the positive reviews on this company I expected them to be exceptional & a cut above the others but I realise that they are no better than the others. I will NEVER use this company again & I will urge all others not to either.

title: Simple, easy to use service

title: Worse than pathetic - Dangerous
body:
I don't know how 1Cover earned their 5 star rating on Canstar, as my experience was not only unacceptable, but potentially life threatening.
I purchased my cover before travelling to Bali, and found myself seriously ill with gastro after 2 days. After 3 days bed ridden, only leaving my room to visit chemists and various medical institutions I decided I wasn't getting any better and I was compelled to head home.
After spending 20 minutes on hold (on the "Emergency" line back to Australia - with huge call costs) I was subjected to one of the most bizarre conversations of my life. 
I was transferred between 2 departments - only to have the medical claims clerk tell me that I wouldn't be covered for the cost of a plane ticket home (a further $300 on what I had already paid) as gastro is deemed to be a "Pre Existing" illness? That's not covered under their insurance.
Right.
I then asked the clerk what would have me qualify for insurance - to which he asserted a "serious medical episode".
I asked "so if I break my arm or leg, that'll qualify for being serious enough - but anything less than that won't even be considered?" To which he agreed.
He recommended I call my airline and just but another ticket home.
Fantastic customer service!

After calling my airline and pleading with them, they saw sense and granted me a seat on a last minute flight to get me home as soon as possible.
So in conclusion - paying the absolute pittance of $60 for the pathetic excuse of what you classify as "insurance" wasn't even worth the paper it was printed on.

I write this review from a hospital bed where I've spent the last 2 days, in Sydney. After blood tests it's been discovered I've suffered from a potentially life threatening strain of gastro - it's so serious even the nurses are entering the room with masks and suits with sleeves tucked into gloves. I don't know when I'll be released.

In conclusion - unless you're planning on breaking a bone, don't bother with 1Cover. Go to a travel agent, spend the extra money on something that you'll be guaranteed will cover you if you fall seriously I'll, because the consequences could be life threatening.

title: Absolutely abysmal claims process - Do yourself a favour - use someone else!
body:
I have used InsureandGo for the past couple of trips I have made. I always thought that the process to purchase a policy was simple and the prices were cheap and reasonable. I guess you get what you pay for though. 

Upon our return from our holiday, I noticed one of our checked in bags had a 6-7cm rip down the side. We had already been delayed a couple of hours so I just wanted to get home thought I will just make a claim with InsureandGo. 

I contacted them today. I selected the options via their phone number to speak to someone from the claims department, however ended up speaking with someone from a different department. When I requested to speak to the claims department, I was told that it was not possible. I was told that in order to submit a claim, I would need a copy of my passport (although it was a domestic trip), the flight itinerary and proof of ownership. 

The issue is, I purchased the bag approximately 2 years ago and am unsure where the receipt is. I asked how I confirm ownership and was advised that I would need to send a copy of my bank statement. I queried how a bank statement proves ownership. He was unable to answer the question. When I asked if I was wasting my time with making a claim he said, (his words) 'You will have to make a claim to see'. 

Again I requested to speak to a claims officer or a manager, however he made excuses and really it was like talking to a brick wall. He stated that the claims officer WILL NOT speak to me unless a claim is made. 

This company will happily take your money, however don't expect them to assist you with the claims process in any way. The professionalism of the staff of InsureandGo is extremely poor. 

Do yourself a favour - Spend a little bit more and choose a more reputable company to purchase your travel insurance.

title: 13 policies 1 claim - no payment!
body:
My sons girlfriend recently went to Portugal. Upon arrival her bag did not appear. That was in August. She never got her bag and did all the required paperwork with the airline immediately. She contacted TID and was told to keep receipts for any essentials she bought. She was away for 5 weeks and spent approximately 350Euro buying toiletries, underwear, clothing and a pair of shoes as she literally had nothing. 
She submitted her claim to TID for roughly $2300. She was insured for up to $10,000 lost luggage.
After a ridiculous amount of time calling TID over the past 3 months and not ever receiving a return call (until today) despite numerous promises she was finally offered 25% of her claim as a goodwill payment. For example, that is $25 for a suitcase that she conservatively valued at $100. This is apparently reasonable wear and tear and depreciation .
I requested an escalation and was offered 50% almost immediately - I was informed that normal procedure is to initially offer 25% and when escalated it is increased to 50%. No where in the PDS are these figures mentioned - just a vague statement about depreciation.
I requested an independent review.
I received a call today (1st call in 3 months). 
Now it gets even more unbelievable.
As she doesn't have receipts AND proof of ownership for the contents she is not eligible for ANYTHING!! 
and remember the 350Euro for essentials she purchased when she was away? - not eligible for anything there either. Why? That only applies to luggage that is temporarily lost.......When it is permanently lost it comes under section 14 blah blah blah..... I cant even begin to understand this.
Even if she DID have receipts for everything in her bag, the receipts must be proven to belong to her and then reasonable wear and tear and depreciation  would still apply!!!!!! 
The airline are yet to respond in any way financially either. 
How on earth is this reasonable? What is she meant to do now? Who has receipts for everything in their luggage?

title: Aribtrary depreciation on valuables left me out of pocket
body:
I broke my prescription glasses, which cost me about $430 when I bought them, while on holiday. When I returned I submitted a claim, which was promptly processed and paid - to the tune of $7.50. The justification for this paltry sum was that the glasses were old and subject to depreciation in value. 

A pair of glasses cannot be depreciated, their value is derived from their function, if the prescription is correct then their value remains constant. They cannot be depreciated based on age, the age has no bearing on their usefulness.

When I called to explain this fact the person I spoke to was unable to do anything except reiterate their policy to depreciate items based on age. I asked to make a formal complaint  and lodge a  dispute. The dispute was a complete cop out and a total waste of time, after 2 weeks I received a form letter via email telling me the initial assessment was correct. Their assertion was scratches on the frame or lenses (there weren't any) would could as wear and tear that justified a $300 depreciation in value.

absolute rubbish, but typical insurance company [censored word removed] tactics.
Initial claim was processed quickly
Deliberate and fundamental misrepresentation of claimed items value for their own benefit

title: Claim successful! Happy!
body:
I've been using Allianz insurance as my main travel insurance for many years! I travel about 4 times every year never had to make a claim. Until now finally for the first time. 

Genuine claim. My second flight as part of a multiple destination holiday was cancelled by the airlines due to sudden airspace issues/closure, which resulted in the loss of my planned prepaid trip. Had to rebook with a new airlines in order to make it on time, otherwise I would have lost costs on my hotel bookings, car rental, everything! I claimed for the additional costs in the rebooking of tickets. 

Submitted claim with all the documents, finally got the call after a few weeks and advised all approved, no problems, subtract the excess which as reasonable. 

So happy that I took up on the premium insurance which covered the cancellations part. Its good to know that Allianz has your back for unexpected situations like this.

The only minor complaint I have is when I first called up Allianz and told them my situation, she didn't think I would be eligible to be covered which was a bit of a shock. I was going to give up but after she sent through the PDS and carefully reading through it,  I realised that I *AM* eligible and obviously everything went smoothly after that.

It seems their support team are trained to not give advice on possible claims. A little shady?. So I recommend that you read the policy carefully! You never know you could be eligible!

body:

I lodged a claim when I got home. It took three months and many phone calls and emails to get a settlement. Among other problems, they appeared to have lost my original documentation (report and original receipts numbered to match the relevant paragraph), so that when a helpful employee responded to my enquiries 2 months after the claim was lodged, he obviously had no idea about the claim and had to ask for receipts all over again.
On the plus side, InsureandGo provides cheap insurance that covers pre-existing ailments. I  guess I got what I paid for: poor service but a full settlement in the end. I would not use them again.

title: A warning to any potential customers of TID!
body:
I had used TID in the past and was very impressed with how quick and easy it was to take out cover. However, I recently made a claim and had a very different customer experience.

While travelling in Hanoi, Vietnam I had my day pack stolen. I immediately went to the local police station to report the theft. After a very frustrating 3 hours, I gave up after being told in no uncertain terms that I could not report it stolen (reporting it stolen would require the police have to escalate the matter, requiring more work) and that if I did I would have to surrender my passport - not exactly the best idea in any country, let alone Vietnam!

So, I rang the TID 24 hour emergency helpline to explain the situation and that gaining a police report was next to impossible considering where I was travelling. The helpline attendant stated that he to had travelled to Hanoi and could appreciate the difficulty I was experiencing. He said that our phone conversation had been recorded and could be played back to the case manager when my claim was being evaluated.

Upon returning to Australia I immediately filed my claim with all the required supporting documentation (except the police report). To cut a long story short, I had to wait 6 weeks to hear back only to be told that my claim had been declined on account of the police report being omitted. This "one size fits all" approach with no regard to individual circumstances is nothing short of a scam. There are extensive areas of the world where gaining such documentation is simply impossible. I will never use TID again and will be loudly discrediting them as an insurance provider to all of my friend and family - many of whom travel extensively.

title: Very bad, claim taking too long,
body:
My mum became ill when overseas and when she returned, we tried to lodge the claim. We were told to send medical report from overseas clinic, travel itinerary, insurance documents and release of medical records from her GP here in AU. we did and waited tor ten days, when I called them after the 10 days, I was told that there was an error and that I was supposed to receive a claim form as well. The person I spoke to sent the form, we filled it in and waited another 10 days, after the second period of ten days they send me yet another for to be completed by my mum's GP and then have to wait another 10 business days. If we have already sent them the release of medical information for in the beginning all they had to do is contact her GP for her medical information. There's no end to the forms that we have to fill, send and follow up with calls to make sure they have received it, it's taking up a lot of time. To make things worst, I speak to a different person every time. It appears that they are going out their way to make things difficult and avoid paying the claim. I will never use Allianz  insurance again and would advise anyone to stay away from them.

March 25th 2017 Update: When will this end???

I have already written a review on Allianz Travel Insurance on the 2nd of March. I am now on the forth cycle of having to wait for certain number of business days, this time its 15!! I have called Allianz on the 20th of March regarding the claim, I was told that the claim has been settled but Allianz paid the overseas hospital/clinic 85EU, the total bill is 6.800EU - THEY DID NOT CONTACT ME TO INFORM ME OF THAT, If I had not called them on the 20th, I would not have known that.  I gave them the details of the travel agent who sold my mum the policy, but when she called them they said they did not have her details, however, they told her that the case was closed because I took too long with documents. The people at the Allianz call center would NOT give me the number of the complaints department, I had to get it from the OMBUDSMAN!!! The person at complaints seemed helpful and put me on to a lady who is going to handle my claim from now on, however,  I was sent another Medical Certificate form for my mum's Dr to fill in - the same one that I had already received and took to her Dr on the 7th of March. It looks like I have to pay again $70 for the Dr to fill in the form. NOT happy! People buy travel insurance for peace of mind but its' been anything but that!

July 24th 2017 Update: Still no resolution despite being informed that Allianz will pay claim.

I have written an earlier review on Mar 02, 2017. I have received a phone call and email from the Travel claims review on the 12/04/2017 informing me that the Chief Medical Officer has confirmed cover for my mum's medical expenses, I thought it was finally over but not so! I have contacted a friend over seas and they informed me that Allianz has not yet paid the clinic. On the 20/07/2017 I receive the following email from Claims department:  "Your claim will now go through a short auditing and finance process, if there are any concerns in regards to my recommendation, I will be in contact with you within 3 business days. Otherwise the funds will be deposited into your medical provider within 4-6 weeks. "That means the claim is not resolved, I don't know what to do anymore.

title: Not cheap but cheaper than others
body:
I travel quite often, and these days I pay for travel insurance. 

Cover More has been my travel insurance company since ever, meaning since I started paying for travel insurance. I found the pricing of the polices really exaggerated, taking into account that I have rarely had any problem and that this might be the case of most travellers. Just guessing!. 

However, there is no detour. I have compared CM with other travel insurance companies (even with my health insurance company, which offers discounts in travel insurance to members) and CM is cheaper or the same price but it has more benefits in their policies. So I am stuck with them.

I would like their policies to be a bit more considerate with regular customers. But they do not have regulars because their idiotic system does not record us as such, no matter how many times you book your insurance with them. They should implement a rewards point system for people who regularly buy their policies, and points added for travels done without claiming anything. Then, turn the points into discounts and voila. That would make me happy.  And you. 

The only time I had to launch a claim, everything was easy peasy. I claimed a night in a hotel for a last minute flight change that forced me to move intercity immediately and the only thing I could find available was a room in a five star hotel. I produced the receipt, told them what had happened and I was fully reimbursed, no fuss. 

In the past, I used to book on the phone because their website was good for quotes but useless for booking. Currently it is pretty good and I book directly online. 

I am never happy paying so much money to a travel insurance company, but, really, if I got sick or something bad happened to me overseas, their policies give me peace of mind, and their cheaper than other companies out there. So let it be.

This was done but I asked for an assurance that their would be no issue with the fact that my husband would be 50 when we travel if we needed to claim.  All she said was that their calls were recorded and to record her name and time and date of call (which I have done).  The stupid thing is that they have issued a new policy and it is at a cheaper price than I had previously paid. ($30)  As I kept saying to them that when I originally did the quote etc I had put in for an over 50 at time of travel.  Their customer service was restricted by their computor system limitations!  All I can say is with all the mucking around I hope I don't have to claim and they decide the policy isn't valid due to my husbands age!  We will wait and see!!

title: Underhanded and dishonest re handling Covid 19 travel cancellation
body:
We purchased a  fully comprehensive policy  for our cruise /holiday through Budget . It was purchased in February with the salesperson strongly reassuring us we would be fully covered for  all cancellation .This policy was worded  It included epidemics .
We were told if we got covi19 while travelling were would not be covered . But would be covered should it be cancelled.
We would not have purchased this policy if it didn't include cancellation . And we were reassured we would  be covered  if the cruise company cancelled . 
26th March long after our holiday was cancelled we got a email from Budget suggesting an error was made and we had been sent the wrong disclosure statement . This is after we contacted Budget to seek a claim and we  were assured at that time that we qualified for a claim  . The policy we purchased stated it was effective November 2019 . The new disclaimer was now Effective March 2020 and the wording of an epidemic removed . This is pure deception and totally immoral .
We will pursue this until we are compensated as promised by Budget .

After several phone calls and emails, all instigated by myself, due to lack of communication by them, on the 29th April they declined my claim as I was unable to provide a "Written Report from the Authorities"  I was staying in a Freedom Camp with no caretaker/manager so within 24 hours I took the phone to reputable repairer for assessment and they provided me with a report.  Apparently this is not good enough for Insure and Go as under their guidelines I needed to report it to either the Caravan Park Manager,  Transport Provider, Tour Operator or some other form of Authority??? So a report from a reputable company being MAC OPS in Queenstown is not good enough.  On 30th April I escalated my claim to their Internal Dispute Resolution Process and at this point in time I have not had an acknowledgement or decision from this department.  Very poor !!  Next step I guess will be the Australian Financial Complaints Authority.
This is the first time 35 years of travelling that I have ever made a claim on my travel insurance.  Happy to take your money but not to payout on a legitimate claim.

title: A relief. It was much easier than I'd anticipated.
body:

When I found out all flights out of Queenstown were cancelled for the day our group was meant to leave, I knew I would be looking at further accommodation and travel costs before getting home. I had never submitted an insurance claim previously, and with the reputations of some insurance companies being quite poor, I was unsure of how successful my claims would be.
When I made my claim, which even included a long-distance taxi trip to another airport in order to get home, the staff I spoke with were very helpful, and my claim was processed and approved much quicker than I'd anticipated. I'm glad I kept all my paperwork in order, as this made the claim process much less stressful.
Overall, I was impressed, and will definitely be using Cover-More for my travel insurance in the future.
Quick, simple, not stressful at all.

title: Should be called no cover - Read Terms and Conditions - all 80 pages!
body:
Took out a policy in good faith with no pre-existing conditions - no idea what injury, illness, sickness or condition would befall me but wanted the reassurance of cover should I have to cancel my trip or get sick. Many months after taking out the policy I discovered I was pregnant and when I went to claim, discovered I was not covered as my pregnancy at the time of travel would have been after 26 weeks. Idiotic rule - if I was less than 26 weeks I would have still taken the trip. At the time of travel I would have been 39 weeks and no airline carrier or doctor would have allowed me to travel. Worse still the response from your company was 'it is in the terms and conditions'. The moronic thing about this is that I didn't know I was going to fall pregnant so I couldn't make the decision to buy the policy based on the terms and conditions!!! To add insult to injury - you just sent me an email asking me how my trip was when you know I didn't take it because I lodged a claim. Never use you again and I have told hundreds of people of my experience.
The only thing was the consultant was 'helpful' on the phone.
My claim was not honoured.

title: Easy to purchase online cover that suited our needs.
body: Reasonably priced cover for a couple for international travel during our holiday to Japan that suited our needs and gave us peace of mind. I purchased the comprehensive policy a few days before our departure for myself and my partner (30yo & 25yo) for $83.12 in total. Excess was quoted as $150 for claims, and the policy offered cover up to $25,000 for cancellation fees and lost deposits. I was emailed the certificate of insurance and PDS immediately after completion of my purchase. The online application form was easy to fill out requiring basic information and I recall being fairly quick from start to finish (after some hours of fairly extensive online research of course). Our cover included our priorities for claims related to accident or injury (not including previous medical conditions unless specified in PDS), theft or loss of  passports, baggage, money, belongings etc., cancellation/delay of flights & bookings, as well as cover for accident/damage/excess for our planned go-karting activity in Tokyo. I did not need to claim for anything for our trip so cannot comment on that aspect, however, if I was travelling again I would be likely to use this type of cover again.

I travel a lot because of work and most of the time I am covered under my Dinners Insurance, this time I had to buy insurance as my dinners was full and I had to travel urgently to Japan. I extend my trip  for 2 more weeks after work confrences. I made the worst mistake of my life by getting TID. 

The reason why I bought insurance was as I read on the Trip Advisor that Japan is risky. Unfortunately I got mugged in Tokyo and I lost my cameras and laptops and some more stuff. 

The person over the phone so called claims "officer" is more like a CIA agent, you will be amazed when I will tell you the questions he is asking me. I can let go all the giggling on the background from them but the worst is the humiliation I going through. I was at the police station from 11PM until 4AM and I was mugged, have some sympathy when you talk to customers like this. 

They asked me to send everything original (Invoices, Police Report) even after I scanned everything. 1 week gone for them to call me back at the start. He even asked me to send him the credit card statement to prove that I bought those times even after sending Invoices. Ok done that after waiting another week from the bank to send me. 

On the first day when he called me he asked me, why did I buy 2 laptops, I mean seriously????? 
Then he asked me why the invoice says cash when you bought it from credit card... for god sakes why would I know. 

He kept trying to prove everything I am saying has something fishy about it, he got me in trap of words when I said I had my main camera, I had 3 cameras as I am learning photography, I made a crime saying that. anyway there is more....

Today after 4 days of delivery of the documents I sent them, the same guy calls me again, He said to me we called [name removed] and [name removed] is saying that they always send the email about the delivery confirmation, you have to send us that confirmation email and guess what I found that email from months agoooo... what will he come up with now I wonder. 

They have all my personal information, I think they call all the vendors pretending they are you... otherwise how can he even call [name removed] and how can [name removed] give him information about the purchase I made like months ago....

And not only that one of the item was the watch I bought was back in 2012 and he said to me the day you bought the watch you bought in Brisbane and next day in your credit card you have a transaction in Sydney...... I mean really...... I fly a lot, do you get this? I fly a lot. 
I told him that for work I travel a lot, he asked me what do i do for work, I am sure he must have checked Linked in before hand, I am not sure if he is even legally entitled to ask me such questions. but anyway.... this doesn't stop here. 

He then asked me to send him my 2012 travel Itinerary... I asked him to send me an email with whatever he needs, he wasn't even willing to send me the email... anyway he did now I have everything documented and I think I had enough....  

I have written everything to fairfax about this... is there anyone who had such an experience with them????... I am not going to leave this like this..

title: I will use them again
body: We had an unexpected interruption to our travel while overseas. I made a claim for additional expenses and it was paid. When it comes down to it, that is why you have insurance.

title: Don't get sick!
body: Whilst away , my husband became ill! Rather than focusing on his health, I found you were more worried about the dollars! Your staff were friendly and helpful, but would I recommend you? NO

title: excellent
body: good value for money and the app was very handy to review the policy. especially as i was in bali and a volcano was threatening to erupt whilst i was there, potentially causing bad flight delays.

title: Disorganised and unprofessional
body: Only got as far as submitting a pre-existing condition form which has always been covered by previous insurers. I was told I would have an answer in two days and I waited over a week for an answer then had to chase up 1cover myself and after much chasing around was told my application was declined.  We then insured with reputable company for same conditions which took less than 24 hrs.  Seems 1cover could be ok for simple policies but I would be hesitant to take a chance on a policy with pre-existing conditions, no matter how small, as they don't appear to treat those clients professionally or with the same respect as "normal" policies. Wish we hadn't wasted our time with this company.

title: Too Easy
body: This is the fourth time I've used 1 Cover Travel Insurance and it's always easy to apply and set up.  Customer service was always friendly and patient.  I will definitely use them again.

title: Ripped Off.
body: No refunds available. Absolutely disgusting the way Insureandgo are treating people not being able to get a refund or extension for new travel dates. Do not use this Insurer. Appalling.

title: Travel insurance
body: Although I have never had to claim anything, the process of buying travel insurance was en easy effort. They have excellent car coverages which is really the main thing that I look for as we only travel within Australia. The cost us very reasonable and if you have an entertainment book they are often in there with a discount code.

title: Fair process and good service with the right result. Thank you.
body:
We had to claim $2,500 for extra travel expenses because we misssed our flight home to Australia from the Solomon Islands due to poor weather. TID could have tried to shift the burden on to one of the airlines involved or a credit card company used for a small portion of the holiday but they didn't. The claims process took a litle bit of effort to collect the supporting data for our claim. But we were treated fairly throughout and TID paid our claim in full, which was fair. Thank you very much. I will always use TID in future.
The insurance was inexpensive and the claims process fair

title: Quick and easy
body: Easy and quick to set up with clear instructions and good value for money. Thankfully we didn't have to make a claim, so we can't comment on the claim process.

title: Fantastic value for money!
body: It was great value and had no problems applying for it. Luckily I didn't have to use it. Will apply for the same policy again when I travel in July.

title: Good range of cover
body:
Finding a travel insurance policy is a minefield! Apart from some standard items of cover, each provider has a different range of items that are covered & for differing values. Sorting through the cover needed is time consuming task.
Allianz had the cover we needed, it wasn't the cheapest but we knew that they had a good reputation as an insurer. Even with pre-existing medical items to cover it was relatively easy to set up.
Haven't had to make a claim yet so don't know whether that would be a pleasant experience or not.

title: Good
body:
Good value when you need it
Easy to set up
Did not use customers support
That?s all I have to say

title: Online claims form has been broken for 2 weeks
body: I'm starting to think this is a scam. They only accept claims within 60 days and their portal has been down now for 2 weeks so far. It's always a different error.

title: Great cover and service
body: We've used 1Cover for a number of trips now.  Policy is easy to set up and very affordable.  Had to claim on medical expenses the last time.  Easy claim service and processed the same day with NO hassles.  Will definitely continue to use 1Cover.

title: Bad
body:
I used covermore as my travel insurer for our 2 recent trips to Los Angeles. My daughter had an accident and had to be transported by ambulance to the local hospital and had to have a procedure. We contacted Covermore when we got home and we forwarded them the paperwork along with the bills. 
It took about 8 months for them to negotiate with the companies but the account was eventually settled. We did not pay for the bills at the time so we were not out of pocket in anyway which was fine but if you had paid them and were waiting to be reimbursed it would have been a long wait.
Paid the claim
Took along time to finalise the claim

title: First Timer
body: Very easy to set up online, did not need to make a claim,this is my first time with you,will go again on our next trip with 1 Cover Insurance Thank You

title: Thank you
body: Being covered allowed for stress free flights and adventure. After having talked to customer service I was confident and trusted the policy. Easy to set up. Questions all answered.  Pre travel tips via email were excellent..helpful. Thank you. Will use Allianz for further travels

title: Great Value & Peace of Mind
body:
We had several flights booked with accommodation and car hire on our two week holiday, although we did not need to make a claim on our domestic travel insurance it was good to know it was there to help out if we required it.  We have used A1 cover several times in the past both domestic and International and have no complaints at all, very easy to book and have made one small claim and it all went smoothly. We would use A1 Cover again and can highly recommend them.

November 20th 2014 Update:
Once again took out 1 Cover travel insurance for overseas trip with 7 flights & car hire included. I had peace of mind during my travels knowing that I had the cover if anything went wrong and fortunately I did not have to claim.  I found the booking of the policy process was simple

November 27th 2016 Update: Excellent

Policy was great value and gave peace of mind with our travel plans. I took the policy out on line it was very simple. Customer service was excellent when phoned them with a query they sorted a change of dates on the policy due to flight changes made by airlines without any hassle.
Peace of mind value for money

title: Peace of Mind Travel insurance
body: Travelled with the protection of 1Cover travel insurance on many occasions. Have needed to make a number of claims over the past 5 years and all claims have been processed and settled in an extremely professional and timely manner. Claims related to illness, accidents and weather events before and during travel.

title: Nice and easy
body: Nice and easy online quote, covered all things that we needed Include the ability to drop the excess. We found the pricing to be very competitive and represent value for money.

title: Professional and Affordable
body:
Used it 4 times
Easy to set up on line and also able to talk to a person if required. 
Never made a claim
Great value for money
I have recommended them too

title: Fantastic service
body: Easy process even if you have existing medical conditions. We have used this company several times now and at present see no reason why we should change our CoverMore Travel Insurance company.

title: Must Have Travel Insurance
body: I have used 1 Cover 3 times and will definitely use them again as.  It is a must to have travel insurance.

title: Affordable quality insurance
body: Never leave the country without my 1cover insurance policy! It's good value and covers just about everything. The one time I needed it, 1cover come through! Highly recommend buying your policy through 1cover.

title: Medical Claim
body: My husband had to go into hospital in Barcelona, and when we returned to Australia, I submitted a claim to 1 Cover.  I sent the appropriate forms and receipts and 1 Cover were very prompt in paying and claim, without any problems. So thanks a bunch.

title: Bali Volcano
body: Phoned today to check on my coverage for cancellation of my trip to Bali, apparently you can no longer get insurance for Bali but my existing policy is worthless because Volcano is still  yet to erupt. Looks like you can have a bet both ways if you are Travel Insurance Company.

title: Will go with another company next time
body: Helpful at first & offered all the right things you think you need when on holiday however, I highly doubt anyone gets actual cover. Needed cover whilst on holiday, not when back home in Australia. Thought travel insurance was suppose to help you out when travelling. Had my bags taken & saw a doctor, they asked for a police report, then when I got one, all of a sudden, they dont need it. Youre not covered when others cause you harm or steal your stuff. Last time I checked, I couldnt control what others choose to do. This is the first time I had to use my insurance on a holiday. Unfortunately I had to keep asking what I needed to do next. Nothing was ever offered. Heading to Bali in a month, will choose another company but will pursue what Im entitled to as stated in the disclaimer. Wasted my money with Cover More.

title: Do not purchase this travel insurance. Its a scam.
body:
My credit card has this travel insurance as a complimentary comprehensive travel insurance. 

Lodged the claim end of May. It took them a month and a half in investigations, requesting an entire file of documents which were all provided and they came back with refusal of the claim for loss of items and damaged bag after two months of claim submission stating that the itemized loss was not reported to the police or government authority within 24 hours. We were in transit with an onward international flight to catch in a couple of hours, tried to report the loss to the airline staff but there was no one at the airline counter at that time. The 24 hour time frame they state was not even enough time to reach back to Melbourne. They have a review process that is useless as they come back with the same . Have to now report to ACCC and take them to court.

Do not purchase this travel insurance as they will not pay you money when its time to claim.

My loss was around $18000 that they refuse to pay. Hopeless travel insurance provider. Do not deal with the. They are a scam.

body: I found it very Easy & quick  to set up online. I would have however liked to see an option offered to apply a discount when you have other insurance existing with Allianz.

body: Will not sell multi-trip cover to persons over the age of 75. Their agents, NRMA, apologised profusely but said there is nothing they can do about this. Go to Australian Seniors Insurance. They do cover people of this age and over.

title: Just what I was Looking for
body: The policy application process was straight forward and easy to follow.  Very pleased with the extras and value for money.  Excess offered is very reasonable and not excessive.  Highly recommended

title: I always use Allianz travel insurance
body:
We feel that the policy was good value for what we needed 
I set up the policy over the phone and then Allianz emailed me our statement of insurance
I feel that on this experience on the phone the provider customer support person was a little hash

title: Quick to take my money, slow to respond to a claim
body:
I am in the process of making a claim and the response times and customer service are appalling. I submitted everything requested of me online then waited 10 days for any kind of response. I was then asked for a medical certificate from my Dr despite providing one from the treating Dr in Thailand. I had to take time off work and pay for the Dr's appointment and then submitted his report as required. I had no contact for another couple of weeks and now i have been asked to provide written information from my airline! This should have all been reviewed and requested at the same time instead of drawing the process out one request at a time. The call line is always so busy you hang up after half an hour and the online status update is useless. 
Use this company if you want an easy process to sign up and pay but beware if you need to make a claim they will make it difficult and drawn out!

title: Absolutely Atrocious
body:
We have been dealing with the most unresponsive company ever! We made a claim on lost luggage. Upon making this claim we have sent all documents that was asked. And then to be asked further documentation, this then added another 10 business days for a response. (N.B another 10 business days have been added to this claim making it up to almost 30 Business Days). 

How are we suppose to get old receipts for all the lost item that was in the luggage! So instead they asked for an estimate date and cost for the lost item. I had explained to the consultant that those details were addressed from my very first initial claim. However, she went on to argue that they weren't it. If she had checked the dates from when the missing items were purchased and the date  we travelled she could see that they were two completely different dates.

title: Would never use again!!
body:
Whilst visiting family in the UK, I got rushed into hospital with appendicitis, this meant I had to extend my trip. As I was staying with family, all I had to do was delay my flight, you think this would be any easy request?! I informed the insurance company thinking I was doing the right thing-what followed was endless phone calls-some at 2am! To be told that the nurse I spoke to on the phone declared me fit to fly (this was very clever as I was thousands of miles away and she couldn't see that I couldn't even walk!) The surgeon who performed the operation said I wasn't to fly for at least 4 weeks to allow the swelling to go down and minimise the risk of blood clots. After going through unexpected emergency surgery the last thing I needed was all this stress, in the end and after getting nowhere with the insurance company my husband phoned the airline direct (from New Zealand!) and they just moved the flight date-easy as that! I was asked on return if I had received good service-sent an email of complaint, was told it would be looked into-never heard a thing back! I went again to the UK last year, was going to give them another try, sent an email to ensure I wouldn't be given the same treatment if I used them again-didn't hear back! It's a shame you are not as eager in dealing with complaints as you are with diagnosing over the phone!!
The price!
Poor service

body: Service, policy and cost all fabulous.  Am always happy to cover my travels with 1Cover, leaving home without insurance would be pure madness and the ease of insuring with 1 Cover always makes it my number one choice!!

title: Great Deal!
body: Great value. Super easy; website is easy to navigate, good package options to choose from. Took me only 5min to get insured!

title: Good value and easy
body: While thankfully we had no need to use the policy, it was simple and quick and affordable to access the travel insurance cover for peace of mind, just in case.

title: Good value
body: Policy was reasonably priced.  We had reached a number of policies and Allianz Travel insurance covered everything we needed.  It was easy to apply and simple to understand.  We were lucky not to have to make a claim.

title: Had a claim which was processed hassel free.
body: Good Value Insurance, had a claim for a cruise ship medical expense Insureandgo were fantastic kept us informed and helped with putting in the claim. we had no problems and would use them again. Well done.

title: Glad I can count on Covermore
body:
I have a rare condition caused by a pituitary tumour and Covermore is one of the few that cover this. 

On two occasions I have claimed with Covermore (but on something separate to my rare condition).   The first being in 2015 where we were involved in a car accident in New Zealand. Injuries were incurred and they flew us and our companions home in business class and took care of us for the week of recovery in New Zealand. The second claim was just a month ago when I fell sick on a ship voyage, their approval has just been received and how happy I am!  I outlaid $1400US dollars for attending a doctor on the ship and only being on a drip, a blood and urine test (that's around $1800 AU).

People who travel overseas without insurance are CRAZY!!!

title: When the trains stopped - Cover more stepped in
body:
We were in Genova (Italy) and travelling Europe on a tight schedule with a Eurail pass.  We were scheduled to travel to Nice when we were hit with a snap train strike.  We would have lost a nights accommodation in Nice and had to pay for another nights accomodation in Genova.  The only bus for the day had left and there are no direct flights between the cities.  Our only option was a private driver which cost 300 euros.  I rung Covermore and was immediately told my policy would cover the cost of the driver.  Not only did this save us money but more importantly did not lose a day out of the wonderful time we had in Nice.
The way in which the person on the phone was able to give us immediate approval for our claim.

title: Dont bother - shame on you Medibank
body: We missed a connecting flight in the US because we were held up in customs for 3.5 hours.  There was absolutely nothing we could do about this.  We caught the next flight out which was at 5.30am the next morning.  Medibank Private "just don't cover this".  Why would you bother with insurance if something that is no fault of your own is simply "not covered".  Don't bother - wish I had read the reviews before purchasing.

title: Be warned the worst company i have ever dealt with
body: Worst bunch of deceiving people I have ever dealt with. There web site is full of deceit as well. Be careful using these insurers and they will do anything not to help you with a claim. I have now lodged a complaint with the financial ombudsman and I bet this doesn't make the review page.

title: Poor policy hard to understand - discriminatory
body:
I recently reviewed 1Cover praising them for their products (478 people read )
I just tried to book a multiple travel policy as I will be taking 3 overseas trips. After taking my details ( I have used them 8 times recently) they advised they will only cover me for single trips because I am over 64 yrs as this is their underwriting policy. I wrote asking for an explanation which they couldn't give me. They are happy to give me 3 single policy but they will not give me one multiple policy. Two other insurers will without hesitation. Off to Covermore I go. Very poor business practice and customer relations. Loyalty?? ps I think I made one claim with them 3 or four years ago.

title: Great telephone service
body: I message up my online travel policy and it was very easy to make a phone and speak to a real person to get it all sorted out.  I have no experience of making a claim at this stage, but have used Insure and Go travel insurance previously and have found them to be competitive in price.

title: Long time customer but not anymore
body: I used 1 Cover for years. I double insured for a trip in error and 1 Cover would not refund the premium. ( I phoned and called a consultant to explain prior to paying explaining that I was not sure if my wife had taken out insurance for our family and was assured that I could get a refund if I was already insured). I received one line responses from 1 Cover. I am sure the customer acquisition cost is higher than the $139 that caused me to move to another insurer.

title: Travel insurance
body: Excellent service and so easy to arrange by phone.  I thought it was good value. Staff really helped me to arrange my insurance and explained everything to me. Great peace of mind with the insurance.

title: Fee For NO Service
body:
I took out cover with 1Cover for a Cunard cruise around Australia over April/May 2020.

As we all know, COVID-19 hit the world and the Australian Government mandated the cancellation of all cruises. So, no fault of ours or 1Cover's. Government mandate.

We had a Royal Commission into financial institutions which found, among other things, the reprehensible practice of charging "FEES FOR NO SERVICE".

1Cover has offered me, and others, a time limited credit but no refund. As there is no likelihood of international travel being allowed within the foreseeable future, and because I would not even consider overseas travel within the next couple of years, any credit would be useless and nothing short of a refund would be acceptable.

Under the circumstances, there has been no risk or, in fact, anything to cover by 1Cover so I just do not understand why they are refusing to refund in full. It would appear to be a clear case of charging a "FEE FOR NO SERVICE".

Really 1Cover? What an absolutely disgraceful attitude to take. Clear warning to anyone considering using this company for future travel cover.

title: 1Cover is different!
body:
1Cover was the only insurer I approached that I felt happy with. Most companies I tried were very risk averse - they seemed to use the same few questions, one size fits all, and (in my case) rejection was the default. Others accepted after very few questions but wanted a very high premium. 
1Cover treated me on my merits as an individual, and charged an acceptable level of premium.
The policy was easy to set-up and I was very happy with the support I received in the process.

title: Happy Customer
body: My policy was very good value compared to other quotes. Great peace of mind traveling overseas.   The instructions were easy to follow and I understood what I was covered for. No claim needed.

title: Camino

title: Travel Insurance.
body:

This is the second time I have used Allianz travel insurance and would use again.

title: This is perfect

I lodged a claim and resolved within 3-4 weeks. The staff was very supportive and helpful.
I used insurance and go twice on my international trips

title: haven't gone yet
body: have used you a couple of times but would like to leave my review till time if I have to claim this time. will  let you know then. haven't traveled yet

title: Disaster averted
body:
We had our trip of a lifetime booked in March 2013. 3 months travelling to all sorts of exotic locations - a tour with friends to the Great Wall of China and Xian, followed by an ATP tour of Vietnam and Cambodia. Then off to Bangkok to meet our daughter for a few days before we were to fly to Dubai where we would board the Oceania Nautica for a cruise through the Suez Canal and the Mediterranean. Visas organised, air, hotels, side tours booked and paid for, when, 2 weeks out, my husband, [name removed], was diagnosed with tongue and throat cancer. During this stressful period, I contacted Cover More with whom I had purchased an annual policy, and they could not have been more helpful and specific with what I had to do.  With the help of my travel agent who liased with them regarding his bookings and my own paperwork, a doctors report and confirmation of the diagnosis and treatment and our claim was approved and paid with a minimum of fuss. Thanks to their great service, we are now able, 6 months later, to resume at least part of our trip as [name removed] has recovered sufficiently to take a cruise. We are very happy with our Cover More experience and would not hesitiate to use them in future and recommend them to friends.
Easy to contact and talk directly to an advisor.

title: Expensive !!
body: I am a regular traveler and have routinely used 1Cover without ever making a claim yet my premiums are always going up.  Hardly fair.  Many others offer the same comprehensive coverage at much lower prices.

title: A no brainer for any travel!
body: There are not many companies you can rely on to give you good service - 1 Cover is the exception.  This company is brilliant.  Their policies are easy to purchase, they have specials all the time and they are very reasonably priced.  We have used them for years now and had to claim on our most recent trip.  Our 8 year old daughter ended up in a hospital and they were amazing.  From the moment she went to hospital, they would call me daily to check in our, had their own doctors on hand to talk to and arranged for us to return back to Australia.  Fantastic service!

title: Delay at Changi Airport
body: Our 6pm flight home from Singapore was delayed until 4am due to fog at Perth Airport. We needed to find somewhere for our two young children to sleep. The transit hotels were full and there were only 3 rooms available at the Crowne Plaza. We knew it wouldn't be cheap but last time we got stuck like this the kids got sick and had to have a week off school. The bill was $332 and Cover-More paid $232 (less the $100 excess we nominated). I was impressed it only took one online form and six business days from lodgement to payment. Thanks Cover-More.

title: Very happy with my Insurance experience
body:
During the first few days of a 5-week overseas trip my Video Camera was damaged which prevented videos for the whole trip. On arriving home I arranged to have it repaired and contacted Medibank Travel Insurance about a claim. They contacted me and suggested that I pay for the repair and send them details of the invoice/receipt and detail the repairs and camera details (make, model, serial number etc).
10 days after sending them the receipt details I received a deposit in my bank account for the full repair amount minus the excess. No more questions or problems. I was very happy with the process.

title: Great value
body: The online claim was very easy to use and the whole process was excellent. Your staff was very helpful and professional. I will definitely use them again for my future trips.

title: Good service
body: This is the second time we have bought a policy from InsureAndGo. It was easy to understand and set up. The assistant was friendly and helpful. Last time we used this company we had to claim, and they were extremely helpful, kindly and we had no problems being reimbursed for our trip. I recommend them highly. title: Not good enough!!
body:
I have used Covermore Insurance 7 times over the last few years and paid thousands $$$ in premiums for my freedom to come and go from Australia.  Each time I have  been loaded up with extra premiums for a heart stent inserted 7 years ago, and last year when I turned the magical age of 70 years which the travel insurance cartels (?) love to use as an excuse for loading up your premiums.  Regardless of this so-called risky health problem, on my last trip overseas, I fell very ill and had to consult a cruise ship's doctor who almost had me medi-vacced out in the Mediteranean Sea, but I fortuately responded to treatment.  Oddly enough it was not a heart problem at all (even though judged as high risk) but a bad case of the shingles complicated by extreme constipation (the traveller' nightmare). Whilst CM paid for an unscheduled expensive night in a Swiss Hotel and return taxi fares from/to my ticketed destination, they chose to deny my further claim in Spain from the same complaint which had bcome very severe.  I continued my trip in great pain because I had made prior arrangements to meet up with my son and dauhter-in=law who had travelled from Japan to meet me there and knew  that when that happened they would look after me.  

This they did, but it necessitated almost a whole day at a hospital in madrid where I was checked out and given every test possible, furnished with  a 4 page copy of all the tests undertaken (and drug prescriptions) confirming that I indeed had a bad case of shingles.  Because with my son's assistance we travelled to the South of Spain as originally intended, and took up our pre-paid hire car for 4 days where I was driven in reasonable comfort but still in much pain.  On returning to Madrid my illness was so bad that I felt obliged to change my air ticketing, originally from Paris, to fly direct from Madrid to Singapore some 5 days earlier.  Hence I was up for a ticket change and when I reached Singapore extra hotel expenses, as after an all night flight my son insisted that I stop over in Singapore for a couple of nights to enable me to gather my strength to continue back to Australia.  CM would not cover the second claim (in spite of cancellation cover) , because I did not get a letter from the doctor telling me I had to return home immediatelyafter the visit to the Madrid Hospital - it was in fact 6 days later.  

The extra costs incurred by my illness amounted to some $800 I was out of pocket.  Whilst I took on an excess of $250 to lessen the cost of the travel insurance, this section of the on-line form is very cleverly included in the health area which is very misleading., because it  in fact applies to what they call a separate event.   Hence, each time you have a medical event (I had two of the same  they subtract $250.  Any doctor or medical professional ought to know that shingles is a very debilitating  illness that goes on for months long after you have contracted it, and it reoccurs for the rest of your life.  My doctor in fact completed a form on  my behalf confirming that I had acute case of Shingles when I visitef him the day after my rturn (and still do 7 months later).

A pair of expensive gucci sunglasses which had the arms broken off at the hinge were deemed to be worth $285 (1 year old and in mint condition) which they covered as a separate event, but then deducted another $250.

I have since learnt that there are other possibilities for older travellers like myself and happened to get this information just recently.  The probus club of Australia (an off-shoot of rotary) due to concerns of many of its members who have often been rejected by travel insurance companies perpetuating this "cartel mentality", offer a Travel Insurance to those over 50 years, and remarkably up to 100 years (Covermore please note!)  with all pre-existing conditions guaranteed cover and no medical forms required.  They are available for one trip up to 90 days and cost a mere $250 approx.  One must be a member to partake of this privilege, but there are many clubs around who are keen to increase membership.   They are largely social clubs catering to retirees, who also run Club Cruises and Tours overseas, but one can use the travel insurance for private travel also.  I recommend you seek a membership of their club, as I am presently doing.
Took my application, after the duration had expired (only to reject large part of it)
Unreaosonable response to a genuine claim.  Huge premiums extracted for freedom to travel, or you don't go.  (Foreign Affairs warning)

Stupid me renewed my policy with Insure and Go, only to be given the runaround on another claim. This time my passport was stolen in Bangkok airport and I had to fly home undocumented. Despite this - and a letter from the Australian Government confirming as such - it is now 4 weeks and they are still giving me the runaround. Last communication I responded to was 2 weeks ago and just spoke to them and they are hinting to me that they intend to reject the claim. NEVER Use this company if you ever need to make a claim - which could be anytime on a trip. They do their best never to pay out policies.
