title: DO NOT TOUCH COVER-MORE - They are seriously deceptive.
body: Covermore is refusing to repay the cost of cancellations for flights etc during this current Medical Pandemic, Coronavirus Virus. Further they are refusing to cover any costs incurred as a result of travel disruption that may be experienced or imposed by Governments as a result of this Virus.This appears typical of a lot of insurers that a very quick to promise everything and take your money but will find any "fine-print" clause to wiggle out of paying what people have paid good money for peace of mind. They are deceptive, dishonest and given that the WHO has triggered a "Global Health Emergency" I would have thought that both Insurers and Airlines would be more "user-friendly" with customers. For me I have learnt who NOT to deal with. That will include Covermore. (go to your bank or broker as your credit card may give you better insurance anyway. I would avoid companies that stoop to such low levels of service under the most unusual and unexpected circumstances. This Virus obviously no one saw coming. Its just the sort of thing right out of left field that you would expect your insurance to step up for. But no, they run a mile when the chips are down and find any "fine-print" way out of paying. Despicable attitude and action.  This alone should warn customers of what type of behavior Covermore adopt. It reminds me of the big flood when some Insurers were trying to dodge payment by saying "the water came from above not below (or visa-versa)" so your not covered. Ridiculous!  If I'm knee deep in water do I really care if it came from up or down! I'm flooded, that is what I thought I paid insurance for. I'd get all Insurers to personally list for you EXACTLY what ISN'T covered on a separate signed sheet, not the usual 600 page PDF written in legal goble-degook that no one reads anyway. And if you actually read and manage to understand it, you will see that decoded it means "there is really stuff all that we will actually be liable for" Maybe a Royal Commission into these shady practices would be good.....Hmmm maybe not, can't see that the banks listened to much! Covermore is in that absolute lowest part of trustworthiness that we  see from the banks. Just despicable operators, shop elsewhere. (you will see I have said no to the question "did you make a claim" this is because our Agent said it would not be approved. Further this pretty high profile Agency doesn't have many nice words re Covermore's attitude in these difficult times). Don't trust Covermore to pay for anything that you think you have covered. Wonder how many horror stories are out there re Covermore? Talk about them to others to warn them about how they can't be trusted. I have used them many times, but never again.

title: Awful experience and left stranded with no insurance cover!!
body:
We get travel insurance to help us in our dire time of need. I had always been pleased that part of Commonwealth bank package I received Cover from Allianz - that is until I needed to use it and after all the effort and time put into communicating with them I am left stranded with no insurance for my journey home on Sunday (8th October 2017)

I have been in communication with Allianz insurance since early August 2017. I had an anaphylactic reaction to medication prescribed by a doctor while on holiday at the end of July. 

1.	I was due to fly on the 6th of August but was not able to due to effects of reaction
2.	I was asked by Allianz to give them all information for my claim
3.	I was called 3 times to repeat the same incident to different people
4.	My GP was contacted 3 times to submit same information (of which he received acknowledgement of msg)
5.	My specialist was contacted in September to submit information already provided by me and my GP (same letter) 
6.	My specialist in Australia was away on Vacation until mid October ? I had informed Allianz of this and provided specialist in NZ to collect information from. Information was provided by this specialist in 1 day
7. Last week, Allianz said I hadn't provided information - which I re-sent again to them proofing that I had sent the information in August. (this has been the theme of repeating the same thing over and over again to no outcome). 
8..	They informed me that they were submitting all information to the medical team and should have a response asap. 
9.	Then, Allianz informed me that they were not ?chasing my NZ specialist? and understood she was away!! ? repeated to them at least 3 times that it was my Australia specialist that was away and that my NZ specialist had provided information on the same day as request
10.	My specialist in Australia office is only open on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday which Allianz was aware of and informed me repeatedly ? however Allianz wrote informing me again yesterday (Thursday) that they were going to contact them again on Friday (6th October) 
11.	Left stranded with no insurance cover on my return trip to Australia on 8th October as was informed that I would not be covered for the duration of my recovery or return trip unless my insurance claim was approved. 

Whatever the internal process is ? it is abysmal. I have been severely unwell (I was not able to talk for 10days) due to the severity of my attack. I had almost died and this had made my underlying medical condition regress to the point where I was not able to get out of bed for 2months and they had received information from my doctors informing that I was not fit to travel. I also informed Allianz that I am now able to travel and will be heading to Melbourne in a wheelchair (which I did not need while coming to NZ) Obviously I had been healthy enough to make the flight from Australia to NZ prior to being administered the drug by NZ specialist. I had also made a long haul trip with Allianz as my cover in April to Malaysia and return. For whatever reason they are mucking around with my claim of approximately $1K and now I am left with no cover to fly back to Australia as I am still recovering and I know not what to do as how do I get a new insurance that costs a fair price while I am still unwell. 

Very upset and disappointed that I am left stranded. It?s unfortunate that while being a valued customer of Commonwealth Bank, that Allianz while being polite in their dealings with me has left me in a vulnerable state in my time of need

title: Diminishing customer service quality and you now need to jump through a flaming hula hoop for claim
body:
I have used TID for more than five years and have slowly found their service to be diminishing in quality. Now claims are referred to a special team known as Cerberus whose sole aim is to cause you the most excruciating pain known to man. I mean it?s bad enough that you have had an unfortunate incident while on holidays but dealing with these guys is terrible. I?d take getting mugged at knife point over dealing with this crew again, they are that painful.

Please be aware that the claims process is intentionally drawn out and they will come back to you with a question, then after a one to two weeks delay they will ask you another question. Then they will ask you more questions after further delays on information that you have already provided, all in the hope that you put it in the too hard basket and go away.

If you are delayed due to an event such as a protest or car accident take photographic evidence at the time this occurs. I have had cases knocked back because I?m not able to show evidence of an English news article in a foreign country that doesn?t have English as a first language.

PLEASE BE AWARE THAT TID?S POLICY DOESN?T COVER YOU IF YOUR FLIGHTS ARE DELAYED AND YOU MISS YOUR CONNECTION AND PURCHASE A REPLACEMENT FLIGHT.

Despite the following appearing on TID?s website (under what we cover) which to the average traveller would suggest this.

Your Travel Is Delayed - For Operational Reasons (e.g. if the Airline delays Your flight due to mechanical reasons)
$2,000 - for any Reasonable additional meals and accommodation; or refund of pre-paid travel arrangements

I will no longer be using TID for my future travel insurance requirements and don?t mind paying more for a better quality customer service experience should a claim arise on the trip.

My son also had medication that he required in the baggage (I only kept enough for the flight as I didn't want issues coming through customs). We missed our international flight and it's connecting flight and a days accommodation, extra food etc etc. Emerites were unbelievably fantastic!! They booked us on the next flight, the next day, however, thai airways wouldn't honour the domestic ticket from Bangkok to  Phuket so we ended up having to pay $600 for flights. Now being the 'reasonable' person that I am, I believed that travel insurance covered unforeseen events which occur on your travels...no, not with TID. Anything that is likely to happen probably won't be covered. I claimed nothing else but the flights, no other extra expense or the day of accommodation and the inclusions with it, just flights. This is our first international holiday as a family. We saved for a year to go, as we are just a regular family with regular incomes and $600 is a lot of money for us!
All I can say is FAMILIES BEWARE! 
It's a shame really, because bad feedback tends to travel especially fast in this era of social media and the internet, so my $600 is a pittance to lost policies...just a thought TID

body:
This is the first time we've used TID and definitely won't be the last. Before I had taken out the policy, I did some searching on Product Review and saw TID was number one; it's no wonder. 

On day 3 of our holiday to Bali, my husband had a slip and fall accident which required a trip to the hospital. As soon as it happened, I called TID. They were so great to deal with and made everything so simple. They suggested the same hospital I did and called them to let them know we were on our way. TID said "we'll call you back in 30 mins to see how everything is", and they called back on time! It was so comforting to have someone to talk to during the 3hrs in hospital. We had to make another trip to the hospital a few days later as my husband fell ill from the first accident and I had the same great experience from their other staff. I think we spoke to 5 people in total. All were wonderful. 

We were unable to fly home as scheduled and TID were fabulous in calling us to make sure my husband was on the mend and ready to fly home. We received a lovely email from them the morning we were going home wishing us the best.
Once we got home, I submitted all of our claims to TID, hoping that I'd covered everything. One quick phone call from TID to clarify my info and a few hours later I had an email with an approved claim. 2 days later, the funds were back in my account!

We honestly cannot thank TID enough for their support and making us feel not so alone in another country. I would not choose another Travel Insurance company again. Thanks again ?

title: Avoid Medibank Private Travel Insurance like the plague
body:
I read many negative reviews about Medibank Private Travel Insurance and there is a common theme of complaints.  My experience is the same - the claims are dealt with by an underwriter, Travel Insurance Partners Pty Ltd, staff member pretending not to know of my claim notification (despite me speaking to their call centre twice whilst ill at a hospital in NYC), requiring ridiculous levels of proof for what is a minor claim for insurers (less than $2,000), delay, a failure to respond to my request for a review. I suspect that Medibank Private is frequently in breach of the Insurance Contracts Act and its duty to act with utmost good faith - this is no trivial breach.

My advice - (1) make a complaint to the Ombudsman and take it through to completion and don't rollover when the underwriter pays you a bit of money, (2) commence proceedings against Medibank Private in your local small claims court or equivalent.  Check with your community legal centre or court but there is unlikely to be any risk of an adverse costs order in the unlikely event you loose your case.  Medibank Private will have to instruct lawyers - the ASX company deserves to incur some costs.

(3) I have taken over many policies of travel insurance (and also health insurance) with Medibank Private over the years.  They will never get another cent from me.  From now on I am relying on the free travel insurance that is provided by my credit card.  Check the policy of such insurance and the amount of cover, but I was astounded to see how good the cover on offer from my credit card.  I kick myself when I think of all the money I have paid to Medibank Private over the years.

title: Pre existing medical condition not covered.
body:
I am very dissatisfied with last years change of insurance underwriter from Zurich Insurance to Allianz/1cover in the complimentary travel insurance of my Bankwest credit card if the travel is purchased on that card. In spite of the previous card insurer Zurich being able to cover me for years, the new insurers do not cover my cardiovascular disease pre existing medical condition. By taking advantage of complimentary credit card travel insurance you do not have to pay for extra insurance with another company, saving several hundred dollars. Other credit cards from nearly all other banks have also switched to Allianz/1cover and the same problem would exist.
My doctor and cardiologist supports me as fit to travel, the condition has not changed, is very low risk, stable, with no symptoms or problems, which does not limit my health in any way as it is medically managed. Up to 4 million Australians are affected by this issue and it is not an uncommon issue so it can affect a significant number of middle age to older people. The refusal response from Allianz/1cover is as follows:
"We are unable to offer cover for the following condition(s) and will not pay any claims arising directly or indirectly from, related to or associated with:
1.Hypercholesterolaemia
2.Cardiovascular Disease and its complications and Cerebrovascular Disease and its complications"
In spite of my GP and cardiologist declaring me fit for travel and at low risk and showing my previous cover by Zurich Insurance, Allianz/1cover would not cover me. Should an incident occur requiring me to seek medical attention and return to Australia the cost is likely to be around $100,000 which is something that one cannot ignore in selection of a more generous travel insurance provider.

title: Outstanding claims process
body:
I recently travelled with my family (2 adults, 1 child, 1 infant) to Russia for the World Cup and I lost my new Galaxy Note 8 phone travelling in Moscow to the Airport (along with my ATM card and access to emails - remember to set up a different recovery phone/email if you are travelling!!). Because our check-in was delayed I didn't have time to get a police report. I contacted the taxi company and cancelled my mobile and card access and when we reached our next destination I contacted 1Cover. They said to put all of the info on the claim form online and it would be looked at.

I was very sceptical of this process however I went online and noted down exactly what happened (they even tell you just to bookmark the claim page so you can easily find it again). When I returned to Australia I gathered the requested info (contract details, phone cost - just contact the mobile company and they have a pro-forma with all of the info, copy of travel documents etc) and uploaded to the online claim.

Within 48 hrs I received an email to say that I was covered (max payout of $1000 for mobile phones which I accepted when I took the policy - I really just took the policy in case any of my family members got sick). 

Within a week the $1000 was paid directly to my bank account where I was then able to order a new phone straight away.

While this was only a relatively small claim the process was so quick and easy, I would highly recommend 1Cover to my friends and family.

title: Beware!!!
body:
I have come back from holidays at end of August and filed my claim for stolen goods which were snatched off me straight away. They shortly emailed me that I needed further proof that I owned the item, so I called up and asked them if I could send in the boxes, the lady told me it was acceptable. It is now 1 month from my claim, I had to call them up because even after 10 days no one had called or notified me of the result. 

When I called I was told that my claim was rejected and I was only going to get the 250 good will amount, even though I had sent through a police report, photographic evidence AND posted them the original boxes. One person I called reasoned that I did not have a receipt, even though on the website they stated clearly that they understood sometimes receipts was just not possible and they would accept photographic evidence. The next time I called i was told that because it was an apple product they could not accept boxes and the lady assured me that it was written somewhere on the product disclosure, and trust me I have read EVERYTHING from their website to product disclosure, basically ANYTHING I could find, I even did a search function for any Apple statements they may have, NOTHING. 

I keep getting different nonsense answers and im sick of it by now, they have escalated the problem and now I will have to wait 5-7 business days for their call which I think I will have to call them up again myself. This is the worst and very time consuming. Please if this happens to you I suggest you escalate it further and if they still try to make you believe you are wrong when you have provided them with everything they have asked for I suggest you go to the ombudsman which I will definitely do if this matter doesn't get resolved.

November 12th 2014 Update:
Hey everyone who just wrote a review regarding rejection of their claims, I am now in the process of waiting for a reply from their IDR team and have also sent my complaint to the ombudsman. 3 months of fighting and I still don't know why I have to fight with them when I've provided them with more than enough information to support my claim. I will list what documents I have sent to them below.

Short story is, in Bali I had my Laptop and Phone stolen while under supervision mind you, so that's something they cannot argue with me for. Upon the incident I went straight to the police to get a report (Document 1). On arrival back home I straight away sent them the Police report (Doc 1), claim form (Doc 2), the insurance certificate (Doc 3), photographic evidence (Doc4). 

However to my surprise my claim was rejected, why?
In a series of calls (lasting now 3 months) listed below is their pathetic excuses:
Call 1: Rejected because lack of evidence of ownership, so I asked them if I could send in my boxes and accessories, they told me that it was fine and they even offered to send it back if it was necessary. I did just that (Doc5).
Call 2: No response after a lonnnng time so I called them, claim was still rejected. Excuse? It was still not evident enough that I owned the items. 
Call 3:Excuse? They said because my items are from Apple I can get a receipt from there, but as my items were purchased from gumtree more than a year ago I had no contact with the last owner and why would Apple give me a receipt if I didn't even purchase it directly from them?
When asked why I had to go through such length to obtain a receipt they told me it was part of their Product Disclosure. But I checked and there was no mention of anything even related to Apple products on anything including their website. Misleading much?
Call 4: Still rejected, flabbergasted I asked them why on earth has my claim been rejected after all that I've provided? Still they said it was because I didn't have a receipt. I did some more research and in the FAQ section on their website it CLEARLY says that they understand that customers sometimes do not have receipts and that they accept PHOTOGRAPHIC EVIDENCE. 

Now I'm utterly confused, I've done everything I can and have not broken any of their "rules" yet my claim is still rejected? What do they even expect? A guarantor sign to prove I own the items? CCTV of when I actually went and bought the items? A lie detector test? A time machine so I can go back and demand the previous owner the receipt?

December 10th 2014 Update:
So here's an update guys, after 3 months, continuously calling and escalating to the 1cover IDR team AND the ombudsman the former decision was overturned and I have received the full amount. Please if you do claim from 1Cover and run into a problem like I did, go to IDR and ombudsman AND most of all allow a ridiculous amount of time to pass by....never ever again am I purchasing from 1 cover again and I suggest you don't waste your time. Only good reviews come from those who don't run into problems....

title: Worst insurance ever!
body:
I purchased winter sports cover on the telephone. I had an accident abroad and called the emergency hotline. They told me I wasn't on their system, even though I had a certificate of insurance and confirmation text message prior to departure. I had to send my documents to them to prove I had cover. The next day when the medical centre was open I discovered I had a fully ruptured (snapped) ligament in my thumb that required urgent surgery. I called them back to be told that my insurance was only valid in Australia not in New Zealand. They spent 2 to 3 days trying to deny my cover. Then the underwriter blamed 1cover for giving the wrong insurance details. I had to constantly phone them they didn't help me in any way. Eventually they told me to return back to Australia and seek medical help there, but once I returned home my insurance was over and I would not be covered. The medical advice in NZ was that I had to have surgery within 10 days before the tendon shrinks and the operation becomes more complicated as they have to take tendon from somewhere else to bridge the gap. Obviously concerned by this I had no support at all from 1cover and had to call back to
Australia to try and find a surgeon myself. I couldn't find one that could guarantee to operate in time so I went to the doctor in NZ and they said they would try and get me seen at a local hospital in NZ. I called 1cover again to explain they told me that I was going against their advice and wouldn't be covered for an operation in NZ. Not only that they never got back to me when I was desperate until everything was too late. Now I'm back in Australia and still struggling to find a surgeon. They do not care about what is best for you, offer no help, do everything they can to make life difficult for you and always seem to be passing the buck saying they are waiting for their medical staff to review your case! A snapped ligament with a doctors report and ultra sound confirmation doesn't need 3 days to review! I haven't made a claim yet. I'm sure they will pay the minor medical examination fees but they did not want to pay for treatment. They're just full of excuses.

But this was far from the truth.  Dealing with Cover-More was amazing!  Usually I admire efficiency in a company, but this was just the beginning. title: Terrible once you need to make a claim
body:
I have been a customer of Insure & go for many years and they are great at making purchasing insurance easy but unfortunately as I have recently found out - they are terrible once you need to make a claim, and it seems like many of the positive reviews on this site are mostly from customers who have luckily not yet needed to make a claim. (I'm unsure how one can really review an insurance agency before making a claim?)

My claim should have been very straightforward: I had a long distance journey booked by a well known travel agency which was over 4 legs/flights to the destination in Sth America from Australia. 
Unfortunately one airline cancelled one of the flights which then caused me to miss the connecting flights and incur costs to stay at a hotel. No worries I thought this would be covered as it's so common... 

Well no, they declined my claim initially for a reason which was totally not even applicable then when I escalated to their internal dispute section it took a further 3 weeks of following up to then find out that they have searched high & low for a reason to decline my claim again and they have come up with an excuse that they are not liable for any connecting flights if they are less than 6 hours apart!!  This is so ridiculous, who would fathom to specify to a booking agency to make all connecting flights at least 6 hours apart when the industry standard is around 2 hours?? That's an extra 24 hours each direction in airports over my journey with young children..

The agent from Insure & go confirmed this situation was out of my control and it was unfortunate but they would still not approve the claim due to their fineprint, I asked if they did not cover this when changes are incurred out of my control then what good is having their insurance at all?... No response..

The process has taken 2 months so far after my initial claim. The entire claim is only worth a couple of hundred dollars and I have paid multiple hundreds of dollars to them in policy fees over the years without ever making a claim, this really highlights the type of company this is and how they treat customers.

Any future customers BEWARE, this company actively seeks any possible way to decline reasonable claims.
I would not recommend them to anyone.

title: Australians Be Warned !!!!!!
body:
We had the misfortune to lose a gold wedding ring on our recent cruise.  Put in a claim for the value - less than $500.  Have had no end of trouble with these people ever since.  The claim has been rejected on the basis that we did not supply PROOF of ownership.  We have lodged a complaint with them about this decision but it looks like they are not going to change their decision.  How many people still have a receipt for such an item after many years of marriage?  Supplied a photo of me wearing the ring while on the cruise - they don't accept photographic evidence!
Make sure you read this section of their product disclosure taken from their website:
Remember that all items you are claiming as lost, stolen, or damaged must be reported to the appropriate authority, usually within 24 hours, and you will need to be able to provide proof of ownership.

We have had home and contents, car, caravan insurance cover for over 40 years and NEVER have we had this kind of trouble EVER!  Think carefully before taking out insurance from this company.

title: No response before Cancel for Any Reason taken away. Only responded after.
body:
At the start of the COVID-19 outbreak escalating I contacted Covermore via email to find out my options on 9 March 2020 and still have not had a response. March 12 I attempted to contact them again via their chat and waited over two hours was told I would be helped soon and then waited another 45 minutes and nothing. I called again on 13 march and nothing. So I went through my travel agent and FINALLY an answer. They've suspended cancel for any reason, makes sense but now I can't change the dates of my travel insurance to match the new dates of my holiday. I have to cancel and rebook. But I will only get a partial refund now. I found this to be very disappointing and figured I'd try contacting Covermore again for more information. They person I spoke to via chat was lovely and gave me one answer saying that I can change the dates and any price difference between the new dates and no CFAR I will be refunded I just need to call. So I called the next day. Different answer this time, no change of dates and a partial refund. Not only was the person I spoke to incredibly dismissive. They gave me a different refund price to what my travel agent told me and when I said that the response was 'thats between you and the travel agent' in a very rude. Well I just double checked my policy it is not between me and my travel agent it is Covermore since you quoted the wrong cost for my insurance to begin with taking off nearly $100. 

I think Covermore saying that because they have taken a product I paid extra for off the market I now cannot change the dates, which I had done before and then they expect to keep over $250 from my $500+ policy is a bit rich. I purchased this insurance in October long before COVID-19 was known about and did the correct thing and followed all government travel advice of changing my holiday. 

If Covermore wants to keep half that policy money then it will be the last cent they ever get from me.

title: PEACE OF MIND
body: We are really happy with your seniors cover, it covered all that we need and it was really easy to set up. We did it all online as was in laymen's terms with no complications and simple to implement.

title: Great price and coverage
body: Very competitive price and easy to set up online. I have always used InsureandGo for all of my previous overseas holidays and have bought it again for my upcoming Europe trip. Fortunately for us we have never had to make a claim so can?t rate/review on that area.

title: Saved the day!!
body:
I was stuck in a hospital in Bali for 5 nights which was not much fun at all.  I had constant contact and reassurance from Cover-More.  I was able to speak with someone from back home so felt really comfortable that I was being understood.  The process went smoothly and I was reimbursed quickly.  What more could you want from a travel insurance company!!
Quick, smooth, seamless process

title: Good cheap cover
body: Cover was cheaper than anyone but I never had to use it. I assume all would have gone smoothly if called on.

title: Good communication
body:
TID kept me up to date during our vacation.

Was going to make a claim on a stolen mobile phone but do not have receipts, etc.. Lucky you. LOL.

Other than that, well done TID.

title: Insurance for travel to Hawaii
body: Only used this company once and as we had no claims it's hard to judge. However you were recommended by someone else who had changed to you even though they could get insurance through their workplace.

title: Would Buy Again.
body:
I purchased insurance for a short trip, which was easy to arrange. I did need to make a claim due to a lost passport, and am happy to say the full value of my claim was paid.. 
however, The online claim form didn?t work, so I phoned them directly to lodge my claim. That was lost, so I phoned again and it was promptly lodged. My claim was paid within ten days with no issues.
The negatives I can share are the issues trying to claim, and trying to get a quote for annual travel insurance through their website. In the end I phoned up and was told that as they only cover up to 30 days, the quote won?t be produced if you put in dates longer than this.

title: Lack of. Refund to Credit due to Covid 19
body: My husband and I were leaving on a 6 week trip of Europe on 7/5/2020 on 16/4 April I emailed Customer Service and received an email advising there will be no refund and if I had an issue to email there complaints department so on on 17/4/2020 I emailed Sure and Go several times without any response todate very disappointed as this Company was highly recommended to me.

title: One gripe
body: Satisfied with value and ease of setting up. The fact the company insures people of older years is excellent particularly if one has no health issues. My only only issue is that when I went to make a claim I was required to have airline tickets and bookings which on reaching home I had discarded, hence could not complete a claim. Fortunately my doctors visit and subsequent medication in Iceland was not over the top. No doubt this requirement was covered in the fine print but it could be made more apparent, particularly as I took out the policy over the phone.

title: Value for Money
body: I feel the policy is priced well, and support was easy to follow. We have never needed to make a claim yet, I hope we never have to.  This is our third time using Insureandgo.

title: Claim
body:
Unfortunately our planned trip to Tokyo at the end of March had to be cancelled due to the earthquake/tsunami.  We were very pleased with the way TID dealt with our claim.
Covered our needs at a reasonable cost

title: Good pooicy
body:
Good value policy 
Did not interact with customer services so cannot comment. 
Policy was easy to set up
And quotes were quick to choose
It covered all the basics we needed for our holiday

title: Excellent
body:
I would definitely recommend this company to others. If you are looking for good quality, cheap travel insurance, look no further!
I found this the cheapest travel insurance of all
I had no problems with this company at all

title: When do we get our money back???
body:
We were told to email support which we did and guess what no one's answering I wonder  are you guys even aware the damage your causing your own company by not refunding what is not your's to keep???
yes you can cite rule 47 section 3 paragraph 4 but morally ethically and not to mention common sense why are you dodging the issue ? guys be aware if you dont do the right thing here you'll find a class act is just around the corner so come on DO the right thing before you lose even more custom, over to you 1 cover...

title: An obvious choice when compared to other products.
body: I was very happy with the price and insurance inclusions. Web page was very user friendly and allowed for quick sign up. Would certainly consider this product initially in future.

title: Good company
body: No claim made this time, but have done in the past with no problem. Rates are very competitive and the app is easy to use. Take advantage of the packing list, I have never forgotten anything yet while using it.

title: Disappointed
body:
I have used Allianz multiple times but have never had to make a claim before. Our cruise was cut short at the last minute so we had to scramble to change accommodation and flights.  I was thanking my lucky stars that i had travel insurance and that it covered this issue.  But lo and behold Allianz refused to pay as my delay was not caused be a riot or similar merely a mechanical breakdown.
I notice that all the good reviews are from people who didn't need to make a claim and anyone who did has given a poor review.

title: Claim
body: They are a bunch of sharks when it comes to making a claim. The endless requests for documentation goes on and on . Typical insurance company delay tactic. Would I recommend this company. NO DON'T GO NEAR THEM  !

title: Best in the Business
body: Have used Allianz on all my overseas travels, have only claimed once when i had a knee injury and was the easiest process. With upgrade on flights and all overseas Medical was covered and with easy online documentation sent through for full reimbursement. Highly recommend!

title: Easy & Prompt
body:
Policy was excellent value, very easy to set up and the staff member I contacted was really nice and efficient.
I had to make a claim which was all done on line- it was so easy to do, responded to quickly and processed in a reasonable time.
Hassle free.

title: No worries
body: The policy was easy to set up and was fair value. I didn't need to lodge a claim this time. I have't used Allianz before but I would use the company again for travel.

title: Great value for money and user friendly!
body: Easy to find out what you are actually covered for and what you are not covered for on your insurance policy.  The website was very informative and user friendly.  TID was cheaper than my regular provider.

title: Good value and reliable
body: We have used this insurance 5 times and have put in a claim .  Replies were very friendly and obliging.

title: Terrible. Do not buy Aust post travel Insurance
body:
I used Aust Post travel insurance November 2018. My flight was delayed due to "Operational requirement" .
 I paid for my over night accommodation and Aust post travel insurance refused to pay it.  I will Never use Aust post travel insurance again.

title: Great Insurance
body:
I have used Cover-more six times, and once have had to claim. The Claim claims was easy to organize, responded to helpfully and quickly, and all questions have been answered for me either via email or phone very easily. I was very distressed when I call but cover-more were very assuring. I always use cover-more because they are affordable and so reliable.
affordable and so reliable

title: Cover-More Travel Insurance Excellent
body: Yes, we did feel it was good value and we did feel it was easy to set up.  We are very satisified with the Customer Support we received when we had to cancel our trip to The Kimberley due to medical reasons.

title: Do not, do not buy insurance from this company
body:
Just came back from 5 weeks Europe holiday, had my laptop stolen, and apparently you are not covered unless someone snatched the bag off you. So, for example if you have your bag on the table, you go to grab a coffee, you come back and its not there, you are not covered.

False advertising, trust me you are not covered even if you buy the full cover.

title: No Stress Holidays
body: Easy sign up, we could relax knowing we were completely covered. A big saving by not needing to pay the excess insurance when hiring a car. Would not travel without having Allianz.

title: Always recommend
body:
Couldn't be easier!  The website is a breeze to complete and provides all the information in a clear and concise manner.  I like that a quote is emailed to your email straight away so that you don't forget to pay and the Certificate is emailed in the folded format so it can be easily included with your travel documents!!
price is competative and would always recommend

title: Don't go anywhere without ICover Travel Insurance
body: Travel Policy very easy to set up.  Wouldn't travel anywhere without 1Cover Insurance.  Been lucky so far and haven't had to make a claim so cannot comment on Customer Support.

title: Read every single word of the PDS to avoid disappointment
body: We had to cancel travel plans during the pandemic, not because of, but it took a bit of convincing to allow our claim to be processed.  A medical issue was the reason and it was substantiated from a surgeon.  A mountain of paperwork, several phone calls, actually an excessive amount of homework to supply all the relevant information, which at times was still not enough. We dealt with a travel agent for flights, booked online for accommodation and travel insurance online.  Will only book everything through a travel agent next time.  This was a huge headache for us, however, in the end, we received all we had claimed through Australia Post Travel Insurance.  Will definitely do things differently next time, and will read every word of the PDS because we would not have been covered if we cancelled because of the pandemic.  This is our first time through Aust Post, they were good, but so was our reason for cancelling.

title: Not Used.
body: Although we did not have a need to use it the peace of mind was worth it. The pre trip advice and contact numbers were well presented and made us feel secure in the knowledge that should we need them they would be there.

title: Happy customer.
body: We were happy we chose 1Cover for our recent NZ holiday insurance. The policy provided cover for everything we needed at a competitive price. It was easy to establish & gave us peace of mind during our travels.

title: Beware and check your cover before you go!
body:
Setting up insurance months in advance ...?     After phoning at least three times with long waits we enquired  about whether a trip to Islands on a boat part of our tour was included.   We were amazed to find it wasn't.   We were advised  Insure n go policies cover only land travel and air.
We were forced to cancel as we were advised that the policy could not be amended.   Luckily we were within 14 day period for money back but others may not be so lucky.   We have used this company before and as we have never had to claim were totally unaware of need to take cruise cover for any period you are on the water overnight .... even though we are not on a cruise!!  Insure n Go have a responsibility to make this known as many people on a largely land based trip are likely to overlook this.

title: Absolutely brilliant service - will be using every time!
body:
Great value, service and ease! - You never think you need insurance (until you do)  I originally justified the TID cost with the Car Rental cover, which saved me save on the CDW costs, plus they were extremely easy to use and seemed include a lot of coverage. But when our child was taken ill and we were forced to stay another week in the Philippines - TID Emergency Services were very helpful and TID reimbursed us in full for our total claim on our return. Brilliant! Very happy to recommend and use them again for all our future travels. 

Only thing I would suggest if you do make a claim with TID is to start the online process when it happens (and keep saving drafts), instead of doing it all when you return like we did. Not really an issue but easier to gather and keep track of the right docs and receipts.

title: No Problems but we didnt have to make a claim either.
body: No Problems but we did not have to make a claim with them either. I would go with Travel Insurance Direct next time we travel. We did feel we had value for Monday also.

title: Excellent
body:
From the very start of the transaction I have found Travel Insurance Direct great. The web site is super easy to use and the products on offer are of the most comprehensive nature. The price asked for these policies are the lowest I have found compared to both Travel Agents and other online insurers. 

I have called a few times in regards to my policy and found the staff very helpful. I have also used the e-mail address and received a reply within 24 hours.
Comprehensive policies for much less cost than what is available from Travel Agents. Service is fast and efficient.

title: Travel Claim - Excellent
body: I was very happy with the outcome. I was kept informed at all times. The claim did not take too long to be received, reviewed and finalised. I will definitely choose Covermore again for my travel insurer.

title: Happy with claim process
body: Not being one to trust or even value insurance companies I was pretty reluctant making a claim for my prescription glasses destroyed by a monkey in Bali that seemed to fly out of nowhere.  Was impressed with the submission system, and just received a note that they will pay out. Not a lot of money but very helpful for me.

title: Domestic Use
body:
I used TID for Australian domestic travel when I hire a car at my holiday destination. The TID premium is a lot less than the cost of the extra cover car hire companies charge to reduce the hire car insurance excess to a manageable amount. And the bonus is that I get all the other benefits of the travel insurance such as lost baggage, etc.  

The only time I've been a bit disappointed was when Tiger Airways cancelled my flight on the day and the next flight they could put me on was 2 days later. Because the cancellation was for "Operational" reasons, TID did not cover the additional cost of an alternative airline's flight on the day I had to fly home. Had I elected to wait for the Tiger flight, again TID would not have covered my accommodation costs, etc. either. Fortunately I haven't had to make any other claims.
Quick, easy to buy cover at a competitive price.

title: Fast response.
body: The cost of the insurance was reasonable. When I needed to make a claim the email responses were very quick. And payment was also within a week. I use cover 1 on most of my travels and I would use them again.

title: a fraud/ no answer when requesting refund for medical charges
body:
Alliance is only good to take money. Contacted Alliance twice by email and asked for process to refund medical bills.
Never got an answer back. My Daughter also tried to contact Alliance with no response.

title: Used Non-relevant clauses to Avoid Paying Claim
body: I had used them before for short trips/ holidays and was happy until a recent trip.  My wife accidentally dropped her mobile phone off a jetty, into deep water, so it was clearly unrecoverable.  We had cover for lost or stolen items however our claim was denied because we did not get a Police Report or tour operator report within 24 hours.  (I have no idea why anyone would waste the Police Department's time getting a report when the item was not stolen, and its location - and unusable condition - is known).  We were not on a tour.   We had four adult witnesses, receipts for the original and the replacement phone.  They were only interested in using the lack of a report to reject what was quite a small value claim after excess is taken into account.

title: Scumbags - Avoid at all costs!!!
body:
Got an infected wisdom tooth while overseas, it took the "emergency team" 18 DAYS to get back to me that I wouldn't be covered, after paying for dentist, surgeon and surgery to have it removed.
Ignored questions, unanswered emails, broken promises and a total disregard for customer service.

title: Easy to set up
body: I use you guys all the time as I like the online user experience to set-up.   I have not experienced claiming anything though - that will be the true test.

title: Positive experience
body:
I am currently in the process of organising an overseas trip, where my mother, aged 75 will be coming with my husband and I. 
I would like to compliment Kate, one of Covermores sales reps who did an outstanding job helping Mum navigate her travel insurance. She was very courteous, friendly, and above all professional in her approach. She was a pleasure to deal with.   Thank you!

title: Absolutely appauled with this service.
body: My partner and myself had to cancel our oversea trip due to complications in her pregnancy, mind you we did not know of the pregnancy itself before we booked the trip. We have doctors certification proving that she has been hospitalised and will need weekly check ups to make sure her and the baby are ok, hence not being able to travel. Travel more refused our claim stating that they do not cover cancelation with pregnancy 24 weeks or over. I do not recommend cover more. I will be taking the matter further.

title: avoid them like the plague!
body:
Took out Covermore cancel for any reason insurance for a planned trip to Canada and Alaska in August, at a cost of nearly $1000.  A few weeks later the world went mad, corona happened and the borders shut.

Flight Center and the travel provider have provided a credit for the deposit paid, however I've been told that Covermore will not offer a credit because they no longer sell the CFAR product.  The only option available is a 75% refund.

I fail to see how this can even be legal under Australian consumer law, as they have withdrawn the product from market, and are not willing to give a full refund.

Have attempted to ring covermore directly for clarification, left my number for a callback about 2 hours ago, not liking my chances of a call back.  Not looking promising based on everyone else's reviews here.

To be fair I will give covermore the chance to offer a 100% refund on unused services, before further action is taken.

Don't let flight center sell you this rubbish product, do some research and get your own insurance.

title: thanks.
body: Very easy to set up,customer support not required at set up stage and hope it is not required in the future, many thanks.

title: Not good!
body: When we need to go to hospital for emergency, nobody is available to help, we need to pay ourselves, then try to get paid, it is very difficult to claim with so much paper work. In the end, give up.

title: Always gotta have Insurance
body: Easy  policy to setup,good valuegor money  a must have when traveling, my number One  insurer , have been using for years would highly recommend to family friends, will definitely use again and again

title: Perfect Cover
body:
We had a perfect holiday with only one minor mishap, our camera broke. I was able to contact Covermore all via the internet and claim for the repairs to the camera. The camera was repaired and all money reimbursed into our account. Very convenient with no hassles at all. We have had more than one cover with Covermore luckily this being the first time to require assistance. They came highly recommended through our travel agent.
Convenient, efficient, hassle free

title: So easy!
body: I liked how easy it was to get travel insurance. Just a few clicks and wham, done! Kids free is is nice incentive too. Felt confident TID had our family covered.

title: Outrageous
body: So here we have a company prepared to grab money for a policy they will not honour or provide a service for. Would prefer to give this mob zero stars if possible. Outright rejection  with a standard reply from an unfortunate front line employee. The company has no clues, nor interest in their customers at this most difficult time. Everything you thought about insurance companies but far worse. Avoid. Avoid. Avoid

title: Total peace of mind. Don't travel without it
body: I've just done a 10 day trip to Bali and for just over $50 1cover gave me total peace of mind that I was totally covered for everything (even natural disasters).  It was so easy to do online and took me less than five minutes to set up from start to finish. Highly recommend to anyone thinking of travelling. I've used 1cover for both domestic and international travel.

title: Always Used TID
body: I have always used TID and have been quite satisfied with the service and mobile app and good value. have not made a claim. but it is satisfying to know that you are covered.

title: Fabulous Cover. Bonus Travel Sim was wonderful
body:
The insurance was great value compared to others. It was very easy to apply for online and it was great to receive the farewell and welcome home emails. The check list was very handy.
The added bonus of the free travel sim card was very handy and provided peace of mind to be able to keep contact when required. Good value call rates as well and the APP on the phone worked very well. Easy to use. 
Will certainly use Allianz next time i need travel insurance.
Thanks for the coverage.

title: Perfect for oldies
body:

Receiving welcome home email, made me feel that I was more than a number on a policy.

body: The prices are a lot cheaper than travel insurance offered by the travel agent. Quick and easy to purchase online. I haven't had to make a claim yet, but would hope it was also quick and easy.

Once claim was lodged, response was very quick and resolved within a week.

This was the first time I have used this insurance company and I wouldn't hesitate to use them again

title: No issue insurance process
body:

TID filled all the spaces and met those requirements and setting up the policy was a simple process. 

Didn't need to make a claim of any sort but , at a competitive price, if it was needed.

title: Fantastic Service
body: I found Medibank Travel Insurance to be very helpful, sensible and prompt in processing my claim. The claims staff gave good practical telephone advice. I will definitely use them again.

title: Lucky for us we didn't need it
body:

Lucky for us we didn't need it so not sure what it would be like if we did need it.
there was 1 medical evacuation while onboard and another medical emergency where the ship had to rush back to sydney 4 hours earlier than expected, it drives home how important it is to have insurance

title: Could not travel without the insurance     Thank you
body:
The policy is very good value.   It was very easy to set up the policy on line and the customer support as very good
Very satisfied and would use them again

title: Simple, smooth claims experience
body: This was my first time using Insureand Go. I had to make a medical claim.  Lodged online, easy to submit required documents, good communication throughout process, claim accepted without any hassle

title: Easy to take out dud not have to use
body: Good value for what is included fortunately I did not have to make a claim so can't describe or comment on this process. Communications are good. Have used several times.

title: Pricing was on par with other Travel Insurance Companies
body: Good value for money, and stopped the car rental company in their tracks when I showed them that we were covered via Travel Insurance and did not need their insurance cover.

title: Good choice for older travellers
body: Relatively easy to arrange on-line. Could be improved by storing medical data for pre-existing conditions for clients. It would save a lot of time for those of us with several conditions.

title: Very easy to purchase the policies
body: Ive purchased policies before from this company, im yet to make a claim. Im guessing the real test will come if & when i do need to make a claim or need some assistance. I thought the policy prices were very good & quite competitive with other companies. But the real test is when you really need the coverage you have paid for & how the company provide you with the help you need, no more so than when your in a foreign country.

title: Everything You Need
body:
We needed the adventure pack and medical conditions added into our travel insurance and everything that we needed was covered and explained well and compared to others even though slightly dearer than some of the others everything that we wanted or needed covered was covered so as far as we were concerned price was good.
The Customer Support was Excellent and couldn't have asked for more to be honest as there is nothing worse than sifting through policy documents to find out what's covered and not covered.

Will use these guys again - Thanks

title: When the unexpected happens
body:
We have held travel insurance with Covermore for two years and did not expect to have a claim. But when my partner became seriously ill in Thailand we took her to hospital and contacted Covermore in Australia. The staff were helpful and supportive and stayed in constant contact during the 9 days of hospitalisation and a further week in recovery. Our claim was unusual and we paid all our costs directly in Thailand and lodged a claim on return to Australia. While the claim was refused initially due to the circumstance of it, we lodged an appeal and it was dealt with quickly and efficiently and approved within a week and we were re-imbursed all costs which were fair and reasonable. My partners illness was life threatening and we could not speak highly enough of the Bangkok Hospital Group and the  way Covermore communicated with both ourselves and the Bangkok Hospital in Hua Hin.
we searched and found the premium for covermore to be the best, with appropriate cover
we had to negotiate with Covermore to have the claim reviewed and accepted

title: Pre - existing condition - 1 Cover Travel Insurance will assist
body:
One Cover travel insurance will cover you with pre existing conditions where most other companies will not even consider covering the  condition. I have used them on numerous occasions with no issues .

January 5th 2018 Update: 1Cover you came to the party

This is my second review of this company.
Our claim was expedited without fuss or argument. We received our payment soon after all the paperwork was submitted in full bar a small excess.
Thank you 1 Cover you came to the party.

title: Quite responsive when making a claim
body: Had to make a claim as I lost my glasses on a bus trip between Alice Springs and Uluru.  Thought it was going to be difficult to make a claim but it turned out not to bad. I was however asked a lot of dumb questions during the claim process and ended up having to provide a statdec as I failed to lodge a ?police report? regarding the incident. Once this was done the claim was finalized quickly

title: Best Service
body:
Great value for money, great service & customer support fantastic, claim sorted out with one week, service second to none, will be using this company again!!!

Many thanks to your team.

title: Better than the average!
body: Well,thank goodness We didn't need to claim. But seems TID covered all the bases we needed to have anyway for a reasonable cost. Straight forward and easy to organise your cover. Customer service readily available and willing to help when and if required.

title: Travelling Noles
body: This is my first time and so far, so good! Easy to buy policy online and covers everything needed for a great price.

title: The website is easy to use and the premiums are competitive.
body: We have used Insureandgo about four or five times in the past and it has always been an easy and affordable experience. I have never had a claim so I cannot speak for that side of the company.

title: Perfect insurance
body: We used Allianz Travel Insurance because it was good value for money, ease of setting up.  I purchased online and found the whole process easy and uncomplicated.  Will certainly use Allianz in our future travels.

title: Good product
body: Good service provide. Detailed information was provided. Very easy to transact. Not made a claim yet but I'm confident that it will be quite easy and fast. Will definitely choose this travel insurance again.

title: Will never use 1Cover insurance again or recommend them!
body: After taking out a "already overseas" policy for 12 months for myself and my partner and believing the "14 day cancellation" slogan on the website, my girlfriend and I changed our travel plans. After contacting 1Cover to modify the policy to shorten the duration, we were advised to "read the PDS because after the policy starts there are no refunds." I find it hard to believe that you let people extend a policy if they pay extra but you can't shorten a policy? Why?  Is it because you've already extracted the maximum amount from us? As a first time customer of 1Cover and a frequent traveller, I would have thought it would be more beneficial to keep customers on side and use some discretion rather than just referring us to the "P.D.S."  I will certainly be telling all of my friends and family not to cover themselves with 1Cover insurance as I won't be doing ever again in future.

title: Well above expectations. Thanks!!
body:
The cost of policy was good value for money.
On-line application, acknowledgments and follow-up were excellent.
The 'Tripwsie' app is extremely useful with good tips, useful information and easily accesible policy details

title: Quick and easy to purchase.
body: Yes. However, when I went to purchase the policy - I was under the impression I was receiving a discount. There was nothing on the documentation to indicate that this was so - a bit disappointing.

title: Good value insurance and a trouble free process
body: I have chosen Insure and Go travel insurance for many cruises ex Sydney. Also some longer holiday trips to Europe and the USA. I have not needed to claim as yet. The website is easy to use. It would be good if they retained my personal and medical details as I use them so often (at least 3 times a year), but maybe this would compromise my declarations. Good value insurance and a trouble free process.

title: Avoid Allianz- Assistance Travel Insurance like the Plague
body:
If you want reliable travel insurance that gives you comfort that you are well covered in the case of an emergency whilst over seas well Allianz- Assistance Travel Insurance  is one to absolutely AVOID!
After having our trip to Europe cut short because of my wife's illness it was a complete horror dealing with them in the claim process.
In short, they did everything to not make any payment. At first they concentrated their efforts in trying to desperately prove that my wife had a pre-exiting condition so they could avoid liability, they dragged out the process for many months and kept asking for more and more and more medical documentation in a hope that they could get out of paying. 
We soon realized that the main tactic is to continually ask for more information, even to the extent of asking for the same information over and over and over again even though they already had it.
It seems that Allianz- Assistance thinks that if they keep delaying for months and months that you will simply just go away.  
When they realized that they could not prove any pre-existing condition they made an offer that was a fraction of the actual costs and a complete joke.
Do your self a BIG favor and just completely avoid any travel products offered by Allianz- Assistance.
If by some unfortunate circumstance you do find yourself dealing with these people go directly to the Financial Services Ombudsman and lodge a claim there....the FSO decision is final and binding on companies like Allianz...they have to pay what they are told to pay...I would love to see them sqwirm.

title: Refund and help timely!
body:
Booking insurance online,realised i had put wrong area of travel after processing. I emailed ,received answer and refund very quickly.I have never had to claim but have booked/ bought insurance at least 3 times ,hope i never have to claim ..but travel with peace of mind
Very helpful service.

title: Seamless set up
body: Policy was really easy to set up and the documents came straight through to my email. I also got a birthday wish emailed across while mid trip which was a nice touch.

title: Great support
body: Always use Allianz while traveling overseas. Great support and easy to set up The booking was made online which is so easy. I would recommend that this insurance be used by all that travel but be mindful allow yourself enough time to get home.

title: The worst travel insurance ever.
body: I lost my luggage while traveling. when I called them they told me I needed to report in in 24 hours so its not covered. I asked them who reports lost things before looking for them which usually takes 24 hours anyway. Bottom line they refused to pay then went to complaints and she was the most rudest most arrogant person in the world. They should be banned they are very unfair. One star is even to much never use budget direct or budget fraud.

title: Joining The list of unsatisfied customers
body: On 18 February we purchased a comprehensive travel insurance policy for our trip to Cambodia and Thailand. Before finalising the purchase I phoned Budget Direct twice to clarify the exclusion clauses of the policy. I was assured both times by the sales staff we would be covered for any medical and cancellation costs as Cambodia and Thailand were not on the Aus. Govt. Do Not Travel list. One week later I again rang Budget Direct and again was advised we were fully covered. We proceeded on our trip but on 13 March we were advised by Foreign Affairs to return home as soon as possible. We arrived back in Australia on 16 March. I lodged a claim with Budget Direct for cancellation costs only to be advised our policy, due to Clause 1 of the exclusions, was denied. I appealed against the ruling only to be denied again. I have since lodged a second appeal but have been advised I will have to wait FORTY FIVE DAYS for a decision. I have asked Budget Direct to specifically refer to the telephone conversations I had with its sales staff. These are supposedly recorded. I would not have purchased this policy but for the assurances of Budget Direct Sales staff. If my second appeal is refused I will have no option but to join the growing list of unsatisfied customers complaining to the AFCA

However when the [censored word removed] actually hit the fan, covermore used their most polite voices to tell us that we were on our own. I would have been better putting my money away and using it to cover my own [censored word removed]. Another useless insurance company that seem fantastic until you actually need them.

P.s it would have been nice if they actually called us to let us know that we were not covered instead of waiting for us to call them again.

Details. 
Due to the government shutdown our plans and accommodation was significantly changed due to the closure of all national parks. This left us with a rental van that we had paid nearly $4000 that was completely useless to us. We were not looking for full compensation, but just enough to cover us for taking the van back early and readjusting our itinerary. Covermore found a loop hole and told us they would offer no financial support, thanks a lot. 

This is the last time I will use this company! Seriously save your money and go elsewhere.

Never had a break before and needed my travelling partners every assistance.

The moment things come undone like this, start your own archive of doctors reports/ receipts/ names and locations. (Get emailed copies sent to you.) Keep track of your hotel cancellations or date changes. Most importantly, make contact with the claims deprtment of tyhe Travel Insurer. Give them your comms details that you may be using in your host country.  Iceland is expensive for everything incluing phone and data..

So, After we got th the Reykjavik Main A&E hospital for assessment we were advised to get home asap otherwise an operation would result in me suffering  post operative DVT problems with air travell. Reports were written by doctors and emailed to the insurers medical team.  In 2 days we flew out of Rejkyavik howeward bound to OZ. The moment I landed I presented at A&E in Mater Hospital Brisbane. 2 days later I had surgery with more pins than a tailor could use. Medical/ Hospital expenses in OZ are not covered..
Thank you Medibank Travel Insurance for your care and cover.

title: Fractured Back stress added to by Covermore's dirty tactics.
body:
Basically, don't even bother buying insurance from Covermore, ever. It's not worth the paper it's printed on. 

My Fiancee and I paid AU$1500 for a 1 year travel insurance policy through Covermore with all the bells and whistles. We even paid the extra for motorcycle cover just in case we needed it. Because when you travel you want peace of mind right? That in an emergency, at least you won't have to worry, everything will be looked after. At least that's the impression they like to give you in their marketing. 

About 2 months before the end of the policy I was in London and I fell down some stairs (completely sober) and hurt my back, it was so bad I couldn't breath in fully, so I took an ambulance to the hospital. The ambulance were completely unhelpful and took me to a public hospital. I got rushed through triage and they refused to even x-ray my back. Days later it was still really painful and I couldn't even lay down properly so I went to a local doctor who was also completely unhelpful. I notified covermore of my predicament but at no point did they offer to send me to a private hospital or to pay to have my back x-rayed (before you say anything mr covermore, I'm not a Doctor, so no I would't know if it needed x-ray or not). 

When you try to make a claim through covermore, you end up dealing with a third party company on an email [email removed] and it's the same people if you call the emergency number. Basically, as far as I can tell, this is a company that covermore use who are expert in denying any possible claim. Every time I called I would find an apparently helpful person on the phone that would re-assure me that everything was going to be fine and that if I hang up and they would have one of their 'specialist nurses' call me back as soon as possible to properly assess my situation. Not once did they ever call back. 

Not knowing what the issue was, I just knew I was still in a lot of pain, so I asked covermore to arrange for me to go to a physio or chiropractor, to which I was given the reply "If you think it's that urgent, go and pay for it yourself and we'll pay you back if you submit the receipts." Eventually, after filling out a small mountain of paperwork, I did get [email removed] to finally pay me back for a couple of chiropractor visits that I had paid for myself. 

After 3 months, and still being in complete agony (it felt like there was a burning ball of lead lodged in my spine) I still had not been referred for an X-ray. I told [email removed] about the pain I was suffering from my accident within the insured period, to which they replied "This sounds urgent, we'll have one of our trained nurses call you back as soon as possible"....   (still waiting for that call). So I went to a local free GP and practically begged them to refer me for an x-ray, which I had done, but being public health in the UK it then took a week to get the result back. This was possibly the worst week of my life because I'd already heard the radiologist telling someone "This doesn't look good at all", so I spent the entire time stressing over things like 'what if I turn the wrong way?', 'Am I going to end up in a wheelchair?'. By this time, I'd not only given up on Covermore, I'd pretty much given up on life itself...  

Eventually, when I did get the results back and found that I had a wedge fracture on my vertebra, I let Covermore know about my situation, to which they felt it was best to leave me plug on through the NHS for the slowest treatment ever (one month wait to see a spinal specialist, another month to have an MRI, another month to get any result). To which the spinal clinic basically told me "If you had have been seen at the time of the accident there might have been something that could have been done, but this late after the incident, the bone is pretty much healed solid how it is." 

Covermore then went on to state to me in an email, and this is a direct quote: 

"I am concerned that the experience you encountered with our service was less than satisfactory and I thank you for taking the time to bring these concerns to our attention. As no additional information has been supplied to suggest that you were not fit to fly and as previously discussed with Sophie a few weeks ago, your policy expired on 07/08/2012 and as such you are currently uninsured. If you were to take out a new policy then your current medical condition would be considered a pre-existing condition." - [name removed]. 

Seriously? They think they can get out of this on the basis that I cannot prove that I was 'Not fit to fly' at the time of the incident? I didn't know if I was fit to do anything at the time of the incident because I was laying on my back in complete agony loaded up with painkillers waiting for a reply from a fictitious nurse that I kept hearing about. 

I want my money, and the last year of my life back. I've wasted $1500 and more time than you could believe on having to deal with all the issues surrounding this whole scenario and all I got in return for putting my trust in Covermore was endless woes to add to my suffering. 

Rhys Cooper 

And yes, this is a real story, Case # 1207176888, Claim number: 649739

Absolutely appalling excuse for an insurance company. Never buy from them, ever!

title: They covered incidents multiple times, saving me a lot of money with a smile
body:
Buying a policy online is pretty easy. Having to re-fill all my details every time is a bit of a bummer but I guess it means that my privacy is higher that way (they don't keep my details on their systems). The system of having a credit card into which they can deposit funds even before I have to expense works great.

The first time I traveled while covered by them I had a group of 5 of us (two adults and three kids) going for 3 weeks in Israel. The price was very affordable. While staying in Israel, the youngest had a pimple show up on her forehead. I found a clinic which would have cost about $400 for a single visit (from memory). I called up TravelCard and had the amount deposited into the credit card they provided me on the spot before I went to the doctor and had to pay. Some extra amount covered the medicine prescribed by the doctor.

In another case, I bought insurance for a short trip to Hawaii about 3 days before departing. The next day both of us got a strong cold and had very clogged nose. Clearly not in a state to fly. We saw a doctor and hoped it'll get better but on the morning of the flight it still was too bad to fly. We got a doctor certificate and with that we received a full refund of the flight and hotel room that we already paid for and couldn't cancel (luckily I was able to cancel the rental car reservation).

In both cases, dealing with TravelCard was pretty smooth and frustration free. Their requests for supporting documents were reasonable and sensible. They even were accomodating for mismatch in the amounts given on the paperwork from the reservation agent.

I now buy travel insurance for every trip. Our experience with them converted my partner from being extremely leery of insurance and agents to someone who buys insurance for her own travels. The same is true for friends to whom I recommended TravelCard.

body:
I was given a free SIM when I took out my May/June 2016 European holiday policy.  It worked like a dream.  My travelling friend also had a Global SIM and we could communicate with each other while away for very little cost.  I could also SMS back to Sydney for peanuts, much cheaper than what my local telco offered.  It worked in every country without a hitch (Dubai, Italy, Greece, Turkey, Spain, Ireland, UK, France and Thailand).

F/F to August 2017 and I used the same SIM in Thailand.  A nightmare.  It kept on duplicating the issue of SMS (2x; 4x and up to 6x in some SMS) and I was charged for each duplication.  I was also overcharged at $1.10 per SMS rather than .25c.  The iPhone was correctly set so that iMessage was off and I didn't resend any SMS.

I now have a replacement SIM for my next holiday.  Fingers crossed.

I give 5-stars based on my European holiday and despite the issues associated with the SIM in Thailand, Global SIM support customer services were very responsive, suggested a few possible fixes (which were unsuccessful) and refunded all erroneous SMS costs and issued new SIM.

title: Questionable Refund Policy
body: Purchased travel insurance with Covermore in 2019 for $2400+. Travel was cancelled due to Viking cancelling all cruises and the Indian Government stopping all eVisas. body:
I'm sure Cover More will have its stooges write positive reviews in an attempt to negate this [genuine] review in relation to a cancelled Ryan Air flight which caused massive disruption to our holiday plans. I expected Cover More to be honourable and protect me for the considerable associated extra costs of the cancellation. Nothing could be further from the truth. CM dragged the claim process out for over 6 weeks before finding small print to deny my genuine claim. If anyone is dumb enough to use Cover More after my experience you deserve what you get. Beware Cover More - they will not cover you, they will not protect you when you most need it. Instead take out travel insurance with a reputable company who will look after you when you have a travel problem. Only 1 star rating because this site won't allow a zero star rating.

December 5th 2018 Update: Addendum comment to my review published Nov 6, 2108 titled BEWARE: Cover More are the worst insurance

I have previously summarised my very bad recent experience with Cover More with the purpose of forewarning other genuine travellers about the problems with this insurance company. 
It is important to note that, at the time of my review, of the total Cover More reviews published by Product Review 45% of people rate Cover More as either 'Bad' or 'Terrible' - and most of these are rated 'Terrible'. 
There are good travel insurance companies in the market who act with understanding and integrity towards claim resolution for their customers. Based on my experience and 45% of other reviews in Product Review Cover More is not one of them.
As a result I have requested CM to conduct an internal review of my claim refusal and failing that I intend to forward the matter to Australian Financial Complaints Authority and ASIC.

My claim was declined because and I quote ?In this instance as you had departed from your home prior to cancelling the Kangaroo Island portion of your trip, the claimed cost falls outside the scope of coverage provided by the policy.?

How on earth is this possible? Now where in the policy can I find a clause that says cancellation must take place prior to departing from your home on the policy commencement date. title: Worst Travel Insurance Ever!!!
body:

They gave me an email address to write to.  I was offered zero assistance otherwise.  There was no free Wifi at the airport either.

My connecting flight to Melbourne was leaving shortly afterwards.  As soon as I arrived in Melbourne, I emailed China Southern & sent a copy of the email to Insure and Go telling them I *may* have to make a claim.

The woman from Insure and Go didn't even ask if I was OK or if I needed medical assistance.

All she said was they would not cover me for medical assistance provided in Australia.

She asked if I needed medical assistance in China & I said nothing was made available to me.

Insure and Go have basically wiped their hands of any assistance they may have provided.

INSURE AND GO SUCKS!!!!

They would not allow the airline to change were I was sitting as they would have to cover the cost of a business  class  seat as I needed to have room the keep it straight but did arrange a wheelchair at the airport. title: Misleading PDS and aggressive depreciation of belongings
body:
Had to make a claim after an airline computer error reserved a flight I booked but didn't allocate a ticket. Had to re-book a bunch of other more expensive flights on arrival at the airport.

Covermore's PDS states that 'we will pay additional transport expenses incurred due to circumstances beyond your control' but then limits those circumstances to a small number of extremely rare scenarios (like natural disasters) by adding the phrase 'and resulting from'. That's not how language works.

The only other claim I have put through during my trip was for damage to a camera lens that their claims department depreciated by 70% despite the fact that, in the real world, it appears to have depreciated by about 10%.

I would hope they would be less underhanded about medical claims but thankfully I never had to put that to the test.

I certainly would strongly advise anyone going overseas to take out a Covermore Travel Insurance Policy, it makes you feel much more relaxed about your journey.  You can also be confident that should anything unforseen happen, then Covermore is there to help, and they certainly do.
