We believed we were covered when we missed our flight due to a breakdown on our train. Our claim for new flights was denied. Apparently a failure of the rail network does not count as an accident.

title: Do not consider this company for travel insurance
body:
I am 51 and work for my self.

I had to travel to China for business and then on to Bali and back to Australia.

My wife booked the tickets and insurance and when she told me we were insured with TID I was then in doubt.

I had a problem with this company over a damages suit case and to be honest I told my wife never to book with them again then.

I took my 14 year old daughter with me so to me it was so important I had an insurance policy that I could rely on.

When we were in Bali, I became ill and thought I had food poisoning, we had two days before we came home so I thought I could manage, I have had food poisoning before but this was bad, no sickness but so bad I could not get out of bed, I was told by the hotel staff that I must go to hospital, but because I was with my daughter on our own I made the decision to stay in bed and then try to get back to Australia, after all we only had a 4 hour flight back to Cairns.

It was so stressful I can not explain how I felt.

Upon my return I went to the doctor and he straight away put some strong antibiotics and ordered blood tests, after 5 days or so I went back to see the doctor and he said I can not believe it but you have come up positive for Legionnaires disease   

I was blown away as the doctor told me it would get worse before it got better and for sure it did.

My wife contacted the insurance company Travel Insurance Direct and was told yes your covered, we need all the results and a letter of your doctor saying you are not fit for work.

Working for myself I needed to get back to work but having this disease, just knocked me for six, I was admitted to cairns hospital because I had fluid on the lungs, they put me on some antibiotics that would knock out a horse and advised me that if this did not work, the next step was a coma and drains on my lungs with very strong medication, I basically had one foot in the grave, it really was that bad.

After three and a half weeks I returned to work but it was hard, really if I was working for some one I could have been off for 2 months, but working for your self I had no choice.

My wife then got everything together and made a claim for $3600.00 for loss of income, over three weeks this was just my personal wage, not the money I generate to run the business.

Basically Travel Insurance direct said sorry you are unable to make a claim, we only look at the case after, wait for it 4 weeks, you need to be sick for 4 weeks before they will then and only then, make a decision if you have a claim.

I was blown away, I could have just gone to the hospital in Bali booked up thousands of dollars in bills, had to get my daughter taken care of, I would hate to see what the final bill would have been, I saved them thousands of dollars.

Take this as a word of advise, these insurance companies are so quick to take your money from you, but when you have a claim they will try every way possible to get out of paying, I firmly believe this company has never paid a major injury or sickness claim, DO NOT USE Travel Insurance Direct, their attitude when we tried to claim was a joke, I hope no one gets what I got, but if you do, stay put call them and ask where you stand.
Do not try to get home, read the small print, thats about 10 pages and know where you are.

I am finally back to full time work, but will never use Travel Insurance Again.

title: Senior medical coverage
body: At this writing, I have not started the travel.  This review focuses on my experiences with addressing pre-existing medical conditions.  I am over 65 years old, and the package was aimed at seniors.  I was greatly put off by the way these pre-existing conditions were evaluated and costed.  It was a "tick the box" exercise.  I have been monitored by my specialist for almost five years with no problems or on-going treatments.  I have a current letter from my treating specialist which says "xxx has stable asymptomatic coronary artery disease on medical management."  It also says "xxx has well controlled essential hypertension"  and  "From a cardiac standpoint there are no contraindications xxx to travel by air."   There is apparently no way to get this information into Insureand Go for consideration at the time the pre-existing medical premium is being determined.  I did manage to email a copy of this letter to InsureandGo, and the reply came back "Unfortunately, we are not medically trained to read and interpret a medical report."  And yet there was a medically untrained person, sitting in front of a computer, making my answers fit into InsureandGo's template, to determine the pre-existing medical premium I was being asked to pay.  One question which really annoyed me was- Have you "Had a blood test EVER at any time shown your cholesterol level to be raised?"   This is so imprecise.  EVER?  Over a 65+ year time frame?  Raised by how much?  Against what reference as been "Not High"?   I was asked how many medications I was taking for this condition.  Does an "over-the-counter" medication recommended by the specialist count?  I decided to pay this medical premium, which more than doubled the cost of the insurance, as I did not have the time to investigate alternatives.  Between now and the next overseas trip, I will be researching travel insurance offers very carefully to try and find an insurance company which is more realistic about the way it evaluates pre-existing medical conditions information..

body: Got a policy with TID for a trip to Nepal to do Everest BC. I always get travel insurance but this is the first time I've had to claim. Decided to got with TID because they had good reviews on here and were relatively inexpensive compared to other brand (good balance between price and inclusions). We had the top level of cover ("The Works" because we needed to be covered for altitude. It was $240. Never thought we would have to use it but boy am I glad we didn't cheap out on pov pack budget insurance when we did. I ended up pregnant with high risk complications prior to travelling. I actually ended up spending a night in hospital on what would have been our second night in Kathmandu if we had left Australia. Put in a claim. I did admittedly did have to jump through a few hoops, getting my dr to write a letter etc but I am sure this would be the same with any insurance claim. Got an email back and we're getting the full amount of our airfares and non-refundable tour deposit back less excess of $200. I'm pretty pleased with the whole process and would definitely recommend TID. I'll be using them for any overseas trips I do in the future.

body:

I fell ill on our cruise and required extensive treatment by the ship's medical team over a number of days. And then we got the bill. It was way beyond our imagination.

We lodged a claim with Cover More upon returning home. The full process took somewhat longer than we anticipated but the insurer was in regular contact with us to indicate progress. A significant portion of the delay was due to the necessity of establishing the possibility of a pre-existing medical condition. The delay was extended by my doctor being on leave from his practice.

Cover More settled my claim in full very promptly after my doctor's return and I recalled that the credit card companies had required me to supply my medical history and charged a fee of $75 for assessing same prior to issuing a policy for each trip.

We will certainly apply to Cover More for all future travel insurance.

title: **beware - do not use this travel insurance company**
body:
I am a single person who receives the Disability Support Pension, and was going on a once in a lifetime holiday, I chose InsureandGo as they were the cheapest available and covered my many pre-existing illness for a small cost. 

Timeline: 

I purchased non-refundable accomodation in NOV 2019
I purchased single GOLD travel insurance on 16th JAN 2020
Travel ban issued by the PM on 18th March 2020 due to COVID-19
Submitted lawful claim with InsureandGo on 18th March 2020 (all documents)
Submitted complaint with InsureandGo/Mitsui/Mapfree on 27th March 2020
Submitted complaint with AFCA 01st April 2020
Submitted complaint with ACCC 07th April 2020
Rejection letter received from InsureandGo 15th May 2020 (unlawful) 
Complaint FAST TRACKED by AFCA 26th May 2020

As of 28th of May 2020 - I am still awaiting a final outcome (complaints) 

**UPDATE**
WEDNESDAY 24TH JUNE 2020 (3 months after initial claim lodged) 
COMPLAINT FINALISED IN FULL $4,500.00 - BIG THANKS to the AFCA
**UPDATE**                      

They may as well advertise as - we are InsureandGo, we will take your Insurance Premium and then never deal with you ever again!!

Customer service is non-existent, complaints is non-existent, disgraceful.

Thanks to AFCA who I had to wait 10 weeks for who then could action my case, this is the first time I have had contact from anyone human.

Why do consumers have to take avenues like AFCA to receive legitimate lawful accomodation non-refundable cancellation cover? Its DISGRACEFUL!!

I really do hope that the ACCC come down on them hard or even more so ALL Australian travellers completely abandon this company!!

DO NOT USE InsureandGO / Mitsui / Mapfree - they are a massive worldwide company who are only interested in peoples premiums, nothing else!!

I would hate to be stranded overseas or ill overseas and have to rely on them!!

If I could rate them minus 5 stars I would!!

title: Don?t use 1Cover
body: We thought we were getting good value insurance for our overseas holiday and Mediterranean cruise, particularly selecting an in advance of departure policy including cruise cancellation insurance. We advised 1Cover immediately and the representative told us not to worry you have cruise cover make the changes to re book another cruise and we?ll take care of your on costs when you return. On return we submitted our claim with receipts and the help of our Tavel agent. 1Cover replied and declined our claim due to the cruise cancellation by a mechanical issue! Which is stated in the t&c small print but not when you select full cruise cover at the time of purchase. We will be taking as far as we can and to the media. Personally I will never use 1Cover again and I will vigorously promote the non use of 1Cover on social media and family and friends throughout the world.

body:
Paid insurance for domestic travel in August.
Cancelled travel due to COVID and job loss.
Request a refund from InsureandGo based on ACCC website advise. 

Was advised by insurer:
As you are outside the 14-day cooling-off period, no refund would be applicable should you wish to cancel your policy.

If your intended travel dates are before the 17th of June 2020 as a gesture of goodwill we will also consider a pro-rata credit with no administration or cancellation fees applying for all* single trip policy holders who have not made a valid claim and can no longer travel as planned due to the impact of COVID-19. To register for this pro-rata credit please log in to your account here and follow the steps. Please use a desktop device to login into your account.

The pro-rata credit amount will be calculated based on your travel dates, purchase dates, and when the government restrictions were put in place. Once submitted, our team will be in contact shortly to confirm your InsureandGo pro-rata credit amount.

Next time I will do my research further and select more carefully and it won?t be InsureandGo.

title: Read your Policy. Do not choose Cover-More
body:
The reason you buy travel insurance is for when things go wrong.
Buyer Beware. Please read your Policy and choose your company carefully. We pay money in good faith and to cover for unforeseen circumstances. Overseas trips are once in a lifetime opportunities, we pay our hard earned money to have these opportunities. It's not often things go wrong but when they do, it can be a huge financial blow. 
What is really sad is that the general public buys insurance products which give them back very little back and Insurance policy statements are confusing and therefore misleading in nature. Please read policy CAREFULLY, take out the necessary extra insurances 

Covermore state in section 3 part 1 of their policy under Amendment of Cancellation Costs 

Due to circumstances outside of your control and unforeseeable at the relevant time you have to rearrange your journey prior to leaving home, we will pay the reasonable cost of doing so.

Ummm No they won't!!! Read your policy because they won't cover airline cancellation for any other reason than the airline striking! To state that they will pay cancellation costs and then put a caveat in their policy to say they will only pay if the airline strikes ,in my opinion is misleading.

I had to change my tickets at a very high cost due to Garuda airlines completely cancelling a flight path to Nias Indonesia. I was going on a surf trip and I surf longboards. Garuda is the only airline company that would take my particular length boards. I had to change my entire flight path and all my tickets to be able to carry my surfing equipment with me as Lion air the only other operator available does not accept boards over the length I needed. 

Covermore are not paying my claim for the costs of me re-arranging my journey due to not being able to carry my surf equipment because of a flight cancellation. The reason my tickets were changed was due to UNFORSEEABLE circumstances outside of my control resulting in me needing to re-arrange my ENTIRE journey. I cannot magically learn to surf a board half the size of my normal board in 2months after surfing particular boards for 14 years in order to take a flight path that is more convenient and cost effective. 
 However, Covermore is trying to avoid paying my claim by saying they do not cover airline cancellations other than for the airline striking. Airline cancellation is not the reason I had to rearrange my whole journey however this is Covermore's reason for not paying out my ticket change. 

I have lodged a complaint with Flight Centre about recommending Covermore as a travel insurance provider. I will so be lodging another complaint with Australian Financial Complaint Authority. I also urge you to lodge complaints with AFCA as these companies need to held accountable for the way they offer peace of mind however do far less than that when all the small print is read properly. 
 Covermore dosen't want to pay claims and help people. They want your money! 
These guys are ruthless and you may as well have cut your insurance out of a cereal box. They have not taken the time to understand the claim and tried to find any caveat in their policy in order not to pay. 

Be careful if you have any pre-existing medical conditions that include mental health problems. Some insurance companies can legally discriminate you in their policies. You are not covered for many reasons. Meaning that in some ways the policies are useless in which I found with Covermore.

title: I will not use Budget Direct Insurance ever again.
body:
My claim for prescription glasses left in the pocket of the seat in front of me on an airplane was rejected due to the following exclusion in the travel insurance policy: "Property you leave unattended in any public place or with someone you do not know looking after it.?

Definition of a public place: "includes but is not limited to shops, airports (including airport lounges), train stations, bus stations, streets, hotel foyers and grounds, function, exhibition or conference centres, restaurants, beaches, public toilets and any place to which the public has access."

Definition of Unattended: "Includes but is not limited to, when an item is not on your person at the time of loss, left with a person other than your travelling companion, left in a position where it can be taken without your knowledge including on the beach or beside the pool while you swim or leaving it a distance where you are unable to prevent it from being unlawfully taken.?

"As a result, we are unable to accept your claim as it falls outside the coverage of your policy."

So, why would you bother taking out insurance? I will never use Budget Direct for any insurance ever again, this is just ridiculous. I can understand if you left your items on the sand whilst swimming in the ocean, but forgetting to take something from the airplane, thank goodness it wasn't an ipad or iphone. It's not until you make a claim that you see how good an insurance company really is.

And I can't believe they received Money Magazine's Insurer of the Year 2017.

body:

I rang your office, was on hold for over an hour and spoke to [name removed] who was no help and referred me to the website.  I sent an email last Tuesday and still have not received a response (your service standard states 2 days). what happens if one of my countries locks down and if i can?t get a connecting flight or if my family is at risk??? Extremely poor service and I haven?t even travelled yet.

title: Disappointing Experience With Allianz Travel Insurance
body:
We purchased a Travel Insurance policy with Worldcare Travel Insurance. When we ran into difficulties overseas we found we were dealing with their owners and underwriters AGA *(ALLIANZ GLOBAL ASSISTANCE).  

I fell in Europe and hurt my foot. We contacted Allianz who said to get an x-ray (they provided no help to find appropriate medical facilities - we had to do this ourselves). After a medical examination at a Hospital it turned out that I had fractured my foot. I was placed in a cast, told to not weight bear on the foot for 6 weeks, given a pair of crutches and advised to go home to see a trauma surgeon to discuss surgery within a week.

(This was my first travel insurance contact ever and I have been travelling overseas since I was a child - I am now a 56-year-old female.)  

We told AGA of the hospital recommendation, and they said we could apply for a medical evacuation and wait overseas (for unstated period of time) or get ourselves home. Our booked accommodation was expiring the next day. Allianz provided no help with finding alternate accommodation. We tried phoning the help line again but gave up after a wait of 17 minutes and sent an email. My husband stayed up nearly all night rearranging our flights and cancelling all onward bookings. We were 2 weeks into a 6 week trip. My husband got me home - 22 hours in economy in a leg cast to the knee with no help at all from Allianz. I was distressed and in pain during the return flights and had to be wheelchair assisted at all the airports.

We put in our claim and Allianz eventually paid only for the medical costs. They denied the costs associated with returning home and cancellation costs. They told us that after seeing an orthopaedic specialist at A& E in a specialist orthopaedic hospital in Europe, that we had just 'changed plans' and this was not covered. They told us that I was fit to continue our trip (4 more weeks walking 10-15 k's a day, travelling on buses, trains and by car while carrying luggage) - because I had been given a pair of crutches. I was supposed to hop through Europe on one leg because I had been given a pair of crutches. 

After I asked  for my claim to be escalated, they closed my case. I had to insist that it be reopened. Allianz's dispute resolution section was no better. They twisted and misconstrued (in written correspondence to me) what I had told them.  My medical certificate stated that I should return home for a review. AGA chose to ignore this sentence in the medical certificate. They ignored the medical certificates provided by doctors once home. AGA took the information we had given them (the truth) and misconstrued it. I told them my cast was fibreglass and I could not walk for 6 weeks. Allianz told me my cast was velcro and that I could weight bear on my broken foot after 1 week. Allianz told me I was supposed to stay in Europe and get an x-ray in a week when the medical certificate stated review at home in one week for possible surgery.    Allianz told me that after I left Europe I had a stopover. The plane stopped at Abu Dhabi to change flights. I was scissor-lifted off this plane in a wheelchair and wheel-chaired to the door of the next flight - Abu Dhabi to Sydney. I was in the airport for about 1 hour to change planes. Allianz told me when I arrived at Sydney I drove to a Sydney hotel and spent the night. When we arrived at Mascot I was wheel-chaired through Sydney Airport across the road to the Airport hotel. It was 7 p.m at night, I had been in economy for 22 hours in a leg cast, with a broken foot and I was exhausted, and in pain.  Home was still a 3 hour drive away. The next morning I was wheel-chaired by hotel staff to the car hire place next door and my husband hired a car and drove me home.

I was so distressed dealing with this company that I asked for correspondence in writing only. Despite this, their dispute resolution section phoned me twice more to interrogate me. Based on my experience, I can only conclude that this company will do anything to avoid paying a claim or avoid fully honouring its policy. After this experience I will never purchase any Allianz product again. In my experience this is a truly vile company which I found to be heartless, ruthless, and morally bankrupt. 

Do yourself a favour fellow travellers - do not buy any travel insurance policy underwritten by ALLIANZ!! They are easy to deal with when purchasing the policy but oppositional in the extreme when you need to claim on the policy. Seek someone better.

title: Good value
body: It was easy to apply on line and good value. I would recommend this insurance to family and friends if travelling overseas. I didn?t make a claim so I can?t comnent on that aspect.

title: Dont take out insurance with these crooks
body: Had a car accident in Crete my fault car rental company demanded I pay full cost of damages because I ran through stop sign thats the law in Greece So I rang  cover more  help line asking should I pay the full amount they assured me a few times to pay and you will receive payment in 10 working days  cut a long story short they only payed excess of 690 euro After I paid 4400 euro as they informed me to do so . title: Good
body:
The site is very easy to use for individuals and families but if the website was ammened for group bookings we feel that it would be and excellent site.
We found the website had all the information regarding the terms of the policy and what is covered in the policy etc to be quite extensive and helpful.
For Group Travel the website was difficult to find our way around. There was no specifiac point that I could find where I could details our group.

title: Never had to claim but easy to purchase and feel relaxed about travelling.
body: Being a single traveller I found the quote the best for me but I travelled twice this year and will be travelling at least twice next year and wish there was a discount for repeat users and a better value multi travel cover.

title: Very efficient claim service
body: I was surprised at how easy it was to lodge a claim online and how quickly the claim was finalised (especially how quickly the money was transferred into my account). I also expected to have to pay an excess for my claim, but didn't need to - was great to have the full amount of my expense (a doctor's visit while I was overseas) repaid!

title: Fraud, just plain take the money and run fraud
body:
I purchased the comprehensive travel insurance after speaking with a Budget Direct consultant, I was guaranteed 24 hour emergency support and medical coverage for the duration of my trip, never believing I'd ever need it in any case.

I suffered a serious injury during my trip and contacted the emergency call centre, they never answered, I then made contact via web chat and was given an email address (yes an EMAIL ADDRESS) and told that someone would contact me. 

I had no response from anyone in over TEN DAYS and that was just a totally uninterested "are you dead yet?" three line email they wouldn't even guarantee that if I sought medical assistance the bills would be paid (I was in a country where if you don't pay you don't get treated).

When I outlined my condition and requested assistance I received NONE, every few days leading up to my departure back to Australia all I got were sporadic emails in response to further requests for assistance Budget Direct gave me NOTHING, I was just left to fend for myself no matter how many times I pleaded for help.

My flight home was approaching and I had to organise my own evacuation back to Australia, when I finally received medical treatment it was found that the delay had caused a permanent disability, again when I contacted Budget Direct to lodge a claim they told me that now that I was back in Australia the policy DID NOT cover expenses incurred. 

During the whole saga the staff I dealt with wouldn't supply their names or location and wouldn't even confirm if they were male or female I have never encountered such a blatant fraud by any legitimate Insurance Company.

title: Better to be safe than sorry.
body:
Our policy was thankfully not physically needed. We had absolute peace of mind knowing we were covered should anything happen. 
It was very easy to set up and price wise was very fair. I will use Allianz insurance again when I travel next.

title: 5 star service
body: Very satisfied.  It was very easy to deal with Insure and Go.  Have been with them 3 years in a row.

title: Excellent service - very happy with TID
body:
I've used TID a couple of times now but never had to claim until this trip. Firstly, they are good value for money and I'm happy with the level of coverage offered. The experience of buying a policy through the website is quick and easy plus they offer a good app with useful tips for your particular destinations.

I ended up having to call the Emergency Assistance number whilst away. We were a little panicked at the time not really sure what to do because we'd never had any problems before and the assistance we received was amazing and made us feel so much more at ease. The person we spoke to was knowledgable and very reassuring and helpful. It was also very easy to get through - we called were in Singapore and called at around 10:00pm SGT (midnight Sydney time) and got through straight away. When we called back, the same person answered and remembered all the details of the previous call which made it a lot easier as well.

As for the claims process, I found this really excellent and easy as well. My family had to make claims across two policies as we couldn't be covered on the one - but the same claims officer handled both claims which made the process so much easier as some information on one claim related to another and vice versa. The whole process was very fair and the officer was thorough and everything was processed very accurately.

I will not hesitate in buying another policy from TID when I travel next. Thanks for looking after us!

title: Ok.
body: Denied my claim. Probably my fault that I travelled to Thailand where no one believes in receipts and with a dodgy airline that looses luggage. At least the insurance was comparatively cheap and easy to sign up for. Just not sure what it covers.

title: Never travel with it!!
body: For all the trips we have made so far, whether by plane or on a cruise ship, I have always used 1Cover Travel Insurance.  The policies have always been easy to set up, very informative about what is covered under the Policy and fortunately so far we have never had to make a claim.

title: Best service I've ever received from an insurer
body:
Irrespective of the contest, I am pleased to have the opportunity to thank the Cover-More Claims staff for their prompt, courteous and efficient processing of my claim.  The manager of the tour company I was travelling with, also told me that he had been contacted to ensure I was being looked after.  He said he had never had this happen before from a travel insurer and said "keep using them". 
I was hospitalised in New Zealand after becoming ill on a bus tour and missed my flight.  I was booked on another flight when I could travel and had the cost of the flight and medical treatment reimbursed promptly.  It was all very painless and not frustrating.
As I said before, I am pleased to have the opportunity to thank the people involved - well done.
I have also recommended your company to friends and others who are needing travel insurance.
Courteous, prompt and efficient.

title: Undecided...
body:
This is the second time I've used TID. I think their prices are competitive. Their service was good right up until I returned and submitted my forms for a stolen camera. The woman I spoke to said the claim had been rejected because the police in Bolivia had made a spelling mistake on their police report when they wrote the date (they wrote the year wrong and so the theft was predicted to occur exactly one year into the future... lol clearly a typo!). She said this made the claim invalid. I went ballistic at her... One letter and two phone calls later she capitulated and told me the claim would be paid out. Which it was, no further hassles...
So my experience was mixed... let's see what happens if I need to claim again in the future...
Service was of an acceptable standard, even when calling from OS the people were helpful.
They tried to squirm out of paying a claim but eventually after threating to open a can of you-know-what, you-know-where they paid the claim

title: Consistent customer service
body: Dealt with one person (Austin) who kept us up tp date with progress emails. We got the impression that he was genuinely trying to assist us with claim. When purchasing the policy information and explanations were forthcoming and staff helpful.

title: Good
body:
I like that they are underwritten by a reliable company such as Alianz and the price they gave compared very well with Lonely Plannet which are also underwritten by Alianz. The process was very easy and straight forward and only took a few minutes for the piece of mind that we are covered should anything go wrong.
The web site was easy to use.  It let you put in the dates of travel rather than buying by the week.  We are away for 3 weeks and 2 days and the price is the same as 3 weeks but we are covered for the exact time we are away.
Very expensive to cover additional items such as jewelery

title: inusrance for travel cover
body: I have using One cover for every oversea travel about ten years, (going oversea at twicw a year) I found that the rate are very good compared to others and very friendly staff not mention helpful and pront.

title: Excellent Cover - I wouldn't travel without it
body: I have used 1Cover a number of times now and find it very easy to setup a policy, very price competitive for the great levels of cover you have to choose from, the customer service is excellent in the event you have to make a claim.  Requests for information and claims are handled very promptly and efficiently and requests for documentation are easy to understand and claims easy to prepare.  Would totally recommend 1Cover.

title: Hassle Free and Quick Claim.
body: My wife and I used Insure and Go Travel Insurance for a trip to Phuket.  Unfortunately due to an urgent family illness we only stayed one night and returned to Australia.  I contacted Insure and Go and advised them on the situation.  They sent out a Claim Form straight away.  I completed the Claim Form and provided supporting documents.  The  Claim was Approved within 5 days.  Very happy with the outcome.

title: Still waiting
body: Submitted a claim on April 1 as my former partner and father to my children died suddenly.  We had a house to empty, a funeral to arrange and grief to deal with so did not take our trip.  Despite my former partner not being on my policy or part of my trip, his death has sparked an investigation into his medical history and AusPost want full access to his medical records.  I don't understand how this is relevant. I went with AusPost as the price was good and I worked for them at the time. I would not recommend them as Travel Insurers.

title: Good value
body: The policy was good value for the money and was easy to set up on line, we were lucky enough to have an uneventful trip so did not have to make any claims

body:

Fortunately we didn't need to make a claim but it was reassuring to know were covered. We'll definitely be using OTI in the future.

title: Easy to arrange insurance.
body:
I am a returning customer of Insurance and Go. I have bought their policies many times over the last 10 years.

title: easy to get

title: The must have travel insurance

We encountered a problem where the airline had lost our luggage, we got in contact with travel direct and were ready and waiting to assist us incase the airline couldn't retrieve our bags. This gave us a confident piece of mind, as we were attending a wedding. Will definitely use them again and tell everyone about them.
reliable, ease of making a claim

title: I didn't need to claim

title: Easy to access
body:
Second time user of this product. Easy to set up and competitive to the market.
Comes with an App to claim but have not needed to claim against it.
Would use again

title: Good overall coverage
body: Policy was value for money. Easy to set up and easy to make a claim. It was satisfyingl knowing that the insurance covered my car rental excess when half way through my trip I needed a hire car.

title: Travel USA

Although l did not have to make a claim, I am sure if I had to, the same level of professionalism and care would have prevailed.

title: Great service!
body:
Inexpensive & reliable. Great phone service always friendly!
I have been using One Cover now for the past few years on our travels to Tasmania, Adelaide & several family trips to Bali. Always great phone service & we enjoy the small discount for being frequent customers. We have booked online & found the website easy to follow & understand. 
We have recommended One Cover to our friends and we will continue to be customers!

title: Fast And Efficient Service
body: Policy was great value.  We had to lodge a claim and the service we received from start to finish was fantastic.  I will definitely  use them again and recommend them.

title: Essential travel tool.
body:
Previously I held an annual travel policy with you however, apparently my age now precludes this.
I have only made one claim in all the years.
I find your product very acceptable.

title: Easy to deal with
body:
1 cover were easy to deal with. Explained everything, gave options, were quick to help and very good price.
I?ll definitely be using them again next holiday and I have already recommended 1 cover to friends to use.

title: Great service
body: On several occasions now I have received amazing service from TID.  A checklist before leaving and good followup service on return.  Must be something in the water at their place of work they are exceptional and I will be recommending them to my friends and colleagues. Congratulations on a great job.

title: Must gave cover
body: With multiple conditions to be considered the process was quite easy to negotiate. It will be interesting to see how the company performs if a claim is required. I am a first time user with this company.

title: Good
body:
The main thing that blew me away was when I called from Bangkok to start the claim process, I was asked to stay on the line and speak to a nurse so that they could gauge the emergency. I was pleasantly suprised to feel that there was a genuine concern for my well being and was encouraged to note that I had made the right decision not to continue my next flight.

All in all, very competitive premiums, great service, claiming was easy.
Have been using TID now for about three years of overseas trips. Other than competitive pricing, I didn't have a lot to comment on as I had never made a claim. Service is excellent, the emails before and after your trip are a nice touch to make sure that everything goes / went well.
Not a lot, I though communication during the claim process was a bit light on. Having said that, the Mondial Assistance office was in Brisbane and the claim occurred in the midst of the Brisbane floods. But this did not impact on my claim process time.

title: Essential to have but still surprisingly expensive
body:
Surprisingly expensive for coverage and suspect due to market pricing power is fully exploited
It was easy to set up and sales staff able to ensure I left with a policy that left us fully covered.

title: Not worth the Premium
body:
I have only claimed travel insurance once before about 10 years ago with Covermore and it was a nominal amount less than $300. 
I lost my phone on no lid at this time in Bali and to replace it would be at least a $1000 you paid the claim less depreciation which I never realised less excess so I received roughly $200 which would not replace a walk-talkie so unimpressed. 
I would not use you again or recommend you to anyone.
Most disappointed and amazed.

title: Disappointed at no response or update, no communication at all. Not looking promising
body:
I was booked to go on a Christmas Cruise with my family and in the early hours of the day we were leaving I was very sick.  Vomiting and diarrhoea, bad stomach cramps, etc. I was unable to leave with my family to board the cruise ship.  To cut a long story short I got a medical certificate stating gastroenteritis, obviously too ill to travel.  I am sure that no cruise line would let anybody near their ship with my symptoms.  I submitted all my paper work on the and have not received one bit of communication from Cover-More.  The only reason I took out insurance with Cover-more was from reading the reviews on this site.  I noted that when something had gone wrong the response was transparent on here and the party lodging the response seemed happy with the result.  
What has gone wrong Cover-More at the least I expect someone to touch base with me and let me know how my claim is progressing.

title: On a same trip I have to claim Damage baggage, date change of airline and one hotel fee, 1Cover trav
body:
Not worth if you have a emergency and need to  claim back,  Any other insurance don't charge twice $100 policy excess like this. Never get 1cover travel insurance again. Its useless to have this kind of travel insurance at all .
After send all detail by email. They call me again asked what i want to claim and bla bla, Its not nice and while at work can't remember what we put in month ago. Can't remember exactly amounts.

title: Easy, easy easy.
body:
The policy was easy to take out. We made a claim and the girl who handled everything was very prompt and considerate.We were worried because of what some people have told us about their experience with other companies, but it all went smoothly and quickly. Whenever they said they would phone they did and sent confirmation emails as well. You did not feel like you were being forgotten about.
Just how easy everything was. The policy was reasonable and the sevrice was good

title: Excellent
body: Difficult to get through on the phone sometimes but very efficient when got through and also when a claim was submitted. Much cheaper than lots of the well known companies for equivalent cover

title: Very  pleasantly surprised!
body:
Having been back in Aus for a time I feel it only fair to let potential purchasers of insurance about my experience.
I found myself in a hospital in Dubrovnik for a few weeks. The team at Zoom didn't miss a beat with helping myself and family through the situation. My claim was an eye-watering amount and they worked with the hospital to sort it prior to me leaving. They continued with the service  by arranging our flights home and making it as comfortable as possible. Once home they guided me through the process of making clean for incidentals that came to a substantial amount. Again there was no problem. I want to  thank the team at Zoom from the nurses to the end processors for the assistance and understanding .

title: No complaints
body: Yes, my policy was of good value and it was very easy to set up. I am very much satisfied with 1Cover Travel Insurance which is the reason why I use it every time I travel.

title: Don't buy bad company to work with!
body:
Never buy from them! I did research for insurance based on reviews, pricing, inclusions/exclusions. Paid $400 for a single trip policy to travel for a FUNERAL! As of mid March we were still intending travel but the borders started closing, now England has closed its borders and we literally cannot travel. I've lost thousands  on the trip, lost my job this week. So I'm trying to recover what I can, I've not asked to claim anything through them, just a refund on the policy as it is exceptional circumstances, the policy start date has not yet commenced, I have not used the policy and cannot claim?! They have ignored all my correspondence, then the person I finally got was horrible!
Some other companies are being gracious as we are now in an exceptional time, but these guys??? I will never buy from them again, thanks for being the great company you pretended to be!!!

title: excellent servicew
body:
Being hospitalised and missing our cruise,  I was fearful  of the consequences.  However, after a phone call to Covermore ((who we had used previously for insurance) I was given clear instructions on what paperwork was required and subsequently submitted all revelant details.  Within the expected time frame I was given a full refund and found the staff both courteous,  efficient  and knowledgeable.  I would recommend them and will be using them for any future travel insurance
Clear concise and effecient instructions.

title: Awesome travel
body: This is first time to used this insurance company. And its good the price affordable love it. Thanks to all and god bless!

title: travel insurance at ease
body: Great easy and straight forward to fill out and apply.. Really impressed...thankyou all would recommend to anyone else looking into taking out any travel insurance travelling anywhere to take a look. Thanks once again

title: Nightmare
body: First consultant informed me the wrong information; misleading and expensive. Still waiting for a phone call for the dispute case, more hours on the phone. Basically was informed to book another flight, which I later found was not covered by my package. Misleading, frustrating, expensive and depressing. Never, ever again.

title: Easy and worthwhile
body:
Very reasonable realistic rates, easy to arrange and set up, easy to amend, will definitely use again.
I did not make a claim so cannot comment on that side of the process.

title: Great Product
body: A good value product and happened easily. I needed a product to cover our New Zealand cruise and it was delivered pronto. It managed our special medical needs without any fuss.

title: Good
body:
I was studying for a year overseas and obviously needed travel insurance.  To get the Insurance it was fairly easy and affordable.  I did need to use the insurance for a dentist visit due to a chipped tooth.  When returning home I was tossing up if it was worth making a claim or not as the surgery was so cheap and I thought it would most likely be a complex process to make a claim.  This was not the case, the claim was made online in no time and within a couple of days I received confirmation that I would be reimbursed.  This then happened about a week later.  I am very satisfied and I will use covermore in the future.
affordable, efficient.

title: Great insurance coverage at a very reasonable price.
body:
My Family and I have used Sure Save for all our travel insurance needs for the last 8 years,  they provide great reliable insurance coverage at a very reasonable price. Unfortunately I had to make a claim on one trip due to a snow skiing accident,  the claim process was simple with assistance provided by very helpful staff each step of the way.

we no longer get quotes from other companies as we find sure save provide great coverage along with a great service at a very reasonable price, what more does any traveler need.

title: Slow in processing
body: After arriving back from our cruise we instantly lodged our claim online, we realised quickly that something wasn?t right and contacted them to rectify, yet some weeks after we are still waiting, going backwards and forwards with them requesting this and that, very frustrating and very poor customer service ... would not recommend this company to anyone, quick to take your premium, slow to pay out a claim ....

title: If you are 17
body: I had trouble finding a good insurance at 17 ! This was good and easy to use on the net! Some companies would not take me on because of my age

title: Piece of mind
body: Hi I have used this company probably the last 5 times I have been th Thailand & has giving me love of mind when travelling.luckily I never Has to make a claim.

title: No fuss well priced
body:
Very easy to set up... would use again
Luckily, I did not need it.. but the reviews are good
I have already mentioned it to a few friends 
Who are keen

title: Wouldn't Be without Travel Insurance.
body:
What a wonderful response to my illness while on  a Cruise and subsequent expenses when arriving back to
Australia.
Cover-More has taken the worry and fears for the costs of Medical, transport adjustments, etc. which I am
sure is helping me with my recovery.
Such nice people to deal with, making everything fall into place. Very well done.

title: Just the better option - only way to fly from now on
body:
Insurance is insurance. you hate paying for it, but always wish you had when you don't.
I guess what I appreciated most was that it was easy and quick and compared to any other prices I was offered through the airline or ticketing was great value.
I will definitely use again.

title: Peace on mind when travelling

title: Essential for travel. Use Cover-More for all our adventures.

The whole process of getting insurance cover is very easy to do. In our last 5 trips we have only needed to make one minor claim, and Cover-More's response was quick and satisfactory. I hope we never have to make another claim, but I think travelling without insurance is exceedingly unwise.
Easy to do, secure and reliable.
Promotional code for competition not clearly displayed.

title: If you can't afford Travel Insurance do not travel - Travel Insurance Direct make it affordable
body:
I think I have now used travel Insurance Direct for the last 10 years or so, on every trip I have been on and further more my sister and hubby and my daughters all use Travel insurance Direct too. 
I have had 2 claims, where I injured myself at the airport on the start of our holiday and TID paid every bit of all my expenses without any problems at all. The other was stung by wasp and my foot starting swelling within seconds and was rushed to hospital because I was allergic to Bee and Wasp stings.
I recommend them to all my friends at work who are travelling as well.
As I said if you can't afford travel insurance; don't travel because you never know when you will require assistance. Look what happened to me, I sure was not expecting to injury myself or get stung but I did and they were right there to process my claims, how good is that.
Affordable and they pay your claims as long as you have your receipts.

title: Great when You pay. No so good if they have to pay!
body: You need to be aware that the insurer is not Medibank but Great Lakes Australia and the claims process is managed by Travel Insurance Partners not Medibank. This same arrangement applies to many other travel insurance suppliers so simply changing your insurer may not change the people you will have to deal with in a claim. Read the PDS carefully. I booked a trip but just 3 weeks before I was due to travel, I was diagnosed with cancer and had to cancel. This diagnosis came as a result of the Government's Bowel cancer testing program and I had no symptoms or family history of cancer. Travel Insurance Partners made the claim process very difficult at every step even demanding nearly four years of medical records despite having a certificate from my doctor, of more than ten years, that he had never treated me for this disease. Unable to find any excuse they finally had to pay me after more than five months. It was useless complaining to Medibank as they simply referred any complaint to TIP. After my experience, I would not recommend placing your your travel insurance with these people.

title: Repaid my stolen money
body:
On the 2nd day of my 5 month trip I had money stolen from my locker in my London hostel. TID repaid the money after a few email inquiries. While it did take a few weeks before the money came into my account, the whole experience was quite hassle free. 

I did an online application and the staff were quite professional and got back to me within about 10 days, despite the fact that it was a busy period. It wasn't a massive amount of money (about $400 worth) so there was no sense of urgency. But it was nice that they responded and that I had money repaid without too much hassle.
The coverage TID offers is good and the policy is very clearly written. And the price was reasonable. Would go with them again.

title: Credit voucher sent in less than 2 minutes
body: Due to COVID-19 was unable to travel overseas. Logged on to my account this morning, answered a few questions and received a credit voucher valid for next 18 months. Voucher arrived in my inbox immediately. Good service, thank you.

I feel this is disgusting the time I had to wait and for the stress the customer service and supervisor put me through.

body:

When we returned to Australia i sent all relevant information to cover more and never heard anything so contacted them, they were very upset that this had not been dealt with i scanned all docs and sent them through by email, I received an immediate response that it was in hand and the claim would be dealt with, it was within a short period the claim was paid without further ado. it was a pleasure dealing with Cover More as it takes the stress out of not just the event but dealing with a reputable insurer, I for one would certainly go nowhere for peace of mind

body:

Called 1Cover Travel Insurance to move the dates back by a week.
They said I had to cancel and make a claim if I wanted to be covered.???

Great options force me to make a claim or go without travel insurance for a child.
Also I can now no longer insure him with another company
they have left us in a very precarious position.
Be aware this could happen to anyone, we all plan with the best of intentions but I simple date change

body: We ticked the box and purchased ticket and baggage insurance when we booked our return flights to Christmas Island.  Only VIRGIN flies there twice a week. VIRGIN cancelled our return flight, we could not get on to the next flight and had to fly to Jakarta and Singapore to get home.  Virgin didn't want to know about the insurance.  When we rang Cover-More we found the insurance does not cover cancellations or delays by  the transporter (VIRGIN).  What is the point of the insurance then? title: Honeymoon nightmare..out of pocket $5000
body:
We regularly travel and have always used TID, however after our latest holiday, our honeymoon ,we will never engage with this company again. As a result of a delayed flight in Barcelona my husband and I missed our connecting flight to Athens and ferry to Mykonos which was all prebooked and non refundable. Upon arriving to our connection in Munich, we were advised that the next flight was not available until the day after our original flight. All ferry tickets were sold out for the subsequent days and due to previous air traffic control strikes in Paris there was no available accomodation in Munich to spend the night. We were advised by our airline Luftansea that we should try to get a train or bus ticket to a neighbouring city instead as we would be unable to get to Mykonos. 
Thinking it was ok as we did not want to spend the night in the airport and then have no ferry to catch in Athens to Mykonos we booked a bus ticket to Prague and remained there, having to forgo out plane from Athens to Berlin (our next destination) which was also non refundable.  We had to book another train fare from Prague to Berlin. All of this ended up costing us a lot of money and by the end we were out of pocket $5000 and very distressed. 

When we arrived back home I called TID to inform them of what had occurred. They told me it was fine and I just had to provide evidence and receipts in order to process my claim. I did all of this and was told they do not cover travel delays, when it does in fact state that they do and this is where I wrote out my claim information on their documentation. 
I am appalled by the dishonesty of this company. If you are not going to be covered it would be courteous for them to advise this from the outset instead of misleading you into thinking you are safe. I have travelled internationally 10 times in the past 4 years and have purchased travel insurance with this company each and every time.  Fortunately I have never had to call upon them previously. Now that something has gone wrong, I realise I have been deceived all of this time into believing that I have some security by purchasing this product.
I highly advise against having any dealing with this dishonest company who do not value loyal customers or offer you any real protection.  It is very disappointing that this has tarnished my honeymoon. Do not believe you are really protected as this is just a hoax. I will be pursuing my options to take this matter further. It is very disappointing that the very company you pay to protect you in case of an incident, actually does nothing for you!

Dishonest, will not help if left stranded

title: What a let down!!!! Worst comprehensive insurance out there.
body:
After 24 hours in Mexico airport, missing/damaged luggage, 3 delayed and 1 cancelled flight later we ended up missing our connecting flight home back to Australia. We contacted Cover-more and were provided a case manager who assured us as long as we have reports for delays, receipts and all documentation to help show the situation, we would be covered. We provided everything, including reports from the airline in Mexico, photos of damaged luggage, plus more to ensure we could be reimbursed for the damages and new flights we had to purchase to get home. After putting in the claim, Cover-more asked for extra report documentation in regards to one delay which we obtained and provided, leading us to believe they would indeed reimburse us for said delays, including our now unachievable final night in Fiji (all paid for).

Our case was pretty straightforward as it was full cancellation of airfares, transfers and accommodation for a fairly simple travel arrangement as a package through Flight Centre.   We had not yet booked day tours thank goodness.    I was very organised with the paperwork and sent claims direct to Covermore and also had them liaise with FlightCentre.  It all went very smoothly as advised and we were refunded in full minus excess and policy costs of course.  It went through quickly so fortunately when Mum recovered and was given the ok to travel again by her GP and surgeon a couple of months later we rebooked our trip.  Yes I used Covermore again and was relieved that the policy cost hadn't gone up due to us making a previous claim.  I was a bit cynical about that!  You never know with insurance companies.  (Travellers you must always take out insurance, you're mad if you don't you just never know what unexpected events can happen.  And please make sure you understand what is covered and what isn't and don't expect anything unreasonable.  Read your policy details!   If insurance covered people for unreasonable carelessness  then the cost of premiums would skyrocket.)  So I have to say thank you to Covermore for being reliable, helpful  and efficient. title: Fraudulent.
body:
This review is a little long, but if you are considering TID, you NEED to read it.

I am going through a claim at the moment. My camera and lens were hit by a wave, and are corroding from sea water.

Their policy documents led me to believe that both items would be covered to a maximum of $4000 each (I had $24000 total cover, with up to $4000 for each camera item).

Not so.

It is NOT new for old. Depreciation is applied at a huge rate to everything, so don't expect to be able to replace what you lost. 

They are applying 60% depreciation on my lens, and 25% on my brand new camera. Believe me, a Camera lens will NOT depreciate 60% EVER. It is not a car. It is a precision instrument, and often sell for about 80% purchase price.

Not only that, but they want it repaired if it's the cheapest option (Try repairing a salt water damaged camera. It will never work again). 

And if it can't be repaired, they will only pay out a maximum of $4000 TOTAL - Even though THREE items were damaged (Camera, lens, and flash), and it clearly states that it is $4000 PER ITEM where it is a camera, or video equipment. My my claim was for just over $6500, for 3 items.

$4000 though, would actually be a good result compared to what they are telling me at the moment - It looks like I'd be lucky to get $2500. 

So basically, My "insurance" has left me out of pocket by over $4000, despite the fact that I have a $24000 in coverage.

Not only that, but it's painfully slow. It took 6 business days just to reach a claims officer, and that's based on when they actually got around to reading my claim (Actually, I claimed 5 days before they say I did).

I am travelling again in 2 days, and this will not be handled in time. My camera is how I make my living.

Also, check out the other aspects of the policy. It looks ok, until you realise it only covers INJURY. An example... if you are a photographer and your camera is destroyed, you can not claim loss of income. You can only claim it if you can not work due to sickness. 

So, imagine your work laptop with all your data was stolen... First of all, they wouldn't pay enough to have it replaced. Secondly, they would not compensate you if you could not work because you did not have a laptop and couldn't afford to replace it. 


There are dozens of little traps like that.

This company is fraudulent. Avoid at all costs, and if you already signed up, cancel asap. OR, if it's too late... protect your things. TID will not pay what you expect it to if things go wrong. It is worthless.

When i went in to STA to ask what the process is as i bought it through their website i was told that no i am not covered. I could not believe my ears. I asked where does it say that and they directed me to a half page tacked onto the end of the PDS saying that as of 21/12/11 Air Australia is not covered. No where does it say in the glossary that this clause is there. No where in the exclusions does it say this clause is there. If this was somehow known about in December 2011 why would my attention not be drawn to it being that my flight is with Air Australia? In my eyes they have taken my money for a service that was never going to be given. No duty of care was taken by STA or Cover More to bring my attention to such a vital amendment. All they do is take and give nothing back to their customers. Well they've lost yet another customer here. Shame.
That they supposedly covered Airline Insolvency
That they didn't cover Air Australia and didn't draw any attention to a hidden, added clause.

title: Expensive cover paid off
body:
I had used Covermore before so I was happy to use them again. I noticed that their cover was more expensive than other insurers, but it was a company I knew, so I used them again.

I flew from Australia to New York City where I had a 4 hours wait before a flight to Toronto. My flight to Toronto was cancelled due to bad weather, which resulted in being moved to another NYC airport for the next available flight, which was the next morning. I found myself a hotel, stayed there the night, and got on my next flight.

Once I returned home, I claimed for the hotel that I was forced to use in NYC following my cancelled flight. I also tried to claim for the cost of the transportation to the new airport.

I submitted my claim online and all I had to do was include any relevant information so I uploaded photos of the departure board showing that my flight was cancelled, I also provided a copy of my old and new boarding passes, and a letter from the airline stating that my flight had been cancelled due to bad weather and that the airline would not be providing any compensation.

It literally took a day from putting the claim online to getting an email saying my claim had been approved. Then it was another week or so before I received my cheque.

My claim for the hotel had been covered completely, however I did not get cover for the transportation as it was well under the $100 excess that I had chosen.

All in all it was a good experience in that I didn't have to fork out $200 for a hotel when I needed a place to sleep.
Fast response, simple online claiming, got my money back.
Cover was expensive to begin with, could have saved some money going with another insurer.

title: Look elsewhere - don't bother buying this
body:
The price seemed reasonable and service was good until you had to call for help and from then on it went downhill.
I have purchased Travel Insurance with Medibank Private mainly for peace of mind. I used to have Private Health Cover with this company. I should have remembered my reasons for ceasing to buy from them!

I felt that the worldwide coverage for 12 months was the best value when I was presented with various offers. It covers for multiple trips for either of the two names traveling for up to 30 days. 

On the last trip, in Bali, my friend got bitten by a dog. Being a medical doctor, I made sure he got the wound seen to. I emailed Medibank as I didn't think it was Emergency urgent but didn't get a reply for OVER 48 hours!  After a second email, the Customer Service Officer calls me and then puts me on hold and gets a Nurse, to whom I had to relate the whole matter to once again. (I had emailed in detail which I suspect NO ONE read), I related the matter to the Customer Service Officer and now the Nurse! The phone bill alone racked up to over $70 and they won't pay that because the Telstra bill doesn't state it was a call from Medibank! 

The Nurse didn't tell me anything more than I already knew being myself a medical professional. She just read if off the Australian Immunisation Handbook She didn't give me a sense of security that comes when you talk to someone with experience. I think people who purchase Travel Insurance should get the best care and advise from qualified personnel.

Because my friend was never immunised for Rabies, he needed, Rabies Immunoglobulin, in addition to a series of (expensive) Rabies vaccines. This wasn't available in Bali but we were going to be in Singapore within the suitable time frame and we were told to go to Raffles Medical to obtain it there. It also cost over $3500 and prior to paying for it I rechecked with Medibank if I should pay and get reimbursed or to get pre-payment from Medibank. Apparently if you couldn't pay for it upfront, you could get a 'guarantee of payment' from Medibank Travel Insurance. Raffles Hospital staff weren't keen on that as it meant paperwork and delays in payment for them. From the sound of it, in the past, it has taken a long time for them to get payment from Medibank. We were also running out of time as the Immunoglobulins were needed to be given as soon as possible. To get a guarantee of payment, we would have to get the doctor in Singapore to write a report of the diagnosis and proposed treatment and fax it all off to Medibank and no one could tell us how long it would actually take to get a reply. 

We were encouraged to pay first and submit a claim. Medibank staff told us the process of claiming was simple. 

When I got back, trying to lodge a claim was so hard. Their website and any attempt to contact a Claims Officer is designed to frustrate you such that you would give up. For instance they say the best way is to do an online claim. You go through as series of questions and it gets you to scan your receipts and upload them. It took me a total of 4 hours to get it all done and it was just ten sheets of paper. Mainly because after you get halfway or three quarters of the way, something would freeze up and you find that none of your documents were saved. You had to re-log on and do it all over again. I found out that it was best to save each page as if you were going to exit and resume at a later stage! I am a very methodical person bordering on OCD and I made sure they were given all the documents. 

When I called to ensure they got all of it, I got a disgruntled Customer Service Officer who told me to wait the necessary 10 working days before you even 'expect to hear anything'. Ten days passed and I got a simple email saying that attached was their 'response'. I got a shock to find out that they left out the most expensive part of the treatment ie the $3682 for the Rabies Immunoglobulin and they cost to inject them! 
When I called and finally got hold of a Customer Service Officer, after a lengthy wait, I was told that they saw that I had put in a claim but 'couldn't find attached a proper tax invoice'.n So they simply didn't pay! 

I do NOT believe they didn't get that paperwork. How convenient that the MOST EXPENSIVE tax invoice, goes missing. Why did they NOT attempt to call me or email me when they could see a claim for that amount was lodged but they couldn't find the paperwork?? They couldn't answer why they didn't bother verifying the claim.

The Claims Officer wouldn't speak to me directly. I was told to 'resubmit' the 'missing' tax invoices and then be prepared to wait for the necessary "lag time - everything here involves a lag time of at least ten working days". (Quoted directly from their Customer Service Officer who expressed very little empathy working for an Medical Insurance company). There is no Senior Officer whom you can ask to speak to - to escalate the case. There is no complaints or feedback line according to the CSO when I specifically asked her. 

The system is fraught with warnings that if they don't get the necessary paperwork the claims won't be paid and you won't be told either. They will just simply ignore it. There is no way to find out and confirm whether they received the paperwork as they will just to tell you to wait for the 'outcome'. You find that you can't trust when they say they didn't receive something. It is your word against theirs!  I have been told by my friends it is generally the case with Insurance companies and this is not new. However I have had dealings with Home Insurance and Car Insurance and generally I have found access to advise and claims experience to be very reasonable. 

Medibank however is only interested in selling you the insurance. In fact they are quite aggressive about it - they will call you constantly during the period after quote and before you make the final decision! The girl that sold me the insurance very nice to deal with.

Thereafter the support is terrible should you require assistance. I urge people to consider this and shop around. Overseas medical incidents and costs are stressful and with Medibank Travel Insurance you find that you don't get any peace of mind. The stress is compounded when you return and try to lodge a claim! You also don't get some sort of security as the person on the other end of the Emergency Helpline isn't as qualified as you would expect.

I should have remembered why I chose to cease Private Health Insurance with Medibank some years ago! Service is non-existent.

body:
I purchased comprehensive travel insurance on the 6th January 2020 for a 6 month world trip, prior to any knowledge of Covid. The cover cost $735.01. I made no claims during my travel, even when I lost money on flights and accommodation during my travel due to Covid restrictions and had to cut my trip short by 4 months and return to Aus. I still did not try to claim on any of those losses as 1Cover states in their policy that pandemics mean that they do not cover any claims. Which I believe is theft in itself.
The real problem here is, many other travel insurance companies have refunded any unused travel premiums to customers in good faith, knowing there?s no way customers can travel, and so there?s no need for insurance - or for insurance companies to keep those unused premiums. The ACCC has urged all insurance companies to jump on board and do the same.
I have contacted 1Cover countless times and have been sent to their automatic phone system saying lines are busy. I haven?t once been able to speak to a representative. I have emailed and only just received an email reply today stating refunds are not possible after the 14 day cooling period.
I?m disgusted, disheartened and upset that a company as large as this one, could do this to their customers at a time when everyone is really struggling. It is theft, it is immoral and I?ll be making absolutely certain that this information is spread as far and wide as it possibly can. There?s no doubt in my mind that this choice of 1Cover during this pandemic will not be forgotten and certainly will catch up with them.
To the people sitting at the top making these calls, you should be ashamed of yourselves.

Well it wasn't enough that my spouse had doctor's confirmation that they had been diagnosed with cancer which we did not know what the outcome would be - they wanted us to rebook but how can you when the future is unknown? My spouse was told by doctors to cancel the planned travel as they would not be well enough or able to travel due to the scheduled radiation and chemotherapy treatments, Diagnosis of cancer in statement from doctor wasn't enough evidence for CoverMore - they wanted a referral from every specialist my spouse had seen - all to be reviewed by a registered nurse (not a doctor). Cover More contrary to their claims of quick resolution took 11 months, we had to constantly contact them and then they would repeatedly request already submitted documentation again and again - often said they'd requested further information from doctor or travel agent which the recipient did not receive until after our enquiries. I think they just wanted to make the process hard and that we'd just disappear.

title: Don't buy travel insurance from this company
body:
I took out TravelCard travel insurance for the first time to travel to Bali for a recent holiday.  Unfortunately, I was bitten by a stray dog on leaving the beach there one afternoon.  I went to a Bali doctor and got limited information and advice.  I was also informed that only the hospital stores rabies vaccine there and that it could be very expensive to purchase there.

As I was returning to Australia a few days later, I consulted a Cairns doctor who recommended that I get two follow up injections to be on the safe side.  At the time, I called TravelCard and was informed that even though the policy was soon expiring I would be covered as the incident occurred whilst I was overseas and the treatment necessarily has to occur later. 

The Doctor provided me with a repeat prescription for two follow up vaccines of which I had the first one in Cairns following my consultation.  The second one was required three days later.  As I was travelling to NZ at this time, I found a GP clinic who administered the second injection on the basis of the information I provided and my vaccination booklet.  The cost of the injection in NZ was $165 and the cost of it in Australia was $98.

TravelCard was difficult to deal with on the claim and they put up hurdles and hoops to delay the claim and put me off making the claim.  They required me to get a letter from the Cairns Doctor stating that in his professional judgement I needed the follow up injections.  This is pathetic given that he wrote a prescription for two injections.  It is also a waste of valuable time and resources at the 24 hour clinic in Cairns where there is an influx of people who have a considerable waiting time to see a doctor.  

The clinic in Cairns charged $55 for the letter, which turned out to be the Doctor's notes on the consultation.  I queried the $55 cost with TravelCard and their telephone representative informed me that they would cover the cost of this letter.

When I submitted the claim with the letter from the Doctor, TravelCard rejected my claim including the $55 for the doctor?s letter they said they would cover.

TravelCard did all it could to avoid paying this claim and provided false and misleading information to me in response to the telephone calls I made to them.  I believe their telephone staff made misrepresentations to me and provided bad information and advice.  I am in the process of making complaints about TravelCard to the ACCC and the state fair trading agency.  I have also requested that TravelCard keep the tapes of the calls in which they provided advice to me.

I am not happy with the TravelCard travel insurance and would not recommend them to travellers.  They are good with their PR advertising and spin in which they state they are different and better than other insurance companies but I found them less than trustworthy, professional and straightforward in their dealings with me.

title: Cancellation cover... Yeah right!
body:
Recently on the 27th feb 2014 we purchased flights and accommodation to America which we also took out travel insurance with cover more with cancellation cover to the amount that we paid in full. 

4 weeks after paying for the trip in full my wife found out that she was pregnant and would be between 30
And 32 weeks at time of travel. Her obstetrician has advised she is not to travel and we now wish to cancel this trip. 

I have contacted cover more by phone and I was advised that we would not be covered under our policy as pregnancy is foreseeable and preventable.

How can this be as my wife was on the pill and had been for 8 years with no previous pregnancies, there was no family planning and this was a complete surprise to us. How is pregnancy a foreseeable and preventable medical condition?

I am completely disappointed with cover more and my travel agent for selling us a rather expensive insurance and adding cancelation cover for "if anything happens and you need to cancel" 

Haha yeah right!

title: Won't pay for flight delay claim..
body:
Last January we're travelling from Melbourne - Bali - Jakarta. We have different flight carrier for each trip. Unfortunately our Melbourne - Bali flight with Jetstar was delay by about 3 hours so we missed the connection flight Bali to Jakarta with other flight carrier. Because of this we have to stay overnight (arrive about 1am) and bought the next flight to Jakarta in the morning.
I have submitted all the required claim documentation to Allianz, all the expenses including letter from Jetstar,  confirming the delay. Allianz returned my claim 2 times said that there was not enough explanation about the cause of delay from the Jetstar. Ok.. then I finally got letter from Jetstar to explain the cause of delay sent it to Allianz, i.e. crew changes etc. Guess what.. Allianz refusing to pay the claim as the cause of delay is not cover under this policy.. For whatever reason from the customer point of view 'a delay is a delay' and the situation was out of our control... An Occurrence like this is a legitimate reason why we bought the travel insurance in the first place. Please note: our total claim is only $700 minus the excess $200 so it?s only $500 claim.. Can you imagine how difficult they are if you have thousands dollars of claim...? NOT HAPPY!!

title: Jury is still out. Claim 1015963
body:
We have used Cover-more for at least on at least 8 occasions with 2 claims and one pending. 2 claims settled within reasonable time. Current pending claim lodged Late Sept/Oct. My wife and I were 2 to 3 days into a trip and just about to board our Scenic cruise of a life time. Son, 40, rang one day to say he had food caught in his throat and was to have it extracted next day. Next day, early am doctor rand to advise son had aspirated on table, died, had been resuscitated and was now on life support. We flew straight home and sat with him over the next 3 weeks on a roller coaster on and off the ventilator. Lost his fight. Following submission of claim we have been asked for more and more information, most recent request was today-3 months into claim. Cover more have been mechanical and in our thoughts, lacking feeling/empathy. Little human contact which in our circumstances would have been appreciated. This is just another matter dragging on, bring all emotions re our lost son back to the surface. Our only thoughts are that Cover More are looking for reasons to justify non payment.
I would quiet happily upgrade on some personal service, like we have received from Flightcentre and Scenic. I contemplated a one star but there have been some good points with our association.
I also note that there have been some very negative reviews recently and ask is the company slipping???????

January 25th 2017 Update: Jury is in refer review 6 January re claim 1015963

Finally received word that our claim would be paid. Virtually 4 months. Claim involved cancellation of our trip with our son critically ill at home. Lost his fight to live. Process was mechanical and only became personal after some distressed emails on our part. There was a different prospective following that time. Covermore need to inject some empathy into their dealings in cases like this particularly as the time spreads out. Our previous dealings have been good hence the 3 stars.

January 25th 2017 Update: Jury is in. See review 6 January.

I did post a review but it is missing. Payment made, past dealing with Covermore have been good but this drawn out 4 months with the death of our son was not good. The process is too mechanical. They need to have some personal dealing with clients particularly in cases as such as ours.
