title: Peace of mind in an ash cloud
body:
I travel a lot and have used Covermore annual travel insurance for the past few years. In June 2011, I went to Townsville with two friends and my 8 month pregnant sister. 
When we got to the airport to fly home, we discovered that a volcano had erupted in Chile and all flights to Melbourne had been suspended. We all had to be back for work the next day, but the airline told us that the earliest we could expect to get home was 7 days away! I got on the phone to Covermore and spoke to customer service. They were very helpful and understanding about our situation (two of the four of us had insurance with Covermore). Our cancelled flight was refunded, and we ended up booking a flight to Brisbane that evening, then we booked flights to Sydney the next day and finally home to Melbourne three days late!
I lodged my insurance claim and within 7 days, the full amount was cleared in my bank account. In what must have been a super busy time for Covermore with so many flights around the world cancelled, I was extremely impressed.
Helpful, quick, easy

title: A compliment is rare but complaints are many, this is life
body:
I have traveled for years with out travel insurance.
As a medic I thought that I could manage most situations myself.
 Thankfully I started to take out  cover some years back.
 On our trip to Bali I had a massive heart attack.
 No previous history. 6 minutes from the BIMC  hospital in a cab I died.
then another 34 minutes before they stabilized me they actually declared me dead.
 They had no ICU so they moved me to the public hospital in Denpassar.
 Here they almost killed me over again as they 
overdosed me with every medication that they gave me.
 One cover could not have been more helpful.
 I am sure if I had remained in Bali I would not have survived
 They were not sure if I would survive the flight or not
 but they flew me to Perth I was in a coma for three weeks then another
3 weeks learning to walk eat drink talk ect.
1 Cover paid for everything no questions even some that I thought that would not be covered. We could not be happier with the service  the advise and help that we received that we got.
We do  recommend them to everybody that we know who are traveling.
I am now on the mend.
A  huge thanks to One Cover and their staff.
Peter Connelly.
Best money ever spent

title: Hidden Clauses - complete lack of coverage for anybody experiencing true travel
body:
To any potential BACKPACKERS, or social travelers - please don't choose this insurance.
If you plan on meeting people, sharing abodes with them, and instilling faith into other people - to experience the 'true' spirit of traveling do not choose this insurance.
I lodged a claim for loss of personal goods; due to theft, with a police report, video evidence of it happening and all the teccomended paperwork and criteria - and due to the fact the item that was stolen was taken during the supervision of a local (who I was traveling with) the hidden* (*they are not made blantanly obvious during any of the process of choosing, and weighing up what insurance policy you want) my claim was rejected.
Why choose an insurance policy that won't protect you from something that is so inherently imbedded in traveling. I'd never reccomend this insurance company to any of my friends or people I know who have plans to travel. This insurance policy and company expect you to not backpack, or share mutual living spaces. I'm completely disgusted and disheartened with my experience with Budget Direct, and looking back realise that they don't have you covered at all. Choose another insurance company.

body: Cruise delay due to medical evacuation the afternoon before we were due to fly to Brisbane to board the ship. Had to find emergency accommodation and missed a night of our cruise and the most popular port - Port Douglas. Placed a claim as soon as we returned. Was told it would take up to 10 business to be processed. Considering the fee I paid for the policy, I would have come out ahead had I not taken ANY travel insurance,. VERY POOR.

August 23rd 2016 Update: An update on the last review

For the 900 people who read my previous review on Covermore travel insurance, I thought update you. I posted that an airline departure delay out of Los Angeles to Brisbane required me to have a night at LAX and a further night at BNE airport. The travel agent said the costs associated for accommodation and travel costs would be claimable on insurance. I put in a claim and the initial offer of compensation was for A$200/night for accommodation only and no other costs associated with the delay were covered. This was approximately 1/2 of the actual costs I incurred. When I complained to Covermore, they said I could appeal the decision. This was reiterated by a Covermore representative on this site. I received the decision today that they are sticking by their original decision and made no effort to negotiate a win:win situation. The PDS states they will cover up to a maximum of  $2000 for delayed travel but the wording of the fine print, in my opinion is difficult to understand. So that it is clear to anyone who reads this, they will only cover $200/night for each 24hr of delay. My concern is that it is virtually impossible to get accommodation near major airports (particularly LAX and BNE) on a weekend for A$200. As such, the Covermore policy under insures costs associated with travel delays and if you are delayed with Covermore insurance, it will likely cover less than you will need to spend. I would encourage people to shop around and be clear with the provider as to what they will and will not cover. In my experience with a travel delay in travel, Covermore covers less.

title: Surprising Terms and Considtions Around Missed Flights
body:
Our flight from the Tello Islands to Padang (Indo) was delayed because of mechanical problems (Susi Air).  

Because of the delay we missed our connecting flight from Pedang to Kula Lumpa (via Air Asia).  We had to buy new tickets at a cost of $600.  When we tried to claim this, it was refused by SureSave with them saying the following ... 

"The SureSave Travel insurance policy does not pay for losses arising from delays, rescheduling or cancellation of scheduled transport services caused by carrier or related to the carrier including, but not limited to, maintenance, repairs, rescheduling, service faults etc."

As far as I can tell the assessment and refusal came from "Cerberus Special Risk" who must be the underwriter. 

I know, I know, I should have gone over the terms and conditions.  But who has time for that.   When I get insurance I would expect that basic stuff like missed flights, and theft and medical would be covered.  Not so in this case.  

Just to be clear:  they did not dispute the facts in our case (we had plenty of documentation), they just said it wasn't covered.

body: On the first part of my trip I landed in hospital, and emailed Cover More on advice. They have an automated email saying that they will get back to you within 48 hours, and it took two weeks. On the last part of my trip I got my bag stolen from me and lodged a claim, its been five weeks and still no progress at all. I won't be paying for this service again.

title: Cover-more are true to their word - they do 'cover more'. Very happy customer.
body:
We have used Cover-more for all our overseas travel needs and earlier this year lodged our first claim ever relating to the need to return home urgently for a family funeral. 
Like all insurance claims you needed evidence of your losses and the extra expenses incurred through cancelled bookings etc. which took time to collect and lodge.
However in the end, even though there were two travel agents involved (one local and one UK based) - which slowed the final decision making process down, the refund we recently received amounted to the full settlement of the amount we claimed so, from our experience, we can't recommend Cover-more highly enough. 
We even received payment towards additional expenses incurred on arrival in back Sydney so we could get to the regional based funeral in time - this was a pleasant surprise and very much appreciated. 
All staff we dealt with from the time we lodged the claim until settlement were helpful and sympathetic to our situation as retirees who had recently lost a loved one. 
We won't hesitate to use this company again should we get the opportunity to go overseas again.

body:

We easily used the Cover-More claims portal, popped in our car rental agreement, our bill and a few other details and within a week the $1000 was back in my account from Cover-More.

Moral of story, Use Cover-More for your insurance...dont rent from Budget.

I had a problem with choice between and annual multi one and a cruise as both holidays for this year involve cruises and land trips - a bit confusing and needs to be made clearer but an email was speedily answered with a solution. .

Easy as to set up and customer service was A plus!!

title: Disgusting company
body:
Absolutely criminal the way this company has responded to the covid situation. 
How can you actually justify not giving people refunds or credits and basically steal people's hard earned money. You cant even use the excuse that a product or service was provided because the polices were not carried out and you were not at any risk. 
I have reported this company to AFCA and will see what happens. Hopefully they go out of business and can't rip off any more people.

title: Appalling Customer Service and and Claims process
body:
Our claim experience, was abysmal. I have worked in the insurance industry for years, and I am astounded by the delorable customer service/customer complaints practices of this company.

We had a bag containing thousands of dollars of items stolen, and managed to email a certified list of stolen items with a Police Report to Covermore within 48 hours of the theft. After a week approximately, we had to request confirmation of their receipt of our email, then received no reply for weeks, and had to request our travel agent to contact Covermore on our behalf, twice, to get a reply to our initial email ! When we did receive direct confirmation, we were told that a
portion of the  attachments were not legible. We emailed better resolution copies and deposited a message on the message bank of our Covermore agent, requesting verbal confirmation of receipt of email, again no response. 

Later, after our travel agent intervened on our behalf for a second time, we were told that many of the items requested (that we had sent twice before, we?re missing) and again we had to resend and request contact, confirming receipt (again ignored). 

I complained about the customer service and requested a complaint reference in an email, again-no response. Finally, after an unreasonable delay, we received a ?part? payment for a percentage of our claim, and yet we  told that our entire claim had been paid (despite their request for information about the missing portion of our claim). Belatedly, we received a final (and disputed) payment. Weeks later, I have yet to be issued with a compliants reference, or a reply confirming receipt of my THREE  written complaints!!!

title: Surprise double excess and dental work only available for immediate pain
body:
Cracked my tooth in Prague, called the hotline very upset and received good service and advice there but was told I could only get work done for immediate pain. I did have immediate pain, but if a chunk of someone's tooth falls out the distress of that and risk of infection if left alone should be enough for insurance to cover the work.

In the follow-up email (which was very prompt, that much was appreciated) I was told I had a double excess that was never mentioned on the phone and made it not worthwhile to make any claim.

Also the paperwork to make the claim was ridiculous. Why my GP should have to fill out a page full of questions about my suitability for travel when a clearly unanticipated tooth crack occurred is beyond me.

body: I have used your company 4 times, always with success.  Customer service cannot be faulted, easy to use website.  I would (and have) happily recommended you.  Thanks, see you next trip!

title: Not impresseed
body:
I had this policy as part of a platinum credit card.

I had an accident in Kolkata, the ends of two toes were crushed in an accident at the shopping center. I went to hospital. They operated, inserted pins, and I was out in three days.

Then I contacted Allianz.

Initially it seemed positive. I just wanted to cancel my trip, and come home. They advised that they had travel agents on hand. I submitted my documents, and was assured a response within 3 days. I didn't think it would take anywhere near that long for a straightforward toe-crushing. In fact, it was four days. I was directed to a nurse - twice - and gave essentially the same information. After four days, they asked for a photo of my foot (I had previously offered one, on the day of the accident, a week previous, but they did not respond).

Finally they accepted to pay the costs (!) but refused to arrange a trip back. I was asked if I wanted the case reviewed. Given the less-than-stellar response rate, I refused.  I made made my own arrangements. It took 10 minutes and cost only an extra $50. I was back in two days. I had wasted four days in an expensive hotel waiting for a response from Allianz.

Now I have to submit a claim, and I am expecting the worst, given the reviews from people who have actually made a claim.

Already, I will check my other credit card policy and see if it is NOT Allianz. I do not recommend them. Beacause, while staff are polite, there seems to be a lack of nouse and urgency - people who have had an accident are not capable of digesting a complex PDS - after hospitalization, most are looking for good, quick information so they can get home or make other arrangements. Allianz failed in that regard. They have failed in effective and timey communication.

body: I got 1cover at the last minute as they advertise at the airport for last minute cover... i had an accident on the 17th july  which required immediate surgery as i was bleeding out on a hospital bed.. absolutley dazed and confused as i also had a brain injury (lucky i had a helmet on) the insurance company was called for a claim and all that was said they will send someone over to investigate.. who has time to wait for an investigation when you are in a bad way in hospital. After about 7 days they come to a conclusion and misleading reports that they were going to cover decided not to as i was a rider of motorcycle but got hit by a drunk rider... they have a policy which is about 60 pages long and on page 50 in small writing is where they have there rules and regulations.. as a last minute cover that should be the first thing that comes up in the policy or atleast the summary on what you are covered on the qoute. ... quick to take your money but try everything to get out of it..

title: Expensive 3 days in Wellington, NZ
body: My review deals more with the process of submitting a claim.  Not easy to submit a claim until you have all the information required.  Can't save as you go along.  Can't talk to anyone - call diverted to call centre in Asia.  Never spoke to anyone at InsureandGo despite supplying email and telephone number despite several attempts.  A decision takes 4 weeks and a review of the decision takes another 2 weeks.  My husband fell ill in Wellington, NZ and I decided to come home and seek medical help rather than be given a large bill in NZ which I was told we would have after attending the Emergency Dept at Wellington Hospital.  He was diagnosed with chronic bronchitis and allergic reaction by a medical practitioner in Australia after the 3 and half hour trip back to the Gold Coast from Wellington.  As we didn't get a medical certificate in NZ our claim for curtailment of our journey was rejected.  Secretive mob with no intention of providing cover for what we paid.  Won't use them again.

title: I'm devastated
body: I booked a trip with my husband to Fiji but I couldn't go because my father was admitted to hospital & subsequently died!!! My dad was a fit man up to this point and we had been on two trips together this year but 1Cover are saying because he was over 85 that we are not covered !!  I have taken out 3 policies with this company in the last 2 years believing I was covered for family emergencies, this is one of the reasons I take out travel insurance.  Is it not bad enough that I have lost my dad- I thought this was a reputable company and  I had recommended it to my friends. All's well till you have to make a claim, I had peace of mind thinking I would be able to be reimbursed when we were unable to travel but this company has fine print that suddenly comes to light now. And yes I had taken considerable time to read the PDS before taking out the insurance but who would have thought there would be such a ridiculous clause. I am going to take this further!!!

title: Not covered. Cover More should be Cover Less
body:
When a flight gets cancelled due to a mechanical problem resulting in missing out on an expensive hotel in Santiago, S America and a flight from Santiago, don't expect Cover More to cover it. Cover More only covers for a workers strike!
I put my claim together as requested. I sent the original documents to prove my claim. On 15 April 2015 I using registered mail. On 17 April I received an email rejecting my claim and Cover More stating that they were disappointed to reject it!
Cover More needs to be Cover Less.

title: Great price.easy to do on line.
body: This is my Ist time insurance policy with your company . Great value and very easy to do on line. Rang operator just to confirm my form was filled in correctly. And yes it was operator very helpful and friendly

title: Speedy and easy
body:
I was on a holiday in Queenstown New Zealand and got snowed in on the very morning we were supposed to leave. Had to Spend an extra 4 days on accommodation until the next available flight out. I contacted Cover-more who advised me of what to do. The biggest delay was trying to get a letter from the airline company regarding the cancellation as proof for Cover-more. Once I had the letter, I forwarded the relevant items to Cover-more. The money for the extra accommodation was paid within a couple of days with no hassles. I'll certainly use Cover-more again!
Inexpensive, Helpful, Australian phone operators

title: WILL USE THEM AGAIN
body: I was recommended this insurance from a friend after they made a claim and said they were so happy with the service.  I had always used the same insurance company for years.  They cost less than my other insurers, was easy to do online.  Will use them from now on.

title: Peace of Mind
body: Very easy to set up.  As with all insurance policies its peace of mind.  I was recommended by a friend to use 1cover.  I would recommend to others to use.

title: I am totally satisfied with Insure and Go Australia as my insurer
body: the policy is the best value for money in comparison to other policies, i tell all my friends about Insure and Go Australia and every time I travel I book on line it is rely easy also, the costumer service is good.

title: Best travel insurance around
body: I found this deal online 2 weeks before we left. $30 each and we were covered for everything. It was great having that peace of mind for so little cost.

title: Simple On Line Travel Insurance
body: Off to Bali and looked at a number of travel insurance policies on line, Cover Insurance was well priced and more importantly both my husband and I being in our 70's have a few illnesses and issues. It was very simple to see what they included which was everything we had life threatening allergies which are always a bit iffy. I filled out the form on line very simple paid the premium immediately I had the response on my phone and computer. On our return I received a courtesy text to say did we need to extend our cover fabulous service. We didn't have to claim but if their claim service is anything like the initial experience I doubt there would be a problem.

title: So far so good!
body: Three times I think. I researched insurance companies and Insure and Go was the one that fulfilled my requirements at the best price.

title: Travel insurance for family
body: First time we have used Budget Direct. We did so because they offered very competitive rates and the cover we required

title: Great help in a medical situation with my young daughter overseas
body: Policy was great value and covered our medical and holiday change expenses due to a medical emergency worth our young daughter while overseas. Emergency contact team was great support and the claim was a very easy process.

title: My Experience with Insure & Go
body:
Yes I think that it was good value for money
Yes but I'd like also to be able to talk to someone and in this case I'm expecting to have an operator at hand.
Refer to my above answer

title: Excellent service
body: Had to use customer service to extend policy - no wait in phone queue and positive helpful client service staff member - made it easy and fast to settle concern

title: Travelling without anxiety
body: I am nearly 80, and in good health. I like to travel overseas a few times each year. It is hard to find travel insurance  at my age for the price offered by InsureandGo. Buying the policy was straightforward.  I have made one claim (medical) and once I had the papers required, the claim was processed speedily and sensibly. Customer support while doing this was excellent.

title: Will be handy for our  trip with no worries
body: It was easy to set up, this is the first time with this company and will use again if we have no worries when we come back from our trip

title: Good value safety net insurance
body:
Easy to use website with good value coverage. Have used them a few times now and cant complain.
Havent had to make a claim so maybe they are a good luck charm as well.

title: This was a life-saver!
body:
I had a really positive experience with Cover-More as the result of a pretty negative experience overseas and I'm so lucky I insured with them! I had my new iPhone stolen in Spain on the very last day of my trip - I made a phonecall to Cover-more and emailed through my claim and I had the money to replace my phone in my account only two weeks later.
The insurance was inexpensive, they were quick to respond to my claim and so easy to deal with.

title: Don't pay up
body: discusting service. Booked flights and took out insurance with these people. Found out a week later I have a terminal illness. Made a claim and it was very poorly delt with snd then denied. So even if your dying and can't fly they still won't pay up. Disgusting

title: Saved me! Best cover ever!
body:
A few years ago on a trip home to Canada, I was in a serious, potentially fatal car accident. Covermore and the Canadian health system argued over who was going to pay it. Not trying to make the other, but trying to pay it themselves! Who does that? "NO I WANT TO PAY THE EXPENSIVE MEDICAL BILLS!!". Sure there were a few things which I needed to cover initially myself, but got reimbursed right away. They were great on the phone, talking me through what I needed. Helped re-arrange my flights, got me back to Australia as soon as I was permitted to fly again. 
I could NOT fault them one bit! I ALWAYS travel with them now! Without them I would have never been able to cover even a 10th of my medical expenses and my flights. 

I can't thank them enough!

title: Easy and quick
body: Easy to set up and excellent value. Although it was not used at least we had piece of mind that if anything went wrong that we would be covered. Very happy!

title: The go travel insurance with no worries
body: The policy offered by yourselves was sufficient for what we needed to have covered. My partner had a medical assessment done online, felt maybe this could of been followed up with phone call. Haven't used policy yet, as haven't travelled yet. Heard about this insurer through my daughter, again great value, will consider using again.

title: Good
body:
We purchased this product in the UK (actually I didn't even know they were in Australia, but will look at them next time I need travel insurance) when we needed a policy to cover our trip from the UK, through Africa and back to Australia.  Many other companies in the UK would not cover us on a one-way journey or wanted to charge an astronomical price to do so.  Insure and Go offered a policy that was able to cover us on a one-way trip at a reasonable price (similar to if we had a return trip).  
Additionally, when we did need to claim for some medical treatment in Zambia, the claims staff were helpful, the process straightforward and the claim processed quickly.
However, prior to purchasing the policy we did need clarification on some aspects due to the nature of our trip.  This resulted in several phone calls and e-mails.  Some of the phone staff did not seem to understand our queries and were uninformed and unhelpful.  
However, overall the product, service and price was good and I would look at them again for another travel insurance policy.
they offered us a good quality policy much cheaper than our competitors, helpful and very few hassles when we needed to claim
we needed to clarify certain aspects of the policy before we purchase it which required several phone calls/e-mails and not all of the staff were well-informed and able to help us, which was very frustrating.

title: Good cover
body:
Easy to set up, good coverage. Competitive rates compared to other companies.
Rang and made enquiries prior to taking out policy.
Did not need to make a claim. Have used previously and will use again.

title: Excellent
body: I recently used Cover More Insurance for a cruise that we were taking. I insured for a preexisting condition. Unfortunately we had to leave the cruise early and fly home urgently. We put in a claim and the claim was settled promptly. We will use them again as we found them very professional and helpful.

title: Good service
body: We had a trip full of misadventure with one of us ultimately being hospitalised in Berlin. The service from Insure and Go was good and our claims were settled in reasonable time

title: All good
body: The policy came with a Seniors' Card discount and pandemic cover. A forced cancellation meant loss of a large deposit. InsureandGo provided the refund (less policy excess) with a minimum of fuss.  Very happy with the service.

title: Easy to book on line!
body: Yes very easy to see what sort of policy I needed for my trip, by listing all the items that are covered in each type of cover with the costs.  A prompt reply via my email, excellent.  As I haven't been on my trip yet I'm hoping that I won't be needing any followup claim etc.

title: great
body:
Yes it was what we needed without being too expensive 
yes very easy to deal with and obtain and understand what was covered
Dealing with customer support was polite and easy nithing was a problem. 
We will use you again.

title: Very good customer support
body: I had to change my policy after finding out my daughter had a quite serious but not urgent condition. The person I spoke with was extremely helpful and lovely. The change was prompt and I can't fault the service.

title: Lost phone
body: Like most insurers - it easier to give them your money than make a claim. We have used them several times in the past, but recently had to make a claim for the first time. Very day to purchase the insurance on line and they are always very competitive in price and coverage. However. Claiming for a phone lost overseas required a lot of jumping through hoops. Nevertheless, their rep kept in touch with us without prompting and the claim was eventually settled. So overall a satisfactory outcome, albeit slow and arduous.

title: Perfect.  This is how insurance should be.
body: Missed a port on a recent cruise due to bad weather.  We had Insure & Go cruise insurance which includes missed port coverage.  Based on the history of our only previous claim with another insurance company, I expected to be frustrated by endless demands for proof & details.  What a pleasant surprise.  The claim was processed & paid quickly, efficiently & fairly.  I would highly recommend Insure & Go.

title: Peace of mind
body: The travel insurance policy was carefully and clearly explained to me. Having shopped around previously for insurance I am confident that the policy price is competitive. The company insurance representative was courteous.

title: Peace of Mind
body: Allianz was very good value for what was covered on their policy, in fact, they were the cheapest online quote we could find. It was easy to do online. Highly recommend.

title: Exactly what I had paid for
body: 5 times used insure and go. First time have had to claim. Gathered all documents for medical and was process with no hassles.

title: Excellent service.
body: I am very pleased with Cover-More. I lodged the claim in the morning and after a few hours I received a reply stating that my claim was approved. The next day, I received the payment. I commend them for their excellent and efficient service.

title: Great value
body: Easy to set up. Hassle free. Great price. Applied on line , it was cheaper than the top ones. Served our purpose for our holiday. We will use Allianz again

title: Great price and what we wanted.
body:
Yes, good value, easy to set up, will use again.
No claim to make, as nothing went wrong or stolen.
First time user of this Company, will use again next trip, thanks.

title: Terrible
body:
Overall: We lost our luggage in transit from Italy to Paris. We had had no clothes or toiletries and had 3 weeks of a 4 week trip to go. We were travelling with children. We checked with our travel agent and the Cover-More agent who both said that we were entitled to a $500 per person allowance for lost luggage after 24 hours and $2000 pp after 72 hours. We forwarded receipts and have not had the claim honoured. This was a totally stressful situation and still is. I think I will have to get my lawyer onto this.
Payment easy all dealt with by travel agent
They do not honour claims. I have been waiting 6 MONTHS for my claim which they said they were processing.  They do not respond promptly. I have been sent long and tedious forms to be filled out.  Much of the information I can't fill out because it is required from Europe and I am back in Tasmania now.

title: Very happy with cover
body:
Third time I?ve purchased from Insure & Go & buying is a very easy process for a fair price. 
First time making a claim. 
(Which is a true indicator of any insurance)
Took a while & they were very thorough & asked for a great deal of information, which is only fair. 
It?s a stressful time but I felt they kept me well informed during the process. I printed out the necessary forms so as I had it all in front of me. Filled them in & posted. All contact following this was by email. 
Additional information was asked for a couple of times. 
I never did speak to anybody but was certainly happy with my dealings, all contact & the outcome.

title: Fabulous Process, Well Priced
body: Since I am hoping to never need this policy,  I am not reviewing anything other than the purchase at this stage. The process was simple, easy and intelligent. The Medical Certification process for Prior Condition was also simple and reasonable. The cost of the policy was very competitive, and the fact I did not have preordained items such as Snow Skiing and Danger sports, ensured it was cheaper than its biggest competitor AIG who I used last year.

title: We did not made a claim , but we read all review before booking and felt that it was the best .Cheap
body:
Even thou we did not make a claim , we read all reviews and felt that 1Cover was easy and the best for us , and our needs . Once decision was made , we went ahead and took cover for our Europe travel . It was very easy , cheap and we felt that if the time would had come , we would had been looked after . It was worth it for our piece of mind .  Thank you, we will always choose 1Cover . 
A Happy Family .

title: Still waiting for claim to be paid out - poor claim service, despite cheap premium.
body:
I can't recommend you guys at this stage as the claims process & service is terrible. I've been waiting weeks to have a small medical claim settled. Your call centres are overseas and pretty hopeless - I never get a call back when promised and just get told it is being processed. It also took me 3 calls initially just to get a claim form sent to me.... Yes, your premiums are competitive and you have a good website and seemingly high coverage, but lodging a claim is difficult. I filled out many pages and provided a lot of documents, had to email then also post all docs via Registered Post and I am still the one having to follow this up again and again.. I call and you won't put me through to my claims officer, but just place me on hold and say I'll get a call back. I just want my claim paid, which shouldn't be too much to ask for a month after my holiday 
has ended...

title: Peace of mind
body: Although we didn't need to use the claim it was nice to go away with peace of mind knowing we wouldn't need to seel the house if my husband took ill overseas paperwork was easy to fill out on line.

title: Good claim result
body: After a disappointing and somewhat discouraging initial discussion with one of Cover-More's consultants, I was pleasantly surprised to receive the full amount claimed for a medical issue  in a surprisingly short time. Thank you

title: Pease of mind
body: Quick and easy to obtain knowing that if anything does go wrong you are covered. I would recommend 1cover to anyone that is thinking of travelling. This was the first time I had ever bought travel insurance and I couldn't fault them,

title: Cheap and useless, is a nightmare going through a claim
body: My worse experience in insurance claim. They will make their effort not to pay you. Make sure you read all the terms and conditions carefully. Had 2 claims, one for luggage and one for medical. They asked me to show them the ownership of luggage. One of the customer service lady told me photo is good enough, I sent them photos. I gave them photos showing my luggage ownership, after that they asked for receipts to proof the purchase of the luggage. I do not have a receipts of my luggage because I bought it long ago, they do not honour the photos of ownership. After 3 months still in process. They paid my medical claim because it was only $13, but they ignore my trip cancelled due to the illness. They closed the case. I had to call them to ask if they are going to reimburse my trip cancelled. They do not follow up the claims efficiently. It is a tiring process to go through these claims with them. Called them and complained, the lady who spoke to me, she is happy for me to go to the higher authorities to complain about them instead of conflict resolution, infact she told me who to go to for my complains! She did so well in that! I did not ask her to bend any terms, all I wanted to know was why my trip cancelled was not processed. Unbelievable service. Will never buy from them anymore.

title: Everything that you would expect.
body:
If you travel more then once in any year I would suggest this option, as its the most economical and convenient that I have been able to find in some years. I had to claim this year, and that was as efficient as I would have expected the process to be, so I'm very satisfied.
The ease and convenience of the World Wide Annual policy
As a repeat customer perchaps a loyalty rate could be offered

title: The most important thing to pack!
body:
Travel Insurance is the first item on my list of things to pack before I travel. Cover-More travel insurance is my number one choice as it provides me with the security and assurance I need.  I have previously made a claim with Cover-More and my issue was dealt with in the most efficient and professional manner...I will continue to use Cover-More and continue to recommend Cover-More to friends and family, thank you!
Reliable and efficient.

title: Excellent  support.
body: Whilst we were shocked by the huge increase in cost (presumably due to our age), the policy was easy to set up and fortunately, we receive a staff member discount so that was appreciated.

title: Excellent Service
body: I claimed for a medical insurance cover due to a fall and Cover-More made it so easy to file for a claim. I got the payment in less than a week. :)

title: It's All in The Name. Budget! Emergency Number Wasn't Working
body: Needed to be admitted to hospital but the emergency number was not working. I was severely sick on 3 different antibiotics, in a hotel room on my own, during Christmas eve and when I was attempting to call their emergency number so that I can be admitted to hospital, their emergency health line was not working! I would call one number and it would tell me to use another. I had to cut my 3 month travel plan down to 10 days. The doctor said I was even at risk of death. All thanks to BUDGET direct.

title: Convenient
body: Easy to get on website and left on holidays with peace of mind that I'm covered. No need to claim always a bonus. Will use again as usual. Happy customer.

title: Very Poor customer relations
body:
15/12/15   Over a month ago Cover Mores claims person advised they needed more info , from their agent FlightCentre and that I should get it  I suggested that as they are Cover Mores agent praps they contact them direct. He advised that he would. Finally I call Cover more today to be told they are waiting the agents info. Just garbage

  02/02/16  Up date , on 2 occasions emails sent by Cover More to advise they await info from their agent Flight Centre who they have tried to call but can't contact; strangely I have no problem contacting the agent at Flight Centre ; Kayla of Flight Centre confirmed this AM that the info requested has been sent twice , in Oct and Dec '15
Garbage service continues ...............though have managed to avoid paying out a black and white claim for over 6 months

title: Affordable
body: great value for money. didn't have to use the insurance fortunately for us but if we had to after reading through the policy this is the one we chose due to value for money!!

title: Peace of mind
body: I did look a taking another insurance policy out but when I looked through the policy I was shocked to see that they didn't cover a lot and that's when I when back to Allianz and was very happy to see that they covered a lot more and a much higher value for medical cost which give you peace of mind to know that Allianz is there to help if needed.

title: Good comprehensive cover
body: Great travel cover easily bought online, very fast reply with policy after I purchased it and will recommend it to all my family and friends. Will definitely use it again

title: It was a relief to know that our loss was covered by travel insurance
body:
I had a mobile phone stolen whist on holiday. I first tried the web site for help where there appeared to be a means of making a claim on line but this did not work for me.  I also had difficulty in finding an email address for reporting the claim which I eventually picked up from a Twitter account.  Once I sent notification by email all went quickly and smoothly.  I received a form/ website link which was relatively easy to complete.  There was follow-up with a few questions to clarify/verify my claim which all appeared to for good reason.  I was pleased when the claim was approved after only 2 weeks from submission.
Email exchange was fast and efficient.

title: Travel Insurance
body: Our policy was easy to get and seemed good value compared to others. I use Allianz for other insurance as well and they offer good pricing. Certainly would recommend to others.

title: Great company to work with
body: We did not need to claim this trip but had incredibly good service when I had 3 claims out of 4 last trip.  Good value offer - better value for money thank other companies.

title: Cruise ins
body:
Policy is good value
Process was quick and easy
Everything is explained in easy to understand terms
First time I have used this Insurance company
Easy to set up
Good information provided
Will use company again

title: Terrible, stressful and shocking customer service
body:
I have been trying to have a claim processed for a month now! They stall at every point by adding an extra 10 days processing on everytime you deal with them. Then it was sent to Cover more, which obviously aren't any better. 
 It was gastro from food poisoning and just rebooking flights. Nothing pre existing. Nothing complicated. They have all the details, medical records etc.  The phone staff are rude and their stalling tactics make the whole process extremely stressful. Not a good company to deal with. I hope it's over soon

title: Slow. Asking for damaged items for 'salvage'
body: This has been the most confusing goose chase of a claim. They have requested I jump through several hoops to finalize my claim and I've been happy with things until this point. (happy with time it takes to speak with someone, price, etc) But the lack of information or communication and all the new demands (which are not on the terms and conditions to my knowledge and I asked them to show me) has left a bitter taste in my mouth. My last phone call I suggested them to send me a prepaid satchel so I could send them in... They are still getting back to me.

title: SOLO LITTLE OLD LADY
body: Being 79 it is not easy finding  travel insurance at a reasonable price when you are on a limited income.  Easy for me to do online.  Have 2 trips coming up to Asia & Italy. definitely use again.

title: Excellent service and good value
body: We have used 1 Cover for several of trips and found it easy to apply online for a policy and found the rates competitive. I initially used 1Cover because my sister used them and had to make a claim and it was handled promptly. On our recent trip my wife had a fall and I contacted them to get advice before we returned to Australia and they were very helpful and supportive. Even though it was a small claim it was handled without fuss and we were refunded our medical costs so we were very pleased. We will certainly continue to use 1Cover for our future trips.

title: Be careful!
body:
Went with TID in January for two weeks travelling in Asia. Had delayed train trip in India so we had to book flights alternatively. Tried to claim for alternative travelling. The train ticket provider confirmed the delayed transport in writing but TID did not accept it. They kept asking for a written letter from the carrier (Indian Railway) which is impossible to get. TID probably knew that. Customer service is also terrible. Not a single phone call to ask me anything or my voice messages were never returned. They did process luggage claim ok.( May be no grounds for rejecting it )...

Customer service, Common sense

title: Excellent claim handling and good value
body:
We've used 1Cover many times, both for domestic travel as a cost effective way to manage rental car excesses and as an essential for overseas travel.
1Cover's claims process proved easy to use with good communication both by email and from the help line. The claim for cancellation the day before travel due to family emergency was settled very quickly and without fuss.
We have also found that 1Cover provides cover for pre-existing medical conditions without excessive premium increases.

title: Happy ending
body: As a follow up to our insurance saga, I am happy to report that Cover more have re considered our request for a full refund due to our cancellation because of Covid 19 and we have recovered 100% of our $1300 payment.  Many thanks to the person who suggested we contact AFCA.org.au as they were instrumental in assisting a reassessment of our claim. I am very pleased with this outcome. Cheers.

title: Excellent service
body:
My family and I were unable to undertake a booked cruise due to my son having an accident the day before departure, Covermore were notified and mailed out the required forms prompty and after compiling these and sending them in, in just over a week the claim was approved and monies transfered to my account. Excellent communication and service.
good communication and speedy service

title: Good Value Policy, Easy to Set Up
body: Good value policy which included all I required in coverage for my trip. 3rd time I have used TID and love the ease of taking out cover and the app for reference when needed.

title: Great Insurance
body: Good value policy. Very quick response when making claims and very helpful. This is only my second time using insure and go and am very happy with them and will use them on all trips.

title: Cover More Actually Covers Less
body:
To set up the policy you are helped by fantastic staff who seem genuinely interested in helping you get adequate coverage.
To make a claim you are treated like second class citizen. 
The policies are confusing and the website actually leaves wording out that is then enclosed in the PDS After you purchase and read the fine print.
False advertising.
I have read glowing reports that this company offer good service until you try to make a claim.
I am writing this to warn people of the Misleading Wording and intentions of this company.
Please consider and scrutinise the policy as you will be stuck somewhere without the coverage you Think you have paid for. Shame Cover more........ the events leading to this review has tainted insurance expections.......Never again.

title: Great value
body:
The policy was good value, lots of helpful information prior to departure. See cond time i have purchased a policy and have had no problems.
Will buy again for my next trip.

title: Never go with anyone else
body: My family have been using 1 Cover for years....and wouldn't use anyone else.  Very easy to set up - and good value for money.  I have lost count of how many times we have used....and just about to use again :) - Highly recommend to all my friends/family - who have also used.

title: Price OK but Questionable how well they deal with an emergency
body:
I was about to take out a policy as the price was very competitive  and the Gold Policy seem to fit what I was after. However as with all insurance policies and companies, you never know how good they are, until you are in an emergency situation or need to make a claim.  I adopted the "try before you buy" policy and tested the "Emergency Number" and posed a few questions to see how well they would handle an emergency  The Emergency Number for InsureandGo is in Australia but routed offshore to the Philippines.  The operator  had very poor product knowledge. I asked to be routed through to Australia to seek assistance. He said he couldn't  He kept me holding on for 15 minutes while he tried to source information.  I hung up.  I'm glad this was not a 'real emergency'! Many would be clients unfortunately will only find out about this lack of professionalism when it's too late.  I called the company in Australia and a  staff member said staff in the Philippines are used to handle emergencies.   
Paying the extra for insurance with a company that has operators in Australia, competent to deal with emergencies is a far better option. I'm glad I did my research. I opted to pay the extra for peace of mind.  That's why, after all, one buys insurance for peace of mind to cover the unexpected.

title: Seniors Travel
body:
Website was easy to navigate and the application was quick and easy - impressive ! 
Happy that is was appropriately priced.
This is the 1st time we have engaged this company so the true test would be if we ever needed to be supported by the company on our travels or make a claim. Not familiar with the underwriters.

title: Read the Fine Print - dont expect any understanding
body:
I submitted a very minor claim when I recently lost my reading glasses in Bali - just over $400.  I inadvertently left them on a table in the foyer of the Mecure, a resort to which the public are not allowed access unless accompanied by a guest. There are actually 2/3 guards on the front checking all guests/visitors bonifides. When I returned a short time later (20 minutes) they had been stolen. My claim was refused as "I left them in a public place unattended" - "even though the public are not allowed in". It makes me wonder what place is actually not a public place. When you read most of the pro comments on this company you will notice they are all made by people who havent had to lodged a claim.  Anyway no chance of a positive result now.  Try elsewhere is my advice.
Not alot - you get what you pay for - spend your dollars elsewhwere
There is no flexibility or understanding with people making honest claims

title: Grateful I had no need to make a claim.
body: It was easy to take out cover online for the duration of the holiday time. Thailand is a destination where peace of mind is absolutely necessary. Just crossing the road can be a major drama.

title: claiming
body: yes Im pretty happy with the value of our policy and it's weasy to set up. We are also satisfied with the provider's customer support when it comes to claiming

title: Refunded our cancelled trip accommodation
body:
Have previously been a customer and not needed to claim. Due to Covid-19 our latest trip didn?t go ahead, we had to cancel before departure due to government travel advice. We had a gold policy and thankfully it included pandemic cover. As we purchased the policy in August 2019 were able to make a claim. Insure and Go reimbursed our accomodation of which 100% had been charged. 

We are so glad and thankful to have bought a policy from Insure and Go. We didn?t get to go on our holiday but to not be out of pocket for it was a massive relief!

title: Very professional
body:
I was booked for a cruise and instead went to hospital for the 2 weeks,I put in a claim and was totally refunded all the expenses without any problems and I have re-booked the cruise. I also claimed on a previous trip with the same efficiency.  Covermore insurance is a must and have got a lot of people to cover with them.
The whole process was totaly efficient.

title: very friendly and helpful with every phone converstion and email
body: My policy was good value and I will use 1Cover again. I made a claim that was only a little over the $200 deductable but it was worth the effort. The claim process took several months but was easy

title: Perfect for my situation
body:
I needed travel insurance for family as their previous one with another provider had expired while overseas. 
1Cover was prompt in providing travel insurance even though the trip had already started and the staff was very responsive and understanding of my situation. Thank you.

title: Second Experience with Insure and Go
body: As this is my second experience with Insure and Go and have not taken any trip yet, I can only comment on the on-line setup experience. It is fairly as expected and reasonably easy to use. I have used several other travel insurance companies, usually one year multi-trip but unhappy with their renew process. It would be good if I can refer to my 1st single trip insurance policy taken only a month ago, instead of doing the medical certificate again.

title: Fast and efficient service, good value for money.
body:
When I bought the insurance online, I had shopped around and thought it was budget-conscious and since it was backed by Alliance, I thought, ok, why not. When I broke my camera and had to file a claim, I anticipated big delays, lots of paperwork and lots of arguing with customer support. I was recently delayed for 3.5 hours and missed my connection, which was the last flight to my destination for the day. I had to pay for a hotel and another ticket the next day but cannot claim. Is the only way to claim under Section 3.2 to ensure that connections are at least 6 hours apart and spend all day sitting around an airport?

title: So Far So Good
body: Had a claim from a hospital trip while overseas. It has taken a while, almost 4 months, but have just received an email to say the claim has been approved and the amount will be transferred into our account within days. We had to wait to see if any more bills would come through from the hospital, which apparently is common with Canada and the US. Then we had to wait to get through the Christmas New Year period. title: Still waiting
body:
Like so many others I am also following up the lack of communications with InsureandGo.  My initial email contact was ignored, I persisted and was sent a very reassuring response saying they would be able to change the dates on our policy to new travel dates.   Once all travel was banned and no end date in sight I emailed again requesting we change the dates to the same ones next year.  I was told originally we had up 
until the original departure date to make this change.  Since then I have sent multiple emails requesting confirmation of the date change to the policy and have received no reply.  
I completely understand they would be overwhelmed with enquiries and requests at this difficult time but having waited two weeks and still no response, our original departure date looms near.  After reading all these reviews I am starting to feel like this policy is worthless.
I have given a 1 star because there is no option to give lower.

title: Excellent
body:
I'm a firm believer in the maxim that if you can't afford travel insurance, you can't afford to travel.  I'm also a firm believer in getting the best bang for your buck.  With Travel Insurance Direct, you can have both - and walk through train stations in Naples, drive the Swiss Alps and boat on Halong Bay in Vietnam without fear!
Twenty six countries down and the rest of the world to see, and I've only ever used Travel Insurance Direct.  The coverage is comprehensive, it's underwritten by Allianz so you know you're not dealing with a fly-by-night operator, and the premiums are the most competitive out there!
Always having to answer questions from fellow travellers (who usually just go with whatever product Flight Centre flogs to them) about whether you can "trust" an online purveyor of insurance.

title: Terrible - How do I give zero stars?
body: We were travelling international for a wedding. We originally were arriving the day before the wedding. Due to weather our flight was cancelled and we were put onto a flight 18 hours later. This was no good because it meant we missed the wedding. We figured we would buy alternate flights so we could get to the wedding on time. We rang Medibank to check what we were covered for and to our horror we were covered for nothing but a taxi home! Nothing for new flights nothing for accommodation (we lived 40 mins from the airport so was deemed 'close enough' to get home) We had bought the comprehensive product - the best they offer but still cancelled flights are not covered. What a load. We bought the insurance thinking we would be covered for these travel hiccups - we were wrong. We have our health insurance with medibank and we will definitely be changing as well has never using them again for any type of insurance. Never use them!

title: Disappointed!
body:
We booked our family holiday to Thailand in May 2019 and I bought my travel insurance straight away, well before any COV-19 issues.  My daughter has a pre exisiting condition so we paid extra for that...and also additional cancellation cover of $6,000.  I spent 2 hours on hold to get through to Covermore only to be told that it was excluded and it didn't matter when I had bought the insurance.  It's devastating that not only is our long awaited holiday cancelled, but that we are going to lose the money we paid for it as no one seems to be offering refunds for anything and its impossible to get onto anyone.  I have another trip booked for next year and bought my insurance with Covermore.  I am seriously rethinking whether I want to be giving them any more money.
I understand that this is an unprecedented situation, but a little compassion wouldn't go astray.

title: Great value
body:
I was very happy with the price. It was $300 cheaper than another company that I had used in the past. The pre-existing medical conditions were easy to complete on line

July 31st 2018 Update: Great for Seniors

Able to insure though aged 72 and 79. Some companies will not even consider you once they know your ages. My partner has had a mild heart attack plus a joint replacement and pays an extra premium to be covered. We find the extra amount is reasonable and worth it for peace of mind. The website is easy to follow and you can increase the excess to reduce your premium if you wish. We have used Insure and go for several trips since the company was recommended by the New South Wales Seniors card. When people get older and have the time and money to travel it is disappointing that so many companies do not want to insure them. Many people in their 70s these days are fit and active and still have a love of travel. Insure and Go are giving us the chance to do so while secure in the knowledge that if there is a problem we have insurance. Highly recommend this company.

title: I have been very impressed with CoverMore's help on 2 occasions
body:
My first encounter was damaged, irrepairable luggage.  CoverMore was very supportive and I was able to purchase a new suitcase.  The second occasion was the loss of a treasured handmade bracelet.  I got a quotation to get another one made and was given the money without question.  I was impressed with CoverMore's efficiency and also their sensitivity to my needs.  Thank you CoverMore.  I will use your services again.
Reliable, efficient, supportive, inexpensive.

body: Fortunately I did not need to use my policy but I felt like 1Cover were just a call away. I also liked the discount for inviting friends to use them.

title: no fuss cover

title: Refund Covid 19
body: Refund: CoverMore has much to learn when it comes to customer service and showing some empathy with people who are usually calling because they are in distress or have a problem, which is exactly the business they are in.  I was due to travel to Europe in 2 weeks time with my husband and twin boys, and just like most people my trip was cancelled, due to Covid 19! I had many components to my trip and as most airlines, Cruise lines and hotels, all want to rip us off by offering ?credits? and taking a slice of our hard earned money for no service provided, we will not be able to travel next year as there are some obstacles for us, I find it extremely arrogant that companies in the travel sector feel they can hold customers to ransom by keeping their money for years in credit or taking a cut for no reason. CoverMore, will not give our family a full refund even though we took out the cover on the 2.1.20 way before this pandemic was announced, it is through no fault of our own that we can not now travel yet they will keep $170 of  the policy I paid $686 WHY!!! I booked with Flight Centre also so going through an agent who is also taking money from us, for no service, we are up to our fourth agent and one shop closure, we are like a hot potato that just keeps getting passed around.  After hours of waiting to speak with someone in the customer service team  at CoverMore I spoke to a girl who clearly was over her job and told me that I was covered for not much as it is a pandemic so they are not responsible for anything, that I understand to a point, but taking money from a customer for not providing anything at all is blatant gouging, and disgusting behaviour, where is the duty of care? I also got a reply by email saying that they would be charging me more than that as at that time I did not mention that I had an agent, so also add conflicting and deceiving to the list!   I would like to know the reason I can?t get my full $686 refunded.  Why am I being penalised for something I have no control over? I did not Cancel, the industry cancelled on us!  I would love some feedback: policy number : 719001069785

title: Great process,value - but one negative to watch when a Senior!
body:
Extremely easy to obtain on-line quote, then proceed with purchase. Great recommendations, very user friendly process, and value by comparison with others. One negative aspect though, as applies to me, seniors above age 75 cannot take out travel insurance until 4 MONTHS out from departure date. But booking deposits, air fares, hotels etc. must usually be paid at time of confirmation - which, in the case of far-off cruise availability, can be many months in advance. This leaves me uninsured against these outlays for this period! Fail to understand, given that NO KNOWN pre-existing conditions exist, have healthy constitution, mobility, etc.
Have used once previously, but when under 75 yo.

title: Opted for TID over my free credit card insurance
body:

I had a much lower quote from my Commonwealth Bank provided  Credit card travel insurance,  however with some  pre-existing conditions  it was an arduous and tedious registration process with the advice that details could be provided to  unspecified third parties. The TID  process was fast simpler, I think the app is excellent.
An improved policy feature would be to include adult (children) as additional members of the family policy with an additional premium added. 
On this trip my son has a separate TID plolicy, my eldest daughter has a separate TID policy and my wife and I and my youngest daughter were on a third policy.

title: Covermore should be first and only choice for Travel Insurance.

We had a need to make a claim with Covermore, our first travel insurance claim ever, when we chose to return a week early from our Europe holiday, after my wife's father took seriously ill.
At the time, we were on a cruise and had to leave the ship a couple of nights early.
The cost of additional accommodation and flight amendment fees were high and unfortunately we were unable to get home before he passed away. 
Although we were required to provide additional information to our claim, which delayed things by around 10 days, our claim was resolved fully in just over 3 weeks.
The totally unexpected call i received from a claims officer by the name of Jacqui advising me I could claim for an additional item I had been unaware of, resulted in a substantial increase in our claim benefit.
The compassion and customer excellence shown by this claims officer has certainly changed my mind about insurance companies and i most certainly will be recommending to all our friends that Covermore should be the only travel insurance provider they research for their insurance needs.

title: Read the Policy Wording - The devil is in the detail, logical or not
body:
We live in Canberra. Our international flight back to Sydney was delayed for over 16 hours which resulted in missing the domestic flight from Sydney to Canberra. The domestic flight was booked separately to the international and they were different carriers. We ended up hiring a car and driving home from Sydney as this was the cheapest way. Insurance claim denied because they don't cover ?Transport provider caused cancellations, delays or rescheduling other than when caused by strikes?. However, they were happy to cover additional accommodation costs for us to stay in Sydney. Go figure - happy to cover accommodation costs and remain stranded in Sydney but not cover the cost of getting us home to complete our journey. ?Journey?, as the define it means the period commencing at the time You leave Home and ceasing at the time You return Home. Their logic defies belief.

I will never use Covermore for travel insurance again.

I had an ankle injury while in the U.S. and required some physiotherapy at the university health center. They authorised me for 6 sessions based on the medical reports from the doctors that I sent to them. This all went ok, and they settled most of the bills fairly promptly. However they left part of one of the bills unsettled, as well as completely ignoring another health center bill (unrelated to the ankle injury, but incurred around the same time).

Now I've been back in Australia for over a month, trying to get those bills settled, almost 4 months after I sent in the original bill/medical report to their operations team, and they have still not paid the outstanding bills. I have re-sent the bills and emailed their operations team numerous times asking for updates and stressing how urgently they need to be paid, but no progress has been made, and they haven't made any other contact with me.

In addition to this, over a month has passed since I sent in a claim for damaged luggage which I had to get repaired. They are taking a very long time to review the claim and reimburse me for the amount I paid to get it repaired. 

It's very frustrating being kept out of the loop in both cases, with no communication about the progress of the claim or the settlement of the bills.  

I don't like writing a bad review considering they were fairly helpful through my injury and treatment, however the fact that at some point they decided to just cut me off and leave bills unsettled is what makes me furious.
Inexpensive
Igorant, unreliable, inconsistent

Their customer experience manager, Alison is a fantastic person who responds to all messages in great detail on this website and to her work email address advertised on this website.

I am so very happy that I chose TID and will continue to do that for all my future travel insurance needs. I recommend that any traveller please give them at least one go for your extra peace of mind during travel.

TID pay all claims provided all the documentation needed by their Online Claims Wizard is provided and claim is properly lodged. They have very good claims processing speed.

TID, Congratulations on a job very well done!!!

title: Pathetic, wasted time, rude customer service
body:
In February myself and friends travelled to South Korea, we got caught in a town right as the Covid-19 cases in Korea spiked, after being bombarded by emergency warnings telling us to stay indoors and avoid unnecessary travel, we made the decision to contact our insurer (budget direct) who let us know if we decided to cut our trip short that we would be able to make a claim. Claim was raised in March, I?ve received communication that it?s been rejected in late July.
We rebooked flights and cut our trip short. Immediately after returning home I put in a claim ? I gave as much information as was available to me. After requesting more information I called up to inform I was unable to provide a lot of it, as it wasn?t provided to me ? after a gruelling 2 months of fighting with booking companies and other parties involved I sent through the additional information. I then proceeded to wait the 10 days for them to make a decision as per their email. After not receiving any confirmation I called up to be informed that as it had taken me so long to get back that ?it had been missed and most likely left in an inbox as the claims person dealing with my claim had left the company?. Obviously a part of their tactic to delay the claim as long as possible to deter customers. A week later they emailed me asking for even more additional information. I provided it and again waited the ten days only to call up and be informed that again, the additional information was sat in an inbox?. Another week passed and they then sent a new email, disregarding the existing chain, asking for the same information again.. when I called I was informed that airlines had retrospectively refunded customers, despite this having nothing to do with what I was claiming. Finally fed up, I decided to have a look at other customer reviews and found I wasn?t the only one experiencing this, so I raised a claim with their IDR department. Miraculously my claim was moved into the review stage, and within 4 days was told it was rejected due to our claim being made ?too early? as travel warnings changed just days after we were in Korea. Very odd given many people who have made complaints were given almost the exact opposite response?
Typical though ? this company is doing everything within it?s power to delay claims and detest customers until they give up, or finding every reason to deny claims. Very disappointing that despite being well within the VAGUE PDS, I was ultimately declinded a refund. Once international travel starts to open up again will definitely not be returning as a customer to budget direct, have left me immensely out of pocket and wasted months of my time. Surley there will be a class action against them in the near future. Will definitely be lodging a dispute and raising with AFCA.

I purchased an annual multi-trip (or should I say multi-hire) cover in January.
I rented a few cars without incidents, then it happened: I scratched the side of a rental car against a wall.

I lodged the claim online 3 weeks ago with all the required documentation.
The damage bill is approx 750$, with 500$ excess, i.e. 250$ payout. Insurance is up to 10k, so I thought the claim would be paid with no fuss. Instead, I had to deal with silly requests and an error with the exchange rate which would have short changed me by over 50$.

The good:
- exactly the product I wanted
- easy to purchase
- competitive price
- straightforward online claim lodging

The bad:
- claim officer asked twice for an extra document, which was totally irrelevant
- the claim took longer than 10 working days despite providing all the documentation upfront
- error with the exchange rate, fixed after I reported the mistake
- ineffective communication, very "mechanical"

title: Waste of Money
body:
Last year I went to work and travel in Africa, I paid $1300 for the full comprehensive insurance with Allianz. 
In Tanzania, I was attacked and held by three men, who took me to atms, extracted all the money from my accounts and took all my electrical goods.
I went to the police station and did a report, informed Allianz and my bank straight away. Visited the doctor to control the extreme anxiety and panic attacks, and also bought a new flight home.
My bank was amazing, the fraud department contacted me, I gave them the police statement and they refunded me all of the money that had been stolen from my accounts. 
But when I went to make a claim with Allianz, I was disappointed with their response. I found all my receipts for all my electronic items, but they took so much of the value off for depreciation, that I didn't even receive enough to buy a new camera, let alone an ereader, ipod etc.
They also would not cover me for any of the loss of flights or deposits on trips due to the cancellation of my trip. They don't recognise mental trauma as a legitimate reason to cancel a trip, which is ridiculous. No one is going to continue to travel after being kidnapped and beaten.
At the end of all this, Allianz gave me around $600, so they still managed to profit $700, while I was thousands of dollars down from having to buy new last minute flights etc.
I suppose all insurance companies are meant to be crooks but this is really a terrible response to what was a legitimate claim.

title: Unethical, neglecting to treat customers with any respect
body:
We were due to fly out on 14th April and I have made numerous attempts to contact someone to cancel our policy as there are travel bans restricting our plans. I have been unable to speak to anyone, despite holding for hours on several occasions, and I have sent several emails. On Easter Sunday I had a call from Travel insurance partners who told me if I cancelled I would lose almost $80 as I was out of my change of mind period. I stressed the fact that the government had banned all travel, I didn?t change my mind, so I was told I could change the dates but I would have to pay more. I gave a few dates to get an indication of how much and it was almost double my original policy cost. I then said when will it not have extra charges, and was told even a policy for one day would be $25 for the day, and it would continue to increase with each day added. This is for a policy that I have already bought!! Seriously?? I then was told that she could make a special request for a full refund but she didn?t have high hopes and she wouldn?t be able to get back to me with a response until Easter Tuesday, two days after the phone call. I asked her to do that. I haven?t heard back, I have phoned several times,I have emailed several times, to a couple of different emails, and am now very angry about the whole situation. It?s disgusting that you aren?t prepared to give a refund, but to just ignore phone calls and emails while you sit on my money for doing nothing is unethical and appalling. I bought my policy and paid for it online, you have done absolutely nothing and have no right to keep my money.
I have used your insurance for many years but unless I get a full refund in the next couple of days I will be making sure that I will be telling everyone how you have neglected your duty of care to your customers.please contact me urgently.

I lodged a claim and lots of supporting documentation; the process took longer than I expected as there was much checking with doctors and travel agent - but I was covered for just about all my claim items - it was many $,000's and I think the expense items of less than $100 weren't covered. So I'm happy to say there was no financial burden and that I understood the processes of investigation and review. title: Minor medical expenses claim paid
body:
I took out the policy online, it was not difficult as I just wanted the most basic policy.

As it happened, I did fall ill on my trip to USA. I had one visit to a medical centre, saw one doctor and was prescribed some medication. All that amounted to several hundred dollars in costs (although less than AUD500). I recovered fully.

Back home, I used the online method to submit supporting documents for my claim. I used flight boarding passes as evidence, provided the doctor's original receipt and original receipts for all prescriptions. All the documents were, of course, in English - but I note that others have said that if your receipts are not in English you will need to get them translated. InsureandGo contacted me about 5 days later to request an extra document from the US doctor that outlined my medical diagnosis. I had to call the US medical centre to get this extra document. Once all the documents were submitted successfully, InsureandGo only took a few more days to review them and approve my claim.

So, it took 15 days (from online submission) to my claim being approved. My claim was quite simple, and I am happy with the way it has been handled by InsureandGo. My claims officer has been helpful and has responded to my emails in a timely fashion.

title: Exhausting claims process - but paid in full in the end.
body:
Have used Medibank Private for 3 previous overseas holidays and decided to use again for South America and Antarctica. I had declared an existing medical condition and paid the extra premium. I broke my ankle hiking in Patagonia and advised the company when we finally reached somewhere with phone access. We elected to continue our holiday after much hassle with the emergency assistance and having to seek out further medical advice and medication in Argentina. We had meticulously documented all our calls, taxis and reciepts, however still had to submit everything twice. In the end they paid for everything we claimed. It was difficult for them to understand that we did not want to upgrade our flight to business class as we were already flying business. I think we actually saved them a lot of money in the end, so they were happy to pay our rather small claim. 
Overall the claims process was cumbersome and difficult to navigate. Photos of receipts did not load with ease and trying to talk to a real person was near on impossible. 
Would I use them again? Maybe, but I have used a different insurer for our next trip. Medibank wanted to charge an exorbitant premium due to my ankle being broken less than 2 years ago despite having full clearance from the Orthopaedic Surgeon.
Let's hope I do not need to claim again.

title: Terrible claims service - not following or adhering to their own PDS
body:
We purchased a full comprehensive travel insurance for 2 people, near the $800 mark. Unfortunately we have been affected by COVID-19 and due to 'do not travel' advice had to cancel our dream 5 month holiday after 3 weeks. We have incurred significant cost and Budget Direct is using all non valid excuses not to pay out our claim. They had updated their PDS mid march, we purchased it prior.  So excuses made so far: 
* Everyone knew about Covid end of January - you should have gone on holiday - even though they still sell the policy including coverage for epidemics (only removed mid march) - it was not a world wide event acknowledge at that point in time. 
* Apparently - the policy does not cover you once you go on holidays (excuse 2) - nothing in the PDS that backs this up whatsoever. 

They should be ashamed how they do everything in the power to just wear their customers out from claiming and coming up with poor and unjustified arguments to not pay out the claim. The arguments are so ridiculous and time wasting I would never recommend anyone using them.  

We are now in the claims process for nearly 4 months without any results. We are now gearing up for Tribunal and have engaged a laywer who confirms we have a strong case. Just do your job Budgetdirect - follow your own policy and PDS, this is so unnecessary and you causing your now lost customers a lot of stress and anxiety during these already difficult times. This is the time the insurance company should stand up and do the right thing. This is why people insure themselves for, do what you exist for.

Easy application process
1) Watch out for policy exclusions - before taking out this policy read the entire product disclosure statement very carefully. While the table of benefits looks generous there are some significant policy exclusions (which are enforced) In our case camera equipment and a mobile phone left in a locked vehicle which was broken in to were excluded (with a one line exclusion clause on page 30 of the 33 page PDS) which as a result left us significantly out of pocket2) Excessive depreciation. In the initial settlement TID applied depreciation of up to 90% on items that were in good condition making it impossible to replace many items that were stolen3) Claim handling process - difficult documentation requirements (eg: you have to provide a translation of a police report at your own expense) mean that the claims process is time consuming.
