We ended up giving the guarantee of payment and having to claim the costs. Too bad if we did not have the credit facilities to cover the costs!!  
CoverMore did email me a doctor release form but I don't usually carry a printer, fax and scanner in my baggage to complete the return of the required documentation. The call centre had no idea of the issues and therefore what was being requested.
During the application process we made all declarations regarding pre-existing illnesses why it needs to be checked is incomprehensible.

And to be honest, I think most travellers are like us.....after a while you start to think that maybe it is unnecessary to spend too much money on Travel Insurance.
 
Well......that has now been disproven for us!

We had booked a 6 week holiday to the US from Australia (Sept 2011). My Dad became ill about 2 weeks prior to departure. From that time, we desperately tried to amend our trip.... but in the end, enjoyed only a 1 week trip (to Vancouver from Australia!). This was disappointing for us, but unavoidable.
I cannot fault Cover More Insurance for their sympathetic & prompt response to our predicament. When one cancels trips like this, you expect to lose money....but we feel that a fair amount of our out of pocket expences have been refunded by Cover More.....thanks to our TravelInsurance with them.
 
I now have every intention of recommending this company to all my friends, when they are travelling. My husband and I belong to the age group of the "Grey Nomads"....recently retired....so have a lot of travelling friends. Hopefully, this "word of mouth" recommendation will spread to their advantage.
 
We are hoping that, in time, we will again be in a position to organise a holiday overseas. 
 
When we do, I will most certainly organise our insurance through Cover More! (But hopefully, we won't need to use their back up ever again!!!)

Many thanks from real travellers.....

title: Claim was relatively simple, price and service were good!
body:
Unlike a lot of reviewers here, I have actually submitted a claim with TID (two, actually!) so I can provide more insight. Most insurance companies are great until you have to make a claim, at which point they turn on you and become slow and unhelpful (like when I had to do a motor vehicle insurance claim). TID, however, was quite helpful and reasonable. Everything was done online (no long hold times) and both times the representative was polite and helpful.

One claim involved us missing a flight due to a connecting flight, and we were able to get our money back through a special circumstance application which the rep kindly found for us. The normal channels were unavailable as it was the airline's fault and we otherwise would have had to chase them up instead. After uploading all the required paperwork (which we made sure we got at the airport while waiting for our replacement flight) and the standard processing time, we were provided with a full refund.

Our other claim was for a lost wedding ring. We provided pictures of me wearing the ring on holiday, as well as the usual documents, and things were relatively painless.

Things to improve: It's quite difficult to find the assistance number when overseas - this could be streamlined. The document upload page can time out silently and lose your claim details.

Apart from that, I agree with other reviews that their customer service is good (I've had to change dates by calling in the past) and their prices and inclusions are great. Note that both times we've had the "The Works" cover.

title: NEVER USE AUST POST TRAVEL INSURANCE AGAIN!!!
body: I have used many different agencies to purchase Travel Insurance but NEVER again would I use Aust Post...Firstly I purchased it over the counter at my local Post Office making it quite clear there were pre-existing health conditions to be told this DIDN'T matter. Upon return from our trip two claims were made.  One for lost sunglasses the other a medical claim.  RED FLAG No. 2...Were not informed of the access of $100 until policy purchased.  Very cunning! The access is per claim NOT per policy...Wanted detailed report from Police and Cruise line re lost sunglasses.  Deserted islands do not have Police nor do Cruise Lines wait for passengers who lose sunglasses on beaches!!!! Anyway claim eventually paid after explaining this and requesting yet more information extending the 10 day process yet again.  Claim no 2 for medical was a logistical nightmare.  4 times a request for additional information was requested. 4 times the same information was uploaded with confirmation received.  Only to be told at the end of each 10 day grace period it was NEVER received. To add insult to injury each time the information was uploaded it created a new claim number  giving me a total of 5 claim numbers instead of two.  Contacted Aust Post via telephone to be told the link I was using was incorrect even though it was the same link form their website!!!! WHAT A SCAM!!!! Eventually claim was paid yet again less another $100. I believe Aust Post hope that you will give up when things become difficult so they don't have to pay, bidding time with their 10 days each time. One representative even gave me another email to use which of course DIDN'T work.  No suprises there...  So much for peace of mind when you willing take out Travel Insurance in case of emergencies.  Please DO NOT tell me to contact Customer Service as all they do is hand ball you again and again! SHAME ON YOU.

title: Cancelled Holiday
body:
My wife and I were booked on a packaged holiday to Japan leaving Australia on 18th September.
On 5th September my wife was admitted to hospital and diagnosed with Influenza and Whooping Cough. She remained in hospital until 18th September which meant we were unable to leave on our Japan holiday.

I contacted Aust. Post  and was emailed a claim form which was submitted on 19th Sept.
On 21st Sept I received an email advising they had received my claim and would respond within 10 business days.
On 6th Oct I received an email advising my claim had been referred to the Medical Board for review. .On 16th Oct an email was received saying Aust. Post had contacted our GP requesting additional medical information. This information  was sent to the Medical Board on 23rd October and on 6th November I received an email advising our claim had been approved and money would be deposited into our account.

As we were claiming the total cost of our holiday ($19280) we were delighted with the speed and regular update advice of our claim as it progressed thru the claim system. Money was deposited into our account on 7th Nov.
The total time from lodging the claim to receiving our holiday money was just over 6 weeks, which I consider was excellent service.

We have used Aust. Post travel insurance on 3 occasions prior to this claim and have already taken out a policy for an upcoming cruise in December.

I am very pleased with Aust. Post travel insurance, they are easy to deal with on the phone and our policies cover my wife for a  pre existing medical condition.
This is the first time we have made a claim for travel in all the years we have been travelling.
I can recommend Aust. Post travel insurance and will continue to take out travel policies with them as long as we are able to travel..

title: Stay Away from CBA
body:
In May this year we planned a visit to Japan for late November, we booked tickets, accommodation and everything else that goes with it. I used my Commonwealth Platinum Credit card to pay for the lot and therefore activated the Travel Insurance (Allianz).
The Sunday before leaving, my wife got a call from overseas that her mother (overseas) was very ill and that the prospects were not good. She immediately booked another flight and later that evening went to be with her mother. What this meant was that she would not be going to Japan. I put in a claim to the insurance to claim for the cancellation of her ticket. To my surprise I first received an email from CBA/Allianz saying that as my wife was not the primary card holder she would not be covered,  I replied that she was listed in the policy and also a card holder.  The next email was that there may be exclusion as according to their terms a relative is only one that reside in Australia. The final dismissive email stated that as this was my wife's decision to go with her mother overseas we are not covered.
I was very disappointed with the wording of the response replying that the decision was the correct one as her mum passed away 4 days later. This is another typical bank that promotes to help but will do everything not to pay up. As I told them in my email, I will not be fighting it because the few hundred dollars are not worth fighting a whole bank/insurance legal team but they have just lost a loyal customer that has been with CBA for 29 years. I am in the process of closing all my accounts and credit cards with the bank and will do everything I can to let everyone know that as far as CBA are concerned you mother ceases to be your mum if not living in Australia. So please if you have relatives that do not reside in Australia remember that the CBA / Allianz travel insurance will not cover you.

title: Discretion should be part of customer service
body:
I made a claim for my camera which was stolen while travelling in China. Ontained a legal stat declarartion signed and finger printed to verify my claim.
It would appear this is not worth the paper it was written on as I had to prove I owned the camera which was given as a gift by my children.
I sent a picture of the said camera which I googled, this was not accepted as a receipt was requested. As the camera was purchased in 2007 no receipt was retained. A picture of me holding the camera was sent and I also was required to have my daughter to sign a stat declaration that she gave the camera as a gift.
I wasn't attempting to claim millions only $400. This claims was paid out, with $237.50 deprecition deducted as well as the $100 excess I had to pay. So I got $137.50 becasue Suresafe do not cover you "for new for old". Who buys a new camera every time they travel?
I work in customer service and can assure you we do have a scope to use discretion and take clients words without having to be pedantic and requesting what I deem unnecessary document.

I had lodged a complaint review as per their request on 1st April - still haven't had a single response despite multiple emails & phone calls.
I will be lodging a complaint with Australian Financial Complaints Authority & would suggest anyone in similar situation to do the same.

title: Absolute Thieves
body:
We paid for premium travel insurance for an international trip to the USA at the end of March. Once COVID-19 was declared a pandemic, I checked the PDS to find that many "covers" were not able to be claimed upon. We made the decision to cancel our trip and contacted CoverMore for a refund. Considering that 100% of our airlines, hotels, and car rental providers offered a full refund, we were surprised to learn that CoverMore would only issue a 75% refund. This is despite them doing nothing, covering nothing, or providing any value whatsoever. 
I was told that they didn't even need to provide this refund as it is "clearly stated in the PDS" (I checked, and it's buried on page 18 of the PDS... not so clear) that the cancellation will only attract a full refund if cancelled in the cooling off period. 
The refund was described as a "gesture of goodwill" however that is grossly misstating the reality - CoverMore has retained 25% of the premium for doing exactly nothing. The cancellation means that no claims can be made on the policy, so there is literally nothing that CoverMore has provided for the 25% of the premium that they have retained. This means that they have collected this portion of the premium risk-free since there is no probability of a claim ever being lodged... it goes straight to their profit. 
Absolute thieves - avoid at all costs.

title: ok, very disappointing depreciation rate
body:
I took out travel insurance with cover-more for an extended trip i took in 2013. 
Four months into my trip I had my camera and ipad stolen. I got a police report straight away and called cover-more to discuss what to do next. They were very helpful and I decided to wait a bit longer to submit the claim as I was still travelling and it was difficult to organise sending receipts etc. on the road. The claim was processed very quickly.
The only disappointment is the ridiculous depreciation they take off the money that you get back. My ipad was brand new before i went travelling and my camera was only a few months old so I wasn't expecting much reduction in value. However, I was depreciated not once but twice! I was told that they could currently replace my items for $970 but then depreciation of $166 was taken off that. If they can currently replace my items for $970 isn't that already the depreciated cost as it is what the items are worth now? The items were worth over $1000 so the amount i got back was a lot less than they were worth. Given the items were fairly new before i left i would hate to think what i would have got if they were a few years old!! The money was also in the form of a store credit, which isn't very fair as i can purchase my camera and ipad much cheaper elsewhere.
Helpful on the phone, quick claim processing

title: The real test is when you claim... TID failed in this regard
body:
I bought travel insurance from the reviews on here but they're mainly positive due to people not having to claim. The value in a travel insurance policy is when you actually try to make a claim... and there's a big difference between happiness of people who don't ever claim and people who have tried but were rejected. Please read those negative reviews for a true experience on what it is like having a policy with TID, rather than those who simply bought but never had to claim!

The website is very nice to use and it is easy to understand the policies and buy a policy.... Except the website is quite misleading. Those snappy little paragraphs that you see on the website make you THINK you're covered when you're actually not. (More later)
The policies are fairly well priced with lots of different inclusions and with a bit of googling you can find a voucher code to use that will give you a few % off.

However the worth of travel insurance is really when you actually go to make a claim and in this regard I find TID lacking.

After having an item left on a plane I carefully checked the policy and even called up TID in regard to whether or not I had a claim. TID support said I did so I went to all the trouble to providing every single bit of supporting evidence I could manage. This included a letter from the airline, records of multiple calls to baggage services and airline, record of call to TID itself, receipts etc. 

What a waste of time!! 

If they had just told me on the phone I had no chance in hell then I would have not bothered to spend all that time in making a very thoroughly researched claim.

If you note on their website under Luggage and Personal Effects, accidental loss is supposedly covered. Expand this section under the What we cover page)

However loss that occurs in a public place is not. This includes anywhere that the public can get to. They count the inside of a plane [not mentioned in 'What we don't cover' page] (where you would have passed through how much security and passport control to get into) as a public place. They will also claim that you having your item in the seat pocket in front of you means you did not take reasonable care in looking after it. Never mind that it could have been taken without permission (and that due to loss you cannot actually determine what happened to it), it will not be covered!

The specific parts of the policy they have highlighted in my rejection letter are the following:
-requires you to have taken all reasonable care to protect your luggage and personal effects whilst
travelling and not expose them to needless risk. Where you do not do so, loss, theft or damage to
your luggage and personal effects are not covered under the policy.

-does not cover claims arising from leaving your items unsupervised in a public place. That is,
leaving your luggage and personal effects:
? with a person you did not know prior to commencing your journey;
? in a position where they can be taken without your knowledge; or
? at such a distance from you that you are unable to prevent them from being taken.

Note that the wording of these policies are not the same as they are in the PDS! So they will tell you the reason your claim has failed is due to policies that are not the same as they are in the PDS.

I will be recommending other travel insurance companies to my friends.
Easy to buy, reasonable price
Exclusions so broad they will never have to pay out

1Cover is offering customers whose trips have been affected by COVID-19 credit notes (in line with many airlines and other travel providers) that can be used for trips well into 2022, refund requests are being assessed on a case-by-case basis considering the policy wording and the customer?s personal circumstances.

title: Becoming a penny pinching company
body:
We paid for a Covermore policy 8 months before our trip, but didn't receive a PDS until 4 days before we left. The agent selling it to us assured that we would be FULLY covered for taking our luggage in a lease car. When our luggage was stolen from the car while we were 20m away, it was classed as "unattended", and so was limited to $2000 limit.

At the time, and afterwards, Cover-more was hugely unhelpful (I suspect deliberately unhelpful). They couldn't provide us with any embassy details, or bank contacts to cancel credit cards. The onus was on us to do every small piece of work, despite the marketing spiels.

Several documents showed lies and contradictions from the agent, and the fact that a PDS was not provided until 8 months after payment. Despite this, Covermore refused to pay a measly $1500 extra to cover the rest of our luggage. Ultimately the Ombudsman sided with Covermore as the agent's advice was not in writing, and let's face it, insurance companies probably pay the wages for ombudsman service.

At the end of the day, we should've got everything in writing. However it is disappointing judging by mine and others' stories, that Covermore is actually covering less. Even getting the $2000 was an ordeal, I can only imagine what it must be like for people with large medical bills.

If you have time to read reviews on travel insurance before travelling, I would strongly recommend shopping around elsewhere. Cover-more is now a basic product that fills a gap for a quick policy to cover serious emergencies.

You can't ring them - I've tried 4 times at various times of the day and never been able to get through. The hold times before I've had to hang up have been: 63mins, 74min, 92mins and 61mins.

Avoid this insurer, have a look at the better rated ones on product review. There's a reason they're better rated!

I wanted to know if the documents I resent through were correct, and all they could say was "sorry we can't tell you that, you have to wait 10 days after you send it, each time, for the assessor to have a look and reply". title: Worst travel insurance I ever had! Stay clear!
body: We purchased our policy online - easy as you would expect when purchasing something. Then we had to extend it as we stayed overseas longer - 3 months instead of 2. We were advised by the sales team that we needed to buy a new policy online as it cannot be extended online (why not?!). So we did that and had 2 policy numbers (same name, same email address etc). My baby boy had a tummy upset just before we were to fly back and we got him checked out and I had a toothache and went to see a dentist in the first half - both emergencies and all in all a medical claim of perhaps 400$. The claims process is still ongoing (someone in the Phillipines is dealing with it) and it has been horrid for the past 4 weeks or so! I travel a lot and have never experienced such incompetence from an insurance company. I submitted forms, passport copies, flight copies etc etc plus both doctors receipts plus credit card receipts - was told it needs to be in English - i translated it - not good enough - she wants a professional translator (for a 50$ paediatrician bill!) - then I got the dentist and paediatrician to email me a receipt in English (signed plus stamp). She asked for the receipt again!?! Then when I pointed out that she already had the credit card receipt she said it was fine (why do I have to point it out?) Then I had to re-submit all the forms again. Apparently the online forms are different from the paper forms and she needed the paper forms (why are they different?) - then I get a call saying that the policy was purchased later and that therefore my first claim (dentist with the first insurance number) is invalid. When I pointed out that I have two insurance numbers (!) and that I had written that on the form, she pointed out that then the second insurance is invalid as the policy should have been extended (again this is regarding a 50$ paediatrician bill!) I said to her that we had been advised by the sales team that we had to purchase a new one online. So now she is checking with the sales team. I think this is all totally unacceptable und incompetent behaviour! and as others have said they want this and that and constantly come up with new things and ways of why your claim should or should not be accepted. Stay clear!!

I was told that because I bought the police before June 2020 the PDS was different then and I am entitled to absolutely no refund. I am pleased to advise that Australia Post Travel Insurance has changed their cancellations policies and has now refunded my money in full $827.00.  It was a long frustrating and laborious process to get to this good outcome but well worth persisting with contacting the company to get the refund.  I?m not sure if I would use Australia Post Travel Insurance again in future but will be asking a lot more questions before purchasing travel insurance from anyone in future.

title: Affordable travel insurance but claim process is takes a long time
body:
Affordable insurance, had a medical emergency in USA and getting our insurance claim approved was quick but the process of paying the medical providers (was a really big bill) took ages and OTI doesn't contact the medical providers, they forward it to a specialised international provider (adds a further 8-12 weeks to the claim process) who is suppose to contact the hospital, ambulance and doctor billing departments about payment. 

Though they never did (we had to call internationally to all these departments to check on the accounts - costed us nearly $100 of international call). We also had an issue with the 'international provider' about a DOB discrepancy (I am assuming they got it mixed up with the American formatting date), so after 12 weeks of sorting, it had to start again which would've made it another 8 - 12 weeks (all up this entire claim process took 5 months). So instead we paid all the bills ourselves which costed us over $10k and had to wait 10 days for that to be reimbursed back to us.

In the end, would've rated it a 5 stars if everything was completed within the time frame and that information given to us was consistent. Unfortunately, it wasn't like this for us. Had high hopes for this insurance after reading positive reviews about the claim process when we were choosing which one to buy, but sadly it has disappointed us and I don't think we want to purchase it again, not for USA at least, since it was so stressful (mental and financially) for us to complete the claim. 

Thank you to Anthony for reaching out to us and having a look on our case though! He managed to get one of the claim consultant to give us a ring the next day and organised settlement for our claim. Really appreciate the service.

body: Easy to select perfect cover for any trip. Used TID 3 times now, and haven't had any problems using the online booking system.  So far haven't needed to make a claim.  Would recommend to any of my friends travelling in the future.

title: Very satisfied. Robert D.
body: Have used Insure and Go a number of times.  Have made one claim. The staff have always been very helpful and friendly. My claim was processed without any fuss or hassles. Highly recommend this company.

body: Never received confirmation or a PDS despite an email stating that I was going to receive one in 24 hours.

title: Just right insurance
body: This is the second time I have used 1 cover insurance  and find it very easy to set up and use. For a family of 3 it is fantastic value.

title: Great Pricing!
body: The policy was easy to do online and was one of the cheapest we could find. Thankfully we did not need to claim on our policy but better to be safe than sorry, especially while traveling in the USA.

title: Bali Travels
body: I felt that the policy got a little expensive when I explained that there was a pre-existing condition e.g. asthma but on the whole I found it easy to apply for the policy and the Customer Support was really helpful.

title: Buyers of Travel Insurance Beware
body: My wife and I took out Travel Insurance with 1 Cover  in November 2017 for travel to Mauritius in May 2018. However, on my day of departure Air Mauritius cancelled my departure flight and re scheduled it for the next day. As I had paid for breakfast and dinner at a resort in Mauritius my wife and I were out of pocket for one nights accommodation and food. I made a claim to Air Mauritus and stated that I had a $200.00 excess with my travel insurer but they denied any liability. A similar claim was made to 1 Cover and documents from my Travel Agent and Air Mauritius were submitted, however , they rejected my claim on the grounds that as per their PDS, cancellation claims relating to operational problems were not covered. The claim was for $300.00 less $200,00 Excess.  Buyers beware.

title: Claiming was so easy
body: Great value have used several times always reliable and cost effective made a hospital claim and had no issues what so ever. Easy to contact and the service was above and beyond

title: A definite Must
body: Felt great to know that I had all my basis covered so just relaxed and enjoyed my holiday.

title: Use it at least twice per year
body:
All works well, the policy is reasonable value, no trouble with online purchase and the service over the past several years has been excellent. Now I have, but I don't like the fact that you set a minimum.

February 12th 2019 Update: Why would you not travel without "InsureandGo"!

I have used Insure and Go generally for at least two overseas holidays per year over many years, I had to make a claim for emergency expenses created by an airline cancellation. This was handled efficiently, without fuss, in a short time. They are rated highly on Canstar and overall satisfy all our requirements, of value for money, pre existing medical, contact availability, service and reliability.

title: Quite satisfied
body: Have used 1 Cover a few times now.Only made 1 claim but I'd have to say that after submitting the claim I heard nothing within the stated time of 10 days so I had to phone them,after that it all went well & the claim was paid.It's easy to organise & pay for a policy online & I find it cheaper than many others.Also you can extend an existing policy or start a new one from online while overseas as I have done...a useful feature. title: I would never travel overseas with out cover more insurance
body: I was very satisfied with the way staff rang me and how quick my claim was processed. The staff were very helpful in every way possible I didn't think an insurance company could be this good.

title: Good insurance - cant comment on claims process due to having no claims as yet!
body: Good value and easy to set up. I feel as though I cant really comment on the overall service of 1 cover, just for the simple fact that I haven't had to submit a claim. But I have used them twice this year and am very happy with the price.

title: Good customer service

Unfortunately I broke my ankle two weeks before we were meant to depart on our trip this year so we had to cancel. TID were brilliant during the whole claim process - from easy online claim submission through to clear communication and, finally, settlement. I cannot fault them.

title: Competitive prices
body: Yes extremely good value and liked the cover for Car Rental Excess. Had to ring the call centre as website was not working properly. Excellent customer support person who answered all my queries first up.

title: Great travel insurance cover.
body: Had a medical claim on a recent trip to USA. An efficient telephone operator lodged my claim and this was followed by rapid payment in a few days. Could not be more impressed with the efficient,friendly and professional manner in which my claim was handled and processed. Highly Recommended.

title: Affordable for everyonr
body: Policy was able to be done for 3 adults on one instead of two seperate policies. Very affordable and covers a whole lot of things. Able to to apply on line and staff very quick to respond to any queries. Would highly recommend and will tell everyone

title: Great value and excellent customer service
body: Good value, excellent customer service, easy to deal with. Policy covers a lot and caters specific needs. Communications is fantastic. Email communication is great. covered the whole lot. Will recommend to all

title: Great!!!
body: Twice now for asian and american trips.... so far so good.... although ive never had to claim anything... i really dont have anything more to say so thank you

title: Doesnt even rate a star - had to note one to post review
body: Pathetic is a kind word for this organisation.  I am in the same situation as other people - taken out well before the onset of Covid-19, and a pro-rata refund.  In addition, rude staff.  After asking the operator to contact me by email as she had called me during my workday, she ignored my request and continued talking.  Will NEVER touch this company again.

title: Excellent
body:
Real easy to use, and by far the cheapest for our age of 55. After being a bit concerned about insuring online, they paid no problems! why pay more elsewhere??
Paid my 1000 Euro accident excess no worries!!
Not a dislike, but make sure you collect all the correect documents for your claim!!

title: Easy to set up.
body: Very happy with the policy choice. No problems completing information online and it was easy to set up. No claims needed.

title: I would use again
body: we used 1 cover for the first time after a recommendation from our credit union...someone who had lodged a claim and said it was hassle free and fast. nothing worse than insurance companies who are quick to take money, then ignore you or have dozens of excuses to reject a claim. the policy is reasonable value, but would like to see it a bit cheaper..especially for fit and healthy pensioners like me  who have reached 70 and have to pay a bit more.....we had no claim, and this should be considered if we use again

title: Very easy to deal with and easy to organise on line
body:
Very easy to deal with.
Easy to organise on line.
Easy to set up the policy and pay on line.
Good all round cover for travel insurance.
Will use this service again.

title: no problems, but happy to know it is there if needed.
body:
Policy is good value,if only for the support if needed.
simple and fast to set up.
We did not require any customer support this trip,everything was great.
On a previous trip we had a medical situation which was handled by your company, and we could not have asked for better treatment,thanks again.

title: easy to follow
body: Was very pleased with the process of pre existing conditions, though not quite sure what I had to do in one section where it said already notified ( when and where?????) to . The price seemed reasonable and the website easy to navigate.

title: easy to use
body:
Process to book was easy and affordable travel insurance. Option to bundle together is great  - not many insurance companies offer this now, I did  not need to claim and therefore can not comment on the claims process. However, a friend who was on the same policy as myself had her flight delayed for 12 hours. To my understanding (I was told she contacted 1cover) that there was not much they could do in regards to covering for a new plane ticket and therefore she did not make it to work. Accommodation costs was only covered only after a 6 hour delay.. and by then there was no point really as she would have had to check out in 2 hours or so anyway.

Besides from that, I would definitely use 1 cover again when traveling in the future.

title: Awful and misleading
body: The policy was definitely NOT good value. I paid for a travel insurance policy that was advertised to cover full medical and dental. I had an incident overseas and allegedly it isn't covered even though I took an ambulance (which was ordered for me by another person, I did not request one) and stayed overnight in hospital. Got messed around by this company back and forth for several months, as every time I submitted one document, they would request something else 10 business days later. It felt like they were deliberately drawing it out. They had one document for a whole month and then asked for it to be translated into English from a language that I didn't understand. They then made me use Google Translate, which they could've done themselves in the whole month that they had it. They either did not look at all until then, or they were deliberately trying to delay things. Either way, very unimpressed. Also, very surprised that there are no translators at Allianz, particularly since it is meant to be "global assistance". I was finally told today that due to the nature of the incident (which I was upfront about from the very beginning) that I wasn't covered. Will never get any type of insurance from Allianz again. Don't think I will get any insurance at all next time I travel. Their policy was misleading and the way my case was handled was extremely incompetent. It was a BIG waste of my time and money.

title: Wouldn't use any other travel insurance
body: I've used this company many times now, and had to make a claim twice due to unforeseen circumstances.  They've been great to deal with and their products provide good value for money.  I now don't bother getting quotes from any other company.

body:

body:
I had completely forgotten about organising travel insurance until the last minute before my trip overseas. 1Cover was very easy to understand and made organising travel insurance a breeze, especially with the tiered system of 'how far from Australia will you travel' - it was great value, too! Highly recommended.

title: Very competitive
body: Very easy to set up &  excellent value for money. Great customer service too. Have my car insured with Budget Direct also.  No claims made so far so can't comment in that area.

title: Good value for money
body: Have insured with them for an upcoming cruise - land - cruise Europe to North America in May 2020. Have used them before. When we returned from our 4 week trip in 2017 Ins & Go sent us a message noting that we have returned and reminded us to make any claim in a timely manner. We had none to make, but appreciated their attitude. We carefully looked at inclusions and exclusions, and they were - and still are -  just as competitive in these areas. Fact is they are a lot cheaper than other big suppliers.

title: Paid additional Premium for Phone Cover - claim rejected when it was stolen!
body: Complete waste of money, effort and time. Paid for the Comprehensive Travel Insurance and even chose to pay extra for 'Specified Items Cover' which was to cover our phones up to the value of $750. My iPhone ended up being stolen in Thailand and we ensured we followed the procedure correctly (i.e. obtained a police report within 24 hours etc) but Allianz still found a reason to reject this by using their vaguely worded policy to fit their agenda that my phone was left 'unsupervised' in a public place when stolen - which was not true as it was stolen in front of me and was being supervised! It is almost laughable that we paid EXTRA to insure our phones specifically and when mine did indeed get stolen, Allianz didn't pay. Completely and utterly pointless. I am thankful that something worse such as a medical emergency didn't happen on that trip, as I can't imagine Allianz would have assisted. In addition to this, when my claim was finalised I received an email stating that I would receive a formal letter in the mail within 5 business days notifying of the outcome. I waited patiently for the formal letter as the email didn't state whether it had been accepted or rejected. 3 weeks later it still had not arrived in the mail. I send an email notifying their team that it hadn't arrived and a few days later get an email response saying 'please see the formal letter attached', but the attachment was a PDF copy of our email trail! I point this out and once again request the formal letter. Finally a week later, after one month of waiting and not knowing the status of the claim, the actual formal letter is emailed to me. The claim was rejected but at the bottom of the letter it outlined the fact that we could lodge a dispute/complaint about the decision and 'all details of the dispute process are within the attached document'... with absolutely no attached document for me to refer to! I became so exasperated at the overall incompetency of the company that I couldn't even be bothered pursuing it anymore. Disappointing to think that Allianz are profiting by having an extremely ambiguous policy and disorganised claims process. Have used other travel insurance companies since and had NO problems whatsoever!

title: Ok Travel Insurance but a bit pricey

Easy to buy online once I understood what I needed and was buying.

body:
I cover claim Insurance was so amazing, and made a very stressful situation so much easier.

trip started my husband become ill and hospitalized unfortunately we had to cancel all our trip.
With in 2 weeks of my claim we were send our cost of our trip.

title: replacement camera
body:
When I was on my holiday in China, I accidentally left my camera in the taxi as I was dropped at the airport. I didn't realise until it was too late and was obviously devastated as I had just lost all my holidays photos. I emailed covermore immediately to let them know what had happened and they told me what to do. When I returned home from my holiday the claim had been processed and approved and I was contacted by a camera shop in regards to replacing my camera. The next week I had a new  camera and did not have to pay any excess. I have used covermore for all my travels overseas and will continue to use them. They aren't very expensive and there were no dramas with the insurance claim. I recommend them to everyone.
inexpesive, reliable, quick service

title: Medical Emergancy
body: Case Number.13001256. My Husband was admitted to a hospital in Hawaii on our recent trip. Whilst the Hospital care was unbelievable, trying to get things organised through you for things such as emergency Accommodation and return Flights to Australia was a nightmare. It took 2 whole days to first get the claim started and At one stage it was suggested that WE do a ring around to see if WE could find something. ARE YOU KIDDING ME. Now I understand that this is a busy company, but when you are told that you have a case manager in the COUNTRY you are visiting, why is it that we STILL had to call Brisbane, Australia to get anything done. We have a $250 worth of International Roaming charges on our phone because No one was getting back to us. You are a 24 hour company are you not. We found out the night before we were due to check out, the name of where we would be staying for the next 2 nights. Still had to phone ( Brisbane ) to find out about our flights the same time. Then when we faxed off a letter from my Husbands Surgeon along with a medical certificate, this was NOT ENOUGH to prov his claim. REALLY? overall, very Frustrating.

title: Easy to take out with no problems on trip
body: I thought the policy was good value for money and cheaper than other options. I didn't have any problems purchasing and it was easy to do so. No claim was needed, but I feel comfortable recommending this policy (we did include cruise cover).

title: Easy to arrange travel insurance
body: I applied online for myself, my husband and my son to get travel insurance for a 2 week holiday to Hawaii! It was really easy to arrange and very affordable. The website is easy to navigate and the language very easy to understand. I recommend 1Cover Travel Insurance very highly.

title: OK
body:
While I had no problems I had no claims so cannot judge what your company is like to deal with if you had to pay out on a claim.
I liked the fact that you cover for terrorism
Would like to see included cover for vehicle damage if driving overseas

title: Satisfied Customer
body: I have used 1Cover twice and have found the Policy was easy to set up. I had to make a claim on my last Policy which was attended to without any problems.. The claim once lodged was addressed promptly and the claim was received very soon after. The customer service was very efficient. I have recommended 1 Cover to friends and they have been pleased with the policy cover and the charges offered by 1Cover.

title: Professional
body: The only negative is the time it takes to ring them, you have to wait a long time to be answered. However, I had to change my destination and they kept trying to ring me back so they could help me out. They refunded  the entire amount of my Insurance for  overseas trip and gave me a much cheaper policy as I was only travelling in Australia.

title: Beware Large depreciations
body:
I was surprised how little I got back for my damaged 2 year old camera - after Covermore deducted almost 50% depreciation. I asked about the depreciation rates, which are not published in their policy or website and was told the following.
Cameras: yr- 24%; yr2 - 20.4%; yr3 15.6%
IPad: yr1-48%; yr2 - 36%; yr3 - 30%
Laptop: yr1-18%; yr2 - 12%; yr3 - 12%
IPhone: yr1-36%; yr2 - 30%; yr3 - 24%
I was also told these are subject to regular reviews.
I will be taking this into account when next buying travel insurance.
Comprehensive cover
Large depreciation rates applied and they don't publicise how much before you sign up

title: Terrible claims service
body: Took almost 2 months to finalise my claim.  They offered me a $400 jb voucher to buy a replacement phone with the cheapest phone double that price. Had escalate to a complaint to get cash instead.

title: Really Really Good.
body: Really really Good and super easy. Great information available.  Be sure to extend before your end time if needed.  Its a great option to have and so easy to do.

title: Great customer service
body: Online choosing between including USA and excluding it I accidentally clicked wrong button, did not pick up till printed of policy, as this is the only country I am visiting, imagine my dismay! It was easily rectified with a phone call. More than satisfied with customer support, excellent service. Thank you.

title: BE AWARE....rental car cover only for 2 weeks
body: Thought policy was a reasonable price and was going to buy. However when scanning through the PDF I just happened to notice that rental car insurance was for 2 weeks only not matter what the length of  trip insured for. As i anticipated hiring a car for 3 weeks i rang the company and was advised by staff that to be covered I would have to arrange for 2 separate car rentals and to comply with rules the 2nd rental had to be 80kms away from where I dropped off first rental. REALLY!!!!! Staff were professional and tried to help as much as they could within the allowable framework. Needless to say I went to another company.

title: Efficient
body: It was easy to set up the policy. They answered questions about pre existing conditions. They gave quote straight away. Did not have to claim. We are happy with service.

title: Reliability
body: i Always use ICover as Policy provides cover and reliability with great service. I have not yet needed to make a claim but would think it must be straight forward.

title: Very satisfied
body:
Have used single trip Insure and Go on several occasions. Excellent value. Modest claim last year for cancelled accommodation and airfare change due to illness. Claim resolved speedily, courteously,  and without delay.   

The following is a separate issue. While overseas we wished to add a short Mediterranean cruise to our itinerary. Although well ahead of the cruise date we were informed that it could not be covered as we had already left Australia. Furthermore we were told that if we attempted to take out a further policy to cover the  cruise it would be rendered null and void. This is a preposterous situation and being fobbed off by talk about underwriter agreements doesn't wash at all. For example Insure and Go (UK) provides such facility to UK residents applying from outside the country. The situation means that travellers are prevented from availing themselves of opportunities that arise after they have left Australia. As pointed out out during communications it is hardly Rocket Science and does not sit well with someone who has spent the large part of a lifetime as a problem solver.  Wake up Insure and Go (Australia).
(This comment in no way reflects on satisfaction with the excellent experiences we have had over time with Insure and Go single trip insurance)

title: Well done Cover-more
body: Our claim was complicated. Taken from a British cruise ship by ambulance to a foreign speaking hospital. Hospital welfare staff contacted Cover-more who opened a file with a collection of medical reports (generally in Spanish)  Cover-more kept us updated as they assessed our changed travel and accommodation schedules. Thank also to Flight Centre for assistance upon our arrival home. These people saw us through a horror stretch and we were very pleased with Cover-more's handling of the claim process and the final outcome.

title: Months to process claim
body:
Lodged claim, InsureandGo took over 2 months to process claim. They were uncommunicative and did not answer my questions. I sent emails to try and sort out why they did not cover what was listed in my policy but no response. Would not use company again and would not recommend them. I have used this company multiple times but not till you make a claim do you realise how difficult and unhelpful InsureandGo is. 
They dragged out claim process(told its being reviewed) to past the end date of my policy and now I can not get my claim sorted out. 
I wrote again their response was not even readable as very poor writing   as did not make sense asked for review from manager, no response no review. Claim unresolved, now sending me advertising, when did not resolve or respond to emails. 
Just terrible service and unprofessional response to claims.

title: good coverage
body:
easy to follow, easy to set up, value seems ok, understandable and comprehensive,
meets all our requirements, long lead time suited us too, hope we don't have to claim, but
who knows, at least we are covered !

title: Over 3 months to process a claim!
body: My travel agent always gives me a quote for Covermore when I travel.  I buy it and don't go looking at other travel insurance but not anymore. Three days before I was due to leave on a month long trip to South America (which had been booked a year in advance) my doctor advised me to cancel the trip as a stress fracture I had in my foot for the past month hadn't fully healed.  Covermore took over 3 months to process the claim.  Twice they contacted my doctor for more medical documentation even after I had provided them with the relevant medical documentation they had requested.  Because it was such a large claim (they would've made a lot of interest on my money during the 3 months) they were obviously tying not to pay it out.  They were trying to prove that it was a pre-existing medical condition which it wasn't.  I was very disappointed with the customer service. I have used them many times before but they have now lost my business.

title: Reassuring
body: This trip I didn't need my cover but it was reassuring to know it was there. In the past my treatment (especially when I took ill in China) was first class. S Overton

title: Would never consider using another insurer for travel insurance.
body: My history with using Cover-More dates back almost twenty years. They helped our family out with a situation involving our son who was involved in a surfing accident in Hawaii. I could not fault the service they provided - and I am talking about sending two paramedics to accompany our son back to Australia, removing at least a dozen row of seats from his flight to accommodate him and the required medical equipment. Time spent in Queens Hospital Honolulu, helicopter flight from the accident scene, expert surgical treatment and hospital confinement - the list goes on.  The invoice from the hospital was staggering and without support from Cover-More would have been devastating financially. When it comes to travel my only thought is to Cover-More. And with good reason.

title: Bali Family Trip
body: I felt the policy gave me the security & assurance that everything was covered properly. I set up a Comprehensive policy online but was notified by the helpful Customer Support Staff that I would need to alter the one policy to two and a refund was given with the combined total of the 2 policies less than the first.  Great service thank you, will definitely utilise 1Cover for my trips.

title: you would be crazy not to have insurance on a holiday

title: Must have.
body: Didnt have to make a claim but just knowing it was there made my wife & I feel safe. Easy to set up online. Excellent value for money. Its a must have.

title: Worst Service I have Ever Received in any industry! Totally Unprofessional and a security threat!
body:
* Update 16/1/19 - After giving Allianz an opportunity to resolve my issue before publishing this review, I received an email from a Customer Experience Consultant stating "I have raised your claim with the next level and they will be in touch within 15 business days." Another 15 business days!? This just demonstrates the level of care this company has! I hope this review will help others avoid such a horrific experience by NEVER taking out any insurance products with this company.

I shall now be contacting the Australian Financial Complaints Authority and investigating legal options.

- - -

Quite simply this company is unprofessional, untrustworthy and should not be allowed to operate in this industry!

I booked a return flight to India from Sydney with Air Asia and after receiving email confirmation on the morning of my return flight, turned up at Mumbai airport at 10pm, 25th August 2018 to discover my flight had been cancelled months previously but the airline had neglected to inform me or update their web booking portal. I then had to book additional flights in order to get back to Sydney ASAP.

I'd have though If there was ever a situation where travel insurance would help, this would be it but how wrong I was! My experience with Allianz has been worse than that experienced with Air Asia!

After months of back and forth with Allianz (including them signing off emails by first name only, being unreachable by phone and calling from witheld numbers!?), I was eventually informed by SMS that I would compensated only to then receive an email 2 days later that I would not be compensated. I was also inexplicably sent the private claim details of another person. Your information is not safe with this company!

I requested a review of this verdict only to then receive a letter on Monday (weeks later) with an incorrect description of my claim and again be told that I would not be compensated.

I am now investigating my complaint and legal options but hope by sharing details of horrific experience with Allianz that others use a reputable provider and do not encounter the same. I note that Commonwealth Bank no longer partner with Allianz and I hope the Royal commission cleans up this state of an industry!

I had to buy a whole new ticket, as Delta booked me out the following day. As my partner was waiting in Buffalo and had to be back in Canada the following morning, I bought a new Jet Blue ticket.

The Jet Blue flight left at midnight.

The second, I had to buy a whole new ticket- Buffalo - New York, again because JFK was closed for high winds.

Jet Blue advised Delta was flying, so I bought a new flight, but later in the morning they cancelled all their flights.
Which meant I missed my international Qantas connection home and had to rebook and pay for that also.

Costs incurred:

1.  Qantas $350 Australian

2.  Jet Blue $169 US JFK - Buffalo new ticket
Delta would not reimburse anything as they said they rebooked me the following day.  They also said they would not provide accommodation in NYC.

title: Disgusting Service
body:
I had a fall and needed plastic surgery, I broke both my front teeth, I needed numerous root canals, I was knocked out and I had to be rushed to hospital. 

My partner lodged the claim the same day and I did not hear from Covermore until 5 days later!!! 
In this time I had an overnight hospital stay and plastic surgery, I couldn't eat and could barely get out of bed. 

I booked in to get my teeth capped as I didnt want to spend my birthday with broken teeth... then I finally heard from them. They were not supportive, they didnt even guarantee that I would get my money back... they told me to get my root canals and any major surgery done at home (Once you get onto Australian shores... apparently they don't cover any medical expenses... so this was their way out). I dont have thousands of dollars to spend on medical at home, so I chose to get it done oversea's at it was so much cheaper. 

On the last day I was told to go back to hospital to get my stitches out. The dentist would not operate until my stitches were out as she did not want to risk ruining the plastic surgery. 
When I saw the doctor, he said they werent ready to come out yet, they needed to heal more... he suggested staying another 5 days. 

I rang Covermore, explained the situation and their cold hearted  response was, 'that's too bad because your insurance runs out today, so we wont cover you if you need to stay... that will be at your own expense'.

So here I was, stranded in a foreign country, I couldnt stay and I couldnt go home... I took the risk and told the dentist to operate and risked ruining my plastic surgery. Lucky everything went okay and I was able to have the stitches taken out a week later in Australia. 

I got a small amount of my money back and have had to spend about $4000 since the accident getting myself back to normal again. 

I would not recommend Covermore to anyone. I am going on my Honeymoon next year and a backpacking trip for 12 months and there is no way I would even consider using them again.

They were unreliable, rude, could not give me a straight answer, uninterested, they generally did not seem to care.

title: Don't leave home without it
body:
Travel insurance seems expensive - until you need it, then it's the best investment of the whole trip. We had to cancel a very pricey tour of the Canadian Rockies and were informed that we would forfeit thousands of dollars we had paid, as per the conditions of page 146 of the brochure we hadn't received. Another good tip - get a copy of the terms. Luckily, 1Cover stood by their policy and reimbursed us what we had lost.

April 10th 2018 Update: It's just about peace of mind

Travelling can be stressful, and there is a lot to remember, and a lot that can go wrong. On the last trip, we had no claims to make, so was our policy a waste of time? On the contrary, it gave us the peace of mind of knowing that, if something did go wrong, 1Cover would be there to bail us out. We rented a car and didn't need to pay the absurd "extras" that the car companies try to bully you into - that saved most of what we paid for insurance. We left our luggage in our hotel, assuming the best and covered for the worst.

On a previous trip, we had to cancel and would have lost thousands of dollars due to the small print in a Globus contract - 1Cover paid it all back to us.

Don't even think of going overseas without it. Shop around, but we always find 1Cover has the best rates and the best record.

We resent this form via email AGAIN, and again, received an email advising our email was received, only to receive an email on June 5 asking us to fill out the claim form. The email I sent concluded with 'If there is any information still needed that is missing on our part, please clearly articulate what is needed to finalise this matter'. title: Vietnam, MediVac'ing, and more... TID's the one to have!
body:
First off, let me just say that I RARELY write reviews, but after what I've been through, I have to let other know how TID dealt with my situation.

After traveling for a few weeks in Vietnam, I ended up with serious intestinal issues, and blood loss, and after calling TID, they advised immediately going to the nearest hospital, and letting them know.

Once the doctors worked out what the issue was, they strongly advised that I leave to get treatment elsewhere, as they were unable to deal with my situation.

With mum phoning TID from Australia (as I was almost dying), they held up their end of the deal, and the following evening I was on a MediVac flight direct to Bangkok. TID covered for the private jet, and they even carried two bags of my blood in the plane, which the doctor/nurse team administered.

Once arriving in Bangkok, I was transferred to the ICU unit, and within a few weeks was flown business class, with doctor escort, all the way back to Australia.

I also made a claim once home for out-of-pocket expenses, and they reviewed it, and approved it all (after providing the extra information they reasonably requested).

I am stocked at how easy TID was to deal with (especially on the phone), and very appreciative of their professionalism and the way they dealt with me.

Especially I'm grateful for the 'customer service' lady - although she only got involved when I became a 'high priority customer'.

All in all, I would definately recommend TID; their prices are good, and their service is great.
They keep their end of the deal; organized hospitalization, medivac, and flights home; quick claim payment.
Took a while to get me home, but that's understandable considering the circumstances.

title: Will Do Anything To Not Pay Out... Unbelievable!
body: BUYER BEWARE! THEY TAKE 2 WEEKS EACH STEP OF YOUR CLAIM AND THEN MAKE IT AS HARD AS POSSIBLE SO PEOPLE GIVE UP.   we got travel insurance (www.travelinsurancedirect.co.nz) for a trip to Fiji. As it was a .co.nz site and we live in NZ we thought we were sweet. Then in Fiji our two iPhone6's got water damaged. Being insured we thought we were sweet, but oh no we were far from ok. That was on the 15th of January 2016, 3 months ago! We called and made our claim...  Travel Insurance Direct advised we had to get a report to ensure the two phones were damaged cause they didn't have an office in NZ. Uh, 'you don't have an office in NZ?' was our initial response. Nope, they only have an office in Sydney. Bear in mind, these phones are salt water damaged. Now to get the 'Proof of Damage' reports (for each phone) it was going to cost $380 - plus the excess. I pleaded with them that this was ludicrous and by putting a .co.nz and not actually being in the country was no better than fraud. In the end they agreed that I could send them the phones - TO SYDNEY..   We were told the claim would take two weeks just to LOOK at it. TWO WEEKS? Other insurers have a 48 hour response time. Why two weeks? Cause they want you to give up on the claim. This is for a phone, they know you need one (i do for my job), so I nearly gave up at this point. But decided I wanted to see how badly they would attempt to not pay us.  We shipped the phones 7 weeks ago. We've called numerous times and your case manager is "unavailable at this time". Over and over again.  THEN, my partner has $960 put in her account two days ago. WHAT FOR? we still don't know. So they are saying two iPhone6's (one only 2 months old) are worth $960?  Do not use them. They are not to be trusted and truly the worst service  I  have ever received.

title: Ruined my honeymoon! Absolute waste, waste, waste
body:
I am so disappointed. I entered a Valentines Competition through Tiger Airways and won flights around Australia and to Hong Kong and Singapore. I decided to get what I believed to be a quality Insurance Policy and even took out extra cancellation cover after reading reviews that Tiger were known for possible flight cancellations in Australia. Two weeks before my trip the Tiger CASA grounding exploded and I thought I was fine as I had cancellation cover.
I recieved notification from Tiger Airways explaining that two of my flights would be corrupted meaning that I wouldnt reach the following six flights that had been supplied. I phoned Cover more to get information as I figured they would easily cover the two flights that had been cancelled and put me on another air-line to make my connections and continue on my way. 
Instead I was met with rude, condescending and unsympathetic call centre staff that told me that they were voiding my travel insurance as because it was a government grounding they did not have to cover anything or anyone and it was just bad luck for me. I burst into tears as I tried to have the staff member explain where all this was stated. I never found where but was ignored.
 I had spent more than $4000 on hotels, tours, luggage, food and such arrangements and are not able to use any of it as I dont have the money spare to pay for the connecting flights that after inflating costs from the other airlines would cost me $1500. I am disgusted.
I am still in negotiations trying to get my money back.
Tiger on the other hand has been very sympathetic. Its not the end of the story yet but for now I am NEVER booking with Covermore again and have told everyone I know about there lack of protection.. hope you do too..
The promises
The deceit, the lack of protection, lack of customer service and sympathy aka EVERYTHING

body:

I will never ever use Allianz for anything ever again.

title: Customer Service is excellent, Claims processing is as fast as others claim it to be.
body:
I recently travelled to an overseas destination in Asia from mid January to first week of March 2014. My 3 years old daughter fell sick while overseas about 3 times, so I have lodged an online claim with TID on 04 March 2014 after returning from overseas. When I enquired about the progress about the claim, I was told different versions about the processing time by their general customer service team over the phone, so I got my hopes up that claim may get processed earlier than 10 days, however when nothing like that happened. Then on Thursday 13 March 2014, I contacted their Customer Experience Manager by email, she is a very helpful person. She clarified situation that it can definitely take up to 10 business days but sometimes claims do get processed faster. Her email response was very fast. 

Every time I contacted their customer service team, they have been very helpful and polite, however in my personal experience their claims processing time is not as fast as others have experienced here. I lodged claims online and their online claim lodgement process is very smooth and claim lodgement wizard advises you at each and every step what documents may be required for your claim, then at the final step they send you an email about all the documents that are required for the final submission of claim. This is really very good because other travel insurance companies want you to fill in the paper forms and then send it to them by very slow postal mail which delays the processing of claims. I have got a few more claims to put in because every incident while overseas is a separate claim. I will return to advise here how the claims processing time was. But overall experience seems to be very smooth with TID so far.

My husband used TID once before years ago, but did not have to claim, so he does not have any experience about the claims process back then.

Edited on Friday 14 March 2014 after receiving Claims Outcome: I am writing my experience about the claims processing time. I lodged 3 claims, one for my daughter and two for myself, daughter's one was sickness, mine were emergency dental and sickness. Claims were lodged on 04 March 2013 online via TID.com.au, then remaining two were lodged online on 10 March 2014. All the claims were successfully assessed on 14 March 2014. Claims officer sent an email with an outcome report individually for all claims. He also included a survey link  in the middle of his email and rating scale at the bottom of his email to rate his response out of bad, okay or wow. This proves that they are very willing to take customer feedback on-board.

In nutshell, my experience has been great so far in all my dealings with TID in terms of Customer Service, policy price, coverage, and claims processing time. I will be lodging one more claim online and write my experience about it at a later date. I highly recommend this travel insurance company and will definitely be a return customer whenever I go overseas again.
Excellent Customer Service, policy cost, coverage and Claims Processing Time.

title: Budget by Name, Budget by service - steer clear
body:
Policy was very easy to set up but it was only when I recently went to use policy whilst on holidays I ran into trouble. 

I have travelled quite extensively and first time claiming any type of insurance. 

Within two hours of arriving OS at our destination my knee collapsed on me. Being a resort island in the middle of nowhere there was not a hospital to attend. I tried to carry the injury for 3 days before seeing doctor on island who gave me a anti inflammatory tablet and heat pack. 

I attempted to contact Budget and got hold of a chat person who stated that he doesn't take claims but would note it on my file. I advised him I had trouble calling them from OS and could only contact him using WIFI. 

Upon returning to Australia on a Saturday I attempted to contact this insurance company but they only do Mon-Fri. Left a email for them to contact me. 

Middle of following week I got a call from a budget person who stated that they only cover medical treatment whilst OS and not back in Australia as we have Medicare. She told me clause 10.8 or something states this.

Surely if I am out of pocket when I get back to Australia I should be compensated. I had too have a MRI $180, see a Knee Specialist $190, need Physio ($90 a pop) and also had to buy a full leg brace for $150. I had torn all my ligaments on inside of my knee plus a meniscus tear.

I would def recommend not using this insurance company for any travel insurance.

title: Not Insured If You Don't Go!!

I wasn't after a refund but a change of date for later in 2021 when the International boarders reopened.
The company offered me a small credit to use on my next trip, I found this unacceptable and emailed a complaint.

Some many emails and many weeks later I receive this: 

Firstly, I would like to apologize for the delay you have experienced. Unfortunately, we have been inundated with an unprecedented volume of COVID-19 related enquiries and claims, which has meant we are unable to respond as quickly as we would like to. I am sorry about this, and I really appreciate your patience during this trying time.

We acknowledge this has been an extremely stressful time for our customers like yourself, and in response, we have decided to offer this additional gesture of goodwill. We understand, these are not normal circumstances and we need to re-act accordingly, and have responded since the beginning of May by offering pro-rata credits to eligible customers. Our understanding of your complaint is that you are not satisfied with the amount you will receive based on the pro-rata calculation methodology and would prefer a full credit to be used for new travel dates.

There are going to be circumstances in which the pro-rata credit may not be well received but this is an approach we have made to consider our customers as a whole. Recently the Australia Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) has also updated their website to confirm that an 18-month credit is acceptable and their methodology for calculating the amount is consistent with that used by InsureandGo. For simplicity, I have shared a screenshot of that calculation below.

Considering the alignment between our approach and AFCA I will proceed to close the complaint and you are welcome to apply for your pro-rata credit as per your convenience through our website.
Kind regards [name removed].

Well [name removed] I don't take your regards kindly!! If I was given the full refund in cash and not a measly half of what I paid in credit, to use on a future trip! you wouldn't get my business again in a heartbeat.

Update regarding refund.
after many emails and phone conversations we have received a satisfactory refund from I&G.
I might add that this refund was due to the fact we contacted AFCA who have corresponded with I&G on our behalf.

They have sold me cover for the past 3 trips to Mexico. PS, my health can't be so bad as I walk 6km every morning in 70 minutes without difficulty.

title: Quick, easy, comprehensive!
body: Every time I travel I use 1Cover. The registration process is a breeze and the pricing is very competitive. While I've been lucky enough to not need to lodge a claim, I see 1Cover as providing value for money and I am satisfied with the level of cover offered and inclusions.

title: Very helpful.
body: I like that you give the option over the internet to do pre-existing conditions. Grant was very helpful and quick responding to any queries I had. I always use Insure and Go due to them covering pre-existing.

title: Dishonest quote
body: Was given 2 quotes when calling 2 different occasions.  There was a 70 dollar difference on the same policy. I called to disscuss this issue and couldnt even speak to someone about the terrible customer service.

title: Dishonest - avoid at all costs!
body: First time we've ever had to claim through travel insurance & our reasons for needing to cancel airfares were covered under the policy so of course thought this would be a straightforward claim. However, Cover-More pulled out all the stops to ensure we weren't covered & basically tried to throw it back to the airline (Virgin) & type of ticket. Initially, they tried to argue that it was a pre-existing medical condition so we weren't covered. When we read from the policy 'This policy includes cover for claims arising from your Existing Medical Condition(s) only.' they changed their reason for not covering the claim to blaming Virgin and the type of ticket we bought which wasn't covered or refundable.  At the time when you book your tickets, Cover-More gives you NO information about the policy. It simply comes up as an option & we selected it, expecting it to be your standard insurance cover. We didn't put in a claim because we found it better to deal with Virgin directly & were able to get a credit for the tickets so we could use at a later date. We basically paid for a useless product & will be contacting consumer affairs and the ombudsman as this company is dishonest & taking money for providing NOTHING. They basically have a disclaimer/reason for rejecting a claim for just about everything - make sure you read all the reviews prior to purchase. Waste of money. Terrible customer service!

title: Generally a positive review with some reservations
body: We felt the policy was of good value and was quite easy to set up. Amazing service and will definitely use 1Cover next time I travel.

body: March 2017 went on a wonderful cruise to the South Pacific and unfortunately had a medical emergency and had to visit the ships hospital. Also on disembarking my a wheel was broken off my suitcase and not repairable. title: Want to feel secure and covered on your journey? Insure with Cover-More like we did.
body:

body: Took out Travel Insurance for a two week trip to China for our Son. It cost around eighty dollars. Unfortunately he got too ill and we had to claim. title: Seriously excellent

Seriously pleased with the service levels!

title: No problems with this Insurance Company
body: Very easy to set the policy up and at a competitive  price.A previous medical  condition was  covered [no medical records were needed and only  small increase in premium was needed] We did not have to make a claim on this cruise.However on a cruise a year ago we made a claim with 1 Cover [accidental damage $525] This was settled promptly and the customer support was great.

body: I chose this cover after doing some Google shopping it offered best value for me for the particular cover I was looking for, simple online application, policy certificate emailed immediately

title: Less than happy experience
body:
Earlier this year I submitted a 5 star glowing review titled Personal Experience relating to my claim submitted and fully finalised within 10 days.  Conversely, due to a personal injury I submitted a claim in October with more than ample documentation forwarded by registered post priority paid. What followed was  a calamity, of ??no we don?t have them ? they have been misplaced,  we have found them and forwarding them to the assessor??  Despite the presence of a return email advising the balance refund would be in my account that day, nothing eventuated. My numerous telephones met with the same negative outcome.
I finalised the issue by directing a detailed email to the company CEO ? guess what, the balance refund appeared in my account that evening.  They say word of mouth is an ?invaluable tool?; needless to say I have shared this unsavoury experience far and wide and will continue to do so. I have now moved on to another travel insurance company.
