Because I was picking up dinner at night, which I would assume is the time a majority of things get stolen, my claim was denied.

This is absolutely ridiculous, what is the point of insurance that has small print that makes them not liable for basically any claim. I am embarking on a year trip and will definitely not be using TID again. They also have fine print which states they will not pay out if it is in a public space.

Not only this but I am without a phone and made TID aware of this, the claim took over a month to get a result given to me, and halfway into the month they came back needing me to get the police report translated at my expense, otherwise they would not go through with the claim. Extremely unprofessional.

I will be leaving many reviews and warning other travellers to stay away from insurers like this, definitely not a good experience, already got my family members to go with a different insurer, I wouldnt feel secure using them again, who knows what fine print they would pull out to avoid paying if you were in serious medical condition. body:
I sustained an injury to my left shoulder needing to upgrade my travel back to Melbourne in a more comfortable seat in order to avoid further pain. I was given three weeks of absolute run around. The icing on the cake was
that they wanted me to seek free medical treatment including an MRI again free from NHS in the UK.  I am a tourist and there is no reciprocal agreement for a tourist.  They insisted on this causing me enormous amount of stress trying to sort it out.  I am going to take this further as we the unsuspecting travelling public are put through so much when we are overseas given the run around false and misleading information.  I have used Medibank Travel Insurance for over 20 years holding a Medibank private blue ribbon cover for well over 20 years. This is the first time I have made a travel claim out of absolute necessity. 2 nurse assessments about 20 case workers over a three week period and up until the night before I travelled back I had no confirmation. I advise the public to act with caution when purchasing travel insurance with Medibank they throw the book at you.  I had a full comprehensive insurance policy where I had unlimited for medical and travel requirement.  They wanted me to seek free treatment first.  What is the whole point in purchasing travel insurance if we have to first seek free treatment from the NHS whilst in the UK?  Furthermore it is clearly stamped on your passport that you are not entitled to claim free resources while on a tourist visa.  They insisted I do this sending me an extract of their contract which is actually false and misleading.  I have enormous out of pocket expenses long distance telephone calls.  Numerous expenses who will bear this?  I was under a great deal of pressure and this was my vacation time.  I am still waiting to hear from them about the rest of my claim.  Be very wary of choosing travel insurance with Medibank it is not all what they claim to sell you.  Staff not properly trained.  With the first call to them they should be able to give you exact advise not wait for 3 whole weeks to ask you to consult a specialist in order to review the claim.  Total waste of my entire vacation.

title: CBA Credit Card Travel Insurance - DO NOT TAKE IT!
body:
We recently travelled overseas and paid the travel agent for air tickets via CBA AMEX card (and paid 3% commission to the agent) and paid our accommodation via same card. The idea was that travel insurance is covered once you use the card. Unfortunately, on the last day of our trip overseas, the bus (we were a group of 14, 3 families) we were using for internal transportation was broken into. My family lost an iPad, another family lost a whole camera Cannon 5D Mark II bag with brand new accessories, mobile phone, and other items (probably around A$7,000). When back in Australia, when we inquired about the insurance we discovered two things - 1) CBA had changed the insurance provider and they sought that we needed to register and send them our itinerary before we travel or the travel insurance won't be valid; and 2) the fine prints (an item in a 60 page document) stated that items stolen from an unattended vehicle are not covered.

So, basically, our insurance was useless. Of course the issue is that we did not explore the conditions etc...before paying by credit card, assuming that nothing had changed and we would be automatically covered. What amazes me is  how many people would have known about needing to provide an itinerary prior to travelling (and I am not sure for what purpose anyway). Hence, I assume this is a nice way to eliminate most claims before even lodging them. Secondly, it seems that if your vehicle is going to get robbed, you need to make sure that you are inside the car (have a chat with the thief, maybe even ask for his/her autograph while you are at it).

The moral of the story, DO NOT TAKE TRAVEL INSURANCE FROM CBA CREDT CARD or at least, READ THE 60 ODD PAGES BEFORE YOU PAY BY CREDIT CARD and incur a fee. IT IS A SCAM.

No wonder insurance companies are sooooooo trust worthy!!!!!

title: Absolute nightmare
body:
After my husband having what we suspected was a stroke whilst in Mykonos I tried to contact Insure and go by telephone.  We needed to catch an urgent private jet to Athens, we were given no support what so ever. The Doctor in charge of the clinic in the end told us to just hire the jet ourselves and sort it out later.  After arriving in Athens my husband was diagnosed with MS.  From the moment i tried to contact Insure and go it was terrible absolutely no help at all, we were left in a foreign country with no support.  No one from Insure and go could call me they said they couldn't get through to my phone when I begged them to check they were dialling correct numbers I discovered that their call centre I was dealing with was in the Philippines (at no time did I realise that I was buying a policy where I would be dealing in another country I thought I would be dealing within Australia).
So after my somewhat more than 50 emails in three days this was my only form of communication with them.  They said they could not even call the hospital to speak with anyone there.  The hospital were holding us in Athens as they had no one to pay the bill and we had no fit to fly forms.
Insure and go didn't believe that my husband's MS was not a pre-existing illness and god only knows how long they planned on leaving us in a foreign country for until they contacted our GP.... keeping in mind they were given all these details on several occasions and were told that the gp practice was open 7 days a week.
I cannot stress enough the frightened state we were in with no support what so ever from our insurance company.  Not until threatening legal action were we booked on a plan on the way home.
Yes now some three months later our settlement has come through with a bill of nearly $15k that we have covered for those three months.
WARNING... ensure that the company you are getting travel insurance through is Australian owned and that in case of an emergency you will be speaking to someone from Australia that understand you, call you back and re-assure you that they are doing the right thing.
This was the worst experience we have ever had with an insurance company and we are regular travellers.
Sorry for the long post but I do hope that it helps someone make the right decision before they use this company.

The Bank has been provided with an interim death certificate and is now requesting a copy of the coroner's report. This is an invasion of privacy and a cause of further distress to the family. It appears that the Bank will not cover the costs of trip postponement unless they have access to the medical records of the person who has died. We are now seeking alternative insurance for further trips. My husband's brother resided and died in Australia and my husband was still in Australia at the time of the death. title: Worst experience ever
body:
I was involved in a serious accident on Wednesday night which involved a bicycle taxi in Amsterdam. It was speeding and had four passengers squeezed into the back, and one girl was sitting on another's knees. We hit a bump and I was thrown out of the side. I spent the night in hospital in the neurologie ward. I suffered a badly sprained wrist, grazes over my chest, shoulder, both knees were cut open, cuts and brushing over the left calf, and the entire right side of my face was grazed and the skin had come off.

My mum contacted covermore 12 hours after that, once I was able,to contact her and tell her what happened. Since then covermore have been the worst to deal with. I have no mobility in my right arm, and no vision out of my right eye, but they insisted I find a police station on my own in Amsterdam to retrieve the police report. Once getting to the police station, the officer was socked they asked me to fetch it in my own and advised that the insurance company must request it as it is their duty, and what if I had broken legs or something? How would I be expected to seek the police report then?

I got the hospital to fax them the medical report, which took them 36 hours to translate it supposedly - whilst im suffering in amsterdam waiting to find out what will happen to me. My mum calls up twice a day to be treated with poor customer service, and be told that i must get the police report for them, and also that they will call me back..out of four promised calls, I received one.

It has now been four and a half days since first contact and they now say they are awaiting me to fill out an accident and incident form which involves me collecting all of the contact details of the witnesses..which they surely could have sent at the beginning. Now I have to wait until all parties return my emails before I can send on the form.

I also forgot to mention I am a 21 year old female traveling on my own in Europe. My mother decided to pay for the return flight out of her own pocket as covermore is messing us about so much. The airline has organized a wheelchair for me as well as personnel to help me - covermore has done nothing but drain our energy.

They are lazy, useless, and simply shift the blame. They also claim to be a 247 service, however thy did nothing for me all weekend.

Poor customer service, extremely poor time efficiency, lack of treatment or care

You took 4 months to decide this even though we informed you at the start, wasted hours upon hours of our time requesting more and more paperwork... which I?m also now questioning, as a lot of this is highly secure information!!!

I?ve requested a refund on this policy as I?m more likely to get a refund on used tissues, then one from this joke of a company!!!

SAVE yourself the hassle as there are companies that look after their customers, this is not one!!!

title: Terrible customer service
body:
Very quick and easy to arrange online but try to make a claim and the process drags on for months. 

Claim for a cancelled flight and train tickets due to tummy bug.

- They ask me to provide ALL the documents again. I called (25 min on hold) "oh I'm not sure why they are asking for all that, it seems to be here" I'll get back to you. No call back.

- I call again after a week (20 min on hold), "oh it will take at least another 10 days to hear anything". 

- I receive a request for clarification and is asked to call. (35 min on hold) Please provide X. I suggest he calls flight centre and he refuses stating they would need three forms of ID for me to authorise the travel agent. I make clear I am not happy. I try to obtain X from both Flight Centre and Qantas (45 min on hold) direct. Both companies say "seems like they (1Cover) are trying to be difficult". They were unable to provide the document. I call back 1Cover and explain (15 min on hold). The operator insists the document is required and when I request a suggestion on how to get a hold of this item she simply continue to say "we can not process your claim without it" I insist, she speaks to a manager who suggest a manager will call me back. As "they might be able to authorise the claim without the document.
I am told I will receive a call within 2 business days. I email on the 2nd business day. "Please call me as promised". I received no call. After a week I call the claim line again (25 min on hold) and now suddenly it is possible for them to contact flight centre without three forms of ID. I'm told it will be maximum a week.
The whole process has now taken 2 months. Oh the joy!
So looking forward to another round in a week, if I do receive that call that is. 


Please don't suggest I call you to discuss this as you have done with other customers who complain. Feel free to email me if you are interested in solving this. Up to now there has just been a whole lot of wasting everybody's time.

This turned out not to be the case at all. The policy fine print was adhered to in the extreme by this company in the case of my genuine claim. The claim arose out of the Chile earth quake and me not being able to attend to the travel because of the devastation there.
They say that they are easy to do business with, they are not I can assure you. It has taken since March last year to recover all my money, 10 months in all and countless e-mail and phone conommunications with their staff. In the end I had to instruct a lawyer to deal with them and the airline involved. The time I spent in the recovery process was enormous not to mention the anxiety it created for me and the associated costs.

title: They don't repair or replace as stated.
body: We recently went overseas and had some items damaged.  We submitted the quotes to 1Cover who only paid out part of the claim. They decide (without seeing products) to apply depreciation at their discretion until the item is almost worthless and then pay you a percentage based on the depreciated amount.  So we were not paid enough to repair or replace.  Staff member advised that this "wasn't right" so put in for a reassessment however the lady who called me back after reviewing was beyond rude.  I submitted a post via Facebook which 1Cover do not allow to be posted without them approving (so it has disappeared).  Repair or replace should mean that these are the only two options, not partial repair or partial replace.  So we now have to pay ourselves to get the items fixed - isn't this what the cover was meant to be for in the first place?  Misleading on 1Cover's part so please be aware that you are not truly covered as they state.  A working item when you leave home will mean that you throw it in the bin when you get home with a minimal financial gesture from 1Cover to compensate for item.  Will never get insurance with them again, and will continue to warn others of their repair or replace conditions.

On my return I put in my claim for flights home and loss of 4 weeks planned holiday . No refund !!! Explanation, I had a family member with a pre existing condition!!! This was never explained!!! Apparently if you have a family member with any pre existing ailment and this can even be blood pressure and that person has a stroke , and you need to come home ,you will not be covered !!! This is truly ridiculous!!! I could understand if I had a pre existing condition as I am the traveller but now you have to consider any family members as well ? body:

We requested a full refund of the travel insurance, under ACCC advice which was denied.
After further discussion we were told to ring back on 31 July 2020, the date our travel was to commence, to request a Pro Rata refund. We asked if InsureandGo were advising their customers of these circumstances, and was told no.
We feel this is extremely poor customer service and unethical consumer practices. 

The world was advised officially of the Pandemic at the end of January 2020, only weeks after we purchased the insurance policy. The Australian Government imposed travel bans in March 2020, preventing travel. It is not fair or reasonable to expect us to ring InsureandGo back on 31 July 2020 and again request a refund. It is also not fair or reasonable not to be provided a full refund due to the unusual circumstances.

body:

The policy would be reactivated when travel could be rescheduled and the insurer could then provide the service I paid for. 
It seems this is not the case as stated in the response from the insurer 

?I have taken a look into this matter for you and found that your contract of insurance states that the policy is for the dates of travel listed and unfortunately we are unable to convert your policy to credit or amend the dates of travel. Similarly, we are unable to provide a refund for the policy outside the 14-day cooling-off period?

Basically this company has taken mine and many more customers money and provided no service.  They are profiting from the Covid crisis! These are unprecedented times, it was unimaginable that a virus would stop the world when I took out the insurance in January.  Insurance companies need to do the right thing and look after your customers, your return customer numbers will suffer dramatically due to your lack of empathy.

If you have been affected I encourage you to contact AFCA and report your loss.

Recently a friend and I had booked a holiday of a lifetime through USA and Mexico however due to a terrible accident which occurred less then 24hrs before our international flights to start our holiday we had no option but to cancel our whole trip... Flights, accommodation, prepaid tours, everything! I was a mess and didn't know where to start however rang cover more the same day as the accident to advise and asked for their guidance in how to go about things... The phone staff were very switched on and gave me all the information I needed to start my claim. I filled out the forms and included any extra paperwork from doctors, surgeon and hospital reports and sent the claim in 3 days after the accident occurred. Cover more contacted me 2 days after they received my claim and after another 4 days they approved our claim and I received the chq in the mail another 3 days after that. I had no problem with the cancellation claim, which was not a small amount and cover more covered everything. I thank cover more for the prompt, professional dealing of my claim, very much appreciated. 
The only thing I can suggest to others is to read your policy carefully and make sure you have a travel agent which is willing to take the time to go through everything with you and make sure you are covered for everything. I strongly recommend that you also take out the extra cancellation cover on top of your normal insurance claim. No one expects terrible things like this to happen, these things only happen in movies, well that's what I used to say :-/ Spending just that little bit extra on your insurance is worth it especially when you have been lucky enough to spend around 15k of your hard earned money on a holiday. 
I have since booked my next holiday, unfortunately my friend will not be coming with me but I have all the faith in the world in cover more and have used them as my insurer again... Not that I ever want to go through this nor make a claim again eventhough their service was outstanding. 
Well this was my experience... Well done Cover More and thank you again.
Reliable, Prompt, Professionsal.

title: Disappointed.
body: After booking my holiday to Bali in November 2014 (and paying for it up-front which meant we had to go regardless) we were unable to claim anything for the delay involving the volcano eruption because "we knew about it" before we left.  Yeah well, we didn't know about it in November 2014.  Thanks for nothing.

title: Super trip
body: My trip 2016 was great felt safe that i had travel  insurance with you need it these days the world has changed thank you online travel insurance highly i recommended to anyone

title: Insure with Cover-More and no need to worry anymore!
body:
Choosing insurance when travelling can be daunting.  Not only do Cover-More provide hassle free and inexpensive travel insurance they have the added bonus that they embrace travellers with medical conditions. Where other companies just exclude conditions Cover-More makes it so easy with a simple online application. Within minutes you have an approval and additional premium where applicable.  So choose Cover-More for the best cover and peace of mind when travelling.
Easy; value for money; reputation; caring and responsive.

title: Felt very confident we had the right cover
body: We shopped around for travel insurance as we both have elderly parents, and some medical conditions. The staff member I spoke to took all our information and then explained how we would be covered. This reassured me that she had understood our situation, and made me feel completely confident we would be covered if needed.

title: Efficient management
body:
Thank-you for your quick assessment of our claim and prompt payment of $281.50.   For your information when we arrived at East Coast Rental, near Tullamarine, we were told that the cover we had with you was insufficient to cover us and so we took additional cover at a cost of $153.91 with an excess of $385. We have since learned that our original cover was enough.

    Whilst in Mornington, Victoria, we had a small accident when we were angled parked in a car park and the car next to us backed out at an angle and hit us on the back bumper bar. Repairs cost $200.00, GST $20.00, loss of income $36.00, plus fee $25.50, total $281.50. We are still waiting an amount of $103.50 to be refunded. Although details of the other driver were supplied, it would appear that they did not pursue the driver at fault to claim full cost of the repair. We thought you may be interested to know what other operators are doing.

    Thank-you again for your efficient management of our claim.

title: TID was exactly want i wanted from Travel Insurance
body: Good stuff, easy to get a more than competitive insurance for the dates and place. And the app is good to just in case you need your details at hand.

title: Great service - efficient and friendly!
body:
I became sick in Korea and ended up at a medical centre. They had a translator there but she wasn't able to stay the whole time so there were parts of the procedure we didn't completely understand. 

The receipt was all in Korean and they didn't type my full name on to the receipt despite giving them my passport.
I thought both of these things would be a problem when I tried to claim the money back from 1Cover, but the guy I spoke with on the phone told me it was fine and that since it was a simple claim he was able to fast track it for me, so I received reimbursement within 2 days!

Great customer service and very efficient. Was very quick purchasing the insurance over the phone too. Will definitely use 1Cover next time, thank you!

January 25th 2018 Update: Full faith in 1Cover, stress-free and fast claims

I have been using 1Cover over the past 3 years for all my travels and have never had an issue with them! No hidden fees or anything and the claims process has always been stress-free, straightforward and fast. The policy was easy to purchase online and alter when needed. Customer support has always been great too and I?ve been recommending 1Cover to all my friends when we travel together. The only thing is that I feel it has been slowly increasing in price and there are definitely cheaper insurance companies out there, but at least I know that I can have full faith in 1Cover when I travel.

title: All good
body: My claim was partly processed and when i rang up and asked why I was not paid out for other items, I was told that I have been paid for everything I claimed for.I then said no according to my copies of the claim, you have missed a lot of them, The claim officer said I had sent a lot of pages and there was only 1 claim page, it was then the missing page was discovered and full payment was made.

title: Allianz travel insurance via Commonwealth Bank Credit card
body: I read the others who are happy, but they haven't made a claim, which to me is the reason you get TI in the first place. When making a claim I found the service was very poor. Each time they needed some more details because they did not clearly indicate this to me, my claim went to the back of the queue. 3 times so its now 2 months and they paid up for a travel delay. title: Nice to know I was covered at all times

title: Lost In Translation
body:
I found Cover-More quite by accident and have recommended this company to others that are travelling, whilst travelling through Laos earlier this year, I had the misfortune to become ill with an abcess on my leg, as Laos people who can afford it travel to Thailand for any operations, I decided after one visit to a Laos hospital this is exactly what I would do, on arrival in Ubon Thailand not a travel destination, no one spoke english including my surgeon, luckily the hospital had internet and I was able after surgery to contact Cover-More.  Oh my phone had been stolen in Laos, so internet my only form of communication, someone from Cover-More contacted me straight away, I also spoke to a nurse regarding the treatment I had received,  I have nothing but praise for the level of service and the professional way in which I was treated by the staff, I had to spend another 10 days post operation in Ubon, so I was able to submit my claim online and payment was credited to my account before I had even left Ubon.  

Well done Cover-More on delivering a service that delivers exactly what it states, especially when one is ill in a foreign country.
Great customer service, very affordable policy, being able to submit a claim online whilst away

body: Made a claim in early January and was assured that the claim would be completed within 10 business days. Over 10 business days and still waiting. I will give them credit, their Emergency assistance team was extremely helpful and reassuring.

body:
Policy is very easy to set up, claims are attended to with a minimum of fuss, premium cost is reasonable. April 8th 2018 Update: Didn't need it this time

Took out travel insurance, as you should, but luckily we didn't need to make a claim. Did get the opportunity to discuss travel Insurance with fellow travellers while away and I had the opportunity to extol the virtues of 1Cover yet again.....keep up the good work and keep those premiums as low as possible while offering great cover.

title: Excellent Service
body: Unfortunate skiing accident in Austria, snapped leg, phoned help centre, off to hospital, xrays, mri and 2 more phone calls into surgery, 10 days in hospital then taxied to airport for a business class trip home. Absolutley Brilliant.All invoices paid direct to Hospital with $100 excess only out of pocket

title: No help or info provided when necessary
body: I have used this insurance company 3 or 4 times now. Never had a reason to make a claim but this time my luggage went missing and I realised i had no proper idea on what to do next. I wanted to know what i am entitled to but all i could find was fine print. This said i can make a claim after 12h has passed but explained nothing else. Just legal formalities. My other option was to make an expencive phone call to australia which i was not happy to do without knowing what the result will be. So i sent and email and of course it sais the responce will take 2-5 business days.... why is there no live chat for immidiate assistance and help from all over the world? The email i received next day said i can make a claim online. Well that was mighty helpful. Not! by that time i had received my luggage. Had i had the opportunity to ask what i am entitled to right away it would have been a much less stressful and enjoyable experience.

title: So affordable with full cover
body: First time to use TID, however purchased insurance for 2 different trips. TID was recommended by a friend who always uses TID.

title: Stick with major companies
body: We usually go with Allianz and have been happy. We have made small claims with no hassle. I decided to give this company a go as recommended by choice. All I can say is stay clear. We had a delay due to plane being cancelled and lost $1000 in hotels and flights and then repaid to get new flights and hotels. I came back and lodged this claim and there the headache began. Close to 10 weeks of continuously being asked to resend documents that had been sent not once but a couple of times. Confirming bank details as said it is finalising. Stall tactic after stall tactic and yesterday I received my refund of $2! Yes $2. It was actually $202 but they took my excess out and after more than a $1000 lost I got $2. Understand maybe all the claims not under their guidelines but I?m sure a lot where. Stick with the bigger companies as this was a prolonged, stalled, stressful situation to go through. We are not giving up though and lodging with the ombudsman.

title: Perfect! Really cheap!

title: On-line made easy, prompt payment
body: While not a fan of on-line claims, the process was quite painless and the claim was processed efficiently and with no fuss or question. title: very good

title: Really great insurance
body:
I went with Cover more the 1st time i went overseas, i got my Teeth smashed out and they paid all the money i paid to get them temporarily fixed, they needed receipts. I also got my camera stolen and some other items. I needed to get a police statement and receipts but they refunded all ym money (minus depreciation, not too much) The second time I went to Europe i got my whole backpack stolen, the needed receipts but refunded everything. I highly recomend this travel insurance, very easy to deal with and had no trouble getting through to them. You can choose your excess amount from $0-200$. The website is easy to navigate as well. The prices may be a bit higher, but definatley worth it when you do need to make a claim. I received refunds higher than i expected both times
reliable, very good with claim refunds
a bit on the pricey side

title: Great rate but what am I covered for again?
body: I think it's a great rate and I know I'm covered for a lot, but a simple email with bullet points of the cover would be great for next time so I don't have to try to research it when I'm on holidays.

title: Excellent Customer Service. Cannot fault the support team.
body:
'The works' cover - great value, especially considering whats included.

Online policy selection and payment was a breeze. Tripwise app and information easy to access.

Customer service is phenominal.  I had never even contemplated an emergency evac during my recent trip to Nepal.  However, poor luck meant My tour agency needed to arrange a helivac due to poor health. 

Every email communication was quickly answered and the staff supportive and non-judgemental in anyway.

Being worried about costs and really not knowing what to do, everything was handled with very minimal input from myself.

I will not choose any other insurance agent ever again. TID all the way!

Thanks again.

title: Excellent service and coverage
body:
My husband and I travelled to Malaysia, Vietnam and Cambodia for a month from mid April 2013, we insured ourselves with Allianz, and unfortunately I dropped my camera a few days before the end of our trip and the lens wouldn't retract. Once I got home I lodged a claim online, received an acknowledgement almost straight away, and my claim was settled within a few days. Unfortunately the excess ate up two thirds of the claim total, but at least the remainder went some way to buying a new camera.
We are travelling to India in October and we are going to insure with Allianz again.
Easy to find details re coverage; quick and easy claim service and payment.
The $200 excess

title: Excellent cover
body: This was the first time my family and I  have used this insurance through this particular company for travel and leisure purposes.

title: Holiday insurance
body: Allianz Travel is always easy to buy online and competes well with other insurers.  We have not needed to make a claim but the cover for everything is very reassuring when abroad. As we are both at or beyond 80 it is good to find an insurer that is willing to insure us.  One major feature we like is the hire car insurance that is better and cheaper than the hire car firm insurance.

title: great product
body: Always great value for money - website is easy to use - thankfully have never had to use the insurance but gives great peace of mind when travelling. Would recommend every time.

title: I always travel overseas with 1cover as a insurance that "if" something goes wrong I will be looked
body: I always use 1 cover when travelling oversea as it gives me and my family piece of mind that if something goes wrong there is a back up plan that allows us to still enjoy the holiday.

title: Length of time for final decision and poor Customer Service.
body:
Submitted my claim on 3rd December 2019 and after appealing the initial decision (which was made in less than a week) it took until 18th February 2020 to get the same result. In one instance I was informed in writing that Cover-More had been in contact with my GP. It just so happened I was with my GP the same day as this notification and he had not been contacted. When I queried this I was informed that they has sent a letter to the GP which arrived some days later. 
On more than one instance paperwork that had already been submitted was requested again.
The thing that most annoyed me in this whole experience was when I was contacted by 2 separate Cover-More representatives requesting Medical reports on my condition. On both occasions I was lying in a hospital bed trying to recover from my condition. One on board the ship, the other in Cairns Base Hospital. Both calls received after 7 p.m.
Warning to all: Read the fine print in your policy. I suffered from a virus, believed to be contracted on the ship, however because I had pre-existing conditions my claim was declined.

title: Unhelpful with my husband's death
body: My husband died when travelling overseas and Insure and Go would not get help underway until they had every document to hand. Other companies start helping while collecting the documents. It was a full week before they appointed a funeral company and I had to give them recommendations! They would only use his email account and seemed to not understand that I was not in the country where he died. They were unsympathetic and very disorganised. I had to send the travel documents more than once and then they rang me to read them over the phone. All while I was in a state of shock. If the consulate had not directed them to take some action I don't think they would have. Never again will I use this company.

title: Cover for older persons
body: Since most other insurers seem to think that 70 is old, it is a pleasure to find InsureandGo...up to 100 is OK for me. Easy to apply for and set up, very satisfied with everything so far, hope I don't ever have to  test the service, but you never know !

body: Be warned if taking advantage of the 15 day cooling off period to cancel the policy and obtain a refund that Australia Post retail outlet will not give you a refund (despite accepting the payment from you). title: Don't expect anything for personal items over a few years old
body:
The "wear, tear & depreciation" makes anything over a few yrs old not worth claiming for.  eg my Olympus waterproof, present/bought in Dec08 for $650, was only worth $150. Remove the excess and I get $50.00 towards my replacement camera.
(I accidently put the wrong date of Dec06 on it & the value is $50.00, so with the excess it would have actually cost me $50.00!).

However, if i'd stipulated my camera, this would have been covered for the full amount (I didn't bother because it's value was less than $750).

The "10 day" turn around on my claim took 28 days, with a few phone calls by me in between to ask what was going on.
Easy to do online - but peice of mind it isn't
Personal items a few yrs old, will not be worth insuring. Long time to make decisions on claims.

I submitted the claim and easy enough we received our money back - less the excess, which all helped.
I will happily look to Covermore for future travels.
Inexpensive and we had great service when making a claim

title: CAREFUL!!!!!!!!!!!!
body:
Very Deceptive Cruise Insurance, you need Domestic AND South Pacific just to sail in and out of Sydney!!

NO OTHER travel insurance has this stipulated as the moment you step foot on the ship you are 'International' hence the need for Insurance. 

BUT to charge an extra $20 bucks to sail out of Sydney Harbour (or Brisbane river) is a complete RORT! Understandable if your Cruise was to Australia BUT even then unless on the Ship you are covered by Medicare on the Land.

Think I will be looking elsewhere for a better Inclusive Policy not one so deceitful as this one.

title: Online application was easy

Quick, easy, informative

title: Approved my claim

title: Excellent, will take out Allianz travel insurance again.
body: We took out travel insurance for a recent trip to Bali. It was easy to set up (over the phone) and the customer service was excellent. I will use Allianz for travel insurance again.

title: Do not purchase
body:

title: Terrible
body:
I would not recommend this organisation to anyone. We used them because of a recommendation from Flight Centre but will never use them again and will think twice about any recommendation from Flight Centre. Due to a sudden death in the family we had to leave our tour and make a hurried trip home. From the time we submitted our claim Covermore used a variety of tricks to delay payment and I am sure they were hoping I would just give up. Some of their tricks included:
?	Did not receive the Faxed Claim Form.
?	Death Certificate not sufficient, it must be supported by a letter from a doctor.
?	Requesting resubmission of information already provided and then requesting the same information again.
?	Requesting more and more information, much of which was either irrelevant or duplicating information already provided.
?	Busy with the Brisbane flood claims.
?	Busy with North Queensland cyclone claims.
?	Busy with Christchurch (NZ) claims.
?	Sending email requests for more information to nonexistent email addresses.
?	When information was sent by email and post, the start date for action was put back to the day the post arrived rather than the day the email arrived.
?	Processing was slowed by my request that money be paid directly into my bank account.
?	I received an email advising payment would be made into my account in three to five working days.  When I contacted them seven days later they said they would get it done that day.  I received another email advising the money would be in my account in three to five working days.  
?	When I contacted them a week later they said they were looking for someone to sign off on the payment.
 Eventually success after three and a bit months but I worked hard for it!

See above. Leave you hanging on the phone and you can't speak to supervisors.

title: TID Dump You When You Need To Make A Claim
body: So you go through TID's slick sales processes but things change when you actually have to make a claim which i unfortunately have had to do. As soon as the claim form goes in you are handed over to Cerebus Special Risks and that where you problems begin. My claim has been under review for 4 months, they never respond to your emails and you always get an automated response - "Unfortunately we are experiencing higher than normal volumes of claims" when you send them info or try to follow up on the status of your claim. Despite supplying all information that has been requested they are still trying to find a way not to pay out on the claim and where is TID, nowhere to be seen, they just dump you and leave it to you to battle it out with the insurer. Also, be very wary of all these reviewers who give TID 5 stars despite having never made a claim and who talk about the need to get travel insurance and how cheap TID are. On that last point i have since used 2 different companies for my travel insurance, both being cheaper than TID and who provide better coverage. Final word, don't use TID, they are just sales focused and cast you off when you actually need their support.

title: Disgusting actions by Budget Direct
body:
Perhaps Budget Direct should spend more money on its company than it's over the top TV commercial...Telling everyone how good they are...They AREN'T.
I too purchased a policy, but was unable to travel due to COVID19...
Budget said it would take ten days to get a response...well that was the first lie.
I have in my policy the PDS states that I'm covered for epidemic...But now they say that no they won't pay a thing...I can't go to the travel agent as they have gone bust too (FLY365)
I'm devastated...It took me over 12 months to save for the trip to the UK to see family and attend a wedding, now I won't be able to go once the travel restrictions are lifted as I've lost 5k...Whats the point of insurance when they won't pay. I won't be letting this go anytime soon and will be trying my best to at least get something. 
In the PDS SECTION 8 IT STATES
What you are covered for
If you have to cancel your trip because of one of the reasons listed below we will pay up to the
amount shown in the Table of Benefits (pages 8-11) 
* You being unable to travel because of travel restrictions imposed on you after an epidemic,
terrorist attack or natural disaster.

So I would like to know if it states I'm covered for travel restrictions imposed on you due to an epidemic...
How can they say No?
I personally think they are liable, but will say no to everyone that claims at first as some people won't follow up and just take that as their answer. I WILL NOT BUDGET DIRECT. 
Anyone wanna get together with similar problem and get a lawyer or two?

title: Excellent, excellent, excellent
body:
I travel quite regularly, and always take travel insurance (mainly to avoid hire car excess).  I have only had to ever claim twice.  The first time was late last year with a Missed connection in Hong Kong, due to a blackout at Beijing Airport, and being stranded for 3 hours sitting on the runway.  I was then insured with Insure-and-go - they refused to pay (even with the Gold-level cover I purchased) - Will never buy another policy with them for as long as I live.  This trip, I decided to give Aust Post Travel Insurance a go.  I purchased it online, and was emailed the policy.  I didn't have to go in and queue at the post office.  I purchased a 12 month multi-trip policy, which was not much more than the single trip.  

Whilst packing our hire car on the last day to go to the airport, I put my phone on the roof of the car, and drove off.  By the time I realised, I was 100m down the road, and had to go back to get it.  Smashed Screen (of course).  Took the phone to the Apple Store, who said it wasn't viable to fix and replaced the unit for $179.00.  Sent off the receipt to the insurance company, and promptly (within a few days) received a payment into my account for $129 ($50 excess).  Could not have been any easier.  Will definately be buying insurance from Australia Post in the future.  I just regret not finding this earlier. Hard to tell which insurance company is best, until you need to make a claim !

title: Very Disgusted
body:
I had the misfortune of purchasing travel insurance for an impending month-long holiday to America. Unfortunately a few days before departure my elderly mother was hospitalised as a matter of urgency. I therefore made the decision to cancel my trip (based on advice given by the doctor), in order to care for her while she was so critically ill. She passed away three weeks later.
Amid my grief and the organisational havoc of the funeral, I submitted a claim for my lost holiday expenses to 1Cover. What ensued over the three-and-a-half month process was both unnecessarily difficult and incredibly insensitive. After submitting the treating doctor?s medical certificate who confirmed her death, two death certificates (from the hospital and the official one from the Registry), and travel documentation, I was further asked for: 
-	A hard copy of the documents detailing flight cancellation (which I have submitted 2/3 times already) ,
-	Copies of communication between specialists and the GP: "specialist letters back to the GP from the last 24 months?, (non-existent as she?d only ever had specialist treatment during final hospitalisation)
-	?GP consult notes for the last 3 months?; and a ?medical health summary? (non-specific as to from whom and from what period),
-	One Cover?s own medical certificate claims form (the hospital-issued 
-	My mother?s hospital discharge report (which does not exist where one dies in hospital), 
-	the medical certificate (page 8 of the 1Cover Claim form since the other two from the hospital were not acceptable!!), and
-	An over-the-phone account of her exact condition on the (one of the numerous days) she had ALMOST died!
Communication was only possible via email, with a 10-working day period awaiting their replies (and no apology or explanation as to why).
At the time of purchasing travel insurance, 1Cover offered one of the most competitive rates for my situation that I could find. Clearly I would NOT recommend 1Cover for anyone reading this - nothing could be worth the trauma, energy and wasted time that necessitates making an insurance claim through 1Cover. From now on, I?d rather spend a bit more to avoid the repeat of such traumatic and lengthy experience. Be warned!

Traumatic, slow, distrusting and absolutely terrible to deal with

On my first trip of the year to Japan, I have to pay for lounge area because the airlines didn't provide accommodation due to their mistake (late) and delayed arrival (bad weather) 
The first flight from Japan to Guang Zhou was late and arrived late due to bad weather which caused us to miss the next flight from Guang Zhou to Sydney. 
We arrived in Guang Zhou on Saturday, 14th April at 11.38pm when we meant to land at 7.20pm to catch our next flight to Sydney at 9.20pm. 
Because of the delayed, we have to wait in Guang Zhou airport until Sunday, 15th April at 3am for the airlines to find us a seat for the next flight which not until Sunday, 15th April at 9.20pm. 
With a peace of mind, I thought my travel insurance will let me claim my 6 hours lounge fee as I need to rest and have a quick nap until my next flight. 
I gave all the evidence, which include the delayed certificate from the airlines, the boarding pass and all the receipts. 

They didn't bother to look at the whole situation (total delayed for more than 4 hours) but just looking at the first delayed (3 hours) and insisted I can't get anything back. 
If you are with Medibank, don't even bother to buy their travel insurance. I'll surely suggest to go with Aust Post which I should have done.

title: If you're 65 years old or older - they don't cover for Annual Multi-trip insurance - even if you are a return customer
body:
When we initially took out 1Cover insurance a couple of years ago, we were very happy with the cost of our annual multi-trip cover - it was extremely comparable with other quotes and appeared to provide the type of cover we were looking for. Customer service was very quick and they provided easy to understand information and responses to any of our inquiries - but then my husband turned 65 years old and that's when the good story ends. 

We only became aware of this concern when we received a reminder email to renew our annual multi-trip policy but our policy could not be renewed. It appears that we couldn't renew because one of us turned 65 so we had to look elsewhere and go through the entire comparison process all over again. Surprisingly enough, this company is not the only one that ceases covering anyone at the age of 65 or over, so be prepared to do some research once you retire.

It just doesn't make sense. Retirees can no longer get multi-trip insurance with 1Cover which is really disappointing - are they hoping that their reputation alone will ensure that travelers over 65 will still take out single trip insurance cover with 1Cover. This would mean that they can make more money from retirees who want to travel more than once a year, which is simply a money grabbing exercise. In our case, they've just lost us as customers and we have quite happily gone elsewhere. 

To finish, I think 1Cover need to update their website. Currently it states they offer Seniors Travel Insurance on the front page of their website, but what they don't state is that this only applies to single trip insurance for anyone 65 years and over. By stating that it DOESN'T apply to multi-trip policies for anyone 65 years and over would be more transparent.
