body: Excellent policy and thank goodness I did not need to use it. The cover was very good and the app for my phone detailing the policy was very helpful and easy to access.

title: Didn't need it but was reassured it was there if I did.
body: Good value...yes. I filled in the details and spoke to a helpful person on the phone and paid on line I think. I usually insure with Alliance when flying or Cruising. Have never had to make a claim!

title: Smooth sailing
body:
Good value for money compared with other companies
Policy easy to setup with travel agent
Customer service was quick & attentive & followed up with prompt emails
Would use again

title: Brilliant
body:
We were set to travel on a cruise to the south pacific with 3 other couples when I was diagnosed with Acute Myeloid Leukaemia 3 days before we were set to sail. The staff at Covermore were excellent.
All I needed were reports to be filled out by my doctors, we sent them in and within a couple of weeks we were refunded our cruise payment. We always use Covermore and hopefully will again in the future.
Sincere staff, reasonable price.

title: No compassion, no service, unreliable .... watch out when claiming!
body:
My father and mother (mid and late eighties) took out travel insurance for a train trip within Australia. Due to health circumstances, etc, they had to cancel the trip and claim on insurance. Unfortunately, his dealing with this company has been a nightmare and has left him in a wretched state. The intriguing thing is that the complaints he has with them are similar to many of the poor reviews below. 
 
My parents are being ?fobbed off? and Suresave are prolonging the claim. My belief is that these are stalling tactics in a hope they will just go away. It is like being treated as second class citizens and is taking a serious toll on them. My father and mother have many health issues and the insurance company's lack of understanding / lack of empathy / prolonging claims, etc, is causing undue extra stress which they do not need. They do not know where to go next. 

But, I will not take this lightly and will escalate it to the fullest extent such as contacting the insurance ombudsman (or similar title), discussing with my legal and media contacts. No one should have to go through what they have been through. All they want is to settle their legitimate claim forthwith and move on. I don't wish to see them hurt any more.

title: An absolutly proffessional aproach to purchase of cover
body:
52 day sea cruise , five day illness on board 7 days out , your service to our well documented claim was outstanding . I would recommend your company and your your staff who where so able and supportive in their advice re our claim , our recommendation of your company will reach as far as we can push it.
No alternative for our next journey but Covermore.
efficient

title: Covers what I need
body:
This is the second time I have purchased InsureandGo.  This insurance covers what I need including medical conditions and is a very competitive price.  
I can not make comment on claims as I have not had to claim previoulsy and hope to not have to claim anything in the future but peace of mind is worth the price.

title: Very good service
body:
Twice
On both occasions I found the response was excellent. They were speedy and fair and I was more than happy. They don?t cover unforeseen weather events though!

title: Excellent claim resolution.
body: We purchased 1cover insurance for a family trip to Bali for four adults for Xmas 2014. Due to health problems we had to cancel our trip. 1cover were excellent in quickly assessing and paying out our claim within 2 weeks. Couldn't ask for better service. We will always use 1cover as our preferred insurance company.

title: Cheap, easy and hassle free
body: The staff were very friendly and helpful. The online transaction was very quick. I would recommend 1Cover Travel Insurance to others.

title: Great Cover!
body:
1 cover travel insurance was a great choice especially with the ski and snowboard extras which is what I required! Although I didn't end up having to use the cover, it was great knowing that help was there on a first overseas trip! I would recommend this to this travelling overseas with snow sport intentions!
ski and snowboard extras.

title: i felt safe and secure
body: It was great to get email before i left with helpful information. And upon return also a email of thank you. I felt safe and secure with all the confirmation and information that they sent. Although I didn't need to make any claim i had all the contacts if i had any problems. I felt that they were professional.

title: Dont waste your money!
body: I left my Iphone XR at a restaurant in Puerto Vallarta Mexico. Even though it was stolen from that location (viewed on Find My iPhone and could prove it moved locations) they would not cover as they said it was my fault.  I have always used 1Cover in the past but decided to try InsureandGo as thye offered a Seniors Discount.  I learned my lesson not to ever use the cheapest again as they dont pay out your claim! Claim fortm was very long.

title: Travel Insurance a must have.
body:
This is the first time I have used 1Cover.  Suffering from Techno-fear I was impressed with how easy it was to set up the policy by myself and was very good value.  The policy was half the price of those I'd used before and it covered me for the Bali volcano,  a big plus.  Unfortunately I didn't need it as our flight was cancelled and we decided not to go at all as it was too risky and we didn't want to be stuck in Bali as we had other commitments at home.   We lost nothing, our airfares are there waiting for us to use whenever and the hotel didn't charge us anything for cancelling within the 48hours.
So next time we travel we will certainly use 1Cover and the hotel in Bali who accepted our cancellation without charge.

title: Thankyou for reassuring protection
body: Good value policy which accommodated a relatively recent medical condition which, while not critical was necessary to have covered. While not needin* to claim, the reassurance is what you need when travelling

title: Will use again
body: All good, will use Online Travel insurance again. Was easy to buy online, and website very user friendly. Great price and the good thing is I didn't need to shop around. I got told about you guys from a friend.

title: High Travel Insurance Cost with Low/No Claims Wanted by Covermore
body:
Poor Communications, by Phone 55 Minute Wait to speak with someone, two times.
They want email as correspondence, then take 2 weeks to answer, after replying they take another 2 weeks to reply.
Absolutely outrageous. They do not want to pay a claim that is certainly justified, with poor communication they are looking for you to give up because of the time frames for their response.
I would Never Recommend Covermore Travel Insurance!!! Never!!!

title: Would not travel overseas without insurance
body: Very comforting knowing you had  my back in case of injury. Not needed on this occasion but you never know when the need will crop up. Will travel again soon

title: Want to travel - must have Travel insurance
body:
Relatively easy to set up .. had medical condition .. processing questions straightforward
Disappointed that after quote, the company altered the condition to include coronavirus.  The quote was made prior to this notation and taken out within 48 hrs  (felt it not justified as I had quote)
First time using this insurance company - will see how it stacks up against ones previously used.

title: Great peace of mind while travelling for a low price.
body:
The policy was good value and easy to purchase.
This is the third time we have used 1Cover.
Great product and service and felt fully at ease with the coverage and cost.

title: Past User for Many Travels
body:
Because of our age cover is now becoming very expensive. Once in the past we found it necessary to make a claim and this was handled efficiently and to our satisfaction.
On our next overseas holiday we may need to look elsewhere to find a more competitive price for our cover.

title: Very price competitive
body:
Have only booked once for a trip in Jan 2019.
Easy to book online and very competitve.
Hope we dont have to make a claim.

title: Didn't need it - but it was good to have it in case...
body: Good value, easily set up. In covering a lot of territory, it was good to know I was covered, especially the strenuous parts, in remote places. Expenses can be high if one has an accident or falls ill, especially away in the back blocks.

title: Excellent
body:
Absolutely amazing when things went wrong for me and my family - cannot recommend them highly highly enough.
They delivered when we absolutely needed it!
A cheap price isn't quite so important when your Travel Insurance is only as good as the help you get when you are in trouble overseas. Mind you, TID was still the best value of any I compared.

title: Total Rip Off
body:
I willingly join the chorus of dissatisfied Insurandgo customers following the cancellation of our planned trip to Canada & USA in June/July. Our policy was taken out and paid in full to the tune of nearly $2,500 in September 2019, well before any coronavirus implications. Same story as everyone..contacted Insureandgo to seek a refund of my premium as a) The holiday had not even commenced and b) no risk has been assumed by them at all. This must count as a "fee for NO SERVICE". Same response - no refund and no change of dates to accommodate a later trip offered by the tour company by way of a future credit. 
We felt we had thoroughly researched the options for travel insurance and Insureandgo seemed to meet all our requirements at a reasonable cost. Our current experience does nothing to allay our cynicism about insurance companies. Will not be using Insureandgo in the future and will tell everyone about this negative outcome.

title: Rip off merchants!!!! Do not book insurance with Insure and go.
body:
Flights cancelled to to global pandemic. Made claim on insurance to recoup cost. After paying extra to reduce excess down to $100 they have the audacity to charge me $400 as apparently the excess is per person on the policy!!!! This is written in their terms and conditions in the smalleat writting and not anywhere near the section where  excesses are explained!

What utter nonsense. One of the persons on the policy is an infant who didn't even have a seat on the plane!
Usually with every other insurance policy I have ever taken out the excess is a one off payment not a one off payment multiplied by the number of persons on the policy!

Absolute rip off merchants and I will never purchase insurance from them again and would strongly urge everyone else never to buy insurance with them also!!!

title: affordable Travel Insurance made easy.
body: very good service and suggestions for travellers  regarding safety of passport/ money security. , before leaving home, good value policy.

title: Two trips, two hospitals visits and still feeling good
body:
When choosing an insurance company for my round the world trip in 2011 I remembered back in 2001 when I had ended up in a hospital in Bali (not a recommended tour stop!) and clocked up quite a bill. The insurance company reimbursed me entirely and quickly. I found my old correspondence with Cover-More, and booked them again. And low and behold - I end up in hospital in Seattle with stomach issues after spending time in South America! 

Although my husband now jokes that a holiday isn't a holiday without me ending up in hospital, I was yet again reimbursed quickly and entirely. And knowing that it had happened that way in 2001, made my next unfortunate hospital visit less stressful, which is what you need when ill.
Easy forms, quick turnaround, customer service,

title: Mostly happy
body: Overall I am very happy with your service. However during this holiday I was bitten by a dog and had to go to hospital twice to get a rabies vaccine. I tried to ring the number for Australia and the number for Thailand, as requested on your travel forms, but could not get a response to either number. I tried quite a few times but just could not get through. As it turned out I will not claim as i have a $200.00 excess and the amount charged was less than that. However I did not know this would be the case and at the time I had questions to ask Allianz and this was disconcerting when I could not get my calls answered.

title: Very happy with service
body: This was my first time using Budget Direct and they were fantastic.  Great phone service. Very friendly. Very easy to get a policy without all the fuss of other companies.

title: Affordable necessity
body:
Value for money, easy to setup,had to make some changes to the policy this was done without fuss.
Customer support was most helpful. Not much else to say really, won't know until I make a claim how good the policy is,hopefully I will never have to find out .

title: House contents and travel insurance
body: I always have insurance with allianz due to customer service outstanding no problem to big or small, all areas of insurance have been explained to a high standards, very happy!!

title: Very Simple And Reliable
body:
This is the third time we have used 1Cover Travel Insurance online services over the past three years. We have not had to claim but it is comforting to know that we have cover and at a reasonable price. Cover is simple to arrange and we do not bother to seek any other quotes.
Easy website for us less capable computer users. Their reputation and reliability and cost competitive rates.
None to our knowledge.

title: Just what I neeed
body: This is my first time. But we don?t travel until next year in June. So hopefully if anything does happen InsureandGo Australia will look after us.

title: Can't be happier!
body:
We are older and not very good at the computer so being able to ring and talk to someone was wonderful and the customer service was great!
Thankyou for your great policys when you have a medical condition we could not be happier!!

title: Easy to apply and gave me complete peace of mind.
body: I found the application process very user friendly and professional.  I left the country with complete peace of mind. The premium is on a higher side but good value for money.

title: Very helpful and efficient
body:
Policy was easy to set-up.
This is the first time I have used your Insurance.
Price was okay.
Nothing else to add

title: Excursion to Bali
body:
Wife bitten by local Balinese street dog - luckily only 3x days before we flew back to Australia. Notified insurer who promptly replied and provided advice re payment for local medical assistance which was minimal. Received most of the potentially expensive medical treatment re rabies in Australia hence no claim made against insurer.
Would have been a different scenario had tthe incident happened at the beginning of our trip but am confident from my correspondence with insurer that they would have covered our expenses.
This was the second time that we have used this company and we will be using them again for our next overseas trip.o

title: Good value
body: Yes I feel my policy was good value and it was easy to set up. Have peace of mind knowing that I am covered if something did happen. I am happy that I have bought another policy for our trip to Europe in November.

title: Travel Insurance at lower rates.
body: Australia Post matches or at times is even better than any other Travel Insurance I could find for my trip at a lower cost. It was half the cost of the policy my travel agent offered me. You can purchase your insurance at the counter of most Post Office branches. They will provide you with a Product Disclosure Statement that spells out everything you need to know. As with any insurance you need to make sure this one suits your needs.

title: Appalling turnaround times and communication
body: Declined claim within 2 days but declined on incorrect reasons. Evidence sent to support claim and now they know they have to pay im still waiting 6 weeks later. On hold for over an hour and just keep getting told its with a claims manager. Sent a complaint over a week ago and not even acknowledged. Will not use again

title: Excellent
body: Haven't had to claim but price was very competitive .didnt mind if we got see sick on our cruise because we were covered, so I think that made us feel better. My sister recommended One Cover as she wouldn't use anyone else, so that was good enough for me .

title: Great service with helpful staff. Good value for money
body: Have used this insurance previously and again it was great service with helpful staff. Good value for money and claims process is simple to use as well. Will definitely recommend to others

title: Very easy and simple to apply for, and very affordable in comparison to other travel insurance. Staf
body:
At least 5 times myself, and my family at least 8 times.
My friends at least 4 times that i am aware of

title: Will not pay out on anything
body:
I trekked to Mt. Everest base camp with the peace of mind that I was fully covered. I had a few minor things happen on my trek. 
My camera lens was smashed.
I dropped my gopro and cracked it
My flight was cancelled
My ipod was stolen.

So far this has been the hardest and longest experience ever. I have never made a claim before but the whole process has deliberately made hard by TID. They initially wouldn't cover me for anything. I had to fight tooth and nail to get my cancelled flight covered. They wont accept the smashed camera lens as I didn't report to a police station and contact them strait away, even after I advised them I had no service and was no where near a police station. The second I did have service I did contact them but it is still not good enough because I didn't carry a broken lens around with me for weeks just to show them. The Gopro has to be send to them to verify it is smashed, even though I have sent pictures to them and they know GoPro cannot be repaired in Australia. The take weeks to reply to emails, in a hope you forget about your claim. I cannot stress enough for people not to use this company, it is a nightmare. No matter what they say about being covered for all situations you are not.

title: Excellent
body:
I've never actually made a claim so I can't vouch for how easy the claim process is. But I buy my travel insurance from TID every time I go overseas (about once a year) and because the price is so reasonable, I don't have to think twice about it and I have the confidence of knowing I'm covered.
Easy to use website, great price, trusted underwriter (Allianz)

title: Helpful staff and comprehensive cover for all your travel items
body: I feel that my insurance is slightly higher than average however the service and the additional item it had covered worth the price. I have not yet lodged a claim however this is the number one choice for whenever I need to buy a travel insurance.

title: Best travel cover ever!
body:
Due to unfortunate circumstances we had to cancel our last cruise on Christmas Eve 2013, 3 days before departure. 1Cover made the claiming process the easiest and simplest, they refunded us the full amount which enabled us to go on this cruise. We had an uneventful and a most enjoyable time. Thank you.
Inexpensive. Best value for money.

title: Travel Insurance
body:
Policy was say to set up online and it was accepted immediately.
I was so pleased to get cover for a pre-existing condition, even though the additional premium was expensive.  This is the second time I have used this company and will be using them again in the next few months.

title: A must have for peace of mind
body:
Policy great value and easy to set up 
I did not need to access the support as everything went smoothly. I had peace of mind should anything go wrong   Very happy with my decision to choose insurance

title: Good Value and Fast Claim
body: The policy is good value.  I've a car damage excess claim.  Lots of paperworks are required, but the claim is fast.  Less than 10 working days. Will definitely have InsureandGo for my next holiday trip.

title: Easy access to pages to gain my insurance
body: Yes, the price was very competitive. Yes the policy was extremely easy to set up and I am very satisfied with the provider's customer support. I would certainly recommend this company to others.

title: A very satisfied Medibank Travel Insurance customer
body: Medibank is my private health insurer, since I began to experience serious heath issues 4 years ago they have been excellent. Medibank was an easy choice when I purchased a comprehensive policy for my families trip to Thailand. Unfortunately I needed to make a claim upon our return. The online claim process only took 5 minutes, I received an approval 10 days later. I recommend Medibank for both health and travel insurance, my experiences have always been excellent. I will definitely continue to use them in the future.

title: excellent
body: Travel card insurance is very good value for getting everything covered it was simple to put in a claim and was promptly seen to, I felt the customer service was outstanding

title: Great Claims process WHAT A JOKE!!!
body:
These guys are reputed to be the best and their expensive product, very expensive relative to so many others, is flogged by Flight Centre as being the ultimate. Taking out cover is made so easy but geez, make a claim and you go down a black hole. I have used Cover-more 5 times before and this is my first claim. The documentation required was worse than doing my tax return.  They wanted everything. Then it gets lodged and you get an auto message saying I will get a response in 10 business days.  Then 6 days later I get another email telling me the claim is progressing and I will hear form them in another 10 business days. 
I have now been holding on the phone for 23 minutes wanting to get an update.  Absolutely pathetic service which you would expect from some type of shonky operation, not the best travel insurance provider.
But why am I calling?  because I have just booked two more overseas trips and I want an answer on my claim before I decide where to get my next two travel policies. If CM act in good faith then maybe I might just use them again but then again its looking very unlikely.  STILL ON HOLD!!!

title: Claim process easy and paid out efficiently
body:
Sadly this year we had to cancel our holiday due to a child's ill health and hospitalisation.
After submitting supporting documentation the claim was assesses and finalised quickly.
The process was simple and efficient

title: Job well done
body: From submitting the claim to getting reimbursed it was just less than 10 business days. No questions asked. Job well done team InsureGo will be definitely purchasing travel insurance through you again.

title: Great
body: Great price, great coverage, easy to purchase. Did not have to claim or call customer support so cannot comment on that side of things but would use them again in the future.

title: Value for $$ and easy to buy online
body: I have used Allianz travel insurance for various recent trips. Competitive rates, easy to buy online and covers dependents over 21. No claims made luckily. Good customer phone support for enquiries.

title: travels galore
body: Used Alllianz again for travel as always. Have never needed to make a claim but the peace of mind in having it is great. The ease of getting the policy and the explanation of what it covers is great . Price wise it's very competitive.

title: Meets specific needs.
body: The only policy I've found that covers large capacity motorcycling. Compares very well or better than the policies I checked in all other respects, and I must have checked over two dozen. My second policy this year.

title: Would expect to be able to at least replace item stolen
body: As mentioned in a previous review - was very disappointed to discover that the claim would not even allow me to purchase back my phone which was stolen. Depreciation off the current price versus what was originally paid seems unfair - when reading your policy it is not clear that this is what you do. I will definitely be taking my business elsewhere from now on.

title: Good app.
body: The app Provided ready access to useful information & linked the details of my travel insurance purchase. The quote gave a competitive price and I would recommend TID to others.

title: Very competitive, particularly for international travel
body:
I have used InsureandGo four times, one of which was for overseas travel. It was particularly good with overseas medical insurance cover. The online site is very easy to access which is a boon for older travellers such as myself.

August 12th 2019 Update: Good value for money 
So far I?ve used InsureandGo for a few domestic trips and one overseas trip. In all cases, it was easy to arrange insurance and I was particularly pleased by the relatively generous medical cover for the overseas trip. I?m glad that a friend recommended InsureandGo.

title: Hassle Free On Line Service
body: Good Pricing, very easy to obtain insurance on line the site was easy to navigate, no hassles, covered what I needed would take out again when travelling.  Fortunately didn't have to claim on this trip.

title: Satisfied customer
body: We recently had to cancel a trip because of the unexpected death of a close relative. Our claim was handled courtesy and professionally. All queries were replied to promptly. We will be using Insure and Go again and will be recommending to relatives and friends.

title: Beware
body: After very badly breaking my elbow in Germany, the first operation was insufficient. I now have incredible pain when I move my arm, and I need another operation to remove a bone fragment and a plate (as a screw is sticking out into the muscle between the two bones in my forearm). Onecover is refusing to cover this, and instead is advising me to fly home and have the operation under Medicare. I therefore strongly advise you not to use Onecover.

title: Perfect for what I needed
body: I was referred by a friend, will b coming back as I found it to the the best value and very easy to apply online. Ci believe customer service was satisfactory

title: Easy to read contract
body: Happy to find that the contract was easy to read and identify inclusions and exclusions. Also had excellent recommendations from an unfortunate friend who had to make a major claim. They couldn't speak highly enough of 1 Cover. Peace of mind all round. Thank you

title: Claim For Sickness On A Cruise
body:
Good value and easy to setup. I made the first claim ever for sickness on a cruise (29th cruise)  and it was settled without even a phone call. Extremely happy after having had property claims with other companied delayed, and delayed to a point that I had to go to BSA and eventually it was paid. A second one had to go to a panel and was eventually paid.
It was a -pleasure to deal with this Company (hope I do not have any sickness next time).

title: Value for money
body: We have used Online travel insurance for many years now, have only made one claim without any problems. We are very pleased with the costs compared to other travel insurances.

title: First Claim - exceptional response
body:
We were both claiming and people told us we would not receive anything and it was too hard. We received what we were entitled to and the process was smooth when we provided the necessary information. To us it was a difficult claim yet it was handled smoothly and without incident.
processed in a short time without a problem

title: Insurance review
body: Easy to set up , no insurance is value for money but it is essential for travelling in case of a mishap. Medium level cover covers most overseas traveling incidents

title: No need to worry, all covered.
body: Best price, best cover. We travelled with the knowledge that if we got sick, had a car accident or lost our luggage we didn't have to worry.

title: Fantastic - easy claim process
body:
I took out comprehensive cover for myself, husband and toddler. When completing the medical section, my husband had a few conditions that wouldn't be covered, but we decided to proceed with it anyway as it was so cheap ($90) and seemed to cover quite a lot. 
My toddler ended up getting sick, resulting in a hospital admission the night before our flights, so we had to cancel our trip.
I found the claims process very easy and straightforward, and it was approved within a couple of weeks. We received all our accommodation and flight expenses back, minus a $200 excess. I would definitely use Online Travel Insurance again.

title: Good price for what you get
body: I always go with these guys. Easy, friendly and fast. Black and white. They don't make the wording complicated which was good for the people like me who don't trust insurance companies.

title: One cover or no cover
body: Great advertising not so great on cover always used before but not after corona virus they should give a cost to existing clients to cover for virus they could make money and kept customers

title: Travel Insurance You Can Count On !!!
body: Great Value and easy to set up and good customer service !!! ... never an issue with these guys !!!

title: excellent service
body: after several Insureandgo policies I finally had to make a claim. which was caused by sad and distressing circumstances.      with trepidation I made claim and the service ,help and care I received was outstanding,   they did everything and settled very quickly. I live in a retirement village and our group all use Insureandgo.

title: Easy to Arrange
body: Arranging travel insurance was easy to do and the premiums were competitive.  This is the second time I have arranged insurance with Insureandgo and thankfully haven't had to claim :-)

title: I had no need for insurance
body: Easy to set up and price was fine. Didn't need to claim so I don't know what the claiming process is like.

title: Didn't need to use it but a comfortable feeling to know we were covered.
body: We traveled with a group where one person needed treatment for a blood clots in the lungs and ran up a shipboard medical bill of around $6,000. Without any prior symptoms or recent illness a clot  caused from recent long air travel ( deep vein thrombosis) decided to dislodge. How the unexpected can happen and without cover can turn travel into a nightmare.

title: Dreadful - waste of time even buying insurance
body:
I purchased "comprehensive" travel insurance from 1cover for a trip to Bali. My flight was cancelled because Jetstar had no captain, so I could not fly until the next morning. I incurred considerable expense because of this, having to pay for a taxi back home and back to the airport the next morning, and I lost money on a night's accommodation I paid for in Bali.

I put in a claim with all receipts and was told they do not cover cancellations. Even though I bought their most expensive policy. Do not touch them with a barge pole, they are awful.

They also took about three weeks to get back to me with this information, so are dreadfully slow as well.
They are awful - there is nothing good about them.
Everything - bad service, and they provide inadequate cover.

title: Smashing!
body:
When my iPhone slipped from my hand and bounced down the rocks at a waterfall in the NT I couldn't believe it. But on arriving home, it only took one phone call & I had the info & the papers to cover a new screen & the charge to fix it. Very impressed.
Helpful, informative staff when you ring for info.

title: Outstanding service when I got sick.
body: Surpassed my expectations. When I got an infection and ended up in hospital, the team were quick to respond, quick to agree to the (expensive) hospital stay.  Daily calls from the nurse and Case Manager were really appreciated. In the next room a girl with a different insurer had the same condition as me but it took 9 days (and alot of stress) before she got any word from her insurance . That is compared to my experience - which was that by day 2 in hospital everything was sorted.  I was also upgraded to fly home business class, which made an extraordinary difference since I had to care for my 4 year old despite having just got out of a week in hospital - so skipping the queues and being able to lie down on the plane made it a pleasant trip instead of one to be dreaded and feared. Everyone I spoke to at 'WE Assist' was supportive friendly and helpful.   Hospital in a developing country could have been a bad experience, but because of TID it was smooth and all worked out well. Thank you to the team.. Will highly recommend and continue to use TID.

title: Excellent Coverage with out too much cost!
body:
I was recommended to Cover more by friends & family. We have been with other companies before which may have been slightly cheaper but were of no help & not worth the fact might be $10-20 cheaper. The only time had to ever claim anything previous was for My Partners damaged items & they werent any help. We nearly didnt bother with travel insurance on our holiday but I am so glad we did. I ended up getting a bite on my my leg whilst in Bali & had to get medical attention over there. It was very pricey. Cover more were very helpful & refunded more then what I expected. We used them on our last holiday to USA when we went over to Colorado for snow boarding. Would recommend them to anyone & will use them again when we go on our next holiday.
reliable, reasonable price.

title: easy travel insurance
body: I think that 1Cover was very good value for money and super easy to setup online and it gave great peace of mind for traveling over to Korea. Highly recommended.

title: CoverMore no more
body:
CoverMore is the worst company ever after having my mother over 70 years of age and other elderly family members been stranded overseas unable to assist.  We were also advise that all our baggage, money and items were not covered after our bags were stolen from the boot of our rental vehicle. This was the worst experience in our lives and no consideration was made after calling there 24 hour emergency phone number. 
I would not recommend this company as we paid over $2300 in policies and unable to assist us.

title: You need insurance
body: I thought the policy covered what we required. I was unable to set up on line as the web site wouldn't work properly so l had to call the company. The person was very helpful in setting up the insurance.

title: It was easy to get a quote.
body: It was easy to set it up. I have used this insurance company for quite a few times before. I haven't need to lodge any claim before. Hopefully I don't need to in the future.

title: Unbelievable
body: Don't read the brochure or the online descriptions- read the fine print if you can find it BEFORE you pay them. Try claiming for a 12 hour delay to your flights and hotel bills. body: I did my research on several travel insurance including one I've used several times in the past and found that InsureandGo were reasonably priced with excellant cover and excellant service.

title: Non-compliance to code of Practice and no Empathy towards clients
body: Let me start by saying that I understand InsureandGo have a 14 day cooling off period and usually don't offer refunds on cancellations of policies after that period. HOWEVER, Due to the extenuating circumstances of Covid-19 (Like many many other travellers) our holiday has had to be re-arranged and postponed for at least 12 months or more.  I called InsureandGo on the 2/4/2020 to see if I could change/postpone the dates of this policy or preferably get a refund. I have no intention of making a claim with them as all the arrangements and refunds have already been organised and provided.  The consultant just said no to both requests and could not give me a reasonable explanation as to why. As suggested by the consultant, I submitted a complaint on the 2/04/2020 and other than the auto reply I have heard nothing. Their Code of Practice States that they will be in touch within 15 business days (Now 28 business days). I have also phoned as a follow-up on approx  4/5 May and was told that someone from the complaints team would be in touch...Still waiting..that was 8 business days ago.  Our policy was expensive and I feel it is really unfair not to be offered options especially as there is now Zero risk for InsureandGo and their underwriter. All the other providers I have dealt with have offered vouchers or full refunds even if non-refundable.  We were due to leave Australia on the 7th May. I am going to continue to pursue InsureandGo for a reasonable outcome. (preferably a refund)

title: Worst Claims Experience Ever
body: Be aware - should you make a claim there claims side Cerberus, will do everything in their power to frustrate you so you end up not bothering. They are incompetent and use delaying tactics to continually muck you around. I would suggest there are much better insurers you can use.

title: Great experience
body: Having had my phone stolen overseas, proving a 24 hour number to call in addition to simple and easy claims submission process made the experience much less painful!

title: Not so simple if you try to use it
body:
We, my wife and I, recently travelled to China for a short trip. We have always travelled with travel insurance over a period of 40 years - with and without children. We have used the insurance once 20 years ago for a minor accident in the US. Our issue that occurred in China was when we tried to access medical assistance in China and found the language and cultural value made this difficult. So we tried to contact the numbers for China using all possible variations with/ without country codes etc. with no success, then we tried the Australian contact and then the anywhere in the world - still no success. The issue was quite serious with my wife in a great deal of pain and comfort which we carried for four days before returning to Australia with paracetamol for the pain and antibiotics that we brought in case any issue occurred. we went to the doctor immediately on return who administered much stronger antibiotics and stated that hospitilisation for the pain was an option. The dentist and a root canal procedure is currently solving the underlying issue!

My issue is that the contact phone numbers for assistance don't work. Yes my phone was ringing other numbers at home. I guess when you buy the insurance that is so easy to organise, you really need to try the contact numbers first to see if they work, particularly in countries where communication may be difficult. Also, the Australian contact number for 24 hour assistance only works when tried in Australia in normal office hours.

I'm hoping to hear back regards this

body:

I spent all night on the phone to organise approval for him to travel with the German doctors and the airline, The airline required him to travel business class because he needed the extra leg room due to his injury and TID assisted with this negotiation and covered the cost of the business class fare. 

They were wonderful, providing prompt, full support and advice through the night and in the follow up. We have used them for all out travel insurance since as they are one of the lowest priced options and they have provided clear, comprehensive advice and customer service when we needed it, including to check if my husband's existing medical condition could be covered. We travel overseas regularly and, having compared rates and conditions a number of times I now go straight to TID.
Easy to use web site and application process, excellent support when needed, the welcome home message and prompt and uncomplicated follow up.
No problems experienced to date

title: Shocked & appalled - charged me 44% depreciation
body:
Took out covermore for family holiday within Australia over Xmas. My 5-year-old niece smashed my 12 year olds iPad by accident, my child uses iPad at school for everything so I was very upset but accidents happen. Isn't that why we take out insurance?
Claim process was very easy, (a little lengthy but aren't they all?!?) then I finally receive an email titled fast track approval just before school is due back, (phew - I can get my child's iPad replaced in time for first day of school). I open it up and they have approved $469 less their excess of $25, so a TOTAL payment of $444 for a $900 iPad that WAS still less than 12 months old at time of accident and at time of claim but fell PAST 12 months whilst awaiting approval so that entitles them to 44% depreciation?
Now 4 days before school restarts I have to find the difference to buy a replacement iPad at $900 because I only have $444 from CoverLESS Insurance, if I had known they were NOT paying the full amount to purchase replacement a MONTH ago - I could have budgeted for it BUT no! And if I take into account their premium of $180 I paid cash for before the trip I am only up by $264 with a whole lot of hassle for $264. 
I even had to drive to our nearest Apple Store (1 hour round trip during school holiday madness) as I HAD to have the iPad assessed as a write off by an actual Apple representative to get paid!!!
I am disgusted - when I called to ask where the rest of the money was as I need the $900 to buy the iPad, the claims officer told me to go back and read the policy then started reciting the policy word for word stating they ALWAYS take 44% depreciation off all electronic items!!!

title: Alternate travel expense claim denied
body:
I accept it was all my fault, i did not read the full 60+ page document before taking out the policy. the misleading summary up front says $5000 for alternate travel arrangements (with no asterisks beside the value) but on page 54 of a 68 page document it says it will only pay if you were travelling to attend a wedding, funeral, 25th or 50th anniversary or conference. Further if you are delayed for a day the claim is only $200 which coincidentally is less than the excess so they would never have to pay that either. My flight was cancelled and I got nothing for the hire car and train fare i suffered to get to my destination. I can only suggest if you do take out this policy be sure you get legal advice on what is and isn't included, Read EVERY single word.  You must understand this policy for example,  personal liability $5.0m but if you have a car accident it may not cover you as it excludes operating a mechanical propelled vehicle, among a long, long list of other exclusions. I suggest you look for alternative insurance providers on the internet, I easily found a better policy for my next travel. Medibank you did not have my back when i need it the most.

July 30th 2018 Update: Alternate travel expense claim denied - "sorry"

Following my post (re:- alternate travel claim denied) and after completing an automated survey scoring them the lowest possible  I was contacted by Medibank. Even this process was difficult, I was bounced between departments and often promised a call back which never came. In the end all they could say was ?sorry?. All I can say is I will NEVER use Medibank insurance again, when you need insurance the most you just may get nothing but ?sorry?.

body: Went to the UK and Singapore on a family holiday. We had booked all accommodation through the travel agent prior to going. The room was on the second floor. We asked to change rooms and hotels (part of a Hotel chain) which was denied by the hotel (fully booked) so we moved hotels to comply with Covermore's PDS. Our claim was rejected on the basis of the room didn't meet standards or expectations of the 3 star hotel it claimed to be and on the grounds of our disinclination to continue or changing of our travel plans.  They refused to acknowledge our concerns regarding the health concerns of mould and fire safety issues of the hotel

title: Horrible Experience With TID
body:
I severely broke and dislocated my elbow during a fall when I was travelling in the USA at the end of 2012. Travel Insurance Direct (TID) was called immediately on my arrival at the emergency department of the nearest hospital, and I assume they took care of the payment as it was never mentioned to me or my partner. The ER doctor told me I would need surgery within two weeks. I was put in a large cast, from just below my shoulder all the way to my knuckles.

Specialty Assist (the company hired by TID to deal with medical issues) said they would not pay for surgery in the States because it was too expensive, so they would fly us home instead. Almost every day we would get a call from Specialty Assist saying that they would book us a flight the following day. But then the next day, they would call to ask us for more information or more faxes of letters, doctor's reports, etc. or they would tell us that they ended up not being able to book a flight for all sorts of reasons. This continued for nearly THREE WEEKS, even though the ER doctor and my check-up doctor explicitly said that I needed to have surgery WITHIN two weeks of the fall. Specialty Assist did not care for my health whatsoever, as long as THEIR doctor said it was okay. The whole experience was horrible and very disappointing. Finally, they booked us flights and we arrived home to Australia.

Here are the dates over which this happened, so you can get an idea of just how long I waited to get surgery while my arm was in a huge cast and I was in a lot of pain:

Broke and dislocated my elbow: 28th Dec 2012
Finally arrived home to Australia: 15th Jan 2013
Was actually able to get surgery: 21st Jan 2013

After recovering from surgery, I lodged a claim with TID for medical expenses, cancellation fees etc. Surprisingly, this claim was handled quite quickly. I got all of my money back expect for the $1300 I paid for our unused return flights. Apparently, they can "use" this amount to offset the amount they paid for our flights home. Although this made me quite angry, I am much more upset over the complete lack of compassion and care for my health and well-being rather than their penny-pinching methods. 

I will definitely not be using Travel Insurance Direct ever again.
The only thing I liked was how quickly my claim was processed.
Everything.

title: Avoid at all costs
body:
I have used Allianz Travel (Allianz Global Assist/Allianz Worldwide Partners) twice. Allianz being (formerly) my preferred insurer for all products, this was a go-to when travelling.

During a recent trip some of my belongings were stolen, I tried to phone Allianz on their "24/7 number" at approximately 5pm (GMT +2) only to discover that 24/7 was not 24/7. 

I eventually was able to notify Allianz while away of what had occurred, the young lady on the phone was very helpful  and assured the process would be very easy and straight forward. It was far from that when I returned. 

I lodged the claim on 23 August 2018 - being aware of Insurance requirements I included a comprehensive level of information about the incident and a detailed schedule of loss regarding what was stolen including proof of ownership and receipts for replacement where possible (this was the significant majority of items). 

I was first contacted by Allianz on 29 August 2018 by email, four days later, advising the claim had been referred to their Investigations team. Confused as to why, I made inquiries to Allianz which went unanswered. I was contacted by the Allianz investigation firm (an external provider) on 30 August 2018 advising she was based in Queensland but would arrange for someone in my state to contact me. This eventually occurred on 6 September 2018. The investigator was a nice gentleman and very professional and whilst clear on what Allianz were asking, was also unclear on what was hoped to be achieved by Allianz. To me, it felt like a deliberate attempt to either refuse or minimize the claim. Following the interview with me, the investigator later advised he would like to speak with my partner (with whom I traveled) and my mother in law (with whom was with me when the theft occurred), two things which delayed the claim again, and again. 

By the 26 of September, almost one month after lodging the claim - I had enough! I phoned the investigations team and spoke with the Team Leader. The TL took time to review the file and spoke with me on 27 September at which time she was extremely understanding and apologetic and had asked the investigator to close the file and return the file to the Allianz claims team. 

I received a call from Allianz on 1 October from Allianz claims (as promised by the Investigations TL) asking me for all of the information I had previously provided to Allianz and to the Allianz investigator (twice), again. After sending this through, I was finally told my claim would be paid. I was relieved it was finally over... I was wrong. 

Of the ~$5k items being claimed, I was informed on the schedule that only ~$3.7k would be paid, despite not being provided any specific information or advice as to why items were short paid or not paid at all. By the time the money was paid to me it was only ~$3k, significantly less than advised (even when deducting the $200.00 policy excess) and significantly less than the claimed amount. The figures simply did not add up and did not make sense! 

When I questioned Allianz on this on 4 October, I have still received no response. I am extremely disappointed in Allianz and would not recommend them to anyone planning to travel.


***Update: I finally received payment in full from Allianz on 23 October which resolved my claim in full****

title: I was in a Bali hospital 2017 and Travel Insurance Direct were fantastic to me
body:
In February 2017 I was in Bali in a remote area and hospitalized for 3 days with a severe bacterial infection. When I was told I had to stay in overnight I was upset and scared but I knew my condition was worsening so I had to have medical attention. I was scared because I was travelling alone and never had to use medical help in Bali before. I found it so easy to google TID at that moment and called their 24 hour emergency line from Bali on  my iphone. As soon as they answered they were fantastic. I had to only quote my reference number and name and from that moment on because they knew I was alone in hospital I was asked by them if I was ok and if I needed to speak to one of their doctors or nurses and if my medical care was to a good standard and if I was being looked after. TID emailed me every morning asking if I was okay and checked on me and my health. Naturally, I was stressing about the hospital cost as  I didnt budget a medical bill as part of my holiday, and they contacted me direct and phoned me and said given my situation, they will pay the hospital direct for my hospital cost and reimburse me any other costs previous to being admitted that day. What a relief! 
No joke, on the phone each day when I touched base with them or emailed they were so friendly and helpful, and I could relax and just focus on getting well enough to fly home. I am glad I took my passport, flight itinery and  travel insurance doc to hospital with me because I handed them over the hospital and they and the insurance company TID sorted it all for me with ZERO hiccups. They even made sure I had a comfortable flight home and I was so relieved that I had a spare seat next to me. TID also emailed assuring me for the flight home which I had to change the date and this was also covered in my insurance. I paid $60 for 2 weeks and this gave me full cover. It was only the second time I had used these guys for insurance and after this experience in Bali in a small practice I had the best care and I was SO comforted knowing my TID Insurance people  truly looked out for me and made me feel everyday in hospital that I was a high priority 
TID if i have not already thanked you and your team enough, I can only continue my thanks once again. I was delivered a service that went beyond my expectations, and I will only ever insure with TID for any holiday here on because your care and personalised service was world class. Its scary travelling alone in a developing nation, and you took all  ,y fears away because I knew if anything to do with my medical state at the time or care was questionable it was so easy for me to call or get hold of you. TIDs email responses to me were also personable and comforting and responded within hours of not immediately. I could not have asked for better service. 
If you are confused or not convinced about who to insure your travels with, I hope my review helps you decide to choose these guys after my illness in Bali and after being put into hospital there. This is a review based on my own first hand experience just recently. Best $60 travel insurance I have ever spent with just a $200 excess, well worth it. I am getting better now, and once again TID I cannot say how much your team made my stay less scary there knowing I could call your doctor and nurses and talk to them if I was worried about anything while in hospital. Your staff had great English language and such great people skills when dealing with me and the hospital. I am no longer scared of getting sick overseas when I have now experienced the gold star effective and fast help these guys delivered to me. I would have been in a bad place without you TID, please thank all of your staff who were involved in my medical care to get me home. Thank you again and again. 
Brooke Chapman.

title: I'm speechless. A 2 week wait to get a TID email - "Your claim has been declined."
body:
Jetstar cancelled my wife and I flt fm HCMC/Changi/Auck. Jetstar rebooked us 4 days later. They left msg of change on my mob (NZ no) while we were abroad. But because I had to report to work on time in NZ (military), I had to make desperate alternate return travel.  Jestars' rescheduled flts were ridiculous. Although in the end, Jetstar reimbursed most of the return ticket cost, the difference between the Jetstar refund and what I had paid in alternative travel was in excess of $1000 NZD.  What made things worst was getting stuck in HCMC Airport, Vietnam where locals speak limited english and are not too concerned nor prepared to go out of their way to assist foreigners.  This only added to the frustration of departing.  
I rang TDI on return to NZ and they knew that I was looking at seeking reimbursement of travel tickets. TDI front line staff should have advised me straight away words to the effect "Sorry no one is covered by cancellation of scheduled transport services caused by the carrier.  Best you try claiming everything from Jetstar and by the way thank you for your premium".  
Notwithstanding, the bottom line is, I guess that I was so naive to skim over my 42 page policy cover document, thinking that "cancellation of flights" must surely be rated up there with loss, damage or injury, as incidences definitely requiring cover whilst abroad.  I cannot be the only one that has fallen into this TDI clause.  I'm speechless and very very disappointed,  It takes TDI 2 weeks to form a 10 minute email to advise that my claim has been "declined".  Maybe that is why TDIs' premium is so cheap and attractive - "Too good to be true".  I should have stuck with SCTIs'  19 page policy cover document, who although has a higher premium, would have provided full cover in this case, had I opted for them.  
I shall not seek travel insurance cover with TDI again, as they do not, in my opinion, provide full cover. The premium substantiates this.  Nor will I recommend TDI to my frequent flyer  travelling companions, friends and work collegues.
Question for TDI - Why is cancellation of scheduled services not covered?

II guess you need to read the exclusions.  Naive I was as I thought cancellation of flights would be rated up there as a most likely event to occur requiring cover.  Yet excluded from this policy.  I'm speechless.  Maybe that is why the premium is so so cheap. Should've stuck with SCTI.

title: Failure to honor Claim
body:
My Tiger Air Flight was cancelled back in January 2018, due to a technical fault of of the Aeroplane and no other flight from Tiger Air was available for me, Tiger Air only offered  a refund in two weeks. We were left Hi and Dry at Sydney Airport, I was with my elderly mother and young daughter, we live 181 kms away from the Airport. 

 I had hotel rooms and activities booked and paid for over the next few days in Queensland, I needed a new flight. I had no choice but to fork out and pay for new tickets to Queensland through Virgin. I had to pay $690 dollars for the new flights, believing Cover-More would cover me due to it being a cancellation out of my control.  Tiger Air has since refunded their Cancelled tickets of about $320 and I claimed the difference of ONLY approx $370 through Cover-More.

I was of the belief  this insurance policy was to cover "Cancellations" Cover $10,000- as was stated on the Certificate of Insurance, I received. Not so easy.

Cover-More kindly denied my claim due to the Cancellation being the Plane having 'technical issues,', 
I believed I was covered for cancellations up to $10,000, and not certain TYPES of cancellations.  

After wading through various Cover-More web pages and PDS and other pdf's, searching through the fine print it so blatantly convoluted and confusing.

Now I am becoming learner-ed in Travel Insurance, I am for warning friends and family. I was going to use Cover-More for my next trip this year, I seriously don't think I will ever be doing business with Cover-More again.  

I am left out of pocket $390 circumstances beyond my control.

body: My wife and I have just recently travelled to china. On departure from Hobart airport our plane was delayed for engineering problems .Quantas placed us on another connecting flight which meant we reached our destination 12 hours late. This meant we lost one nights accommodation, we also paid for the extra leg room on our flight and had also pre paid for a cab to take us to our hotel once in Shanghai. The cost of our lost  was $350. I would also like to add that we were placed on a lesser air line company than Quantas .We were un able to sit with each other on our journey and to make things worse my tv on the plane did not work so i had a long boring trip. We received this travel insurance through the flight centre when we booked our flights. At no stage did they explain to us the legalities of this policy, we naturally assumed with travel insurance we were  covering  these types of things. Not the case, cover-more sent out a letter 7 weeks later and said they dont cover anything other than a airline strike with the policy we had. This i feel is just not right. We take out this travel insurance policies in travel agencies thinking they are looking after our best interests while having a holiday. WRONG, so the morel of this story is cheek into there scam policies and read the 10 pages of fine print.

I applied for cover and sent the paperwork before the date of our holiday March 7 as I was hospitalized on the 5th. I was told ten days until payment. After not receiving the payment promptly and having time off work I called and was told my payment would be in my account by the 17th. Then I was emailed on 21st to send more forms from my gp?? which cost me $110 to get the gp to fill out! This is after sending two forms from the hospital doctors clearly stating I was unfit for travel. I faxed their medical certificates, with further docs all stating how unwell I am and they say they received the fax on the 24th but still no payment it supposedly takes another ten days to process this info. I was involved in a car accident last year and was covered within two days. So obviously this has been annoying service. Not to mention the people on the phones don't tell you anything except your claim officer will look at it ummm why can't we speak to an officer about our claim ourselves? I hope this is resolved soon as the added stress is not helping my recovery.

title: Seamless Claim Process
body:

I filed my claim on 6th Nov for reimbursement of flights and accommodation costs due to cancellation of my trip, courtesy of a burglary at my place where the burglar stole my passport and few other things. 
I called OTI and informed them about the situation. I was then sent an email where I had to document reason for cancellation and provide evidence such as police report and flight itinerary. I further received an acknowledgment email about my claim followed by a phone call confirming the claim and its aspects. Exact 10 days later, on Nov 16, I had been refunded the flight costs and accommodation expense less the applicable excess ($200). 
Hence, I will recommend OTI without a question!

While in Switzerland, I started to develop fever and 2 independent medical practitioners suggested, with a consultation at the day of my dad's funeral, a 10 minute surgery to remove a lesion. Two medical practitioners in Australia had given the green light to travel to Switzerland and the small procedure was scheduled on 24 OCT, three months later.
The panel - I am unsure who is on the panel - refused my claim in the area of $1300 due to the technicality of a precondition which two medical professionals in Australia categorized as not urgent and gave the green light to travel and have the lesion removed 3 months after my return to Australia.
I am not going to argue with 1 Cover Travel Insurance, only looking for a new service provider where I have a peace of mind, also when assistance is required.

As I have had experience with ear infections and I am aware it is dangerous to fly with them I thought I would call covermore to see if they had any advice for me (as I was able to get any medication I needed over the counter). My phone reception was poor as I was in a bad wifi zone so the phone kept cutting out but everytime I called back I spoke to the same woman who was able to quickly direct my call back to who I was talking to. I was put through to an Australian GP who conducted an assessment over the phone and recommended I needed to go to see a DR to get clearance to fly. I was in a small town and the medical facilities were not a western based standard *and the doctor in South America said I would be fine) but I knew different as the Australian doctor knew my symptoms and because of this I went and sought out an ear, throat and nose specialist who provided me with different medication. I had peace of mind that I was ok to fly and if it wasn't for covermore I would have just settled with the local doctor and not even thought about finding an ear, throat and nose specialist.  I was able to claim for this so I was not out of pocket and it was so nice knowing that I could call them anytime and be able to speak to a great team of people. THANKS :) and will highly recommend you to others!

Covermore is one of a number of travel insurance companies that do not cover a customer in the event of an airline , travel agent , rental agent  etc, etc ,etc becoming insolvent or cancelling a booking as of a ( word of special meaning) clause .Perspective customers of Covermore need to read the PDS statement in particular the special words of meaning and clause 23 of the policy. I would encourage people that are looking at travel insurance to purchase a policy from a company that includes any cancellation of travel in the future due to these clauses.

title: Future Credit - BEWARE
body:
Considering Insure and Go?s offer of future credit? You will find the offer hidden away after you log on to your account
BEWARE: The formula for the offer treats everyday from the day you purchased the policy until the day you were scheduled to return as the SAME RISK. The RISK in the days BEFORE travel is only cancellation. The time you are away accounts for ALL other sections of the policy. Clearly the most expensive part of any policy is overseas medical. Clearly your actuaries have come up with the SIMPLEST formula not the FAIREST formula. My high school maths students could come up with a more equitable formula.
In my case I took out the policy from Jan 21 to travel from June 18 until July 15. A total of 175 days of which 28 are overseas. The calculation takes the 62 days up to March 22 when the government introduced level 4 travel bans and gives me (175-62) out of 175 days credit. Each day being at equal risk.

From my $1137.77 policy I would get a credit of approximately $741.17 to go towards my policy to travel next year. I am assuming my policy cost is going to be greater next year so I am going to be out of pocket a minimum of $396.60 for a policy that I did not use.
My alternative is to, instead of rescheduling my holiday as offered by my travel providers, cancel my holiday and forfeit my deposit. For this I claim back $1417.20 less my excess.
I am $200 worse off. Insure and Go is $1217.20 worse off and loses my future business.

Not actually a very ?AUSTRALIAN? offer in these times of hardship.
I would like a comment from Insure and Go management rather than the standard ?[name removed]? response.

On three occasions they claimed that they were waiting for replies from myself, our GP, and our travel agent, but all three of us had not received these requests. When I informed them of this, the reply was an arrogant " well we sent it"  This was typical of their attitude on most occasions. 
I could detail so many more unpleasant incidents with this company in this review, but many of them have already been written by other previous exasperated customers on this site. Which boils down to the fact that Cover-More need to take a serious look at their customer relations program.

20 weeks of frustration, waiting for replies that did not come, Talking to brick walls with bad attitudes.

title: God Help Travellers Who Are Relying on Allianz
body:
I have developed an eye condition while travelling in the Greek Islands - almost impossible to get specialist treatment. I managed to stumble onto an ophthalmic surgeon who spent more than an hour to diagnose my condition, and provide immediate advice and assistance, and things to watch out for which would require immediate specialist attention - the worst, retinal detachment, an eyesight breaker!, I phoned Allianz Emergency Medical Assist line - reverse charges it says. Ha, ha, no it is not. I am up to nearly $100 in phone calls so far. I advised my frightening symptoms in detail, but all they were immediately interested in was how much I have spent on medical costs to date, how much in travel to date, where I am and what it will require to get me home. No concern at all about my well being. I have spoken to four paper shufflers so far (except for the first one there has been no human element in terms of compassion, acknowledgement of my fear, or predicament, so that is all I can think to call them), and very briefly and in my first contact to Allianz, a nurse who was kind, and advised that the doctors advised that I would need a medical clearance to fly. The nurse noted that they may need to organise treatment somewhere here before flying. I provided the required clearance to fly, but have heard no more from the nurse re flying, or local treatment. It is now 24 hours since first contact and I have had no further medical assistance or comment. Now the paper shufflers. We will email you details of the case and case number, we will telephone you and keep you up to date, we will send you details of an allocated case manager - no not the person I spoke to in the first place, but a medically trained person who will manage it. I am still waiting for that one. I have received no phone calls what so ever, and not one email without me chasing it. Every time, even when I requested them to confirm receipt of critical documents I was requested to send. It turns out, when I finally called, that they hadn't even bothered to open the emails, let alone action them. I was requested to send details of the doctor's report, and who he was (a British trained and working ophthalmic surgeon who spends his summers in Corfu); a copy of passport, etc., I was asked about health history - 42 years of comprehensive global travelling including 3 other trips this year (where I was relying on Allianz, phew!) and this is my first time ever to ask for help or claim; I have my eyes checked by an ophthalmologist every 2 years and have only mild distance prescription; top health cover for 41 years and the only claims in the last 3 or 4 years at least, is dental. The issue I have is a known, instantly happening eye problem, common in folks my age. Its symptoms and diagnosis are very clear cut, according to several articles by British medical services and the British Royal National Institute for Blind people. It has nothing to do with existing health, it is just bad luck and age. Doctor [name removed] spent more than an hour examining my eyes multiple times, using a number of drops, including dilators, to reach his diagnosis. He was patient and thorough, and sat with me with a clinical model of an eye to demonstrate what had happened. He advised me of how to deal with it immediately, things not to do, and the things that I needed to watch out for. The diagnosis is clear cut, like appendicitis. You get it, or you don't. But no, not with Allianz.  Doctor has not provided enough information for them to be sure that it is what he has diagnosed. He has not provided symptoms, or heath history, they will do no more without it. And this is the medical emergency assist. Wow. I have described my symptoms in great detail. It is very obvious that my eye is not normal. There is something seriously wrong, and needs attention. Allianz, get me home where I can be properly diagnosed, treated and monitored. My eye is in trouble. But, no, that would be too reasonable, wouldn?t it? They claim for my ?safety?. Are you serious? Where is the safety? I have a full diagnosis from a qualified specialist, I have provided detailed symptoms of totally abnormal eye behaviour, the specialist doctor provided written medical clearance to fly, and I am sitting on a tiny Greek island (my travel itinerary as moved me on from Corfu) with very basic services. Allianz you don?t give a damn. You don?t contact, respond, you don?t do anything. You don?t even provide a reverse charge service as noted on your website. And this is your emergency medical assist service?

November 15th 2018 Update: Haven't Even Lodged a Claim, But Allianz Have Knocked it Back, With Conditions

I haven't even lodged a claim for a cut short holiday yet, or a dispute about my claim (how can I, I haven't lodged the claim yet?). BUT a Dispute Resolution Officer (who couldn't even spell my name correctly, until I noted it), has 'completed the Internal Dispute Resolution (IDR) review of your claim and dispute, and my final decision letter is attached to this email'. How can he do this when I have not even lodged my claim yet - I am still receiving specialist attention? 
It has been knocked back (but hey, I have not lodged it, and he acknowledged this, and refers to, 'my dissatisfaction with the outcome of the claim' no, Mr, it was my dissatisfaction with Alianz's response to my complaint about Allianz's initial reaction to my contact with Allianz.  It gets worse, folks, the statements below were included in the letter. Money and shut up, it appears.
'Although your claim has not yet been received and cannot be assessed under the policy, in an effort to amicably resolve this matter, AGA is prepared to offer you as a gesture of goodwill, settlement in full in the amount of $250.00.
In accepting this offer you agree to not take any further action against Allianz Global Assistance in any external dispute resolution scheme, court or tribunal in any jurisdiction with regard to this dispute. You also acknowledge this agreement may be used as a bar to any action, suit or proceeding commenced at any time against Allianz Global Assistance regarding this claim.
Further, you agree that you will not (except as may be required by law) disclose any of the terms of this letter to any person and will not make any public comment of any nature whatsoever with respect to the terms of this letter without the written consent of the Insurer.'
Mr Dispute Resolution Officer also advised me that I have a limited time to respond to this letter. I state again, I have not lodged a claim yet.

title: Cannot recommend 1Cover highly enough!  Just brilliant!
body:
1Cover was recommended to me by my daughter in law after I had related to her a previous horrendous experience with another large insurance company.
The 1Cover policy was so easy to do online and it was not expensive, very good value I thought.
On my recent trip to Siem Reap in Cambodia I was given as gifts a painting done by a traditional Khmer artist and a hand sewn cross stitch picture of a peacock. Both were framed and behind glass.  They were packaged by an art dealer and marked "Fragile" and "Top Load Only" but unfortunately they were smashed in transit on the return trip to Perth.

title: 5 star reviews, 1 star reality
body:
A large percentage of OTI 5 star reviews are people submitting reviews based on how easy it was to obtain a policy. It?s 2019, of course it?s easy to log onto a website and enter a few details. 

You have to scroll through large amounts of useless uninformative reviews to find ones where claims were submitted. Well here is one. 

I purchased a Comprehensive policy, believing it was exactly that, comprehensive. When you sign up to the policy you agree to have documents emailed to you AFTER paying for the policy. 

Long story short, I had my hire car broken into overseas with my laptop and passport stolen. The only refund I receive from OTI was $3.79 for the cost of my Emergency passport less the $200 excess. They did not even refund the $293 it cost me to replace my passport in Australia. 

If you scroll to page 32 of their policy there is a line about items not covered in vehicles. 

It?s not the fact the items weren?t covered, it?s the fact they advertise the policy as comprehensive yet it doesn?t cover theft from a vehicle, which isn?t overtly advertised by OTI yet hidden on page 32 of a document. 

Many many travellers will go between destinstions in a car and will have equipment in the car. Basically what OTI is saying with their policy is if you?re overseas and stop for lunch make sure you take all your equipment with you into the restaurant / shops because you won?t be covered if it?s stopen. 

If the vehicle was unlocked on a Main Street you?d understand their policy, when it?s locked and secured inside a motel and the windows were smashed to get inside the car, different story. 

Please make sure you all ready their large disclaimer document word for word. I can guarantee you that OTI is not the best travel insurance out there. Since being informed of their outcome on my claim I extensively reviewed their policy. Their coverage when you inspect the documents and break it all down is quite poor. 

The whole process of putting in the claim and receiving information was long and drawn out and the staff members I spoke with lacked any form of empathy. 

My first and last time using OTI or any Allianz affiliated insurances.
