title: Customer service and claims let this company down, look elsewhere for better!
body:
I have been a loyal customer of TID for at least 6 years, but after 2 experiences with their claims departments, and multiple interactions with customer service, it's time for me to do my research and move on to something better (and going by Choice and plenty of other review websites, there are a lot better, and cheaper out there!).
The first instance that lead to me having to make a claim was after i broke my ankle in Bhutan. The nurse that i dealt with was great, very compassionate and understanding, and the fact i could talk to her over WhatsApp made the whole experience much better than i had been expecting. However, when it came time to make a claim in regards to my broken ankle, that's where customer service let her down! I emailed through my claim as i had been told to do, to the email address i was provided with. After waiting a month and hearing nothing back, i got in contact with customer service. They told me nothing had been submitted so i sent them a copy of the email i had sent with my claim. They then told me i had sent it to the wrong email address, so i sent them the email where i had been told by an employee of TID to send it to the particular address. Within 24hrs i had an email notification that i would receive my refund, but no further communication from customer service.
In spite of the above i was willing to write it off as a one time error from TID. I have consistently praised them on travel groups i am a part of on social media, however after my recent encounters with the company i can not in good conscious continue to do that, and will instead be warning others to steer clear of them. All it takes is a google search to see that there are higher rated, and at the same time better priced, travel insurance companies out there.
My recent experience with them has occured after i got robbed and injured while i was in Tanzania (losing my passport, phone, etc). After contacting the emergency area of TID, i was told that they couldnt help me because i had attempted to extend my policy, but i hadnt yet paid for it. Never mind that the reason i wasnt able to pay for it was because their site wouldnt let me (it kept timing out!)! When i explained that, i was passed off to customer service to try and fix the issue. The guy i was passed onto was unable to fix the issue, and when i tried again to pay for the extension, the site completely deleted any record of the extension, so i emailed customer servide to let them know, but to this day i have still not had a response to that email. I eventually had to purchase a new policy to cover me for the extend dates i was in Tanzania.
As there is no Australian embassy in Tanzania, i had multiple issues with being able to cross the border into Kenya to get an emergency passport. I asked for guidance multiple times as to what was acceptable under my policy, but never really got a clear answer. Adding to this was the issue that most things in Tanzania are paid in cash, with no receipt, so again i asked for some guidance on how to deal with this so as to ensure i would be reimbursed for the costs i was incurring, and again there were no clear answers. Surely i can't be the first person they've dealt with in situations like this?!
I am currently waiting for my claim to be processed, but based on the questions i received from the claims officer on Day 9 of their 10 day service standard period, i do not have high hopes. The questions seemed to ask for things i had already provided, were not well written and also quite confusing. I got the feeling that they are trying to delay any payout to me, and also try to decrease the amount they pay out to me. I have stated repeatedly that i am willing to sign any legal documentation they may have to verify the vailidity of the amounts i am claiming for, but that always seems to get ignored.
If you choose travel insurance companies based on the expected level of service you'll receive from both customer service and claims, you should definitely look elsewhere. There are also other companies who provide better prices. Based on my research, TID prices are only remotely competitive because they always offer discount coupons. But, their service definitely falls short of their prices!

body:

I then required monthly hospital check-ups for the following 12 months. We have used them twice,two seperate holidays,making one claim.We were due to travel to Bali for one week in January 2011,these plans were cancelled due to my brother committing suicide several days before we were due to leave,my brother was not travelling with us nor did he have a policy with TID,all we claimed for was the cost of changing out flights to another date & half the cost of our accomadation which was held by the hotel booking company.
This claim was flatley refused even though clearly stating in there policy that they pay for claims for cancelation due to unforseen circumstances,because my brother committed suicide they rejected the claim,it was a $630.00 claim.
After numerous phone calls to them & non returned calls from them,many arguements later,I contacted my solicitor & the media (60 Minutes & A Current Affair) who were willing to air this story,I spoke with Ian Jackson,the general manager of TID & explained to him what I was doing about the claim & he finally agreed to pay the claim out of good will,funny that,bad publicity & legal action.
I as a human being am totally shattered by the inhumane dealings from this company,even though they finally paid,the claim was not settled,but it was written off as a good will payment.Please be very careful dealing with this company.
Cheap for a reason.
Typical insurance company - all claims denied initially - fight to get claim payed.

title: My Claim Took 3 Months & Was A Simple Domestic Claim !!
body:
Never will I ever touch this insurance company again! I had insured with them for some years & yes it so easy to get a policy but trust me making the claim was a nightmare!!
My claim couldn't have been more simple but it took 3 months with so many phone calls and emails I lost count! You don't get a direct claims case manager call line. You call the insure and go number and it goes through to some overseas customer number where you have to go over all the details over and over again before they say they can transfer you through to Australia. But then when you get to be transferred the claims person you want to speak to isn't available to talk to. So you request a call back which you never get then a few days later you do it over again with no success again! When I sent emails to them, they bounced back as they were having problems with their emails so the problems just went on and on. 
My claim couldn't have been any simpler but they made me get constant paperwork from my doctor. Initially I had to go to the doctor to get everything they wanted in paperwork. But instead of asking for it all in one visit, they kept wanting me to go back.  I had to have emergency surgery for a non pre existing condition and my claim was for a simple small domestic tour in Australia. It wasn't expensive, my claim should have been completed in no more than 2 weeks but it took 3 months. I had no medical background to be screened and no pre-existing injuries or illness.
They were horrible to deal with and had no sympathy for me or any customer service skills. I was home recovering from surgery and the way I was dealt with was no excuse.  I would rate their customer service skills as the worst I have ever experienced anywhere. 
Trust me, go and insure with another insurance company. Don't get a policy with insure and go!!! Since my claim, I have taken out another 3 travel insurance with another company that was recommended to me a friend. When you make a claim, all the claims are dealt with in Australia and calls don"t get diverted overseas. You have a direct number for your claims manager too.
Thanks for reading my review.

I was asked to supply doctors notes from specialists I had never visited.  Even the initial claim form assumed that it was a pre existing condition.  Didn?t once ask if it was unrelated to prev. Illness or pre existing.

The USA hospital provided me with about 40 pages of notes as to illness and treatment. This mentioned it was not pre existing.  All supplied to the insurance.

After a further 2 doctors visits to get relevant documentation (one an extended consultation) and over 3 months later, my claim was approved again after the 10 day wait.
I am still waiting for my hospital deposit to be returned nearly five months after paying it.

I have since had over 5 weeks on hospital and major surgery.

Not very happy with the process or lack of contact.

title: Be Careful When Booking Cover More Insurance Through Medibank
body:
We booked a cruise to the Carribean on the 22nd January and after being offered travel insurance by our travel agent decided to shop around. My girlfriend searched the Internet and ended up at Medibank Midland Gate on the 3rd February where she was advised to purchase an insurance policy with cruise cover, cancellation and medical cover.  Once she got home she checked the product disclosure statement and read in the small print about infectious diseases and also if the coronavirus became an epidemic or pandemic that there would be no cover if we were to contract the virus and require medical assistance. She returned to Medibank on the 6th February (3 days later) to query the small print and was handed a letter updated the 6th of February with an original issue date of 23rd January (a letter which she hadn't sighted) basically indicating the policy worthless in regards to medical in relation to the caronavirus and cancellation because of the caronavirus. The women at Medibank said she thought that we should still be covered because we bought the policy before the 6th February but said they can't deal with the policy in store as they are only an agent for the insurance company and to call the number on the bottom of this letter to get clarification. She has called the number on numerous occasions placed on hold for an average hour and a half to 2 hours and each time since the 7th February when it sounds like it's connecting it states there is a problem and disconnects the call. We returned to the store last week and spoke with the Manager and she said because the policy was purchased after 23rd January we wouldn't have any cover and the girl who sold my girlfriend the policy should have given her a copy of the original letter dated 23rd January which would have helped her to make an informed decision and had she received the letter we would have declined the policy.  Conveniently the girl that sold her the policy doesn't work full time in the store and their system doesn't allow for them to know who uploaded the policy as there was no name attached.  We asked the Manageress to contact Covermore on our behalf and she said she couldn't call them and we would have to keep on trying as she didn't have 4 hours to waste sitting in a queue on hold. We got rather irate we were very disgruntled that although they sold us the policy instore and were quick to take our money they had no control over changes or any means of contacting Covermore directly and said she would send an email to ask them to call us, that was last week. Today Monday we still haven't been called by them after trying to get through all weekend so I rang again this morning as soon as they opened and I was placed on hold again for another hour and a half and then disconnected again. We once again returned to the store very irate and once again we were  told that we would have to speak to Covermore. The Manageress sent an email on our behalf but couldn't say whether they would be in touch in 5 days or 4 weeks she also wasn't sure if we would get all our money back as a refund or some as we were now outwith the cooling off period due to Covermore being unresponsive and could only apologise for the girl who sold us the policy that she hadn't given us a copy of the letter dated the 23rd January. So Medibank sold us an insurance policy for $525 on the 3rd February but were already aware that the policy would not cover our needs for medical cover or cancellation for the caronavirus. The policy was misold to her and she wasn't made aware of current DFAT updates at that time she also assumed we would be covered but would need to speak with Covermore and were not given the opportunity to cancel the policy during the cooling off period of 14 days because they couldn't cancel it instore and we were unable to discuss this policy with anyone at Covermore up until today's date and no one has made an effort from Covermore to contact us. The cruise company has already offered us a cruise credit for 100% and more than likely we will be offered a full refund at the beginning of April after the likely cancellation of the cruise with further compensation. I asked the Manageress of the store if Covermore had called for a conference call with Medibank to explain the process and wait times for customers and when we would likely hear back from them and she said they hadn't received any information instore. So the dilemma continues and currently we are awaiting contact from the insurer but with no idea when. If we haven't heard from Covermore within the next fortnight with an apology and a reasonable outcome we will be contacting the insurance ombudsman to raise a complaint against the company. Will update this site once we receive a response from the Insurer. Some feedback for Medibank if you are going to sell insurance just as an agent you need a better process and a procedure so the women who sold us the policy can be identified and held accountable for not disclosing critical information in the current situation when purchasing a policy. No letters were readily available for customers perusal on desks or window area when we purchased the insurance or on the 6th of February or when we attended the office last week and I made a point of asking where that information was displayed and on our return to the store today it was readily available and displayed for new customers on their front window.  

Alastair Gillingham

I waiting another few weeks for a reply, that they would settle the claim. After receiving a confirmation letter stating this I noticed the payout figure was wrong. After waiting on hold for 50 mins I was told I was wrong after I tried explaining the amount I was hang up on. I phoned again and waited a further 50 mins to be told to put it in an email that was on the 21/2/2017. I attached a letter from my travel agent clearly stated the amount paid so not sure when I paid extra for no excess what the problem would be. Two emails later I am still waiting on a reply or confirmation.  Can't believe a claim can take so long.

March 7th 2017 Update: Still waiting

Wrote a review last week. Covermore respond with sorry will send you a private message and guess what I am still waiting. I guess they just respond to make themselves look well guess what are not.

body:

(read the 1Cover "fine" print!) My example, hired a car in Brisbane (w/o extra rental car company insurance at the time of hire)... the car suffered hail damage and I was up for the repair cost. !!! 1Cover "cover" covers an "excess" from the rental car company but if you don't have rental company insurance in the first place, there IS NO EXCESS, it's just a full liability on your part!!! Beware!!!  1Cover would do well to "highlight" this "gotcha".

body: One of the travelers became very ill just three days before the travel, it was very disappointing and unfortunate.  She was not sure if she would cancel or would delay the trip at that stage.  I called the Insurance Company before the travel commenced and asked for an instruction. The officer said "to get a medical certificate". It was on Friday and we were relieved that she found a nearby medical clinic (too ill to visit a regular doctor) which would open late and take a casual patient. The doctor wrote "she has a medical condition and will be unfit for travel".  Eventually she could join the trip four day later. We made a claim and we had the full claim amount (less excess) back.  When lodging a claim, we were told to spell out the medical condition. As it was that doctor's last day, it was very difficult to chase the doctor. Luckily, the clinic's other doctor wrote a more detailed certificate. I have rarely made insurance claims (once long time ago I claimed for a lost camera), and I was glad I had purchased the insurance policy of this company. If being instructed "to get a detailed medical certificate" at the beginning, I could have given the rating "Excellent" . My overall experience was pleasant and I would like to use this insurance company again and recommend to others.

title: Training for call centre and claims officers
body:
This is not the first time I have used CoverMore and it is some years since I last used this brand. However, this time I have had a claim and apart from the initial call to inform them that I had to cancel travel plans, when they were helpful giving instructions about how to complete a claim form online or by ordinary mail, I have been given the run around +++. It was not possible to complete the claim online because of a site glitch first up, after which the claim was completed long hand and posted. I received several "no reply" automated notifications following my follow up phone calls to see what progress was being made with the claim and receiving new instructions about required outstanding documentation.

Each time I asked for and forwarded the travel agent's documentation to CoverMore, I have discovered when I have made another call to see what progress was made, I was asked to contact the travel agent yet again because the terminology was not definite enough. Finally, I have asked the claims officer to dictate the wording that is required to move the claim along to be chastised for "not listening" to her helpful advice.

Given that I have made at least six phone calls to CoverMore and 3 to the travel agent who has sent 3 e-mails to endorse my claim, at my request the claims officer dictated the exact wording required. If this scenario does not support the need for training for call centre and claims staff, I do not know what does. That phone calls are recorded and never listened to is inefficient in the extreme. I was even sent a satisfaction survey before the claim has been concluded!! All I can say is I am glad I was not stranded somewhere overseas. Come on people, premiums are not sale priced and therefore adequate training and follow up should be "de rigeur".
Ease of purchasing policy
Whole claim processing procedure

title: Dragged out my claim
body:
The service was terrible. 
I felt like the company was constantly avoiding and then questioning things. The feeling I got was that they were hoping I?d just give up because it was all too hard to continue with me claim. 
Everything was by email and upbeat even when I?d messaged and was obviously very unhappy. 
When I tried to call the service person assigned to me she was on holidays and the replacement never returned my calls. 
I was expected to have my paperwork in within 30 days of the return to Australia yet the company took almost 3 months to process it. 
My flight had been canceled by Jetstar as had many the days before and that night.
I understand this must be costing insurance company?s a lot of money so I get their frustration with a company that cancels when their flights aren?t full. 
It was very obvious it wasn?t ?technicalities?. 
But I too was frustrated and had genuinely, in good faith, bought insurance and as such should have been assisted without being made feel I was ripping Insureandgo off. 
An example of this was when I was asked about whether I?d left the country because my insurance ran out the day (following) my original due date when I?d been forced to pay another company for a ticket. I had already stated my 30 days allowed visa free was up on that day and as such I would have overstayed my visa and been fined. 
It was Bali a very common destination for Australians and I would have assumed an insurance company would have been well informed about visa requirements in Indonesia. 
Apparently not. 
This really upset me. 
My claim was finally settled after I threatened to go to the office of Fair Trading and the Ombudsman. 
This should happen and 
I will never use the company again

Louise Brennan

title: To Zika or not...
body:
Less than 24 hours before departing on a South Pacific cruise we were informed by the Cruise liner that Zika had landed on the islands we were going to visit. Being 17 weeks pregnant, we were hesitant to proceed and ended up cancelled within 10 hours of departing. 
While the cruise liner had been exceptional in offering us a 24 month credit due to the unforeseen circumstances, we submitted an online claim to Covermore to justify why we weren't able to use the credit provided in that time (due to other personal health reasons); and Covermore covered the entire cost! 
There will always been fine print however if you book your insurance when you book your trip, and make sure you include an amount for cancellation costs then you will be fine! 
I have used Covermore previously, and also have an existing condition in which requires me to complete another small assessment in addition to the usual information- however Covermore have always been so easy to work with, quick to respond to queries, and were so efficient and effective in the entire claiming process, I will be sure to continue to use them!

title: Medical and hire car cover
body:
During my last trip to Europe (July - August 2016 6 week period) I visited 7 countries and had a hire car for the duration of my trip. My son cut his head open and needed to go to hospital to get stiches. I had to initially pay the bill as it was a amount under $1000.00. Upon lodging the claim with Cover-More all my money was refunded to me within a 5 day period. Excellent service and speed of processing of claim.  With the Hire car I had hired through Hertz Car hire whilst in Europa a rock hit the windscreen and smashed the front windscreen of the car. The windscreen was not covered in the car rental agreement so I had to pay about $780.00 to get a new windscreen fitted. Hertz was good to deal with. My insurance policy with Cover-More covered my excess payments on the rental car. Upon filing the claim online with Cover-More I scanned all relevant paper work in. 3 days later they asked for one extra piece of paper work, and 3 days later I received full payment for the windscreen.
In summary I am very impressed with the level of cover in the Cover-More travel policy, their price on their policy and the speed in which they processed and paid the claims I had. I found Cover-More to be excellent and have used them on 4 previous occasions (but did not have to make any claims until now). I will definitely be using Cover-More again as my travel insurance company. My wife has one occasion used a different company for her travel insurance and had to make a claim, and there was no end of delays and excuses for not wanting to pay. With Cover-More there was no delay, no excuses, there was professional and clear communications. I can only thank Cover-More for their service and am happy to recommend them as travel insurer for anyone needing travel insurance.

title: Great Insurance
body:
Were there for me on the other side of the world when needed.
Worked with the hospital for a week while I was there to ensure all went well.
Were very reasonable with my claim even covering taxi fares for my wife to visit me and phone calls.
Paid very promptly on arrival back on Oz.
My only choice for a travel Insurer.

title: Not helpful at all when I had a problem.
body:
I have used TID several times and when there are no problems with trip I am happy as purchasing cover is straightforward.
In the past 12 months I have had 2 problems and the company were not much help the first time when my luggage was delayed by 2 days. I had to deal with everything myself and got no assistance from TID. As my bags eventually turned up I was happy and used the company again as it didn?t seem like a big issue.
The second problem was much more serious and again TID were not helpful. I was stranded in SFO at 3am after a flight cancellation and  airline had allocated all the rooms they could arrange. After contacting TID, all I received was an email with references to a bunch of clauses under which I may be possibly entitled to make a claim. This was not the response I expected after dealing with other 24 hour assistance contact lines on policies I have had from other companies in the past. 
I haven?t even had a follow up to check if my needs had been met, just the system generated welcome home email with invitation to review.
Terrible customer service....obviously zero interest in helping travellers...just taking money in premiums.

title: Flying high and far, but feel well covered for any unforeseen eventualities.
body:
Have read the recent reviews concerning Cover-More, however can only report very compliant and helpful staff concerning  medicals bills over $700 , all of which were promptly  reimbursed after I presented all required documents.

No  company can insure for everything and it's up to the individual to check the entire coverage before taking out insurance I's say.

I'm very satisfied with Cover-More and can absolutely recommend this company .

title: Quick processing of claim, friendly staff
body: I took out cruise insurance to cover my mother and myself for a 11 day family cruise.  A week prior to cruise my mother fell and broke her hip and required a total hip replacement.  Rang company to find out process for claiming cancellation as could no longer travel.  Spoke with a helpful, friendly Australian who emailed claim form.  Nil issues with processing claim which was paid no questions asked in a prompt manner.  Will definitely use again.

title: Lets see!
body:
The policy seems to be good value, and was easy to organise.

I guess the proof of the pudding will be in the claim process as we found it necessary to lodge a small claim for a tyre blow out on the rental car.  TID came recommended to us from a close friend, whose daughter had to make a claim and they said that TID were terrific.. It was lucky we took the cover, as we may have had a major claim. I slipped on a wet travellator, before even leaving the originating airport, and badly sprained my ankle. I suspect it would have been  enough to cancel the whole trip, as I was wheel chaired to the planes, from there, and had difficulty in walking for over a week, and indeed after 3 weeks still have swelling in ankle

I assume thee will not be any issues with our claim, although I did find the claim requirements a little cumbersome and unnecessary, and the online claim system, had a few minor shortfalls, that were sorted in one quick and easy call to customer support.

title: Good. Just wish it would store my information so I do not have to input it each time!!!
body:
Reasonable value.
Convenient to fill out online and questions are straight-forward enough.
I understand the need for the detailed questions. However, there needs to be a "member" area for storing a profile.
Never used Customer Support and hopefully never need to! (ha ha).

title: Excellent service
body:
Response to my claim within a couple of days excellent service, claim form easy to complete, very satisfied, policy was excellent value
second policy with this company for travel, will be using again next year.
Patricia Hambour

title: Returning customer
body: I have taken out numerous policies and fortunately have not had to make a claim.  I use InsureandGo because the website is very user friendly and explains the cover in clear detail.  The price is also very good.

title: Ross&Toni2012
body:
We were very happy with the coverage and service right from the first contact we made with the TID office via the internet and also on the phone. My wife has a pre-existing condition and she found the medical interview, via telephone, to contain very logical and relevant questions handled in a courteous and professional manner by your representative. My wife's pre-existing is not considered to be medically extreme and was treated as such by TID in assessing the coverage and appropriate premium. (as seniors we found some other travel insurance companies virtually require a letter
from HM the Queen to even consider a pre-existing condition!). We had a very enjoyable extended holiday to UK and Europe and most fortunately we did not have any claim arising from our seven weeks overseas.
The easy to use website, the client friendly approach to coverage of a pre-existing medical condition, and excellent follow-up after ariving back from our holiday.

title: Great service
body: Policy was great value. Had to make a claim and the process was very easy.  Payment came through quickly. Highly recommend and will use in the future for all my travel.

title: Had everything I needed.
body:
Best value product found after shopping around so that keeps me happy.
I always end up with Allianz even after shopping around amongst the 'cheapy' 'unknowns'.
Allian researches very well in reviews so I have peace of mind.

title: Cannot give this company a rating!!  Not 1 Star - more like 0 out of 5
body:
My husband and I were flying to Hawaii on Wednesday 13 May and of course due to Covid 19 we are unable to go. We generally go overseas every year and up until 2020 insured our travel with 1Cover. This time we decided to use InsureandGo on the recommendation of a friend. The policy was well priced and covered existing medical conditions. So we were happy with our initial purchase UNTIL travel bans were put in place due to Covid19. We were able to cancel our Hotel bookings (free cancellation) & have taken a credit for our flights with Qantas as we hope to go to Hawaii in 2021. I emailed InsureandGo via their website in early April asking if it was possible to receive a refund or partial refund of the $447 paid for our policy OR receive a credit to use at a later date when we were allowed to travel. I am still waiting for a reply from INSUREandGO!!
At the end of April I telephoned InsureandGo and spoke with a Customer Service Rep. I asked the same questions as I had in my email earlier that month - refund or credit?  In fact I asked many questions to which the answer I received was No, No, No! .... and yes they quoted those lines about the 14 day cooling off period.  [name removed] from InsureandGo, I note that you have responded to some of the complaints on this site (all much the same as mine). I would love to hear from you. However, at this stage I will never use InsureandGo again. If it were not for Covid19 we would be on that aircraft next Wednesday looking forward to a wonderful holiday. Not our fault that we are unable to travel InsureandGo. Your customer satisfaction is rated as a absolute zero!
Janette & Stewart Terry

title: Peace of mind travel
body: Policy was easy to set on line,this is my preferred method. Very competitive price. communication was excellent after setting up policy. Policy wording in my opinion seems straight forward and clear.

title: Our go to Travel Insurer
body:
Have used InsureandGo, for that last 8 years that we have been travelling to either the USA or South East Asia.  The policy is always competitive, especially with listing your medical conditions. The application is straight forward and easy to apply.
We have never had the need to make any claims, but from other reviews, they all seem straight forward.
Highly recommended.

title: I like to be insured when I travel , which for me is quite a rare event.
body:
I felt the policy was competitive .
 Yes it was easy to set up and when I realised I  may not have  covered my needs I called back to increase it,  Easy.
 I was hospitalised a couple of weeks before I was due to fly out . Customer service were very kind,  thoughtful and reassuring that under the circumstances I would be covered if I  took a risk and  continued as planned or had to cancel ,  In the event I was able to go and stayed well so not necessary to claim anything .
 I  therefore  cannot comment on how efficient it is to make a claim

title: I always use this product when going oversesas
body: I have used this product 4 times in the past and i. Happy with their service i would recommend to friends and family

title: Good to have backup
body:
I didn't need to use the policy but it is good to know it is there should I require it.
The website and the setting up of the policy is easy to use.

February 5th 2018 Update: Full refund on expenses incurred from stolen passport

Very thankful to have TID when my handbag was snatched resulting in an extra 4 days stay.
All expenses incurred in getting an emergency passport were refunded when I put my claim in.
I would have felt way more stressed at the time if we hadn't had insurance to cover the extra expenses.

title: No tried to made a claim and wouldn?t except
body: Once and never again, tried to claim lost phone and didn?t except claim due to it blocking number, my telecon transferred instead of blocking due to business connected to this number

title: Damn if you do and damn if you don't
body:
Policy wise it's a good value and easy to purchase via internet.  Never had a chance to call their customer support.

Can't really rate if they are any good as I never make a claim.  Am not really a believer of insurance as it easy to take your money but it's hell when making a claim.  It's a case of damn if you do and damn if you don't.

title: Paid my claim... eventually
body:
I had cause to make a claim for a missed port on a recent cruise. I submitted my claim only to have it rejected. The person reviewing the claim had not read my claim and supporting documentation properly and it was only after I requested a review that they approved and paid the claim.
In saying that, the process was simple and once approved, payment was prompt.
I would still use InsureandGo again.

title: $200 of the best stress relief before departure...
body:
Easy purchase well in advance...online discount was a bonus.
One of us had a medical emergency just before departure...while this policy removed about $7000 of worry, no claim was required, fortunately.

title: An excellent online Travel Insurance
body: Was really easy to set up, definitely good value and when I had to contact Customer Support they were extremely prompt to get back to me and rectify my query.

title: Good experience
body: Used Insure and go for the first time on a colleagues recommendation. My husband had a fall on ice on the 5th day of our holiday and fractured his ribs. After incurring 1600 AUD in medical costs we submitted a claim online. After just a few emails with the claims officer our claim was accepted and within a month we received the funds.

title: Declined policy
body: Wow.  I have just been declined a policy based on a pre-existing condition which the policy precludes insuring anyway.  In the past I've been issued travel insurance to cover medical and other emergencies which arise separately to, and are not affected by the pre-existing condition (from 1Cover in fact).  Suffice to say, my private health insurer (Teachers Health) was willing to provide travel insurance - slightly more expensive, but accepting!  I won't be transacting with 1Cover in future, and will warn others of its discrimination.

title: Always use 1Cover
body:
Easy to deal with. Straightforward online application. They provide cover for all our needs with high limits for areas of coverage. 1Covers's rates are very competitive - after checking other rates we end up coming back to them.
The only claim we have made from multiple policies was handled promptly and as expected.
Plain english conditions. Value for money.

title: Easy affordable and safe
body: Glad I didn't need to use the cover although the typhoon and we were in the same country. It was good to know if we had a change of plans we were covered. I also want to say it was the best quote with better coverage than the other offer I checked out.

title: Very efficient!!!!!
body: We have used InsureandGo for many years now (probably close to 10 years) and do 2 to 3 overseas trips a year.  Very unfortunately we have had to make a claim 3 times over that period.  The efficiency and attention via phone calls has been outstanding.  We have always had a person on the end of the phone within hours of being admitted to hospital.  I would NEVER change my travel insurance from InsuraandGo.  I feel very safe as a family having this insurance company covering our trips.

title: Trip to South Africa
body:
Best value travel insurance around while still being comprehensive. Very easy to set up. Obviously not making a claim makes it easier but previous experience with support has been very positive.

October 5th 2017 Update: Feeling covered skiing in New Zealand

Back safe and sound, no claim to make thankfully but TID makes everything so easy, they follow up, keep you informed and they are the best value in the market. You'd be mad to go anywhere else!

title: Great value
body: Simple and easy process and friendly staff. Product was very convenient and suitable for my travel needs. Self sufficient and easy to follow steps made it easy to compel eye the process

title: Perfect price
body: Budget direct was Great value and easy to apply for. This was my First time using budget direct. I didn?t have to claim for anything this trip but will 100% use them again.

title: Thakyou for making it Easy.
body: I was recommended by a friend and it was Very easy to get the cover i needed for my holiday. Would recommend to my friends when the go on holiday.

title: Dissapointed.
body: The polici is not good value. Read your policy very carefully, the fine print excludes a huge criteria. Not a happy customer and will not use 1 Cover again unfortunately.

title: Good insurance for what I wanted. Good price too.
body:
Was easy over the phone to set it up. Very informative lady helped me to finalise this insurance.
I had a claim some years ago and this took about 2-3 months to finalise.
 
I have used this company at least 3 times.

title: Unhappy customer - even before the travel
body: Cover more was recommended by my cruise P&O. I took the policy and the staff was good. Things nose dived when I called back today to make a small change to the "excess" for my insurance. The call centre staff sounded very arrogant ( 29th April around 5:20pm) my original plan had $100 excess and just wanted to change it to $0 excess by paying the difference. As per the agent that was not possible and I will need to cancel the whole policy first plus I will need to make FULL payment for a full new policy and then wait another 3 to 5 working days for the refund of my first policy , which I find very inconvenient and not a very customer friendly policy by cover more. If the staff was curtious and polite in explaining this, I would still have taken the new policy. Just for making a small change in excess if cover-more is making this much fuss , God forbid, I wonder how it will be in an event of claim .. I hope management takes this feedback constructively. Thanks PV- Auckland, New Zealand.

title: Worse than Terrible
body:
I suffered a serious injury while overseas and was moved to a specialist spine injury  hospital by helicopter. My family at home contacted Insure & Go to get assistance for me & my friend. We were on our gap year. Insure & Go were useless. They couldn't contact the hospital as they told us they couldn't find the phone  number. My family found it by a Google search. They told me to move hospitals as it would be cheaper, I had a spinal injury & couldn't move & they were confused to which country I was in which ment the information they gave me was incorrect. They provided no assistance at all to me in hospital, to my family at home or to my friend who was on the same policy who was stranded with hardly any money. 
They denied my claim, we complained to insure & Go and ended up with the Ombudsman. It took over a year but insure & Go were forced to accept my claim and pay me with interest. It was extremely stressful for me & my family. 
If I could give them a rating of no stars I would. This company is useless . Avoid them

title: Beware of Covermore/Coverless Insurance
body: Claim not resolved.  Used once before.  No problem then.  Have not been reimbursed for purchases made when luggage stolen.  Sent documentation requested twice & it has been over a month disputing.

title: No worries with Tid
body: I felt my policy was great value. Morso with the inclusions it has as standard. It was extremely easy to navigate and set up. Me and my wife were extremely satisfied with Tid. Thankyou

title: Always best price for comprehensive insurance
body: It is hard for me to give a true valuation of the service as fortunately, I have not yet had to make a claim. However, after comparing several quotes for travel insurance I always come back to 1Cover because they offer the most comprehensive cover for the best price.

title: Claim was hassle-free
body: I have used TID on two separate trips to Bali.  The website was easy to use and the policy was simple to set up. I did not claim on the first policy, but did on the second for reimbursement of medical expenses of approximately $500.  The online claims process was easy and the claim was promptly processed.

title: Recommended!
body:
I have shop around for travel insurance and found 1Cover to be most competitive. The website was easy to use, and take up was super easy even I was insuring my teenage son 15 year old who was traveling with another adult. Some insurance compnay just made it a lot harder when parents were not traveling.
Plus, We made a claim as my son lost his camera during the ski trip, the claim process was pain free, we had our claim finalised in such an efficient manner. Thank you 1Cover!

title: Excellent value.
body:
Excellent value 
Very easy to setup
Customer Support excellent
Have recommended to friends.  Previously had to make a claim and went through without any problems.  Give it a go you won't regret it.  Excellent service.

title: Good experience
body:
Felt reassured throughout my trip that I would be covered - if anything were to happen. 
Would definitely use TID again, good value. Policy was easy to set up, and good customer support.

title: Easy access easy to understand
body: I have been with Insure and Go for quite a while, 15 years?  I have never claimed. But I feel very comfortable with Insure and Go if ever I would have to. I only heard very good news about your insurance and I am a yoga teacher fit healthy and happy even at 68 in 2 weeks time.

title: Very Fast and efficient
body: The policy i took out for travel to Indonesia was very well priced, sadly i had to claim but it was very easy to get in touch via email and they approved my claim VERY fast once i had provided all information required. They were prompt with responses even though they say 10 working days, it was barely 2. Great help, thank you for approving my claim.

title: I keep coming back.
body:
Easy to follow application process, I have used InsureandGo for numerous trips.
Be mindful to read the PDS as with any cover.
Example: RENTAL CAR EXCESS contract duration has to be less than 15 consecutive days.

title: Good
body:
Really good value, I had two claims on one trip (Travel delay - Jetstar lost suitcases, and car rental excess). All got paid for.
Excellent value, pay claim fair and square.
Not really dislike but it takes the maximum of 10 days to process the claim from the claim acknowledgment but it takes almost 10 days to acknowledge the claim.

title: Exelent value for money
body: Easy to down load policy,even for an oldie like me...Have used Insureand go for my last three holidays. The proof will be in the Pudding if I have to make a claim.

title: Good value for money
body: easy to set up, I did make a claim - It took a little longer than my traveling companions who used other insurance companies which was a little frustrating but all in all will use again and claim was easy to do, just took a little while to process.

title: Essential for travel
body: I have migrated to InsureandGo in my travels because they offered an attractive discount for Seniors Card holders. The Price of insurance  was most competitive. Applying online was straightforward. Completing the data related to medical issues was not intimidating and I felt the product was good value.

title: Forewarned - be very aware of small print
body: Just one extremely important fact - I chose NOT to insure with this company simply because of what I saw in the fine print in the PDS - they don't cover you medically at all if you have experienced a bout of cancer in the last 5 years, even if deemed to be clear and a supposedly less aggressive type -  it's not covered by an extra premium - it's just not covered at all - they have a clause in the fine print. Be extremely careful.

title: Great
body: Great people to deal with over the past year  used 1Cover 5 times / Easy to understand and straightforward responses - very competitive prices great value in comparison to well known travel Insurance companies

title: Great Experience of Claiming
body: I had to cancel my planned overseas trip & was very impressed with the service, right from my 1st phone call through to the final refund. The process was clear & concise, the customer support staff were helpful & courteous, and I didn't have to wait in long phone queues. Highly recommended.

title: Service is Appalling!
body:
This company is helpful until you need to make a claim. They will try everything in there power to not pay. I had to wait over 6 weeks to get paid for a claim. Even then I wasn't paid correctly. Definitely would not even consider this company for future trips! Yes real people to talk to with attitude and real problems! The whole claims procedure as been nothing but a big headache.

Bad service, Attitude from staff, No communication, Empty promises

title: Great Value for Money
body: After obtaining many quotes for Travel Insurance from a range of Insurance Providers for our upcoming overseas trip we narrowed it down to two contenders, which were about the same premium. They were Medibank (20% discount applied for long term customer) and InsureAndGo. After comparing the cover InsureAndGo provided far better coverage for many of the insurance items and also we declared that one traveller was a mild asthmatic and after the easy on-line screening (which asks similar questions to other providers) no additional premium was applied. What was reassuring in doing business "on-line" was the quick response time to confirm the Insurance Policy number and also acknowledgment of the payment.

title: Very very bad insurance DONT USE THEM!!
body:
We have travelled all around Italy Greece Turkey and Lebanon for our honeymoon.
I took insurance for anything that goes wrong ofcourse as anyone would.
From Lebanon to Melbourne on our way we had a 2am flight we got a taxi to take us but we got into a car accident then the taxi took our language out of the car I dropped my phone as iam coming out of the car and then the taxi jumped in the car and took off and then the other car that was involved in the car accident drove off to catch the other taxi driver while me and my wife stuck on the side of the road on the freeway no phone and cars doing 110km/h and dark and then we missed our flight I called cover more insurance but said needed a police report. I played $2500 tickets to leave the next day for Melbourne then I went to a police station and tried to get a star deck but police said we dont do that and there is no police for me to call and in Lebanon country the army has taken over now cover insurance won't pay me out and they dont want to no about nothing they said.
I played $600 for my travel insurance and stole it from me the thiefts anything to make money they insurance when something happens they dont care.
I REPEAT ANYONE OUT THERE WHO IS READING THIS DONT USE THIS INSURANCE THEY ARE THIEFTS AND THEY WILL JUST WANT TO TAKE YOUR MONEY THAT IT NOTHING ELSE!!!!

title: An excellent, Professional, Service Provider.
body:
The Policy was excellent Value for Money and very easy to set up over the phone !

Customer Support was First Class, especially throughout the Claim process ! 

There was genuine concern for my well-being after I encountered a Medical Incident on board a recent Cruise, and the Team could not have done more to assist us professionally moving forward on our return trip to Australia.

title: Warning....1Cover are not to be trusted!
body: Policy was easy to set up and customer service team were lovely to deal with. HOWEVER, the COVID-19 pandemic hit and our trip was cancelled. 1Cover agreed to refund our policy (taken out well before the pandemic) as a good will gesture. We were pleased with this and received an email notification advising funds would arrive in my bank within 5-6 days. Funds did not arrive as promised. So I sent an email asking what was happening. Reply I got was that they would look into it for me. Funds still not in account a few days later and no reply explaining what the hold up was. So I sent another email - no response. I tried phoning and after waiting on hold for over 30 mins was told that a message would be sent to the accounts team to follow up on what was happening. I received no response. 2 more emails sent - both ignored. Another phone call made and this time the person on the phone told me she was just the "message service" but would get someone to phone me back that day - no response. I tried contacting 1Cover through Facebook - no response. In the end I got sick of being lied to and ignored so I lodged a complaint with the AFCA. Funds finally appeared in my account today - 34 days later! Will NEVER recommend 1Cover to any of my friends.

title: Felt comfort being with you!
body: Very good customer support. All went smooth even when I had to extend for ten days was easy to do. Thank you and I will book again with your team!

title: Holiday peace of mind
body: The cost of the policy was a small fraction of the total anticipated cost of the holiday and provided cheap peace of mind. The policy was very simple to set up and the customer support person was extremely helpful and had an excellent product knowledge.

title: Okay...
body:
Insure and go was great in value, don?t get me wrong, but in there PDF there are many things the contradict another.
We made a claim but unfortunately when we were overseas we did not see the specialist as we were advised to only seek the necessary medical attention that would mean we were safe to travel home. Unfortunately we were unaware by doing this our medical expenses would not be covered once we entered Australia. Nor was any loss of income once we returned home unless we had been home for 30 days and the doctor still claimed him unfit for work, again unfortunate for ourselves as the injured person has a desk job and could continue working, he was just unable to drive to and from work due to being in a cast, but insure and go won?t cover you unless the workplace also agrees you are unfit to continue your usual role.

Apart from our own learnings with the company, the claims process was quick and stress free and I couldn?t fault the staff I dealt with.

I would use this company again, but I would also now be aware of what I needed to do in the same situation.

title: Great
body: Good value for the money spent and makes peace of mind . Easy to set up it took no time at all to do on the computer , I think 5 times .

title: Excellent, efficient and prompt. Will use again
body:
We booked our trip with Aaron Ainsworth at Student Travel Belconnen, ACT Australia and he recommended Cover More Travel Insurance. At Penn Station in NYC there was an accident and an expensive camera and lens were broken. We had both repaired for a little over 2K and dreaded putting in the claim to Cover More, thinking it would be rejected, but Aaron helped and the whole process was straight forward as long as we provided receipts and proof of ownership of the goods. Would definitely use them again.

JO, Belconnen, ACT

title: Didnt need it .. so it was great!
body: Policy seemed comprehensive fro travel to Asia (China). Gladly I didn't need to use the policy but had excellent followup and support regardless. Would use them again based on this fact alone.

title: So far so good
body:
Good value
Very easy to set up. I set up on line.. good rate
I haven?t used the customer support

title: Easy Insurance Online
body: No claims for the USA trip, but the insurance is easy to apply online and I have heard good feedback that claims were followed through well with this company.

title: Never had an issue but cover has become expensive
body: We have had to claim twice for medical and flight delays and had no issues, Friends also have had no issues with claims. Fast and easy. My only complaint is that they have dropped their mid cover option and this has made the cover ALOT more expensive and therefore they are no longer competitive. I will still book for peace of mind - tried and tested.

title: All too easy!!
body: Initial phone call inquiry was followed up with an online quote. When we had questions regarding existing illnesses we were put in touch with a representative who talked  us through our questions and sent the relevant forms for us to fill in. The quote seemed reasonable and the whole process was easy to negotiate.

title: One star too much
body: I claim purchase protection because i have commonwealth credit card. They refuse it because product which reduce price not on thier catalog but on website

title: Quick response
body: I have used InsureandGo 3 times, including this latest insurance for travel booked for May 2019. I am pleased that InsureandGo don't make a great fuss over minor existing medical conditions (in my case, mild asthma).

title: Easy travel insurance.
body: Happy with how quick and easy this was to setup. I also like the fact that you can reduce the excess on your hire car for a very reasonable price.

title: Very good!
body: The web site is Easy to use,   the contents cover the things for  what we want,  it really suits our family needs.

title: Perfect
body: My first time using this insurer would recommend for all travelers will definitely use again quick simple and the best price by far

title: Excellent
body:
Great insurance for travelling anywhere and price is great too. Have checked them against the others and they were the best. Website is so easy to use and if you have to call the customer support line for anything, they are always nice and very helpful. Highly recommended.
Great coverage and very affordable.

title: Comprehensive
body: Policy was good value and I will utilise coverage again in my future travels! Was easy to set up policy and all services were sufficient and met my expectations. Thank you.

title: Nothing but fights.....
body:
In brief, wife fell ill while in California...We went to a hospital and she was diagnosed with a bacterial infection which called for out patient drip for three days plus specialist doctors to nail down the diagnosis.  The bill was about $12,000USD.  First cover was informed immediately and called every day to keep in the loop.

I had to pay about $500 out of pocket for scripts etc. (medicine is super expensive in the USA).  Wife recovered within several days.  When we returned, I submitted my bills for reimbursement minus excess which was done within a a week.  BUT First Cover delayed paying hospital and doctor bills for more than three months which resulted in debt collectors calling us up in the middle of the nigh wanting payment.

I was totally unimpressed with the way the claim was handled.  Sorry First Cover...but you let me down big time.

title: Absolute Joke
body: WORST INSURANCE COMPANY EVER. DO NOT USE THEM. Had to cancel our trip to Nicaragua due to political unrest and tried everything to get a refund prior to lodging a claim. I provided all the necessary information and followed everything they asked for in the policy and they rejected it based on the fact that the status of travel on the smart traveler website didn't change. In other words people, your lives do not matter to this company.

title: A MUST for travel
body: My policy was excellent value compared to other providers and was set up in a matter of minutes. The tripwise app made things a lot easier with phrase books and policy details etc all in one location. I will use TID again and have recommended to other travellers.

title: So much for brand loyalty
body:
We agree with Stephen's comments published last year.
We have been with Medibank Private for 39 years. We used Medibank Travel Insurance out of loyalty on a number of occasions. The true value of a company is only realised when you need to make a claim. What a wake up!
Took 12 weeks to finalise a straightforward claim. Communication is poor and the constant-will get back to you in 10 days- only adds to the processing time at each step of the claims process. Very Disappointing.

title: The Best and easiest way to arrange travel insurance.
body:
We have used this group on many occasions and found it meets our needs. Have made one claim which was hassle free. Still have one policy arranged for this year.
Only possible disappointment that when I turn 75, insurance with this great group may not then be available.

title: I am insured and go to go

title: Finally getting a refund
body: To be fair I have come back to change my rating from 1 to three. Finally after months of writing to 1cover, [name removed] (their underwriter), and consumer affairs the lovely lady on the phone [name removed] told me the money is coming back to my account.  Other companies took three days (AIRbnb, klook) and they take three months. The worst thing in this saga was that they said jobs had been lost. So they keep the money and then lay people off. Well it seems they now want back into the industry? Why take so long? Just return the money - a few clerks could do it in a few days? Or even automate it after a certain date? I certainly hope all get their money back now. Not just those that press for it. I thank 1cover for finally seeing the light. If you are in the insurance industry just be ready to get back to people much faster than this. Even higher premiums to make sure this never happens again. I would rather pay $20 more on the premium and have an answered phone call than go through all this fighting. WHEN WILL AUSTRALIA REALIZE ABOUT REAL CUSTOMER SERVICE?

Maybe if we had had to get all the flights paid for Medibank might not have been so good. 
Now I think about it they did say if the claim was over $1000 they would need my husbands regular GP to send in a report. Which I thought was abit strange for a bout of  Gastro.  The claim was under $1000 and they paid it quickly. After reading all the horrible reviews I was wondering if I should purchase this years travel insurance from Medibank. I took out the same travel insurance for my daughter and she has had money stolen. So maybe I will wait and see wether they pay my daughters claim.

body:

body: This is the third time we have used insure and go for our travel insurance and the second time we have had to make a claim. Both times we were treated fairly and swiftly. Would highly recommend and will always use this company for our future travel insurance.

title: 0 Stars is too many
body: I submitted a claim for a damaged suitcase and was asked to send through a number of documents and information. I have sent through several emails asking questions about the documents/info required which have gone unanswered. I submitted what I had and didn't hear back from them. I called through and spoke to the claims staff at least 20times over the last 2 and a half months and keep getting told that they will escalate the claim and have someone get back to me with an update (Spoiler: they never have). I got an email about a month ago stating that "my claim had been solved" and that they were not going to offer me a settlement but I could dispute this. I have disputed their decision and was told I would receive a response within 15 business days. Needless to say, a month and a half later, I haven't heard back from them either and when I call the claims department back they tell me there is nothing they can do other than tell me they will escalate the matter. There is no number to call the dispute department directly and they can't transfer me through to anyone. It is an absolute joke of a company and I won't be using them again.

title: Pre existing conditions covered
body:

body: Having made claims in the past for health, loss and theft, with fast and complete satisfaction, we always use Allianz to give us peace of mind should anything go wrong.

body: the policy was of good value, exceptionally easy to set up, and I have no complaints re Customer Support as the only contact I needed to have was during set up.

title: No claim, unsure how good insurer is. Well known name though.
body: Easy to set up, competitive price. I guess you only know how good your insurer is when you make a claim and we are not making a claim. Will use again if price is right.
