body: Policy components offered were good value in comparison to others.  The policy was easy to set up. I didn't need to contact customer service because I didn't have any claim but friends told me of great support and understanding when they made claims.

title: Oldies travel also
body:
Value, ease of application and complete peace of mind. First stop next time.  Allianz is value fir me because I have all
Of my insurances and now travel with the company

title: would never travel anywhere without my travel card.
body:
have only used travel card once, but would never go any where else cheaper than others, easy to set up.
we had our travel agent get our insurance before but not anymore.

title: The young lady 'catilyn' was a credit to your company (I ran and requested cover for r trip)
body:
I was more than happy with my service from Allianz, I ave home and car policies with Allianz. I don't want to write any more, thank you  tho. Stop already

February 5th 2018 Update: Excellent

Very happy, We again used Allianz travel and were very happy with excellent service provided by there team member (apologies cant remember her name she was excellent in providing information an guidance)

title: Disgraceful
body:
WARNING about losing your luggage.Read your disclosure statement very carefully because when you are trying to claim lost items they will deny you for almost everything. Even though the summary says-
Luggage & Personal Effects
Luggage & Personal Effects: Cover for replacement of luggage and personal effects stolen, lost or damaged during travel. This includes luggage, personal effects, camera, spectacles and computer.
When our laptop was LOST they said it was 'unsupervised'. Claim denied.
Scammers if you ask me

title: Peace of mind
body: Yes the policy was good value. Online application was simple and good communication from Allianz was given throughout. I have used Allianz travel insurance twice now and I intend to use it for all my future holiday trips.

title: Very happy with TID
body:
Although I didn't need to make a claim, I know others who have. Their experience with TID's easy and supportive processes is what convinced me to switch to TID.

The prices for signing up was easy and they were significantly cheaper than my usual insurer.  And I've never before been asked how things went and encouraged to claim if needed!

title: The claims process was very smooth and easy
body: Very satisfied. Very good communication. The whole process even from purchasing to claiming was very user friendly. The people on the phone were lovely and very helpful. I will use 1cover next time I travel.

title: Worst customer experience. If I could give a negative rating I would!!!!!
body:
Policy was purchased through the travel agent, standard cover. 
Customer service is absolutely disgraceful.  I had to cancel my trip due to illness.  It has taken nearly 8 months to resolve. I continued to contact Covermore by phone and email and nothing was done.  I provided all of the material several times.  I kept calling and calling and I was told lies.  I pulled them up when someone finally told me that no-one had been looking at the matter for 6 weeks after a staff member left.  It took them 4 plus months to get my medical records all because they did not obtain the invoice to pay the Dr for the records.  The claim was accepted and I was finally paid partial refund.  Gosh I hope the phone calls were recorded for training purposes!

You call and can't ever get to speak to the claims handler you call wait on hold some times in excess of 30-40mins only to be told the claims person will be in contact by email.  Every time you send something through they take 10 days to respond but this is after they acknowledge receipt of the email so this could be 3 weeks at a time.  You have no direct contact with the claims handler which is the worst part of the process.  Had I been able to speak to this person I would have known what they were doing and I believe the claim could have been resolved many many months ago.   I made a formal complaint and I was supposed to receive a call from the complaints manager - still waiting for a call back months later!
Worst experience ever and I will never ever purchase insurance with Covermore again!

title: Worked well, reasonable price
body: This was first time I used Allianz. It was easy to set up. I didn't need to claim. It was cheaper than other companies I had quotes for and recognised that my asthma history was no reason for an increase in cost.

title: Excellent
body:
Policy was great value and very comprehensive and easy to comprehend.
Easy to set up and took very little time and effort.
I am very satisfied and would recommend to other travelers.

title: Misrepresentation australia post are not a travel insurance company
body:
I purchased this insurance from auspost travel insurance because of their reputation little did I know I would be shunted of to a company like 'covermore".
I gave my medical details to someone purporting to be from auspost I paid my money to someone purporting to be from auspost but when I had a claim where were auspost nowhere to be seen I was to my shock and horror dealing with covermore. A Company in the news for all the wrong reasons and I would suggest struggling for business having to trap customers under the auspost banner
Never again with aus post for anything and absolutely never covermore.
So beware just make sure who you are dealing with

title: Happy customer.
body: This insurance was easily dealt with over the phone, due to my age factor and information that they required. Value was good, very helpful staff that gave explicit details of the terms and conditions.

title: Never travel without it
body:
My husband and I recently travelled overseas, we weighed up whether to buy insurance. We were surprised when obtaining quotes how expensive it was going to be.
After searching numerous sites I then looked up Budget Direct and was very pleased and surprised that the same cover could be bought for a fraction of the price. 
Don?t chance it buy insurance.

title: A must have
body:
We didn't have to make a claim, but we had the peace of mind that we did have travel insurance.
Going on another holiday will be trying them again.
Thank you!

title: Never again!!
body: After 8 months of fighting over a claim when my husband took sick overseas & had to attend a hospital overnight. Put in a claim & was rejected because my husband had had an operation for a complaint over 10 years ago, they said it was a pre existing condition. He is not on medication for any reason. We love to travel but will never use this agency again.

title: You have to be extremely stupid not to buy travel insurance.
body: I always buy Allianz travel insurance.  Sometimes I do think I waste my hard earned cash.  Until recently my five years old daughter had an accident while we were in Singapore.  Not only the insurance covered almost AU$50,000 medical bill but also providing great support for my family.  They checked the hospital and doctor making sure we have received the right level of medical attention.  Thank you so much Allianz.

title: Sneaky Company!
body:
I will tell everyone I know what a bad company this is.  Through cheap tickets.com, I purchased round trip tickets for my 90 year old mother and I to travel to see family...(you never know at 90,when it will be the last time).  Because of her age, I bought Allianz travel insurance and did not read the small print.  Shme on Me!  She became ill and could not travel, so I put a claim in for the $623 round trip tickets.
Allianz denied my claim since my mom had a previous condition that flared up and kept her from being able to travel.  I thought that was what it was for!!  I am sad beyond words.  Of all people, we cannot afford to lose this money.  Times are tough, and I thought I was doing the right thing.

title: Excellent Service!!!
body: This is the 1st time we've used TID and will be using them again. All the service extras such as the reminder notices, helpful hints, the app you can use and even the Welcome Home message and checkpoint for claims give this product the edge. TID were recommended by a work colleague and I would recommend them to others.

title: A wonderfully easy way to insure our trips.
body: After using another company for decades, we tried Insureand Go and found it to be truly good value and a wonderfully easy way to insure all our trips.  There are no hassles and if you answer all the questions truthfully, then you have complete peace of mind that no matter what happens, you are covered.  It is so nice to deal with a company that trusts in you for a change.  Hence, we have used Insureand Go for our next trip and will continue to do so.

title: The Only Travel Insurance I Use
body:
We have used TID many times and used again recently for a 6 week trip to USA & Central America - the price is extremely competitive and although we had no need to claim this trip we have claimed previously for illness and baggage damage and the claim process was painless, efficient and settled immediately. We have recommended TID to friends and family and they have also been very happy with the product.
Inexpensive, easy to use and easy claim process

title: Covermore THE BEST
body: Have used Covermore before but this time I made a claim. The payment was in my bank account less than 2 weeks after I made this claim which was due to illness on a cruise ship. Excellent communication provided peace of mind. I would highly recommend and use Covermore for further travel. Thank you.

title: A very good travel Insurer
body:
I have used insure and go many times now !
I have made only 1 claim which was deal with very well ! 
I would recommend them to anyone 
Their price is very fair

title: Couldn't fault InsureandGo
body: From start to finish we only encountered helpful, friendly staff.  We had to make a claim and had only polite, efficient staff during a dreadful time for us.  The claim was resolved in full in 5-6 weeks.  This is the second time we have used InsureandGo  and have already recommended them to friends.

title: Cannot travel without travel Insurance
body: Good value and very easy to do on line.  This is the 3rd time I have used this company. I cannot give a review in relation to a claim as there has not been any occasion during my travels to need to lodge one.

title: Quick and Easy Process
body:
It was an easy process to obtain a quote that suited all of our needs. 
My husband has diabetes, so it could have been a complicated process to nut out the particulars, but this was a simple process. 
We didn't need to claim anything so I am unsure about that side of the process.

title: Poor On Claims
body: HI due to illness I had to cancel out my trip. I sent the forms and details in to you by certified mail on 26/8 as of 16/9 your claim section cannot even tell me if you have the documents or how the claim is progressing. As a loyal customer with many polices and no claims I find this unacceptable.

title: We always choose Allianz Travel Insurance when we travel overseas.
body: Policy was good value.  Easy to set up.  We did lodge a claim a few years ago and were pleasantly surprised by how quickly we were reimbursed.  We've used the insurance company for the past 3 overseas trips.

title: Good cover
body:
We have 1Cover frequent travel family insurance cover. Our family off 5 had booked a holiday to China that we had to cancel because a relative has been diagnosed with cancer. 
ICover have been great to deal with and the claim was paid very quickly.
We where out of pocket over $4500 after all of our airfares and tours where refunded and this was paid back by 1Cover. 
I was impressed by the ease of the claim and would recommend this cover for any family.
easy, good value.

title: Used it for second Time No stress , No Fuss just pay n go !
body: Full comprehensive cover for family , Price was reasonable, even cheaper than other online insurance companies. Piece of mind knowing its through a well known Australian Insurance company  ... Second time using Online Travel Insurance .. Would recommend

title: Extremely helpful customer service staff
body:
I had a few queries about this policy and the people in the customer service section made sure that everything was explained in a very clear and concise manner. 
I was very impressed.

title: Fantastic
body: We didn?t have to use our insurance n the end but we thought we would have to claim at one stage. after making a call to enquirer what to do we were continually contacted to ensure everything was ok. Thanks so much, we will definitely use this again on our next trip..

title: Easy to buy, terrible shocking service and coordination when you need to claim - almost dead waiting
body: Don?t use this company! Call centre is somewhere in the world, English is their second language (no disrespect to those trying to earn a living) 0 star for claims when loved ones life is in the balance

title: Right price, easy to apply and change
body: The ease of applying for and purchasing a policy was very good. And the price was not too expensive with seemingly good cover which is what drew me to it. Making changes was simple, too. I realized that I had initially gotten a policy that didn't cover my whole trip but I went online, changed the finish date to the correct one, paid the difference, and the problem was solved. I did not need to make any claims so I cannot say whether their claim process is convenient or fair.

title: Medibank Travel Insurance came good when needed
body:
I have used Medibank Travel Insurance for my last three overseas trips, and have not needed to make a claim until this year.
My trip to Isle Of Man TT, due in August 2020 was cancelled due to Corona Virus and my travel company has a 'No cash refund policy'
Medibank Travel Insurance assessed my claim, with some delay due to large number of claims they had to deal with, and finally repaid all of my travel fees except for the $250 excess which I chose on my policy.
They kept me informed of my claim progress throughout and answered all of my queries.
I will certainly use them again for my next trip.

title: only a fool would travel without it.
body:
During a recent trip to Mauritius my wife suffered a heart attack, fortunately we got her to hospital just in time to save her life.Just as fortunate was the fact that we were covered by CoverMore.They were fantastic in their response to my pleas for assistance.They immediately covered all medical & surgery bills, plus the bill for extra nights accomodation. Most importantly, this was all done by their wonderful staff in Sydney in a most sympathetic and helpful manner.
On returning to Perth W.A. CoverMore also settled my out of pocket expenses in full.
Everything, great peace of mind

title: Very efficient service
body: The claim was handled through emails and responses were forthcoming with minimal delays. Staff were sympathetic to our claim. I would not hesitate in recommending InsureandGo and will be using them for subsequent travel.

title: "24/7 assistance" is a blatant lie!
body:
Contacted Cover-More seeking assistance with a medical emergency overseas... it's been 4 days and I'm still waiting for their "24/7 in-house emergency medical and travel assistance team." to get back to me. It doesn't matter now as I'm back in Australia and have been forced to seek treatment locally. 

Go somewhere else for travel insurance. This company is a joke.

Edit: Received a reply 16 days later after originally contacting apologising as they had a "high volume" of messages and my case was closed. I guess with so many people not getting responses that's to be expected.

title: Peace of mind
body: Great to know you are always covered. Nothing went wrong so that is also great. Always use Allianz as I can trust an Australian based company. Checked around and is the best value for money.

title: I have waited more than 4 weeks for a simple stolen phone claim providing all the documents
body: The customer service people treated me like a criminal and were rude. I imagine they are trained to try to reject all claims and not believe their customers who make genuine and legitimate claims. Typical of an insurance company.  I wont use again. Cheap does often mean nasty.

title: Excellent all round.
body:
On our recent family holiday to the Gold Coast, I used my new iPhone to video and take pictures of the kids splashing about in the swimming pool and on the water slides. My phone was in a brand new waterproof case which turned out to be NOT so waterproof. An emergency appointment at the nearest Apple store the next day confirmed that the phone was "damaged beyond repair" and that the nature of the damage was not covered under warranty. Needless to say, the stress levels skyrocketed because I had recently purchased the phone outright.
The 1Cover claims officer was wonderful and very helpful,explaining what I needed to do. Even though claims are usually resolved within 10 business days of being lodged, my claim was accepted and the money deposited into my bank account on the 6th day.
I always take out travel insurance for my family when we go on holidays,but this is the FIRST time we've ever needed to make a claim.
Thank you 1Cover for helping make the best out of a bad situation!!
With competitive pricing, excellent customer service and now the knowledge that they ARE reliable when needed, no need to look elsewhere for travel insurance.
Based on this experience, our travel insurance is all sorted for quite a few holidays to come!!!!

title: Shocking Experience
body: Shocking experience. Pregnancy complications forced a cancellation however a letter provided by OB was not sufficient. They wanted a GP letter instead. Due to moving cities we didnt have a GP for longer than the required 12 months as they needed to verify this was not an ongoing medical issue. Sorry, what? A specialists letter isnt good enough? Joke. The entire cover is less than impressive and the experience with the claims team terrible.

title: If i could give no star ratings i would -
body: the absolute worst customer service i have ever experienced.  Policy seems so nice and easy to purchase, but when actually needing a claim to be put through they are the worst! Lack of communication between claims managers and customers. I had to contact my claims manger nearly every week to see if they had received additional documents / supporting evidence and not once was i emailed or contacted when they said they would. They have finally approved my claim after  A MONTH of going back and forth. I would strongly recommend researching policies beforehand and also make sure whatever you own that you have photos of yourself with the object ?? (Advice given from my claims manager to ensure full payment comes through) I hate writing negative comments but this was needed.

title: Can?t go without it.
body:
My policy was necessary: comfortable to have a coverage, good value and very easy to set up.

I have always travelled with this insurance under the privilege of ANZ VISA PLATINUM card for many years (previously with QBE) right up to the age of 80 years.

title: Travel insurance
body: Booked online. Very competitively priced. Needed to extend our travel dates, which did not cause any problems, just a slightly higher price, as expected. Fortunately didn?t need to use the insurance, but comforted during holiday knowing we had it. Hired a car on holidays, and this insurance covered the excess if involved in an accident. Again, luckily we didn?t need this, but was very pleased to have it included.

title: Have had good experiences
body:
I regularly purchase insurance with TID given their competitive prices and level of cover. I haven't personally needed to make a claim but one reason I keep going back is the experience my mother had a couple of years ago. I purchased a policy for my mother and was glad that I did. We did some traveling overseas together and then I returned home for work while my mum was planning to continue on holidaying for a little longer. Unfortunately she had a fall and needed medical attention. TID were awesome with assistance while she was overseas and then when claiming upon her return. I will keep using them!
Reliable, competitively priced, small discounts for repeated patronage

title: Unsatisfied / Stressful
body:
I booked flights to the Gold Coast for Christmas for my wife and myself but had to cancel early this month due to my 93 year old mother in law suddenly becoming unwell, possibly dying. I have the claim form to submit for a refund of flight costs, but Cover-More wants mother in law's medical history to see if it is due to a previous illness. Commonsense needed here with elderly people's health. This is all happening at a stressful time for us and Cover-More has not shown any compassion. Lots of phone calls and emails without success.  Was told to submit claim form with the information I have and will be contacted if insufficient details are given.

January 5th 2017 update: 
Extremely disappointed with my claim being rejected when I had this valid reason for canceling flights. My mother In-law was placed in the hospital rehab unit in mid October and by early November she had fully recovered. I then thought I would book flights to the Gold Coast to visit our daughter for Christmas. But by late November my mother in-law had a relapse and went back to hospital. Her condition worsened and was not expected to live long.
I then advised the travel agent to cancel the flight. I then submitted my claim to Cover-More, plus several emails and phone calls asking them to show some compassion. My mother in-law passed away December 22nd and have had to deal with her loss, and now the rejection of the insurance claim. So much for "good old Aussie spirit"(not). It goes to show there is no compassion from this insurance company. $330 is a lot of money to lose
so I definitely don't recommend Cover-More.

title: criminals
body:
so last year the partner and I thought to our self lets have a nice little wedding in in late April/ early may, hired a beautiful 12 bed villa costing close to 9k Aus for the venue in bail, 
got canclation cover insurance through Cover-More Travel Insurance back in October, just incase anything happened, now they won't cover anything, so looks like not getting married anymore and just throw the last 2 years of saving away. and with 2 little boys 3 and under, and some member of our family in the high risk zone for the coronavirus, the lovely people at cover more would rather we put the young and elderly at risk rather the payout anything, insurance companies a crooks, the lest they could put on a balaclava's and try beat me for my money lest I might have a change of keeping some of it

body: Policy easy to set up. Should start a loyality program, where the customer receives percentage discount for multiple travel policies. I have used this company several times now with no claims but we do not receive any discount. Traveling again in July, but I can see that there are several other companies now offering the same deals for a lot less???

title: Usually great
body:
The support was excellent, the result disappointing. Wanted to cancel policy due to last min cancellation. Policy purchased tgat day. Called emergency line )ot was after hours, who could not cancel but asked me to call on weekday. We tried to get new flights. When I called to cancel on the weekday, the policy had already started. There was no log of my Friday night call.  I asked for credit towards my next policy coming up this September. Unfortunately that was not granted.
I have always used 1cover and am generally very happy. I believe a credit towards my new policy would have been fair as I did call the available number before the start of the policy and before 24hrs.
I will continue to use 1cover though as the service has been good inbthe past.

title: Good value
body: Easy to arrange initially. Have not made a claim but good communication is available. Would use TID again on next trip.

title: Excellent cover, best price
body:
Policy matched travel agent cover but 1/3 price
Easy quote on line in 3 mins
Email copy of policy for ease of use 
24 hour help line accessible from overseas

title: Wouldn't travel without it!
body: We have used 1Cover several times.  Our policy has always been good value and easy to purchase online.  Luckily we have never had to claim however I have friends that did and they said it was very straight forward.

title: Coronavirus
body: I chatted online yesterday and was assured we would be covered for the Coronavirus. Whoever I was chatting with said they are not like other Insurance Companies. I save my Chat from them to have this in writing now just wondering???? Had to put in I had traveled but we have not as that is why I chatted with someone to see if they covered our upcoming trip. Not sure how to rate them either

title: Avoid Covermore at all costs
body: My wife and I booked and paid for an overseas holiday with Flight Centre, and accepted their recommendation to insure with Covermore. 2 weeks before our departure my wife required emergency surgery with no prior indications. Holiday cancelled, so we went back to Flight Centre to get a refund and claim the rest from Covermore. Flight Centre were very good and basically did all the work of getting refunds from airlines, hotels etc.. This amounted to about half what we'd paid, then the claim was lodged with Covermore. We have been through SO much rubbish with this company. We've supplied Doctors certificates, Doctors reports, claim information, verifications that the condition was not pre existing etc etc. Finally they accept and agree to pay - but they just don't pay! Last 'story' was that on the date they were to transfer our money they had a 'computer glitch' and payment didn't happen - and they didn't reschedule or advise, just...nothing. 4 mths now and still waiting. still calling... If you need travel insurance (and you do!) - do not use Covermore.

title: Excellent
body: Great value. No problems setting up. Online setup was very good. Operator was very efficient & helpful. Price of policy was good value compared to other companies. I will be travelling again soon & I hope to avail myself of a policy with Cover again. Thank You

title: Typical insurance company
body:
We took out travel insurance for our September 2019 trip to Sicily.
We paid extra to increase the car rental excess cover as we were concerned about driving over there.
All went really well apart from our front passenger door getting a tiny dent in it (while we were parked somewhere, looks like a scooter handlebar mark to me)

Europcar being like every car rental company we have dealt with, charged us 
320 Euros ($570) for this tiny dent (pure robbery which we have tried to argue about Of course they could not care less..) and off a matrix (chart) of their own making.
We put a claim through, we were asked for more documentation than ever by 1 cover this over several weeks. Ok they are making sure it's not a fake claim....
They are now refusing to pay because Europcar will not supply a quote and invoice for the repairs ( likely because they have not fixed anything) despite all our efforts to get them.
It seems to me the moral of the story is, if you are going to incur any damage on your car rental, make sure it is substantial enough to warrant legitimate repairs!! Were it in the thousands,
we would hopefully get the right paperwork!!
There is no reward for being careful and trying to minimize your claim!!
We are being treated as though we are the ones doing the wrong thing here.
What's the point of insurance???

title: So great!
body:
This is the company my travel agent company uses.
I got sick oversea's and phoned Cover More and the lady was lovely and explained everything and recommended which hospital to go to. She was so lovely! When I got home I put my claim in online which was very simple and within 3 days I had a response!

title: Very Satisfied Customer
body: We have used 1 Cover several times in the past, and been very happy. I have always said that you don't know how good an Insurance Company is until you are forced to make a claim. Unfortunately, due to a serious medical emergency, that has just happened. 1 Cover was very prompt and efficient, and we have no hesitation in recommending them.  David

title: Excellent
body:
The website is user friendly which means no hassles while filling out details. Price and benefits are just what I was looking for. Hopefully I wont need to make a claim, but if I do I'm sure it will be an easy process. The young lady I spoke to with a query was very helpful.
Very easy to buy online.

title: 1 Cover
body: I am always very happy with my travel insurance that I get through ! Cover. So easy to do , no mucking around put in my details & then lm on my way .. Excellent Service :)

title: Excellent
body:
Overall, I was happy and confident with one cover, was pretty cheap and gave me the care I needed. It was good staff and good price for the medical cover they gave.
they helped when it was my first time overseas and i was on my gap year and I got food poisoning, was a bit of a downer on my trip but was able to get care from one cover.
got transferred a bit when I had to make my claim, but the staff was really friendly!

title: Great
body: Peace of mind although thankfully we didn't require to make any claims  was good to know we could  enjoy our trip knowimg if anything  was to happen we had backup  and support most importantly  any costs were  covered.Also price for insurance was very reasonable and competitive  to other offers.Excess fee low too

title: Great way to save on rental excess insurance
body: I took out a domestic travel insurance after refusing the exuberant excess reduction from the car rental company. So easy to set up, completed registration while still at reception. Hit a kangaroo on the first day, and got an invoice for $1800. Sent a claims request when I got an invoice from the rental company. Swift claims process overall took about a week. I got paid in full for damages. No questions asked.

title: My go to Travel Insurance
body: Great efficient and easy travel insurance.  Very happy with the price and the communication of this company. It's my go to for Travel Insurance. Highly recommend to all customers considering.

title: Piece of Mind, easy insurance
body: I have just returned from another trip which I used Travel Insurance Direct for my coverage.  I did not make a claim this time.  I have however in the past made a claim with them and the experience was relatively smooth and trouble free.  Purchasing the insurance is online, fast and easy.  Their app is also useful as it knows your destination and provides useful tid bits about where you are holidaying.  If you cant afford travel insurance, you cant afford to holiday.  This inexpensive easy option provides the necessary piece of mind.

title: Easy to set up
body: Good value and easy to set up. Overall, I feel comfortable and safe setting this up. Also, compare to the insurance provided by the car rental company, this is a no brainer.

title: Didn?t need to make a claim
body: Have used this company quite a few times and have never needed to make a claim. So I cannot accurately review as I do not know the efficiency of claims.

title: good insurance
body: Policy was easy to setup although I had to end up ringing as online it would not accept our address for some reason. Tried several times & even the man that helped me over the phone couldn't understand why it wouldn't accept it.

title: Courteous information without sales tactics.
body: Policy was good value & easy to set up. I have used InsureandGo many times in the past. When dealing with claims communication was difficult but eventually resolved with many phone calls & repetitive questions.

title: Got it right for seniors!
body: Great value and they have made it so easy to navigate the website.  This is the second time we've used InsureandGo, and it won't be the last.  Already recommended this company.

title: Not worth the paper its written on
body:

Contacted one cover only to be told they do not cover people aged over 85 yoa.
Will not be using 1Cover again and will be pass all the info onto friends, family and all other contacts

title: Don't go anywhere with out it!
body: A great insurance, covered all most everything and was really quick to settle a claim. Accepted my documentation and paid up with out a question. I will use TID again this year when I am travelling.

title: No worries insurance
body:
Cover-more lets you travel with no worries. Cover-more looked after me when I got a small stone chip on the windscreen of a rental vehicle.  In a timely and fuss-free manner, they got the rental company premium returned to me. All the big things are covered, and when you sign up you can easily ensure any extras like snowsports are covered without breaking the bank.
great customer service, and everything included that you need
not the cheapest one you'd find

title: Excellent
body: This was my first time using 1Cover Travel insurance. It was easy to purchase the product and thankfully I didn't need to make a claim.

title: everyone needs these guys!
body:
Used CoverMore in Bali when we got sunstroke head full cover or premium rather with zero excess. Which works really well which end up at the hospital everything was sorted by CoverMore 0 out of pocket. Really pleased with the speed at which they processed a claim in the call centre lady was lovely. Even though as a bit of a stress head due to the situation we were in but she managed me really well and I couldn't have been happy at the end. So thanks, keep up the great work.
And just bought my insurance cos I'm off to Fiji on Saturday

title: AMAZING Service!

title: Hidden excess and incorrect excess
body:
We have bought Cover-More Travel Insurance on numerous occasions for our overseas travel, but never had to make a claim. We had stayed with Cover-More on the recommendation of a trusted travel agent. However, our recent experience in relation to domestic travel highlighted a small but significant issue in relation to the disclosure and application of the excess, which has given me pause to consider looking for an alternative next time.

When applying online for the Domestic Plan or the Domestic Cancellation Plan, there is no up front disclosure of the mandatory excess. (An application for the overseas cover shows the excess and gives a choice, though I do notice that the 'box' is placed so that it could easily be missed). I checked every little ? or link, and there is absolutely no mention of an excess for either domestic option. The certificate I received said there was a $50 excess, and this is the first time you will see this, UNLESS you read in detail the PDS. Of course, the application makes you certify you have read the PDS, but in reality who does, or even picks up every little detail if they do. I really think that there is no excuse for the excess to not be clearly stated during the application process so the customer is fully informed.

I didn't think too much about this until we had to make a claim and I was looking at the PDS after there was an error in the calculation of our claim. The PDS clearly stated that the excess for Domestic Cancellation is $25 - not $50 as stated on our certificate as only the Domestic Plan had an excess of $50. When I spoke with a claims officer about this, I was gobsmacked when he wanted me to send them the copy of the PDS and my Certificate! While I said I would, I also said I shouldn't have to, as their PDS, which I had looked at 20 mins earlier online, clearly stated that the excess should have been $25. Really people, do your own homework. Asking the customer to email in something that you have provided and have readily available looks lazy and unprofessional, and would cause unnecessary delay. Eventually, I was put through to the Claims Officer who actually handled my claim. He checked it out and agreed to repay the extra $25 and did so within an hour, along with the adjusted payment from recalculating the claim. Thank you.

To me this issue with the application of the excess is obviously a computer programming problem that populates the certificate with the incorrect excess amount, and this flows on to the calculation of the claim. So the big question is, how many other people have had the wrong excess applied to their claim for Domestic Cancellation insurance, and been shortchanged $25.

Based our experience, an ethical company would now be taking four steps:
1. Changing the application process so that the excesses for domestic insurance are clearly shown to the customer up front along with the cost and details of the policy being selected.
2. Changing the system so that the correct excess is applied to the policy and shown on the certificate of insurance.
3. Examining how this system error happened, and putting quality control processes in place to ensure everything in the system is double checked for accuracy, so that something like this does not happen again, and any other system errors are corrected.
4. Identifying how many other Domestic Cancellation claims have had the incorrect excess applied, no matter how long ago that was, AND immediately sending each policy holder the $25 that was incorrectly deducted from their claim, along with a letter of apology.

You might think that $25 each is not a lot, but there is a much bigger principle at stake here. And given the findings of the recent Royal Commission into financial institutions, I would expect that Cover-More would realise that it is morally and legally bound to repay this money to each policy holder who made a claim.

So, over to your Cover-More. I would appreciate your advice that all of these steps, and particularly number 4, have or will be actioned by Cover-More.

title: Just ridiculous & pathetic
body:
My partner & i went had a 3 month holiday around vietnam, cambodia & thailand planned during december 2012-february 2013.
we got as far as nha trang in vietnam before having a motorcycle crash. my partner was riding, & i was on the back.
2 other local guys on another bike T-boned us. they admitted fault (they were drunk), the lovely people at our hotel helped my partner deal with the police while i was stuck in hospital, & the hospital chief dr contacted them with the relevant info. so we had all the paperwork that TID policy said it required.

firstly, my boyfriend wasn't covered for his broken jaw because he was riding a bike without a vietnamese license. an international licence wasn't good enough, & our hotel managers tried to explain to TID that a tourist cannot get a vietnamese licence unless they've been there for at least 3 months (or maybe 6 months, i can't remember now).
TID didn't care.

secondly, my right knee was busted open in 2 places right down to the bone & i needed 22 stitches & was confined to the hospital bed for 5 nights on antibiotics. my left foot was banged up badly & needed a few stitches too. so basically, i couldn't walk.
the dr who looked after me advised me that i need to rest it & not walk for at least a few weeks, & my partner needs to go home to get his jaw looked at properly in australia because it would be too expensive (& nowhere near as good treatment) there. especially since TID had already said he's not covered for anything.

we got back to our hotel after my 5 nights in hospital & had to wait another 5 nights until TID "decided" yes they would fly us home.
we were given all sorts of excuses like "need a more detailed report from the police (who didn't speak or write english) so had to get our hotel staff to translate & guarantee it was valid (i don't even know how they did that...). the report the dr gave me was "reviewed by TID's dr & he has deemed me fit to continue travelling & no need to come home earlier" based on my dr saying "patient is fit to fly home". even though he specifically said i am not fit to continue travelling. How on earth do they have the nerve to say "oh, our dr has reviewed your dr's report & decided you're actually ok...Even though he can't see you & blatantly ignores the bits of the report that say you're not ok"....

Call after call after email & having to quote their own policy to them about how they do have to book flights for us home now (otherwise if we booked them ourselves without their approval then they don't need to reimburse us).

Eventually, they said they can fly me home, but not my partner....It clearly states that since i was temporarily crippled (cannot walk, get changed, go to the bathroom, etc) the policy will fly home a carer for that person too. & the dr's letter specified that too.

Eventually they agreed.

& told us we could fly economy, since our original fares were for economy class.
Now, i couldn't bend my knee, the dr said in his letter to them i need to be able to keep it extended straight & elevated until the stitches are ready to come out (1-2 weeks later).
So my partner had to go back to the hospital, explain to the dr what was going on & the dr (thankfully for us) very angrily called them & pretty much laid down the law.

So we made it home with those flights paid, but the extra nights accommodation booked while we waited in  ha trang wasn't covered (as we would've been paying accommodation anyway on our 3 month trip).
They insisted of communicating over the phone over email (which we protested greatly) which was awful because we had so many international charges, & being on hold for up to half an hour per phone call! None of that was reimbursed.

No money was provided to me for staying in hospital for more than 4 consecutive nights...

We were just so lucky that things in vietnam were so cheap! & that vodafone capped us after $500. Otherwise it would've been nearly $2000 (phone calls & not having wifi in hospital needing to use roaming to email them & download their policy to quote back to them...Not to mention family members worried & calling/emailing lots).


Our pre booked flights home at the end of february weren't refunded as "they booked us earlier flights home that cost more, so only the difference would've been paid"...

It's all bad, but after a few weeks back home getting nowhere, we just cut our losses & stopped stressing over this.


Nb to all you people who leave amazing 5 star reviews about how easy & cheap it is to book, stop reviewing travel insurance companies unless you actually need to make a claim.
Eventually they flied us home, after being yelled at by the dr.

title: Avoid Medibank - Cancellation Costs
body: I purchased a Annual Multi-trip overseas travel insurance with Medibank. My domestic flights in overseas destination were cancelled by the airlines for no fault of mine and I was stranded. I had to buy much expensive tickets at short notice to continue with the journey. I thought i had cover with medibank travel insurance for cancellation costs. After I made the claim i was advised by Medibank that they do not pay for cancellation by transport service provider unless its due to a strike/industrial action. When I bought this travel insurance, the sales guy said we pay more claims than anyone else as they are part of Zurich Insurance. I was not at fault and I had a significant out of pocket for cancellation costs which you expect any reasonable & fair insurer would pay as it was not due to my fault. But not medibank. If you are looking for travel Insurance (Domestic & Overseas), my advice is Stay away from Medibank (Zurich). First time and last time I bought travel cover with medibank / Zurich Insurance.  I now realise why ratings for Medibank travel insurance is 2.8. I will give them minus 10 if I can. Medibank/Zurich Stop Selling travel insurance and exclude Cancellation costs completely - that will be fair & reasonable as it will not lead people to believe that they are covered and find that when you make a claim, the most basic risk of cancellation costs due to airlines changing their mind is not covered. title: Very disappointing
body:
It's taken me a while to get to this review.  I broke my wrist skiing in Japan December 2013 (correction 2012).  After ski patrol rescue I visited a local Japanese clinic for Xray and was told there was no fracture.  However, due to severe pain, bruising and swelling I consulted a physio the following day.  She diagnosed a likely fracture in spite of the 'normal' Xray and said this was common in Japan.

My husband then phoned Cover More who transferred his call to their emergency assistance company.  He requested advice about what our policy would cover under these circumstances.  In response an email was received stating that a response could not be given until we provided extremely detailed information.  The request included contact details (name, phone, fax, and email address) for all gps, medical centres and specialist doctors I had seen at home in the last 3 years as well as the current medical reports.  Much of this information we either did not have to hand or had no way of sending due to our isolated situation and lack of access to a scanner.  As well we were asked to fill in detailed forms - uneditable pdfs which required access to a printer and a scanner. 

I emailed a rather plaintiff reply indicating that we were not in a position to provide this information.  No further communication was ever received from the assistance company nor was any further help offered.  We were at a dead end unless we confronted the difficulties involved in waiting until we reached our next destination in a week's time where we could ?prove? the seriousness of the injury with further more complex medical tests and somehow print, scan and email the requested documents.  In a country where you don?t speak the language this is daunting.  With your right hand completely out of action even more so.  I just soldiered on for the next two weeks unable to ski or manage everyday tasks without great difficulty.  

In retrospect this was a big mistake. On my return a severely displaced scaphoid fracture and multiple other injuries to the right wrist and hand were diagnosed.  The next day I had emergency surgery to insert a permanent screw into the fractured bone. 

We had held annual multi trip insurance with Covermore for a number of years and never made a claim.  Naively I imagined that if a problem ever arose, particularly with injury or illness a kind and helpful representative of Covermore would assist and guide us. Instead, a beauroucratic smokescreen was placed in our our way.  It was pretty clear that the underlying implication of many of the questions was that the condition could in some way have been ?pre existing? or that Covermore were looking for a way not to take responsibility for what was clearly an acute injury.  

On my return I called Cover More who put my call through to the Emergency Assistance Company. They agreed the case (1212200343) had been poorly handled and promised to acknowledge this by email.  No email was ever received.  I then lodged a formal complaint with Covermore along with the modest claim for expenses.  Except for a phone call promising the concerns would be forwarded to the appropriate person no one ever responded. I followed up with more emails - still no reply. After the claim was paid I responded to the automatic request for feedback with my story.  Still no reply.  Then I gave feedback through the website feedback facility and only ever got the automatic reply promising contact within 15 business days. That was on 10/4/13 so it's a long 15 days!   

I was always polite. I'm a nice person.  At first all I really wanted was for somebody to listen and say they would improve the systems.  As time went on I felt really angry and was advised to go the Ombudsman because I was denied appropriate access to my entitlements by their failure to offer appropriate assistance.  

I thought about this but eventually just gave up, not wanting further stress and needing to concentrate on the long recovery with the wrist. 

I'm not sure whether Cover More just don't care, or whether by responding to me properly they might open themselves up to some kind of liability. 

Anyway, today I'm filing all the paperwork away.  I hope my story will help you choose a much better travel insurance company.

In the ambulance they inquired if i had a current credit card no, i answered, but i do have a cover- more travel ins. Policy . When i arrived the hospital took a copy of it. Then my wife of 55 yrs. ,who spoke no french, was thrown off the deep end. No help came in from  c.M.Travel.Ins. I was taken into a operating theater, i was told that surgery was required with a 1-2% chance of survival,( no top surgeon from london for me) op. Now over , you must go now as we need your room. No joy getting c.M.Ins.To get my wife and i accommination so as to recuperate or getting us to the paris airport( we paid for and caught the train) to return to aussie. A flat refusal to upgrade to business class, as required by the surgeon  (proof was supplied) n.B.  I had to pay my own air ticket home.This is what you receive if you use cover-more 1 international 30 day insurance.@ $980.00. I am still too sick to apply for any refunds.

Your red book ,part 1 : absolutely no offer of reassurance and  or support

title: Unforgivable. Deliberately unhelpful. Disorganised
body:
My brother Kurt was killed in a bus crash in Bolivia. He had travel insurance with Allianz. So I had to deal with Allianz regarding my brothers repatriation to Australia. I also booked travel through Allianz so that our flights would align with the flights my brothers body was on, coming home.

Allianz left my brother in an unrefridgerated morgue for 4 days, whilst they "found us the best price" to move him 3 hours away to La Paz to a refridgerated morgue. We begged Allianz to move him immediately and stressed the urgency of the situation and offered to pay whatever the price. In the end Department of Foreign Affairs stepped in and organised for my brother to be moved as they could not understand why Allainz was taking so long.

Our family needed to travel to Bolivia to bring my brother home. Despite the fact that we would have been paying for the flights ourselves, Allianz refused to give us information regarding how they intended to repatriate my brothers body. In the end a Federal Minister from the government had to call on our behalf to get things moving.
My family booked travel through Allianz as we needed to be on the same flight home as my brothers body. It cost us $300 each just to use their travel agent. We gave Allianz permission to deduct $600 from my fathers credit card to pay for this initial fee. Without contacting us Allainz booked flights and deducted a further $12,000 form my fathers credit card without permission. 

When we arrived in Bolivia, we went to get money out only to find that Allinaz had double dipped and taken out a further $12,000 out of our account. So we were left with no money overseas!!! Just to reiterate...That is $24,0000 deducted from my fathers account without permission!

My father had heart breakingly promised my brother before he left on his trip that he "would come and get him, if anything happened". When my brother died, we travelled to Bolivia with the sole purpose of being on the same flight home as my brothers dead body. However, when we arrived at the airport ready to fly home with my brothers coffin, my father asked the airline to check that my brother was on board the plane. After 4 hours of searching with my father, the airline worked out that my brother had been sent home on an earlier flight. The lady at the airline cried when she gave my father the news. My father cried too. 

What your company, Allianz, did to my family in our most desperate time of need was unforgivable. 

You were deliberately misleading. You rarely phoned us with information. Even when you booked our flights to Bolivia no one called us. We called you at 4pm, wondering if you had the quotes regarding flights to Bolivia, only to find that you had booked the flights and we were leaving at 5am the next morning. When were you going to call and tell us about the flights you had booked? 

What your company did to my family in our most desperate time of need was unforgivable. Allianz's actions at all times were slow, unhelpful and disorganised. Your company caused us so much stress in a time that was already unbearably stressful.

I would not recommend my worst enemy to use Allinaz. Over 1000 people attended my brothers funeral. Everyone of those people will be advised not to use Allianz.

title: Frustrating & extremely Unprofessional
body:
I am currently going through a claim with cover-more this process started on the 23rd January 2014 and only yesterday was informed certain items are not covered ie. iphone, ipad, camera etc "electrical items" & jewellery I was also just informed they require the receipt for repair to the hire care in Rome.  When I questioned this they told me to complain to customer relations, I asked for the number & was told I can only email them! After reading this thread I rang again today & asked why my electrical items were not covered they told me because they were not stolen directly from my person or lost! (they were in the luggage stolen from the boot of the hire car) I also asked how long before I would here something from customer relations , 2 weeks he said !!. I believe that Flight Centre & or Cover-more should verbally disclose these common loop holes prior to clients accepting cover & after reading these comments I am shocked that a reputable (for want of a better word) business like Flight Centre continue to use them.  I certainly wont be recommending them in fact 9 of us are going away in July & will secure our own travel insurance privately. This is a copy of the email I sent yesterday. lets see what happens now!!!!

To whom it may concern 

I am in the process of an insurance claim with your company as while I was overseas prior to Christmas we had our hire car broken into and EVERYTHING bar the clothes on our backs were stolen and of course the hire vehicle was damaged.

I would appreciate someone from your department contacting me asap.  I have a huge issue with the way my claim is being handled, I am continually having to submit more and more documents, hence dramatically extending this already harrowing process.  Two weeks ago more information was required and I sent what I thought it was you needed, I rang a few days maybe a week later to confirm that finally you had everything I was told that you did & the process now was that it would take up to 2 weeks then I would be notified by email and that if I had given my bank details that the claim amount would be direct debited to my account.

So I'm sure you can understand my anger when I received an email 2 weeks later (today) that was a requirement for  more info, in fact I had not provided exactly what you wanted on the last request (the info requested was  the invoice for the repair to the vehicle from the repairer not the hire car company!)  I rang your office and spoke with Ben who apparently was the last assessor to review my file.  I explained that this process is now getting extremely frustrating as I have provided every document that i have from Hertz and my bank statement to prove what I paid I also explained that I fail to see the relevance of this invoice as I am claiming what I am out of pocket which is why I thought I had insurance.  During this conversation I was also informed that my sons iPod, ipad & iPhone 4s (electronic equipment) are not included in the claim and that jewellery was also not included some of which was mine and also gifts for my friends. I found this very difficult to understand as who goes on holidays without either having these things or purchasing them whilst there away?

I understand that you have to make sure all claims are legitament, however I feel that this is now going nowhere and costing me money and time, I can't help but wonder if this process is deliberately made so difficult so that your clients give up.  I request that you go back through my file & phone recordings as at no time I was told this information regarding coverage and required documents. It certainly would have been appreciated at the commencement of my claim that (A) you required the repairers invoice (as surely you must be aware how difficult they are to obtain from abroad) and (B) that the "electrical devices' and jewellery I was claiming for were not included in the cover which I believe is information that should have been disclosed to me by yourselves or flight centre prior to my accepting you as my insurer, which is something I will address further with the relevant departments.

I would appreciate your speedy response to this email.

title: Unacceptable of 1Cover to only offer shifting travel start date within 12 months from date of issue due to COVID-19

It soon became clear we would have to cancel the trip due to COVID-19, so just 28 days after purchase I asked to cancel the insurance considering the circumstances. 1-Cover said no because it was past the 14-day cooling off period. All they offered was to move the start date to within 12 months from purchase date and I had to advise them of the new dates by 14 May 2020. It was completely impractical to do that since we don't have any idea when borders will reopen and we will be able to travel again, so I am now unable to use the policy.

1Cover please reconsider and provide credit valid for 18 months as you have for others. Last six digits of policy is 2582037.

title: Terrible support - Warning - Do not use COVERMORE
body:
On a recent OS trip with my wife and friends to Singapore then on to Koh Samui my wife became ill. I contacted Covermore to get advise on an English speaking doctor in Koh Samui. As my wife reacts badly to a wide range of medication we needed to be able to effectively communicate this to the doctor. The follow is the chain of events that followed.

1. On 21/04/2017 I messaged Covermore via live chat. I provided my email address, Thai mobile number and policy number. We were not able to call international from this mobile or from the accommodation we were staying at. Covermore only provides international contact options when staying in Asia.
2. On 21/04/2017 received a message back from live chat advising that details have been passed onto the emergency contact team and they would call me.
3. On 22/04/2017 I received a call and could not hear the person on the other end. The call was disconnected. No attempt was made to call me back. Our friends we were traveling with then received an email to say they tried calling but as I couldn't hear them the call was terminated. The email then stated I could call them back on the international number (which I couldn't call.)
4. On 23/04/2017 I reopened the closed ticket by responding to the Covermore email advising that I still had not been contacted and confirmed that we are not able to call international numbers.  
5. On 24/04/2017 I received an email to say my request was again passed onto the medical assistance team and that if my wife's condition is worse we should seek medical attention. Again, we needed an English speaking doctor.  
6. On 24/04/2017 I received an email from the Medical assistance team to say that I need to call them if I need an immediate response. Again, we were not able to dial international numbers.
7. I then received another email from Covermore providing me with the details of the Bangkok Hospital on Koh Samui.

I had sent feedback via Covermore live chat and web page on 22/04/2017 and even though we are back in Australia and have been for 5 days, I continue to get emails advising if we still need medical assistance to call them. Latest email received 02/05/2017.

I did get a call on 24/04/2017 from a Covermore team leader advising to go to the Hospital but this was 3 days after my initial contact. We were able to get some medication from a chemist which helped ease my wife's infection until we got home but what appalling service from Covermore. 

1. Why did the CSA not try and call me back after the first phone call was unsuccessful?
2. Why didn't Covermore provide the Hospital details in their first email response?
3. Live chat is simply not live chat. Covermore needs to provide genuine live chat where you can webchat with a CSA in real time.
4. Is there no way that Covermore can provide a Skype or some form of VOIP phone service that can be used? Most accommodation provides free wifi that customers could use to make contact with them?  

We have used Covermore for all of our previous travel, but never again. Avoid Covermore.

I was unable to get a refund from the Hotel or for the flights, no advise was given in relation to the restrictions Gibraltar had in place for those who had traveled through Singapore so I was unaware.

I had to lodge a complaint through AFCA as they have not responded to me referring the complaint through their internal process within 15 business days, they advised they had 15 days under the General Insurance Code of Practice.

title: Worst Travel Insurance Provider
body:
As a Comm Bank customer, we were offered  one complimentary Travel Insurance so we decide to get a travel insurance for our holiday to Thailand on July 2019. Later we found out my Wife is pregnant and our GP advised us not to travel to Thailand during pregnancy due to Zika Virus and other infected diseases in the region. We did our research in internet, Australian Department of Health and health care services advised not to travel during pregnancy so we cancelled our holiday and lodged a claim with Covermore.

After a week,  I received a email stating my claim was denied as the insurance wont cover claims caused by, or claims arising from, an epidemic, pandemic or outbreak of a contagious disease or any derivative or mutation of such viruses, or the threat or perceived threat of any of these. I was not happy with the decision so I called Customer service to get more details. The Claim Officer I talk to was very rude and he also once stated that I have a complimentary Travel insurance which is free of cost. Our main reason to cancel to our trip and make a claim was because my wife was pregnant and we were told not to travel to Thailand by our doctors but i could find any information about what is included or not in Covermore Travel insurance PDA. Since we cancelled our travel due to consequences, we should have refunded as we would have travelled to Thailand if my wife was not pregnant even there was a Zika virus risk.

Won't be buying Travel Insurance with this company and won't advise to my friends

title: RACV / Allianz Travel Insurance
body:
My mum who is 79 purchased travel insurance via the RACV (the underwriters are Allianz) for her 5 week trip to India. Within a week of arriving there she took ill and was hospitalised.  We were notified of the situation by relatives and we immediately got in touch with Allianz. For 2 weeks the hospital carried out numerous tests to determine the illness and kept her under observation. We were given a case reference number by Allianz and put their medical contact person in touch with the hospital in India. A family member from Australia got a visa to travel to India to accompany my mum back to Australia. Allianz asked for copies of the test results & letters from the doctors there, and were willing to cover the costs of the person flying there to accompany her back.
They organised all the flight bookings for both people to fly back. 
Despite a long wait and many phone calls, faxes and emails, all expenses incurred were eventually fully refunded. This was our first ever experience of a claim from travel insurance.
Allianz were in frequent touch with us and easy to contact until everything was sorted out. RACV  offers members competitive rates for  travel insurance!

I had clients needing to claim for a huge variety of things - losing glasses in the sand on a beach, getting back packs stolen in Malaysia, medical expenses as a result of malaria, sea-sickness on cruises (that was me!), mobile phone being stolen, broken arms resulting in additional travel expenses - the list could go on and on.  CoverMore paid every time and the amount that was requested.  I had no hesitation in offering their product to friends and family alike because a) I knew they would have 24 ours emergency assistance overseas and b) I knew their claims would be paid out on their return.
They pay out nearly every time because their premiums are initially higher but they make their profits here rather than in rejecting claims.  They only do travel insurance so they are specialists.  They cover insolvency of airlines etc (remember Ansett?) and no other travel insurance in Australia does.

title: Watch out for Excess!!!
body:
Hi, for those looking into purchasing Travel insurance with CoverMore take EXTREME CARE when selecting your excess.

The travel agent who sold me the insurance package gave me know forewarnings regarding how the excess charge works and as usual, the policy guide makes it really convoluted, but essentially YOU WILL be charged an excess for EACH SEPARATE EVENT regardless if they all come under the same Section of the policy.

For my case, I paid over $750 (with $250 excess) for my travel insurance with CoverMore expecting to have no issues as they were referred to me as being one of the best. Unfortunately, during my trip 3 separate events happened where items totalling over $1000 were damaged or stolen. Consequently I made 3 separate claims to CoverMore and was charged the excess each time.

So at the end of the day, I had to "pay" $500 worth of excess fees (that is $250 excess x (3 claims - 1); (I say pay because that is essentially money I could have received back). In the end I received less than $150 back. Money that is no where near enough to cover the $1000 worth of items... 

In addition, one of the items I damaged during my trip was a camera. I had only purchased it 2 months before, and even though the item was still available on the shelves at the same price, Cover-More still applied a 4% depreciation to the item which I think should be in the order of 1% given how new the item was and the current market value of the camera.

I called Cover-More to dispute the claims, however as usual, they quoted policy and refused to amend the decision.

OPTION 1: Look into complimentary travel insurance with Credit Cards
OPTION 2: Go with a cheaper Travel Insurance.
OPTION 2: Pay the little extra in premium because it is so not worth paying the excess fees for each event later on.

I want to clarify that Cover-More (according to their policy) have done no wrong doing in this case. However I feel I am now over $1500 out of pocket, and feel that there was no value in getting Travel Insurance with Cover-More in the first place.

title: Save your money as they will do and say anything to avoid paying out.
body: We took out a travel insurance policy with Allianz prior to our 3 week Ski trip to Japan, just 5 days into our trip my wife broke her ankle. We went to emergency where they Xrayed, confirmed the break, put her leg in plaster and advised us to return home and rest up. I immediately called the OZ Allianz HQ direct (because the Japanese office never picks up and the freecall number didn't work) I spoke to a pleasant and helpful person who said we should follow the doctors recommendations but keep copies of all paperwork. I explained my wife was in a wheelchair and I couldn't assist her and travel with all our bags and they agreed it was acceptable to freight 2 of our bags and return home on Drs advice. I kept copies of all our documents; credit card statements, receipts, tickets, emails, telephone log, medical docs Japanese and Australian, etc. On return I called Allianz and confirmed what I needed to do to lodge the claim and I followed it to the letter. I submitted the claim (total about $8000) a few weeks later, they responded saying they would process it within 15 working days - on the afternoon of the 15th day they called to say the claim had been rejected... except for $200 for the first emergency dept visit - I couldn't believe it. They rejected the claim because the doctors notes didn't state that the we needed to go home (obviously ridiculous to spend 2 weeks of a ski holiday in a wheelchair with a broken ankle) - this was news to us but as the medical notes were in Japanese we couldn't argue. They said we could appeal - so I contacted the Doctor in Japan and he wrote another letter in English stating that we were advised to go home and consult a local surgeon - so we resubmitted our claim for review. Guess what - they agreed to pay for the shipping of the bags but nothing else and said that as my wife waited 5 days after we got home before she saw the doctor and also added we hadn't had the Dr in Japan pre approved? - the rest of the claim was refused AGAIN. We explained that we arrived home on a Saturday, we contacted the Dr on the Monday and explained the situation, he was ok with it and that the first time available for an appt and an Xray was Thursday - which we duly attended. This made no difference but we were told we could lodge for another review - which we have now done. THREE times now they have come up with different and original reasons to refuse our claim although each time they payout a small amount obviously and transparently hoping I'll just give up and go away. Also I was a little shocked to see the number of positive reviews on this site for a Company that in my experience are appalling, so I had a closer look and it seems that the majority of the 4 and 5 star reviews are recent and from new reviewers with only 1 review - on the other hand the 1 and 2 star reviews seem to be older and from experienced reviewers with more than 1 review... hmmm not sure what that suggests but seems odd. I feel that my next stop will be to involve The Financial Ombudsman as it seems Allianz just won't accept their responsibility and accept our genuine claim. I hope that relating this saga here can help other travellers make better choices and avoid the same frustrations.

title: Get travel insurance, get TID
body:
Last year I purchased travel insurance with TID. While nothing happened to me on the trip, my grandfather fell ill while I was away. This was completely unexpected - I've never even known him to catch a cold. TID covered my travel to get home, and back to Canada a month later so I could continue with my planned trip. I was incredibly fortunate - this was the last time I saw my grandfather alive.

Knowing this visit home was paid for by TID, something they agreed to without hesitation, gave me one less thing to worry about - all I had to focus on was getting there. It was especially nice since my entire family thought it wouldn't be covered. Luckily TID covers trip interruption.

The policy took minutes to take out, provided a lot of coverage for the best price, and the claim process was simple. The only downside was it took ages to actually process it. Months, in fact, instead of the promised 10 days.

Even if you're healthy and travel carefully, things happen to you and others which you can't predict. 
Whenever I consider taking out travel insurance, I remember this event, and how easy the process was with TID.

While I travel once or twice a year (always insured), I haven't made another claim, however I have been told they have sped up the process times since last year so you most likely won't be waiting as long should something happen.

Of course do your research, but I have been using TID for a few years now and have found them to be competitive, and comprehensive.

body:

body:

Take the grounding of the A380's recently, CoverMore put out a statement saying because that's the fault of the travel provider (Qantas) they won't pay. Also, if anything happens to you if you've been drinking, even if it's not your fault, there is an escape clause. So if you're in a pub, a car comes flying through the window and hits you, through no fault of your own, there is an escape clause saying because the injury happened while alcohol was in your system, it's not their problem. Loose you luggage, no problem, they get to decide how much to depreciate the item, say, 90%. Also, there is '$12,000' coverage for lost items, but there are sub limits on everything. 

What a scam.

Escape clauses for everything.

title: Frustrating waiting times!
body:
I have used TID on many trips, after a trip to the US in April I had my first claim experience. Unfortunately I had to claim for some stolen items and documentation, I found the online claim submission process simple and efficient and made every endeavour to provide all the required documentation to finalise my claim within the first assessment.  

Upon submission I received an auto email advising i would hear back within 10 business days. My claims assessor (Prak) got back to on the 10th day to advise he couldn't read my police report and as such couldn't approve my claim, I advised I could clearly read the document at my end. He apologised and  said it was the document upload system that had reduced the document size and made it impossible for him to read. I explained waiting 10 business days to be told TID's system meant my claim couldn't move forward was very frustrating. 

Nonetheless, I immediately re scanned the document and emailed it through, to my surprise I received a response  stating I should hear back from my assessor within 2 business days. This was short lived... after 10 days without contact, I made a phone call to the office to enquire on the status, the phone rep advised this had just been picked up by the assessor and i would hear back in a further 3 days. I asked to speak with the assessor and was advised this isn't possible, I left a request for a call back which was not returned. 

All in all it took a further 13 days from the time I re submitted the document to receive a settlement. The service was poor and communication extremely frustrating. Also, they depreciate everything, so if you need to re place something you're likely only going to receive a portion of the cost.

title: Cover More- The best Investment ever
body:
Here is my story;-
for many years i have travelled to my native Country Switzerland without any Travel insurance ever. Why should I ?, I thought, I am a healthy Person.!

It so happens one of our Daughters decided to join me on this trip. She took out a Cover-More Travel Insurance for her selves and urged me to do the same. I initially felt this would be unnecessary but she persisted and persisted until i gave in and took out a cover too. 

As it happened when we arrived in Switzerland my daughter suddenly developed a serious Sinus infection which necessitated urgent medical attention with a specialist. This resulted in a very expensive medical expense. 

As i said, i am a healthy person and never had any sort of ailments. One day however in Switzerland, when i got up in the morning i lost my balance which became worse as the morning progressed. I was unable to stand upright and could not walk straight. I was immediately admitted to the Hospital where extensive tests were carried out in order to identify the cause of my in-balance. Later that day i was transported to a Medical Specialist  who, after extensive tests, diagnosed the ailment  as BPPV ( Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo ). 

Some specific exercises, in various positions, solved the problem. The resultant medical bills from the Hospital and Specialist were horrifically high !

Upon my return to Australia I filled in a claim form with Cover- More. A very few days afterwards, without undue delay, Cover-More promptly re-paid the full amounts of all my medical expenses. 

The same happened to my daughter. This was a very serious lesson for me which, without the Cover-More Travel insurance, this trip could have gone horribly wrong for my Daughter and myself.

I shall never, ever travel overseas again without a Travel Insurance from Cover- More.
I recommend Cover-More Travel Insurance to anyone who travel overseas.Take out a cover ! It is very cost-effective ! Do not take the risk, it could prove very costly if you don't !!
this was my story and experience with Cover-More Travel Insurance.

title: AN INFORMED DECISION BY A CUSTOMER NEEDS MORE DISCLOSURE BY THIS COMPANY
body:
1)  Travel insurance companies are exempt from discrimination legislation on the basis of age but this company does not mention this anywhere in their product disclosure document.  Your application can be declined summarily on the basis of age even if you are the healthiest person alive.
2)This company requests you to disclose all your existing medical issues and to truthfully disclose anything else of relevance.  But try and get them to disclose how they assess your application and you find that they do not tell you anything.  In their PDS they list various factors they say they use but will give no information as to the actuarial data or scientific references they use.to come to a decision on your application. In other words it is a one way flow of information.  You to them but none to you.  So how can you make an informed decision to go with this company.
3)  In the PDS is listed medical issues which are automatically covered and the range/conditions required to qualify for this cover.  If you think you are covered, think again.  If you have diabetes for instance you are NOT covered automatically even though you fall within the range/conditions mentioned in the PDS.  You only find out about this hidden gem when you are rejected.  The 'automatically covered' items don't apply to you.
3) Your application is initially assessed by non medical people using a computer program. You are not talking to a medical professional just a clerk. 
Remember to part with your money you need to make an informed decision and if you don't get the information you need then move on.

title: Won't cover change of dates due to pandemic
body:
I purchased travel insurance in October 2019 for an overseas trip in April 2020. Unfortunately the trip had to be cancelled due to the COVID-19. All out of my control! Fortunately the flight provider have given me credit for flights. Accommodation and car rental were all reimbursed as well due to the nature of the virus. 
I asked for my insurance dates to be changed to next year (will be changing holiday to 1 year later) as I do not need to use the travel insurance and don't need to claim anything. 
I thought this would be easy for them and accepted because of the virus. 

This has all being rejected and I can only change the travel until October 2020, which is 1 year after purchase. At this stage, lock downs will be in place until then. 

I have been offer 20% off my next purchase but you already offer 15% off online. So not a great saving.

I just don't understand why you wouldn't move the dates to my new holiday date considering I am not using the insurance in any way. Holiday or claims. 

Pretty poor effort by Budget Direct, considering every other company is on board with helping travellers out.
