title: Wasn't covered for 10% of our holiday!!
body: I recently took my wife and 18 month old on a trip to the uk and chose 1cover as our travel insurer as they seemed to have pretty good reviews overall. As this was the first time travelling with out little girl we chose the intermediate cover rather than the basic as it seemed to cover all the essentials including loss/theft. On our return flight our daughter didn't sleep well at all and my wife and I had no sleep. At some point my wife's phone went missing and we didn't realise until we got off the plane. We made every effort at the time to recover it to no avail. We submitted a claim to 1cover for it only to be told that we weren't covered for any loss on the plane. Considering we were only the plane for 24 hrs each way this meant we weren't covered for 2 of the 20 days we were away! Unacceptable- anyone travelling with kids will know this is the time your most likely to loose something - We received a lovely letter informing us that on page 17 of the pds it stated we wouldn't be covered for losses incurred during the flight. Suggest anyone looking for travel insurance to go with another company.fnp

title: As a Health Professional I would NOT recommend this product!
body:
I've been a Medibank Private health insurance member for many years.  In addition, I've worked for preferred suppliers with Medibank for several decades.
As such, I decided to take out Travel Insurance with them.  What a mistake that was.

Flying into Singapore I suffered a health issue which, given the medical services were unavailable at Changhi at the time, required me cancelling my trip to fly straight home.  I fly regularly, and even hold a pilots license, so flying isn't a problem normally.

I contacted Medibank Travel Insurance, and from the moment I attempted lodging a claim, received conflicting information, delays, lost paperwork, and just about every possible delay imaginable.

8 MONTHS LATER, I am advised my claim was rejected, because they feel a matter totally unrelated to actual travel, was considered a pre-existing condition, and therefore voided my claim.

Honestly, as someone who has worked in the Health Profession for 25 years, they tried every possible avenue to delay and misdirect my claim process, and forget talking to someone, because the incompetents gave conflicting advice each and every time I rang them. 

Over the years, I've seen the rebate applicable to extras coverage in my health insurance fail to change with CPI, costs blow out hugely in proportion to actual benefits, and generally be a complete over-inflated waste of money.  But it's necessary evil, especially travelling, when you EXPECT to be covered for problems as they occur.

However, do NOT expect Medibank Travel Insurance to be there for you when things go wrong.  If they reject a basic claim like mine, you have no hope in anything more complicated.

Read the reviews.  They're spot on.  Go elsewhere.

Oh, and Medibank?  You've lost over $10K in private health insurance along with my professional business.  All for rejecting a $2500 claim.  Enjoy the karma.

title: NEVER AGAIN
body: I purchased my policy on 06/02/20. At this stage there were no warnings about COVID-19 for my selected travel destinations on the Insure and Go web page. The only travel alert was for China. Sure enough I checked back on the website prior to my departure date and Insure and Go had an announcement stating the cut-off date for international travel was 31/01/20.  I was concerned so 5 days before my departure date I called Insure and Go, the agent I talked to advised me to continue with my travels because my chosen destinations were not effected (At this stage). It was also after the 'cooling off period' so I had no option for a refund. At the risk of losing my pre-purchased airfares I set off on the 07/03/20, on the 18/03/20 the Australian Government implemented a level 4 travel ban, at which point the travel insurance becomes redundant according to Insure and Go policy. I had no choice but to come home. A $3000 airfare later and I am back here in Australia having used just 11 days of my 180 day gold policy which Insure and Go has informed me is non-refundable. Free money for them. I have now lost a total of $4000. I am furious and I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND Insure and Go to anyone. I suggest anyone in a similar situation report this company to Fair Trading/ACCC for mistreatment of consumers.

title: What A Joke Of A Company - Do Not Waste Your Money
body:
Absolute Joke Of A Company 

Had to cancel my holiday come early March not due to COVID-19 but rather an immediate family member passing so reached out to InsurenGo, the provider we chose to go with, to process my claim of a cancellation before departure which falls under the Sections of Cover we are entitled to claim under:  Section A (Cancelling your trip before departure) clause a. (Page 18-19).

With a very lengthy and vigorous process to follow, they give you 30 days to comply with and send all the supporting evidence within that time and through Registered Post.

Doing everything from my end including paying for a doctor consultation to fill out details around the death of my family member, printing everything required, photo copying all our personal information documents ensuring all supporting details were there whilst grieving a dear loss, we did abide by the rules put forward and sent everything across including paid for Express posting.

Every step of the way from our end with any updates, I was consistent with communication and even shared all receipts and necessary factors via email so that their team would be up to date with the claim process. No responses at all until it got to about my 7th email to understand where things were, if they received my papers, what the current status was and all.

This was 7 weeks ago.

I have then finally received 1 email confirming they received my papers and since then, not once have I heard back from them (4 weeks ago). Calls were never connecting and when they did, they took down my number to tell me someone would be in contact with me (3 times). I have not received any calls. 
Every time I call and speak to someone before they tell me I will get called back, I get the same questions asking if I submitted my documents, if i have done this or done that and I have constantly stated I have done everything requested, confirmed it multiple times as well as being within the time frames with email proof to support that.

I do not get any traction with the company unless I am that annoying person who calls or emails all the time because as a customer, I would like to claim the service I paid for midst the unpredictable time of my families passing. Understanding this is in the middle of COVID, any form of communication or acknowledgement or even a message to let me know of a delay would be great. Just the bare minimum.

This is now the extent I am going to so that I can try and get some form of communication back and understand what the hell is going on.

My recommendation: choose a more mature, reliable, adept and staff trained based Insurance Organisation because you never really see the flaws in these businesses until you actually have to process a full claim. I travel 3 times a year and this is my first extensive claim and boy have I learnt some major lessons. 
Every single person I have spoken to, keeping in mind majority are internationally based, have been clueless, unsure of what to say, unsure of how to locate information, unsure of how to provide customers with some form of reassurance or anything.... unless it is accidentally the sales lines you are put through to; ironic hey.

I will keep sharing my extensive story as the weeks and months roll on so that people on multiple platforms know InsurenGo in NOT the way to go.

title: An Angel by our side in China
body:
My friend collapsed unconscious in the corridor of the train between Xian and Beijing. The train did an emergency stop at the next city,  we were unloaded into an ambulance and taken to the hospital. The room and furniture was from early 1900's - with dirt from that time! No-one could speak english and we couldn't speak their language.
A mobile call to '1 Cover' saw the situation taken out of our hands immediately. Their 'parent' company organised for a Chinese agent to contact the hospital. Doctors records/xrays were emailed to '1 Cover' and we left the hospital two days later with the assurance that our insurance company would cover the bill. 
I should add that after the hospital realised that we had insurance we were shot up to the VIP suite on the top  (19th floor) and treated like Royalty to the point that the press and photographer arrived to interview us!!!   VIP 'guests'  :)
I have never travelled with insurance before - Will never be without '1 Cover' in future travels.
Before we left NZ an internet search showed '1Cover' to be the least expensive yet offering the best cover. An emergency phone call from a foreign country was answered and acted upon immediately. The hospital bill was paid before we left - two days later.

On return of my flight my flight home was cancelled. Also, because jetstar compensated us $30 day for food travel insurance would not pay for any expenses which i think is unacceptable. $30 a day is no where near enough to cover the cost of living overseas for a day. Make sure you read all their fine print as they are one of the worse travel insurance companies i have ever delt with. Very unhelpful!

title: Don't be cheated by them of their cheap premium
body:
I bought travel insurance with them and when I handed all my original receipts from a HK Chinese doctor, they need all receipts in English.  Have told them that is a Chinese doctor and he has a Chinese software.  They asked me to use a accredited translator to do an official translation (at my own cost of course).  Finally got the doctor to write me a schedule of my visits with diagnosis (like flu, headache).  Then they asked for a detailed medical report saying why I had flu and headache, they said that diagnosis listed "flu" "headache" is not enough.  They said they need to know why I went to see the doctor......of course I went there because I was sick, who will dare to waste time going to a doctor while travelling!! They are just making things difficult for you and I think they hope to stop you proceeding with the claims with all these hassle.  Until now, after a month of to and from handling in documentation, claims not yet approved and asking me for more information from doctor. title: Mother's Faith Restored - CoverMore is the Real Deal.
body: Approximately 2 weeks ago I wrote a review because of unforeseen circumstances, my 2 teenage daughters were unable to accompany me and my partner, on an international Cruise from Singapore in January 2020. We live in North Queensland and we were departing from Cairns. Unfortunately for everyone, their biological father reneged on his promise that they could travel. I was heart broken that my daughters could not come with us, and as I had comprehensive travel insurance, I assumed their cancellation costs would be covered. I was wrong as I had not taken out "Cancel for Any Reason" which by the way, my online Travel/Cruising agent never offered me. The Queensland claims manager for Cover-More, Mr Edward Boyle, read my review and took the time to investigate my concerns, to ensure that all policies and procedures had been followed by the online Cruising agent. As it turns out, it wasn't Covermore's fault at all. What had actually happened, was the online Cruising company had failed to send me my Policy Disclosure Brochure when I took out my travel insurance. I soon learnt that the consumer has 15 days to make any changes to their policy, including upgrading it to "Cancel for any Reason." Essentially, I never had the opportunity to read my level of cover or even how much our trip was insured for as it was never sent to me. As a result of Mr Boyle's investigation, I received a 100% refund and a free education in how to make sure all bases are covered for next time we travel. Mr Boyle is obviously a busy man in his position, but he took the time to follow up my what occurred, as he genuinely cared about our unfortunate situation. I really commend the due diligence that Cover-More demonstrated, as it proved to me, that even though they are a big company, they still value the "human" element. Without question, I was delighted with the outcome and I would purchase Cover-More travel insurance next time in a heart beat.  Outstanding service.

Then, shortly before departure, we had bad luck in the extreme. Another need for urgent surgery forced cancellation. It was not related to my previous experience, which I had fully disclosed anyway.

title: Excellent
body:
On the evening of 28 June 2013, my wife and I were on a cruise ship at sea between Alaska and Canada when she had a heart attack. Surprisingly, there was a reasonably well appointed hospital on the ship.  Without this she would not have survived.  Nevertheless it was decided to medically evacuate her by Canadian Coast Guard cutter to Prince Rupert Regional hospital in Canada. This was 2-3 hours away.  Unfortunately, the port engine of the cutter broke down, delaying our arrival.  After some 21 hours at Prince Rupert, she was further evacuated by helicopter to the nearest airport and then by fixed wing light aircraft to Vancouver, some 450 klms south where she was immediately operated on. Fortunately, I was able to accompany her.
When you book passage on a cruise ship, like any major hotel they take your credit/debit card details in order to recover any on board costs incurred.  When you present at a hospital in Canada you are expected to pay for any services provided.  The incident occurred on a Friday night and the following Monday was a Canadian public holiday I had sufficient to pay the $800 odd for the initial fees at Prince Rupert, I did not have the $9000 odd for the intensive care costs in my card account. 
Not intending to spend time in Canada, I had no Canadian money or phone coverage.  The luggage which had accompanied us to Prince Rupert was now divided into two lots.  We had one small case with us and the remainder was to follow by Greyhound coach to Vancouver in two-three days.
It was then that things got 'interesting'. The cruise ship put a hold on my account for the $5000 odd costs of the medical disembarkation procedures.  My bank noticed that I was not following my proposed itinerary,and refused to pay through the ATM. The bank could only be contacted between 0800-1700 hrs Mon-Fri Australian time.  I needed cash for food, accommodation, phone card, freight costs etc apart from the growing mountain of medical expenses.  Lack of food, sleep and anxiety was starting to take it's toll. 
I have said some disparaging things about insurance companies over the years but I was to be totally overwhelmed, on this my initial experience, by the way Cover More picked me up, dusted me off and re-connected my thinking parts with all my other bits.  From my initial call notifying them of the event, they were totally courteous, considerate and caring. They completely comprehended the situation, knew what had to be done and carefully guided me through the procedure. They even organised the exceedingly comfortable flight home after my wife was released from hospital. When we got home they assisted me to fill out the claim forms and refunded all the unexpected expenditure within 10 days of our return. 
Now around a month after the event, I would like to tell you that my wife is well.  Our savings are secure and we would both like to assure everyone that travel is a great experience but please make sure you have insurance.  To those many wonderful people at Cover More: Christine, Paul and all the others whose names escape me, please accept our profound and heartfelt thanks.  I could not have done it without you.
 Sincerely
Mick Harding
Australia
Everything. Very helpful, courteous and understanding

title: Dissappointed with their depreciation percentage and their Claims people.  Simply too much!
body:
I lost my iphone in the Philippines last Jan and immediately reported it to Covermore.  They informed me what to do which I followed to the letter.  I submitted all documents that they need and specified to them that I want communication thru email.  2 weeks passed and I was wondering what happened to my claim when lo and behold I received a letter in the mail.

The letter from Covermore said that I need a letter from my Australian mobile service provided to prove that I reported to them that my phone was lost.  This resulted to more than an hour of my time lost because my service provider does not give this kind of letter.  They instead told me to give CoverMore the reference number and time and date that I reported the incident.

I called CoverMore the following day and the person who answered my call was insisting that I should get a letter and that he said he checked AMTA website that says the phone is still unblocked.  I said look I reported it and it should be my phone service who should report it to AMTA and he continued on as saying but the phone is still unlocked.  I took the better part of myself and asked him to just give my mobile service provider a call and confirm the information that I gave him (ref# and time and date of the report).  He gave in and then informed me that all is now ok.  He told me that the claim will be processed already.

Now here comes the second and third shocks of this issue, CoverMore then decided to depreciate my 16 month phone by 46% and to give me a store credit when I specifically asked for a direct deposit.  The direct deposit issue took another call and a letter to get it sorted.  Then I tried to look for the information in the CoverMore website and their PDS about this depreciation thing but cant find it.  I found that another travel insurer has it and studied it.  Then I called CoverMore again and asked why my phone was depreciated that much.  They told me that it was their way to depreciate.  So I said how come the other insurer has their depreciation policy on line and it is in line with the depreciation of ATO.  The information I got was, I was not insured bu the other insurer and I am insured by CoverMore so I have to follow CoverMore's depreciation method.

So unhappy with their reply, but I still emailed asking for a review, let us see how they will answer my request.

Information not readily available.  I felt I was left to my own by this insurer.

title: Shameful, indifferent, insulting service - effectively, a scam
body:
4 July 2020 - A request for immediate remedial action

In the past  I travelled with Cover-More trice, made a claim once, and did not experience any hindrances. However, In 2020 Cover-More insurers developed  and perfected a new approach to customers.

Last year, In early Jul 2019, I bought a 2-person (self, my wife) Annual Multi Trip Travel Insurance.ÿ

The premium (incl. stamp duty) was $2,031.30
The policy covered a period 11 Jan 2020-10 Jan 2021.

Due to the current pandemic our tour operator advised us that the planned May-Jun 2020 trip to Italy has been moved 12 months to May-Jun 2021.

On 5 April I called Cover-More hotline at 1300 72 88 22, confirmed that under the said policy I have not lodged any insurance claims and I am not intending to do so, and asked for a transfer of my existing policy to a fresh travel period in 12 months time. In reply a Cover-More consultant informed me that the Cover-More WILL NOT transfer my existing cover to new May-June 2021 dates.

Since my friends travelling to the same destination, with the same travel company but insured with another Australian insurer, vave obtained such a transfer of their insurance policy without any difficulty, I tried to clarify the situation via email dispatched on the same day.

28 May 2020 (7 weeks later) I received a perfunctory response from "[name removed], Refunds Team" <refunds@covermore.com.au>. [name removed] wrote: 

"Should you wish to cancel the policy, To cancel the Annual-Multi Trip policy 719000** **78 as of 24/03/2020, due to the travel ban implemented by the Australian Government, a pro rata refundable amount of $354.74 is available. [...]
Please be advised the amount offered to you has been done so in good faith as, in accordance with the above policy wording, no refund is technically due."

On 28 May 2020 I wrote a reply:
"This advice is erroneous and Unacceptable.

Moreover, According to my quick calculations (start and end of the insured
period: 11 Jan 2020-10 Jan 2021; paid premium ofÿ $2031.30; borders
closed by government 24 Mar 2020 i.e. 74 days into the start of my
insurance #7190 00** **78):

Using a short, 90% pro rata calculation
the earned premium (retained by the insurer)ÿ - $572.83
the unearned premium (refunded to the undersigned) - $1,458.47

or

Using a pro rata calculation
the earned premium (retained by the insurer)ÿ - $412.35
the unearned premium (refunded to the undersigned) - $1,618.95

So, please do look at the my request for refund afresh.
Thank you for your attention and cooperation, -- signature --"

---
Today is 4 July 2020 (6 weeks later) and still  I have not received any communication from the Cover-More people. 

Their conduct is scandalous and shameful.

I am taking the case to

https://www.ombudsman.vic.gov.au/complaints/

and

Australian Financial Complaints Authority 
https://www.afca.org.au/make-a-complaint

Bye bye, scammers. Advice to others? - "Never more with Cover-More"

=====
Subsequent Developments

6 July 2020  
This means 93 days (3 months, 2 days!) lapsed since 5 Apr 2020, my first attempt to postpone or get a refund on a travel insurance policy rendered useless by government mandated travel bans. Still, No remedial action, no response by/from Cover-More managers.  

Do they ignore customers requests for due refunds with or without explicit authorisation by [name removed], Cover-More Group Chief Executive Officer?  

Cover-Moore Group since 13 Apr 2017 is a Zurich insurance subsidiary (see https://hotcopper.com.au/asx/cvo/). Their executives form an 11 persons team (3 women, 8 men) and they describe themselves:
"And we are a group of people who are prepared to speak up and who don?t shy away for standing up for what is right."
https://www.covermoregroup.com/team

Yeah, guys, whatever.

7 July 2020
No news from the Cover-More Mediation team. 
However, someone called [name removed] from Cover-More Cancellation and Refunds <refunds@covermore.com.au> wrote 7 July 2020 at 15:02:
>[...]
> Considering the delay in processing your request and in good will, I have cancelled your
> travel insurance policy and refunded you the full premium amount.ÿ
>
>The full premium will appear on the issuing credit card statement within the next >3 to 5 business days.

Well, well, well.  Has my complaint lodged 4 July 2020 via www.productreview.com.au touched a Cover-More's raw nerve?
Or is it just another "cheque in the mail" device?

12 July 2020 
No sign of any refund, no news from the Cover-More Mediation team.  How typical of them.

Reassuring and well priced.

I have not made a claim with TID fortunately but cannot find a fault with them so far

title: Great value and easy claims!
body:
I've been in the UK for 6 months now and CoverMore was recommended to me by my travel agent. At first I thought I knew better because I found a few cheaper ones, but now I'm glad I went with CoverMore because they have honestly taken great care of me! I've had to claim after we had a flight delay and missed our connecting train, and the claim was easy to process online, the response was quick and the money was in my account shortly after. 
Also, the policy was price matched to a cheaper competitor and I was given snow cover as well which saved me a lot of money! 
I would recommend CoverMore over a lot of competitors as they are easy to claim with and cheapest isn't always best. I find they provide good value for money and when it's price matched, it shows they care about their customers.

title: Smooth claim process - a good experience
body:
Had a good experience with Travel Insurance Direct and the claim company Cerberus recently.

Two claims in North America ? one night in a hotel, a very expensive doctor room call and transport costs in LA due to my wife not feeling well enough to continue to our destination after the flight from Australia ? and the other from an accidentally shattered iPhone screen, requiring replacement from Apple in Canada.

We submitted the documentation when we returned from the trip and were paid for both claims within two weeks. It was the first time we've had to claim on travel insurance, so was glad that it went smoothly.
paid claim quickly

title: Claim was handled efficiently w/o problems.
body:
Given my age, existing medical conditions and fact I travelled to USA (all of which made it expensive), the policy value was as expected.
It was easy to set up.
It is important you read all the terms and conditions - they were clearly set out in the PDS.
Responses to both my enquiries for assistance was prompt and helpful.

title: Hmmm, trying to get a claim sorted but no joy
body:
I had bought their travel insurance and unfortunately had to claim due to flight cancellation and medical health.
Firstly they treat each incident as a separate claim even though it was on one trip - presumably so they can deduct excess twice and avoid some payout.
Trying to get them to answer emails or phone is difficult. One claim was settled quite quickly (Medical incident) and thought ok second part would be not far behind. Chased them up after sending them the additional information requested as it was 13 days (quoted within 10 business days) since they confirmed receipt. Well I then get an email saying "they are pleased to advise that they will be paying out...."etc. However, this was referring to the part of the claim that they had already settled 12 days earlier! They have not responded to the emails regarding the cancelled flight part of the claim. Phoned and was on hold for a while...then told I would have to be transfered to another person as she (Abby) couldn't open file....was transfered back to Abby, who, surprisingly, could now see file and said it was still being investigated...why??? they had all the details they had requested, so should have been a simple decision. Still waiting on a) response, b) decision and c) payout!!! Will advise people to not use them in the future.

title: It was a mistake to be their customer,with this company you are just by yourself,judge it yourself
body:
Cover more company does not keep its promises. They say many things in their advertisements, but when one goes in a situation to claim his right, they are not responsive. 
I have been faithful customer for this company, and I never had a situation to claim until recently 

I was on holiday in Iran where I was rubbed by 3 men on 19/11/2013, they were armed and they took my mobile, brand new computer, my computer bag, my tablet and wallet which I had some money and document in it, anyway I called the police and they came. 

I never had experience like this, I called cover more customer service and they ask what I have to do and they advise me to go to their website to submit my claim online as it is easier and faster. As my computer was stolen, I had to wait till I come back home (Australia) to submit my claim on 28/11/2013. It was written on their website that claims will be respond within 10 working days. 
 
And the story began.

On 09/12/2013 I received an email from Claim officer which ask for some information,

What we require:

 1: Obtain and forward a letter from the mobile network service provider confirming that the loss / theft was reported to them and that the phone connection was barred.

 2: Forward the receipt for your new replacement mobile.  If you have not replaced the phone, please let us know as we are presently obtaining a replacement quote and if economical we will exercise the option to replace your mobile phone.

3: Please completely fill in the attached claim form and send it back to us with the above information



I called the customer service and explained that I have filled the form online and she mention it was some issue on their website, and some of my information is blank!!!!,( which anybody who fills online claim ,knows , that wouldn't  be happen from my side because I cant press submit if I don't fill all the section) , 

I did answer all the questions and I filled all the form and document and send that email by 13/12/2013 again

After taking so long (from 28/11/2013), I called few times and filled the enquiry form in website few times and mention I am not responsible for some issue from their side and they answers on calls and emails were, WE WILL REVIEW YOUR CASE WITH PRIORITY 


And I have receive another email from the same claim officer today which is 27/12/2013 which need some information 
And guest what???? They requested same information again!


1: Obtain and forward a letter from the mobile network service provider confirming that the loss / theft was reported to them and that the phone connection was barred.!!!!!!!!!!
 

 2: Forward the receipt for your new replacement mobile.  If you have not replaced the phone, please let us know as we are presently obtaining a replacement quote and if economical we will exercise the option to replace your mobile phone. !!!!!!!!!!

3:Please note we are currently obtaining quotes for a possible replacement of your electronic items. (They have to do this and I don?t know really what I have to do for this, maybe it is another trick to just make me to give up, or just waste time)



When I call customer service and he refuses to connect me to his supervisor, he was not able to answer none of my questions, and all he said was I don't know!!!! , 


In the end 
Its more than 4 weeks and no claim, no answer, and remember 10 working days claim on their website is just when you don't claim, because they do what ever they can to make you give up, and take as much as time that they want, and my advise to you is If you want to claim just record all your calls, keep all the emails, you will be surprise when you comeback to their answers and excuses every time


Cover more, never again, never again, never again

body:

title: READ THE FINE PRINT!!!
body:
We arranged cover in November 2017 for a planned trip in May 2018. We completed the full disclosure and were accepted without exclusions. In April 2018 just 4 weeks before we were due to travel I was diagnosed with bladder cancer Fortunately it was superficial and was removed. The specialist issued a letter to say this and that I was fit to travel. We contacted InsureandGo to advise them of the change in circumstances and they tried to push us towards cancellation of our trip however to do this we had to obtain a letter from a doctor to say that I was not fit to travel. A contradiction of the letter I sent them already. Next we were told that if we travelled we would have bladder cancer excluded or we had to pay a 400% increased premium. Next they told us that all pre-existing conditions we disclosed would be excluded including my wife who was not associated with this illness. They have now agreed that they will provide some level of cover excluding bladder cancer or anything that may be associated with  it.
We took the cover at the time of booking our holiday in case there was a change of circumstances however it seems that this is just an opportunity for InsureandGo to reassess their risk and impose a huge increase in premium. If the doctor had advised against travel we would not have considered travel however this was not the case.

May 6th 2018 Update: Read the fine print

We asked the Sales Team Leader at InsureandGo to review the decision to exclude the recent illness I had suffered, which was 6 months after we arranged our policy and just a few weeks before we are due to travel. My specialist has advised in writing that I am fir to travel otherwise we would not go. The response was
" We have the right to change the conditions of your policy in line with the change of risk. Your newly declared bladder cancer does represent a change of risk and the system determined that the risk equated to a medical premium of $2,185.05because with cancer there is always a possibility of relapse or associated issues" 
Note it was the system that determined the extra premium and no consideration is given by a medically qualified person that there is very limited risk. The simple solution is to try and extort a 400% extra premium or simply tell us that this part of the policy no longer applies.
InsureandGo are aware that we are not able to arrange insurance with another provider, particularly at this late notice and it is just a way of extracting a huge premium increase.

When you arrange your cover do not assume that you are protected because if your circumstances change you could end up without any cover at all by the time you go on holidays or could end up with thousands of dollars in increased premium. WHAT A JOKE!

May 9th 2018 Update: Read The Fine Print

Dear Sales Team Leader ([name removed])

Well there you go. Despite the letter from the specialist urologist that I provided in the hope that you would see reason, it is obvious that you and/or your company is "bloody minded" and arrogant.  You are clearly of the opinion that you know more that the Specialist Urologist who for the record has just provided another letter that I sent to you saying "he has superficial bladder cancer which had been adequately treated and cured but his ongoing treatment involves Mitomycin medications instilled in his bladder (now completed). This treatment is only precautionary and in no way implies that he still has bladder cancer. His cancer has been adequately treated and eradicated and the precaution treatment of Mitomycin should not affect his insurance as it is not an essential treatment but an optional precautionary treatment only. In addition the treatment will not result in any side effects that should affect his travel"

Your options you provided us in response to this are:
1.	We accept your exclusion for bladder cancer "and anything related', as deemed by your company
2.	We pay the extortion fee of $2185.05 for us to have the cover we arranged in November 2017 reinstated
3.	We go elsewhere (with just 5 days before we are due to travel)

June 10th 2018 Update: Read the small print

Insureandgo put us through hell before we left on our holiday. Arranged cover in November 2017. Am unexpected medical incident occurred in April 2018 and we notified Insureandgo. 1 month before we were due to leave they suggested we cancel or pay an extra $2,700 in premium (400% increase) or exclude anything related even though the specialist issued a letter to say I was cured and fit to travel. Insureandgo refused to accept the specialist advice. We went without cover for any related event although we had major concerns on how any claim would be treated based on their inflexible approach to this matter. Fortunately nothing occurred however we will never use them again nor will many of my friends as they too were of the view that once cover was arranged then any change in circumstance would be covered and not seen as an opportunity to extort a huge increase in premium.

Overall, spent over 15 hours doing their job. Asking the right questions, obtaining info & I initiating alternative measures for resolution!
They didn't follow-up on verbal or written commitments (all recorded) or answer emails comprehensively or hand over to next shift correctly, if at all. They promised a physio which they did not deliver, & set-up what felt like little traps along the way. I asked if we should seek secondary medical advice to avoid compromising the case due to timelines... Not only did they advise no, they didn't meet timelines & said we needed secondary advice at the 11th hour..

I was told they had millions of customers so it was hard to get back to us, meaning they are taking on more clients than they are willing to resource for. 
The nurse was rude & contradicted herself on previous comms, as fud several of the case workers we dealt with. It felt like were trying to make it as hard as possible to follow-up so we would give-up!

I have dealt with many insurance companies and NEVER experienced anything as sloppy, unprofessional & stressful as this.

They admitted it was poorly handled & could take a lot of learnings but refused to compensate the customer as their misconduct may have jeopordised her outcome.

They even refused to call the airline to ask if they would help out if good-will considering the circumstances (as supposedly they didn't have anyone with the authority to rectify).
They said the airline would be very unlikely to support them, which also suggests their reputation with third parties is very poor.

Please do not waste your money, but more importantly do not put yourself or your loved ones through the horrific & stressful circumstances that may result from having to interact with this company.

Their overall rating is poor & they love to refer to the fine print once a claim arises.

At a high level this is a company that over-promises & under-delivers!!

It is my opinion they target customers that don't read every word in the fine print (even though that didn't support my case) & people that trust insurance companies as they have never experienced an incident prior or have had a positive experience with another provider!

It is a shame I cannot give zero stars, the fact 1 is the minimum & they sit at 1.4 says it all!!

Do yourself a favour.. Do some research & look elsewhere.. I hope nobody else has to experience what we have!

title: Totally Unconscionable Conduct
body:
We have used this insurer for many years and most recently I took out a policy in mid-January for travel to USA in mid-April. When the travel ban was introduced I requested cancellation & a refund I too got the "sorry, you're outside the 14 day cooling off period" response. I pointed out that the policy I bought did not cover pre-travel Cancellation risks and so Insure&Go had ZERO risk until I stepped on the plane. That made no difference. I used the analogy that if I took out insurance on a car I was planning buy & then the purchase fell through, how could an insurer keep the premium? That made no difference either. 
I escalated the problem to their Complaints Dept who undertook to provide a response in 15 working days. Having not received a reply in that timeframe I advised that I was taking my complaint to "Stage 2". I'm now up to 28 days with still no response from them. 
I have also written to Choice Magazine and the State Govt who promote this insurer as part of the Seniors program.
I am now only a few days away from the 45 calendar days referred to in the Insurance Code of Conduct when I can refer my case to AFCA (Australian Financial Complaints Authority). 
Having worked in the insurance industry for 40+ years, I am totally confident that AFCA will not tolerate this totally unconscionable conduct. It's just going to take time but ultimately WE WILL WIN and we will also remember who not to insure with on our next trips!

Under 5 mins to easily set up
Policy was very competitively priced and seemed to tick all the boxes I required for my 1 week stay
Will use them again for travel insurance

title: complete lack of care and communication - draining and stressful experience
body:
my daughter went overseas for 12 months and even though a student spent over $2000 for full cover. She got extremely ill in South America and was diagnosed with Ulcerative colitis. The doctors could not speak english and she was alone and frightened in a scary country. I brought her home in January this year and 9 months later are stilling waiting compensation and have been struggling with covermore ever since. Our doctor here diagnosed a bacterial colitis after a trip down the amazon and we have every receipt they asked for. ( after they lost originals and luckily we kept copies!!!) We do not get calls, emails are never answered and the information they have asked for is frustrating and I feel they are hoping we will go away....After signing forms (twice when they gave us incorrect forms) to get her Entire medcal history they now advise us they are contacting the doctors in the emergency room in south america to get 'more' information and yet again another ten days before they even answer emails though this time has taken 3 weeks. I have complained in emails and passed on my frustration and noone has ever bothered to contact myself or my daughter to see if she ok. My daughter is going away again and we will not be using Covermore or recommending this to any of her many friends who travel. Only asking for what she was insured for and refund of medical expenses and cancelled flights....considering the fee she paid would think would not be a huge issue!

No service at all - never able to get a proper answer and stressful and time consuming

title: Medibank declined my claim because my mum had a surgery
body: Medibank travel insurance declined my claim because my mum had a surgery so we need to cancel my family trip and go to the hospital to take care of her.

title: Repeat customer
body: It is always easy to buy online and the value is excellent.  This is my third policy and thankfully I haven't had any reason to claim, but I hope if something did happen (touch wood...LOL) the handling of the claim would be easy too...

title: Trip to South Africa
body: I had difficulty obtaining travel insurance because of a heart condition.  If InsureandGo had not provided me with full cover I would not have been able to join my group of friends going to South Africa.

title: Dishonest and expensive insurer
body: Another Covid 19 case.  When my cruise was cancelled I asked for either a refund or a credit for my cruise cover from May 19 to June 8.  The Certificate states that the policy runs from these dates, but now the company says they were actually 'covering' me from January when I paid for the coverage, and therefore they only need to give me a $50 credit because I was "covered" from January 2020 until I advised the trip had been cancelled in May.  This makes no sense.  It is just a specious practice to circumvent granting the credit for a policy not used.

title: Good product @ a competitive price
body: We purchased a travel insurance policy for our recent trip to South America. The website was easy to navigate, the price was competitive and the policy covered all of the requirements for our adventure travel itinerary. We did not need to make a claim against the policy.

title: Really appalling insurance company
body: Don't touch them. They take 14 days to even look at your claim. I lodged my claim online and telephoned them to check they had all the documents they required (I was told  "yes"). 2 weeks later they request additional documentation (a stalling tactic to hang on to my funds indefinitely). Another 2 weeks now while they sit on their hands refusing to pay out. Insurance companies like Covermore give the whole insurance industry a bad name. Sharks. I believe that the positive reviews on this site aren't submitted by customers, they're false ones submitted by Covermore.

title: Affordable price
body: This is my second time purchased  with InsureandGo . I felt safe and not much to worry while I?m on holiday . Price was affordable not overpriced. Never lodge the claim yet and hope I do not need it but at least I got a backup.

title: Effective, reasonable; don't leave home without it.
body: I found setting up my cover very easy due to the extremely helpful staff. Value was excellent, cover was all that I needed, and I have no complaints at all about TID.

title: Good value and convenient
body: I feel the policies are of good value.  I have purchased InsureandGo travel insurance to the US three times now.  Once I needed to extend my policy and made a call to the customer service center.  I would have liked to had the option of speaking to someone earlier in the call and not having to go through all the automation because then I had to wait a bit after that. But in the end, they were able to help me with my extension.

title: I wanted insurance that would cover me for my specific needs and Allianz seems to have done just tha
body: The policy covered all of my needs and conditions of travel. It was well priced and easy to set up and complete on line. I also believe Allianz is a major insurance company and hoped that they would have good global coverage if I needed to make a claim.

title: User friendly quote conditions clearly listed
body: Good value policy, easy to navigate website. All. Conditions clearly listed, for easy selection of the most suitable policy.

title: Peace of mind
body: I travelled recently including the hire of a car, and although l didn't need to make a claim, it gave me peace of mind to know l was covered if things went wrong. Coverage was easy to set up and communication from 1Cover was excellent.

title: I didn't need it, but it sure felt good having it and so reasonably priced.
body: I think my title says it all. Compared to my health insurance company and other 'big' companies, this was so inexpensive. It's great to travel with this kind of security.

title: Easy to book
body: I?ve used this travel insurance several times and found it very easy to book online. I will continue to use them.

title: The gold option is perfect for this trip
body: The gold policy suited this trip much cheaper than other insurances we had looked at Use insure and go all the time as it is one option for seniors Im not over confident using computers but this policy was very easy to do

title: Quick and easy
body: I have used 1 Cover on a couple of occasions and I have been really happy with how easy it is to apply online.  The prices are very reasonable and they offer a lot more cover than other companies that I got quotes from.  Luckily I didn't have to make a claim on my most recent holiday but I wouldn't hesitate recommending 1 Cover to people thinking about traveling overseas.

title: Pack your passport, toothbrush, plane tickets and Cover-More policy .... tick, tick, tick and tick!
body:
Saved me the disappointment of missing out on so many good photo opportunities when my waterproof camera went kaput in a pool of all places on the first day of my trip. I had bought it especially for this trip as i knew we would be doing lots of watersports and i wanted to capture that. When my camera broke i had no qualms buying another so i could capture great memories for the rest of my trip - i knew Cover-More would have me covered and they did in an easy to organise, streamlined process.
Good level of cover on all policy aspects.

title: Easy to set up and good value for money
body: Sign up process was easy. Good coverage. Had no need to make a claim. Will consider using Allianz in the future. Cant think of anything else to say, but necessary to have thirty words. Don?t know why.

title: First time user
body: I felt our policy was good value. We found the questions were not clear enough and ended up being denied some cover owing to a misunderstanding a question, which we called and tried to fix 3 times. The phone support staff were good to talk to but some of the health questions may be beyond their understanding.

title: Massive difference in prices quoted by two different operators
body:
We had a fantastic experience on our first time getting a quote with insureandgo. We have pre-existing medical conditions that needed to be covered which were. The medical premium was also a very good price. We missed locking in that quote by one day, and had to go through the process again. We provided all the same information and we ended up with a quote for the pre-existing medical conditions that was about 4 times the original quote. They couldn't explain why and would not honour the previous quote. 
Went to a competitor with equal coverage and got a much better deal.

title: Very happy with travel insurance and claiming.
body: We were very happy with Travel Insurance Direct there policy was very competitive .  We have used them five times and never had to make a claim. However on our last holiday my dear old Mum passed away and we had to come home early for obvious reasons.  We found them very helpful.  Claiming for extra travel expenses and refunding of already paid accommodation was relatively easy and we thank them for their quick payment and compassion.

title: Very quick and easy to do online
body: I've been purchase my holiday insurance every year though Insurance and Go and have had no issues at all. I find it Affordable, easy And quick to do online. Highly recommend

title: DEBACLE -  THIS IS A RORT! SHAME ON COMM BANK
body:
We made the mistake of utilising this insurance . We activated it before travelling with our 2 young  children overseas and due to a delayed flight missed the connecting flights back to Australia. After calling the insurance helpline that night - we found that it was manned by one person  who had no idea about the travel insurance policies and could offer no assistance whatsoever unless it was a medical emergency. We then came home and put in a claim for the new tickets home - which were same price as the original tickets. After months of paperwork shuffling which we had to chase up from day one..I was informed by some teenage rep from allianz that our claim whilst "legitimate'our claim for those tickets  would not be paid as the letter from the airline re the delay which we obtained was not clear enough about the cause for the delay. Apparently...it would have been fine if we were hi jacked (unlikely) We are now left to ask the Comm bank for assistance on the failed product we took out through them. 
Their answer -take it up with your insurer Allianze/comm bank.
 Allianz answer - take it up with the airline...
the airlines answer - we provided proof so take it up with the insurer. 

What a joke. After years of handing money over for a mortgage and business account and insurance the one time we ask for assistance from this bank and they stonewall you. They don't even give a toss when you say you will move your accounts elsewhere. The customer support was patronising and abysmal. This bank is a joke and this insurance policy is an expensive joke. Do not rely on it and certainly don't trust that they will assist if you do and actually have to make a claim. They will pass the buck like nobody business...they cannot claim Can as their attitude.Its an inside joke to anyone who has dealt with the true nature of this institution.

title: Purchase
body: Our policy was great value and really easy to set up, we didn't need to make any claim so can't comment on that side of the cover yet. This isn't the first time we have used 1Cover and some of our family members also use them.

title: Looked good at first
body: The premium was very attractive so I started my application - then "Natural Disasters" was optional and at extra cost, huh?  I bought the policy anyway and read it more closely.  I then discovered in the General Exclusions that they "will not cover claims if you or any insured person on your policy has in the last 5 years: ...been referred to or seen by a hospital doctor, specialist or surgeon (other than an accident or emergency doctor)" - and this applies to all sections of the policy.  No, that was enough for me, how many other pitfalls are buried in the 54 page PDS?  I cancelled the policy and went with a different insurer.

title: Felt secure with this policy
body: Offered a good coverage with out a lot of difficulty and reasonably clear about the details also made me fill easier rather then using my credit card insurance which was a concern due to bad reviews at times

title: No claim but no hassle
body: Having not made a claim its difficult to comment on the whole package, but organising and purchasing the policy was very easy and confidence building.  I will use again next trip.

title: Modest price for a great product - highly recommend
body:
Great value and excellent customer service.
Excellent customer service over the phone and also via live chat.
Highly recommend this great product that I have used time and time again when I travel domestic or internationally. 
I have even taken up the discount by recommending my friends.

title: 1Cover is the only cover you need!!!
body:
Will never leave Aus without having Travel Insurance. As we are frequent travels 1cover is simple, easy to use with competitive pricing. We made a small claim once & it was hassle free and all covered. I feel at peace and mind and can enjoy our holidays more knowing my family & I are covered and if something does happen it will be covered by 1Cover and they are only a phone call away and extremely helpful. I will continue with 1Cover when ever we travel.
Competitive prices and inexpensive as we travel one to twice a yr
I can not vault 1Cover at all!!!!

title: Absolutely necessary
body: Needed to cancel my trip due to a medical condition that arose prior to my departure, rang and found the staff very helpful have aready insured my next two trips with covermoe.

title: Peace of mind
body: We always get travel insurance even when travelling at home. It covers your car rental excess to. Better to be safe than sorry. We haven't had to use it yet but it's there incase we do.

title: Low cost Insurance with good reviews
body:
We have used Insure & Go approximately 6 times over the past five years for both overseas and domestic travel and although we have never had to make a claim, we have always felt confidant that we were adequately covered. 
As we are now into our seventies, premiums with other Insurers became quite expensive. However, the premiums offered by Insure & Go were much more reasonable and affordable. We were reassured by numerous good reports/reviews.
Taking out our policies has always been simple and well explained.

title: Courteous and Thorough
body: We had to cancel a planned trip to Vietnam because of Covid-19. Travel insurance had been taken out well before the outbreak became known and therefore Medibank Travel Insurance covered the cost of the deposit that was not refunded by the travel company we had used. Claim was straightforward to lodge and was handled quite quickly.

title: VERY DISAPPOINTED
body:
This started around the 23rd June "Where do I start"
 Had to make a claim first time ever. After discussing via phone I was advised to email all information. They received information then requested more information which I had already sent in the first place.  As anyone knows that has to claim it is very time consuming stressful and frustrating .We had told them on the phone that it was for accommodation due to not being able to fly home on the dates due to flights being cancelled we provided all the information requested to claim back 2 nights accommodation no problem they say  just fill out form and scan in all documents required and we will process it yeah I thought this is too easy well I was right.
 Today received an email that read  as per attached letter the claim has been rejected. Well to start with no letter attached to the email  I feel they had no intention of paying this and they just wasted my time saying it was going to be  processed as all the information was advised on the phone why could I not be told prior to getting all receipts flight schedules  scanning passports etc that they would not be paying. I will never and advise any other people to not take out Travel Insurance with this company. I should have known by some previous reviews I wish I had went with my first instinct and paid a higher premium to go with a legit insurance company as the people we travelled with have been able to claim all their costs back through their insurance. 
These company's  don't mind taking your money but do not like giving any back. Oh well we all learn from our mistakes never again TICK INSURANCE (INSURE & GO)

title: Couldn't be happier!
body:
It's easy to apply for Travel Insurance with Cover-More, and quotes are competitive. The staff on the end of the phone are helpful and do what they say they will do.
The claims process is quick and easy. Who could ask for more! Thank you Cover-More!

title: Value and service fantastic.
body: I have been using TID for  over 5  years now and wouldn't use any other company. There prices have always been lower than any other company and we claimed medical expenses once & had no issues and the claim was paid within 2 weeks.

title: Seniors'Overseas Travel
body: I have used InsureandGo for several overseas visits and have been comforted by Choice Magazine recommendations. The real test is however is when one makes a claim.  In fifty years of overseas travel I had not had a claim but on the last trip this year we had urgent medical problems in Europe and ran up significant expenses.  While the application/claim procedure is understandably complex but thorough, InsureandGo dealt with our submission promptly and professionally.  There was no unnecessary resistance or dispute and our claim was met in full. I will use them on my next trip.

title: Excellent value.
body: First time using this insurance company but definitely wont be the last.  Customer service were a pleasure to deal with and they knew their products and found exactly what we needed.

title: Great - for when you need it
body: This is the second time I've purchased a policy. I've always bought travel insurance, but never needed it until I got unwell on the previous trip. I thought it would be a hassle to claim, but all went well and now they are my go to travel insurers!

title: cover
body: After nearly being stranded in Melbourne due to plane delays at midnight on Friday night, I was disgusted to discover that your policy does not cover my accommodation if I was stranded. It is ludicrous that because my plane was delayed due to a technical fault, I am not covered!  How is it my fault if the plane is delayed for that reason? After being a customer for many years, I will certainly not be obtaining another insurance policy through your company

title: Tassie Trip
body: Didn't have to use it, so no idea is it's any good or not.  I thought it was a bit expensive for what it was, but I was short of time and didn't get the opportunity to shop around.

title: Very satisfied with recent claim.Communications excellant.
body: Value for money,Will certainly use this company next time and recommend them ,A satisfied Senior. Very good,Kept abreast of my claim,with no problems at all.My first experience with this company,

title: Relaxed in knowing I'm covered
body: I felt the policy I had chosen was well suited for the holiday lifestyle and activities done in New Zealand. And I felt at ease during the trip knowing I was covered.

title: Cheap, But Covers Next To Nothing
body:
TID is reasonable priced, although not the cheapest. However, their comprehensive cover is far from comprehensive.
Virgin Australia has cancelled the flight due to operational issues (they would not disclose exact reason of cancellation) and I had to arrange alternative flight at an extra cost. Well, have a guess... TID does not cover this.
They only cover cancellation costs due to bad weather, natural disaster, riot, hijacking, strike or civil commotion.
However, companies like AAMI cover all cancellations due to circumstances out of your control.
Well, TID is not going to get my business anymore.

title: Cover-up by Covermore-threatened by Ombudsman-they paid in one day-after 4 months stalling
body:
[name removed] mentions an 'internal complaint& claims appeal process.This is the first tome I have heard of this. Indeed [name removed]  the phone no. given to the Ombudsman purporting to be this appeal centre is just another call centre, where no-one will give their full name and their only response after consulting for 20 minutes with the supervisor was 'send another email'Why? they had 'misplaced' the previous 4.On reporting this to the ombudsman he made a few phone calls & the result: an email from Covermore saying the money will be in the bank in3 days
Please everyone with a legitimate complaint, register it with the Ombudsman, or such firms will get away with the bland assertions by people paid to do PR that 'most people are happy' Most people are just too busy to keep ringing about poor service.
I have only just joined productreview-I rarely complain about anything, but I hate being treated like a fool
Thank you productreview!

non-existent internal dispute centre, and appalling service

title: Don?t holiday without it
body: Value for money, easy to set up and easy to understand policy, excellent service and peace of mind, made traveling an breeze.

title: Great
body: Yes good policy filled out all online. Didn't need to use the customer support however was pleased I had the insurance as gave some reassurance as doctors were expensive on the trip if you needed them.

title: Not what I expected
body: On purchasing this policy, I was informed that the motorbike was not cover for repairs and we were not covered if we needed medical assistance. Understood but asked that if anything went wrong our accommodation and ferry cost would be covered under this policy. I was told yes they are covered. Image my surprise when I rang when the bike broke down to told our lost accommodation was not covered as we were not sick. So then we were not covered for literally anything. So unable to claim.

title: Fantastic company to deal with...
body:
I found that my experience with Cover More was much better than expected.  Unfortunately, insurance companies do get a lot of bad press about not paying claims without a fight, etc but I found that this was definately not the case here.....My claim was processed quickly and efficiently once the required information was received and I would have no hesitation in using Cover More every time I travel.  Thank you.
The ease and speed with which the claim was processed.

title: Easy to set up (but couldn't put in the discount code)
body:
I thought the policy was easy to set up online, but once again, I couldn't find the spot to enter a code word for a competition and discount.
Please make this clearer.  I checked twice, and in the end gave up and purchased the policy without entering.

title: Peace of Mind
body: A cheap and easy to set up travel insurance that gives peace of mind should there be an emergency and knowing that it's backed by a company with a solid reputation.

title: TID- THEY WERE THERE WHEN WE NEEDED THEM!
body:
We have taken TID insurance for several overseas trips, and in 2017 we took an extended trip to Europe travelling in a hired motorhome. While in France my wife suddenly became unwell and required an ambulance and surgery in hospital. TID responded to my phone calls immediately and the emergency operator was sympathetic to the situation, providing all the advice and assistance we needed. 

Later in the trip, another motorhome collided with us in England and damaged our motorhome?s mirror fittings. Another claim was required, and again, the emergency response operator was sympathetic and provided all the necessary advice and support.

\When we returned to Australia I submitted our two claims, providing all the required documentation. TID processed our claims promptly and without a fuss. Our Travel Insurance Direct experience could not have been better. This was our first time experiencing the TID claims process and we could not have been happier. We will definitely be insuring with them for our next trip.

title: Easy travel  insurance for people 'in their prime'
body: My daughter made enquiries, we called back answered a few questions and bingo we were covered. This was further peace of mind that all would be fine should we need assistance during the trip!

title: Good value and convenience
body: It was a good value policy with clear terms for Asia. It was easy to set-up online. I have not used customer support nor not made any claims, so cannot comment

title: Value for Money
body:
The policy was bought to cover a domestic holiday on the way back from overseas. Was easy to buy and covered all areas we required.
Represented value for money and while we did not have a claim we were happy with the policy.
Test is always if you have a claim.

title: Did not respond to my claim!
body: Very disappointing service from company. Submitted a claim and received a confirmation that I would receive correspondence within 10 days. 2 months later and I have still been left in the dark! Tried to check the status of my claim with my policy number and claim reference code that I was given, and it says my claim does not exist and that I need to contact them on the phone. Never trusting Allianz with my travel insurance again.

title: Good Value
body:
I have used Insureandgo several times. The set up was a bit drawn out as I have existing conditions but the support staff took the hassle out of it.
I have made one successful claim in which the only problem was that they would not accept a report was not available even though I stated this it time it was requested

title: Medical and airfare claims
body: I had some medical claims while admitted to a hospital in Colombo while on vacation. These claims were attended to within a short span of time. As a result of my medical problem, I had to forgo a  paid booked flight and cancel it. This claim too was settled very quickly. I am impressed with the efficiency and manner in which my claims were handled.

title: Straightforward & easy to understand
body: No nonsense & jargon free terminology. We didn't need bells & whistles, but if you do, they are there. I'd buy this product again as it is very affordable compared to other insurance policies

title: Still waiting for claim to be processed. Really slow.
body: Took out travel insurance with Travel with Jane, with 0 access fee (paid extra for this). During our trip, one of the flight got cancelled due to bad weather (all flights out of the airport got cancelled), had to travel to another city to be able to continue with the journey as airlines could not offer another flight till 2 days after (which would've only meant we had a night to spend at the destination. Lodged travel claim to claim back for the accommodation we had to spend over at the other city (as our accommodation could not offer refund as we cancelled on them last minute), difference in airfare (for having to fly with another airline to the destination), and the travel cost to travel over to the other airport. It's been over 2 weeks since i lodged my claim, and it took them over a week to reply back to me requesting for more information, and now they haven't even replied to my email. Not even sure what the point of taking out travel insurance was. I also had unfortunately to see a doctor whilst on my holiday, and that claim hasn't even been addressed yet either. It probably will end up taking forever.

title: Thankfully it wasn't needed.
body: Got insurance just in case while site seeing on scooter in Bali. Thankfully it wasn't needed, but didn't want to risk not being covered. Enjoyed our holiday without the risk of not being covered.

title: Good cover but limited to 90 days.
body: Good, cost effective if doing trips less than 90 days and clear conditions. Extending beyond the 90 days was expensive but easy to organise through the online web site.  No claims made so we cannot comment on the efficiency of this aspect.

title: Worth less than the paper it wasn't even written on.
body: I tried to claim once, my brother committed suicide & I wanted to travel home to see my family during this hard time. There was a general exclusion relating to suicide. A suicide is something that no one sees coming, so the fact this company had excluded it I simply found sickening. Left me stranded away from my family during a very tough time.

title: Perfect from start to end.
body: I love using 1cover for multiple reasons. Starting with the phenomenal customer service when purchasing the plan. The lady I spoke to was more than helpful as I was having wifi trouble. In addition I felt overwhelmed with the recognition I received for being a past user of this travel insurance. The value for money is fantastic, I can't nor would want to find another company to deal with. Thanks !

title: Good to have....Just in case!
body:
No claim necessary, but felt comfortable if the worst happened, I was covered.
Reasonably priced insurance, good level of cover. Cannot comment on the service level in the event of a claim. Just hope they would honour their policy!

title: Excellent
body:
I would highly recommend to anyone who is travelling to use TID!!! It is a great company!!! At a Fantastic Price!! Nothing online compares to Value for money!!
Easy to use online Insurer, at agreqat price and no fuss!!!!

title: Great value , easy to chose options - used many times when flying overseas
body:
Great value for money,
Have been using OneCover since 2006 and always recommend to friends
Always felt piece of mind having insurance
 - fortunately never had to make a claim..

title: Easy online selection cover
body: Insurance was easy to organize and travel policy cover was competitive with minimum fuss and very good value. Have never claimed and this is my 3rd time cover with Insureandgo

title: Easy to use
body: Third time I?ve used this product and the set up is easy, email confirmation immediate and the app is very easy to use

title: Similar to other customers, WORST travel insurance company. AVOID like the plague.
body:
It's been 2 months since I lodged my insurance claim for delayed luggage and items stolen from my luggage and they are yet to pay my claim. I've had to now refer this to the ombudsman, AFCA. 

5 stars for ease of purchase, 1 STAR for their claims process. This is literally yet another JUNK insurance policy brought to you by Allianz!

title: Cover More? Should be called.....Cover Less.
body: Policy was very expensive. When we had to cancel our trip for health reasons, ( Open Heart Surgery ). It took an enormous amount of effort to get our money back, adding to the stress of surgery, also we didn't get it all back, they kept changing amount of payment. I received 3 different offers. Now they want my Credit Card Provider name and statements, to request contribution from my claim. ( I think they are being funny) .Any one with problems, you can contact Insurance Legal Advise. ( it is a free service) / or the Ombusdman. Don't contact Complaints Cover More.

title: A very happy customer.
body: This is the 3rd time we have used 1 Cover and have found the on line application, payment and claiming to be fast, easy and hassle free. It is excellent value, especially when you consider it extends to hire cars. We have made 2 small claims and the process was simple and stress free, leaving us very happy with the outcome. So needless to say we will be going with 1 Cover the next time we travel.

title: A excellent policy
body:
I have been using 1 Cover for my family for a number of years .
I have only had to make 1 claim for myself whilst overseas.
At that time the phone staff where very helpful and organized all my medical and flights.
The policies are very easy to view and over all a very good company.

title: Very Satisfied
body: Yes I looked at a few policies online and found you were very reasonable,  it was very easy to set up online, I did not need to claim so cannot comment there

title: Confidence in this company
body: Good value easy to set up. Customer service was exemplary with emails updating support during my ten day stay in China. Glad to know they were there if I needed them.  Cheers

title: Great, as always.
body:
We've used 1Cover on several occasions and only needed to make a claim on one occasion.  Claiming was made relatively easy and staff  very pleasant to deal with.  We're impressed with the range of pre-existing conditions covered and the policy is easy to set up.  We'll certainly continue to use 1Cover for our future travels.

January 9th 2018 Update: Very satisfied long time client of 1Cover. Brigadier21

I've been remiss in not submitting a review until now. 12 months ago,  I booked and paid for a trip to Israel and Jordan for end of October 2017.  Unfortunately I needed major surgery and shortly before I was due to depart,  found I wasn't going to be up to a hectic itiniery.  I advised 1Cover shortly before departure who gave me a claim number via email.  I sent off the required paperwork and didn't hear anything for a couple of weeks.  I presumed the claim would take quite some time to confirm the support documents I'd provided but no, a couple of days later I received an email advising that my claim had been sent off to be checked and the full amount less excess would be paid into my bank account.   Thank you 1Cover for making what could have been a stressful experience so easy.  You really are THE BEST.  And I love how easy it is to set up the policy online.

title: a great product for travellers
body: We found that this product suited our needs very well. Always kept informed. Luckily didn't have to claim, but would expect that wouldn't have been any issue.Would recommend to any persons travelling.

title: Thankx
body: I was very happy with the help I received from the people I spoke with regarding my Travel Insurance. They made the process easy and were courteous  when explaining the cover. Have not lodged a claim or used this company before.

title: almost Excellent
body:
Did you feel your policy was good value? will not know until after the trip and if we needed to use this travel policy. 
Was your policy easy to set up? Online service was down, reason for Good review, not excellent.
How satisfied are you with the provider's Customer Support?Customer service agent was excellent, knowledgeable, friendly and professional.

title: The best one
body:
I have to say, the 1Cover is the best insurance company which I experienced.
Response was so quick. My inquiring by email always be answered in 30 mins. My God, I love it.
2 Months ago, I hit a kangaroo in evening when I was driving a rental car. After accident, the Herzt charged me a high excess fee. I asking some question to Herzt, they almost never have any response until email them twice or third. High excess fee is the profit to them as I know, why they still look like unhappy? title: (( Scam Insurance )) that doesn't cover the important things you think it would
body:
My pensioner father who had saved his money for his first overseas trip, made the mistake of booking his trip through the Flight Centre , Who advised him to use Cover-More travel insurance. My father had paid out thousands of dollars for his holiday. He arrived at Brisbane airport to find that his flight was  cancelled. Disappointed but thinking at least he had taken out insurance, Guess again ! When he tried putting in a claim, he was told by Cover-More insurance that they don't cover him if the plane doesn't fly. He is now out of pocket the money for the flight. The money he paid for his overseas accommodation and the money he paid for the usless insurance.What sort of insurance is that ? 
So why would you bother taking out insurance if it doesn't cover what you would think to be some of the most important things like the holiday being cancelled due to no flight ??
My father is 74 years of age and had saved for his first overseas trip only to be scammed.  Shame on you Cover-More Travel Insurance and Shame on you Flight Centre for using a insurance company who should be called Cover-Less.
I want everyone to be aware of this scam and if taking out travel insurance, ask does it cover you if your flight is cancelled or have you lost all the money you've paid on the holiday, such as flight and holiday accommodation.

title: Absolutely terrible and stressful
body: After being stranded in the Bali Ash cloud, and submitting our claim, there was nothing but problems with my claim. I was told on three separate occasions that the cover was only for one person, this was not true. I have taken out insurance cover every year for approx. 8 years with 1cover and have never made a claim before. We had coverage for 2 people. When I questioned this, they were all sorry "I'll check this out for you." Because we were delayed for 8 days in Bali I had a phone bill of over $250.00 this is not covered apparently, even though all the calls I made were to try and get out of Bali and were made to icover, my work, and Jetstar. They paid out the claim for 1 person and I questioned this again and my claim was escalated to supervisor finally! The remainder of the claim was finally paid into my account but with absolutely no explanation of how this figure was calculated. Appalling, stressful and  time consuming. It just shouldn't be this hard to make a claim. I guess if they make it difficult enough for a claim to go through a lot of people would just give up, and for 1covers bottom line even if a small percentage of customers give up its a good profit. Disgraceful - never again 1cover.

title: Great Product and Service
body:
I just came from a trip in North America where I had a snow mobile accident and fractured my left wrist. I had to go through a procedure to align the fracture and cast it. I initially paid for it and made a claim when I arrived back in Australia. The people at Travel Insurance Direct were very good in explaining the claims process and how to fill out the form and submit the documents.  I submitted everything through email and the process was very seamless.  They processed my claim well within one week and paid out in less than two weeks.  I am so impressed and the staff were very kind, understanding and knowledgeable of the status of my claim.  I strongly recommend Travel Insurance Direct. It was the very first time I was hospitalised and made a claim and I feel that TID helped me each step of the way.
Reliable, Inexpensive, Great Service, Efficient, Clear

title: No Cancellation Cover
body:
I was supposed to fly to Bali, my airline cancelled my flight and didn't alert me until check in. I had purchased insurance through covermore and had paid for extra Cancellation Cover. There was no indication that the Cancellation Cover is actually not really cancellation cover at all. They only cover the cancellation of your journey in a small amount of circumstances. Apparently, your airline not showing up for your flight, is not considered enough of a cancellation to be covered by cancellation insurance.

They are refunding me the full amount I paid, but in reality, I wouldn't trust this company. They expect you to be up front with important information but they are underhanded and secretive about important information that they should be telling you up front. 

The cancellation cover will only cover you if you or a family member living in Australia becomes ill and you have to delay your flight. But if that illness is due to Avian flu, it won't cover you there either.
Nothing at all.
Cancellation Cover is not actually cancellation cover.
