title: Good Reliable Economical Travel Insurance
body: I've.been using I&G for a few years now.  They are my go to company for travel insurance.  Great vale for money.  Good coverage options.  Fairly good on claims, (referring to my one and only claim), but a little time consuming and I'm sure they could easily speed up the process.  Have had general Travel insurance and cruise insurance. On my last trip I completed the online request to buy and clicked pay.  I immedarely realised that the dates had scrolled back to their original settings and my insurance would kick in from the next day.  I frantically emailed them and they sorted my new insurance with minimum fuss and had my refund within the time specified. Highly recommend anyone to use this company.

title: Travel with protection....
body: We always get TID when traveling for the assurance and confidence that if something goes wrong, we will be covered. It's then one less thing to have to worry about especially when we are traveling abroad. We didn't claim this time but have in the past and it was simple, easy and hassle-free.

title: No more worries when travelling overseas
body: I thought the initial price was fair for $100 excess but never thought i would actually need it. Unfortunately my daughter ingested something contaminated and had to be admitted to hospital for 3 days. I knew it would be expensive and emailed TID to see if they could cover the costs for me. After a couple of emails they managed to contact me through the hospital phone with a doctor who talked with the local doctor over the phone. They rang every day to see how my daughter was and if she would need any more treatment. We were able to stay in a room to accomadate me, my wife and daughter so we could stay with her and all costs including the medicines to take home were covered. All staff were friendly and quickly resolved an issue, when the hospital tried charging me the bill, that had already been guaranteed for payment. I will always use TID from now on.

title: Just the job!
body: They made a mistake by issuing insurance for the person who booked it, rather than the person it was for - but they immediately rectified that mistake without fuss. They're obviously small enough (and/or professional enough) to keep an eye on things because we received an email the day before flying home to offer extra cover if we'd decided to extend our stay.  Can't complain about anything - highly recommended and we'll use them again in future.

body:

in order for the "loss " to be acceptable, it must be on your person at the exact time of loss. If it is on your person then it is not lost!! go figure. Gold cover but loss personal items are not covered. 
Dispute process a complete joke I am taking this to the ombudsman. Buyer beware. The free travel insurance you get with your credit card is better than this one

body:

body: Never again will I recommend Cover-More and never again will I take out one of their insurance policies. title: When you need them the most, they are not there for you
body:
I'm very disappointed with my experience with 1Cover. I purchased the comprehensive cover travel insurance from 1Cover thinking I would be covered for any situation that was out of my control while I was overseas, but that wasn't what happened.
While I was travelling abroad my grandma, the person that raised me and one of more important person in my life, passed away in Brazil (where my family live). I had to make changes in my trip and go straight back to Brazil (which was one of the countries that I was covered for in this policy) to attend to her funeral. However 1Cover informed me that they wouldn't pay my claim as my Grandma is not an Australian resident!!! So their policy is not for all Australians or residents as they say, their policy is just and only for Australians with family in Australia.
As an Australian citizen, I would expect to be covered for this, specially because Brazil was one of the countries that was covered for in my policy.
Australia being a country of so many foreign residents with family overseas, how can 1Cover exclude our family that live overseas or make distinction of us who unfortunately cant have the family here in Australia?
I ask: how are Australians with family overseas supposed to be covered while they are travelling? What is the point of all of us, Australians with family overseas, to purchase travel insurance?
And to finalize my discontentment with 1Cover, no one had at least the empathy to answer my email, after a few days, when I called them to ask about it I heard that they were too busy to reply me, but the girl that I talked to had all the information on her computer, it means that they had time to put on her computer but not to reply their customers...
Sad and disappointed 1Cover!

title: Don't fall for the Cover More carrot of a Free Global Sim unless you have plenty of time
body: I purchased Cover More insurance for a 6 week trip to Europe through Flight Centre as I wanted to take advantage of the Cover More free Global Sim offer. I have used their Global Sim in the past and it worked well for me. As soon as the Policy and paperwork was received from Flight Centre I contacted Cover More to order the Global Sim, mindful of the fact that my departure date was in seven days. I communicated directly with a Cover More Representative who assured me that she had ordered the Sim and that I would receive it the following week. Today is Friday and I leave the country on Sunday. No Sim. I rang Cover More and was told by the Representative that I had left her with insufficient time to do anything about the situation! I expressed my dissatisfaction and only at my urging, did the representative make an enquiry to confirm that the Sim had been dispatched through the post and that she couldn't track the package or offer me anything other than an apology. I asked to speak with a manager and she told me that I would receive a call within 90 minutes, further reducing the remaining time to rectify the situation! No call. I have just paid $49.95 for a Prepaid Sim from Australia Post. Don't fall for the carrot of a Free Global Sim from Cover More unless you have plenty of time for it to be received by snail mail once the Cover More Representative decides to despatch it.

title: Good customer service
body: I have bought a number of policies over the last few years but haven't had to make any claims so far. Purchasing the policy online is quick and simple, what I am buying is very clear though I do also scan the PDS to make sure I have the coverage I am seeking. Cost of the policies are very competitive compared to other insurers. I emailed the customer service team and got a quick response to my query. Just to warn people, my brother got very sick in Brazil and required emergency hospital treatment. Apparently in Brazil foreigners need to present something from their travel insurer before treatment will be given. My brother's insurer (NOT Insure and Go) refused multiple requests over three days to provide the required documents to the hospital. When my sister called the insurer to query the delay they refused to speak with her as she wasn't listed as a contact on his policy. It was a very distressing time and I would recommend to everyone they contact their insurer to enquire if family members can be nominated as a contact person for their policy.

title: BUYER BEWARE- Read all the small print in the brochure before you accept Travel Insurance from Allia
body: Do not insure with this company. I paid for Essential Plus Plan A via House of Travel Agent for my planned 4.5month holiday in Australia this year and about 8 weeks into my trip I got sick and was diagnosed with a Gall Bladder/stone. Went to emergency dept of hospital who confirmed this and advised surgery was necessary. Allianz advised "Reciprocal agreement between NZ and Australian Governments means you have to go Public". (this was not mentioned by Travel Agent at time of purchasing). Why do we have to have Medical Insurance then? Allianz unable to answer this question. I was advised to continue with my travels, but always know where hospitals were, stay on main highways only. As I had not paid for bookings, etc. in advance no compensation available. One concern I have is that an Allianz rep claims to have contacted one of the hospital emergency depts. I visited and I did not take their advice - absolutely untrue (could this be Invasion of privacy, and interestingly they did not contact any other hospitals or Drs) The Dr at this hospital did not make this suggestion. Allianz work strictly to their "Small print" have no flexibility. Due to their lack of empathy my holiday became the "HOLIDAY FROM HELL" and was not completed. No Hospital emergency dept knows about this Reciprocal agreement. I was told by Drs "Why are you travelling without travel insurance - not our problem". Could not believe the issues Allianz used. Even called my surgery "elective" although 5 Drs and 3 Hospitals advised different. Allianz claim that if it was an emergency the hospitals would have done it there and then. Not so, Emergency Depts provide pain relief and hope it will settle. By the way Allianz have admitted they could have done things better now I am back in NZ. Don't believe the cover of brochure "Head into the unknown knowing you're prepared." Joke. A reminder to always read the small print.

title: Claiming process a complete nightmare - would not recommend TID to anybody
body:
While  traveling in Japan I got cellulitis. Went to hospital twice to have it diagnosed. I have been corresponding with TID through their claims process for almost two months now. I called their emergency line when it happened, and was told not to worry about having documents translated as they had translators there. So I send in my claim, and guess what the response was - "please have this document (a medical certificate) translated." I respond with exactly what I mentioned previously, and the reply - "We did have our translator have a look over the document however it was still difficult for them to work out the diagnosis."

So I take a photo of the document and put it through Google translate and get this - "At the right lower leg bee or cellulitis above diagnosis is expected to take a medical treatment by about two weeks of antibiotic from September 9, 2015." Unsure if the translator at TID can actually read Japanese, but the diagnosis seems pretty clear to me. At the hospital it was hard to communicate with the doctors as limited English was spoken. I can definitely rule out a bee sting, and on further research of what cellulitis is - a bacterial infection of the skin, I can definitely say this is what I had been experiencing. 

I originally went for TID for their easy to navigate website, and seemingly transparent PDS, as well as very reasonably priced coverage. However to conclude, don't use TID. The claiming process is long and arduous, and they will clearly stall and lie to you in an effort to either make you give up, or worm their way out of paying you. The emergency line was excellent, and clear instructions were given to me, props there. However don't expect any payment from them anytime soon, even when you provide all documentation that is required, and when you know you have a legitimate claim that should be paid out to you. I am still waiting for the claim to be finalized, I am looking forward to seeing what happens... 

This is my fourth policy I have taken out with them, and will certainly be the last.

title: Uses unfair requests and delaying tactics to avoid paying claims!
body:
Our flight to Bali from Sydney was returned to Melbourne due to problems in April 2016. We missed a night and a day 24 hours from our 8 day stay. It was not a massive claim (around $2-300.00). The initial claim response was reasonable with normal requests for documents and proof of items on the claim which is all standard. Once they were provided with the information in its complete form from the original requests they said they would process within 10 working days. From there they requested proof of the re-routing, quite hard to do but I had a screen shot of a text from Jetstar. From here things got more bizarre with phone calls that kept "dropping out" or called and hung up with corresponding emails saying they were having difficulty reaching me in some obvious attempt to meet reporting guidelines I assume. 

Then came an update in August stating they were still waiting for documents from my accommodation provider, these had been provided by myself earlier. I was told the claim would not be processed until they ( the villa owners) provided them with what they wanted in some kind of cross checking capacity. To me this was not under my control and formed an investigation of sorts to verify my claim. I spoke with them and the requested a deposit invoice showing the deposit amount, luckily I had this and provided it on the 8 August 2016. Today I received a call stating they had not received this email and invoice and the claim was rejected because I have not provided proof that the villa had refunded the unused night of accommodation.

title: Why isn't third party damage covered in rental vehicle section??
body:
I shopped around for decent travel insurance.  TID seemed to fit the bill.  I haven't taken my holidays as yet.  However,I just want to know that I'm covered. I am renting a vehicle in NZ and obviously want all bases covered in that regard.  But I must admit to being a little disappointed to find out that only the rental car I'm driving is covered and not any third party vehicle.  So, if I was to have an accident with another vehicle and it was my fault then TID would cover my excess only and not the other vehicle? In other words all liability falls on me.  This means to cover all vehicles requires me to take out extra insurance through the rental car company.  What's wrong with this picture - isn't that what travel insurance is all about?  It should be made clearer in their advertising.  This is one of those hidden nasties that we can all do without.  And please don't give me the spiel about "you should read the policy to determine if this cover is suitable for your needs".  Spell it out in plain black and white so the consumer knows what they're covered for.  And don't hide it away in the policy wording so that if some poor fool goes to make a claim in this regard then they're not left in the lurch.  If I'd have known this clause prior to buying TID travel insurance I would have bought elsewhere.

title: The devil is in the policy wording
body:
I won't be buying this travel insurance for many reasons.  Eg:

1.  The policy wording says: "You must make sure that you tell InsureandGo Travel Insurance about any change in your circumstances that happens after the policy has been issued and before you travel on your departure date. We have the right to change the conditions of your policy in line with the change of risk."  The policy we take out has FULL cover, regardless of changes in circumstances, from issue date.  No after sales changing the rules!

2. I have not checked the rates.  I see they have at least three levels of cover.  That's good.  Unless the lower cover rates are teasers and the gold (maybe standard cover with others) is dearer than others.
 
3. I have not checked the rates.  I have noticed that there re a lot of optional extras.  Fair enough, we pay extra for health issues with another insurer - I expect that.   But some of the extras seem to be standard inclusions in other policies.

So . . be careful.  No 1 reason above is enough for me to avoid this product.  I'm not prepared to take out insurance, disclose everything about me (duty of utmost good faith - no problem)  and later on have something happen to me (even as 'simple' as a broken leg!) and be told that they will no longer cover me.  To me, that is NOT utmost good faith.  The way I read this, the insurer has the ability to avoid ANY and ALL pre travel claims, simply by claiming a change in circumstances!

Over the years, I've analysed quite a few policy wordings.  My background is insurance and I have passed exams on it.  In recent years, some of the majors available via travel agents have been playing catch up with the one I've been using since 2010.  (Available online only).  Good to see the changes.  But this one seems to be winding back the clock on policy wording.

I explained all this to Travel Insurance Direct and they couldn't have been more ghelpful or supportive! They answered my emails promptly, professionally and courteously. After sharing my ongoing frustrations, they have now decided to pay me the $230 anyway, despite the fact I can't supply the necessary documents. I always get my indurance with TID and on the 2 occaisions I have made claims - I have been 100% satisfied with them in every way. Highly recommeded, in my opinion :)
Outstanding customer service, very cost efficient, wonderful people to deal with.

body: The policy was good value and easy to set up but unfortunately I can't reply to the customer service as I didn't have need to use the insurance at all. It was really only a precaution.

body: Never used Allianz before, but found it easy to book the travel insurance I needed. Although there was a problem with the internet, when I rang the insurance was successfully and easily booked.

title: Made the claims process easy
body:
We had to cancel our trip because our son got very ill and was airlifted to hospital the day before I was due to leave. When I called they were very understanding and compassionate and told me not to worry and just focus on our son.
The claims process was straight forward and quick without too much back and forwards. 
It's hard to know whether you're doing the right thing in regards to cancelling or postponing flights or getting credit and perhaps some more help around this would have been good, but I get the feeling that making the best reasonable choices would lead to a hassle free claim.

title: Terrible!
body:
Flight cancellation from New York to San Francisco. The next available flight was nearly a week later, meaning we would miss two destinations. Airline advised us that we could fly to LA and hire a car and drive up to San Fran the next morning. Called Medibank and they advised this would be covered. Imagine my surprise when I made a claim for the cost of the return taxis, car hire and car garaging and I got nothing! All recepits were kept, a letter from the airline was supplied, as was a letter from the car agency stating we had to get a more expensive car because they had no cars left on the lot. I also made a claim for $300 sunglasses, iPod and clothing hat was stolen. I got $100 back, which was cancelled out when my excess was factored in. I called several times, had unhelpful people each time. If I hadn't called to check on things, I suspect it would have falled by the wayside.

No service until prompted, ensuing service was poor. Website is shocking and extremely unfriendly. Long delay in getting my $0 back.

title: great Insurance
body:
Thank you for the courtesy and promptness with which you processed our claim. This has been a good experience and has made my recent illness a lot less traumatising than it may have been. Once again, thank you
Heather Connery

title: travel insurance great
body: great to travel with confidence in travel insurance as you don't know what insurance you need in a foreign country.the policy was easy to set up and good value,very happy

title: No hassle claims
body: Fractured my shoulder skiing overseas. 1 cover processed the claim online with my discharge info and receipt. No hassles. Very efficent! The process was fast and no problems. Will be using again!

title: Didn?t need to use this time
body: No claim this time lucky but have had to claim prior on a Bali trip volcano stopped us from flying out ! Absolutely brilliant paid all expenses and there help was brilliant

title: Best travel experience ever!
body:
I can't recommend them enough! 

Unfortunately on our trip to Bali, a family member or ours become unwell. We called a doctor and they charged us $120 AUD.

 I called Travelcard to let them know, within 10 minutes there was $140USD on the card to withdraw from the ATM to cover the expenses! Plus extra money in case we need more medication! (The best part about travelcard is that they give you a physical debit card! You use their money, while other insurances make you pay first then claim later on.)

We went to the atm, got the money out and didn't have to worry about losing any holiday funds! They called the next few hours to check on the family member, to which I said that he's going to the hospital as he has gotten worse.
They set up someone to call us every 2-3 hours to check how they are going! Luckily he was discharged later that night, while the bill was $600. I called travelcard again via skype, they put more money on the card and it was good to go!

They continued to call every few days until they heard it was all clear. 
They cared, they helped and they took the stress out of having to worry about money and claims.
I will never choose another travel insurance provider again.

title: Absolutely Shocking Medical Assistance
body:
Australia Post outsources their Medical Assistance to "Customer Care". Firstly, do not rely on their "24 hour emergency medical assistance." It is near impossible to get in contact with a nurse and don't even bother emailing them because you will only get convoluted replies from their Case Managers making excuses for their behaviour. There was also no reverse charge phone number I could call and when I did buy phone credit to call their "24 hour" number, no one picked up and I ended up running out of credit.

Another issue I had was that I was told I would be contacted by a nurse as to whether Customer Care agreed with a recommendation that I received from a hospital and I informed Customer Care that I would be leaving Phuket in 4 days. I was then contacted by a nurse as I was flying out of Phuket to Kuala Lumpur. Once I got to Kuala Lumpur, I was told that Customer Care would contact their agent in Kuala Lumpur to arrange an appointment for a nephrologist for me. I never had an appointment booked for me and no one even contacted me to let me know it would not be possible for me to have an appointment before I left Kuala Lumpur to go home. I eventually got a call 4 days after I returned home about the complaints I had made about their travel insurance and the only explanation I got for the delay in making an appointment was that it was "out of Customer Care's control."

Save yourself the hassle. Don't buy this product and choose an insurer that has true 24 hour emergency medical assistance.

Yes that's right, the insurance company gets to decide if your medical visit was necessary.

body:
Read ALL the terms and of the policy and make sure you understand what your money is really paying for!!! I would not recommend Covermore to anyone, especially as there are so many insurance companies available to travellers.
Convenience of arranging through Travel Agent
Did not pay out our claim and ended up with out of pocket expenses. Our international flight was delayed by 90 minutes, which caused us to miss our domestic connecting flight. After doing the run around OURSELVES to get this done, Covermore refused to pay our emergency costs as they had changed the policy and not told anyone. Our travel agent was unaware and is looking into changing Travel Insurers based on the incorrect information they provided at the time of taking out the policy. I have since spoken to another work colleague, who got stranded in India on her honeymoon, due to a flight cancellation and she had to pay out over $2000 AU to arrange new flights. title: Do not use Cover-More Travel Insurance
body:
We used Cover-More once before but did not have to claim.
We had a health claim this time and it took 9 months to settle the claim.
They claimed it was pre-existing and they were not paying. 
They sent off to my GP and requested all records of all my consultations for the past 2 years. As well, both my specialist's reports told them that it was not a pre-existing issue.
In the end I got legal advice that said I should fight them all the way.
The big problem is the turnaround of emails to Cover-More. Every email they say they require 10 working days to reply. Everything waits until the 10th day until any response is returned. Once it was 11 days and their excuse was that there was a bank holiday for 1 day. This is why the claim took so long to progress.
I took this travel insurance with the NRMA of which I have been a member for 50 yrs. Unfortunately, the NRMA does not support their members when it comes to insurance. I was desperately ill and did not appreciate the stress this took on me.
After a long battle I have been paid out but would never insure with Cover-More again.
Information: You have 6yrs to make a travel insurance claim on your policy from the date of event.

body: Had the top cover and rented a vehicle in Europe and unfortunately scuffed an ally wheel. No issue. Paid excess $1,000 no issue again. We had cover for rental car excess. title: Waiting for Refund
body: On 30th October, 2019 I purchased a comprehensive travel insurance policy for travel to UK and Spain from Allianz for $760.53 AUD. The trip was scheduled for 13th May to 24th June, 2020.  When the Australian Government stopped international travel, I contacted Allianz on March 23rd 2020 and was offered a refund which would be credited to my bank account in approximately 14 days.  As no refund was forthcoming I contacted Allianz again on April 29th 2020 and was advised that my request for refund was being processed and to wait another week or two.  On May 20th 2020 I was told that the "refund team" were working on it and to wait until the end of June to receive my refund.  I have spoken to other people who had booked similar policies with different insurance companies and they have received their refunds.  I am becoming increasingly concerned that I am being "fobbed off" and I am placing this review to see if others have had a similar experience.

title: Peru times
body:

One such day required me to finally be admitted to the hospital with Bronchitis, Amoeba and good ol' Salmonella. I was picked up by ambulance and taken to the hospital at 2 in the morning. After some rest in the hospital, and being a tourist, I was finally asked what travel insurance I had. 20 minutes i was brought the telephone and asked how i was by the covermore representative how i was and how they will ensure I received the best care the hospital could provide and not to worry. after 3 days i was finally discharged after i was told i had a $500 bill, however they only asked for $100(my excess). i was extremely satisfied with the amount of cover the insurance provided and i recommend it to anyone ooking to travel overseas
Quick coverage, reliable, efficient, amazing staff
was a bit expensive but i believe it was worth it onsidering the care i was provided

title: A rip off - will not pay.
body:
I was injured on a recent trip in a remote location where I had poor access by phone and their emergency number was misdirecting to another business.  
Be aware that Allianz does not allow contact by any means other than phone, so I had to email another person to phone them and relay my story and get Allianz to contact me by email. This occurred, but they insisted that I make contact by phone. 
Eventually I was able to do so after travelling a few days to a phone.  Once I could get through I explained the particular treatment recommended by the medico.  Allianz said it would get straight back to me for approval. 
In the meantime I personally paid for the treatment as the Allianz PDS requires me to minimise their costs - i was fixed medically in two days for a few hundred dollars only and back on my trip.
A week and a half later I received an email telling me that Allianz would not approve the treatment!  
My argument in reply was that I was fixed in two days rather than stay in a hotel at Allianz much greater cost to await their response and then seek treatment. Regardless of me fixing the problem and saving Allianz much greater cost it will not pay.
It is now some some 6 months later, the matter is still not resolved, I have been given the biggest run around of all time - lost emails, fail to reply, repetitive and unrelated queries, rude staff and much more.
Do yourselves a favour and NEVER even consider using Allianz - they will use every trick in the book to not pay and waste heaps of your time to try and get you to give up i suspect.

title: 3rd time used.
body:
For our ages, policy was good value & covered my husband's back op from 30 yrs ago (even though he'd had no probs), whereas other companies wouldn't even consider any cover!
The policy was very very easy to set up (especially for someone not particularly computer literate).
Customer support was great when unfortunately we last year had to make a claim on our domestic travel.

title: Avoid at all Costs - Policy has no practical real world value
body:
At the beginning, when they take your money, it is all sunshine and circuses but as soon as you make a claim the dark clouds roll in.

Don't be fooled by the PDS, it has a couple of pages on what is covered by the insurance then scattered throughout the numerous pages in the rest of the document what is not. And let me tell you, pretty much everything you thought was covered in the beginning is excluded by the time you get to the end. Even common reasons such as taking prescribed medication or seeing your GP before taking out the insurance can be used as reasons to reject a claim.

I made claim after my father died while I was on a domestic trip. Even before I had supplied all the requested paperwork my claim was rejected. That's right they didn't bother waiting to get all the facts, my claim was rejected before they had all the information. Then trying to get information from Budget Direct (actually Allianz who handle the claims) was almost impossible. 

Trying to negotiate the review process was appalling. They don't reply to emails, they fail to meet their own service standards, they only return calls once a week on a Friday afternoon so if you miss them that is it for at least 7 days. When you call them you are shunted though three layers of service staff only to be told they will get back to you with a letter 'next week'.

So keep away from Budget Direct, it is simply not worth your money to buy insurance from them.

title: Great cover for great price.
body: Fortunately I didn't need to make a claim but at one stage I thought I was going to have to and it was comforting to know that I was covered.

title: Always use and never regret it
body: Always easy to set up and find are very reasonably priced. Will always use them for our travels. For peace of mind we'd choose them over any other travel insurance company.

title: Never going to use TID again, as they go with Cerberus
body: I lost my phone overseas, this was already trouble enough as I had only got it a month before my trip. Instead of helping me with the service they claim to provide, I was greeted with a 'too bad, so sad'. They would not cover my claim as I had "all reasonable precautions to safeguard the items you have claimed for have not been taken". This is what I get for going to another country to help those in need. Don't bother with insurance if they are just going to pocket your money and shut you off.

title: great stuff
body:

I never did have to claim, but this coverage excellent for peace of mind too. 

Thanks again. I will be recommending this to others.

title: Great experience.  Won't travel without them.
body: I got sick with Dengue fever in Bali... it was an alful experience and I spent 4 days in hospital, Covermore was absolutely fantastic we had nothing to worry about, the staff at Covermore covered  everything for us.. we had nothing to stress about. I can't sing their praises high enough.. Best thing we did was get them as our insurance cover.. telling everyone I know.. get Cover-More as your travel insurance.

title: good value for money. ...
body: Policy was good value easy to apply.i did my research and compared many other policies and came back to 1 cover.  I didn't use customer service however i can only hope that it would have been excellent.

body:
We didn't need to make a claim but 1Cover offered the best range of cover for us in medical; cancellation, and lost of property.  The PDS is easy to understand providing clear examples of what is in and what is out.  We felt comfortable being insured with 1Cover throughout the trip.
Easy and affordable.

title: Horrible, would never use InsureandGo again
body:
My policy was of horrible value, I paid the maximum possible and travelled with ease thinking there was no higher cover to purchase and would be covered for anything that may occur, as you expect with insurance.

An issue occurred with a travel agent overseas and they cancelled my ticket due to my surname being misspelled (instead of changing 1 letter, which could have been done free of charge through the airline)
I am now 400 Euro out of pocket, I claimed this with your company to no avail. 
The customer service was appalling, I was passed around to different people who claimed they were management. In the meantime I was mocked and belittled that I hadn?t read/ received a booklet explaining all disclosure of content, by the end was hung up on and no emails sent to me with my claim as promised.
My case must have been too complicated & time consuming for their attention.

I have used your travel insurance on many occasions and have recommended the service to my family and friends. I will never use your Insurance in future travels and will most certainly not recommend you to anyone I know, it?s not worth the heart ache of being ignored and treated horribly by your customer service team based overseas.

Thanks
Gabriela

title: Total peace of mind
body: I was extremely happy with the cover on offer from Allianz Travel Insurance. Total cover even while on our cruise gave us peace of mind and left us to enjoy our holiday without having to worry. The policy was very easy to set up and pay online. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone looking for good value cover.

title: A compassionate travel insurance company?
body: A compassionate travel insurance company?  Is that an oxymoron?  Apparently not!  Our recent experience with ?Insureandgo? travel insurance has inspired us to write this review, which they unreservedly deserve. After a cruising holiday which ended in New York, we were flying from New York to LA and then, supposedly onto Australia.  However, I developed a serious medical condition on the New York to LA leg of the journey and had to be taken off the plane by paramedics and taken to hospital where I had emergency, life-saving surgery at 3am.  We contacted Insureandgo right at the start of this drama and they could not have been more helpful.  They actually communicated concern and care for me and our situation and took care of everything.  After I was released from hospital, they arranged for an upgrade to business class for our flight home and insisted that a medical officer travel with us.  Transport was arranged by them from hotel to airport and then airport to our door at home.  All bills and reimbursements have been paid without fuss or delay by Insureandgo.  We could not recommend them highly enough.

body: 1Cover makes the wh0le experience easy: from buying the policy through to a claim (if you are unlucky) the prcess is clear and easy to navigate.  We will use them again.

title: Straightforward online experience.
body:

Time efficient, on line assessment of medical conditions.

body:

Funds were transferred to my account quickly and the usual 3 month claim period was waived which I appreciated.
The efficiency with which the claim was settled
I think there should be a small card that abbreviates what claimants have to do i.e. 1.  All thefts must be reported to police and a police report obtained.  2.  Keep all receipts for medicine and doctors visits (pretty ought but I hope you get the just of what I'm writing)

Very satisfied with the Customer Support

body:

We were a family of 4 delayed in HK recently due to the protests and had to spend an extra 3 days there with no luggage (as we had already checked it in via the Airport Express Checkin Counters), so therefore had to buy clothes and toiletries as well.  We kept all our receipts for all expenditure including accomodation, meals, clothes, toiletries and transportation and then made a claim when we got back home. The claims process was straightforward, sent via email the completed claims form with copies of receipts and claim was processed within the week including payment hitting the bank!  Couldn't fault them.  An excellent experience.

body:

title: Great peace of mind when travelling
body: TID offers great value for money. Taking out the policy on line is very simple and easy to do. Communication via email was good, with reminders of our holiday approaching, and check lists on things to have and do. Will definitely use TID again, and happily recommend to others.

body:

I would recommend Allianz and will be using them again for my travel insurance requiremements.

title: Very difficult to deal with
body:
I paid extra for what I thought was a quality insurer. I travelled to Europe and on the second day my companion collapsed from a DVT. I was in a state of shock and decided to go home. Despite the fact that we booked everything together, my claim was rejected as according to Covermore, it was my lack of motivation to continue. They expected me to continue travelling by myself for a month whilst my companion was in intensive care fighting for her life.

I found dealing with Covermore very difficult. When making my claim I had to submit the same documentation numerous times and it was extremely difficult to contact me. They emailed me saying I had to submit another form but they forgot to attached it to the email. I tried calling and after an hour on hold (no exaggeration) the phone call terminated. I then had to wait another ten days (as per their email policy) to get a reply to the email. 

My friend who had the DVT also had problems with the company. It took months for her to receive months to be reimbursed and despite a top surgeon in France requesting a flight with extra leg room, this was denied. This is inspire of their own advertising campaigns which showcase a client who had a dvt being flown home in business class.


I know not all claims will be successful but just the communication alone is enough not to go back to this company.

i have used 1 cover before and they were efficient and supportive when i was sick overseas and then when i made a claim on my return. I had no issues this time but was happy to know that I was covered by 1cover in case something did.

title: Insure always with InsuredGo
body: The policy indeed was good value for money, because you can insure for multiple travels for a whole year. I had no difficulty to set up the policy. Good communication and prompt response. Polite and helpful staff.

title: Happy with the service and the rates
body: I have been using TID for about 10 years (5 times about) and find it always very easy to set up my travel insurance. I have never had to claim. I think it is reasonably good value. Only slight snag I found was that in setting up I could not show I would be in more than one country on a trip.  Maybe just not smart enough, but rang them and the extra country noted on the policy. J.

title: Terrible
body:
We got caught up in the snowstorms around the christmas/new year period in 2010-2011. Our luggage was lost for over a week and we finally got it back after our cruise had finished. However we still needed clothes, etc. so we bought items along the way.

Upon return from our holiday, I contacted Lufthansa and submitted a claim for reimbursement due to delayed luggage.  They promptly paid half of the value of the clothes we bought.  

We then submitted a claim to Cover-More to pay the other half. Its now been over a month since submitting a claim and I haven't heard anything from them except when I called the other day (29th March). I had to wait 30 minutes on hold until I could speak to a person there. They are still refusing the pay the rest of the amount as they want an itemised list of clothes. I told them I can't speak Greek or Italian (which is what the receipts are in), so I'm not sure what I can add to the list. I have submitted all receipts and included the original letters from Lufthansa stating what they paid and everything else that an insurance company needed.

long call-center wait times, arrogant attitude, say they will call back and they don't

After extra visits to GP and Specialists and being able to provide further information and requesting 1Cover once again look at our circumstances they covered our needs. Thank you 1Cover

body:
Had to make a claim for my wallet that was stolen in Patong, Thailand. Had a response in 2 days saying that my claim was successful. From my experience, as long as you read the fine print and know what you are and are not covered for with your policy (I had to get a police report), this insurance is great! Another friend of mine had his phone stolen in Bali and covermore responded in the same way and paid for his phone, no questions asked. Will definitely be using covermore next time!
Cheap and paid out my claim
Nothing (if you read the fine print)

title: Peace of mind
body: The best, will use next time, easy to do and talking  in what and were i was going, And TID keep in touch before and after holiday, Many thanks TID for your help

title: worry free insurance
body: We found the the service fast, efficient and just what we wanted. The staff we spoke to were friendly & caring. We are senior travellers and were not sure exactly what we needed but it was all explained and handled with one easy phone call.

title: They got the job done
body:
I was using 'Ski Insurance' which is essentially 1cover with Lloyds as the underwriter. 

Snowboarding in Rusutsu Japan and hit a tree. I was taken to Hospital in an Ambulance, had X-rays, spoke to an orthopaedic surgeon etc and found out I had broken my ankle (fractured fibula). I had to pay the hospital bill upfront which came to about $550, which I thought was reasonable considering an ambulance ride in Australia can sometimes be $800 alone. 

Got back to my mates in our Villa and contacted the insurance company on their 24 hour assistance phone number. The initial stages were a bit tedious as there were no staff from the medical team on shift. I had to wait until the following morning when I spoke to the nurse on the phone who was amazing. 

By 8:00am that day I had business class flights booked home. As you can imagine I was pretty [censored word removed], my ankle was busted, I had a heaps of luggage and there was a blizzard outside. The insurance company arranged for a taxi to pick me up, take me to the airport at Sapporo and the driver carried my luggage to the check in counter. 

From there I was wheel chaired around airports back to my parents place in Australia. 

When returning to Aus I claimed the hospital bill and lost accommodation etc. This was reimbursed within a 'reasonable time' - Had to provide the usual documentation, which can be a bit tedious if you're not tech savvy. 

All in all would recommend, and I am thankful for their assistance, hence why I am writing this review. 

Unfortunately I have a long recovery ahead.....

title: Wonderful timely and compassionate service.
body: We had to cancel our trip very close to departure due to illness.  I dealt with several members of the team both with our claim and with setting up our policy going forward. The process was fast, transparent and friendly. We have many friends who travel a great deal who have been most impressed with our experience and talking of moving to InsureandGo. This is the first time we have had to claim on travel insurance and are so grateful we are with this company whose support people were actually proactive in staying in touch with us through the process.

title: Unexpected Holiday Postponement
body: I recently had to contact 1Cover as I had to postpone our overseas holiday which had been booked for 12 months prior to me being diagnosed with having to have a total hip replacement as soon as possible. From the moment I contacted 1Cover and advised them of my pending surgery they were extremely helpful, they advised me of what was required to make a claim for any out of pocket costs associated with postponing our holiday to later in the year.  I found the process easy and the consultants were always helpful and compassionate when I had to speak to them. My claim has now been finalised and it was completed without complications and stress. I have and will continue to recommend 1Cover to my family and friends for all their travel insurance needs.

title: I survived the Munich Beer Fest without falling over.
body:
Extremely happy with policy and staff assistance and providing I can remember my Special discount code I will be travelling
again soon. There will be a recovery period, and then off again with TID as my backup.

title: Worst insurance company to deal with!
body: My wife bought this cover for both of us for our recent holiday and did not realize that they do not cover preexisting  conditions. I asked them if they could cover my condition and they said no. I could not get the cover I required and I was prepared to pay extra to get my required cover so to have a full cover so that I can have my holiday in confidence. I told them that I need better cover and that I would go to another travel insurance company who would cover me completely. Yes, this cover cost more but I was completely covered and why would you buy a substandard insurance, no matter how cheap it is? I asked for a refund from TID, but they made it so hard to get the refund, I just did not bother. We are both back from a wonderful holiday without injury or illness. I would not recommend TID Travel Insurance Direct to anybody and I will be posting this on my Facebook page as well as Trip Adviser I found TID uncaring and just in it for profit!.

title: Great service
body: 1st time client found website  very simple to use great value will use again on my next holiday next year

title: Beware of Loopholes
body: I purchased cover with TID and while I was overseas my grandmother passed away.  When I called to make a claim I was told that because she was over 85 and not an Australian resident I was unable to claim any money.  Make sure to read carefully in case something similar happens to you.

title: Happy to be insured with Allianz
body: Setting up the policy was very easy and after comparing with other companies it seemed very good value for money. I would happily recommend Allianz to my friends any day and will take out my next policy with Allianz.

title: I felt let down by this insurer
body: No. Won't go back. We need cover for the very thing we needed to be covered for and did not get. We won't feel safe using them again.

title: Easy purchase and great value for money
body: The Policy selection and purchasing process was so easy and the value and inclusions very comparable to other more well known insurers - will certainly use again for future travel needs.

title: Never going with Medibank Private Insurance again even though we have been with them for 40 years.
body: Have used them many times but this is our first claim and will never use them again.  We booked our trip to Darwin on 20 November 2017 departing 14 July 2018. On 14 May I was diagnosed with Pancreatic Cancer so cancelled our trip on 18 May 2018. Our travel agent [name removed] from Mobile Travel Agent forwarded a supportive letter stating our situation. We also supplied necessary Medical certificates and other documentation well before cut off date.  We have received all of the monies excluding $649.36 which after many phones calls to Medibank Private Insurance their excuse being it was for cancellation fee even though we were never charged a cancellation fee. Each time I have rung I am left waiting for a long time and could not speak with a claims officer. I now have to take this matter to the Insurance Ombudsmen to rectify.  I have had a stressful time having pancreatic cancer and did not need this type of treatment, when it was our first claim and have been with Medibank Private for approximately 40 years.  Shame on you.

title: Bali Trip 2016.
body: The policy was extremely easy to set up and pay for. It was definitely the best value for money that we had looked into to purchase for Bali. The Adventure Pack that we added on as an extra covered all the activities that we wanted to do.

title: First time user
body: Applied for policy Nov 2019 for trip in August 2020. Online application was relatively easy with additional inclusions for health issues approved. Cost was on par with similar policies with other companies & was cheaper when using Seniors NSW discount. The test will be later in year if Covid-19 is still impacting travel arrangements.

title: Expect the unexpected
body:
On the early train from Naples to Rome to catch a flight to Paris, I checked emails and found that our flights were cancelled due to a 3 day air traffic controllers' strike in France, with rail staff threatening to join in the following day. This would mean staying in Rome for 3 days and missing our planned and booked one week walk along the Pilgrim Trail. Knowing that this event was covered by our insurance, I was able to book flights immediately from Rome to Geneva and then a train to Paris, arriving just in time to connect with pre-booked train to Rodez. I was able to claim all (minus the excess) from Covermore when we arrived home.
Not having to stress about the extra costs of the changed travel plans. Knowing that it was covered and being able to book immediately on line. As thousands of people were stranded we had to act quickly to get flights and train transport.
There were some delays as Covermore believed that our credit card agency may be liable for some of the costs.

body: I found 1Cover an easy company to deal with. It allowed for the ability to forward further details and explanations for consideration. I will be using 1Cover in the future.

body: My husband and I have for the second year purchased Cover-More annual multi trip travel insurance with Cover-More, hearing that this cover does not cover us for any of our upcoming trips as it falls into the pandemic crisis was disappointing but not surprising, what is surprising and very annoying is being on hold for 185 minutes and counting, I have also attempted to contact them online so far that also is useless, this will be our last Cover-More purchase I simply can?t imagine how useful they would be if me or my family had an urgent problem, I do consider myself to be a patient understanding person and fully grasp that these are difficult times but this is a business that took no time at all processing my credit card and have nothing in place to answer questions from loyal customers. Shame on you Cover-More

Just make a claim and the stars will fall down very quickly.  They say they cover lots of things, but in reality, they do not.  I will not go through this company again. body: Very easy to obtain on the net and good to get a discount for loyalty. Haven't had to claim yet so cannot give an opinion on this.

body:

February 10th 2017 Update: Great Travel Insurance, wouldn't go elsewhere!

I've used this service for many years and many years and several trips.
I have had several claims, and it's been very easy & a very very quick turn around.

title: They would use any excuse to reject a legit claim. DO NOT USE THEM!!!
body:
I had a round trip booked, meeting, hotel booking, etc. My flight was diverted due to aircraft breakdown, so I never arrived at one of my original destinations, which means, now I will have to make a separate trip there.

I provided all the required evidence from the airline. InsureAndGo straight away said that it cannot be a cancellation, because basically I arrived at my final destination, so it can only be a delay, which is very clever, because in that case the max payable amount is a lot lower. Well, as I never arrived at one of my planned destinations, in my view that is a cancellation of one of my flights.

Now it will cost me $2500 to cover that missed trip.

Finally, they rejected my whole claim, saying I arrived at my final destination without any delay, in fact, I got there about an hour earlier than expected. Wow. And what about the destination that I never got to?

I have used them lots of times, recommended them to many of my friends because they are an Australian company, so we should support them.
Luckily, non of them had any problem, otherwise I would be in big trouble now, because when something happens, that is when you really find out how good an insurance company is.

Well, this one is rubbish and extremely sneaky.

title: You will need patience if you ever have to claim
body: Product and sales process was pretty good,  however the claims process was convoluted, lengthy and staff gave contradictory, and some cases incorrect advice.  Getting a date when a payment would hit my bank account took three calls with three different  dates (all staff were friendly enough though)  Whilst I disagreed with the some parts of the claim outcome I received,  what was  most annoying was the lack of certainty on process and dates.  Surely a service company nowadays can lock this down with a service guarantee !!

However we always have felt that if we did we would have no concerns doing so. They give very good discounts at different times which helps keep the costs of your holiday down.

title: Do not trust
body:
Will never use again- do not TRUST- could not use the online portal despite weeks of attempts. 

The fact they stated that the portal was working and it still isn't deems them as untrustworthy in my opinion. Wasted so much time.

My experience in more detail:

I paid for the policy through Teachers Health. I then got my certificate of insurance from Allianz Global.

After some emergency dental treatment in Thailand, tried the ALLIANZ online claim porta. It didn't work on any of my devices,

Thought it might be my i-pad, so I tried my laptop (still no luck)

Registered my policy and let me proceed through stages:
1: Your details
2: Trip Details
3: Would not allow me to select in the dropdown menu


Sent about 10 emails, only 2 replied to

Got home and have been trying on my desktop (with different browsers etc) many, many times.

Called them, in the morning and was advised by NAME WITHELD (who was very nice and apologetic) that her superivior, NAME WITHELD -told her the 'system was down' and they had only been alerted to this at that point (even though I have been trying for weeks). This is when I really realised that they were giving me the run around. A huge company like this has only been alerted to the portal not working that day? 

I was sent a 9 page claim form to fill out. That's all well and good- I understand insurance companies need to prove the legitimacy of claims. I just want to know why my policy number would not work online.

I was told to try again later that afternoon. Which I did, and it still didn't let me pass stage 3 on the portal. I sent an e-mail threatening to write a review.
 once again I called and explained my situation. He was very confident and well versed in the content of my claim but could not actually give me reasons why the portal was not working for me.) I was told by the representative that he wasn't in I.T so he didn't know why it was working. 

I asked if there were many policies that couldn't get past the third question and he stated that there are just some numbers that the 'system doesn't like' He explained more about the policy claim- which was good but then - GET THIS - he told me the I.T guy was listening in on the conversation and came to whisper in his ear that the portal was now fixed, and that I should try again immediately.

I did- and it didn't work. 
Tried again this morning- and decided that I will let other people know about this dubious practice of not allowing some claims to work on the portal.

So my complaint is that I was lied to about the online claims process.

title: If you want to be disappointed and be declined  - consider buying it and good luck!
body:
I recently went on holidays with my family to Bali and stayed in a reasonably popular villa. As it was unsafe to carry all of my cash in person, so on the first day of my stay I decided to keep most of my cash notes (total $1700 bank notes) in the safety box given inside the villa. Since then I never opened the safety box, until checked out (after two days). To my surprise, after a careful counting a total of $250 bank notes was disappeared (must be stolen by someone, who was very cautious to just take out only one from each pre-bundled notes (10 notes per bundle). I then immediately reported the incident to the local police and obtained a police report within 24 hours. 

I lodged my claim to 1 cover, but another surprise again. I was told that such incident is not covered by the policy, which seems to state that the bank notes must be on your person at the time they were stolen. 

I was astonished and disappointed by such an inconsiderate reply as the money was securely placed safety box during my stay in the villa, so the incident was clearly not expected and was out of my control. The nature of it in my view is as equal as being thieved in person as stated in the 1 cover policy.  I have to admit I didn?t realise 1 cover insurance policies would not cover money left hidden in a locked safety box as I thought like many other insurance companies, 1cover would also cover money stolen from a locked safety box. I thought this was just a trivial assumption, but obviously I was wrong! It is just so unfair and nonsense, and the decline of my claim appears to be just a "word game". 1cover seems to just try to find a "glitch" to decline, rather than being considerate to try to make sensible decision for their clients.  Anyway, it seems like the 1cover policy recommends their clients to never keep their cash in a safe place (e.g. a safety box), but to keep them all in pockets or bring along the heavy "safety box" with them 24/7 when traveling overseas??

Don't waste your money to buy travel insurance (from a provider like 1cover) as eventually you will not get covered and be rejected with an inconsiderable reason.

title: SCAM pretending to be an insurance company
body: Their travel insurance product is a SCAM.  Seems like a good value to start, however don't expect to get your claim paid.  Their policies are so robust in fine print that few claims actually get paid, especially small ones.  They falsely advertise their travel insurance Gold policy covers 'unlimited cancellation' oh but wait.. 'delayed' is a whole other term all together that falls dubiously under other portions of their policy.  This is done on purpose, so that the most likely to happen e.g. in our case the airline *cancelled our flight last minute and rescheduled 19 hours later.   This caused us to be out of pocket on transportation and our accommodation that was nonrefundable.  We we're relieved that we had bought travel insurance and thought no big deal, BUT WAIT, after loads of paperwork, receipts and lots of time wasting back and forth, they denied our $300 claim, stating *delaying (ahem cancellation) of a flight wasn't covered, even though they advertised it was (Why do people get travel insurance in the first place #1 is flight cancellations).   They also charge a $100 Per Person Excess even if you bought the policy together, meaning we could only get $100 even if that's to case, which was denied anyways.  This insurance is a joke, what travel insurance doesn't cover flight cancellation?? Seems only this one and their policy is built to be as confusing and subjective as possible so they can always deny a claim.  Don't waste your time with Insuranceandgo (aka SCAMGO) and go with any other travel insurance provider but these guys. Oh and yes, we have reported them to the ACCC and Financial Ombudsman, you should do the same if they've scammed you too.   Even if a small amount, its the principal of the matter, they should not be allowed to continue scamming people in Australia like this.

body: I have always used 1cover for my travel insurance but this time was very disappointed to find out that one of the main things they advertise (and the main reason I got it) had fine print that meant they didn't have to honour it. Unfortunately for me my mother has relapsed with cancer after having been clear for 14 years. Because it was 'pre-existing' I was told they would not honour the service if I needed it. As a person with 2 elderly parents, it's a bit hard for them to not have something pre-existing. Thankfully I didn't need to claim but I think of people who have had to claim during a difficult time like that only to have issues with the insurance company.

Fortunately the airline ended up refunding my money because they had changed my departure time by more than 2 hours. When I asked Allianz to refund my premium I was given a website to use. When I went to access that website a warning came up saying it was possibly a phishing website. I then called Allianz again and said I wouldn't use their website. They told me they would process my refund over the phone. We'll see if I actually get my money back as it hasn't yet been credited to my card yet.  Don't use Allianz!

They have no intention of paying most claims.

title: Be careful of using Allianz!! Warning to others
body: I had complimentary credit card insurance that unfortunately used Allianz. I thought they were good due to positive review ratings. Now I realise however too late, none of them are for people who actually had the misfortune of making a claim with them. I had my phone and camera stolen overseas, and it was the first time in my life that I ever had to make an insurance claim after years of travelling. Over the course of several months, they wanted every minute details including confirmation of IMEI number from your phone company (even though I told them I didn't have a SIM in the phone, used for Wifi only), your phone records (even though I didn't use that phone during the entire period), IMEI confirmation from place of purchase, etc. My phone company provided me with the wrong IMEI number when I enquired with them. The consultant (who think she's some kind of FBI) scrutinised every little detail of my claim, was very sneaky with her questions, with a false pretense of trying to help. and accused me of fraud when the IMEI number didn't match! I do not accept this as it was not my fault. But they don't care about the facts, just interested in finding every single loophole to deny your claim and make it your fault. The consultant then went on and told me it will put a permanent black mark for all my future insurance claims even with other companies, to add to the insult. There is simply no empathy or understanding, they are criminals to deal with and will make your life hell. This is a warning to others, stay away!

title: Terrible
body:
I had my drink spiked in the USA unfortunately the hospital didn't test for drugs & even though I got reports/references/medical reports from home TID refused to pay and I have been forced to pay over $4000AUD for the ambulance and a couple of hours in hospital. I was so sick, so suddenly I had no idea what was happening and couldn't tell the hospital I needed them to test for drugs. It also wasn't my call to be sent to hospital. TID provided inadequate advice over the phone, they didn't even tell me to get a police report or a report from the nightclub - I only found out long after. I fought their decision but in the end the little person never wins and I didn't want lawyers involved. So PLEASE don't put yourself in the same situation I did, spend a little extra for the security of a big insurance company who are prepared to actually look after their clients. We also had one of our flights cancelled due to a freak snow storm but after all the drama I was going through it was just too painful to try claim for that too so we lost out there as well. - Safe and happy travels to everyone.

WARNING: DO NOT GO WITH THIS COMPANY

Stressed out beyond belief and with no help from any Airlines we had to contact family back home for assistance to pay for a NEW $1500 to get home... to then find that this TRAVEL INSURANCE we purchased doesn't cover delays. What is the point of travel insurance when they can't cover you for anything reasonably likely to happen. If I had known this COVER MORE defiantly wouldn't have been on my choice for travel insurance. title: So glad I had it
body: TID policy was good value Insurance and we have taken it out several times for our overseas trips And never needed it till our last trip when I broke my ankle in Vietnam and had to get home for surgery.  I panicked and contacted TID, the girls I spoke with were so helpful and understanding.  Phone lines made it difficult and I was not always easy, being worried and in pain but the girls never lost patience and organised for examination and next day flights home. I could not complain about their service and I was grateful for it all including business class fares home to make me as comfortable as possible and for my husband as carer.  The claim process is online and was fairly straightforward although couple of glitches with it not allowing me to upload receipts.  We had receipts for our expenses we paid for our holiday going forward and were reimbursed in full for everything we claimed.  They were overwhelmed with claims but rang to see I could wait a few more days and then rang again to say claim assessed and would be paid.  I can not fault  TID through my experience with them, I will purchase again and hope never to make another claim.

I put in a claim only to discover that having something stolen in the 5 minutes I left it unattended on a plane constituted an exclusion. It was my human error that gave someone the opportunity to steal from me. But that is why I took out the insurance, to guard against human error and deceit. 

Lesson: No matter how boring, long and tedious it is I must read the entire policy. Don't think that insurance will cover you if you make a mistake. Insurance is there for the insurer not the insured.
I was told within days that the claim would be rejected.
There are so many exclusions it can be difficult to determine what is covered, when and for how much.

title: They Insure and Go -with your money
body:
I purchased travel insurance last November for travel in May. In March the Government stopped overseas travel and Qantas cancelled my flight. InsureandGo rejected my claim for a pro-rata refund. I did not want a credit as I won't use it in the future. InsureandGo claim they use AFCA guidelines as per their website, they even share this link from AFCA's website showing that calculation:

https://afca.org.au/coronavirus-covid-19-pandemic-support-hub/insurance#appropriatepolicy
The AFCA link actually advocates a pro-rata REFUND and not a credit that InsureandGo are offering.
You are entitled to a portion of your money back for a service not provided in full.
If you are not happy with a credit voucher I encourage you to start a case on the AFCA website, it is very easy and straight forward.

I have accepted we will not be getting any reimbursement from them but if I can advise anyone else looking for travel insurance not to go with these crooks, I will be happy.

A joy to deal with these people.  Plus, they give you a cute page to print out & carry with you, which I always keep with my passport in case I am hurt and someone needs my details for insurance, as I usually travel alone.

title: Never leave home without TID

I have never needed to make a claim so cannot comment on this aspect of the policy but it is a company I will continue to use.

title: China Trip

title: Reasonably Priced and Easy to Purchase
body: I didn't need to make use of my insurance this trip, however it was well priced for covering the essentials and it was very easy to purchase. Thanks very much

title: They treated us well
body: Sorry to hear about other people's bad experiences. I got back from Bali and claimed medical and broken glasses. They took the claim in first phone call. I sent quotes and receipt. title: First time using budget direct
body: As a first time user the process of getting travel insurance online was quick and easy, and the price seemed good in comparison.

title: Excellent service, highly recommended
body: I obtained travel insurance online and had used this company before but never needed to claim. Good value for top tier insurance including winter sports. title: Great customer service
body: Excellent online experience followed up with great personal service. It was the first time I had made a claim and it was handled in a friendly and professional manner. I would certainly recommend 1cover and have done since.

title: Something you must take with you when you travel.
body:

I didn't have a lot of receipts for my purchases because in Thailand they didn't give out receipts, or didn't understand what they were, all I had to do was take pictures of the items.  I was relieved that my claim was paid out rather quickly after lodging the claim

title: Peace of mind

Easy to get online and simple to comprehend . I had to submit  a claim which was dealt with quickly

title: Worst claiming process I've ever come across
body:
I have an annual policy with this company.
I was admitted to hospital whilst away in November.
Its now nearly the end of January, and after providing all requested information, they just constantly come back with a request for a further document, with another "10 business day processing" response each time (no matter if if i provide within an hour of request).

They've now requested my usual doctor "routine information". Routine information, that I would presume if so routine, they would've asked to begin with - he already signed off that I had no pre-existing, and i didnt travel against advice.

The first time i've purchased a  policy through these guys - Usually and in the past have gone with Vero. Their claims process is 1000x better then this mockery of a system. Waiting 10 business days every time something happens on the file.

Recommend, go elsewhere. Atrocious customer service.

Edit - what is ironic however, is that, im a lawyer, and my partner works for Flight Centre - SELLING their product. We travel a lot between us, and i tell you - I can't imagine it'll be good for business stuffing around the people who use/sell your product.

title: Very poor service
body: trying to get assistance having been stuck in Bali due to volcanic ash so unable to fly out as scheduled. Rang and spoke to an [name removed] from the customer service centre on their 1300 no and he was not very helpful it was like he was not interested. Then he transferred me to the emergency dept where I spoke to a woman who had no idea about their own product. she then said she would get this [name removed] person to ring me back. title: Terrible, I got stuck in Mexico City for an extra week because of them
body: I experienced terrible service. So bad that the Head of Operations at Cover More called me to apologise for all the mistakes they made, which resulted in me getting stuck (with no passport) in Mexico City for a week longer than necessary. What an ordeal. Now they?re refusing to pay for my losses which happened as a result of their advice. When I asked for help after my passport and bag were stolen, they wouldn?t assist (as contracted in the policy) - didn?t even show basic human decency, i.e. helping a person in need, and they made my situation worse. They wouldn?t return my phone calls either. I wonder how often this happens to their customers? Definitely using another insurer like 1Cover or Southern Cross next time I travel.

title: Very helpful and easy to deal with
body: Very easy to deal with from overseas when I had to make a claim. Claim went through very easily and in a quick fashion. I paid premiums that were on the expensive side but I definitely got an A+ service which made it all worth it.

title: Denied Medical had to pay all myself
body: Now we all know that working in the insurance business you have to be a very special kind of person! So anyway I took out the works travel insurance with them, the best they have. I have used them many times as I?ve travelled a lot and never claimed once. Now after being assualted by a group of thai taxi drivers because I would not pay the agreed amount I was king hit from the side and had my lip cut and teeth smashed. So after going to the hospital after it happened they didn?t let me claim insurance because they kept giving me the run around saying I need to leave the hospital and get a police report, an accident report and witness statements. So I left the hospital with my lip gushing with blood and teeth smashed because my insurance said I need this other documents before I?m covered. So the next day I do all that?s asked and head back to the hospital late the next day. The hospital they deal with is Bangkok hospital in Pattaya and it?s no doubt they have a scam going on with customers. The next day I was still denied medical treatment because I haven?t got a medical report! (That?s correct a medical report). I couldn?t get medical help from the medical staff because I hadn?t got a medical report about my injuries. (You are reading correctly). I had no choice to pay for everything myself. I went to another hospital! That?s not all either but I just can?t be bothered writing anymore. I have used other insurance companies before but never before as a company calling themselves ?travel insurance direct? I thought they?d be the best. Because they are definitely not the cheapest. Bottom line is they don?t want to help and make it impossible to claim! I hate this company so much!

title: This is perfect!

body:
We were recommended Insureandgo for over 60s..Took out our policy on 5/1/2020 for a Trip overseas in May..Due to Covid 19 all our flights and accomodation were cancelled . Completed a claim and submitted on 5/4/2020.
Did not receive confirmation that they had  received our claim form...after 2 weeks we then rang to see where we were at..they acknowledged they had received the claim..and they would get back to us.. On the 28/4/ !we received an email requesting further documents..which we then forwarded back on the 29/4.
We were then informed by claims on the 12/5 they had all our documentation that they needed and they would be in contact with us....after not hearing from them we made another phone call on the 27/5 and asked to be put through to a Claims supervisor..the lady on the phone said this was not possible ..she would get someone to call us ..Today. I called to ask why it was needed and they could not provide an explanation and the claims assessor was unavailable. I was promised a call back within 24 hours and heard nothing. I called myself and was told the assessor was not in but again they could not tell me why I needed to provide additional information but maybe I had provided too many documents or my insurance didn?t cover the days I was away- both of which were untrue. Having just been to Bali my partner and I had a couple of claims to make. For items stolen and for my boyfriend falling sick. I checked the PDS before buying the policy to see that on page 4 it states that luggage (including mobile phones) is covered up to $5K....BUT on page 45 it then details sub-limits and my $1900 phone was in fact only covered for $600!! If they weren?t being sneaky then they?d have the sub limits with the benefits table!!
In regards to their terrible customer service; I called for an update 16 business days after putting in a claim to be told an email had been sent to me 5 days prior asking for further details, I had nothing in either inbox or junk mail, blatant lies to cover up that they hadn?t got back to me in the advised timeframe of 10 days. We then received an email advising of an attached response, but no attachment and so I had to sit on hold to them for 20 mins to have it sent again. 
Finally, I was dealing with a claims investigator in regards to my stolen items, I was advised I?d receive a response to my claim by COB 4th Feb, I received nothing. I emailed the investigator asking for an update and by 10:30am the next day, still no response. I spent half an hour on hold to them to be told i will be receiving it now. 2 hours later and still nothing. I call again (another 30 mins on hold), this time to be told I will get an urgent call back from the claims officer. Another 2 hours later and STILL nothing! I call for a third time and finally get put through to the claims officer, who sounds unimpressed with my call and finally get the document sent through to me at 3pm.  
I have spent more than 4 hours on the phone to Covermore since returning from my trip, awful service! 
Do yourself a favour and steer clear of Covermore.
