title: Don't fall for the 4 star rating.
body:
Looking back on Cover-More's reviews for this year and the majority of them are overwhelmingly negative. They must've once been a respectable company, but it seems that aspect has since depreciated.

They latch onto their PDS like it is the holiest of documents, almost a god-like narrative written eons ago, and in which every other important bit of information concerning insurance is conveniently forgotten. Including the LAW. I'd advise people to read not only their PDS but also the Insurance Contracts Act of 1984, which in my experience, Cover-More does not abide by. 

I bought my insurance policy through Flight Centre, and I must point out I bought this through a friend who is a travel agent there. I bought what I thought was a 6 month policy and was intending to extend it after 6 months as I wished to continue travelling. Unfortunately for me, I had a major accident in Guatemala which needed an urgent operation - I was immediately on the phone to Cover-More's assistant team in which they casually informed me that my policy had ended 2 weeks prior, uhh what? Someone put my policy in for only 5 months? Gee, if there was a mistake somewhere I would've loved to be informed of it. They told me to check my PDS and Certificate Of Insurance for confirmation. Yet, as I go scathing through my emails and documents in my bag, I then recall that I'd never even been sent those documents. Then they cheekily send them to me for the first time, on October 21st - 3 weeks after it officially expired. 

By law, when you buy an insurance policy, the insurer MUST ensure that the insured has been appropriately notified about their policy, including any relevant documents to be sent in writing. By law, the insurer must inform the insured at least 2 weeks before the expiry of their policy, that their policy is expiring on the given date. In fact, my travel agent friend did write to me about 5 weeks before it 'officially' ended, asking me if I wanted to re-new my policy as it was ending 'soon'. I asked, "It ends on November 2nd, no?" To which I received no reply, and as it goes, most people would take that as a positive response. Since it didn't end on November 2nd and she didn't informed me, this was a bit of a misrepresentation by an agent on behalf of your company, and of course once again, that is in breach of the law.

Yet, in dealing with your representatives over email, they always completely ignore what the law is saying and keep quoting their PDS. How can I even be liable to the PDS if I never received one from you!? Please stop quoting it it means nothing at this point. I get an email every 2 weeks, in it contains perhaps one sentence concerning my particular case and then about 5 paragraphs quoting the PDS, there is never anything new or helpful and in their messages, and in their investigations there was no requests for me to provide information to them - they based their findings on what my travel agent said, "Did you send Jono his PDS?" "Why yes, yes I did." "Great. That's all we need, investigation over". At least that's my impression on how the investigation went, what with all limited information they provided me concerning it. I've asked multiple times for a detailed response on how they confirmed this and my requests go unheard. Seeing as I have enough evidence against those facts, I have a lot of concerns with the way you investigate there.

My dispute has since been moved to GLA which I believe is involved with Cover-More but I'm being put on the 2 week wait again. I've written here because the responses to these reviews seem to come about 10 times quicker then through personal email. I just want this ridiculous dispute to be proceeded with, got enough to deal with, what with learning how to walk again and thinking I'm about to foot a $10,000 surgery bill through no fault of my own, and in just in time for christmas too.

I will point out, I had some excellent assistance whilst in Guatemala in my time of great distress. Your assistance team and nurses talked me through everything concerning my injury and my policy, and your doctor stationed in Central America region helped with communicating with the doctors and hospitals there so that I didn't have to. If that was all I was dealing with and not all this pain and hassle afterwards, this review would be a straight shooter 5 stars! It's unfortunate it came out like this.

title: Coverless, Couldn't Care Less!!
body:
We were recommended Cover-More Travel Insurance by our travel agent. Four months ago I set out to go on my dream trekking holiday to base camp at Mt Everest, In the hotel in Kathmandu around midnight the night before the trek was due to begin, I experienced strange sensations in my chest around the heart area. 

I was extremely concerned and was taken to the Heart Hospital, as only a few years ago I lost my son-in-law while trekking with him on the Kokoda Track. He passed away due to an unknown heart condition, which made me realise I had to get myself checked out. The doctor told me while I was with the trek leader that I could not go on the trek. 

I got told to return to Australia for a check up.
Now after lodging my claim over three months ago and numerous phone calls and e-mails and repeatedly sending the same information we have still not had an adequate response from Covermore.

We are still waiting for our claim to be processed and it appears that they have tried to claim back money from our credit card. We did not take insurance out with our credit card we took it out with Covermore, which was a big mistake, and I advise anyone looking for travel insurance to give Covermore a wide berth.

What service?

title: Broken ankle and surgery
body: Five months ago I fell and broke my ankle in Germany. It required surgery, 5 day hospital stay and physical therapy before I was able to travel home. Insure and Go was very easy and fast to work with and they paid directly to the hospital so I did not have to worry about anything. I had the bronze cover (excellent value for money) but not that I realize what can happen I will take the Gold coverage. Customer service was excellent.

title: No transfer of dates
body: Due to government travel restrictions we were unable to travel at the end of April. I contacted Insureandgo and asked if I could transfer my policy to a new date in April 2021 as I assume travel restrictions would be eased. Not possible was the reply. So one unused policy, what a rip off. I had another policy with Covermore for a trip in March 2020 and they advised me I could ?slide? my dates forward to a time when I felt I could travel. Now that is CUSTOMER Service.

title: Great peace of mind
body:
I always use this company twice a year for travel. I often take my grandkids and they are included for free. I only claimed once and had the utmost courtesy from staff.

 A great company.

October 15th 2019 Update: Excellent travel protection

No hassle claims. Good customer service. I'm using them again next month for Europe. I wouldn't choose anyone else. I have used them 4 times this year. Excellent phone  service.

October 17th 2019 Update:

Insurance is a good price and excellent service. Helpful staff and a pleasure to talk to. Great followup service for claims.claims settled in 3 days. I always insure with this company.

title: Untrustworthy
body: We were four weeks into a six week overseas holiday when an immediate relative died unexpectedly in Australia and we needed to return home urgently. Budget Direct were very slow to respond to our request for advice or assistance and when they did reply, they said they could not comment until a claim was lodged. We read the fine print of the policy and it states they will not pay any claim over $500 unless prior approval is given by them, but obtaining approval proved impossible - they either ignored our emails or restated their no comment position. We gave up. This is an insurer you cannot trust. Just another greedy company without scruples or integrity. Be warned!

title: Cancellation Insurance is a total waste of time and money!!
body:
Book holiday of lifetime to Europe to celebrate major milestone.  
Have to cancel trip due unavoidable and distressing change in family circumstance.  
Should be all good, purchased that expensive Cover-More cancellation policy that was pushed on to us by the travel agent. 
Nope, it pretty much covers nothing!!
Lost over $14,000.00 ...

title: Useless when it coms to actually cover what you suppose to be insured for
body:
Had travel insurance with "insure and go" for my recent overseas trip.
Charged me for the full 6 weeks of traveling period including rental car cover. When came to making a claim for a small scretch on the rented car I found out that I was covered for 14 days only.
I realized that  I was driving a rented car and not being covered for most of the time.

title: Super easy
body: The policy was very easy to purchase and the price comparative or better than other similar policies.  Whilst I didn't need to make a claim, I would feel comfortable in doing so.

title: So Far So good
body:
The policy was good value and easy to set up, all went smooth.\
we were lucky enough not to had any experience in making a claim but the communication and information provided by TID was excellent.

title: Crap
body: Reply to your customers and show respect to them. I'm not claiming for anything but after using you on several occasions I won't be using you for my next trip

title: Not just talk, they back it up!
body: Have traveled quite a bit but you never think you'll use the travel insurance. Well, Cyclone Debbie put paid to that. Cover-More assessed my claim for lost flights and found we were entitled to a refund. Just provided the details asked for and the claim was approved very quickly The policy was easy to set up and understand. We are going overseas again and once things are organised I'll be onto Cover-More to arrange our insurance again. No worries!

title: Question
body:
Hi,

My wife is pregnant and we are travelling to New Zealand for a vacation. I am keen to understand if the travel insurance will cover for any medical attention she required in relation to her pregnancy? Of course her doctor has cleared her travel.

Please advise.

title: 1Cover wonderful
body:
Easily organised and value for money travel insurance. We've used 1Cover Travel Insurance every time we have been away over the past two years and will continue to do so. A fantastic organisation. We have used other companies in the past but none come close to 1Cover Travel Insurance. Well done team.
Easy to organise and inexpensive.

title: Dont waste your money use the free credit card insurance
body:
My travel agent told me to take covermore insurance out before I went to Italy for 5 weeks.I travel a fare bit and normally use the free credit card insurance. In Lake como my husband dropped our camera getting it out of the bag.We bought a new one in vience as every time we turned on the camera the picture was blurry. It dampened the first few days of the holiday,but we thought we paid for travel insurance we'll claim when we return is'nt this what insurance is for, especially if its your first holiday to Italy, and you've saved your life for this trip and the first claim Ive ever made for travel insurance. Not so they first said they required a letter from a repair shop on the cost to repair, so I did this also they had my original docket and bank statement , for proof of purchase. 

I then received a letter back, telling me( that my rarely used camera, as we all use iphone and tablets now), has a 85% depreciation on it and is now only worth $61.34.I then have my excess of $100.00 so I will receive no payment.Lucky I haven't insured my house with them, with depreciation I would get nothing. What happened to old for new.I really look after my things so this is very disappointing. Anyhow they are the loosers, I will let everyone know, but first Im going to the flight Centre and blasting them, Then I'm ringing the radio station, and contacting the Sunday Times. Please everyone out there, tell all your friends. I know the travel agents get a big kickback from covermore and they really push covermore over the free credit card insurance, but you all need to know its a big rip off.

Not worth a cent ,useless, big letdown

title: Quality Cover
body: Now,at age 66,I had no problem with 1Cover insuring me.Fortunately I didn't have a claim.I did have a claim in 1998 and it was handled promptly and efficiently.Will always insure with 1Cover.

title: Unfair expectation
body: Lost jewellery in Venice did not know where to report to police had my claim knocked back for not reporting

title: Last minute cancellation refund ?-excellent response
body: I have insured for travel at least 4 times with Insure and Go having found them easy to deal with both by phone and their website. I had reason to cancel a trip to Europe including a river cruise 2 days prior to leaving due to one of our party of 3 ( all insured with Insure and Go) having a sudden major back problem where she was unable to move. Sadly there was no option but to cancel. While having to fill in a lot of paperwork and supply medical documents proving our claims ( as expected and necessary) the claim and refund was handled in a couple of weeks with little inconvenience to all 3 claimants and we received most of our expenses back. We have all reinsured for our next trip in February.

title: Insurance policy charge sucks with Cruising 4 nights Brisbane Gladstone Brisbane
body:
No need to leave the ship, but the Policy covers a "Rental" and many other items to pump up the premium. This policy was also purchased with another for 14 nights around N.Z. Approximately $90 difference.
A short Q'ld coastal Cruise for 4 nights and nearly $200 with two days at 30 minutes to a Hospital.
That won't happen to us again. No Cruise in Q'ld waters and won't need insurance. Don Neil.
I have averaged two such policies a year since 2007 and once a year over many years prior to 2007.AND - NEVER EVER HAD A CLAIM FOR MY WIFE AND I.

title: Our preferred insurer and Insurer of choice
body:
Easy site to navigate. Never needed to claim, but am sure it would be hassle free if ever needed to do so.
This is the only insurer that bothered to insure my wife, while others refused, even when she had recommendations and a written endorsement from her Doctor that she was fit and able to travel.

title: Excellent customer service
body:
This is good value; as to whether it works out I hope I don?t need to find out.
Customer service in buying was first class. I feel satisfied with the product so far.

title: Go Australia Go Holidaying
body: The policy was very good value it was easy to set up the customer support was excellent this is the second time within less than 12 months that my family and grandchildren have used your service, we are very happy with it. Thank you.

title: Misleading
body: Not very satisfied. The insurance I chose was misleading and it was very difficult to make a claim and prove ownership of items I owned for years. So I could not claim it.

title: Travel insurance
body:
This is a terrible product - avoid. I had a business meeting in NZ. I paid for travel insurance for myself and my wife. Before the trip I had a suspected heart attack (which was not, thank goodness). After discussion with my client we agreed thought that it would be best not to travel. I looked at the online web site as to how to claim for a medical event, and a form was required for the doctor to fill out which was like war and peace. I was not going to pay for a lengthy doctor's visit for wasting the doctor's time like that. Clearly this form is designed just for this purpose, so that Australia Post do not have to pay out on claims. I tried submitting the claim saying the trip was canceled by my client, but this was denied. 

Don't waste your money with thus rubbish. I intend to make the financial ombudsman aware of the complexity of the medical report required.

title: Flawless Insurance
body: They provide cover for everything at an amazing price, love supporting a company who is doing good for equality too! So easy to talk to and find answers through the instant message feature, seamless process. Will be booking with them again and again and have already told all of my friends

title: Completely satisfied
body: Travelled last year to KL so happy chose Allianz again this year I bank with NAB have all my personal insurance with Allianz and being 77 years of age they have always given me great assistance and any claim I made was dealt with almost immediately so why would i bother with any other Insurance company

title: Simple, straight forward, suits me fine
body: Great value policy, simple set up, very satisfied. We have used 1 cover several times being senior citz, thought it a good idea and good value. Haven't had to make a claim as yet fortunately; but feel sure they would be good to deal with if necc.

title: Give it a Go
body: First timer so haven't traveled as yet but feel the policy covered all the bases and the price was very competitive doing this through the seniors web site so I know who to blame if anything goes wrong!

title: Very disappointed
body:
We missed our transfer (which included an internal flight operated by the resort and a boat ride) during our holiday because the airline delayed our flight of over 2 hours.
We filed a claim with InsureandGo to request compensation as we had to seek alternative arrangement to reach the resort (we had already paid over $400 for the transfer via plane/launch). The claim was declined as the flight was not delayd of "12 hours or over"! How ridiculous is that, insurances are supposed to cover clients whe unexpected circumstances take place which are outside the client control, and a delay of 30 minutes can be as costly as a delay of 24hrs, but this company seem to think that a customer can only be out of pocket if flights are delayed of over 12 hours.

I will wait until the official letter arrives and will contact the Financial Ombusman to see if they agree with the insurance company.

We made the mistake to purchase the multi-trip insurance, please don't make the same mistake.

title: Very easy to arrange.
body: Very easy to set up, value for money,  hopefully will not need to test the claim process.   Have not previously used this company for travelling, policy gives a strong sense of security.

title: Quick and easy process
body: Policy was good value for money & covered all necessary areas, compared highly to other policy's about $5 more expensive for a week trip but covered a lot more fortunately didn't have to claim anything but will use again in the future.

title: Seemed suitable for us.
body: The cover seemed good value for money. Seemed to include extras. Easy to set up. We didn't need to claim,so all went well. I would use 1cover again when travelling.

title: good cover
body: Policy is good value and was easy to set up. The cover appears good and service to date is efficient. Will use again if the experience continues to be positive.

title: Dont waste your money
body:
Cover more - should be Cover Less
My flight was delayed by 1 hour, which meant I missed the last connecting flight to my destination. This in turn meant a rebooking on the next available flight 12pm next day, overall an 19 hour delay. Cover- Less only note the 1 hour delay, not the other 18 hours - what a joke, save your money, use alternate insurance.

title: TID value insurance
body: Not the first time I have used TID. Insurance is easy to purchase and very comprehensive. Great value for money. I will recommend to family and friends who are traveling.

title: No Hassles Travel Cover
body: Very simple to get a quote and lock in cover. I have used TID several times and even though I have been fortunate enough not to have to make a claim they always remind me when I return to make a claim if necessary.

title: Great service in emergency situation
body:
My daughter's return trip from Europe to Australia had to be delayed just 2 days before scheduled departure time, due to her sudden illness. After a few reverse charge phone calls (and some nervousness) to TID emergency contact phone line all got sorted out and TID stuff advised us that she just needs to get the medical certificate stating that her sickness did not allow her to travel to Australia. So she did that (which was not easy I must say, considering how she felt). Few days later when my daughter felt better TID people at London organized and paid for her a return ticket to Australia, all in one day ! The ticket was ready and waited for her when she arrived to the airport.
Friendly people, good coordination, good quality English, prompt actions, prompt return calls and good final outcome.

title: Great price
body: Always use 1Cover when travelling just to make sure we are covered for any injuries or medical reasons.  Haven't needed to use the cover but is worthwhile knowing we have it.  Great price too!!

title: Zero customer service
body: I had to involve The Financial Ombudsman to get a refund on our travel insurance. Allianz then agreed to repay us but over 2 months later no payment and no apology from them.

title: Called 1Cover from my hospital bed and they said Don't Worry
body:
l recently returned from Thailand in March 2013.  I had an accident and ended up in Bankok/Phuket Hospital.  I called 1Cover from my hospital bed and they said dont worry they will open a claim. Everything was taken off by 1Cover doctors bills, hospital bills, rehab bills, xrays ect.  I literelly done nothing it was all taken care of for me. Best service I have ever seen from and Insurance company I will definitely advise anyone going overseas to use this company. First class staff members and service.  Well done 1Cover.
Fantastic staff they kept me up to date.

title: First time using them and Happy with Product Services
body: We have used them once, and considering we had an emergency and the service was prompt in our request. Yes I would use them.

title: Won't pay out on flight cancellations due to weather
body: Do not use this insurer. When my domestic flight in Mongolia was cancelled due to weather I missed all my international connections and had to rebook flights home, incurring a cost of $1900. Insureandgo denied the claim on the basis that the list of inclusions for payments for cancellation of flights doesn't include weather events. Their pds doesn't state this as an exclusion. When reading their pds I suggest you try to guess which items they have omitted and then use a crystal ball to predict which of the omitted items might happen to you. I have read many many similar reviews of insureandgo on different sites. They don't pay out for legitimate claims. This insurance is not only a waste of money, it will leave you out of pocket. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

title: Don't use, attempting not to pay legit claim
body:
I purchased A1 cover for domestic travel insurance within Australia. The specific aim was cover my rental vehicle excess. Unfortunately I reversed into another car and damaged their door. 
I made a claim and was told they don't pay any third party costs i.e. The other car damage! This despite their Product Disclosure Statement stating they will cover the costs of the repair for property damage which you are liable. The other person's car is their property. 
I honestly feel that I've been defrauded. What kind of insurance doesn't cover the other car in an incident?! 
I can see that I am going to have to take this to the ombudsman. 
My advice, purchase your insurance elsewhere. 
Stuart

title: Great
body: Quick and easy to find, sign up with, use and well priced too. Even with pre existing medical conditions signing up was easy and the price good. Very happy and would use them again.

title: Terrible - Read the fine print - Crooks
body:
Will never use again! 
If you read their fine print for possessions lost or stolen, most situations are not covered, they will not pay for anything. You require certain certain documents within 24 hours, they use special words like "public places" which gives them an excuse not to pay. 

Honestly felt like the only thing they will consider to cover is if I got robbed in a hotel room, and ill have to realise my possessions are missing and make a report within 24 hours, or else I get nothing. 

Another example of insurances promising cover yet covering every themselves in convoluted terms and conditions.

title: Easy to set up, good value & the lady I had on the phone was outstanding
body: I spoke to a girl called Radha & she was very polite, new her job, helped with our questions & that is the reason we gave 5 star

title: So easy to use, helpful when a claim was needed
body: Not exactly sure, maybe used 12 times, have made 2 claims, one substantial claim and have never had an issue. Both times helpful filling out paperwork, claim was paid quickly

title: The only way to go.
body: Very few insurance companies will insure people of our age but we have a great history with Allianz Travel.  We have never made a claim, but they do provide the comfort of knowing that we are well covered.

title: Great value
body: I did my claim online, was really easy and had all the information I needed, I was happy with the amount I paid and even though I did not make a claim I will make sure I continue with 1cover travel insurance for future holidays

title: efficient
body: I can't believe how quickly my claim was serviced I am thinking of changing all my insurance to RACV you are so efficient

title: Terrible
body: so the policy was pretty good, covered all the things that we may have needed, if our trip went ahead.  our trip has been cancelled and we can reschedule with a full refund if needed.  Not with insure&go. No refund. No reschedule available. Why, cause we applied for the policy 2 months before sailing, and because the cancellation was requested outside the cooling off period, you feel that it is right that you keep our money?

title: Wouldn?t go anywhere else.
body: So easy to organise insurance for myself. And personal help was available promptly when needed. I wouldn?t go anywhere else after this for my insurance needs. The products on offer are very competitive.

title: Thankfully didn't have to use
body: We thought our policy was good value. The customer service was good when opening the policy as I had a previous injury to state and they were more then helpful.

title: Made a claim - smooth process - will be using again
body: First time I have ever had to make a travel insurance claim, and I have to say 1Cover made it very easy.  They answered the phone quickly while I was overseas in Japan affected by the typhoon.  Their staff member on the phone told me the important parts of the policy that was relevant to the situation and so I was able to make a decision based on that.  Submitted the claim after our holiday following the instructions of 1Cover, and the claim was approved very quickly.  Will definitely be using 1Cover again given our first experience.

title: Overseas Travel Policy 2017
body: Policy is of good value for our overseas travel requirements, the Policy was easy to set up, and very satisfied with the Customer Support in setting up our Policy requirements.

title: Excellent Service
body: I have used InsureandGo many times with no claims, Unfortunately I had to claim recently on a cruise that I had to cancel after paying the full amount. I found the whole process easy and was paid in a very short time.

title: It's called "Insurance"
body: Good value. Easy to set-up online. Didn't need/use customer support. Didn't make a claim so cannot comment on whether or not the claims process and customer support are any good.

title: Efficient service!
body: I felt the policy was a bit on the expensive side especially with the $100 excess.Nevertheless I was happy that I had it! Policy was set up by Travel AgentClaim submitted on Tuesday16Aug and completed today 18th.V efficient.Was unable to access the Travel sim as it kept rejecting " Australia" & W A when I tried to register. Gave up as I did not really see the need for it!

title: Good price easy set up
body: Have insured with them a few times personally have not had to have a claim found the price competitive my friend claimed when she couldn?t go on our Europe trip because she broke a leg before she went she got a refund no problems just took a little while

title: Shame on you!
body: I thought this would give me some basic cover should a situation arise. Sure enough we had a terrible flight back to Australia. Wont go into detail but the result was I got a migraine and forgot to collect my jacket between the flight changes in Singapore. Well it seems there is 'fine' print leading to exclusions under either buyer purchase protection or travel insurance cover. Both forms have been declined. For such a small claim at about $100 after excess, I am bitterly disappointed. I sincerely think the time and resource effort put in to reject my claim would have cost more than processing it. Shame on you Cover-More.

title: Difficult and unreasonable
body: I broke my leg skiing in the USA. I was told I needed to see a specialist. I flew home three days early and I sought to claim back internal USA flights plus my hotel room. Travel insurance Direct refuse to pay it because they say it was non essential travel. Had I stayed in the USA to see the specialist it would have cost thousands. These people are appalling.  I would not recommend that anyone use them particularly given the dishonest spin in their sales pitch when you buy their policies. I bought the highest possible level of cover to deal with situation I am now claiming on and they do not pay

title: Very unhappy customer
body:
We have used TID 3 times previously but never had a claim, so no complaints until now. On our 4th time, had to cancel our holiday beforehand, due to unexpected bad health, eg. Major heart surgery. Claim was submitted at the end of August and still unresolved. 
We submitted our claim once all the required paper work was done & also received the same automated replies, then 10 days later, we received an email requesting further info / docs & submitted, to receive the same automated reply and this has been the pattern ever since. My emails are not answered & have called a few times and requested that my case officer call me, but still no contact.
Contact has now been made with a different person who has promised to look into it,again.
It would seem like TID is trying to get out of paying, looking for pre-existing conditions but who books a holiday for a family wedding and then decides to rather have open heart surgery to get back a portion of your expenses and the wedding had to be cancelled!!!
Further to the above, the medical condition was picked up by chance and if it had not & we had proceeded on our holiday, there's a 99%chance that my husband would have died overseas which would have cost TID far more!!

title: golf trip
body:
yes easy on line I have used it many times.
I have used your company many times.
I like to have pease of mind when travelling just incisor something goes wrong.
I travel 3 times per year and I need insurance to be assured I'm covered in all aspects.

title: Travel nsurance Policy.
body:
I am glad that I had a travel insurance policy. I had a frightening experience when landing  at Hong Kong. The plane seemed to go down too fast for me and my right ear hurt, even though I was chewing mints. When  I arrived in Amsterdam and boarded the boat, I noticed blood on my pillow for the first two nights, then it stopped.  After this, I noticed myself getting a bit hard of hearing and it gradually got worse, so when I arrived in Vienna, I saw a doctor who sent me to an ear specialist who gave me tablets and also a nasal spray to use for my flight home, which was very good - no more ear problems. 

Covermore Travel Insurance was very helpful and they advised us what to do and everything went smoothly- no problems. I was very happy with Covermore and will definitely insure with them next tine I travel.

title: Home
body: Easy to set up. Did not need to use in end but gave me peace of mind especially when our flight was cancelled in Mexico. The flight company managed to get us home via an alternate route and we got home safely with no extra cost.

title: Peace of mind
body: I purchased travel insurance recently for a trip to Fiji - it was very reasonably priced and had good cover. It was very easy to set up the policy, got emails just before leaving the country and on my return. While I didn't need to make a claim, several people in my group were struck down with gastro and colds, requiring them to visit a local doctor. I was very glad I had the insurance even though it wasn't needed. I'd definitely purchase from TID again when travelling overseas.

title: Good but untested
body: Everything was great and easy to purchase, but I haven't had to make a claim so I can't comment on that part.

title: Poor service
body: A also submitted a claim with suresave and they said the same thing it seems like the pattern is the same and you ring them sit on hold for 30 minutes and then they hang up

title: Do not use cover more
body:
I provided receipts from the hospital and doctors surgery and they still would no pay out my claim. Strongly recommend not using cover more for travelling over seas. 
Cover more take a ridiculous amount of time to reply to all emails.

title: Expensive travel insurance
body: Travel Cover was $150 more than the NRMA travel insurance so I would not recommend 1cover as there  are more cost effective alternatives  so shop around and compare policies before you  buy.

title: Awesome policy
body: Didn't have to make a claim , but was more than happy to go with Allianz . I checked out quiet a few other companies but found Allianz was the one for me , will select Allianz in the future..

title: Travel Insurance you hope you never need!
body:
These people use the same claims manual as the insurance company in that famous movie The Rainmaker!  Deny all claims, and push claimants between departments, so there is no way you can get all information from one person.  They try to wear you down, but don't give up!  Demand to speak to management, and if that doesn't work, the ombudsman is designed for these sorts of people. I do speak from personal experience, when 2 flights within China were totally cancelled, and I had to buy new tickets from another more expensive airline in order to travel on the original travel dates to keep to my business itinerary.  Lost track how many times the details were faxed to Cover-More.  Each time I followed up they said they had not receievd the faxes!  Eventually after numerous phone calls, and once I said I was about to go to current affair and ombudsman, they miraculously found the faxes and paid out the claim.

unprofessional, unhelpful.

title: This company should be called Insure and Scam
body: Booked a holiday to Vanuatu and then the COVID19 hit like everyone else we are unable to fly. Lodged a claim and like everyone else they denied it, as Air Vanuatu offered credit for 12 months which we cant use and wont ever use now. This company uses every insurance tactic in the book to deny claims such as long protracted delays, asking to provide documentation again and again, long telephone wait times and hanging up on you. Their facebook page is littered with negative comments, stay away from them, we know [name removed] will add a comment down below from this company apologizing to try and look like they are compassionate. We want our money back and now are going to AFCA to complain, I suggest all other people do the same. I am also writing to my local federal member about this scaming company. They should not be allowed to operate in this country.

title: Ongoing satisfaction
body:
I have used 1 Cover each year to travel to the USA since 2007 with my most recent trip in Nov -Dec 2016.
I continue to use them because each year when I compare costs /Vs cover their rates are very competitive. With regard to claims - on the three occasions (separate trips) where I had to submit a claim, their turnaround and fairness were exceptional.
No complaints whatsoever and I will continue to use them as my benchmark for future trips

title: Easy Travel Insurance
body:
Our policy was good value for our overseas trip.  Easy to organize with helpful friendly staff who recommended good cover at a reasonable price.
We would definately use again and recommend

title: Amazing Insurance Company! Went Above and Beyond.
body: I ended up in Hospital in Thailand at the end of my trip as a solo traveler and Allianz were amazing. They had their nurses call me and check how I was going, they called my Hostel to let them know the situation, they spoke to my parents and at all times kept me fully informed and made sure I was on the right track to recovery. When I got back to Australia they called me up to check on how I was going and kept me fully up to date with the process of my claim. I've worked in insurance before and can say that without a doubt Allianz are the best. I will never go with anyone else.

title: Complicated claims process, no local costs covered; otherwise handled quickly and without questions
body:
I injured my shoulder skiing in April in the USA. When I put in the initial paperwork, I was surprised to be told that I had to fill in a multi-page report, including getting signatures and details of my medical history from my doctor. This was after being treated by experts in the USA, so I didn't think that paying to see my own doctor was really necessary. 

I was also very disappointed to find that my ongoing medical expenses in Australia were not covered. But that was in the policy, I guess, so I can't really complain. It just seemed that costs I bore as a direct result of the accident should have been covered, including those here which were a darn sight cheaper than they would have been in the states.

Anyway, it took me a few weeks to get everything together and send it off. Then I worried that it might be rejected due to the time that had elapsed since the accident. But I was pleased to find that a payment was made within a couple of weeks, in full less the excess.
efficient, helpful staff
pity related costs at home are not covered: check your policy

title: Great cover for price.
body:
Policy is good value. Easy online process.
Although we have never had to claim, customer support has been very helpful when we have made enquirys. Ie when potentially stuck in Bali due to ashcloud.

title: I alway take some insurance depends on policy & what's included at the best price
body: I didn't have to use the insurance so unable to tell if it was good but the information I received was good when I purchased thanks Lee Thompson

title: One clause which needs reassessment
body: The policy was excellent value compared to competitors. It was very easy to set up. Customer support was exceptionally helpful.  However, when I discussed the information contained in the Travel Insurance document, I found that a couple meant 2 adults who lived together and they received a cheaper rate than I could get, even though I saw us as a couple even though we were a mother and daughter who didn't live together. Why is there a greater risk in insuring a mother+ daughter compared to a woman+woman or a man+man or a woman+man, as long as they are travelling together as a couple? Insurance rates usually reflect risk levels.

title: No compassion, given circumstances.
body:
I intended to travel to the USA and Canada for a period of ten weeks from mid-July, and took out a policy with the organisation, whom I had previously used, when I started to book various components of the trip, but thought that it best to cancel the trip when the extent of the current pandemic became known.
I sort advice from "InsurenGo" about their cancellation policy under the current circumstances, and was told that the policy could be cancelled, but there would be no refund, and I was referred to the policy wording, and other relevant terms, conditions etc.  
I was told that I could appeal the decision, which I did, even though I knew it would be a fruitless exercise.  It was noted that the General Insurance Code of Practice applies, under which a response to the complaint is required within fifteen (15) days.  I am still awaiting a response, and we are now well after the 15-day period.

Apart from the lack of a response from the organisation, I am a little disappointed that the organisation is taking such a hardline approach to a situation beyond everyone's control.  They won't be paying out any claims, and thus are making money for no risk. The Australian government has urged all organisations to show some compassion, but obviously it is not happening here.  I have had no real issues with other organisations from whom I have sought refunds.

DSD

body: I use 1Cover every time I travel - mainly for their rental car excess cover.  The car company's excess reduction fees are steep, and to not have any protection is just playing with fire.  Unfortunately I recently had an accident in a rental car and had to make a claim.  1Cover approved the claim in 48 hours, no questions asked.  Couldn't hope for anything better that that.

title: Exemplary!
body:
The customer service at TID is nothing short of exemplary. I have been a customer of TID (every time I go OS) over past 8 years or so  and I must say that all other client facing organisations (not just insurance) should take a note from their book.
 
I have made a claim with TID once before. Not only was the process efficient and painless, it confirmed my choice. 

Not only do they care about the welfare of their clients, they do not hide from claims, but rather proactively raise the issue with a view to ensure that if any client making a claim is dissatisfied, they can email a ?real person? directly to discuss. It?s great to see TID putting a little effort into recognising that the customer ?experience? should not end on the day your insurance ends. 

For many people any recognition that their insurance company is not only aware of your travel dates but interested in ?how you went? and if there were any issues is unexpected. Even though insurance companies are often large, financial institutions predominantly calculating risk via numbers, why not differentiate by adding  simple, thoughtful, courteous and logical customer service initiatives to your offering?
 
No need to mention that you?re also the lowest cost, with the best coverage/inclusions representing the best value. Good customer service is just a bonus!
The service is excellent.

title: Appalling customer service
body: I also have used this company and referred all my friends to do the same over many years.I have never had to make a claim before. like many others I purchased our gold cover last October for travel in May, being well before a pandemic was declared, I lodged a claim in March and after phone calls by me was emailed for further documentation, which I supplied. title: Deceptive - Referred to AFCA
body:
I gave Insure & Go a try only because I was recommended to them in a 'Mailout' by Seniors NSW.
I obtained an online quote from I & G which was issued with a promise of the quote being "good for 30 days' which was also confirmed in conversations with their Service Staff.
A couple of weeks later when I used their email quote 'link' to proceed with the purchase of the insurance, it took me to a payment page, but fortunately I noticed that the premium had increased. There was no separate notification from I & G alerting me to that fact..
I lodged a formal email complaint with I & G, & promised a response within 15 business days but nothing.
I then lodged a complaint with AFCA & in due course I got a written response from I & G saying "On the 21 November 2019, Insure and Go had a premium increase and this resulted in the increased premium on 24 November 2019, when you continued with the quote originally obtained on 09 November 2019."
So in other words, quotes are good for 30 days unless "Insure and Go has a premium increase".
On that basis, I feel that their claim that their quotes are 'good for 30 days' is misleading and deceptive.

title: Terrible experience
body:
I have used Allianz/ Online Travel Insurance several times before, but never had to make a claim. This time I did. They showed their true colours.
My domestic plane to Melbourne was delayed, which means I missed my international flight. Policy claims they will pay for "Reasonable expenses" when a journey is delayed for 6-24 hours or more (the wording for this in their policy is extremely convoluted).
Uber into Melb and back ($90), hotel ($300) and meals ($100). 
According to the policy, the costs of changing a ticket due o missed connection should be automatically reimbursed ($140). The carrier only has one flight per day, so 24 hours was my minimum delay.
Policy has a $200 excess. I submit all documents. I base my claim on missed connection, travel delay and that I had an event to go to (I submitted these docs as well). 
Allianz reject the claim stating that "reasonable expenses for a 24 hour delay" IS actually $200 (in Melbourne?). They refuse to pay for the flight change as well. Allianz send me an email stating they have "trying" to get in touch with me. My phone works just fine.
I dispute their decision. Three weeks later I receive another email again stating they have "trying" to get in touch with me. Again, the phone works just fine and no missed calls or messages. Allianz ask me to call them back on a 1800 number. I tell Allianz I am now overseas and 1800 numbers do not work so kindly reply via email. Allianz do not respond... 
Their insurance is misleading and the wording convoluted. The reason people take insurance is to cover their backs with unforeseen incidents. Allianz misleads customers; their product does not deliver what it promises to or what consumers have paid for. I will now take my case to Consumer Affairs.

Once l was home and put in a claim (even with a Death certificate) my claim was knocked back because in the fine print it says that if you of a family member has been hospitalised in the last 2 years you are not covered. To protect myself I called insureandgo with some simple policy questions, the representative did not understand what I meant when I asked who administers there emergency assist line as sometimes this service is contracted to third party companies, further she didn't seem well informed on where the emergency assist call centre is located.

title: Absolutely poor management of getting me home with a broken collarbone
body: Covermore was extremely unhelpful in getting me home from Japan. I had to organise And pay for my own bus from Hakuba(6hrs from Tokyo) to the airport, was told about my flight on the day and had to book the bus immediately, very lucky it wasn?t yet full as they usually fill up quickly. I had requested I needed assistance with my bags as I has a snowboard bag, suitcase and backpack and was unable to carry these as I had broken my collarbone. They simply told me once I got to the airport to ask airport staff or the bus driver for help, I also did not speak Japanese. I did manage to ask a kind stranger who spoke English on the bus to help me. They said they had arranged for assistance when I got to the terminal. Once I found the terminal I discovered it was closed for another 4 hours, therefore I had to sit at the check-in terminal for 4 hours. While on the bus to the airport, I somehow managed to worsen my injury, my collarbone had snapped on the bus and I could not support it at all and had to hold my arm, therefore rendering me with no hands. I tried calling covermore for help/advice, they said there was nothing they could do to help me and that I?d just have to continue on my journey to the airport as planned and try come back to Australia. They put me through to a nurse who was absolutely useless during this stressful and scary time he sounded completely uninterested and that he didn?t know what he was talking about. Once I had managed to get to the check-in desk, I had someone take me to my gate in a wheelchair, as I said at this point my collarbone was snapped and I could not support it at all and could not carry my backpack. I asked if they could assist me by wheeling me to the bathroom. Once I had gone to the bathroom, I came out to find that they had left. I had my backpack with me but could not carry it myself as I had to support my arm. Therefore I had to push through the excruciating pain in order to pick my bag up and walk back to my gate and wait another 1.5hrs until my flight boarded. I could not believe how poorly supported I was in my experience and will NEVER use covermore again. I highly suggest you look elsewhere.

title: Read the PDS.
body:
I lost my $500 glasses overseas. On the 27th of June, TID receive my claim which I posted in a couple of days earlier. On the 16th of July, I enquire how my claim is progressing. On the 17th of July, TID announce that my claim has been settled. They depreciate my $500 claim by 60%. After my $100 excess, I will receive $103. TID note that the PDS states depreciation will be calculated at "rates reasonably determined by us". During a telephone conversation, the claims officer informs me that the depreciation rates are determined by a proprietary method. I ask for a review of the rate among other things. On the 19th of August I receive word that my claim, after "thorough review" stands. I must compliment TID for the speed with which they transparently handled my claim given the complexity of the case. I look forward to putting the $100 to good use. When it comes.
Professional phone manner. Nice hold music.
Vague PDS. I've seen snails move faster.

title: Extension of cover whilst overseas - watch the "waiting period"
body:
I was provided with comprehensive advice on how to extend my current annual cover (1 October 2012 to 30 September 2013) which was due to expire while I was overseas (Trip: 14 September to 20 October 2013).  "All I need to do was to send an email close to the due date to 1Cover and it would be organised".  No problems with this part.  

Email sent on 28 September.  Then it took more than a day to get a response: Yes they can extend my policy but what was my policy number?   Jez...I already said in the email I had an existing policy - couldn't they just have searched on my name???   Another 24 hours later (because my first contact was "out of the office" finally I get an email on 30th September confirming that I have a policy and asking to provide my CC details. 

Thought is was expensive for an 10 day extension; annoyed to find that when the policy arrived (the day before my existing policy was due to expire)  I would have to wait another 7 days to claim medical treatment (not that I needed it then) but what happens if I did? So here I am driving around Southern France WITHOUT medical cover if I need it.  Why should I have to wait when I a) had existing coverage, and b) had no history within that coverage of making a claim? Annoyed that I was not given advice when I made the orginal enquiry that I would have to "wait 7 days" - very dishonest of service provider NOT to draw that to my attention.  I would have taken a different policy if I'd known THAT!
Covenient to extend existing cover whilst overseas
Misrepresentation of cover; expensive for the duration; poor response to emails;

title: NEVER AGAIN
body:
I purchases our comprehensive travel policy on the 29th September 2019.  This was long, long before COVID 19 became a "known event".  I phoned the call centre on 11/3/20 when the travel advice for Italy was level 3 to find out if we would be covered.  I was told that with a letter from our doctor and a level 3 travel warning we would be fully covered.  The operator also told me if the travel warning was raised to level 4, we would not need the doctor' s letter as we would automatically be covered.  Before we could get an appointment with the doctor the  warning went to level 4 so I started an online claim.  
 
Thought I would phone Allianz and just make sure we were still covered as previously told by their staff member.  I was then informed that I had been given the wrong information and we were not covered.  However it was suggested that I place a claim as each claim is addressed on individual merit and circum
stances.  Nobody will give you a direct answer over the phone.

I am disgusted that I was given such incorrect information.  I did ask if Level 4 over-rode the pandemic clause in the policy and was told yes it does.  Obviously this staff member needs further training or I am now thinking that perhaps the incorrect information was given to me as some kind of sick joke on her behalf.  
but at the time I was foolish and trusting enough to believe her.  
 I will NEVER use Allianz again for any type of insurance.  Travel insurance companies are doing nothing to assist travelers who are out of pocket through no fault of their own, especially if  their policy was purchased before the pandemic was declared.

title: Found out that the rental car cover doesn't cover personal liability
body:
Very disappointed with this policy. I took the 1Cover policy based on its claims that it would waive the excess on rental car insurance and that it had personal liability insurance. I found out when renting a car that this cover specifically excluded the personal liability component for a rental car.

The advertising implies that you are covered and that you don't need the extra rental car insurance. This is not true as you are not covered to the level that is needed.

When I spoke with 1Cover by phone at the rental car company they had to go and look at the policy and claimed that it was on page 31 of the terms which states in clause 16.c that it excludes any liability from "Your ownership, custody, control, or use of any firearm or weapon, aerial device, watercraft or motorised vehicle"

I strongly recommend that you avoid 1Cover if you are after any significant reduction on rental car insurance.

I had to fly back home from interstate to be by her side and care for her. When she was finally ok and recovering from home I started the process of claiming for my emergency flight back. The process started on 17 January when my claim was given a reference number....I provided all information asked for then was continually asked to provide more, was rarely given receipt of providing documents. They did not accept a an official hospital medical certificate signed by a doctor saying she had been admitted to high care. Was sometimes asked for the same information over again. The process is long, drawn out and designed to make you give up. I have only just got confirmation today 29 May of my claim being approved...it took 19 WEEKS. So no I don't recommend this company and will never, use them again.

title: Super service
body: I have travelled overseas a number of times and after hearing about Covermore and the reading the detail I was happy to use this policy.  The policy was easily set up with help from our Travel Agent.  Now we get to the critical part.  Over the years I have lost baggage, had to visit a doctor and getting any money returned was either difficult or didn't happen.  After a serious fall with concussion and a trip to hospital in Asia and then the need for all sorts of tests including CT Scan, blood tests and a night In ICU, I really wondered how all this would work.  My Tour Director stayed with me on the trip to hospital and the various things that happened overnight.  He rang the insurance company for me and I spoke with the person on the phone, just to let them know what was going on, as far as I knew at that time.  But then the gentleman I was speaking with put me through to the nursing staff here, who talked me through what was going on.  She took the necessary time to reassure me about my treatment as well as their support from Australia.  I was truly blown away by the support.  To follow up on this service, they rang as soon as I got home, to follow up on everything and get it all sorted over the phone.  Eventually I received my credit card statement with the Aus Dollars for the hospital bill and emailed that and some other doco, and it was all done and dusted.  Best service and follow up I have ever tripped over.  I found the pricing competitive and would absolutely use them again, and recommend them to any one who asks.

body:

On the 28th [name removed] said "The company was working towards a solution for customers and would be in touch with people who had contacted them soon" and "The solution will be available in the next few days, and we will also be contacting those customers who have reached out to us over the past few weeks,".

title: Horrible, stressful, Claim process
body: We had used 1-Cover for over 15 years and never had to make a substantial claim. However in February 2016 our family travelled to Fiji and stayed at the Sheraton. Unfortunately the deadly Cyclone Winston devastated Fiji during the week we were there, we lost a lot of possessions, and our holiday was totally ruined. When the cyclone hit the entire country and the Sheraton was in total chaos, staff did not know what was happening, it was like a war zone, no electricity or conveniences at all.  I- Cover on their Website advertised all Cyclone Winston Claims would be settled, but they asked for heaps of paperwork, rang the Sheraton, not believing certain events that took place, and after all the trauma, they rejected the claim on no concrete basis. When the cyclone hit we were all evacuated and we lost our belongings when we ran for cover. . I explained all this to the Claims officer, and our claim was not a large amount, but was still refused on the basis that there was not enough receipts and that the Sheraton's version was different to ours.They staff at the Sheraton were so busy and exhausted organizing meals and dealing with complaining customers and cleaning up and most of the staff had to leave to go back home to their families and just told us to claim stuff from our insurance and not hassle them. Our entire holiday was ruined, and I felt that 1-Cover let us down.  I have never used 1 Cover since 2016, even though they still send me marketing emails, inquiring why I have not used them for my travel insurance needs for a while.

title: Unexpected costs.. I'll ask better questions next time!!
body:
we took out full cover for our USA trip recently.  Due to a pre-existing health problem (it's never been a problem though) we ended up paying over $600.  I made a claim upon our return for lost glasses and a cracked mobile phone. I gave all documentation and emailed the claim off.  I received a txt two days later to say it was received, and to expect 10 days.. ok... I received a call to say my claim had been settled and I'll see this in my chosen account.  I was shocked to see it was less than half of what I expected and I had 2 lots of excess taken.  It was one claim.... the word 'Event' is not disclosed anywhere as 'separate' and this really annoyed me as it meant only the screen was covered. on my certificate is clearly say Excess $100, not $100 per item claimed.  My glasses had a depreciation of 55% and then the $100, which meant I could somehow buy a new frame and lens for $25. please tell me where????  so angry about 2x$100 just because it was two items.  The holiday and insurance was one. i didn't take out separate insurance for each holiday stop, so why the separate excess. Never again!!!.  I tried to contact them today, 35 mins on hold.. sorry but that's really bad in my eyes not good customer service.
Online for everything you need

title: Worse Than Useless During Hurricane Harvey
body:
When i called 1cover two days before the storm to mention that i was heading towards it and was i covered for changing my travel *away* from Harvey i was told that there was no cover until *after* the event.  

When i called from Houston during Harvey to ask if i was covered for getting a hotel in Dallas if i could get there i was advised that i was supposed to stay in the same hotel or 'in the area' (in other words stay in the disaster area!) and that i wouldn't know if a Dallas hotel was covered until i put in a claim (who wants to bet the claims team reject it?).

So the Emergency Team can't advise on cover. They have also provided zero advice on the best approach to minimising the impact and expense caused by Harvey.  So what their role entails is anyone's guess (giving useless rote responses seems to be their current modus operandi).

What is painfully obvious is that 1cover are fine if your biggest travel risk is losing your phone or having a flight delayed. If you find yourself in a serious pickle then you are better either relying on your own wits or going with a *real* insurance company.

title: The are ignoring me after receiving my claim. Cannot speak to Claim agent, time keeps ticking by.
body:
I purchased the travel insurance online before going to Bali for myself and family. I bought the Gold package as the difference in price was like $30-50 more from memory.
The villa we stayed in was broken into and our things as well as friends and their kids things were stolen. Our friends had a different insurer and they received cover for their claim after about 2 weeks.
I supplied everything they requested and had receipts for most things. They wanted the originals so I had to keep photocopies for myself. They stated when I called them after not hearing from them, they received it on 16 August. They also stated in their policy and when I called, it's 10 days to process. It's now been a month and that's not the worst part.
Whenever I call I get an international tele-centre, they don't give me any information except it's being processed and if I ask to speak to my claims agent, who originally emailed me she's either not at work or in a meeting. If I ask why my email hasn't been responded to, the operator says she will now forward the email. Soon after that I get an email stating the email has been sent. I've called and emailed in excess of a dozed times each and have had 1 reply email from my claims agent for further information which I immediately supplied. That was two weeks ago and have had no feedback from them despite my efforts. 
Their internal dispute resolution service is an email which doesn't work, one day after sending it I got an email saying it's being delayed in sending and not to try sending again, then a day after that it states it was not sent. I did try again with the same result. I'm being totally ignored and fear my only avenue now is the Financial Services Ombudsman or small claims court.  
For other having the same difficulties, I'll update this as things progress.

body: We have had many trips without a claim and the last one we had was the first that we needed to make 3 claims on. When we returned we submitted the claims straight away. It was lucky we had our boarding passes, etc. from ALL flights and not thrown them away after use like we usually do... as we didn't realise we needed them for the claiming of just one flight. I was surprised with what was required for them; in saying that though, I guess there would be people who abuse their insurance claims too, so they have to be specific and demanding to avoid false claims. All claims were paid out in a couple of weeks. An individual excess came out of each claim. We have since used 1Cover Travel Ins. again for our next holiday insurance as well. Next time though we have now learnt to save every piece of paper including dates, receipts and copies of the credit card statement from 12 months ago showing where and when the flights were purchased. All was well in the end, everything was honoured, but it was a pretty long process to complete 3 claims, hence why I had the day of work.!

title: Peace of mind.
body: Easy to set up - very important! - have not needed to claim but have travelled twice with confidence and look forward to using you again next year. Also one of the best value policies.

title: Says they do claims for natural disasters including ash clouds, but only if you've bought your insur
body: We were supposed to fly from Perth to Bali on the 13th of July, we ended up booking our accommodation/travel insurance etc on the 9th of July. I was struggling to fill out a claims form and was on their website looking for some help pages when i found a link for natural disaster claim advice. Managed to find a relevant part which states 'There is no cover for costs for policies issued on or after 3 July 2015 as the current ash cloud and its effect on air travel is no longer deemed an unforeseen event.' To be honest it just seems a little ridiculous, surely if we aren't going to be covered for anything they should tell you before you fork out money for nothing, or at very least i would expect them to mention the page via email so that we could find out for ourselves. I'd also already spoken to someone on the phone about our claim and not once did they think it might be a good idea to mention that our policy was pretty much invalid. We're seriously disgusted at this at the moment, if we knew that we weren't going to be able to claim anything beforehand then we wouldn't have booked replacement flights and wouldn't be out of pocket. Absolute waste of money and time, we will never even consider going through them again and will be warning friends and family of their loopholes.

title: Missed Flight - 1st Claimed denied but 2nd approved
body:
I travelled to Europe via KL in May 2019. Due to conflicting flight information between airlines and ground staff I missed my flight and Turkish airlines forced me to pay another ticket (avoid TK airlines - they're the worst!)
I made a claim with Medibank and they denied it. I wrote back to them expressing how angry and disappointed I was with their refusal. Also mentioned how I would swap my private health cover to a better company if they refuse my basic claim - I did not feel like a valued customer at this point!

The following day I received a phone call from a representative. He was very friendly, understanding and I felt he genuinely wanted to help me. My claim was approved that day and 3 days later the money was in my bank account.

Very happy I chose Medibank travel insurance together with private health.

title: Insurance why do we need it ???
body: Good value and eady to use online..compared with many other insurance companies and InsuranceGo comes out on top everytime. ..the only one we use when travelling..great value for money...thanks InsuranceGo

title: Handled our only claim efficiently
body:
Fortunately we have only made one claim in the 5 or so years wee'e been using Covermore. The claim was processed efficiently and we received our refunds for the extra costs as a result of being delayed by the Chilean volcano. Hopefully, if we do have another travel incident, it will be handled in a similar way
Efficient & straightforward claim process

title: It?s good to feel safe if things happen
body: It was easy to set up and pay. The online service was outlined in an easy to follow way and made the process simple. Fortunately I never had any problems and had no need to use it.

title: Easy to buy
body: I bought my travel insurance over the phone and I was able to solve questions that I had and make sure my policy was covering what was important for me. They were helpful and it only took me a few minutes.

title: Repeat customer satisfaction.
body: Third policy in 3 years covering quite different destinations and duration. Did not bother this time in running a price comparison, knowing the rates have always been very competitive.. Telephoned direct and completed the cover in 10 minutes.

title: Easy application and responses.
body: Easy to apply and relatively quick responses when needed to update details. Would be good to have web/live chat 24x7 otherwise good to have long term options for working holiday.

title: Check Hire Car Coverage
body: I recently took out of policy with InsureandGo and on reading the fine print discovered that they only cover hire cars for a maximum period of 14 continual days.  This is not highlighted on the benefits page and was only discovered when reading the fine print.  They were happy to cancel the policy and after a couple of calls a refund of my funds are on the way.  Staff were helpful on the phone.  I have had travel insurance with several companies and this is the first one I have come across which limits the number of days coverage.

title: A good travel insurance
body: Bery Satisfied... thank you and I will contact you again next time when I go on a holiday and maybe I will recommend you too  to some of my family and friends.

title: Liars, timewasters, complete waste of money
body: Put in a reasonable claim for medical expenses as recommended by their representative. Refuse to pay. Liars, complete waste of time. They wait for months to reply to my emails. I think they are hoping I will go away. I will not. You can't tell me to get a medical procedure, that it's covered, and then tell me it's not AFTER I've paid. They keep dodging my emails and not getting back to me regarding this. I would not recommend this company to anyone. Avoid at all costs.

title: Always take out travel insurance
body: I feel our policy was adequate for what we needed and easy to set up. However you never really know about value for money until you need to use it.

title: Do not purchase your policy here!!!
body:
The sale representative told me that I can purchase the insurance and then call later to add my husband in the policy at no cost. I did exactly how he told me, and now I called to add my husband in, they said I have to pay a separate to add him in.  
Totally misinform the customer to lure you in purchasing the policy and turn around and said something else.

Bad customer service,  Do not trust what they said

title: Pre-existing Condition
body:
First, but not the last time, I have used TravelCard. They understood that even though I have a pre-existing condition I am still very fit to travel and enjoy myself. Staff via the internet and telephone ensured the set up of my insurance policy was painless. This happened after days and days of contacting, or trying to contact, other companies and their denying me coverage.
And the price was right!

title: peace of mind
body: Once again, we were lucky to not have to make a claim but always remember the ease when we have previously had to do so.

title: No improvement on perfection
body:
Took my annual holiday 15/5 to visit my daughter in Japan, 2nd evening fell ill, a viral infection of sorts. Struggled through till 24/5 then saw a doctor who diagnosed Chronic Bronchitis.  X'Ray, consultation & issue of anti-biotics
resulted in a fee.  After my return to Australia 31/5 I mad a claim for the amount charged with the help of my Travel Agent.  This claim was honoured within 5 days - I have always insured with Cover-More but this is my first claim which has certainly convinced me to always insure with this company when I travel... Excellent service!

title: Good cover, Aussie based.
body: Easy policy to arrange. Cost is affordable. Correspondence is great via email. Have not made a claim but know of someone who has and from all reports they were fantastic.

title: Trustworthy! Insurance you can afford and rely on!
body:
Insure and Go had a very competitive price and looked to cover all the travel worries. We have never had to make a claim on travel insurance in all the years we have travelled, but the 'claims' reviews are the one I always checked, as they are the ones that give you confidence to buy. 
Insure and Go were easy to purchase online, great coverage at reasonable rates. AND!!! When we had to cancel our trip before leaving for our holiday, due to a sudden health issue, they dealt with our claim very efficiently, we were so relieved that we picked a company that delivered on their insurance policy! So now we know for sure this is a company you can trust and rely on. Of course we provided all the necessary paperwork that was requested on the claim application form.
Christine looked after our claim with professional customer service, friendly help, prompt replies, and always keeping us updated with how things were progressing. Very happy with customer service.

title: Excellent cover for Seniors
body:
Very expensive for me as a Senior in good health, can discounts be made available for those with doctor's certificate of good health?
Easy to set up.
No customer support was needed so far.

title: Easy to buy, very good product
body: Great value for money and peace of mind. Have used 1 Cover several times, my daughter had to make a claim a couple of years ago and they were brilliant. Highly recommend.

title: The speed at which I received confirmation of my application was amazing --  just what you need when
body: The speed at which I received confirmation of the application was amazing . Just what you need when you have numerous ( or at least seems that way ) issues to tidy up prior to travelling . Love this company .

title: Very Disappointed
body:
My wife and I travelled to USA in July 2016 for daughter's wedding, the day before we left Australia we were advised by the airline company that our flight would be delayed by 11 hours, no reason given. We had an onward flight with another airline company from Los Angeles to San Diego which we would now not be able to catch.
We cancelled our original onward flight and rebooked a later flight but due to the late notification the airline company would not refund our fares nor give us credit towards our new fares, leaving us out of pocket.
We subsequently heard from staff at the airport that our flight was delayed because of a mechanical problem which required a replacement plane to be brought into service.
We made a claim to Cover-More for the cost of our lost airfares which was caused by circumstances totally beyond our control, but the claim was rejected as their policy only covers such claims if caused by a strike.
We feel it is a total cop out to reject such claims.

title: User friendly website, quick, convenient and affordable comprehensive cover.
body: User friendly website, quick, convenient and affordable comprehensive cover. Didn't have to make a claim, fortunately, so can't comment on the customer support. But it's good value for some peace of mind, and we'll continue to purchase travel insurance through them.

title: Suited my requirements for business.
body: Good value for money with friendly and professional service when arranging the policy providing peace of mind whilst travelling overseas. I would recommend family and friends to use Allianz for their travel insurance.

title: Be aware of the loopholes that this insurance company uses, to not pay claims.
body:
I bought the policy for peace of mind as I had done many times before when travelling.
When it came to claiming, a big fat zero! I believe that travellers want a piece of mind when buying insurance and that doesn't end just because of how easy it is to buy the insurance online. Burying details in a 60 page document about how you'll squirm out of paying a claim. Be more upfront, (this maybe hard for an insurance company).
I decided to use 1Cover years ago after having a problem overseas with another insurance company who wasted my time until I just said forget it, and took the loss. I thought this company was different, but no!

title: Can't fault this company!
body:
I first contacted Customer Service in order to see if my situation qualified for a claim and their reply was returned promptly.  I then did as they directed and everything was so easy to complete via the internet.  I particularly liked the reminder emails of what documentation was required and the way that the claim did not have to be filled out from the beginning again if there was some information that I did not have in order to finalize the application at the one time as the site saves each page as you go through the claim and can then be continued from where you last stopped at a later date..
great customer service; inexpensive; extensive coverage; easy to use web site; prompt follow-up service

title: Value and convenience
body: Very competitive in price, better than the standard offerings through travel agents.  The coverage looks fairly good. And it's easy enough to arrange on line; TID remembers your historical data if you're registered as a repeat user.

title: Absolutely terrible!
body: Your customer service is despicable & impolite to say the least. After being told we were not covered ($30k cancellation cover) I was told ?have a nice day?. No empathy whatsoever!

title: Easy peace of mind

However, due to the time difference between Australia and Europe, I received the email reminder the day after it expired. When I asked about extending, the response was 'oh, your policy is expired, now that you are already overseas, you need a different policy- at twice the price of the initial'. body: I purchased travel insurance as I always do on holiday, my flights were cancelled and 1Cover refused to compensate me for loss of flights and accommodation when I attempted to make a claim, and wouldn't even refund me what I had paid for the insurance, even though I never left Perth! all in all a very poor service, meaning I am out of pocket for my whole holiday and I never even got to go.

Was cheaper

title: Total rip off
body: Refer to recorded phone claim made today. Tried to make a claim for loss of Income, Personal defamation, damage to reputation. Was told it was not safe for me to assist a handicapped person off a cruise ship into Auckland. I may no longer be asked to assist this client on future holidays.

body: At least 3 previous times. I?ve never made a claim before. I find the cost and coverage more than adequate for travel.
