body: I have tried to make a claim about accommodation that didn?t confirm my booking and took my money... they didn?t want to refund my booking as I booked somewhere else.. they said I can?t make claim as it?s my personal fault... what a crap service and no help .. it?s not insure and go it?s waste your money and go

title: terrible
body:
Completely pathetic. I had a hospital bill of $180 dollars in Koh Samui which i could not afford to pay. I called covermore and they said to email along some of the medical documents. While i was on the phone the nurse had the nerve to tell me to have the doctor change my diagnosis as it wasn't a "real" one. I later found out that it was, and that this nurse obviously had no idea what she was talking about. I was meant to leave Koh Samui in two days however the hospital had my passport as collaterall and had a flight booked out of koh samui two days later. I went back to the hospital both days and they said covermore still had not responded. The hospital had emailed covermore four times with the medical reports. I called covermore and they were very blaze about getting my claim sorted. They said that they still needed my doctors details in australia to rule out that what had happened was not a pre-existing condition. I asked them why they had not thought of contacting the hospital to let them know the reason they could not move foward with my case was because of this, or better yet why they had not thought to contact me when i sent in my case details after our initial conversation, they ignored those questions.
So i sent off the doctors details on the spot and the woman on the phone assured me I would hear back from covermore in 48 hours. I had already missed my flight at this stage and was paying much more than i expected for accomodation, not to mention my condition was serious and i needed to get home asap. 
Two days later the hospital still had not heard anything from covermore, after emailing them numerous times.
I decided i might have to wait one more day, so the next day i returned, by now the hospital was frustrated and would not let me contact covermore from their phone, and contacting covermore elsewhere in thailand was expensive. I finally managed to call them and they said that it was a problem with my doctor in melbourne, that he had not yet responded to them and that they would do everything they could to get the claim prossed for me the next day.
The next day I called covermore and they had still not begun to do anything about it - I had an extremely rude woman on the phone who claimed that covermore had been in contact with the hospital via email, this time i was back at the hospital and the foreign manager there had his emails open with no sign of a response from covermore. I asked her where she got off thinking she could lie to me and asked her to put me through to her manager. I told her manager i was not happy and the woman on the phone said to me "Well you can deal with that when you get back home" then refused to give me her operating number and name. Eventually this vile woman connected me to my doctor in melbourne and had the nerve to start speaking over me to the receptionist at the clinic. THEN, the receptionist said - the doctor has not received anything from covermore regarding that patient - at this point the woman from covermore would not stop speaking - probably trying to cover the mess up. I firmly asked her to be quiet and asked the receptionist to repeat what she had said and the receptionist again stated that the doctor hasn't received anything from covermore and that she didnt know anything else. Covermore then asked to proceed over the phone with the doctor and said to the receptionist to have the doctor call her and then she will start processing my claim. Covermore the next day finally let the hospital know that they were accepting the claim, however did not state the correct things eg. "not a pre-existing condition" and how much the claim was for - so therefore the hospital were reluctant to accept. I finally got my passport back the next day then made my way to bangkok the next day to return home asap. my insurance policy exppired on the 31st on january and i was meant to be back in bangkok on th 23rd of january and to leave within the week back home to australia. however i was not able to leave koh samui until the 3rd of feb due to covermores sickeng lazines. When i arrived in bangkok I fell ill again and had to return to hospital, this wouldn't have happened if it weren't for covermores incompetence and i wouldn't have missed my original flights and i  wouldn't have had to spend hundred of dollars on accomodation. and unfortunately because they took so long to assist me, i was left without cover the next time i went to hospital, definitely not worth forking out $300 dollars because at the end of the day they can't be trusted to assist you promtly overseas and at the end of the day you're better off without their assistance. 
I will be making a much bigger deal about all of this in the next few weeks and will be seeking full compensation for my stay past the day i was first promised that covermore would have processed my claim - including the next hospital bill. I have never felt like I had such little faith in a company - especially when i was so sick and this was a company from back home who is meant to help, the hospital in koh samui was so appalled that they ceased accepting outpatient claims and claims under a certain amount from covermore due to my case. 
I would not recommend them to anyone and would suggest going with a larger insurance company and getting your travel insurance there rather then a smaller insance company like covermore who specialises in only travel.

completely unhelpful, incompetent employees, uncaring

title: Hassle free insurance
body: Great value.  I took lots of electronic gear, paid extra and managed to get one piece damaged. This was promptly dealt with. Fabulous customer support. A few kinks with the new online application form, otherwise couldn't be better. Thnx InsureandGo

title: Terrible
body:
My wife was snowed in on a recent trip to USA and there was a real possibility she would miss her Los Angeles to Sydney flight as she was two and a half hours late leaving Colorado with a short connection time in LA.
The brochure and website for Covermore  has a large multi coloured summary of benefits which for the top cover we had purchased offerred "unlimited travel benefits if delayed due to extreme weather".
When I spoke to Covermore to try and arrange a booking on a flight later that evening or LA accommodation if she missed the flight they pointed out to me the fine print on page 26 which said that this benefit was only available if weather had caused a >12 hour delay. If she had missed the flight she was going to be stuck in LA for 36-48 hours but again the actual weather delay was only 2.5 hours therefore ineligible-Absolute disgrace and stay away from them
How quick they were to take a customer's money and issue policy
Failure to pay or even help when we tried to make a claim in USA-disgraceful deceptive advertising brochure

title: Have not had a claim.  I have some medical issues & at least I can pay extra for EMC cover & peace of mind.
body:
You really only know how good or otherwise an Insurance company is, til you have a claim. Thankfully, I have not.
But, I do have some pre-existing medical conditions that other travel insurance companies refuse to insure me.
I happily pay extra for the disclosed coverage and peace of mind it provides.
Cover more is now our 'go to' travel insurer.
Easy to take out, navigate site, read essentials.

title: Great
body: Recommend this cover to anyone wishing to travel, simple and easy. Seems easy enough to make claims if u need to.

title: Thank goodness I bought 1Cover! Excellent customer support! Terrific company!
body: I have always bought travel insurance whenever I travel as I travel to Singapore about twice a year. This is the first time I bought travel insurance from 1Cover, and it is also the first time I had to make a claim in all my years of travel! I had severe water retention when I was in Singapore and on my second week, my blood pressure went to severe and dangerous levels, at 225/125 and pulse of 168! I had to go the Khoo Teck Phuat hospital's A & E department and stayed a night there till my blood pressure reached a normal level. As I am a foreigner in SG, the hospital bill was shocking compared to free hospital treatment for Australians in Australia's public hospitals. Therefore, I was perplexed with the bill that was almost 1k! I had never made a travel claim in my life, so I wasn't sure if I can claim it without much problems. All my previous travel insurance were also expensive compared to what I've paid with 1Cover, hence, I was initially worried about the company's credibility. However, I received prompt customer response and follow-up after I contacted them, and was informed about their approval for my travel claim after I submitted my online claim back in Australia. Thanks so much for 1Cover, and kudos to the company for their excellent customer service and credibility in travel insurance. I will always be your client from now on. Thank you.

title: Great travel insurance
body: Didn't need to make a claim this trip, but had to last time and TID was excellent. Making a claim was easy and payment was prompt. Highly recommend TID for travel insurance.

title: Allianz Travel Insurance is no good
body: My fishing trip was postponed several weeks due to weather and the lodge manager sent us a letter that, in his experience, provided sufficient documentation to make a claim if we had travel insurance.  I incurred several hundred dollars n air fare change fees and when I submitted the claim to Allianz, they denied it saying their trip delay/cancellation policy did not cover actual trip delay/cancellations!  This is appalling, do your research, find a reputable company, or take your changes.

title: Cheap when taking policy - would never settle your claim
body:
I had taken a TID policy in October for my travel to US. I chose the highest form of family cover as I was travelling with kids. 

I was mugged in my journey and thankfully only lost my hand bag which had a laptop and a mobile phone.

I duly reported it to the local police and took a sigh of relief that I had taken the highest cover so hopefully I wont be out of pocket.

So I came and logged a claim and dealing with a claim officer called [name removed]. I logged the claim on 19th Nov and its over 4 MONTHS I am still working with [name removed] despite of saying TID has decided to go ahead with the claim.

The way they work is they will make take 10 days after your email to come back to you with question and even if you respond to that question they will take another 10 days to come back with additional question and so on and on.. 

Their auto reply says their SLA to come back to their clients is 10 days so they will literally take 10 days.

So it goes I am still waiting to hear from my so called settled claim and they don't really care.

I had to record my phone calls with [name removed] and also with the police station in US to prove to TID that I actually logged a report. This is after providing them a victims bills of right ie standard report from US which any police station will provide they make me go in circles and asked me to prove the list that was provided to US.

The law in US does not allows them to share this on phone so I went in circles on and on

Overall my experience has been TERRIBLE. I feel they dont care and their claim department probably has incentives to take as long as possible to settle a claim.

After providing everything finally one day I received an email a month ago that my claim is settled and I should expect a call. After all this [name removed] called me on 9th Feb and said by the way can you help us find the cash withdrawal in the statement (that I had already provided on 19th NOV!)

I then took efforts to find that transaction and help them with page number and highlighted withdrawal and send it back same day.. that was 9th Feb and today is 28th Feb and I am still waiting...


Don't even go close to them they don't care.

title: Disappointed and disgruntled - loyal customer no longer
body:

We usually are satisfied with the service,,when we were stranded in Paris during the volcanic eruption, they helped us join our tour in Morocco, and we were grateful that they would work with our travel agent to get us on the first flight out.  On return to Australia the remainder of our claim settled fairly quickly. 
BUT....
This year my partner got sick while we were in Europe and was hospitalised racking up huge medical bills which were required to pay before discharge.  It was three weeks before returning to Australia, and my partner was fully recovered by the time we returned. Covermore endeavoured to make my partner see his own doctor at our cost to provide a report on his illness.  Being fully recovered we needed to argue that this was vexatious and pointless as a doctor will not report on your condition if you don't present with it. This didn't stop then requesting 18 months of medical records.  Keep in mind each request delays the processing 10 days. 
We started the claim process and we were less than impressed with the time it has taken to resolve the claim.  The claims manager has 10 days to deal with your enquiry or submission.  So every time they need a little more information, you can expect a wait of 10 days, then they will ask for another little snippet, which we would send immediately, and then the waiting begins again. We started our claim 3 months ago and we are still waiting.
We will be avoiding Covermore Insurance from now on. You should too.

November 8th 2017 Update: Beware! The PDS has changed

Be careful if you are considering Covermore and are expecting the conditions to be the same as the last time you used them. The PDS has changed and a lot of what they used to include in their cover is now excluded. Don?t get caught out. READ the PDS carefully. You may choose to look else as we will this year.

title: Dedicated to ensuring I forewarn as many people as possible
body:
Allianz travel insurance is quite legitimately a scam. Firstly don't be fooled by the overwhelming positive reviews on here which are posted by their marketing/media team, but they are so fake you shouldn't really have an issue working that out, however, chances are if you are reading this, it's already too late sorry.

Despite them covering "loss or stolen" items, sadly, unless your hotel room is broken in to or items were snatched from your hand, it's neither lost nor stolen. My wife and I were playing with our daughter and had personal belongings just a few meters from us attached to our pram, the items were stolen but Allianz classes this as unattended items (tiny clause they keep well hidden). which makes perfect sense right? in the eyes of an insurance company trying to make money, it's theoretically not stolen, nor lost, it was just unattended and repossessed by another deserving human being.

The best part though, this 2 month ordeal, they wanted to question other people we met on our holiday, they requested insane amounts of documentation, things you simply cannot understand, yet at the end of everything they say "item was unattended". So why request insane amounts of documentation when the issue is it was "unattended" which they had understood from the first line of the claim? It's all just a gross invasion of privacy so they can hold as much of your personal information as possible and at least try make you let go of your rightful claim.

On top of what was already and increasingly stressful situation, Allianz managed to make it 10x more painful. So the best I've been able to do is educate the thousands of people I have across my social media platforms and continue to do so with everyone i communicate with.

Avoid at all cost.

title: Terrible service, lack of understanding and no regard for medical best practice
body:
Don?t let the name fool you, when it comes to coverage they are of the philosophy that less is more.. Not exactly what you want when it comes you?re our health. After been advised to get rabies post-exposure shots after a run in with an unfriendly monkey, my girlfriend and I complied and received the shots (after all the doctor is the expert and the consequences of rabies in universally fatal). We began our post exposure course and notified the insurance company. On returning to Australia I was informed that we could not claim the expenses (totalling about $800 between the both of us) due to them not been necessary, after all the doctor had only advised that we receive them.

I pointed out to the insurer that I work in public health and regularly deal with potential rabies contacts and that there is no diagnostics for rabies unless you have the brain on the animal that bit (I didn?t stop to kill and decapitate the head of monkey that just attacked us). And that the only way to know if a human has developed rabies is after symptoms begin (at which point you have a better chance of winner the jackpot lotto then you do of surviving the next 2 weeks). 
After a considerable time spent in correspondence with always a different person, all of which I should point out were sympathetic on the phone reassuring that the mistake would be cleared up and I would receive payment with the next 10days? After roughly 3 months I received my first check, thinking the awful saga was now behind me I was confused that the check was only for roughly $17. 

I sought clarification from cover more and was told this was all I could claim after the processing fees are removed. Each claim for the prophylaxis (5 each for me and my girlfriend) were individual claims. In total I would be receiving roughly $200. 
Another lengthy back and forward battle with people assuring me that it will be sorted out lasted about 1 month before I enlisted legal support. After one letter from was issued I received the full amount back minus only 1 processing fee (fair enough I think compared to 10). 
I find it almost incomprehensible that a health insurance company would be so incompetent to suggest that rabies pep is only a recommendation and not a necessity and it is deeply regrettable that It required a letter from a legal firm in order for them to act on their obligation. 
When travelling avoid the monkeys, when picking insurance also avoid these monkey.

We unfortunately had to make a claim after a mugging and they paid to cover a replacement phone no problems, however, the assessor was extremely rude and a bully when my daughter in law called to make the claim. He constantly repeated "You expect me to believe that" and then indicated that my son was a coward for not fighting the gang that committed the crime. I wonder if he would be so brave had a man called about the claim instead of a young lady? He really should be weeded out and retrained or put in a position away from customers.

title: NEVER USE AGAIN. SHOULD HAVE STUCK WITH WORLDCARE
body: Took out the top cover for our 19 day holiday in Vietnam. Accidentally left my phone in the front pocket of vietjet on the way from danang to Ho Chi Minh. I did everything possible to locate it. Must have been stolen...so I make a claim...we don?t cover losing something...what???? Isn?t that the point of having insurance. Unbelievable.

title: Simple, seamless and well priced
body: I have used Insure and Go for all of our family trips. Their website and contact centre are very easy to use, understand and helpful. Never had a problem and will use them again for our future travels.

title: Its good policy but impossible to get money from them..
body: I and my  wife travel  last year.. we lost our laggage when we called the customer service . there are many hidden clauses that they never say when we buy policy.. its bad..company..first cover.didnt pay any money..never buy from them.. please..

title: Great travel cover
body:
The policy was extremely good value & easy to set up. It covered all our needs & there were no hidden extras.
Would use this cover again in the future.

title: Great policy
body:
I have used this insurance company three times. Very happy with claim outcomes. Would highly recommend them.
I will definitely use TID again when I go overseas.

title: Seniors segregated
body:
Insure&go is by far my number 1 and only choice for travel insurance. They were the ONLY company who will insure pre-existing conditions. Conditions that are just part of the aging process. I have not had any hospitalisations for 20+ years. All my conditions have been managed by medication. One would think National Seniors to whom I pay a membership would understand age related conditions. But sadly NO. 

I travelled to Vancouver last year and was fully covered by Tick Insurance. This year, with no added conditions, I was not able to insure with them. Apparently there is a partner insurance group that agreed to insure me. I had a wonderful representative, Mike, who looked after me and seemed to understand where I was coming from.  Of the 8 or so insurance companies I approached, mike was the only one who successfully found a policy that covers me completely, cardiomothy and COPD included.  I?m now a very happy customer.

title: Very good
body: Very good value.  Easy to set up.  I found them rated highly by Choice Magazine.  They seemed the best combination of service and value.  Didn't have to make a claim.

title: Takes money but provides no service
body:
I have purchased Insure& Go travel insurance a number of times over the past few years and have never made a claim.
My current trip was planned towards the end of June 2020 but have had to postpone it to a later time. All other travel companies have either reimbursed all costs or held deposits for use as credit at a later time EXCEPT for Insure&Go. 
My request was not unreasonable since it was simply to move the period of cover for my trip to later time and as no claim has been made would be of no real cost to them other than a minor admin one. 
Insure& Go have just responded that they can't or won't convert the policy to another date or give credit for future use outside the 14 day cooling off period. 
In other words Insure& Go will take your money but NOT provide a service for it i.e. plain & simple robbery. Their policy is not worth the paper it is written on & I (like many other people) will now never use them again.

title: Simply the nicest company
body: I always use/recommend Allianz to friends travelling. When I did need to make a claim previously they took away the stress rather than add to it. Always great to deal with. Policies are concise, straight forward and cover every situation.

title: Happy we didn?t need to use it
body: Was impressed icover sent me an email before my trip was over asking if I would be requiring extra time abroad, therefore reminding me not to let my insurance lapse. I didn?t need extra time but it was a good reminder. Thanks

title: Good and affordable
body: It is a Good value. Way more affordable than other insurance companies. Does cover a lot and is easy to set up. Also good customer support . Didn't have to claim.

title: Disgusting. Shameful.
body: I was in a scooter accident 2 days ago and rushed to hospital. the hospital tried their emergency number, but 1cover said everything must be paid for up front. In an emergency!!! I paid for comprehensive cover and I couldn't afford to get much done except for one X-ray and some painkillers. I now have to fly back to Australia in 5 hrs and need business class as I cannot sit upright for 6 hrs due to swelling and bruising of my leg. How is anyone supposed to afford a business class upgrade in an emergency???? I Spent all my money on hospital fees and transport , I'm stranded and injured in a third world country. 1cover have not responded to any of my cries for help. I've emailed them 5 times and my sister in law in Australia has been speaking to them but they are not responding. Disgusting service, rude staff. Don't waste your money.

title: Online ordering of Insurance.
body:
I found TID fantastically easy and quick to use. I was heading to the UK with my children for a month google searched and this site came up. The site was easy to use gave you the price immediately  and as a comparison to our in-house travel agent at the University TDI's insurance was $80NZD cheaper. The follow up came 6 weeks after the trip to ensure we didn't have any pending claims and if so this was a reminder. Great service all round.
Cost and ease of site use

title: Dissatisfied Client
body: We were extremely pleased with the original quote and purchased your Travel Insurance for a recent overseas trip. Due to a change to our itinerary, we had to extend our trip by one day and contacted TID to extend our policy, which we did. The extremely disappointing part of the transaction was the premium charged. For one day, it cost an extra  $70.56, on top of a $460.84 premium for 35 days. We expected to pay more for the one day but not be gouged for a simple 1 day increase. A complete loss of trust in TID, because we feel if we actually needed help for a claim, we would not be accommodated and  trust is all there is when selecting insurance of any kind. We will not use your services or recommend them again. Hope the exorbitant one day charge was worth the loss of an ongoing customer, we travel regularly.

title: Travel Insurance
body:
I think that all International Travellers should have adequate cover prior to travel. After some Internet research I chose TID.I believed they offered a great competitive service.The online process was simple and easy to follow.A follow up phone call was dealt with by a professional agent who clarifed an issue for me.Thankfully I travelled safe and I did not need to make a claim . It was a concern to read that others were having difficulty making their claims.I can only make a 4 star judgement based on the ease of buying my policy.Maybe it would be different if I needed to make a claim.Had I needed to make a claim I could only hope that I received the same great service I did when I purchased it.!
Ease of online purchase
Other travellers complaints regarding slow settling of claims is a concern

title: Excellent service
body: only once for internal Australian travel, had to claim due to illness, prompt and courteous service. Would recommend and certainly use again.

title: Good cover
body: It was good value, but no refund or partial refund or credit for the cancellation of our trip due to Corona Virus. I feel this was something out of our control. When I took out the cover there were no travel restrictions. This is probably more indicative of the industry than a failing of a particular insurance company. There was a disclaimer that if the insurance was taken out after a particular date I should have been aware of possible travel restrictions! If I was clairvoyant Id have done Lotto instead.  We are advised not to leave insurance until the last minute but that is exactly what I should have done. Very disappointing.

title: Very unhappy
body: Unfortunately my claim was denied, because I was delayed due to weather. I will never get over the fact that my claim was denied. If I did not have the money to purchase new flights, I would still be stranded in another country. I will never use your company again! and I will never recommend this travel insurer to anyone.

title: So slow and non responsive when a claim is made.
body:
Made claim on April 9th, claim approved. Waited the full 19 days to hear claim was approved, then get email stating funds will be processed... still waiting. No response from emails sent regarding payment. Poor customer service. 
Update: after four calls today at over 20 mins on hold to be disconnected due to technical issues three times.. I was told on the fourth call that my payment hit a technical issue and hadn't been processed yet but will be within 5 business days. So don't believe confirmation emails... They hold your money for as long as possible, excuse after excuse.

title: Always happy with 1Cover
body: Good value for wide coverage. Have used 1Cover before and happy with them, easy to talk to. This is at least the fourth time have used them and haver never encountered a problem with them

title: 1 Cover Insurance claim
body: Policy set up simple, now unsure if it was good value, the claim was easy set up too but their inaction on a claim is deplorable even after phoning so dissatisfied with lack of support. Images now scanned from the Cyclone damaged Samoa have now been submitted as evidence.  Samoan airlines cancelled, we were on Virgin and theirs didn't happen either.  Used 1 Cover for years, first claim, not happy now.

title: No Compassion - No Telephone Communication & Lots of Excuses from every man & his dog from this company
body: I am starting to agree with other reviews about no payouts and communication.Just days before we was going on a trip to New Zealand my father became ill, hence passed away in the first week that we would of been away, funeral on the day that we was meant to come back. This claim is now into the sixth month with excuse after excuse even tho they have the documents more than once.no one will call me back even tho it was promised two times in 48 hrs,it is now two months ago.Beware if booking a trip from RACT and using Suresave insurance you might not be covered

title: Disappointed on Seniors' Discount
body: Generally good; but 15% Seniors' Discount offered applied only to base premium, not also to medical condition add ons, which made it much less value than implied in the promotion.

title: This is excellent couldn?t travel without it !!!
body: Policy was very easy to set up and great value. I didn?t have to use it but felt very confident travelling for the first time knowing I had the cover.

title: In this difficult time with a looming number of claims due to the pandemic we received our claim in full.  Good work
body:
Yes the policy was good value
We received notice our claim was approved and payment was received in the published time frame
This is the 3rd occasion we have used this company for travel insurance and add that we are shareholders in the company

title: Good Cover for over 70's
body: We have Taken out annual multi trip travel cover with InsureandGo for 5 years now. We are happy with the cover and fortunately to date we have not needed to make a claim.

title: Well priced, quick and easy!
body: After comparing a few prices, 1 Cover was coming up on top. The process to quote and buy is quick and easy, all through a simple user-friendly platform. I've covered 4 trips so far this year, and feel much more comfortable with 1 Cover!

title: Very simple and easy
body: Very good value compared to others. Very simple to apply for and get. Put our minds at rest having it..  great value for money and peace of mind. Simple fill in a form or two on the computer

title: Ok if ur single
body: The policy was easy enough to setup but was a bit convoluted when it came to adding my wife and daughter who were travelling separately to myself. Tried doing it online for my wife and daughter but couldn?t so my wife ended up having to do it herself.

title: Frustrating claims process, inefficient, poor overseas call centre.
body: Won't buy again. My wife was hospitalised. they could not confirm if coverage extended to a private room. She was in a 2 Bed ward. They then said she won't be covered for a 2 bed ward, only a single bed. this didn't make sense and it turned out they thought she was in a king sized bed! It's like they've never seen the inside of a hospital. Kept asking for more and more docs. sent through a "discharge report", they said thats not "final"? whats more final than discharge? death? Hospital wouldn't accept their guarantee. They asked me to pay - imagine if the bill was hundreds of thousands? Hospital wouldnt let us leave so I had to pay 8k and now have to claim. ridiculous.

title: Great price for last minute!
body: It was fantastic to find a great price at the last minute, just before we were about to board our plane! We found it in less than 5minutes! Thanks Budget Direct!

title: Substantial cover for a good price
body: Easy transaction with great cover and competitive pricing. Ticked all the boxes for us and we were able to travel with the confidence to know if anything went wrong we were covered.

title: Aweful Allianz
body:
Got robbed in Penang which was bad enough and now Allianz Claims (dealing with a person who won't even give his name) say they won't pay on certain items because we can't find the original receipt.
Don't insure with Allianz..

title: Always helpful

title: Fingers Crossed No claims yet
body: My friends, family and I use 1Cover yearly, the process of purchase is easy, the price is competitive and an easy to read PDF on what is and isn't covered. Would highly recommend

title: Affordable insurance
body: Easy to organise online policy, affordably priced with more than enough inclusions. Great piece of mind.  Didn't have to make a claim so i can't comment on the claims process.

title: Very happy
body: My policy was good value for what i needef it for..it was recommended to me and would not hesitate in suggesting it or re using it again to anyone  for any typeof travel

title: Very poor service after an overseas accident
body:
Following a hamstring injury in the second week of holidays while in the uk I phoned Covermore for help. I got a recorded message saying we'll get back to you within 2 weeks. I phoned again from my pre-paid mobile and the signal dropped out. I waited in great pain outside the building where the signal dropped a d nobody phoned me. Eventually I was able to scan hospital medical records of my injury to cover-more. Still nothing from them. I should say the treatment in the uk was free but I had to pay for medication once out of hospital. I later found out from my Sister in Law my premium of over $1.200 was a waste of money and got the same cover for $650  from VERO the Bank of Queensland travel insurer. After I got back to Australia I sent in a claim and receipts for drugs and walking stick while in the uk and so far got nowhere despite the costs would have only been about $50! We'll never use cover-more again.

November 21st 2016 Update: Rotten service

The service I got from Covermore was rubbish with rude and unhelpful operators. Took over 2 months to process my very small claim after I did my hamstring in the UK in August 2016. The policy cost over $1,200 and later I found out VERO the bank of Queensland would have charged me less than half the premium for the same cover. Will never use Covermore again and advise people to shop around before getting travel insurance.

title: Good value !
body:
I was happy with 1cover travel insurance, price was very reasonable and It was very easy to apply online and there were no problems when making a claim.  The claim process was easy without any dispute. I would definitely use 
1cover again when travelling.

title: Happy to use Cover-More for future trips
body:
We have used Cover-More in the past and will continue to do so. Recently, we had to make a claim. I was sick on the first leg of our journey and consequently had to stay in Singapore for three days. Made a claim when we returned home and was very happy with Cover-More's efficiency and prompt response... and our claimed refund.
Peace of mind that Cover-More's insurance was easy to understand and ease of claim

title: A must have for all travellers

I made a claim for cancellation of my travel due to breaking my ankle late September 2016.  I received remittance ADVICE only of a paltry contribution for partial travel (that part between neighbouring countries) but it this token amount was never received in either of my accounts so I have no idea whose account it went to, if any.  To add insult, the main travel, out of and back to, Australia was ignored.
VERY Unhappy!

Great value for money. Highly recommend Allianz for quick & easy travel insurance and peace of mind.

title: Completely satisfied
body:

The staff were all friendly and helpful and all seemed keen to get my case resolved quickly which they did. I can thoroughly recommend them based on my experience.

title: Easy
body: I didn't have to make a claim but purchasing/signing up was very easy, I will use this company again. Very simple.

title: Great travel insurance

We did not need to make any claims but something you need to have!

title: Good coverage for surfboards
body: For some reason my emails come addressed to Alicia. All of my bookings are made using my name Kevin. Please rectify this. 6 years now. It can't be that hard surely.

title: Rip off Company
body: Like all the other reviews, this company is a total disgrace..Took my policy out in june 2019, to travel in april, 2020, and off course we can't travel, all I asked for was a credit to use next year when we can travel, the person I spoke to was so rude and said bad luck your 14 day cooling off has expired, so please don't use this company, they will rip you off.

title: With a pre extising medical condition
body: Our gold policy covered both my wife's and I pre-existing medical conditions at a very reasonable cost for any part of the world in which we have traveled. Their call centre has been very helpful and have kept records of our past policies.

title: AB
body:
I have used covermore since 2004 and have always found them to be very comprensive with what they cover.  I have been travelling most years since 2004 andThe first time I every had to claim was in the 2011 and I found the process to be easy and stress free.  The staff have always gotten back to me in a resonable time and the turnaround for the payout has always been relativly quick.  The only problem I have found is that sometimes I need to re-send my original claim as it was never assigned to anyone
Speedy turnaround

title: Easy folks to deal with
body: No fuss and value for money. Good to know that there is a company that offers a great service to the traveler.

title: great service

I didn't need to use the service but the price was right and I liked that it included car excess insurance.
will be using them in the future. they could have some discount codes for pre existing customers tho...

title: Shocking Service if you need to Claim!!
body: I agree with many of the poor reviews below.  I lodged a claim with Covermore on 18/12/2019 and as of 25/02/2020 I am still waiting.  Was a straightforward claim, my daughter had an asthma attack on holiday requiring hospitalisation.  Lodged all paperwork online, and I called them 2 weeks later only to be informed, ohh the upload facility on the site doesn?t always work so your medical invoice attachments have not come through.  Umm, so then Covermore, why don?t you call me?  No you don?t, I then email them to you and you take another 10 business days to get back to me, telling me you want further information.  Provided!  Then you send another email 10 days later asking for a letter from my daughters Doctor stating she is Asthmatic.  What does that prove??  Another 10 business days wait you say.  She had an Asthma attack on the holiday, for which she was covered, simple as that.  Just pay the claim!!!  Now well over two months, had enough.  Going to the Ombudsman.

title: Need this security to enjoy our holiday
body: Easy to navigate  site .First time  cruise travellers.gave us options to customise to our own needs without cover we dont need so this made it more affordable for us as pensioners

body: Did not make a claim this trip but was very sick last trip  The claim was payed in a very short time would recommend  Allianz travel insurance  to any person going overseas

title: Easy, fast.
body: I have used insureandgo many times and find the process of obtaining the policy easy and fast.  i have yet had need of a claim but I am optimistic that it would be handled with the same efficiency.

title: Very Efficient
body: My dealings with Cover-More have always been a pleasant experience. This time round, I was amazed at the turn around time-frame. I was advised they would be in contact within 7 to 10 working days and within 3 days the money was in my account and a response received from the claims processing department. I would highly recommend their services.

title: Seems a very good policy and easy to obtain on line
body:
Yes I believe the policy is good value and easy to set up and I will use it again in future  
 fortunately I never had to contact your customer support

title: I was very unpleasently surprised.
body:
I have used Cover-More since 2003 for my travel insurance after a glowing referral from my friend, whom experienced great service. In 2008 I started purchasing annual multi-trip policies and more recently business trip annual cover. I initially thought it a little strange after so many years, buying the policy each year was like buying a new policy with what felt like no regard for my loyalty to the company for nearly 10 years. I have never been offered a reward for loyalty, but that I can live with. The most surprising of all was my recent experience while making a claim. Never during the whole process were the emails/letters signed with a name. I asked for a name, but the person/persons at the other end did not oblige. Neither were my requests for further information to understand the process for the claim, I did receive cut and paste sections of the policy as a reply. Which did not answer my question. The claim was handled swiftly and in accordance with the policy. I appreciate this. I truly cannot understand how a company can survive with such an impersonal approach to relations. I was deeply disturbed that no one put their name to their work.
I appreciate the speed and accurancy of which the claim was delt with. Thank you
The no name policy and manner of correspondence.

title: Terrible claim service!
body: I have provided all documents requested and they are drawing out my claim for no reason. I was told it would be within 10 days, 6 weeks later still no answer after many phone calls. I am sick and unfortunately had to cancel my trip. I provided a doctor?s letter confirming that my symptoms started well after I took out the insurance and also that I am too unwell to travel. I also provided cancellation documents and receipts but apparently that?s not enough! They are now wanting to investigate my health history for the past 5 years! It?s stressful enough that I had to cancel my holiday let alone be stressed about not getting my money back! I?ve had terrible service and would never go through this company again. I?m very disappointed that somehow they have a good rating with choice and Canstar. It?s probably because they are cheap and say that they cover lots of things but in reality when you actually need to claim, they make it very hard! Why bother even having insurance!

title: Good, so far
body: The original quote for cover differed considerably towards the end of the set-up when our ages were input!  Easy enough to set-up though, despite the surprise.   With no claim made, hard to really comment.

title: Cannot travel internationally but can't cancel the policy.
body: I took out a 12 month international business policy in November 2019. After traveling to a few places the pandemic has hit and of course Covermore doesn't cover a pandemic.  But as I can no longer travel internationally I want to cancel the remainder of my 12 month policy as it's worthless to me. Covermore claim that as it's been used there's no refund. But if I sell a vehicle my unused motor vehicle insurance is refunded. Covermore are not being fair to policy holders and don't deserve to exist post coronavirus.

title: Do not use this company
body: My son chose to come home early after becoming unwell in Mexico.He sought medical advice (the doctor did not speak English) but because he did not contact the insurance company or get further advice, InsureandGo will not pay any cancellation costs. He was unable to get reception to speak to us and was in no fit state to think to ring them. He preferred to get home than be in hospital in Mexico. The woman we dealt with was rude and said he didn't fulfil his obligation according to the  policy. Th only people they cover are themselves! BEWARE

title: A very straighforward claim
body:
Dealing with insurers usually makes me cringe, but that wasn't my experience with Cover-More. I selected my policy online -- very straightforward -- and they made it clear from the outset exactly what was covered. The price was very competitive ... I think there was a cheaper insurer, but that policy was far too complex and I wouldn't have been comparing "apples to apples" anyway. Just before my trip to the US I got pneumonia. You can imagine how much money was tied up ... I was thinking that, even with insurance, I'd end up wearing quite a loss. Not so. I provided the required certificate to Cover-More in quite a straightforward claim process. It took a little while, but I had several components to my trip and I think the time it took was simply a reflection of Cover-More carefully working through my documentation -- which you'd expect from a reputable company. I won't bother checking the other insurers' prices next time: when one behaves this well you go back.
Good price. Straighforward claim process. Clear policy details.

title: Easy and instant!
body: I forgot to order travel insurance and was at the airport. Within 5 minutes it was all sorted. Love this app for its convenience and the no fuss that comes with their policies.

title: easy to insure with

The policy was easy to set up online and very convenient.  Luckily we didn't require any assistance from 1Cover during our trip.  We will continue to insure ourselves through 1Cover for all our trips as we believe the cover is very comprehensive.  Very happy customer knowing we have peace of mind should something happen whilst away.

title: Great Service

Efficient and Priced well for Families

title: All I every wanted in honest upfront policy and no fuss affordable quick insurance for travel
body: Go for it - you will be happy. I have not made any claims but all else considered I would do it all again. This product looks and feels good.

title: Great service, follow up promptly.
body: Have been impressed with Insure and Go, especially since an accident I had in Bali, where I was travelling solo. Such great staff, quick payout of claim gives me much faith in your company. As a frequent traveller will come to you again and again. Thank you for you efficiency and care.

title: Reliable and efficient
body: Impressed by SureSave following a  full refund for a trip to Antarctica cancelled because of broken foot. We continued with  Sure Save for 2 sea explorations around the north of Australia and recently to the USA.

title: Excellent service and customer experience.
body: I have used travel insurance with you a number of times and have not had a problem. Loved the insurance options I choose.

title: Fair Dinkum Quality Product & Service
body:
I have used Cover-More twice. The purchase of the product is smooth and easy. I had to claim for medical services and thought this would be a difficult process. Wrong! I filled in a simple claim form, submitted it with evidence of my treatment and forgot about it. Not long afterwards, I received the unexpected refund. Great surprise after a terrific holiday.
Got the service that was initially promised at a very competitive rate.

title: Be Aware, Do not get travel insurance with this company if you want peace of Mind!
body:
Be Warned.
The worst Insurance provider I have come across.
No peace of mind if you take out insurance with this company!
They do not cover you for your items if lost or stolen!
They took over 3 months to process my claim, they asked me to send by registered post unnecessary things. At the end they apologised for asking me to send them. Well apologies is not good enough, it COST me MONEY to send these things by registered post.
I was robbed and physically attacked while overseas infront of my children, yet this company shows no compassion!!! My kids to date are traumatised by the whole incident.
My phone, bag, money, baby carrier and other valuables were stolen.
For the phone they are sending me a voucher to use at JB HI FI (which doesn't even stock the phone). They did not cover my money because I was unable to provide atm receipt (and i explained to them that the money was gifted to me so how can I provide an atm receipt) yet they insisted on an atm receipt. The bag was not covered as it was a birthday present and I didn't have a receipt. title: Was There When I Needed Them
body: I have been using InsuresndGo Australia for a few years now and last month was the first time I have ever needed their help.  I was on a tiny isolated isolated island in Asia when I suffered a potentially serious medical condition. I sent them an email advising the situation and I heard back immediately from them.  Their advice  and concern was very reassuring.  After 24 hours they even telephoned me at the place I was staying to keep offering support.  After a few days my medical condition resolved itself but they still kept in regular contact until I returned to Australia and only then did they close the file.  I am a senior and even I found it  easy to set up on-line and great value for money.  Highly recommend his company and I will only use InsureandGo Australia in the future.

title: Good value for money for what I needed

title: Disappointing and frustrating
body: I attempted to update the end date for a policy that had been issued and paid for over 3 weeks earlier.  I rang the number supplied and was answered by a call centre in the Philippines. (Please note that Cover-More states on the web page that "Customer operations are based in Australia".)  The girl I was talking to was unable to locate my policy despite the fact I gave her my policy number and name under which to search.  Not her fault - she was polite at all times - but my frustration built.  How can I trust a company that has taken my money, apparently issued a policy but are unable to locate it?  So I have requested my money back. This was refused since the 15 day cooling off period was over!!  Was eventually offered 50% which I refused as none of this has been my fault.  Today I 'chatted' with an assistant (also in the Phillipines and very polite and patient).  She told me that Cover-More were refunding 75% of the cost.  Better - but not satisfactory.  I have used Cover-More in the past but never again and will discourage others.  I accept the blame for the wrong date - it is the total frustration of apparently being insured but the company then unable to find the information which is if major concern.

title: Worst Customer service I have ever experienced
body:
On 1st January 2015, while we were in Fiji our 18 months old baby boy got sick and I rang the Cover More's 'assistance telephone number to get an address or a phone number of a local doctor. The lady on the other end of the phone didn't have any clue of a possible doctor's details in Nandi (Denarau Island) and asked me to contact the hotel reception. On that day I rang the 'Cover More' telephone service 3 times, and each time had to wait about 30 minutes for someone to answer the phone. (They asked me irrelevant questions and asked me to email them doctor's recommendation, which I did but didn't even get a response from them). I spoke to 3 different ladies on that day and all of them were extremely rude and unhelpful. I don't know why a reputable travel agency like Flight Centre promotes this insurance company. I travel overseas approx. 4-5 times a year and previously used another travel insurance company and about 7 years back only once I had to seek help from that insurance company and I had a complete different experience.
I sincerely ask everyone not to use Cover More for your travel insurance needs. They are ruthless people and have no compassion for you or your family in time of need. They don't know how parents may feel when their child is sick in overseas in an unknown environment.
Sam Allen

title: Just went through a claims process - keep looking for a better policy!
body: We purchase an annual multi trip policy every year and switch policies every so often. Unfortunately I decided to try Insure And Go this year. Read the PDS thoroughly and make sure the policy covers you for your needs. It?s one of those trickier ones with lots of exclusions from standard policies. Only upon needing to make a claim for lost belongings had I discovered that we?re not covered at all. The other claim I made for broken spectacles was covered, a straightforward enough claim with all the necessary paperwork tediously uploaded online was processed painfully slowly. Claims processors try every way to not pay a legitimate claim. The staff on call are competent enough though lacking in the friendly customer service that I?ve experienced elsewhere. The kicker is I?m locked in for an entire year and dread to make any serious or major claim. This isn?t the type of feeling you want from a travel insurance provider. You would hope that your family is well covered, the service is warm and the claims process is easy. The most disappointing fact is that in terms of price there are cheaper policies out there (as well as more expensive) and we chose this policy because the PDS seemed comprehensive enough - there are similar or better policies out there with way better customer service.

title: Make sure you have your lawyer go over their PDS.
body:
Just a FYI, if you are shopping for alternatives to Allianz be aware that fastcover uses them as well.

Here's my experience with making an actual claim through fastcover, which was processed and handled by Allianz -

Took up travel insurance with them - so called 'COMPREHENSIVE' cover
Got really sick overseas, called them up to advise
Returned home as there was no way i could continue traveling
Put a claim for the pre-booked hotel bookings and tours which i couldn't get a full refund of. I did NOT try and claim the early return flight, as that was my 'choice'.
Completed all their forms (lots and lots of forms - along with doctors reports etc)
They then took ~TWO weeks to acknowledge my claim (who knew email was so slow!)
~FOUR further weeks to come back with a declined response due to some disclaimer in their PDS, their medical team also felt i could have been treated for my condition overseas - which may be true, but i still wouldn't have made it to the tour or pre-booked hotels anyway (was still sick 2 weeks after my ORIGINAL return flight, which i also showed them evidence of). But wait, there's a disclaimer for that too!

So much for their whole "We will pay your cancellation fees and lost deposits for travel and accommodation arrangements that you have paid in advance and cannot recover in any other way if your Journey is cancelled or shortened at any time through circumstances neither expected nor intended by you and outside your control."

I'm guessing my falling ill must have been intentional?

Anyway, that's my first (and last) experience with them.

body:
We just took out 1Cover travel insurance again for an upcoming trip and while doing it, thought about the reasons why we stick with 1Cover. Unfortunately i had to lodge a claim earlier this year due to Qantas loosing my fishing rods but 1Cover took care of that.

One of the reasons why we will keep on choosing 1Cover, is my experience with them during Cyclone Donna in May last year. I went on a 2 week fishing trip to some of the outer islands in Vanuatu and at the start of the second week got bitten by something, chances are a possible spider. The bite became infected and then turned necrotic and by Wednesday night I had a fever, sweating , shivering in my bed in a hut. I had a comprehensive first aid kit but no antibiotics, so the wound got exponentially worse and obviously there are no Doctors or Nurses on the islands.
Thought I would be ok as the flight out was early on Saturday morning and I just had to bite the bullet until then but by Friday the fever had taken over and I was in trouble, i needed to get to a Doctor. I am no expert but you kind of know when your body is not functioning well. 
During the day the wind picked up but nothing uncommon for the South Pacific but by Friday evening it has not stopped and it was really pumping and this was not normal - I have been doing these solo island fishing trips for many years and have a bit of an understanding of the weather across the islands. 

Saturday morning was greeted with sunshine but strong winds, up to then we were not aware of the approaching cyclone. I have not been in a cyclone before so i had no idea of what was coming. As we got out of the dugout canoe on the other side of the lagoon, the guys came and gave me the message that the flight was cancelled and that there is a Cyclone nearing the islands.
So i was properly up ships creek. 
The island had a mobile tower, think Digicel but mobile reception is very limited at best,during normal conditions. Eventually had to send a text home and chat to my kids, both nurses for some advice with the bite. And then the Cyclone hit the islands, went past, turned around and came back over us again and then turned around again and came over us for the third time, by this time it was cat 5 and winds reaching 260km/h. This took out all the mobile towers, destroyed everything that was in its path.
The huts are build in and around trees bordering the mangroves, obviously centuries of cyclone experience had taught the guys where to build their structures for safety, so we were ok. Th rain just ran through the coral sand in to the ocean, so there are no flooding.

On the Thursday of the third week the cyclone finally started moving away in the direction of New Caledonia and  apparently just faded away but the wind was still very strong around our area and no chance of a flight out.
Then out of the blue and very surprisingly my phone rang - by Thursday late afternoon the local island technician must have done some kind of emergency repairs to the mobile tower.
The very first phone call i got was from 1Cover, a well experienced Registered Nurse greated me on my name. 
For a fever infected/affected guy, that had by now ran out of all his medical supplies and had been stuck on remote islands for 3 weeks, in a cyclone, the sound of her voice was like a large MacDonald's Coke full of ice, on a hot summers day. 
My daughters had contacted 1Cover earlier and explained the situation to them when they lost communication with me. They wouldn't normally do this but this was the first time ever that i asked my kids for medical advice and they new that I was in trouble.
So 1Cover must have kept on trying until they got hold of me.
They asked what my condition was, how serious it was and would i need to be evacuated.
Right there, at that moment, they were willing to come and fetch me, if i beleived it was necessary and they were serious about doing it.
But very lucky for me, the guys on the island , that did their utmost best for me, found a little plastic packet with some pills, that we thought to be pennicilin tablets, that was left behind by a priest. Chances are it would have been past the expiry date but i divided what ever was in the packet, with the days left until the following Saturday. A good possibility that these pills pushed me back up the hill.
I explained to the guys at 1Cover that i had the situation under control now and that i am positive that everything would be ok. Before i said good bye they asked me again if i am sure that i will be ok. 
So my personal experience is testimony that 1Cover were and are willing to provide the insurance that they sell to me.

The wind eventually started to die down and by Friday afternoon the protected side of the islands still had a fair swell running past but looked fishable, so we went and pulled the Banana boat out of the mangroves, had a quick 2 hour session and managed 7 smallish Yellow Fin Tuna. Sounds crazy that one would go fishing in not so safe conditions but we had run out of fresh food, all the crops, all the banana trees, everything was completely destroyed. 
Air Vanuatu still did not came and fetch me on the planned Saturday morning flight, as mentioned it was still very windy, so they chartered a flight from Unity Air, a BN2 to come and get me. The flight back to Santo was as bumpy as hell but i was just too glad for a lift out.

I have read countless stories similar to mine. Its about time some internal Government review is carried out looking into these travel insurance companies. Just like the banks they act with impunity and it is high time they were made to be accountable.  
Even expecting any ordinary person to understand the pages and pages of obscure conditions and 'get out' clauses is just unreasonable.
They make is oh so simple to get the policy on line and their ads are just so enticing about what they offer.
Its all a giant con! 
Please under no circumstance should you use InsureandGo. They are legal crooks and I will tell as many people as possible about what they did to me.

title: Incompetent Without Even Making A Claim.
body:
Many of the reviews on 1Cover are based upon not making a claim or using their on line portal.

This review is based upon actually talking to an employee in their call centre. 

When I think of the Australian 1Cover call centre it can best be described as incompetent and clueless when it comes to customer service.

Firstly, I did attempt to use the online service, however 1Cover were having technical issues (for three days) so I contacted the Australian based call centre.

I have just returned from an overseas holiday where I had travelled with 1Cover travel insurance. On that occasion I was able to book on line.

I'am traveling again on a new trip, so I intend to take out travel insurance with them again for a second time.

On speaking with the male phone consultant he advised me that I had never held insurance with them. After providing my name (several times) my date of birth, email address and phone number, he still advised me that I was not on their system.

Eventually through my partners name also on the policy he found my details. I explained to him that if I was to make a claim in the case of an emergency why would I make contact using my partners name! 

If a hospital made contact in an Emergency to verify my cover, being told I have no cover would be extremely damaging and dangerous to my treatment options.

Eventually he changed my contact details and updated the new cover for my next trip which would be undertaken by myself as a solo traveller. Due to the confusion during the call I asked him to email me the policy so I could check it and pay for it on line.

I could not believe my eyes when I received the email! It was in the name of my girlfriend!!!!!!!

I contacted the call centre again and asked to speak with the Manager. The consultant said  they could not put me through to their manager for a complaint and told me to email them!!!!

So I terminated the call and again phoned back to get another consultant. I went through the details and the consultant stated that she could not understand what the original male consultant had done. I asked for the Manager to contact me.

I was then put through to a team leader, I explained that I wanted to speak with the Manager, however i was advised they were unavailable. I advised that I wanted the Manager to phone me back despite speaking with the team leader as she was clearly trying to cover for the original consultant with numerous excuses for his errors.

I was then advised that I could not purchase the policy on line as the original consultant had in error loaded my policy with a pre existing medical condition that requires disclosure, ie heart condition etc. 

I don't have any of these medical conditions!!! Why would he do that I asked! those pre existing medical conditions do not apply to me! 

The response from the team leader was little more than dribble that made no plausible explanation.

What did I learn from 1Cover,

1) When you take out a policy and pay for it, the 1Cover call centre will deny that you have a policy.

2) When you take out a new policy, they we send it to you, in another person's name.

3) If you do not have a pre existing medical condition under disclosure as per their PDF, they will give you one anyway regardless of your advice.

4) If you ask to discuss their service with the Manager, this is clearly unacceptable as the Manager still has not contacted me.

5). To silence the complaint, they discounted the policy by $3.00

6) They don't record their phone calls ( as they advised me), very convenient for them. 

As someone who wants companies to employee Australians in Australian call centres, this company provides the perfect example of why so many call centres are now based overseas.

November 4th 2017 Update: Wait Till You Need To Make A Claim Before You Review.

Wait until you need to make a claim before you Review this incompetent company. 

So many people are reviewing them without having actually made a claim. 

This review is based upon actually making a claim.

This company has perfected the art of selling their product with their glossy website, however they have failed to deliver when I needed them most, yes, thats when you make a claim.

My claim was accepted when I fell sick overseas and I was hospitalized for two days.

What followed from there was their, missmanagement, missinformation, incorrect fact recording and failure to follow through with Case Manager undertakings.

Further after allocation of a Case Manager whilst overseas I had no less than 5 Case Managers who followed.
 
It is little wonder none of them have any idea of what was going on when incorrect information was recorded in the case notes by one of the previous case manages.

Thank God my illness was not life threatening, as if it had been this company would have caused me considerable inconvenience and remember, this was for an accepted claim.

Their overseas based call centre when making a claim leaves alot to be desired.

Of course I've asked for an explanation, however they have failed to respond to my specific Complaint that contained specific questions.

Avoid them and their slick marketing, it's off to the Ombudsman for me.

title: allianz and compassion don't go together in the same sentence
body:
Our son died a few weeks before our planned trip. We were told not to waste time putting in a claim - it would be denied as it was suicide. Then the day our trip was to start was my mother's funeral. Claim denied as she was 86 and Allianz doesn't pay out over 85 so be warned of that if you have elderly family. These two exemptions are in the PDS tucked away on pages 73 and 74. Finally with the help of the Financial Ombudsman we got the claim settled on the grounds of my husband needing an urgent biopsy. Thanks Allianz for making a tough time even tougher for us. The claim money turned up in our bank account 148 days (21 weeks)  after our son's death. I will never use Allianz for any insurance again and I have told heaps of people of our awful experience with Allianz.

April 28th, 2017 Update: Don't just be insured. Be inspired

After my one and only experience with allianz I'm inspired...to NEVER use allianz insurance again. I recently spoke to a broker and asked would he recommend allianz travel insurance and he said no way. Then I told him of my bad experience with them.

body:

Who ended up on a Hawaiian shore

Into evacuation we sprang
And made the call to Covermore

The night grew dark, the winds picked up knots
The bottom four floors were moved up to the top
It was serious when
Our hotel was on CNN
While my husband googled tsunamis on his laptop

Over our loudspeaker were updated calls
While people slept in the halls
We were all ok
We weren?t swept away
A mum of a baby, I slept through it all

When I awoke the danger had passed
But my poor husband?s eyes were all glassed
He?d stayed awake
But now had the shakes
So, it was time to hand over fast.

?Hello Covermore, how can we help you??
?The roads are all closed we can?t through,
We?ll miss our flight
Need a bed for the night
We?re not sure what to do?
Well, that friendly voice, focused and calm
Helped work out our escape route like a charm
New travel booked
No detail overlooked
Give us a hand?  They gave us an arm!

A passport and Covermore is all it takes
To make me feel free on all my escapes
No matter the emergency
Like when caught in that rebel insurgency
A phone call is all we have to make!

A client for over a decade
On every we claim we have filed, they have paid
We would feel bare
If Covermore weren?t there
To cover our backs if ever we?re waylaid
Customer Service is too 'corporate' a word to describe how the staff make you feel assured and safe and trusted as a person in need in a foreign country.  That feeling and the no-fuss claims process keeps me loyal year after year.

title: Disappointed and Crooks
body:

I suddenly needed to cancel my trip planned for September 2019 and  was not within the cancellation period.Claimed on the off chance of being successful.Correspondence was always  respectful and informative ....I am very elderly. title: Devil is in the detail
body:
Do not buy this product if you want your baggage and personal items covered. I had my iPhone stolen in Ho Ch Minh City, I claimed under my TID policy  and got $100 back. They have a depreciation clause in their travel insurance policy which allows them complete discretion to discount the value. I always thought the aim of travel insurance was to enable you to replace lost or stolen items but not this one. The claims service (now outsourced to Cerebrus Risk) was also awful. They breached the industry code of practice by not replying in the timeframes set out and it took 6 weeks to settle the claim, all for a measly $100! When settlement was made, I received a standard letter effectively telling me I paid a low premium and as a result got low cover and they were able to do this under weasly policy wording. This appeared to be a standard letter that they must be sending out to many customers. Reading the below reviews it seems TID probably used to be good when underwritten by Allianz but that seems to have changed for the worse recently, now that they are underwritten by Lloyd's and claims are handled by Cerberus Risk.

Poor cover and not cheap

Cheers 1 cover...... here is to many more years of wonderful peace of mind travel.
Gabrielle Woodward

title: Seems all OK

title: Watch out for PDS Clause for Luggage and Personal Effects
body: I was almost about to use 1Cover for Insurance. My main criteria was for medical and emergency coverage and as I am a photographer, cover for my DSLR and laptop. Luckily I read the PDS for luggage and personal effects and was shocked to discover that your 'hotel' is considered a public place and if you leave your luggage and personal effects in your room (to say go out touring which is what people generally do when on holidays) , your goods  will not be covered as that will mean your goods are 'unsupervised' where they can be 'taken from you without your knowledge'! Isnt that the very definition of theft? Your goods will however be covered if they are in a 'safe' - what happens when safes arent big enough to hold a laptop and camera gear or your hotel room doesnt have a safe? You wont be covered. Also surprised to discover that if other people have access to your room (ummmm hotel room cleaners say?) then your goods are not covered. I found this VERY sneaky and wanted to warn others.

title: Covermore? More like CoverLESS!!!
body:
All this insurance company cares about is taking and keeping your money!!!
I was completely unaware a pandemic would break out 6 months ago when booking my trip for myself and my partner. Halfway through my trip, I was emailed that my flights home have been cancelled and that I had to find my way back home on my own, and FAST before Australia goes into lockdown due to the COVID-19. So had to repurchase brand new flights home the next day out of my own pocket, missed the last 4 days of my trip and because I was told if I didn't fly home now I would be locked in America or quarantined in an airport for 14 days, after all of that the insurance company will not cover me for anything. $0 money back. Over $10,000 down the drain and what's worse is I had to take money out of my house savings to pay for the flights home so I'm now 3 years behind on purchasing a house as well. So disappointing and to see this has happened to hundreds or thousands of other customers as well!

title: Travel Insurance pays, count on CoverMore
body:
Our 3rd trip to Europe in 3 years was planned for the 6th May and insurance obtained from CoverMore when we booked. Just over a week before we were to leave, my wife had a routine trip to the Doctor which resulted in Heart Surgery, being performed on the day we were to depart. Once the diagnosis was established I contacted CoverMore who explained the process and when and what to submit. There were delays, due to the need to process service provider refunds, once this was completed by our Travel Agent I submitted medical records and claim details. We were bitterly dissapointed to not be going on our trip but fortunate on two fronts we were insured with CoverMore and secondly that we had not left on our trip as the circumstances would have been been worse if we had been overseas.  As my wife is on track to be back to full health shortly we plan on doing our trip next year insured with CoverMore of course
CoverMore has a more reasonable approach to those of us who have pre-conditions such as my self, although in this case it was my wife who needed the support and she did not have a pre-condition. If your can't afford travel insurance you cannot afford to travel. There was empathy from CoverMore staff about my wifes health
Service over the phone was excellent although there seemed to be long delays at times in processing the final step of approval, may be time spans to process could be promoted to explain if a delay is likely

title: CoverLESS Travel Insurance
body:
Purchased travel insurance in October 2019 when I purchased my flights (before Covid-19).  Rang to enquire about whether I would be covered should we pursue our NZ trip.  I was shocked to be informed that due to the 'virus outbreak' my travel insurance is practically useless and I won't be covered for any cancellations / setbacks along my journey (flights and/or accommodation).  The only thing I would be covered for is medical expenses should we catch Covid-19.    

I don't understand the purpose of travel insurance at these times where these insurance companies are waiving their arms, exempting themselves to pay for anything UNLESS you catch the Covid-19 virus.  

Having said that, I promptly cancelled my travel insurance in which they kept approx 25% (not being in the cooling off period).  Rest assured, I will not be using CoverMore for any travel plans in the future.
