body: booked travel cover in june to ensure we would have cover for natural disaster. checked booklet and gold cover has ticks next to natural disaster. realised yesterday that the fine print needs to be read in conjunction and that we should have paid extra for natural disaster. our fault as we didnt read the policy cover to cover. appealed to the company to apply common sense and goodwill (obviously we would have paid the extra $13 had we been aware). were told they wont consider allowing us to add the cover as there is a large disclaimer when you book your insurance. well so there is.....NOW. there was nothing mentioning the added cover back in JUNE when we booked the policy. poor customer service and i am concerned how we will go if we actually have to make any claim on the trip. lesson learned.....but wont use them next time.

title: Total waste of money!
body:
Would give ZERO stars if this was an option;  
I was one of the unfortunate who was stranded in Bali in July due to problems around the Mt Ruang volcanic ash cloud (our flight was cancelled when our pilot thankfully deemed plane unsafe to fly). Consequently I decided to try to claim expenses (via TID) relating to unplanned days in Bali including rebooking alternative flight (earliest being 4 days after original flight, as I needed to get back for work & elderly parents & the airline was not giving any confidence/indication as to when our flight would be rescheduled so I decided not to wait & booked a new flight) also needed extra accommodation, taxis/transport/phone calls, meals-all genuine BASIC expenses for the extra 4 days away from home (thankfully I was very careful not to overspend as I do not trust insurance companies in general - they all seem to be happy to take the premium dollars but neglect to pay when claim is being made & TID proved no different!) Of the $980 claim I made for these genuine expenses they returned $145au being $40 for only one of my extra 4 nights accommodation & $100au for meals (which left $45.30 after they took $100 out for the excess - which I expected, however I did not expect they would deny me the rest of my honest claim!  I have naturally complained several times (via e-mail) & it was eventually put into review OVER A MONTH AGO - although I was told it would take 15 days for another answer & I've since been told twice it would take 2 more days- I am still waiting & sick of it!.  I have provided every possible piece of supporting evidence (11 pages plus documents/receipts) to back my claim but they have done nothing but give me the run-around & excuses as to why I would not be paid this claim.  After all of this I am definitely done with TID & also had my faith ruined in any travel insurance company & would never go overseas again as it is impossible to make a travel insurance claim after paying the $60 premium!  I will also be taking this further when I find out who to take it to (including social media) as everyone should be made aware that if something happens you will be on your own with TID!!

title: Excellent piece of mind
body:
We had found Allianz to offer all of the coverage that we felt we needed - accurate pre-existing medical guidelines and coverage for (the very unlikely event) of terrorist related activity. It gave us traveling and our family staying at home great piece of mind.

May 27th 2018 Update: Exemplary piece of mind

The policy was very easy to set up in the first place and - due to pre-existing medical conditions - was very up front with what the full costs would be. Overall, the cost was very reasonable for the wide coverage. And the product disclosure statement was easy to read without all of the other legal jargon that others resort to - it told you what was covered, what was limited (very little btw), and what was not (again very limited). Lastly, what was nice were the emails leading up to our holiday that were reminders of the other things you need on a holiday such as passports etc. it really felt like they cared about their product and our wellbeing. I have used them the last three times we have booked holidays because of these attributes, and we will certainly love to continue to deal with them!

title: Too many exclusions
body: We took this travel insurance to travel oversee. After we had a issue and lodged a claim. Unfortunately it was turned down. Our fault because we did not read the PDS properly and just accepted all will be good as it was recommended to us by flight centre. After reading the PDS we found allot of exclusions that is ridiculous and might have been cover we would have needed. When I travel somewhere I don't sit and read insurance documents but enjoy my break away. Sad to say rather read the document folks because you might not be covered. We just lost a couple of grand for this mistake.

title: Peace of mind at a great price!
body: Easy to use on-line purchase process - good talk range of coverage levels- very competitively priced. Will use again next holiday. Made it easy to enjoy my trip without worrying about those ?what if?s?.

title: Good Value
body: Yes, compared to other Travel insurers it is good value, it was easy to set up.  I didn't have to lodge a claim this time.  This year I will be using 1Cover for my three overseas trips.  Middle East. America, and New Zealand.

title: Preexisting condition.
body: We were in Malaysia when Doug's 90 year old mother died suddenly. We had to change our return flight and had to pay an extra $600. We put in a claim with covermore. They refused to pay because she had high blood pressure - a pre existing condition. We will never insure with cover more again. H.d. and r heaney.

title: Excellent
body:
Compared many products (actually read policies) believe TID has best combination of benefits vs cost. Haven't claimed, hopefully won't :-)
Very clear website and easy application process with competitive price.

title: Satisfaction Level
body:
1Cover has been very prompt in answering online queries & very helpful in resolving them.
The policy was very easy to arrange &, I felt, provided excellent value for money.

title: Resolving our claim
body:
Excellent value full comprehensive cover for our overseas trip to Fiji unfortunately Husband had an accident and we couldn't go on our holiday the whole claim process was simple and easy lodged the claim scanned in the document's that were requested and it  was approved within a week then paid a week later so easy with no stress.
I use 1Cover all the time and will never change.

title: Poor Service
body: I have recently purchased a rental car damage excess policy from Rental Car Protection, which claims to be part or the Covermore Group, and have found it necessary to modify the Terms of Cover. Unforuantly numerous emails and phone calls to Rental Cat Protection have gone unanswered. It also leads me to wonder how one could deal with a claim when the company is uncontactable

title: Great company to deal with
body: Policy was easy to apply for and good value . Have used them many times even to make a claim and the process was effortless. We will use them again.

title: Good value for money
body: Very good value and made some enquires before we went making sure we were covered for things we needed.Easy to set up over the internet.

title: Travel Insurance - There when it is Needed
body: 1Cover are NOT like other travel insurance companies which begin to charge an excess the day after you turn 50 (that really makes you feel old). 1Cover quoting process is simple and quotes are good value for money. While all goes well during you trip, how would you know how good 1Cover is? Well after a number of trouble and claim free holidays we did have to cancel one trip in 2010. 1Cover were fantastic. They delivered the cover we purchased right down to the fine detail of foreign exchange to ensure we were not out of pocket. The claim process was efficient with great communication and support throughout the process. Since then have had quite a number of other incident / claim free trips. We are loyal to 1Cover and enjoy the confidence of having 1Cover travel insurance knowing that they deliver the cover purchased when it is needed.

title: Getting insurance OK but claim is a pain
body: I did take the Gold travel insurance. I had unfortunate flight cancellation in USA by JETBLUE and the alternate flight was give 2 days later. I was forced to find hotel to stay. When it comes to claim INSUREANDGO was a pain in the rear. First they knocked back all except one day hotel bill. After writing to them they accepted 2 days bill but no taxi fare to hotel/Airport and the telephone calls to find a hotel. Very disappointed

title: This is the maximum
body:
No 
Unfortunately every time I call for new policy , the customer service officer saying we do not keep a record for previous policy. Just to bring the attention that I am regular customer to find out if I am entitle to some discount. As I said the answer always " sorry we do not keep previous policies?

title: We use one cover every time we travel.
body:
Yes good value
Very easy
We have just had to make a claim for stolen property while on a holiday, on returning I filed a claim. I received courteous, professional help. Within a week I received a response detailing our refund payment.

title: Best service with TID always
body: Fantastic service from TID, myself and family have used TID for years, competitive prices but by far the very best service if making a claim or just setting up insurance for the trip. I highly recommend TID to all those travelling. Excellent!

title: would always use this insuance company gives me peace of mind
body: easy to set up  covered my needs no problems   have used TIA before and will continue to use them very satisfied with this insurance company  no need to make any claims this trip which is a good thing.

title: Reccomend this Necessity
body: I have used Insure & Go a few times now and have found it a very easy process online, even,  with a pre existing medical condition. I haven't had the need to make a claim, however assume the process would be straight forward ....

title: Exceeded our expectations
body: Having planned our overseas trip over 12 mths ago, we had very unexpected news only 5 days into our trip! My husbands father had passed away suddenly. We had to return home, leaving two thirds of our trip uncompleted. We submitted our claim through our travel agent & we received a full refund for the unused portion of our trip. Australia Post Travel Ins kept us well informed as to where our claim was up to & settled our claim quite swiftly. We have used them a couple of times now & would not hesitate to recommend them. Thank you Australia Post Travel Insurance

title: Over seas car excess claim
body: Recently travelled to Great Britain. I would just like to thank the Cover-More people for advising me how to make my claim and for not making me feel like an fool... both for the car damage and the fact that I am a complete claim novice... (the latter is a good thing I guess!) Plus they paid promptly.

title: Happy with the result.
body:
My brother passed away suddenly while I was in New Zealand and I had to return to Australia. I lodged my claim, which was only for the costs involved in changing my airfares as we were staying with friends and no accommodation or  tours had to be cancelled.  It was a very straight forward claim and I was paid out within a month of lodging the claim. I had all the necessary documentation.  I would like to believe that should any other unforeseen things happen in the future that Medibank Private Travel Insurance will be just as efficient. We have a 12 month policy with them as we travel overseas a few times a year.
Quick payout of my claim.
Nothing as yet, still have the policy until March 2015.

title: Easy to apply online But ive never claimed and thats where the proof is
body: Policy was good value and appears to have broard cover , it carries the usual exclusions , so effectively covers very little to nothing. Every thing will hinge on a claim, they are probably o worse of better than any of the others

title: Want travel insurance? Try another company.
body: Check the fine print for what you are NOT covered for. You will find it is most things, and the policy wording can be manipulated to your disadvantage. For an expensive policy we got poor service for a stolen camera. It also took them almost a month to tell us they would not cover the stolen items.

title: No worries
body: We only use alliance now :) we had a sick child on a previous trip (first time we have ever had to contact or use our travel insurance and it was a breeze :) thanks alliance

title: Easy, convenient and no hassles
body: I always use Insure and Go, when I'm traveling on a cruise. So easy to organise and understand, Website is easy to use and its all there in plain english.  If you need to claim, its simple to complete online as well. If you need to contact to ask questions, person on the phone is always freindly and very helpful. I will not use any other travel insurance.

title: Not worth it
body: I bought this travel insurance for my trip to Singapore and Bali. I had to visit the doctor in Singapore and claimed for the cost of the consultation and medicines. When claiming, at no stage did they mention a $100 excess was payable. So my claim of $106 turned into $6. Waste of time - they need to provide better education about claiming and excesses. I also got the insurance because it covered vehicle hire. I rang to confirm this before I left for the trip and they said it wouldn't cover the vehicle I was going to hire. Won't use them again.

title: Your chances of having a satisfactory claim
body:
I was considering getting a Budget Direct domestic insurance policy so I decided to check on what proportion of claims had satisfactory results. All insurance companies are happy to make it easy for you to pay them but some are quite reluctant to pay on claims.
So I counted the positive and negative results of travel claims recorded on Product Review by Budget Direct policy holders. 21 had positive results and 65 negative results. 
Go figure your chances of a happy outcome if you have to make a claim. I am looking for another insurer.

title: Great!
body:
Great value. Easy to set up. 

(ssss sssss ssss ssss ssss sss sss ssss ss ss ss ss ss )

title: Convenient and easy to understand
body: The travel insurance policy was good value, easy to understand and the process of purchasing it was easy. Communication was easy and frequent. Didn't really have much to do with customer support however I am sure they would be easy to get in contact with should I have required their assistance.

title: Would use again.
body: Easy to use, good amount of communication, great value even though I didn't make a claim.

title: Slow process
body: Always use Insureandgo for our holiday insurance, made our first claim recently for a missed port and found the process slow and slightly confused.  After providing the initial information requested, I received several other requests for further information which delayed the claim being completed by several weeks.  Having said that, the claim was paid and I am quote satisfied with the service.  It may be useful for Insureandgo to clearly state what evidence is required at the initial claim application stage instead of to and fro-ing, especially for something as simple as a missed port.

title: away activities
body: Hi, when trying to buy a policy online there is a problem when filling in details for someone under 18... my 17 year old son going on a ski trip with school. For the ratings/name above it is hard to rate something unless there was a claim although it is good to choose the sport or activity you may be doing while away in one click and know you will be covered for specifically that

title: What's the point
body: Bought travel insurance at the start of February with cancel for any reason cover. Apparently no flights leaving Australia is any reason. Then to add insult they will generously give me a partial refund for a trip that hasn't started and they won't cover anyway.

title: Excellent policy and customer service.
body: Great policy, cheap as chips and had great customer service when calling about my payment. Thanks for taking care of me so well. Will definitely recommend to friends and family.

title: Short trip
body: This was the First time used Allianz travel insurance.The policy was adequate for the length of our trip. Would like to take out an annual policy in future but find it does not cover for members not travelling with us who get sick and are over the age of eighty years thus leaving us unable to claim if we have to return back home.

title: Bit of a disapointment
body: My partner were both on our policy with $100 excess.  You can't do one claim, have to do separate claims for incidents & as we both had ear infections had to go back to medical centre more than once & my partner got a broken tooth we were charged $200 excess  :(  so how is that justified?

title: Travel with a mind at ease knowing you have Cover-More 'looking out for you'
body:
I had an urgent health crisis beyond my control 3 days before a trip departure, plus a further trip due 3 months later booked and paid for. Unable to attend either, I received full support from Cover-More and a total refund of all my outgoing expenses. I wouldn't consider travelling without Cover-More!
Sense of security, prompt attention, supportive, reasonable cost

title: Excellent
body:
Impressed with them but did not have to make any claims which may or not change my opinion of the service they provide
love the price and cover provided. Like how they send reminder before you leave with contact details. Like that they contact you on return asking if you need to claim and how to do it. Will definately use them again. [name removed]
Have no dislike because had no problems

title: I use these guys every time
body:
I'm going to sound like an advert, but I use these guys every time I travel.  The stupid thing is my credit card provides travel insurance, but on the two occasions I have had to make a claim with them, Covermore have delivered.  I have probably used them 10 times and they are a bit more expensive, but the two times I've claimed, both had far from ordinary circumstances (probably common for travel and the chaos that happens when stuff goes wrong in a country that doesn't speak you language) and they listened and understood.
Yes, I've paid out more over the years than I've needed to claim, but they have been spot on when needed.

title: No hassles
body: Peace of mind knowing I was covered just in case something happened.which it did but not to me my sister needed cpr after a jet ski accident which was extremely scary

title: Easy to use
body: The policy appears to be good value. I have purchased several over the past couple of years, however I have never had to make a claim so I am not able to comment on that part.

title: Quick n Easy Purchase
body:
Policy was very easy to purchase.Was done with minimal fuss.
Customer service was excellent.Am traveling again in December to Hawaii and already have purchased travel insurance with TID.
Highly recommend!

title: easy booking great price
body: well set out website made for a simple and quick set up of policy. Comprehensive cover info to aid in choosing level of cover and  fast service.Would certainly recommend this company and shall be using them again in the future

title: Good for healthy people
body: I get penalised for having a heart attack in 2010 and for multiple myeloma 2010/11 when I have been in remission for 4 years. Otherwise OK for my family. Easy to access.

title: Straight forward and efficient. Worth the cost.
body: I found applying to Cover-More for insurance for our trip to the Baltic, Scandinavia and Scotland was straightforward and I appreciated the quick reply re acceptance of medical conditions. When a small claim was necessary the process was simple and the response speedy and positive. Thank you.

title: Complex, Complicated, Poor service
body: A short Cruse with P&O around Pacific, I have called Allianz Travel Insurance to organise the peace of mind. We have Diamond Card I was informed - apply on line to be covered. During our stay on Cruse my husband got unwell. The medical fees of $127.50 have been loge to Allianz Travel Insurance. Numerous email requesting several of documents just to tell us we do have a excess of $250 therefor we are not eligible. Why I was not told that when I called? My issue; if I would have that information on hand, I would not go through the process of scanning and feeling pages and pages of information the Allianz requested for the application to be process, that was unnecessary. Indeed the treatment I have received was very unpleasant left me with a feeling that I wanted to swindle $127 dollars out of this Allianz. All I can say that Zurich was an excellent service; unfortunately I cannot make the same statement about allianz.

title: 5 STAR when you purchase cover, 1 STAR when you make a claim.
body: Got the same run-around as others trying to claim.  "Unlimited" Cancellation cover is nothing of the sort, (carefully read what they actually will cover and how much you will get under exclusions for Cancellations and also Travel Delay in the PDS). And of course the claim was rejected after numerous requests for yet more information, because it did not fall within the "specified reasons".  But what I resent most is not being told at the beginning and wasting my time, money, and effort. It would have been annoying, but far preferable to the run-around and drawn out delay before final refusal by CEREBUS who handle the claims.  Never again!

title: No fuss, no problems
body: Made a claim for a fall overseas. The emergency team kept in contact to make sure I was OK. Then the claim department assessed the damage (my glasses) and paid for the damage. Quick, easy and excellent service.

title: Cover-More covers more!
body:
My husband has a minor condition that other companies will not cover. After a simple questionnaire, friendly service and doctor's referral...covered! Easy! Whilst on our cruise, my husband saw the doctor for a sinus infection which I also caught. On return both our claims were quickly processed by Cover-More...money back..easy!
Cover-More definitely covers more and the lady we dealt with was incredibly helpful and friendly.

title: Great Timely Service
body: I had made plans for a conference trip that I was very keen to make. Unfortunately I became quite unwell just before the trip and had no choice but to cancel the trip at the last minute. The airline would only refund the return ticket minus a fee but not my first ticket. I placed a claim and within just over a week Cover More had approved my claim, minus a $25 fee. I am happy with the service and will use them again.

title: very happy every time
body: I now use TID every time me or my family travel. We have made a couple of small claims and nothing was too much trouble. I will definitely continue to use TID whenever I travel, the before and after notifications are excellent.

title: Always book with TID for your travels!
body: TID are good value for money - although they're not overly cheap their premiums are comparable with all the rest. What I like about TID is that it's a piece of cake to actually take out the policy, they include handy tips and tricks associated with travel and much more importantly, they don't harass you endlessly afterwards to buy another of their products or constantly send emails asking when you're travelling again. I dislike aggressive marketing which makes TID the most attractive to me when choosing travel insurance. The one time I had to make a claim (quite a few years ago) the process was easy. We travel often and I will continue to book through TID as long as their policies and marketing remains the same.

title: It covered everything I needed
body: I had a very pleasant holiday and did not worry me at all. I knew I am covered for any cancellation of my flight and my luggage. In a country and on a new environment the only strength and support I can have through my insurance .

title: Go with a trusted name
body: I did some research online ahead of time & decided to go with Allianz. I will use them again as they are a trusted name in insurance, they were competitively priced, and signing up was quick and easy.

title: Great communication
body:
Love the way 1Cover email your prior to your departure and then again on your return - Keep up the good communication 1Cover!! Haven't made a claim, but this form of communication would make it easier :)
Astrid

title: No fuss cover
body:
1Cover made it easy food me to get travel insurance where others set all kinds of hoops to jump through because I have Menieres Syndrome. 1Cover appeared to understands the unpredictable nature of the condition and the relatively easy ways in which it can be dealt with.  For this reason, most likely, 1Cover have included it in their last of automatically covered conditions. Luckily, I had no incidents while I was on holiday and did not need to make a claim. I was also impressed by the couple of communications I received from them towards the end of my trip. Very happy with their clear and friendly manner when I called confirm a couple of things before I departed as well.
Clear and easy.
Nothing but I didn't need to claim.

title: Very comforting!
body: We have used 1Cover on a number of holidays. We have had to claim on a couple of occasions and they have been WONDERFUL! Fortunately everything was fine this trip but knowing that we were covered was so comforting. Acquiring the insurance was easy and the cost was extremely affordable - thank you 1Cover and we will definitely be using you again.

title: Easiest insurance to get
body:
Easy to set up
Great messages and emails with contact details
Didn't need to claim,  was given all the information to be ready
Welcome home message received day after home

title: Prompt and Efficient
body: Forgot my iPad in a taxi in Europe and contacted TID.  I was given instructions as to have a police report and to claim on my return as I had to provide proof of purchase.  I also had some medical bills.When I returned I submitted my two claims and within two weeks both were settled.  However, I had a dispute on one of the claims, as I had been given different information when I first contacted TID in Europe.  When I explained this, TID traced the call I made on that day, confirmed the information I had given as correct and they accepted my dispute and settled my claim in full.  I found that they went to great lengths to trace my call,  as I could not find the number I called on any of my phone bills.  All I could give them was the date and the approximate time and they traced it.

title: European holiday
body: Pretty happy with cover. Thought it was good value but didn't make a claim so can't comment to much. Perhaps if we had to have made claim we'd have a better idea if the cover was good/adequate for our needs.

title: Good Value.
body: As I didn't have to make a Claim,I don't really know how good it is.The Policy was very Easy to set up and I thought it was the Best Value for Money.I was very Satisfied with the Correspondence.

title: very helpful policy and staff
body: the best ever cover. policy easy to set up. we had a claim due to ill health and the staff we very very helpful. nothing was too much trouble. Thank you all .

title: Worst ever to claim with Don't recommend at all
body: I've been with TID for over 6 years, extremely loyal and recommended them to everyone I knew. I had to claim just recently. My bags were lost for 10 days in Paris. I bought the bare essentials to get through and had to buy basic sleeping equipment as we were camping as all my stuff was in my bag of course. I didn't even buy a sleeping bag, just the essentials.. a EU40 tent EU20 mattress and clothes etc. They would only give me $300 for my personal effects when I was entitled up to $1000 for family. Seeings I paid well over $300 to live off for 10 days even though I was super thrifty. I tried working with the customer service rep, but no Manager got back to me after 3 requests and several phone calls. The customer service was the worst I've ever dealt with. They just didn't want to know. I think it's appalling and I don't recommend anyone uses them again in case they ever need to claim. Use anyone else!

title: Good insurance
body: Easy online pre-existing medical condition screening.  Only dislike is 3k total limit on personal goods/electronics - most other insurances have 3k per item w/10-12k total so DSLR AND laptop are covered.

title: Easy, hassle free travel insurance. Great value.
body: I didn?t personally make a claim but my sister needed to while she traveled with me. Her child became unwell during our trip and I was very impressed with how seemless the process was for her. It made a huge difference in a difficult time.

title: Excellent travel insurance and service
body: We have used InsureandGo several times and have had to make claims a few times.  The communication from the InsureandGo team is amazing.  When our daughter was ill overseas, we were given outstanding support and the follow up couldn't be better.  This company has paid quickly on claims.  We highly recommend InsureandGo and will continue to use them.

title: Excellent
body:
We initially used this product domestically just to avoid paying the car hire no excess fee as this covers it. It seriously cost us $40 for a one week domestic trip. and saved us a bunch on paying the no excess fee which was much much more. Highly recommend.
Competitive pricing. This insurance was very easy to set up inside a branch - we have also set up over the phone in the past.  staff at medibank private are always knowledgeable.
For overseas insurance you dont get much of a discount for being a member, however the price is still great.

title: We don't leave home without it.
body: Great policy, good price, easy to access, we haven't had to make a claim so I can't comment of Customer Support. I have no reason to look at other policies.

title: This is perfect policy
body: My policy is very good value and easy to set up ,  it support me when i travel in the cities and on the cruise , it makes me  peace of mind when traveling .

title: Excellent travel insurance after I made a claim.
body: I am extremely happy with Cover All Travel Insurance.  I bought it via the NRMA.  I needed to make a claim, as I attended the doctor and also needed scripts while away in Canada.  The claim couldn't have been easier.  We did it over the phone and I received a cheque in less than a week after claiming.  Thank you very much.  I certainly will be using Cover All again, as you don't know how good these firms are until you make a claim.

title: Allianz Travel Insurance is a Must Have
body: The policy was reasonably priced and I was given a lot of info as to what do if I got into trouble overseas. Luckily my trip went smoothly so I did not need to make a claim, but knowing there was a 24/7 phone line I could call with lots of extra protections thrown into the policy provided me with peace of mind.

title: Terrible - don't touch them
body:
We took 3 policies for our family of 8 when we booked a holiday to Solomons.  Three weeks before Qantas/Air Solomon with drew the flight back from Honiara. We had to leave a day earlier (losing a night paid for at the resort) and QF could only get us to Brisbane that night - we had to overnight in airport hotel Brisbane before flight to Melbourne next morning.                                                                                                                                           At the time the agent (who sold us the policies) said the lost night and airport overnight would be covered by Sure. 
This is how my policy reads  > 
.```2 Your flight, other transport or overnight tour is cancelled or rescheduled before your trip starts
Cancellation costs
Chosen Limit for Cancellation Related
Expenses````

They /Cerbus are DENYING  the entire 3 claims - stating `change of schedule not covered`
Shocking
I wish I had read these other reviews before paying for these policies -
- go elsewhere

title: Happy
body: Policy was good value and yes it was very easy to set up. I have used Sure Save for a number of years and while no claim has been necessary (thankfully) it is peace of mind and reassuring to know you a looked after by a good company

title: Happy with service and always recommend to people
body: Took sick while in Bali , fantastic service , consultant even rang me in my room , arranged my flight home and paid up front for it . My hospital expenses only took 10 days to be given back to me

title: Good value and easy to access
body:
While I didn't need to claim, I found the policy was good value and the app very convenient.
Setting up the policy was easy and I was impressed with the follow up contact on my return.

title: Simple and relatively easy
body: TID was simple to get and reasonably easy to claim. Their infrastructure for Indonesian hospital bills was a little shaky - I had to deal with more phone calls that I really wanted to - but in the end I got the cash back. If I were in a more-frequently-visited country this would have been easier, but overall, worth it.

title: The Reassurance Of Being Covered
body: After completing a simple questionnaire, cover for a pre-existing condition was approved, which had been declined by other insurers. The policy was easy to set up online and the premium was very reasonable. We will be coming back to Allianz next time we travel.

title: Covers everything necessary
body: It was easy to set up and decide which cover to choose! We had to make a claim due to airline cancelations and rebooking additional flights and we are in the process of getting our claim back! This is the first time we have used this insurance company and I'll definitely be using them for our next trip!

title: Not a single f**k was given
body: My husband and I booked our first year anniversary to Phuket. About a month after we had booked and paid for our trip my father-in-law was entered into hospital suddenly becoming very ill very quickly. He was given 3 to 6 weeks to live due to his liver cancer. I will also add that we knew we had the cancer but he was never ill or sickly. At that point he got administered into hospital it was 6 weeks before we were meant to leave for our first year anniversary trip. I immediately went to Flight Centre and cancelled the trip. I got my money back on everything but the flights. Which was about $2,000. My father in law passed away 2 days before the 6-week mark. It's taken CoverMore more than 5 months decline our claim. Due to my father-in-law going to hospital in the last 2 years about his liver.... I hope something like this happens to them so not only do they have to worry about mourning I loved one but also money troubles. My family and I will never ever use cover more again. We ( my family & i) have spent over $100,000 in the last year on holidays and they were our cover needless to say that was our last trip and covered by them.

title: Great peace of mind
body: Allianz was the best travel insurance option to cover my daughter's type 1 diabetes at a reasonable price. The conditions were very clearly stated. I would choose Allianz again for future travels and have already recommended it to a friend for her upcoming travels.

title: wouldn't travel with out insurance
body:
Policy was good value, easy online set up. l had to purchase it for 2 adults. 
Thank God l didn't need to use it.
Yes l would recommend this site. value for money peace of mind.

title: Terrible! Hard to communicate.
body:
Local affiliated company in the Philippines is pinpointing Thailand and uk for the delay of claim. Have called the emergency hotline when my kids are in the hospital and until now never heard from them to reimburse my claim. It's frustrating when kids are involve and are sick and affiliated companies of this insurance is very hard to communicate and demand a lot of documentations. It's an added stress that none of them get back to me to inform me the status of my claim. I'm not happy at all. Overseas call is very expensive and when you email, none of them will answer your query. When you inquire to their local affiliated company, they always said they are waiting from Thailand office. So i purchased the insurance from australia and uk, thailand and philippines need to decide from this. No wonder it's too slow!

Local affiliated companies are unreliable, i feel like a ball passing into each other, worst insurance

title: Excellent
body: From the initial call to payment, the service was amazing. A disaster turned out a little better. The most professional company and would recommend them to anyone. After doing a google search it was a great find

title: Too soon to rate?
body: Very happy with the process, easy and effective. Appears to be good value.  Don't actually go until mid-July, so opinion may change if I had to make a claim. Hope not!

title: Easy to purchase, easy to claim.
body: Very satisfied. Claims always easily transacted and promptly refunded. The claims dept always helpful and replied to all my emails within a day. I only travel to Bali/Lombok but would use them on any trip.

title: Great Service
body: 1cover gives you great peace of mind when travelling, have been using this company for years, easy to purchase the policy which suits our needs, and the price is the best offered. Thanks

title: Peace of Mind
body: I use TID for my Insurance on all my travel especially as my wife is disabled. I have found they are great and have been very helpful. I love the Phone app as they send you reminders,helpful travel tips and of course all relevant emergency numbers in that country of travel. Also the phone app gives you advice on simple language sayings and also safety etc. Next trip though I will Google other companies as I feel a little bit pricey for Pre-existing illness cover but still I am impressed.

title: Hassle Free Insurance
body:
This was the easiest insurance experience we have ever had - fill in the information and sit back knowing that you are fully covered for your holiday no matter what situation might arise. It is a great feeling to know that one aspect of your holiday cannot be the subject of "Murphy's Law".
Inexpensive and concise
Nothing, it was a real comfort to us.

title: Good value
body: Cheaper than most of travel insurance companies on the market and very easy to buy online. Haven't made a claim yet so can't comment on this aspect. I would rate it 4 stars for now.

title: easy way to get insurance
body: i found this company to be good valve, straight forward and easy to set online, we didn't need to use our policy but it was piece of mind to know we were covered. i would use this product again on our next trip overseas

title: I will definately recommend covermore!
body:
My policy was excellent value and easy to set up. The team at covermore were friendly and helpful.   4 days into my my 2 week holiday in koh samui thailand, I fractured my ankle while on a quadbike tour with my husband and friends. I was rushed to thai international hospital by a tour guide. When i arrived at the hospital i was in total shock and in excruciating pain. I was sent for xrays and given pain killers. A few minutes later a doctor came to see me explaining the depth of my injury ( i thought it was a bad sprain and i would be fine to walk again!) Totally not the case! She explained that i had broken my ankle in 2 places, I would need an operation and wont walk again for 3 months!! I was panicking, scared and didnt know what to do!! This was not what i wanted to hear while i was on holiday in a foreign  country and because it was a private hospital it was going to be very expensive. Not knowing if i was going to be covered or not because i was on a quad bike tour! Well you could only imagine what i was feeling! Having kids at home, work etc i was very worried. I didnt have thousands of dollars to pay for it!! The doctor asked if i had insurance i said yes covermore. She knew exactly who they were and reassured me i would be taken care of. She called covermore and explained what had happened and then they spoke to me. At this time i was still in shock and beside myself!!. The lady from covermore was very helpful and calmed me down. She asked me what i was worried about and i told her. She told me not to worry we are here to help you and explained everything i had to do. I was given an option to either stay in thailand and have the operation or fly back to australia and have it done here. At this time i still wasnt sure if this would be covered or not ( there is a waiting time) i didnt want to risk spending the night in hospital and being hit with a big bill. So once the doctor gave me the ok, i decided to go back to my resort and wait there until i knew what to do. I was prepared to pay my hospital expenses for the day and our flights back but not the thousands it was going to cost for my operation. So they put my leg in a cast, gave me crutches and pain killers, i paid my 20,000 + bill and was on my way. Covermore contacted me later that evening to ask me what i wanted to do and that they would cover everything should i decide to stay. They were prepeared to do whatever was in my best interest and made me feel so much more at ease. She stayed on the phone with me and helped me decide. Once i had decided to go back to australia she told me what i had to do and  the reports i needed. My husband gathered them all and the resort faxed them in. She told me to rest up and she would be in contact. 2 days later we were on a flight back to australia in business class. From the moment we arrived at samui airport we were met by staff and taken care of from then on. The service was fantastic. Once we arrived in sydney we were met by our chauffer and driven home. After my operation i submitted my claim All my hospital expenses were reimbursed and the extra nights i had lost at the resort. 3 months later i am only just starting to walk again and they are paying me loss of income because i havent been able to work. 
I am planning to travel again this year and will definately be using covermore. The highest policy with nil excess is the one to go for. A couple of hundred dollars is definately worth it just incase something does happen. They looked after  me from start to finish. I will stay with them and will definately recommend. Thanks to covermore i am now on the mend and if it wasnt for them i dont know what would have happened!!

title: Warning!!!!! Do not use this insurance company
body:
Had my bag stolen whilst on a train, If you have ever been on a train in Russia you will understand how crowded they become during peak hours. So from then I tried to report the theft, of course no one speaks English. So I went and got a friend who was able to translate for me about what had happened to the police, I obtained a copy of the report and a receipt number from the police.
Then when I got back to Australia I began the claims process. So I uploaded receipts for items I had receipts for. 1x camera, 1x phone, 1xnotebook, plus a few other misc items. The first hurdle I come across was when it asked for the IMEI number of my phone, like a lot of people I bought a second hand phone so I could use local sim cards in it. The purchase was made from a facebook buy swap sell page. So my receipt is just a copy of the agreement from the person who sold it, that I was buying it from. Furthermore I contacted the previous owner and they were happy to vouch that I purchased the phone from them.. 

However TID find it unusual I don?t know the IMEI number, most people don?t even know there phone number let alone the IMEI number of the phone. So strait away they become suspicious like I?m doing something wrong..  I had to call them gave them as much info as I could about the incident they also requested that I post them the receipt for my notebook even though I sent them a digital copy of it.. Keep in mind any new piece of evidence will increase the claim process time by a further 10 days. I then spoke with the person on the phone who was handling my claim and they had asked why I said I lost my camera and all the photos on the SD card, when I they had gone to my facebook profile and found photos I uploaded. 

I explained to them that when I got to Russia I wanted to show my girlfriend photos of where I had been on the way to Russia so I uploaded what I had on my SD card which included about 12-18 photos from Russia, from the first few days of being there.  Her reply was ?you said you lost all your photos? I said yes I did lose them all they were on the SD card. silly me I forgot to mention I had 12 photos from Russia on my girlfriends computer so out of 1000 or more photos of Russia I have what I took in the first 2 days. Furthermore I had sent her 2 of the photos I had taken in Russia and explained where they come from so I hardly think I was trying to conceal anything; of course you are made to feel like you are the criminal. 

Now they want a statutory declaration from my girlfriend to say I put photos on her computer.. Also this will be considered new evidence and increase the claim time buy a further 10 days. To me this sounds like a way to just continue dragging out the process.  So I have decided I won?t be providing any more evidence as it?s just going to increase the claim processing time. 
As it stands they have a police report, a translation of a police report ,photos as evidence I was carrying a back pack, digital copies of receipts of items stolen, also I had to provide tickets as evidence I travelled which I have done. Bank statements to show when the purchases were made and to show money coming from my account..  

I will make updates on the progress of my case as it goes. At the moment they are waiting on a statutory declaration and my original receipts.. However I have decided to hold all the originals until the claim is processed as once I send these to TID I will never get them back. Yes regardless of your claim outcome TID will not return original receipts. I think its fair that when they show me what they are willing to pay me for my items that I then send the receipts. Sending an exact copy of what they already have is not new evidence and should not add 10 days to processing time..
I have written to Alison as I see she looks at some cases.. If this claim falls apart ill upload all conversations between me and TID with all evidence submitted and you can then see for yourself of how this process goes.. 

My advice for now is, spend the extra money on a good travel insurance company.  I know some of you will be students on a budget, but please guys if you cant afford to replace stolen items just spend the little bit extra on good insurance. by the other reviews on here you can clearly see they dont like to keep up there end of the deal..

title: Unacceptable Delays
body:
???Today marks five months since I first submitted my claim to Cover-More Insurance.  The trip we planned needed to be cancelled because my husband was diagnosed with a heart blockage that required hospitalisation and treatment less than a week before our trip was scheduled.  I delayed submitting his claim until all of the documentation asked for by Cover-More was accumulated, thinking that this would expedite the claims process.  

Over the past five months, I have been advised that Cover-More Insurance had not received documents that were sent in the original submission.  Since the claim was sent in one complete envelope, this could not be true.  When I tried to follow up on the status of my claim on the ?online portal?, the information listed was commonly inaccurate; for example,  it would show that information was being requested when I knew that it had already been sent.  When I called the 300 number, I was informed that emails had been sent to me showing the disposition of the case.  I never received these emails, even though I was looking for them.  It was suggested that my spam filter must have dumped them. Eventually, I asked the customer service person to send me an email while we were on the telephone.  The email came through without incident.

Both my husbands primary care physician and his Specialist  sent information that was requested, and when I learned that the information had not been ?received? by Cover-More, it was suggested to me that there must not have been a proper cover-letter or claim number sent with the FAX (untrue).  Each submission, once it was ?received? (which translates, of course, to having been acknowledged by Cover-More to have been received) underwent the 10 business day processing time.  Only after the initial 10 days for the individual submission had expired would the information be turned over to the ?medical evaluators? where another ten business days were required for medical evaluation.

In addition to all of the medical questions, my travel agent who had booked the airline tickets had the same experience; submitting information and much later being told that the information had not been received.  Cover-More also only processes one issue at a time, to that the ten day period must elapse for airline tickets, bank statements, etc. before going on to the next category.  Today, I was told that the complete medical records for my husband, which were asked for only after his doctor?s statements, his specialist statements, and the receipt for his hospitalization were received had now passed through the initial screening (of what, I don?t know) and had been passed on to the ?medical evaluators?.  I did not receive an adequate explanation as to what the initial screening might entail if it was not medical in nature.

The nice man with whom I spoke today said that another 10 working days would be required for the current process, and that he could not assure me that there would not be additional information needed at the end of that time.  Because this claim is rather large, I assume that the hoops we have to jump through are more than usual, but this process has been upsetting and infuriating.

title: Ridiculous - Cost for adding 4 days of cover on an existing policy if you claim
body:
I unfortunately had to make a claim under my policy for cancellation cost for flights and accommodation after my tour was cancelled. I was actually able to negotiate and re-arrange my holiday for a price less than the cancellation, however for whatever reason TID decided to pay me for the cancellation of my holiday (which was inconvenient as re-arranging would have been much easier from a customer service perspective). 

The claim experience was ok, i understand insurance claims and the turnaround time of 10 days seemed excessive. I did request an earlier review as i needed to know whether we should re-arrange or cancel the trip and what would and wouldn?t be covered. I'll give credit here - the claims team/assessor begrudgingly reviewed my claim earlier. 

What i found with direct questions in relation to my exact cover was very cagey/non-committal and left me in a position where i was unsure what i would be covered for. The claims assessor i had appeared defensive and made me feel that when i called or asked questions it was an inconvenience talking with me. there was a particular call towards the end where i actually asked her why she was getting so aggressive (usually isn't it the customers who were aggressive?). I particularly wanted to understand why a certain document was required as i had provided information to confirm the cancellation occurred outside my control and the document i provided confirmed this. I was not claiming for the cost of the tour, just flights and accommodation which we had pre-booked. She was unable to answer my question or properly explain to me or under what section of th policy she relied upon to request this information. 

To speed my claim along i ended up providing them the document without the explanation. Overall claims experience was fine, although the way your treated was questionable. The team leader i did speak to was friendly and answered my questions in a great way. 

My current gripe is - i recently called to extend my cover by 4 days. The first consultant i spoke with stated my cover had been cancelled??? She then referred back to a manager who also confirmed this was cancelled? I asked under what section of my policy the cancellation occurred? No explanation could be provided, i had to end the call as i had a meeting to attend but was very concerned as no letter/confirmation of cancellation of cover was provided in writing to us. 

I called again today and was advised that my cover was still current (Inconsistent information being received so very confusing)? I then requested to extend the cover by 4 days - technically 2 days as we would return earlier. What shocked me was TID would not extend my cover by two days as i had a claim!!!! 

In order for me to purchase cover for my husband and i for 2 extra days it would cost over $100 when the cover for our whole trip for over 1 month was $200?? the consultant stated they would normally pro-rata the cost, however because you claimed you have to purchase a full new policy. 

Seems ridiculous the whole thing, penalise existing customers. My husband and i will end up with 4 policies to cover the trip, as he and i purchased separate policy as i have pre-existing medical conditions (the original two), then another 2 policies to cover a 2/4 day period. Which means if i have to claim (i hope not), i would have to lodge 4 claims online with all the relevant documents!!!

TID what are you doing????
Online Access and Claim
Excessive information required at claim without explanation and Penalising customers who have claimed

title: I would not use them again
body:
At the time I bought the policy, I thought the policy was expensive but worth it.  I couldn't do it on line as I had some pre-existing issues and as a result I had to pay a little extra.  What I particularly liked was that I bought a specific insurance for cruising and that insurance covered items such as missed ports, camera, laptop etc.

However, what I didn't like was that I had to contact the insurer IF I wanted to see a Dr and that I would have to get approval first.  This was difficult at sea but I managed to get through, got the approval.  I was told keep all the receipts and claim when I get home.

However the first email I received in response to my phone call said this.

" .. if your medical expenses is minimal and won't exceed to 500AUD, you can pay for it first then lodge a claim for reimbursement once back in Australia, But if you needs further assistance, kindly send us the following documents for our initial review.

ú Copy of the medical report/certificate from the doctor whom you had seen during your trip outlining your medical condition
ú Copy of your passport/medicare card.
ú Copy of your completed flight itinerary 
ú ALL ORIGINAL invoices/receipts of payment for expenses incurred (e.g for the doctor?s fee)"

Given that the cost of my visit to the Dr was around $118, I thought the receipt etc was all I needed, afterall, it was well under $500.

When I looked at the Receipt from the medical centre, it had all the information about my medical condition.  The following day I received a letter from the Medical Centre asking if I wanted a "report" for $42 as some Insurance companies require a report.  Again I didn't think I needed that because of the information on the receipt and the amount charged was well under the $500 limit.

A day or two after my initial contact with the Insurance company seeking permission to see the Ship's doctor,  I received a follow up email from MAPFRE, the Insurance representative.  I thought "oh that's nice, they are concerned" ... I replied ... but then the emails continued to arrive to the point where I received them every day.  I felt harassed and completely bombarded wanting to know if I needed further assistance.  In three weeks I received some 28 emails ... for some reason or other they asked the same question over and over. What's wrong with them?  Couldn't they read my replies?  How would they feel if they were on holidays and received email after email asking the same questions?

Once I got home, I put in a claim for the visit to the on board medical centre and was told to attach the Doctor's report as the claim would not proceed without it - the receipt wasn't good enough.  On board, they charged an additional $42 for the report, however the diagnosis was already written on the receipt.  

I thought I would be able to make just one claim for my medical expenses and the missed ports, but I couldn't add anymore to my initial claim.  So I contacted the company and was told each issue was a separate claim.  For example, we missed two ports .. both me and my spouse would have to lodge separate claims for each port we missed however the claims would only cover missed ports due to weather or mechanical issues and that I had to have official documents from the cruise line to that effect.  

Unfortunately a medical-evac to save a passenger's life which resulted in a missed port and our pre-paid private shore excursion was not covered ... and in any case, because I didn't pay extra to reduce the excess to nil, there would be a $100 excess on each claim for each issue. I wasn't aware of that nor did the insurance rep explain that to me when I contacted them initially before buying the policy.  I assumed that I would be able to lodge a claim for the entire trip, not each little issue that arose.   Nor did I see anything in the policy T&C about this ... consequently had I claimed, I would not have received a cent for the missed ports because the excess would have eaten up whatever refund I would have been given.

The lack of transparency, and in my instance, the lack of details in the T&C resulted in a decision to pay extra for insurance that simply did not "work" as I expected it to.

The final straw was that when the medical centre claim was finally accepted without the Drs Report, the insurance company's rep could not refund the princely sum of $18 to my CC despite me proving the correct details on the claim form.  Even then, they converted the amount to USD when I paid in AUD so that figure had to be corrected lest I be charged with insurance fraud !! 

Would I insure with them again? Unlikely - it was extremely inconvenient stuck in the middle of the ocean having to contact the insurance company by phone PRIOR to seeing any doctor on board.  Had I not done this, the claim would be denied.  Had it been an emergency situation, I would not have had time to contact them prior to seeking treatment.  And more importantly, how the heck would I know in advance if the cost of the medical treatment would exceed $500? And then to be harassed with emails day after day, getting the amount of reimbursement wrong, unable to process the amount to a CC ... I felt like I was dealing with a bunch of incompetent fools who had received their first claim and had no idea what to do.

title: Travel more ensured our paradise was not entirely lost!
body:
Our recent trip to Thailand was to be the perfect extended family vacation. We arrived from Australia with smiles, good health and thankfully..... covermore insurance.  Ocean calling. So many new sites to take in. Friendly locals and animals everywhere. And our 8 yr old, Gabriel, loves animals.  Especially dogs. And there dogs aplenty on koh Samui. Gabriel also knew how to approach any dog that he did not know. Cautiously, fom the front, with a hand held out. Unfortunately no caution could have prepared us for the stray dog that launched an attack on 8yr old on day 2. The dog bit Gabriel on the arm. More shock than apparent injury. But the skin was broken and as many animals carry rabies in Thailand we had to get him to he hospital for shots and medication. A quick call to covermore ensured that bills would be sorted no fuss. Little did we know this would be the firt of several calls to the brilliant covermore team and that by week 2 of the holiday Gabriel would be severely ill and have to be admitted to hospital for several nights. There is nothing worse than being on holiday in a foreign country with a child that is chronically sick. Covermore was with us through the thick of it and didn't drop the ball once. In a place where you are really at the mercy of the locals (who dont speak english) they dealt with hospital admission, attended to bills and made sure he had the best possible care  It is also worth mentioning that a hospital stay in koh Samui opens your eyes to the many tourists that end up in foreign medical care. We witnessed a group of badly injured aussie teenagers rushed in from a bad car accident. A woman with chronic appendicitis and unbelievable amount of food poisoning admissions. As we found out - it can happen to anyone at any time and we cant thank covermore enough for their care, guidance, efficiency and of course for settling all the bills for us.
Reliable, efficient, caring and a pleasure to deal with.

title: Unhelpful
body:
I booked travel insurance for a week in Bali.  The day I travelled I was violently ill.  I rang 1 cover to find if illness was covered and the reply I got was "I can't give you that information".  I asked several times and the standard reply was I can't give you that information.  As a consequence I travelled to Bali with a vomit bowl on my lap - sick the whole way there.  I spent the week in a 5 start hotel - in the bed desperately ill.  I was unsure whether I would be well enough to travel home - the doctor in Bali said I could have meningitis or denque fever.  This trip was a 21st present from my parents to my younger sister.  She spent the week between nursing me and sitting by the pool by herself.  Thank you 1 cover for a week from hell.  I am travelling to South America next month and will certainly not be insuring with 1 cover.  My family and I will spend as much time as we can telling everyone how unhelpful 1 cover was and never to use them.  All that was required was a sympathetic voice at the end of the phone with the words "yes, illness is covered under your policy, with the proviso that a doctors certificate is provided and the illness was deemed serious enough to make travel difficult.  My parents are appalled to think that I felt compelled to travel with a potentially life threatening virus because I thought if I cancelled I wouldn't be covered.  I forced myself onto that plane hoping that I would recover and that I could have been good company for my sister.  In hindsight this decision could have been fatal.
Cheap
Extremely unhelpful and unsympathetic phone operator.
