title: Thanks for prompt claim assessment.
body:
My husband and I travel frequently and have always taken out a Cover-more travel policy just in case... Shortly after finalising arrangements for a trekking holiday to Nepal and Tibet, I suddenly fell ill and found myself unable to travel.  This also meant that my husband had to modify his holiday plans.  This resulted in a fairly complicated claim.  After collecting and submitting the records and statements required by Cover-more, we were pleasantly surprised to receive a statement, after just 10 days, stating that our entire claim had been successful. We have nothing but praise for the friendly assistance of Cover-more call centre staff, and of the prompt service of our claim.  We will not hesitate to continue to use Cover-more each time we travel in the future.  Thanks Cover-more!
Friendly call centre staff, prompt claim assessment, clear advice on the claim forms about what to provide

title: Top Cover
body: Friendly & most helpful staff. Priced to meet our needs, (including medical conditions)  which was far better than some other Travel Insurance agencies.  Even the gasto didn't stop us from enjoying the holiday and the thought of Allianz covering us removed the stress.

title: Disappointed
body:
We have insured with InsureandGo three times and after our last trip we made a claim for two separate items. We had an iPad lost/stolen and we found that conditions of the policy made it almost impossible to make a successful claim. Our claim was rejected even though we had supplied a report from the tour director and had made several attempts to recover the item from the hotel where the item was lost.
We also had badly damaged luggage and our claim was upheld. We made the claim as soon as we arrived home in mid September and the claim was not settled until early November. The amount of supporting reports and paper work was substantial and in some cases needed to be provided twice. The whole process was drawn out and complicated.

title: Use to be 1st Class Not Anymore
body: Used CM for over 20 years however the last 5 years has proved exceedingly difficult. Their  processes/procedures and level of cover is inconsistent. Considering how complex it was to get cover initially this year I am in serious doubt  of how they would be if you needed to make a claim and I've  found an alternate insurer for my next trip due to the experience.

title: Do not use this company - ever!
body:
I've been using TID for many years and recently needed to make a claim for this first time as I had lost a pair or sunglasses while kayaking on Halong Bay in Vietnam.  The claim was declined as I hadn't reported the loss to "the authorities".  Seems they could not comprehend that there are no floating water police on Halong Bay!

I thought TID were different to other insurance companies but sadly no. I could almost hear the glee in their voice that they had got me in a technicality rather then recognising my previous good history.

title: Excellent insurance company
body: Easy to deal with and no hassles. Great company and will use for all future travel. Fast reliable excellent service. 2nd time I have used travel insurance direct and will never use any other insurance company for travel now. Review and payment of claim was fast and easy. Great work guys. Thank you

title: not recommended
body:
I am still waiting for covermore to answer my emails after 3 requests to find out what is happening with my claim....the service is appalling. It's cheaper and much more user friendly to go elsewhere 
AVOID COVERMORE 
OH and you can't phone them as they are having issues with their phone system....really!!!???

title: Interstate travel.
body: Recommended by a friend who is a frequent oversees traveller who has also made claims in the past. TID were excellent, helped over the phone and followed up without being intrusive. Highly recommended.

title: Didnt need to use it but great to know it was there
body: Good value, easy to set up. Rang help desk for clarification on some matters and they were more than helpful. Will probably use them again for our next adventure. Thankyou

title: Easy to set up insurance
body: TID came highly recommended by a friend who actually had a claim while overseas and found TID very easy and efficient to deal with....although I didn't need to claim, I found setting up the policy for overseas travel very easy...within minutes I had an insurance policy and piece of mind...and at a good price...thank you TID

title: Single parent nightmare Allianz travel insurance
body:
Policy purchases thru webjet, 10 days Bali,single father with 10 yo and 7yo first time overseas.
7yo falls ill with "severe case of tonsillitis" as diagnosed by the Dr onsite at Hard Rock hotel mid way thru the holiday. Attempted to contact Allianz , presses number 2 option being for Claims enquiries, message was office is closed until Monday . It was Saturday midday .
The dr did not write he's advice on the report.
We checked out of the hotel and purchased return airfares to Perth for $600 for the 3 of us with Garuda. Loss of accomodation at club med and hard rock , claim circa $4000. 
Allianz knocked back the claim because their 24 hr Claims office didn't give approval to return. 
I was expected to sit in a hotel room with a sick 7 yo and 10yo for possibly 5 days?
Absolutely disgusted , 
To add insult they offered $3000 on the same day their response to a FOS complaint I made, which I now regretfully declined. My claim was bonafide and I believed was reasonable when all circumstances taken into consideration .
Fine print is the fine print . 
Single parents do not use Allianz
Rubbish service and I'm sure there is no response from Allianz to this review as it's 1 star. Check other reviews on Allianz. They only respond to 
those who were satisfied . Disgusting

title: Havent travelled as yet, but the purchasing of the product was easy
body: It Seems like good value for money and good piece of mind. Hopefully we wont have to use it but its always worth having cover when travelling domestically or overseas.

title: Hassle Free Travel Insurance:)
body:
Our travel insurance policy was great value. The process was very streamlined and we were extremely happy with the customer support.
Particularly happy with receiving emails from 1Cover when nearing the end of our holiday enquiring if we need to extend the cover.
Will not hesitate to use 1Cover next time we go on holiday.

title: Travel insurance
body: I always travel with Allianz insurance. Easy to purchase online, good cover at an affordable price. On the odd occasion I have rang customer support they have been very good.

title: Suitable Travel Insurance
body:
On the face of it the insurance was appropriate for my needs. How good can only be judged when making a claim.
Cost was most reasonable. I would use Allianz again.

title: An insurance policy that won't cover corona virus related events.
body:
I purchased an annual worldwide insurance policy only to find not only have I wasted my money on flights, prepaid accommodation, and other travel related costs but also the $546 I was charged for the insurance policy.

1Cover is refusing to cover events relating to corona virus.

I have taken out their worldwide annual cover for a number of years without a claim. However I will not be taking out any more policies with this company and strongly encourage others to do the same.

They also make many unwanted phone calls in the weeks before the previous policy expires to try to sell a new policy. 

Awarding this lot one star is over generous.

title: Thieving sharks!!
body: Like all the other recent reviews from people that InsuranceandGO has stolen from, on 3 March 2020 we bought Gold travel insurance for our intended family holiday in mid-April 2020 to celebrate my wife's 40th birthday over in WA. But InsuranceandGo declined to refund us despite COVID-19 being declared a global pandemic, with Australian Federal and State Governments ordering all non-essential travel to be stopped and borders closed. While all other travel, hire car and accommodation companies have complied with ACCC recommendations to offer a credit or full refund, InsuranceandGO has not. Instead, they claimed their standard 14 day cancellation policy. So I agree with [name removed](18 April), this is robbery! I too believe like [name removed].,(17 April) avoid them like COVID-19 and as suggested by [name removed] (15 April), never insure with them again. Help us to shut their business down by never insuring with InsuranceandGo so it will stop them from offering to deliver a service that is not provided and instead just stealing money from their clients. Finally, I recommend all clients who have recently been denied a credit or refund to notify the ACCC. Perhaps pressure from this federal agency will help to make a change.

title: Excellent holiday ends with bug. Smooth pain relief from Cover More upon return
body:
After an otherwise excellent dive holiday in Truk Lagoon we spent the  last 3 days at The Fiesta Resort in Guam. Unfortunatley we  spent most of the time "enjoying" the view from the hotel bed, while our friends went diving and dining. The only trips out of the hotel was the taxi trip to visit the medical centre, who provided us with excellent service. We let them know we had travel insurance and we would make a claim upon our return to Australia.
Simple claim forms. Very expedient service. Provided necessary paperwork and had a refund within a couple of weeks. Excellent service from staff.

title: Excellent customer service
body: I purchased a comprehensive policy for a reasonable price. When I needed to make a claim for damaged luggage, the response I received was courteous, helpful and prompt. I received the payment for my claim in just over 24 hours! I could not have wished for better or friendlier service.

title: bad travel insurance
body: i had a problem with my boarding and i had to buy another flight ticket to come back sydney .When i came back i did my claim with budget direct travel insurance but they made me wait 10 business days and rejected my claim.This is very bad insurance company you can get.....

title: Worst Insurance Company...they wont pay out claims
body: I have had the worse experience with insure and go..got volcano cover to Bali and had to cancel the trip because of the known risks of being stuck there and that will not cover the cancellation.....basically they want you to go to Bali, get stranded then you'll get covered...in the meantime you can loose your job, suffer the expensive costs of being stranded, nope great company NOT...there is always a sneaky fine print to get out of paying..i have no taken this further

title: Very satisfied with phone interaction
body: I think it is quite  good value. It was not difficult to set up and my customer support contact was helpful. The series of questions that are asked are reasonable.

title: Insurance, necessary evel
body: The policy was the best price for our trip however we did not use it as we had no problems so it is hard to say much about this policy

title: Travel insurance priority /claim
body:
Travel insurance is a must I never thought I would get ill overseas.
When I returned back to Aus 1Cover made it very easy to understand what information they required and receipts to process my claim ASAP.
I am very impressed how quickly 1Cover processed my claim.
Thank you 1Cover I'll be using your travel insurance on my next travels and will recommend to everyone.

title: Piece of mind.
body: I didn't need it but it was nice to know I was covered. Premium was pretty reasonably priced. I'd probably use 1Cover again.

title: Customer service is appalling!!!
body: I had to cancel my overseas trip due to a medical condition and therefore was unable to travel.  All medical certificates have been supplied as per Cover Mores requests.  My claim has been in with Cover More for nearly 2 months and I am still none the wiser what exactly is happening with it.  When I have chased them up previously I have been told they have contacted me via email only to find they have sent emails to the wrong email address.  Each time I submit a follow up request I get an email advising they will contact me within 10 business days.  I have now been on hold for 2 hours with them and I'm not exactly sure how to go about getting this resolved.  I do understand the current workload with the Corona Virus but my claim has nothing to do with this.  I also got an email asking me to rate the this company, needless to say I will never insure with them again!

title: Complimentary for covering nothing? Please read the 6 feet long "not covered clauses" first...
body: Pay for proper insurance.  Does not cover lost property that was lost on flights or Hotels etc... Lost my handset during flight or at the airport, not covered... Most of the good reviews actually never tried to claim anything?

title: No cover if they cancel your flight
body:
I assumed I paid insurance to cover me for most unexpected events such as cancelled flights.  I found myself stuck in a foreign country, sick, with maybe another flight in a couple of days.  I took the option of getting on a flight  with another airline (the flight cost more last minute, not direct) to get home.   Seems I wasnt covered unless the cancellation was caused by a strike.  

Considering how often flights are cancelled, how often people need to get home for a multitude of reasons, it makes me wonder the point of the wasted money of buying insurance from covermore.  Never assume you are covered.

They treated  it like a straight forward no yet took 20 days and alot of documents required to get to this decision.  You have to work hard and wait to be turned down. 

Shopping around for better cover!

title: No claims but positive experience
body: Didn't need to claim but the policy was easy to buy and plenty of info was provided. Have claimed from this company on a previous trip and had no hassles. Rates are some of the cheapest I could find from a reputable company.

title: You have to have it but very disappointed in how much u have increased your premiums
body: I have Never had to claim but paid a lot more then the other times.Not sure 3 or 4 times.Yes it was okay to set up I rang to do it.

title: Not happy
body: This is the First time we used this  company and the last time not worth it & the time frame to get back to us was too slow

title: Did not use it
body:
I could be a bit cheaper, mainly for those customers who did not nake any claim.
Moreover, it could be linked with other memberships, such as Qantas frequent flyer, velocity Virgin, flybuys...

title: Just what I need
body:
Easy to set up and quick response , been with Budget direct for most of my overseas travel , good value for money, would recommend to others.
Keep up the good work

title: Always looking for excuses
body:
I don't understand how this company's ratings are so high.
The depreciation on electronic items is horrendous and they will use any excuse to avoid paying claims.
My experiences:

1) Camera stolen in Europe they did pay out but had really high depreciation on item. I also purchased a memory card in Singapore at 30% cheaper than what I could have purchased it for from Myers/ Dick Smith etc as part of the same trip so the item was 2 weeks old.
I can't remember the exact prices, but the memory card was about $95 at Myers, AU$55 in Singapore and I got a payout of $25 as they said that is what they could purchase them for.
2) After close to 3 months travel in the US I had a really bad toothache in the last week of my holiday.
I rang Covermore and was told by the operator that any expenses would not be covered as this was a pre-existing condition. Why would I bother to wait more than 2 months to claim on a so called pre-existing condition?

Avoid paying out on claims

title: Easy to deal with
body: Reasonable value and easy to setup. Only downside is they do not have the option to pay by AMEX which is my main card. I would still recommend this insurance company to others as they are easy to deal with

title: I will only travel with 1Cover in the future!
body: I would highly recommend 1Cover. During my 8 month Europe trip I was sure I wouldn't rely on my insurance at any point. But unfortunately circumstances change. It was their easy and extremely quick claim process that means I will only take insurance out with them for future adventures. I was one of 3 family members making claims, each of us with different companies and 1Cover is certainty the most reasonable, reliable and fast. I vouch never to travel without insurance and will always rely on 1Cover. Thankyou!

title: Good cover for Mature travellers
body: Not many insurers cover mature age people these days. Chose Gold cover which is good value. It was easy to set up through website. No claims made as yet. Have taken cover twice for interstate and overseas travels

title: Will always use Allianz travel insurance
body: Simple application process. Far cheaper than similar products offered by airlines and with a much lower excess. We had to have a hospital visit and rabies treatment while overseas due to animal bite. Online claim was submitted late one afternoon and paid in full by the next morning. This was the second occasion claiming on an Allianz travel policy and again it was simple, quick and efficient. Would never use anyone else.

title: A top outfit
body: Have engaged their services for a number of years now. Simple to set up & Customer Support personnel are always most helpful. Have recommended InsureandGo to many of my friends & associates as well.

title: so far SO GOOD
body:
better value than some but still costly
first time user
multi trip annual policy has good coverage, better than last company used.
no claim made at this time. A number of overseas trips planned in 2020 so will see how it goes.

title: Change of destination
body:
We were disappointed that we had to pay additional premium when our first travel company went into liquidation and we booked another trip which was shorter. We realise that you do not cover bankruptcy and the second trip was to Japan which is a different area from the European cruise but feel that some flexibility might have been applied as it was only half the number  of days.
Otherwise no problems and no claims

title: Heartbreaking Service
body:
My husband and I were in Europe in June and he developed bilateral Pulmonary Emboli and couldn't fly for 2 weeks.  1 Cover told us to book another motel of a similar quality and keep in touch.  As it was school holidays and peak time, most motels were booked out so we had to move a couple of times. Our flights were put on hold and when the time came to rebook, it became a nightmare.  Everytime I called 1 cover I spoke to a different person. Noone knew what was going on. I had to get a friend in Melbourne to talk to them and try to get us on a flight.  this took 2 days. They wanted a passport stamp that didn't exist, once again no one knew their job. On our return, they didn't want to pay the motel costs.  It took months of emails until it was repaid, but not fully.
 I would never use them again or recommend them.

title: Policy Review
body: Having not had to ever make a claim it is difficult to give a comprehensive rating however I always find TID policies easy to set up and good value.  Clear information and good customer service.  However I had no end of problems with setting up the TID cash passport and after multiple phone calls and several emails I consigned it to the bin.  Still waiting to hear back from the call centre weeks later.

title: Comprehensive Travel Insurance
body: I have used Insure and Go International Travel Insurance on numerous occasions and have always found them to be comprehensive in their level of cover and competitive with their pricing. In fact I have already purchased a policy for my next trip with Insure and Go.

title: Always feel safe with insurance from these guys
body: Policy great value and super easy to set up on line...took only moments. Didn't need to actually make a claim but have had to in the past and these guys are great to deal with!

title: Lucky we read reviews because in the end we needed to claim
body: 1st time we used this company,  after reading bad reviews of other insurance companies 1cover looked highly regarded. My wife found a cheaper policy with some budget direct company but I said no point in going with a cheap company if when you need to claim they will not pay. Well unfortunately her father passed the day before travel and whilst that was horrible 1cover certainly were not horrible. They helped us every step and have paid all the costs that we had lost. Thankyou 1cover I will not go through another travel insurance company.

title: Do not buy if you plan to stay in hostels
body:
If you are hoping to get a property theft claim through when you stay at a hostel, forget it.  The policy wording is interpreted in the meanest trickiest way to basically mean that the oly way you can claim in a hostel is if you are physically assaulted to have the luggage removed from your possession.  Oly mitigation seems to be to take your luggage into the shower cubicle with you.  Rediculous.  Wasted our money on this product.
They were very nice and helpful when selling.

title: Peace of Mind, Only Clicks Away!
body:
All I needed in terms of Travel Insurance. Easy to read without so much technical jargon.
A Peace of Mind without the Price Tag.
Keep up the good job TID.

title: It?s perfect !!
body:
I found the policy is good value and very easy to set up 
I looking best value and I found it !!
This is my second time using it
I?m very happy and recommend it

title: Couldn't be happier
body: I have only used insurance and go once .  Due to ill health had to cancel my trip and I had no problems with my claim.

title: Travel insurance
body: Easy to set up, it's the first time I have used Ally and for travel. The operator was very friendly and professional. I would use Allianz again in the future

title: No credit on insurance for cancelled holiday
body:
TID is an absolute joke.

Prior to COVID-19 our airline rescheduled our flights which required us to alter our itinerary, change connecting flight bookings and add an additional nights accommodation.

This result in approximately $1500 in additional costs. A claim was made for these costs but was rejected.

Once COVID cancellations and travel bans came around we were unable to take the trip anyway.

TID then sent an email asking for us to advise if we wanted to reschedule or take a credit. As our new travel date would be further than 12 months from our original purchase, a reschedule was not possible. We then asked for a credit of our premium.

This request has now been rejected and now we are left with no credit, no travel insurance, and $400 down the drain. Their excuse is a claim was made, which should mean nothing considering it was rejected and nothing paid out.

Will never use this company again, and will be avoiding all NIB companies from now on.

title: Best Travel Insurance l have had
body:
I took the policy for a year ( second time) great value
Easy over the phone set up
Great customer service and discounts credited.
I claimed and all was easy the only problem l had was fitting in entries of claims which l had to do by email

title: Do not be lured in by their low costs!
body: Carefully read through their PDS and you'll realise that there's so many exceptions to what you're covered for that you're particularly covered for nothing useful! Not even flight cancellation! Our claim for reimbursement for a flight cancellation was rejected AFTER they told us that we WOULD be covered when we first purchased the policy! What a joke! DO NOT FALL INTO THE SAME TRAP WE DID - GO WITH SOMEONE ELSE!

title: Insurance rating
body: We have made a claim on a previous trip. It was the ease & service of our previous claim that keeps us with Allianz. Although we saw other travel insurance that was slightly cheaper we did not believe the company was as reputable.

title: Non existent cover for our overseas trip cancelled due to corona virus
body: We went with Sure Safe because it was maybe $60 less than the other cover offered us.  It covered fares, hotel and luggage plus health, but,  when we had to cancel due to the corona virus and me being immunocompromised which they knew about beforehand - I was told  we were NOT covered and to please refer to page 72 of the fine printed booklet.  What was the point of using this company they were absolutely no help and the person I spoke with just kept repeating to please refer to page 72. They refused to cover us because of the pandemic.  Not happy and do not feel inclined to give them any good reviews ever going on our experience.  Sadly.  Might as well have saved the  money and not taken out any insurance.

title: Outstanding cover for a 70 year old.
body: Excellent Very good value and is really nice to receive a welcome back email.,with asking did i want to make a claim etc. Keep up the good work as i will  be using your services in September / November this year. Very excellent policy for myself, being over 70 years old.

title: Pointless and Unjust
body: I had lost a very valuable item on a trip to cairns. The last place i remember noticing it was inside our car rental. i contacted the car company to ask if it was left behind. They claimed nothing was found. I therefore filed a claim with my insurance. To them, "lost item" meant "leaving it in a public place unattended". Despite disputing my claim further, it was still rejected under the basis i had left it unattended in a public place. How is that right? lost means not knowing where it is. I simply called the rental company because i did not know who else to call as i had lost the item and had no clue where it was. Please read the entire policy document before taking a policy with InsureandGo because seriously, i read it later and found a whole bunch of excuses for them to get away with not settling a claim.

title: Great support
body: The InsureandGo gold family policy with snow cover was excellent value. We had to claim  for travel delay due to excess snow fall and avalanche risk. All went smoothly as we had all the receipts. Unused ski pass and ski rent was covered as was extra accommodation and meals. Note, we paid the extra to remove any excess from the overall policy but there was an excess of $100 per person  under the snow cover add on. We will use them again.

title: Always use TID
body: We always use TID  when booking through QANTAS or any other travel that we may be undertaking. We have never had a problem to date so there is no reason why we should not continue to use your company. Also your quotes always come in cheaper than the opposition!

title: Excellent experience.
body: I have had no reason to access your customer support as yet, so it is a moot question your software will not allow me to overlook! More words are required!!!!

title: Value, and suits older people too.
body: Best rates for our requirements, and straightforward to set up on line. Had a question on the phone which was answered easily. This is our second Annual policy and so far we've  had no need to make a claim.

title: Updated - I have now received a credit note. Faith restored somewhat.
body: Paid over $600 for policy with cruise cover many, many months before covid -19 started. Pandemic is excluded in one sentence in many pages of print (and who'd have thought?) Tried to cancel more than a month out and was denied. Contacted the company via social media and was given a credit note for future rebooking of my policy. Refund would have been better but I appreciate the assistance.

title: Problem free claim
body: Claimed for airfare, hotel, visa costs after I needed to cancel due to ill health; the claim was settled promptly for both myself and my travel partner.  There were  reasonable requests for evidence of the costs incurred (e.g. copy of credit card statements) as I'd expect; my experience in claiming was positive.

title: " Peace of mind."
body: I would not be without your cover. I had peace of mind at a very economical cost. Thank you !!

title: This is a very good travel insurance designed for the seniors
body:
Good value for policy and with a very simple system to set up.
Very hard to call for a quote no on answer the phone with the exception
of 1300 401 177 a lady on the medical screening was very helpful, very kind

title: Good Value and Easy to Use
body: Haven't had to claim yet but so far the process is clear and easy to use. This is the second or third year of insuring with InsureandGo.  Lets hope that the claim process is as straight foward

title: Simple & Affordable
body: Didn't need to use the policy, however it was cheap enough to satisfy our anxiety of 'what if' whilst overseas.

title: Easy process, peace of mind
body: I did a fair amount of research prior to my trip and 1Cover came out on top for a long trip in the US. Fortunately I didn't need to make a claim, so I can't comment on that aspect of my purchase; however, the process of purchasing itself I found as being easy. The PDS explained everything I needed to know and the policy was priced reasonable, if not cheap in comparison with other insurers.

title: Good price and good service.
body:
Extremely satisfied with TID service. Unfortunately we had to make a claim but I'm pleased to say the experience was very good. The claim was handled promptly and payment made without further information being requested. We have two os trips planned next year and we will definitely use Travel Insurance Direct again and recommend your organisation to the other two parties we are travelling with. Thank you.
Good price and reputable.

title: Totally recommend Cover-More
body: Our son got sick while on a cruise. The bill from the medical centre was nearly 4 thousand dollars. Lucky I had insurance through Cover-More. They reimburse me the full amount.

title: 3 months to take a look at a claim
body:
Had to call a couple of times for them to look at a claim that was submitted 3 months earlier. Then received a call saying that they would not be paying it out because the excess was more than the lost item.
Not great service.

title: Very efficient service for our claim!
body: We have used this insurance company when travelling for 4 times now.  A very reliable company! On this final trip with claim, the process went on so easy and smoothly.

title: Travel claim - Medical expenses
body: Very satisfied with support and efficiency with my claim. Have used 1 Cover on many occasions and will continue to do so in the future. Will recommend the company to friends and family.

title: Reputable Company
body: With all the negative publicity coming out of the Royal Commission I expected to have to fight to get my claim approved. It took a lot of paperwork but payment was made so I would use Insureandgo in the future and recommend it to friends.

title: Don't bother
body: Flight cancelled on return Sydney flight due to storms. Airline rebooked a flight 8am the next morning. Booked a budget room in Sydney to stay overnight ($92). Could have stayed five star and claimed on insurance but didn't. Luckily as now 5 weeks later they still won't settle. Have sent two letters from the airline with all the information regarding the cancelled flight but obviously they are good at taking your money but reluctant to pay out. Never had to make a claim on travel insurance before but surely there are better companies to deal with. Never again this company.

title: Fantastic company to insure with
body: Eventhough I have to pay extra for medical history I feel the premium was value for money. It was really easy to apply and unfortunately I had to cancel my holiday due to an unexpected illness. InsureandGo keep me informed of how the claim was going and it was settled really easily.

title: Good and reliable
body: Easy to organise and relatively easy to read through.  Good coverage with low excess.  Travel insurance is essential for everyone so it is good to find a company that is reliable. And provides various levels of coverage.

title: Policy and claim with 1Cover
body: Compared to what was offered by the agents 1Cover offered a lower premium. Policy was easily set and the customer service was excellent. I would not go to any other company.  Period.

title: Economical choice
body: Quick economical choice with cover similar to the expensive alternatives. Have not made a claim so can't advise if claim service is good or bad. I have use this company a number of times now.

title: Online coverage for pre existing conditions was great
body: The thing I really liked about this policy was the ability to get cover for pre existing medical conditions online. One family member has a reasonable rare and complex disorder but I was still able to get clearance and cover for this online,especially great when you have left buying the insurance till the last minute!

title: Good value, good cover
body: I found 1 Cover to be the most comprehensive and the best value. Haven't had to claim yet so can' t comment on that but otherwise easy to purchase online and great value for money esp when covering for 4 people in the family

title: Customer Service Plus!
body:
I just wanted to compliment TID on their service. I have used TID on several occasions for my travel insurance needs and have consistently found the process of purchasing the insurance to be efficient and user friendly. On my last trip I had the unfortunate experience of having an expensive camera lens stolen, and had to make a claim for the first time. I have to say that the claims experience was equally efficient and the settlement was completed in a very timely fashion.

In addition the consultant who contacted me regarding the claim was very pleasant and professional and took the time to explain a part of the process that I didn't fully understand. It is unfortunately rare to encounter the level of service provided by TID.

title: No Stress Insurance
body: So quick easy and affordable.  Holiday planning made easy, InsureandGo online was super quick and easy to navigate, the easiest insurance policy I have ever had to organise. Value plus, no need to shop anywhere else.

title: They hide behind their fine print. Didn't pay out even though they claim to cover financial default.
body: Took out insurance, on line accommodation company went bankrupt.  Claim denied even though it says they cover you for bankruptcy. One section states they cover yet they hide behind fine print. Make sure that you don't have to claim. Won't be using them again.

title: THE BEST EXPERIENCE. DON'T CHOOSE ANYONE BUT 1COVER.
body:
Our story started on a international trip to Greece with my wife and my 3 young children. Unfortunately a day or so before we were to depart, my 3 year old boy was hospitalised with an acute chest infection. Subsequently we ended up missing our flight home... Throughout this time the SOS travel team kept in touch with us and advised the hospital that they would be settling the medical account direct, so we did not have to pay. This was extremely helpful and considerate. After my son was discharged, he required constant medical attention for some time and then my wife also got severely ill...

When my son and my wife were eventually cleared to fly, we were advised there were no flights and we may be stranded in Greece without a flight home for another 2 weeks. title: Avoid! Hell When Lodging Claim
body:
Avoid at all costs, the high ratings mostly of the process of buying the travel insurance but once you made a claim, all your privacy will be invaded and they will made it super difficult in the hope that you will just give up. I got robbed whilst overseas and emailed allianz right away. Initially the process was smooth, they asked for all documents you can possibly imagined and asked ridiculous questions like asking questions to a crimical, they asked for the contact numbers of all your friends and family members, they asked whether you have ever made a claim to other insurance eg. home and content etc, they asked you to send all your credit card statements (no advice given to blur out some of the digits), passports, photos taken whilst overseas, proof of ownership, all dometic and returned tickets. EVERYTHING. I have given these to them on time and no I have never made a claim to any insurer, not my car, not my home + content, so unsure why they need to ask that question while really they have access to the insurance database and they can check themselves instead of asking a stupid question which made me feels like i'm a scammer, this is the first time ever that i experienced something unfortunate overseas and trust me, being an avid traveller i always make sure i have a travel insurance for a piece of mind but now that this happened, there is really no difference whether or not you have a travel insurance. 
after all the private information and docs were provided, this is in the span of almost a month, they will ask for docs and waited for 7-10 working days (they are no way in a rush to respond) ,they will send another email asking for more docs more questions more confirmation , after all those are provided on time, i was advised the next process is to have an external investigation where i will be interviewed (perhaps like a criminal), which i agreed. However before this happened, after almost 3-4 weeks providing all those confidential docs and information, i was told that im not eligible because i have not spent $500 on my bankwest credit card. I have only spent $470 AUD apparently after all those currency conversion that they decided to use. SERIOUSLY!!, the officer was so defensive and rude after i told her my dissappointment, there  was no real process and she obviously has no clue and knowledge and no appreciation whatsoever about customer's privacy, she could have just asked for the bankwest credit card to first and foremost confirm the eligibility of the customers instead of invading someone's privacy by asking all of those docs to be provided. they were at least 30 attachments sent in the span of 3-4 weeks, all containing confidential information and just to be told after 4 weeks later that I'm short by $30. 
I have called allianz prior to lodging a claim to ensure that I'm eligible and was told since my husband and I spent $500 in total , that's fine. 
The officer now after 4 weeks telling me that I'm not eligible because I have not spent $500 on myself. I spent close to $2k on my credit card for prepaid travel costs. the last thing she said, you can go ahead with the interview process and we can issue you with a formal decision, which is declinal because i'm not eligible. VERY UNPROFESSIONAL ALLIANZ!!
my 2 cars are actually insured by Allianz, but after dealing with allianz for the very first time, i will change all my cars insurances to another company

title: Not ideal for rental car, lack of contact option abroad.
body:
Review is primarily around Rental Vehicle Excess and Contacting Allianz abroad.
Fortunately I did not have to make a claim, however it's important to note:

Rental Vehicle Excess
The quick summary of the policy indicates the rental car insurance covers $6k so I took out the policy, under the impression I could save money by not having to purchase the high rental car "Damage waivers" cost.
However after reading the PDS, for Allianz to cover the rental car excess, you need to pay for the rental car "Damage Waiver" which is quite expensive($35USD/day). The rental damage waiver from the rental car covers all the cost if you have an accident, so the Allianz rental car excess is pointless. Alternative travel insurance companies do not require this, so if you need travel insurance for renting a car, I would suggest going elsewhere.

Contact
I needed confirmation of this from Allianz, however their FB messenger staff weren't capable of providing an answer and their support is not 24/7. I was unable to call Allianz as it was an Australian number only (Unless it's an emergency). I was suppose to get a response via email, however that was not forthcoming. 

Unfortunately I would not be purchasing travel insurance from Allianz, what appeared to be an affordable insurance policy, turned out to be expensive option.

title: Travel Insurance - an absolute joke.
body:
So disappointed in this high profile Travel Insurance Company.  I travel very often for business, so I always take travel insurance and have never claimed yet, until my most recent trip, when I lost my laptop and realised that I had most likely left it by mistake in the taxi that took me to the hotel.  I was traveling with quite a lot of luggage and can only assume this is what I did.  I made contact with the taxi company through the hotel to try and retrieve it, but to no avail.  I also went to the police station and reported my loss.
On my return home, I sent my claim and documents for processing.  I did not expect to receive very much back because of depreciation on my computer, but thought I may get something towards a replacement cost.
My application was flatly declined because I had "left it behind" in a taxi and anything left behind in a train, aircraft, bus, taxi etc is not covered.  But loss of an article is??  Well this is just typical of insurance companies trying to get out of paying out on a claim - why do we take travel insurance?  Precisely for this very reason.
I am a frequent overseas traveller for business - this time I was traveling with two colleagues who also had a policy with Travel 1 Insurance - I will never take a policy with this Company again, neither will my colleagues - so this is three customers you lose and we will also never recommend your Travel 1 Insurance to any of our friends or colleagues.
Furthermore - this just makes travel insurance a waste of time!!

title: Too Hard to claim
body:
Went on a cruise so took out policy with TID. I was mugged in Barcelona and had gold necklace stolen which was given to me on my 21st, 30 years ago. I did everything that was expected, spent hours at a Barcelona police station and made the necessary statement, had markings on neck photographed. Went to make the claim and it seems all they are interested in is the receipt and proof of purchase. I have explained that I cannot get a receipt as this was 30 yrs ago and the person that bought it for me was now living somewhere in the Phillipines and not contactable. I am know told a stat dec will do, however it will only be and estimate of what it cost. This has now been going on for the last 6 weeks and they are still insisting on a proof of purchase and price from 30yrs ago. I am happy to do what ever is necessary to provide what they need,  knowing what the replacement cost is likely to be, however I have now been informed that this claim will only cover $700! 
I have checked the PDS and it very miss guiding as in the spread sheet it list coverage of $6000 and $3000 but in reality the claim is only good for $700. 
I will never use TID again as I feel absolutely scammed by the usual ?small print garbage?. Why can?t it just do what is says on the packet!!
******************************************
UPDATE
8 Months on and they have, up until recently insisted on the receipt from 30yrs ago. I have now sent a stat dec, a jewellers quote  and 2 photos of me wearing the necklace, 1 from 1989 ish and the other from 2015.  Fingers crossed that that this gets it over the line. 
Oh and the fact that the company?s customer service person reached out to me in an email obviously made absolutely no difference what so ever. 
This has been absolute joke and extremely painful.

title: Travel delay wasn't covered.
body: We purchased travel insurance as a duo prior to travelling to Indonesia. Once we arrived at the airport to fly home our flight out of Bali was delayed by 14 hours, meaning we missed our connecting flights and got home a day later than expected. The airline paid out some money, which meant Allianz could delay deciding about the outcome of our claim for a few weeks, then they claimed that only the accommodation was able to be covered, not the travel to and from the alternate accommodation or necessary phone calls to the airline company to ensure we could get home and to my employer to let them know I would be late coming back to work due to the delay. Allianz seem to be very choosy as to what constitutes a travel delay expense and it seems ridiculous that they suggest they would have covered the hotel room but not the phone calls to the airline company to arrange alternative flights or the taxi fare to get to the accommodation either! This is all after the online claiming system was faulty and would not allow me to file my claim whilst it was being fixed, and the phone help centre was unable to give any advice regarding the matter, just told me to try again later. I will not be buying Allianz travel insurance again, and would not recommend them to anyone!

title: Sweet and Sour
body: I had two seperate claims, Broken surfboard (snapped in two) on the plane on the way over, and Stolen phone about 2 weeks into a 3 week Indonesian Holiday. I was pleased with the result of the surfboard claim, simply amount of purchase less excess..... that's fine. The time taken and documentation was slightly agitating, needing to provide: Receipt of original surfboard, receipt of new surfboard, written confirmation of surfboard being damaged beyond repair obtained from an "expert" (even though I had photos of it snapped... down the middle.. in two pieces...) Accompanied by written confirmation from the airline that they are not going to compensate me (even though I'd signed a waver before boarding that any damaged luggage was not going to be covered by the airline). This took around 2 weeks, a little longer than I'd have liked to wait but hey, the result was good I suppose. The second claim, stolen phone, was a little disappointing, again because of the time taken, documentation required and end result. Took best part of 2 weeks again, needed to provide: Receipt of phone, police report outlining the theft, written confirmation of my sim card being blocked from the phone, photo of the lifeproof ($100) case on the phone, bank statement proving transaction for said case. After that my phone was depreciated by $120 (phone was  only a couple months old). So in summary was I happy? Yeah I guess, definitely glad I had some kind of insurance, would I recommend covermore? Undecided. I'm sure there'd be a more comprehensive cover out there that isn't so tedious and may have a less harsh depreciation clause.

body:

title: Do I even have to give a star?!?!
body:
I was left stranded in Bali after making enquires to the airline if I could bring my flight forward as I left one of medications at home.  The airline took no money for this change nor did I receive written confirmation with changing of flights so just hoped for the best with doing without my medication & it was only 3 days till I was flying home!  I arrived at Denpasar airport on my original paid return flight & the airline had cancelled it.  It was 10pm at night plus I was traveling solo so upset & concerned was an understatement!  I had to book a hotel room for the night.  The airline stated I had to buy a one way ticket home for $1050, or there was cheaper options with other airlines for $816 which I took.  I?ve been in contact with the airline who cancelled my flight to no avail so my only option was to claim.  I travel once a year overseas & this is the first time I?ve ever claimed!  The first time I?ve used TID but in the future I?ll stick with covermore as my family & friends have always spoken highly of them, instead of TID which was the cheaper premium option at the time. 

It?s seems it?s continuous flow with how TID actually work & to be frank scam innocent people who do the right thing from the gecko!!  They will make you wait 10 days for a claim to be processed, then on the 10th day ask for more information to be sent, which I did immediately (Half of the info I originally sent) I actively rang them wondering how my claim was progressing mind you in that 10 days just to make sure I?d sent the relevant information!!  Then told it will take another 10 days to be processed...to finally get the out come no they will not be accepting my claim!   I?ve now made an official complaint to the AFCA!!!

I emailed 1 cover, they asked for a letter from the flights with the loss of money and a letter from my doctor.. sent both.. apparently the letter from the doctor was not good enough and they wanted more details. So, second trip to the doctors i went and got the letter with the information they asked for. Waiting a few days, got another email.. still not good enough and has now sent a 5 page form my doctor has to fill out! why was i not sent this to begin with? This has now cost me 3 trips to the doctors, money, time and stress. I should of been notified from the beginning what i needed but every time they add on MORE that i need that was not requested previously.
They really do not care, do not waste your time using 1cover. I am going to the ombudsman in a few days if this isn't resolved.

title: Do NOT recommend!!! Lied to by staff!!!
body:
I was one of the people who was affected by covid. On 23 Jan I bought comprehensive travel insurance for a trip to Bali in March. On 2 occasions before the travel restrictions were put in place I called budget direct to confirm that I would be covered in the event of cancellation. They confirmed that I would be covered. When my flights were cancelled due to stage 4 travel warning (which is covered under the PDS) I lodged my travel claim. So to ensure I did it correctly I called BD who told me very specifically not to accept any travel credits otherwise it would be deemed as a refund. I was able to get money back for my accommodation but not flights. When I called to ask why they rejected my flights claim they explained it was because I had a credit from Jetstar and in order to progress my claim I was advised to cancel this credit (which I never accepted to begin with, was sent automatically). I followed up with Luxury Escapes who then followed up Jetstar to cancel this. The email from Jetstar stated 'as you did not accept the credit it was forfeited'. I only did this because of the instruction I was provided by Budget Direct. I was then denied my flights refund with the outcome email from budget direct stating that I had 'preemptively cancelled my flights'. Needless to say I was furious as I only did as I was told and called numerous times to ensure I would not be in this position. I only acted on the advice provided. The customer service was terrible when I called to explain I only did what I was told and that I had recorded times and dates when I spoke to their staff and got this advice. On 5 May I lodged an internal dispute which under the code is requires budget direct to provide a decision within 15 working days. It has now been almost 30 working days and still no response. I have followed up via email and 3 times via phone. I have been told each time that they would send a note to the complaints team to contact me but I'm still waiting. I have even asked for an indication on timing to which no one can provide. 

In conclusion don't waste your time or money. I was completely within the rights of the PDS to make my claim, I followed the advice that multiple staff members gave me and I am still trying to get a favourable outcome through their disputes process.

title: At last an insurance company which honours its policy.
body:
My wife and I were set to travel to Europe in May last year (2010) to attend our son's wedding in early June. Prior to attending our son's wedding we had arranged a Senic River Cruise for 19 days and then proceeding to Austria to attend the wedding. After spending in excess of $30,000 on our tirp our agent convinced me to take out comprehensive travel insurance with covermore. Thank god for that.

We flew out of Brisbane and arrived in Singapore to transfer to a flight to Paris and had a 3 hour stop over. When boarding our Paris leg of the journey it was announced that our flight had been delayed. Unfortunately 48 hours later we were still at Singapore airport due to the Euporian shutdown due to the "ash cloud". I contacted my travel agent who advised that we had taken out comprehensive insureance with Covermore and not to worry about the loss of our $30,000 trip as is was comprehensively insured.

Our agent gave me a direct number to contact covermore and on ringing they confirmed that all our losses were covered. Covermore also advised to immediately depart the airport and book ourselves into a hotel which would be covered by Covermore. We relocated into Singapore city centre only to find that the price of rooms had doubled. I rang covermore and they again advised not to worry and just to book in and remain in contact with the airport for any change incircumstance.


We stayed in the hotel for 2 nights and on the 3rd day presented ourselves to the airport to be met by Australian Consular Officials who adivsed us to travel immediately back to Australia as the ash cloud was not looking like abaiting in the near future and transport back to Australia would be ceasing after today. We immediately returned to Australia where we contacted Covermore and our travel agent to see if you could somehow make our way to Austria if conditions changed so that we could still attend our sons wedding. 

Our agent arranged our return to Europe as soon as the Ash Cloud lifted and we altered our travel to join our son in time for the wedding.

Covermore refunded some $24,000 of our original trip which was lost due to the debarcle. They also covered our costs incurred in Singapore.

This is the first time I have ever taken our travel insurance on a trip however I will always insure that I take out Covermore insurance on any further trips.

Covermore's staff were a preasure to deal with and were fully committed to ensure that we were given every asssitance to claim for legitimate losses. Thanks for their assistance.
No fuss, helpful and assisted us in our time of need.

title: Read the fine print and ask questions!
body:
I phoned up for a quote from this company today. First, I had to wait for ages on-line listening to slightly blurry and overly loud music. Second, upon asking some detailed questions, I received replies that didn't inspire me. I was inquiring about the Gold level cover, based on Choice's recommendation. 

I found that my partner and I are not considered a couple for the purposes of this insurance because we do not co-habit (in order to receive the couples discount you have to be living together for 6 months). That's pretty exclusionary (and non-sensical). I've not encountered this elsewhere, where a couples policy is generally applicable to any adults travelling together. 

Most concerning was that the policy for rental car excess does not apply if you are renting the car for more than 15 days. This pretty much cuts out many driving holidays and would normally render the insurance useless for us (in this respect). The main point of this review was to draw others' attention to this latter point because it is not obvious unless you ask (and not usual either). 

In the end, I decided to shop elsewhere because I was worried that these somewhat bizarre policy rules portended other equally bizarre ones that would not become obvious until it was time to make a claim ...

title: Disgusted on how our claim has been handled.
body: We put a claim in to be refunded for our tickets back home as the airline carrier declared it was cancelling certain international travel due to financial difficulties. Budget insurance are using COVID-19 as an excuse for the airline going bust. Absurd to be denied our claim on this basis as we insured our travel tickets and not for why companies go bust no matter the reason. Also our cover included pandemics so how Budget Insurance decides to choose the end of January for no cover on insurance claims relating to the pandemic is mind blowing as than why did they not change or stipulate any of this in the policy which we purchased in February . We are disputing the claim however they are now 3 business days overdue on replying to the dispute and we were promised an outcome by COB yesterday after speaking to one of the call centre employees. Very disappointed in how we have been treated on the phone and the process of the claim/dispute. If you going to advertise that you are their for your clients in time of need especially during the COVID-19 pandemic than stand by your word and not blatantly try to get away with peoples hard earn money. I would love to speak to a manager that sits on these claim/dispute outcomes and not merely a call centre clerk.

title: Not too bad
body:
I just want to share my experience that I have with TID so far. Their service is hit and miss. I cannot say that they are very good or bad. We have purchased our travel insurance from TID for so many years. 

In 2009, my mom broke her wrist when we were in Vietnam and were about to return to Sydney within a week. I rushed her to a nearby local hospital but she was refused admission because she is a foreigner. We then rushed to the Emergency Unit at Cho Ray Hospital where it was flooded with patients cover in blood from traffic accidents. 

Mom could not stand the horrific scene and we caught a taxi to another Emergency Unit of Nhan Dan 115 Hospital where a cast was put on her wrist (it was later found out at Auburn Hospital that the cast was badly done which has caused further damage to her hand and thumb). 

I was panicking the whole time and did not know what to do as this was the first time mom has an accident overseas. I contacted TID as soon as I got out of the hospital. TID advised that they needed a medical report from Nhan Dan 115 Hospital. However, the hospital refused to provide it. 

TID then advised us to go to Cho Ray Hospital in HCM City for a consultation and to get a medical report to confirm that my mom would be fit to travel back home as per our itinerary. I faxed the medical report from Cho Ray to TID but they did not accept it. TID then rang us again and advised us to visit the Viet Phap Hospital which was more than an hour by car from where we stayed. 

TID agreed to pay for the transportation and medical consultation costs. A Registered Nurse from TID called us to explain that we would not be able to board a plane without a proper medical report from the doctor. We did not want to stay in VN any longer after the accident so we finally got the medical report from Viet Phap Hospital as requested. 

We did not understand why TID did not suggest us to go to Viet Phap Hospital initially to save all the hassles. We were so exhausted with all the visits to the hospitals. We did not put in a claim as we have been worn out with our experience.

Last year, mom and I went to Los Angeles. This time she suffered from a severe back pain. I tried to contact TID 24 hours emergency assistance number but no answer. I left a message and hoped someone would call me back and refer my mom to the closest medical centre or doctor. I also sent an email to TID with my contact details in LA. 

However, I only received a reply by email advising me to collect all the necessary information I could to support a claim and to contact the (uncontactable) 24 hours number. We went to Houston and still have not received a phone call from TID. Mom was again sick in Houston so we took her to a local medical centre. 

The receptionist tried calling TID 24 hours number and no answer. This time I gathered all the supporting medical reports from the US. We completed the claim form with the supporting medical reports and her claim was processed by TID within a month. TID reimbursed all the medical expenses to mom less the excess of $100 which we understood what it was. 

This year, we also bought travel insurance from TID and will continue to do so as we have been doing so for many years. We admit that we stay with TID because it is cheaper than other providers. We hope TID will improve their service and make sure they are contactable to give advice and instruction on what to do when someone is in a frustrating situation like me.

body:

title: Frustrating service and outcome!
body:
made  claim for a theft in December 2014 and only now have gotten a useful response about it. they kept asking me for more and more information and proofs etc and every time i replied, i would have to call just to see if they had even opened the email, and usually had to wait over 20 minutes which costed me lots of money since calling from overseas, which you apparently cannot claim back on their insurance!

 then finally, only now, i got a response from the outcome of the claim, only to find that they are not reimbursing me for my camera, which was the most valuable thing i lost!! They said it was because i didn't provide enough proof of purchase but i had written to the case manager that i can definitely get the necessary documents if it was needed. i didn't get a reply, as usual, and so assumed that what i had provided was enough. they are reimbursing less than a third of the value of the things i had been robbed off! 

and since the whole process took 3 months instead of the '10 days' that the website says, I've gone through my entire trip without a camera. wouldn't have made a difference anyway, apparently, cos they weren't going to reimburse it!!

i have sent email after email since the calls hardly get answered before i run out of credit, and not once have i received a reply from the email. i would like to know now, if i send through the receipt will you be reimbursing me for my camera?

super frustrating and upsetting having to deal with having all of your things stolen and then having a supposedly great insurance company not help you out.

title: Terrible company, terrible service, terrible claim process.  DO NOT USE!
body:
I had a fall in May, tripped on a tree root, and broke and badly dislocated elbow whilst in Italy travelling alone.  After 10hrs in Italian emergency hospital I rang asking for help to get flight home.  I was told, contrary to website, that it was not their job to help me, they emphasised that I had to make sure I got cheapest option home and that no medical claims could be made once I got home.  Any out of pocket expenses were my problem.  That was the only help I got from them.  
Luckily my travel agent stepped up and got me home so I could have surgery.  Then he helped me with claim process which should be called DELAY process!  Once details were supplied to them they tell you they will replay in 10 days.  Day 9 they ask another question, sometimes same question, then you have to wait another 10 days.  Again and again!  Finally when I started ringing them on a daily basis, talking to supervisors and threatening legal action in September the claim was paid.
  No way will I ever use them again and I am making sure any fellow travellers know how bad they are!

title: Will not respond to emails about submitted claim
body:
We went with InsureandGo for travel insurance within Australia because we were going to a remote location and InsureandGo received an award from CHOICE magazine for their GOLD Domestic Insurance in 2018. This is the policy we, in good faith, took out before we travelled.

One of us was injured 6 days into the 20 day trip. We followed all procedures, went to Accident and Emergency at the local hospital for treatment where I was X-rayed, diagnosed with a sprained medial ligament in my knee with probable tears in the meniscus, treated by a doctor, put into a leg brace from hip to ankle, provided with crutches and given documentation by the treating medical officer in the hospital who advised me to cancel our camping holiday as I could not walk without crutches and to return home to recover and undergo rehabilitation. The hospital provided me with the 'Fit to Fly' certificates required by InsureandGo and by the airlines (AirNorth and Qantas). Because I could not bend my leg, we were told by the hospital that we would have to travel business class home.  We have documentary evidence on the Hospital letterhead advising this and signed by the treating medical officer. 

We had also taken out Qantas insurance against cancellation, and Qantas refunded the cancelled return leg immediately, then applied that refund to new tickets for the amended return flight. We advised InsureandGo we had received this refund from Qantas. We had to pay up front for the flights, over $4000 because of our remote location in Australia.

Insureandgo communicated well while we were negotiating with them and while we were providing them with every scrap of information they required. However, once they received all the documentation seven days ago, there has been absolute silence on their part and they will not respond to emails asking for information on how the claim is proceeding. We are taking this up with the Insurance Ombudsman, with CHOICE magazine for recommending this company to consumers, with Tourism Australia because of the bad reputation this will give Australia to overseas and domestic travellers, with our local MP and with a lawyer. We intend to saturate social media (FaceBook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Trip Advisor) with our experience in lodging a claim with InsureandGo.

We are thousands of dollars out of pocket and can not afford it, we will have to take our a loan to pay our credit card debt. The daily rate per person allowed to be claimed by the Australian Taxation Office for food and accommodation in Darwin is $333.70. We claimed $150 per person per day for food and accommodation for the four days and three nights we were waiting for the flight to return home. Less than half what is deemed a reasonable daily amount for food and accommodation by the ATO. All we are asking for is reimbursement of our emergency expenses and for our prepaid expenses to be reimbursed on a pro-rata basis, surely that is what travel insurance is for, and what travel insurance companies sell to the travelling public.

After reading the experiences of others with travel insurance, we realise that we are not the first to be treated in this fashion by a travel insurance company. Therefore, we believe that we need a Royal Commission into the Travel Insurance industry in Australia. We will be lobbying our local Federal MP to present a private members bill to Parliament.

We had saved our money for this $13,000 holiday for eighteen months and were looking forward to it immensely. Because of an accidental injury we had to cancel and return home. We believed we were covered by travel insurance and because of this we feel betrayed by both CHOICE and by InsureandGo.

title: Still awaiting result of cancellation claim

title: Paid out in full, with a smile. Highly reccommended.
body:
Our last trip was to be something very special. Our elderly next door neighbours (70-70) had never been out of Australia and we organised a Cruise with us to show them the South Pacific. It was great to see them prepare over several months, buying clothes, shoes etc. all for THE trip. Every time they mentioned the cruise their faces lit up.
When we first booked the cruise we discussed travel insurance as a must do, we had used covermore on a couple of occasions before and were very happy with the service and advice given by their team over the phone. We purchased the cover we felt we would need,  bearing in mind age and health of our traveling companions. The gent had to fill in an online health questionaire which was very easy. Because of a couple of previous conditions their policy was a little more than ours  but that was to be expected.
Around a week before departure our friend got Diagnosed with Terminal Cancer, bugger, that put a spanner in the works as his doctor advised him NOT to travel and also his wife should stay near. Needless to say it came as a total shock to us all and it was very sad to see this last opportunity slipping away. Our friends asked us to handle  all of the cancellations of flights, accommodation etc. Covermore asked for an email from them advising them of their wishes, after that was done,  we did all the follow ups. I cannot stress how easy covermore were to deal with and how very understanding they were to this setback. After furnishing doctors reports and filling in and submitting  the claim forms, covermore deposited the money into their account with in 48hrs of the claim being accepted. What great service! Every thing went smoothly and the guys & girls were very concerned with our friends health. 
A big thankyou to covermore for their understanding a quick settlement, we would have NO problem strongly recommending this firm for all your travel insurance needs.
Service was great, I never expected the claim to be handled so quickly and seamlessly.

I was told when I bought the policy to add a certain dollar amount to cover costs already outlayed in case of cancellation. This of course increased my premium.  I was also told that cancellation was covered for any reason.  I unfortunately had to cancel our trip due to circumstances outside our control and covermore informed me too bad we're not paying you. title: Travel Insurance claim being frustrated by Budget's unreasonable requests for excessive, irrelevant
body:
I recently had to cancel a cruise following emergency surgery to re-attach the retina in my right eye. On the advice of the Consultant Professor who performed my surgery I was to remain at home close to the hospital in the care of my wife for post-operative monitoring (sound advice because complications did arise).

I completed and lodged a claim in the form approved by Budget, including a certificate by my GP verifying that my retinal detachment was spontaneous, ie ' things that are natural or instinctive, and which happen without warning'.

The first communication I received from Budget requested on ?behalf of our medical department? copies of notes relating to every GP consultation I had during the 2 years prior to my retinal detachment, without any attempt to explain the logic grounding this request or how it could possibly be reasonable.

In response to my queries, I received a further email stating that Budget was trying to eliminate certain specific general exclusions , that is, pre-existing conditions. I received no comment in relation to my request for information about the qualifications of the person in the medical department who is unfamiliar with the occurance of spontaneous retinal detachment.

Even though they said that certain specific information was required, Budget still insisted that I produce a full 2 years worth of GP consultation notes, which are of no relevance.

I have asked my current GP to prepare a response to Budget addressing the specific criteria that has been put forward.

I have cancelled all of my other insurance policies with Budget Direct. All of this for a claim of about $3,500.

title: Slow to respond to medical assessment, READ general exclusions before buying
body:
Second time to use insurance for travel with this company, first time to request medical assistance. Took more than 6 hours to reply to initial phone call for help regarding medical assistance. Asked to provide medical reports from hospital and photos. It was distressing by 48 hours to still be waiting to have the medical assessment made for our daughters, only to be told on day 3 that care was sufficient and no evacuation necessary from the Cook Islands. First and second degree burns were sustained by my daughters on their legs - very serious, needed re-dressing at the hospital each day, x-ray (concern of ankle fracture), injections and antibiotics.
Injuries were sustained whilst quad biking. We were told one week after arriving home "While there is a provision in policy for medical expenses for sudden injuries, there is an exclusion within the policy for quad biking." 
It seems when I purchased the cover online, choosing comprehensive insurance, I had not read the PDS statement carefully enough under 'general exclusions'. It's very easy to choose travel insurance online without reading the PDS fully - please don't make the same mistake. As it turns out medical care in the Cook Islands was not expensive and we also stopped in NZ for a night on the way home (pre-booked) and went to Auckland hospital for a further assessment (NZ/AUS governments have a reciprocal agreement for medical care - no charge there and very good hospital system). If this had happened in USA the expenses would have been immense. Make sure all your recreational activities are covered and not excluded in the PDS before you purchase.

Submitted a claim with a screenshot of VideoPro's price, showing the TV and the lower price.  Also provided a direct link to VideoPro's website for the claims officer easy access.

All good, I thought, given that VideoPro is another "bricks & mortar" store and not an online only store - this shouldn't have any issue.  WRONG - I was asked to provide a printed catalogue from VideoPro showing the same TV and lower price.  I would have thought Covermore would evolve with time - who uses catalogue these days still?????  Beside, I found the lower price via google and not via a printed catalogue...

All the claims officer had to do was click on the link I provided...?.. how difficult would that be... rather than asking me for a printed catalogue...

Hopeless.

Update: after escalating to the senior claim officer, claim has been approved.

title: 5 out of 5 I can't fault them on anything
body:
Having recently being repatriated from Cambodia with 2 broken ankles  by 1Cover, I would rate them excellent.

My injury was as a result of a motorcyle accident in a village 400+ Kim's from Phnom Penh, we visited the local hospital but they had no doctor, they only offered some Panadol.

The hospital recommended I return to PP for treatment. My  guide arranged for me to get back to PP by hire car (long trip) which took me to the Royal Rattanak Hospital for treatment. 

I contacted 1Cover to notify of my incident, they immediately assigned a case no and checked if I met the criteria for cover ie license, correct policy etc. 

Once approved, they notified the hospital they will cover cost and arranged for Business Class flight from PP to Sydney.

They provided  a Registered Nurse manage my case who contacted me every day to see if all was ok, she also ensured I was being attended to properly by the hospital.  

The return flight to Australia  was seamless, I was provided a wheelchair and assistant when required, this included to my friends car at Sydney Airport. 

My total cost for treatment and repatriation will total approx $10k, and be aware, hospitals outside of Australia won't treat you if you can't guarantee payment, they are a business not a charity. 

I strongly advise people to read any Travel Insurance Policy you take out, and be aware of "what is what's not covered" I made sure motorcycles were covered, some don't cover motorcycles. 

What surprised me in hospital was how many tourists to locals are admitted, the doctor said it ranges from dysentery to dengue fever to one German lady who fell 10 metres off a cliff, she was being airlifted back to Germany big $$$$$$$ for this one. Motorcycles are a very common injury type. 

To sum up, 1cover gets 5 out of 5 from me, if you think Travel Insurance is not important, wait till you are in accident emergency  in pain or with life threatening injuries being asked to guarantee payment before treatment.
Once approved they arranged and managed everything. They are very well priced and offer excellent coverage if you need them.

I read some of the reviews on this site while I was waiting to hear about my claim, so thought I should share my own experience.

When I booked my trip, I fortunately 'activated' my insurance through the Commonwealth Bank (Diamond cover) which provided a higher level of benefits including unlimited cover for cancellation fees and lost deposits. I lodged my claim online with Allianz in the first week of January 2016. A couple of weeks later I received a written request from Allianz for one further document to support my claim. A couple of weeks after that I received a call from Allianz setting out their response to my claim - paying everything I had claimed (about $3800) less the $250 excess. This was paid into my back account less than a week after this notification.  

All in all the experience was a very positive one (especially as the insurance was complimentary).

I then called the team to receive further clarity on the matter, I was passed around to three different people (cold transferred) each time so I had to re-explain my query  to then be advised that I would be able to lodge a claim. 

Once the claim was lodged, I received an email advising my claim was approved and money would be deposited into my account. I wanted help with the recovery of my lost item not the money to be transferred into my account. The reason you purchase insurance is so that you don't have to deal with any Third Parties when lodging a claim, on top of that I was then advised that they would not provide help with this . 

The online quote system is not clear as to the limits that apply and I still have not heard back from anyone in regards to my concerns/experience.
