title: Covermore has been my choice of cover for more than 15 years
body:
I never leave home without my travel insurance, as far as I am concerned if you can't afford insurance you can't afford to travel!  
Covermore has always been competitive with others in the market  however what brings me back time and time again to Covermore is the fact that claims are dealt with fast and their staff are efficient and compassionate.
I have had to use my insurance on more than one occassion.  Once I was diagnosed with Breast Cancer, I needed to be operated on within the week and when I couldn?t be repatriated in that time frame Covermore arranged and paid for an operation overseas and then assisting me to return to Australia.  The cost of that operation was in excess of $10,000, money I didn?t have as a backpacker.  Cancer is devastating news but it would have been made even worse if I would have had to have sold my house to cover my overseas operation.
Covermore was also the only insurance company who would cover me for my cancer when I went travelling again for a year after my treatment.  All others wouldn?t even look at covering cancer but Covermore, with an extra premium, did.
I was also mugged in Kenya on another trip and lost everything.  Covermore covered all the losses I incurred and helped me deal with the aftermath of organising passports, money etc.
My last trip was another year long trip and I got sick in the USA.  I phoned Covermore and asked for advice on where I should seek treatment in the US and I was directed appropriately.  The joint bills for this illness totalled over $2,000 dollars and Covermore settled these accounts before I arrived home.  
I have claimed several times on my insurance with Covermore so I do see myself as a bit of a risk for an insurance company, but Covermore have never penalised me for past claims and never rejected a claim.  I would highly recommend Covermore and will continue to use them in the future.  In fact I am off on another holiday in a few days with my Mother and Covermore are covering us both on this trip.  
Keep up the good work guys!

title: BEWARE Delay Tactics to avoid claims
body:
I contacted Insure and Go  about lodging a claim for a trip to Europe departing 21 June 2020.   The Insure and Go representative checked my details and knew my departure date was 21 June 2020 and said I should lodge a claim. I lodged on  26 March 2020.

I finally received an email on 5 May 2020 as follows:

"There is a current travel ban from the Australian Government, with the declaration made under s 475 of the Biosecurity Act 2015 (Cth) which declares that a human biosecurity emergency exists. Section 7 of the Declaration provides the instrument is in force for 3 months from the date of registration of the instrument (18 March 2020), meaning it will end on the 17th of June 2020. However, this period may be extended.

Therefore if you are considering to cancel your travel arrangements, we are advising that you do not do so at this point, as there is no provision under your policy to claim for any possible cancellation after 17th of June 2020. In the event the travel ban is extended you can contact us again and we will lodge your claim. However, as stated previously, we strongly recommend DO NOT CANCEL ANY OF YOUR TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS at this point."

I was shocked it took them so long to finally respond after being told mid March to lodge my claim and that now I need to start all over again on 18 June 2020. There is no way that the Australian Government is going to allow me to leave the country and fly to Paris on 21 June 2020 and the French government is wanting all arrivals to quarantine for 14 days.  I am only in Paris for 3 days. I am not flying half way across the world to quarantine for 14 days.

Further, if I was to leave the country when the Government does not allow, you have no insurance coverage anyway. 

I cannot find anywhere that the Level 4 Travel restrictions are to last only 3 months.  It is widely thought that international travel may not even be resumed in 2020.

I cannot believe how ridiculous this email is and Insure and Go are just using delay tactics.

title: Budget Direct Came Through In the End
body:
This is an update to my original one star review below.
After sending my appeal to the Budget Direct IDR panel, Budget Direct made good on my original claim that they initially denied.  I would have given them 5 stars if I did not have to go through this the first time. But  I'm glad they have been responsive to my complaint.

Here is Budget Direct response to my appeal...
"As you are aware, your claim was escalated to the Stage 1 IDR Panel for consideration. Following the Panel?s review of your claim they are pleased to advise that your claims decision has been overturned and we will attend to payment within the next 10 business days less applicable excess and any payments we have already made."

Here is my original review...
In January on a trip to Japan on the final day of our trip on the flight home, my wife took ill and ended up spending 4 days in a hospital in Tokyo. (I thought we were covered with our travel insurance with Budget Direct. I was wrong.)

Our policy went from January 15 - January 24th. So we boarded the plane on January 23rd. But had to exit the airplane before take-off as my wife got very I?ll while still on the tarmac. That night we went straight to a hotel as it was very late. The following day, January 24th, my wife was admitted to the hospital for four more days (3 nights). 

Yes we went beyond our policy, but the incident happened within our policy. And it was this incident that extended our trip. This is exactly the reason we have travel insurance.  Maybe I should have called Budget Direct to extend my policy. But I did not know this, plus at the time I was worried about my wife, attempting to get her admitted to a hospital, dealing with my kids and the possibility of having the Corona Virus. Turns out she had influenza A and pneumonia.

I submit my claim and approximately 40 days later I get a check for the hotel room and a bit of travel totaling $235, less than 10% of what we expected. Budget Direct didn't pay a penny of the hospitalization cost. 

Budget Direct has a way to dispute a claim result and I sent my case to the IDR Committee, but never even received a response.  Needless to say I am not satisfied with this policy.

body:
I took out this travel insurance in good faith, as I have Allianz insurance for my motor vehicles, my home and contents, and their rates seemed competitive. Their sales pitch was reassuring, leading one into a false sense of security!
I have had this travel insurance before but never needed to claim in the past. However, on this occasion when it came to making a claim, I found my claim was rejected due to a small exclusion clause on page 60 of their terms and conditions, which I believe is unreasonable and not in good faith.
I am not silly enough to think that insurance companies are there to help the customer, their primary purpose is to make big profits for shareholders and executives by finding exclusions so they can continue denying claims!
The rejection prompted me to closely examine the eighty pages of their terms and conditions. I have come to the conclusion that Allianz Travel Insurance is there purely for providing a source of income for the company. There are so many exclusions and conditions that I have determined it is a waste of money to purchase travel insurance from Allianz.
I would strongly recommend anyone considering Allianz Travel Insurance to carefully examine the policy including exclusions, before they decide to buy! Following this experience, I will need to reconsider my other insurance policies with Allianz.

body:
My room key was stolen from the beach. It was then reported to police, and the hotel, who could not change our room locks. The next day, the thief used the key to enter our room, and broke into our safe. Final verdict from TID: "You just didn't take enough care, and you should not have left your belongings in the hotel room." - they were in a safe! My luggage was broken open with a knife. So does that mean I should not leave my luggage in my room? My mistake, I thought that was what a room was for. 

We took every precaution to make sure that our things were not stolen, because at the time, we had a feeling this sort of thing could happen. And at the time our things were stolen, we were so distraught but we thought "Thank God we have travel insurance." 

God bless the Financial Ombudsman Service. I would recommend the Ombudsman to anyone who has been messed around by this company, and if your claim is approved, TID has to pay a tidy fine. Ironic, being that the fine will cost more than paying out my claim. 

Oh and as if the insult of having a legitimate claim rejected wasn't bad enough, their response times are a joke. I sent four emails, and asked for someone to call me back several times. Be prepared to get left in the dark. This is the third time I have used TID for my holiday insurance, and obviously, they are fine until you have to actually make a claim.

title: Never ever take out a group policy... or better still, never use 1cover!
body:
Well, very clever one cover... You certainly know how to trick people with your deceitful wordplay. My Fiance and I were on a trip in Europe recently, we had a pretty stressful time for most of it. It came to one of the last few days on the trip when we had locked our possessions in the back of our hire car out of site of any intrusions... Nonetheless our car was broken into and all of our things were stolen out of the back. Apparently these desperate criminals in Rome coordinate complex theft systems and target Hire cars or International cars (Ours was French) and break in anyway regardless of whether there is anything in them! After getting back to the car and observing the damage... in a minor state of panic, I called one cover for assistance. They originally said over the phone we would be covered for $5000 each for our possessions once we send in a police report and an itemised list of the stolen items. After re-reading the policy wording I noticed that the claim would be reduced to $2000 in the event of our things being stolen in broad daylight from the back of a locked car. I thought, ok fair enough, some onus on the policy holder applies in this situation. When we received the claim back, I noticed they only paid out $2000 in total for our possessions... not per person. When I called and asked about it, it was because we had taken out a group policy. had we had taken out individual policies, which appear to cost about the same, it would have been $2000 per claim. How can you punish people for taking out a group policy? I also ask, why is there nowhere on any of your policy information notifying policy holders that taking out a group policy significantly reduces your cover and that you wont have the same rights as an individual? Hopefully the FSO will be more favourable to our claim than the tricky wordsmiths at one cover and rectify this misleading unconscionable behaviour!

Misleading policy wording, no notified differentiation between group policy and singles policies, deceitful conduct

body: My wife and I used the above insurance recommended by flight centre. I had some issues with my health but none was a deterrent factor of my trip. Despite a letter from Consultant surgeon stating my previous health issues had no bearing on cancellation of my trip, Covermore stated that I had pre-existing condition, yet my surgeon specifically indicated they were not affecting my holiday plan. Covermore selectively chose those clinical notes that fitted their purpose and even when i asked for review by sending the notes again, they came up with the same outcome. Throughout their investigations their delayed it many times and could not meet their own timelines. they continuously asked for info they had been provided. I am now referring the issue to a relevant ombudsman and will never work with insurance. My advice to anyone travelling is not to waste your money insuring with Covermore, just convert your credit card to a CC that provides complimentary insurance, saving yourselves several hundred dollars and when a genuine situation comes up, you do not regret it, at least you did not pay for it. Not only was that not any reasonable time, but there is no way I could see my specialist as they are booked out 3 months ahead. 
This was my first time leaving Australia, and I had to do everything I could to make sure nothing happened to me regarding my diabetes, and one of the nights in Bali, I almost had an emergency, however because I wasn't covered for the condition, I had to frantically treat myself as best as I could.

title: Disappointed at the system
body:
Hi there, BE AWARE - INSURANCE/ TID - PLEASE SHARE to everyone you know who goes on holidays: Our family had a policy with TID unfortunately my father passed away unexpectedly 2 DAYS into our holiday. As I (his daughter) was legal carer, lived with my family for 6 YEARS and I was executor we returned home a day later. My son and daughter returned home a few days later. I rang TID to tell them dad had passed away and I would be lodging paperwork - WELL this is where I suggest NO ONE EVER BUYS WITH TID - I provided all receipts of original return flights plus accommodation we did not use - AFTER 2 months of TID wanting a DEATH certificate, than certified copy of DEATH certificate, than wanting a DRS report - which I must say - dads doctor of over 10 years said he was NOT suffering any condition apart from his PTSD (Vietnam Vet) which he had same medication for past 20 years - he did not have any illness or condition, was in good health. 

TID than requested a Coroners report - which I sent in as soon as I received..after waiting another week was told they are looking at it, requested ANOTHER Drs letter stating what medication dad was on (fair enough).. RANG by TID to be told that my case being DENIED because under SECTION 21B it clearly states: NO alcohol or drugs - I said dad has had the same medications and they are PRESCRIBED and I was told - no the ALCOHOL was the problem because he needs to have NO Alcohol in his system - ZERO !!!!!! SO basically saying that IF ANYONE IN YOUR IMMEDIATE FAMILY HAS A DRINK or is INTOXICATED AND THAN DIES YOU ARE NOT COVERED,,, THAN to be told that we are NOT refunding your flights home AS YOU WOULD HAVE TO COME HOME ANYWAY !!! (Exact words)...Well this is a warning that TID can HIDE behind this 21B is BLOODY ridiculous. DAD was at my brothers home at Christmas enjoyed a couple of beers took his normal medication and had a heart attack and died - well he DID die and I was not in the country - this is my fault that dad had a beer - what a load of crap...

I AM SO DISGUSTED that our family were knocked back because the real deal is: I was in another country, dad went to my brothers home, had a couple beers, took his medication and than had a heart attack and died...PLEASE READ and than READ again any INSURANCE POLICY and what THEY DONT COVER as I am sure ALL of you think this is really DISGUSTING of TID... I cannot say how UNHELPFUL and how much extra STRESS they have caused this family at a time that no matter what will never bring my father back...TID NEVER GO WITH THEM....Just think if you or your family member have a couple of BEERS than you will NOT BE COVERED..(HOW ARE YOU EVER SUPPOSE TO MONITOR THIS)....IF 20 of you DO NOT BUY A POLICY the money may not come to me but they LOSE... PLEASE PLEASE SHARE this and send the message that this is NOT MORALLY FAIR or GOOD ENOUGH...

title: Excelent Value
body:
I have used InsureandGo twice, it is very easy to set up the first time I looked at a quote online leaving my telephone number and someone phoned me the next day and said that I didn't need the gold plan as the silver would cover me for where my wife and I were going so I took it. It was for a three cruise holiday almost 7 weeks Mediterranean, London to New York and the Bahamas and was the best value of all the company's I looked at. 
I did fall ill with heart problems....which I had no idea would happen....and was in the ships sick bay before being transfer d to a New York hospital where I stayed over night before getting medicine and continuing on my trip round the Bahamas. Had a heart OP when I got home. 
When I was leaving the hospital admin came to my room and said that they don't deal with my insurance company...I stress this was the American side of insureandGo.....and could I afford to pay, I said no that was why I had Insurance, lucky the hospital had some sort of deal with the government and I didn't have to pay but it would be a worry if I was going to the States again.
On my return InsureandGo payed my claim out in full for the stay in the ships medical  hospital which was over $14000.  they did require my medical records etc; and it took about 3 months before I received the money.
I used InsurandGo for my next holiday and it was so easy over the net, still good value and not more expensive because I had put a claim in I was glad to see, except a bit extra for heart problems but that was with every company... I didn't have to claim this time.
Very happy with them.

title: Is insurance really worth it?
body:
I purchased an annual multi trip policy because I was travelling backwards and forwards to Chicago from Australia as a student. I was caught up (accidentally) in a car jacking while walking along a street in inner Chicago. This was a traumatic experience and left me with Post Traumatic Stress Disorder. 

I travelled back to Australia after the event and received good support once home.  Still suffering PTSD and due to return to Chicago in January, I was advised by my doctor not to travel until I was better, so I cancelled my airfare ($2163).  As I did not previously have this condition (when I purchased my Policy) and had medical advice not to travel, I figured I'd be able to claim for the Cancellation.  

Wrong!  Unfortunately, I realise now after being quoted numerous escape clauses by Covermore in my claim rejection letter, that I was not covered for Medical Cancellation because it is considered a stress related illness and it was My "disinclination" to travel. 

Having a gun pointed at you and running for your life and then suffering because of this incident is just not a good enough reason to cancel travel plans according to Covermore.  Better to have been shot or worse I suppose?  At least then there is visible evidence of trauma to warrant cover.

Very disappointed there is no humanity in this industry.  I will not buy insurance in the future - it is a costly exercise and just doesn't pay.  Too many "exclusions" to warrant the cost.
While formulating my policy I received good service. Claim processed quickly.
Claim rejected after being diagnosed with a medical condition and advised not to travel.  No refund if I cancel my policy which is now superfluous.

The Insurance Australia Group "will refund travel insurance premiums for holidays that have been cancelled or cut short" as a result of the corona-virus pandemic (includes NRMA, CGU and SGIO).  Other big insurers, including Suncorp, QBE and Allianz, are working on support measures for customers as well, and customers who have not gone on their trip "will get a full refunds of premiums". We are pensioners up against a Lloyds-backed company, who are profiteering from this health crisis - one example of a company seemingly feeding off the world's misery.

We have 2 great kids and their cousins live in Thailand so after saving for a few years we finally took them there.  It was of utmost importance to us that we had travel insurance particularly as the kids are small. Our little one aged 5, [name removed] is affectionately know as "monkey man" his favorite sleeping toy is a monkey who by the way he bought to Thailand with us.  We visited Monkey Island and he was bitten twice,( not really the monkeys fault we feed them ), once on the leg and the arm breaking the skin and scaring him.  We jumped back in the boat and anxiously made our way back to our hotel over an hour away.  The moment we got back to the hotel we were relieved to remember we had taken insurance and it allowed us the piece of mind to engage a Doctor to come to the hotel with a nurse as well to administer the beginning of a long needle process 7 in total to avoid rabies.   Every day the nurse returned to re dress his wounds and to make sure he was in good health - I cannot begin to tell you the sheer delight we all felt knowing we were insured for this and could access this service because of the wise decision to engage Cover-More for our  travel insurance.  When we returned straight away we put a claim in with all of the appropriate documentation that was requested of us and within a week we heard back and the money was deposited into our accounts - it could not have been any easier and an extremely non stressful process to go through for us.  We were never made to feel bad or questioned on our integrity at all, and do you think we would engage Cover More again - you can bet your Monkey's Uncle we would.

title: Read the PDS carefully - you are not covered for what you really think.
body: We have used Covermore for all of our trips over the past two decades however when I tried to make what I thought was a legitimate claim in September 2014 I was left very disappointed with what I was thought we were covered for and what we were actually covered for.  The policy stated that we would be covered for "any cancellation or amendment costs that were outside of our control", however when our flight was cancelled and we had to purchase alternative tickets with another airline at a cost of $1700 in order to reach of destination, we were turned down by Covermore when we submitted our claim.  After waiting two weeks for a response we were emailed back a letter that was a copy and paste of their PDS, and within this PDS it had a list of items that basically contradicted and nullified the high level items that we were led to believe were claimable, with us being told that Covermore was not responsible for "transport Provider caused cancellations, delays or rescheduling".  My recommendation is to read the PDS very carefully before you click on the "Purchase Now" button on the website as this tells is more factual and truthful than what the glossy advertising web page lures you in with.  Covermore seems very good at marketing their product with what you want to see but were also quite happy to refer to the PDS (as I am sure that they will be if they respond to this review) in your time of need.  Shop around - we know we will be in future as Covermore will not be getting our business again.

title: If only natural disaster coverage was handled better!
body:
I have used InsureandGo several times now (cruises and land only holidays) and find their policy purchase process easy with excellent policies on offer - there is a policy to cover every travel occasion.  Their online 'existing medical' condition survey is simple and far superior to those companies that require 'medical documents' to be sent via post for consideration.

InsureandGo rates are very reasonable and they offer seniors like myself a discounted rate.  Fortunately for me I haven't needed to make any claims to date.

I have recently purchased my next policy for a Bali holiday next year from them.

My only issue is their handling of the natural disaster add-on which comes too far into the process and might be missed if you are not concentrating.  Further, while they cover natural disasters for an additional premium, unlike other insurers, they DO NOT list current natural disaster 'events' on their home page.  To find out about any existing 'events' (e.g. Mt Agung) you have to begin a quote with InsureandGo before you know if an event will be covered or not.  It should be on their home page in your face!  Insurers such as Cover+More have links to current 'event' on their home page.  InsureandGo this should be a simple fix.

As for me, I took out my new policy when there were 'No current ongoing events'.

Finally, I have found their customer service most pleasing.

title: Do yourself a favour and do not take 1Cover Travel Insurance or  Allianz Travel Insurance
body:
We took 1Cover?s comprehensive travel insurance underwritten by Allianz Global Assistance (AGA) for our travel to India. On Jan 4, my wife fell and injured her tail bone and had a bump on her head. We were not in mobile coverage area, so I contacted 1Cover claims via email for assistance. Followed up with email on Jan 6. On Jan 7 I sent an email providing all the information in the claim form. I did not receive a response to any of my emails.
When we reached a city with mobile coverage on Jan 8, I rang the 24 hour emergency assistance line and was on hold for 25 minutes after which I hung up. This supposedly ?reverse charge? call ended up costing me in excess of $40 with no outcome. I rang my son in Sydney and requested him to get AGA to talk to us. My daughter-in-law  eventually managed to get claim number from AGA by the end of that day. My wife?s condition was deteriorating by then. We called a local doctor for medical help and he prescribed steroid tablets and pain killers. His diagnosis was that she had injured her coccyx due to the fall. 
On Jan 9 we rang AGA  and requested to either reschedule our flights as we had a stopover of about 14 hours in Singapore or upgrade my wife to business class for travel back home. I was asked to email medical report from the doctor who attended to her. Subsequently a nurse assessed my wife over the phone. After the nurse?s interview, we were  told that the case manager would contact us by the end of the day, which did not happen. We rang medical assistance again on Jan 10 for the status of our enquiry. We were told that AGA had determined that she was fit to travel and our request was verbally declined. Subsequently we talked  to the team leader whose only intention was to deny our request. 
Upon return to Australia,  X-ray and CT scan have revealed that my wife possibly has a sacral facture. We are consulting  a spinal neurosurgeon. 
AGA failed to provide emergency assistance for 5 days as per the policy and then by declining to reschedule the return flights or provide business class travel for her, exacerbated my wife?s condition.
I would not recommend 1Cover or Allianz to anyone going overseas. Their 24 hour emergency assistance phone number in Queensland is not geared to handle emergency calls.

title: It was a long process however it all worked out.
body:
After looking into multiple companies the ease, convenience and competitive price my partner and I decided to use TID. At the time we were already out of Australia and travelling through Mexico and travel insurance was an afterthought. 

I travel between 6-8 months of the year with work so took out the 12 month insurance plan which included the time we were on holiday.  The cost for a 12 month plan including the additional extra's for including my laptop, ipad and camera was extremely reasonable. 

Damaging my laptop whilst in Finland on work was a nightmare. I submitted a clam almost immediately and was afraid that due to it being water damage caused by a third party I may not have a leg to stand on. After going through all the processes required (which were all straight forward and easy to deal with) I was asked one final requests to finalise the claim. I was required to send the damaged laptop to the TID head office in Sydney Australia at my own expense. After much back and forth and being able to supply 2 x technical reports from Apple on the damage condition of the laptop they still insisted they needed the laptop in their possession. 
To send the laptop from the other side of the world was not cheap and also not an expense I could claim. Luckily for me I was heading to Australia for work in a couple of months so would travel with it and post it once back. The claims department regularly made contact to see where I was with sending them the damaged laptop and were happy to wait till I arrived back in Australia. 

After about 3 months from my first contact with TID claims, the damage the laptop was in their office and the following day I received an email that they would honour the claim and reimburse me for the damage.  

I did feel it was a big process to send the damaged item back to Sydney, especially at my expense and even if I was able to provide official technical reports. Regardless, they continued to stay in-contact and its nice to have a human that responds other than an automated robot response. 

90% of the time I think travel insurance is for piece of mind and often not needed. It was nice to know that I was able to lodge my claim and have a company stick with me until we saw the end of it. 

I will use TID again and will recommend friends and family to research to see if TID could work for them.
Good costumer service

Unfortunately it's been 3 months and nothing has happened. I have now sent it off to the ombudsman and they can deal with it. On top of this I am preparing a lawyer in Sydney to deal with them from now on. They basically left me stranded for 3 months, dragging me through 1000 hurdles and constantly asking for the same information over and over again. I supplied them with all the proof they need and yet they still won't pay. They will do anything not to pay out a claim, they will drag you to hell and back. Not only do they lie to you but they step outside the laws that govern these insurance companies. They ask for bank statement over 5 emails and each time listed a different reason as to why they need it. When I told them I am not comfortable providing my bank details but I have already sent them numerous receipts and everything is backed up. I gave them every piece of information they needed apart from this bank statement and then I was told we cannot process your claim without it. Yet they have all receipts!!!!!!  
On top of this it takes them so long to reply to an email, you Rarely get through to their staff. I spend over $300 aud on phone calls on Skype to wait on hold for 50 mins and then sure enough they wouldn't answer. It has been the worst experience yet. They told me they would send an investigator to go over my claim (4th time they have interviewed me) 
I had to wait 4 weeks to see him. They I finally did and it's now been another 4 weeks since that point and nothing has happened. I email them 6 times a day now and then they reply at 4:59 pm and say our processing time is 10 business days we will contact you if we need more information. 
I gave them flight details, receipts for everything, I had to give them details on where I stayed my whole trip, they harassed my friends constantly trying to get information from them but yet they had nothing to do with the incident. It's just all delay tactics in the hope I give up. Well I have handed it off now to the ombudsman....funny thing is once I sent them that information, thy replied straight away. title: Forget comprehensive
body:
I took out comprehensive travel insurance for a trip taking several months. I was really on the fence about going with a full insurance rather than just medical.
After having my passport, credit cards, wallet, cash stolen and missed, then had to take several flights after as a result of this. All that was paid out was the replacement cost of my passport.
This was as I assume because I couldn't produce one receipt for a flight which was taken from me at immigration along with my boarding pass.

A lot of the things that happen which you need insurance for while traveling is because you are not in countries that correct procedure is always followed, which is exactly why I insured myself, to protect from the unexpected.

I had a massive short fall in my payout with no explanation of why it was not paid. To the point that I would have been financially better off not insuring myself.

Personally I would get medical again (with another company) but never comprehensive. The amount of formalities and hoops required for you to jump through on a claim is almost as stressful as having your property stolen in the first place.

What a huge let down.

However, what disgruntled me as a customer was that it took Cover-more longer than the advised deadline to finally make the payment to me and this became a financial worry to me. I had to call Cover-more several times to follow-up my case before I finally received the cover. All in all, a great and through service and cover, but not without long wait periods.

title: No epidemic or pandemic cover. Refund received.
body:
1cover does not cover for epidemic or pandemic, regardless of when you purchased your insurance and the epidemic or pandemic was announced. This is not an an industry-wide standard, as Sophie from 1Cover misleading claims. It is only a few insurance companies that do this. Most will cover if you took out the policy before the announcement. My annual insurance is now worthless. My fault for not reading their exclusions. Never again 1Cover. You have lost my business into the future and I suspect the business of many many more people. 
From The guardian article.

Lisa Kable, communications manager for the Insurance Council of Australia, told Guardian Australia that after Dfat made its announcement on 23 January on the risk of travel regarding coronavirus, it became a ?known event? for insurers that is adjusted for coverage.

?If people are travelling and bought their travel insurance before it became a known event  the majority of travel insurance policies should cover people if they contract coronavirus overseas, or if their trips have to be moved around countries or places.

?If you bought it after, most travel insurers exclude pandemic, epidemic disease or infectious disease or a known event.?

title: Disappointing Do NOT Recommend
body:
It?s now July, while on a domestic holiday to Melbourne with my husband I had a fall, 28th March 2019. This resulted in a 3 week hospital admission. We were on the 2nd day of a 6 night holiday.
After making a claim followed by me requesting a review, regarding their decision ? then another, their process escapes any logic. I?m still waiting for their answer of the 2nd request to try to understand their decision. I was assured it would be addressed last week. I have sent emails and made phone calls and simply been ?put off? time and time again. Yet when I was in hospital for 3 weeks we were harassed daily for updates by email and phone calls.
We have paid a total excess of $400. Insure and Go decide what event category your claim fits under. Our excess was $100 per person, per event. 
For example, my Husbands claim of $124.90 apparently covered 2 events ? (1 event for $17.50 the other $107.40) incurring a $200 excess. 
Stay with me on this ?our claim was for $124.90 - deemed to encompass 2 events resulting in a $200 excess. 
It?s now cost us $324.90
So he?s in the red to Insure and Go by $75.10 this they recovered by deducting from my proportion of the claim ? really! 
Result we paid our receipted expenditure of $124.90 plus $75.10 

Our claim was for a total of $3023.08. Medical expenses were covered by Medicare.
We paid a premium of $145.89.
A deduction was made from our claim: by Insure and Go for their ?acknowledged? expenses was an excess of $400. The actual reimbursement we received (after 2 attempts) totalled $360.99. All receipts and documentation, as requested, was submitted supporting our claim.

Seriously who in their right mind would take out Travel Insurance with Insure and Go. They promote Easy claims ? they say they cover unexpected ? unbudgeted expenses. Sorry this is not our experience.
We are extremely disappointed and would definitely not recommend Insure and Go

July 19th 2019 Update: Failure to honour policy, unforgivable Bad Service

An understatement would be Disappointed, I do not Recommend
It?s now July 19, it?s been an additional 12 days since I last posted my previous review on Insure and Go.
[name removed] (Product Review/Insure and Go liaison) has been attempting to intervene on my behalf ? also she too has been given the run-around. If you read my previous review you will understand the sequence of events.
Insure and Go are hoping, by their rudeness, that I will give up and go away. They are correct!
However, fellow travellers I strongly recommend that so do you. Don?t waste your money on a Policy they have no intentions of honouring should you need it.
My initial review was Posted 7/7/19 regarding a claim resulting from a domestic holiday to Melbourne with my husband. I had a fall, 28th March 2019. This resulted in a 3 week hospital admission.

I bought travel insurance to ensure if things like that happened I would be covered and not be out of pocket. It appears not. title: Do not like paying out on claims!!

Even though we spent a couple of hours at the local police station with cctv proof of the theft, Aust Post denied the claim because my wife walked five paces from the luggage to give me a credit card on hotel checkin. The luggage was literally within sight of both of us, however because my wife turned to me to give me the credit card and the luggage was behind her for five seconds when it was picked up and taken by, clearly a professional thief, Aust Post said it was out of atrendance/control in a public place!! This is not acceptable in my view, had it been in a public place completely out of sight it would be understandable, but even with cctv evidence and a full police report which clearly showed both my wife and myself in view of our luggage the claim has been denied. We are frequent travellers and have never made a claim before, however this was the first and last time we will ever us Aust Post. Shameful!!,

title: Poor recent experience
body:
I have been using Covermore consistently for my overseas trips for the last few years - it is always my go-to for travel insurance. Good value, peace of mind, the option to customise your policy and also a free global SIM card thrown in (this is certainly a selling point for me, as it saves buying one elsewhere and the service is easy to use.)

However, my most recent experience was below their usual standard.

I purchased my policy a month in advance. As usual, I was taken to a confirmation screen which I screenshotted that provided me with my policy number and informed me that my policy documents would be emailed soon. A few days later I received the email to claim my free global SIM card, which I ordered. This usually arrives one week prior to your departure (always delivered promptly in the past with enough time to set-up the SIM.)

With a busy month leading up to my trip, I left it until the night before to print my policy documents - only then did I realise I had not received them via email. After logging into my account, I found 'zero active policies'. The screenshot of the confirmation screen was my only proof of purchase and the only record of my policy number. With an early flight out the next day, I found myself in-transit frantically calling the customer service line to confirm my policy existed and have my documents sent out to me. I was assured that these would be sent immediately after providing my postal address over the phone. These documents never arrived via email. I silently hoped that nothing went wrong during my trip.

As for the global SIM, I mentioned earlier that it's a selling point for me. My SIM from my trip earlier this year expired after 90 days of inactivity but no big deal, I ordered another one with my most recent policy. I departed first thing in the morning on Monday 23rd. I checked my mail in the week leading up to my trip - nothing. I decided I could do without. I returned home to find my global SIM had arrived, dated Friday 20th. I'm unsure how something mailed on a Friday is expected to reach me by my Monday AM departure.

I was told over the phone on Monday 23rd that my policy documents had not been emailed as there was no postal address on file I (re)provided it then. My global SIM card was mailed to me on Friday 20th.

Overall, this was more hassle than my usual experience with Covermore and more hassle than required for my trip. I'm thankful nothing went wrong, with only a mere screenshot as a record of my policy number (nothing in my account!) I went without the global SIM but would have preferred one. Three stars as they are usually on the ball - I'm not sure what went wrong this time around.

Originally i wasn't even going to bother however when the quote came back at $300 i was a bit shocked and decided to look into claiming it. Google search revealed several people on forums stating travel insurers wont pay on cracked screens sighting the reason "you cant prove it wasn't already cracked". Anyway i went ahead and got it repaired and later decided i would try my luck. I was very pleasantly surprised that 2 days later the claim was accepted and paid. 

Thanks so much to medibank i know there are a lot of people out there that do try rip the system so it is a balancing act but its fantastic when legitimate claims like mine are paid so i believe you are an insurer looking to do the right thing and i highly recommend medibank travel insurance to anyone considering them.

title: Horrendous service, will never recommend it.
body: Having fallen ill whilst overseas, and needing to immediately return home, I was initially relieved that I had travel insurance. After attempting to contact Covermore for emergency assistance, no further contact was made, even though the representative stated that they would be in contact every step of the way. The Covermore representative stated that they would contact the hospital that I was at, and take care of the initial expenses, none of which happened. Once home, a week later I was contacted, with Covermore asking if I was still overseas. After attempting to submit a claim online, and the website not accepting the supporting documentation on any browser or device, I called Covermore support, only to be told to fill out a hard copy and mail it to them. No technical assistance whatsoever. I later attempted to resubmit the documentation, which was confirmed and accepted. 10 days later I receive an email stating that I had "not provided a completed claim form for the expenses incurred". Naturally I contacted the assistance phone number to ascertain which part was not completed. After being put on hold three times and being on the call for over 20 minutes, the representative stated that the claim form I had spent close to an hour filling out was not there, but only supporting documentation. I was spoken to with a sarcastic and condescending tone, and told to print out a form and completely re-do the claim, then wait for it to be mailed in, and then wait an extra 10 business days to hear back from Covermore on the progress. Horrendous customer service, terrible and faulty online claim portal, and a complete waste of my time and money. I have spent almost 2 months attempting to be reimbursed for my trip, a process which should have taken less than a month. Will never use Covermore again.

But they refused this because it wasn't a actual credit card. It was a travel card, so a debit card. Don't be fooled! title: Very helpful
body:
My daughter and I travelled to Indonesia.  She became very unwell on a small isolated Island.  We spent several days in the very basic clinic there, then she was transferred to a large hospital in Lombok via boat and car ambulances.
I didn't have phone access on the island, so mostly used email, although Alianz spoke to me on the clinic phone several times also.
It was a very stressful time and they helped as much as they could.  They even had their Registered Nurse talk to me a few times to explain about my daughters condition.  
It was hard for me to get them all the paperwork they needed, and the Allianz team was as flexible as they could be.
I had to pay for some of the care myself as the clinic and ambulances wouldn't just accept Allianz's guarantee.  But when I returned home and put in the claim it was repaid quickly, as Allianz had agreed to pay it.
Allianz covered the full hospital stay.
They followed up a week or so later to check how my daughter was recovering.
The policy was extremely good value when you consider how much the medical care ended up costing Allianz.
I had never expected to use Travel Insurance, so was extremely grateful when I did need it.
Aidan was our Case Manager and he was terrific.

title: Given the Runaround 3 months and counting
body:
I thought the initial process to apply and make the claim was quite pleasant and straight forward. The process to have my invoices for medical expenses paid is another matter. Every time I have emailed and reattached the invoices, I have received a response saying the matter will be looked at and I will receive confirmation. So far five emails, same response and in the mean time I am being harrassed by the Hospital with invoices to pay because TID hasn't yet paid the invoices. It' now almost May and the medical appointment was initially made on the 18th January... It was a five minute consultation in the Emergency ward, mind you. I am in a Commonwealth country, not a Third world country where it would understandably be more complicated.
This is terrible service. The international number only lets me call during Australian Business hours and I feel like I have been dealing with an automated robot this whole time who has yet to even pass on my invoices to payments!

Just pay the invoices already!! I am waiting for a response to my last email to escalate my claim. If I am not satisfied, ACCC will be contacted.

Our claim has now been declined 3 times due to this "This item was lost in a public place" they define public place as Shops, airports, streets, hotel foyers and grounds, restaurants, beaches, private car parks and any place the public has access to..

So unless you loose your items in your own home your not covered, I told them i was going to bring this up with the ombudsman and they said go for it, we always win..

There loss insurance policy is clearly a scam and this product is not fit for purpose..... Do not buy it.

title: Staff failed to provide correct advice twice
body:
I have used Insure and Go for many years without having to make a claim. Unfortunately, this year I had to make a claim. My flight was delayed for over 12 hours due to a sick passenger and then a mechanical fault and as a result, I missed the hotel booking I had reserved and paid for at my destination. Leaving me $200 out of pocket.

To ensure I was following procedure and that my claim was valid, I read the terms and conditions carefully and called the service centre.  I spoke to a staff member who advised that my claim was valid and that I could submit it. Before submission, I made a second call (just in case) and was advised for a second time that my claim was valid.

I received a phone call a couple of weeks later from a staff member advising that because my flight was not delayed for more than 12 hours, my claim was denied. I asked them to read the claim again as it clearly showed that I had been delayed for over 12 hours.

I received a follow up email a few weeks later advising that my claim was denied, with no sufficient explanation.  Needless to say I was angry and appalled.I appealed the decision and this time, received another rejection letter, but this time with a clearer explanation.  

I am utterly confused as to why two sets of staff advised that my claim was valid when it was not. They have wasted my time and effort and caused unnecessary stress.

I will not be using Insure and Go again and I do not recommend contacting their staff for advice.

title: Insurance claim
body:
I booked my airline tickets to India for 21st December, by Malaysian Airline, through Spendless Travel & Tours P L,who have closed their shop and figured out that they have not paid the airlines only on the 20th of December 2016 and I had to rebook the tickets with Air Travel at a much higher price due to short notice and Christmas time. I have also lost the bookings I had arranged when reaching India and lost couple of days off my holidays as i had to rebook on the 23rd of December. Have approached the insurance company which is through Combank complimentary with Alliannz. They asked me over a period of 4 weeks lot of paper work which was submitted and at the end of which has been refused by the insurance company.The insurance company has asked me to to Tribunal which in opinion is not right as if i go the tribunal I will have spend money for the case and loose time and at the end of it I am not certain if i will get the money. I feel that the insurance company is making it hard so as to avoid the claim which is genuine.

In my opinion Combank is duping the customers by giving complimentary insurance to their customers when they cannot honour a genuine claim which has caused lot of stress and monetary loss for me. If i knew this is the case I would have purchased a more genuine insurance from some other company who would honour their deal and have a credit card from another bank not from Commbank. Both Commbank and Allianz have to liaise with each other to resolve the issue and put the customer through this grief. The costs that are claimed are only the direct costs in this case not even the indirect costs of losing holidays with delayed travel plans or cancelling of ongoing journey tickets, accommodation, etc.

title: Beware if you are looking for travel insurance coverage for a sporting event
body:
I googled "team sport travel insurance" for an upcoming trip overseas for my 13yo son to participate in a amateur soccer tournament, I wanted to get coverage for flight/hotel cancellation costs if he gets injured and is medically unable to compete. 

The info on the website looked promising. Under a heading "Team Sports Travel Insurance" it states the following;

What Do We Cover If You're Playing Team Sport?
- We cover team sports on all overseas travel insurance policies.

What Don't We Cover If You're Playing Team Sport?
- You're part of a competition or playing professionally (where there is a prize involved)

Will I Be Covered If I Miss My Team Sport Event?
- There is a provision to claim for Cancellation Fees and Lost Deposits of unused travel arrangements if you have to cancel your trip or your trip is shortened due to claimable events such as injury/illness, and the fees cannot be recouped from the provider. 

Perfect, but I thought I would call to double check, thankfully I did. When asked whether there is a trophy for the winner (yes there is) I was advised that no he wouldn't be covered "because there is a prize" i.e. - a trophy. On questioning this and running through the above from the their website I was advised "yes we have had this issue before". I am trying to think of travelling to a team sports event where there isn't a winner's prize of some sort.

I have no comment on how good their insurance is but I am giving them a 1 star, I think their website is completely misleading and misrepresents coverage they specifically advertise as being a speciality, I was told "will pass this feedback onto product management"

Cheers

title: Unscrupulous insurance company, avoid at all costs
body: Our insurance policy with Budget Direct probably saved us $30 over our usual choice of insurer, but this is a classic case of getting what you paid for. They are, without question, the most unreasonable and unscrupulous insurance company we've ever dealt with. After having to cut short an overseas trip due to illness, as a result of a call to Budget Direct for medical assistance not being responded to for four days, Budget Direct are, predictably, refusing to pay the relatively small amount of compensation for cancelled bookings and early return flights. Frustratingly, everybody we have spoken to from Allianz, who handled the eventual medical care overseas on Budget Direct's behalf, were appalled at the breakdown in communication protocols while we were overseas which led to us making the decision to return early. We were promised a thorough investigation of what went wrong, but despite this, once we returned Budget Direct are not willing to accept responsibility and meet their obligations. According to Budget Direct, they are not able to pay our claim to return early because we did not get medical advice to do so. What they fail to acknowledge is that we did not do so because they failed in their obligation to return our calls for assistance. By the time they eventually organised something, some four days later, we had already made the arrangements to return early. Their response has been consistent; we cannot pay because you did not meet our policy terms and conditions. Well, unsurprisingly, they didn't meet ours in terms of their responsibility to provide timely medical help. A shameful company to be avoided, unless you don't plan on making a claim.

title: Misleading insurer / Complete lack of common decency / Do not use
body:
This is a genuine warning to ALL Australians travelling to avoid using Cover-More at all costs, not a moan to receive anything more from Cover-more Travel Insurance.

I know you'll be weighing up the upfront cost difference but please heed my advice. Spending this up front could save you HUNDREDS of dollars in the long run. The three key messages to avoid any trouble are:

1) Avoid using Cover-More insurance.
2) Spend more upfront and ensure you have a travel insurance policy with a decent/reliable insurance company. (Cover-More is not one of those).
3) If you don't believe me have a quick look through their reviews. 383 of their reviews out of 1875 are rated "terrible". That's a whopping 21%. I'm kicking myself now.

With no further a-do; if you like being screwed by an insurance company, want to ensure your personal belongings are valued at the LOWEST possible rate (even below market value) and don't want to be treated like a human being, this is how:

1) Buy a travel insurance policy with Cover-More.

2) Go to Barcelona. Approximately 300 thefts occur daily in one of the world's worst cities for pickpocketing. But hey...you are covered by travel insurance. That's what you paid all that money for right?

3) Send an email to claim for your stolen phone which was brazenly taken from a zipped bag hanging over your shoulder.

4) Wait 14 days every time you want a response from someone at Cover-More. That's right. Not even 14 days to process the completed claim...but literally, 14 days to receive a "Hi", or "I'm sorry your phone was stolen, let's get onto sorting this.." or "We need XYZ document to complete your claim", etc. If I was a board member of this company (now amalgamated into the animal that is Zurich Insurance Group), I would be disgusted knowing my customers have to wait 14 days to receive boo from a representative. Imagine if you were more unfortunate and had your passport stolen? I found this "process" to have a complete lack of common decency. 

5) Wait over 2 whole months...that's right...over TWO months. Then you will subsequently receive an email from Cover-More saying your iPhone 6 64GB is worth $199. They calculate this by depreciating the asset by 'market industry' standards to represent fair value today. Therefore because of the iPhone's age, Cover-More has depreciated the value down from its original purchase price of $999 to today's value (drum roll please)...$199.00. Looking on Amazon right now a brand new phone costs approx. $600 and a second hand can be picked up (all depending on age/wear) from between $250 to $500. To rub salt in the wound I have to deduct $100 of excess. So effectively I receive $99 measly dollars to replace an iPhone 6 64GB. I understand the excess part (this is normal), but there are two important points to make here:

i) This insurance company expects all people to depreciate their assets on their mental balance sheets daily to create provisions for new assets such as phones, laptops, etc. Last time I checked this is nonsensical given the majority of people don't even understand the concept of depreciation and is deceptive in its very nature.
ii) If the market price for a second-hand phone is between $250 to $500 how on earth is this insurance policy genuinely insuring me against theft or loss? If I can't physically go into the market and buy a phone for $199.00 then how can you argue your depreciation is fair and represents true market valuation? This defies logic.

6) Decide what your options are...do you respond saying you disagree with the outcome of the claim and wait another 14 days for a response only to receive a response saying its "policy" and there is nothing you can do about it after already dealing with this for over TWO whole months?

Oprah Winfrey is quoted as saying, ?Real integrity is doing the right thing, knowing that nobody's going to know whether you did it or not.? Cover-More needs to do some soul searching, maybe even watch a few episodes of Oprah and regain its integrity.

Annual multi trip insurance, taken out after being recommended by NSW Seniors. They have used every possible excuse to deny a claim. Police report provided, they try & dodge every item, They do not pay out full item value on most items that they accept. I would not use them again & recommend that others go elsewhere for their travel insurance.

April 11th 2019 Update: OK until you make a claim.

upon  reading the cover it appears to be reasonable, however read the policy VERY carefully, as it is very specific about what they will pay out on. If your claim circumstances vary marginally from the very specific conditions referred to in the policy they will reject it. so if you want a policy that covers the multiple variations of a defined event, then do not take out a policy with I & G.
If you lodge a fair & reasonable claim be prepared for a very low % payout & be prepared to fight it all the way to the independent arbitrator The AFCA. Do not be put off by their claim review system & give up .

title: Terrible
body:
My wife and me were the victims of an express car kidnapping in Ecuador in Oct 2010. We were robbed of everything,including all our ATM/credit cards and their PINs, computer, camera, passport, IDs, luggage, wedding rings, watches etc 

It was a bit hard to not comply with a gun pointed at your head. 

They also mildly assulted my wife, then dumped us off in a deserted area. I was told by the police later that we were lucky because this gang generally beat the male victim senseless and raped the woman. Needless to say this was a very stressful experience, which also involved staying in said location for a long time waiting for a replacement passport.

Thats the background, and how did covermore react to my claim for their 'premium' cover ?.....

I informed them in October 2010, and I was concerned about sending original receipts from Sth America, so they said to leave it until we got home. The claim was filed on 12th Dec, 2010, 3 days after arrival. It is now April  2011, and I have still not recieved any money, or any clear indication of when I will be paid, for how much, or even if they intend to pay at all.

Instead I get endless, dodgy, time delaying tactics to stretch out my claim... I have supplied original receipts of EVERYTHING. So documentation is not the issue. They sent an assessor ( Covermores underwriter is McIntyre Insurance fyi ). Nobody rings me back, answers my emails. Usually the scenario is this.. I ring up to find out
what the status on my claim is, then after a 45 min wait in the phone queue, the operator says 'thats not normal, and out supervisor is looking into it right now, and we will ring you back when we find out anything'. Ive had this same response numerous times. Do they ever ring me back ? Never!  When the assessor saw me beginning or March 2011 he recorded my conversation like I was a criminal and insinuated that I was a liar
and tried to trip me up on technicalities on the translated wordings of the police report. ( It was translated from Spanish ). I even provided replacement receipts for my laptop and camera. I also informed Covermore numerous times that the re-purchases of my replacement gear was on a emergency credit card, and the interest on this is high, and could they help me by processing my claim quickly ? hah no chance, Cover-Less. 

I was told by the assessor that he would take a 'few' days to process my claim and send it in for 'approval' then I would be paid. That was a month ago. I have rung up numerous times since and get the same dodgy time stretching answer... but this time its tag team blaming. The assessor blames covermore for not doing their job. The covermore team blames the assessor for not doing his. So my claim as it stands now seems to be in limbo.

What a perfect dodgy strategy. I have told as many people as I know never to use cover-more. 
Pray you never have to make a claim with them.

I am now in contact with the Ombudsman as I think 5 months is a little extreme in paying for my losses, and I feel they have no intention of paying me whats due. 
The bad part is they now have all my original paperwork.
Nice pamplets at Flight Centres office makes them 'look' reputable
The type of dodgy insurance practice that affiliates insurers with used car salesmen

title: Fine prints - bad! Interpretation terrible!
body:
Insure and go. 
Be careful with them. Let's be honest no one is reading all fine prints. Exactly like me. Agree it is wrong.
Recently my flight has been cancelled. I decided to check if my insurance is ?working? or not. I wasn?t sure if I can claim my case so I just gave them a call. Lovely lady on the phone said that I can. SO I did. 
And now:
My claim has been rejected. (and I don?t have a problem with it because it was not ?standard? claim) however the reason is  strange to me. Because it wasn?t flight from or to Australia!!! 
Quote:  
We will pay up to the amount shown in the Table of benefits if during a trip, your final international departure from or returning to Australia by aircraft or sea vessel, is delayed due to poor weather conditions, a strike, industrial action or mechanical breakdown

And now we have 2 issues.
1.	It was flight on 1 (one) ticket to Australia from Europe! ? However for them because happened on first leg so it was not final destination Australia. 
Let?s clarify here: There is no direct flight between Australia and Europe. So what does it mean: for example if you flying from Australia to Europe via one of the big hub (Middle east, or Asia) you are insured for first leg from Australia only but not on the second leg. Or like in my case happened my first leg from Europe was cancelled so my claim was rejected!!!! However my FINAL destination was Australia!! INSUREANDGO ? wake up.
2.	Second issue is that me like many other Aussies travel to say Europe and then we are taking other planes to fly between the cities (say Rome and London) ? this flight is NOT insure!!
So after finding this issue I am not sure about other cases and I am not going to try. So before you insure yourself with INSURE AND GO make sure you have travel insurance ;)
Maybe in other cases they are good however with mine their interpretation of the fine prints was bad.

title: Appalling service
body:
We have used Cover-More several times and held them in high regard. The problem this time is the appalling management of the 'contact' system. Sent email... no replies. Decided to ring... waited 100-min and gave up. Tried leaving a message for a call back by phone twice. Both times they did ring back after an hour or two but when I could not answer they leave a message to ask me to call again. So the process started all over again. Tried chat and eventually got a helpful person. But had to sit at my computer of hours to get that answer. Started off I was 80th in line. And the 'expected time' indicator on the chat fluctuates wildly. Of course, the chat means you are sharing the one person with several other customers and you are lucky if you get half a dozen exchanges in every 15-min!

Does this company realise how much time they are costing their customers in time? It might be ok if you are retired but this is sheer arrogance to expect working people to make the time to simply contact their insurer.

So, without commenting on the insurance side of their business, I say the management of communications is terrible. They need a system whereby you can 'book a call at a certain time'. A little bit of thought and the company would save a lot of frustrated customers. Yes, I am sorry for their predicament at this time, but there is no excuse for weeks and weeks of such terrible inefficiency.

body:
I read a few reviews on here before purchasing and a lot mentioned the vague PDS and the 'wear & tear' part of the policy in relation to personal items.

When you buy your policy online there's an extra bit for specified items. I entered my MacBook Pro in here with a value of $2500.00, which put the policy cost up by $72.00. When you read the PDS it states the maximum they'll pay for specified items is either the figure stated on the Certificate of Insurance or the cost of the item, whichever is lower. BUT, this does not mean you will get this amount. 

Earlier in this section it states: We are entitled to choose between repairing or replacing the property or paying you its value in cash after allowing for wear, tear and depreciation. 

Although this 'wear & tear' statement seems like it's in relation to everything other than specified items, it's actually referring to everything on the policy. So even though I would have paid an extra $72 to specify my MacBook, they could deem that it's worth $50 and there's nothing I could do about it.

The PDS is misleading & not clear.

body:

"at such a distance from you that you are unable to prevent  them being taken"   (I could touch my bag from where i was sitting)

Allianz is the biggest criminal you will come across in your travelling!

title: Still waiting for settlement of Bali volcanic ash disruption claim!!!!
body: What a stressful process trying to get a claim settled!!  Our long awaited trip was disrupted by the Bali volcano eruption in July.  We submitted the claim which TID acknowledged receipt of on the 11th of September (TIDN001701). [Name removed] is our claims officer.  We have since been sent three separate requests for information on the 22nd, then the 1st of October and then the 26th of October, in between which we thought the claim was being settled.  The gaps for requests are totally unacceptable and the requests themselves have been ridiculous!! One asked if our airline had proof that the cancellation of the flight was due to volcanic ash when it was obviously plastered all over the news channels!!!!!  In frustration I called [Name removed] on the 13th of October and she assured me once I sent yet another proof of airline putting us up in a hotel, that the claim would now be processed asap.  THIS DID NOT HAPPEN and we have since received another request for information on the 26th of October.  Just to put this in perspective two of our travelling companions had their claims (identical to ours) processed by AIG with no questions asked and settled on the 22nd of September (the day TID first requested information from us!!!).  AIG settled the claim in full.

We had to ask our travel agent to resend the necessary documents to cover-more again as they told us they did not need to keep them.

Our claim is now on hold and we cannot claim reimbursement for anything, clothing, laptops, phones etc all because further investigation is required on one item, the one item we took out extra cover on.
Cover-more did not provide good customer service as we had to repeatedly ask the same questions to get an answer and wait 2-4 days for a response, more often than not the answers were vague and unclear.ÿ
We are still in South America, unfortunately our travels have been seriously impacted by the robbery and cover-more's actions. We are still waiting for an answer to questions we asked 4 days ago while being seriously out of pocket and upset.ÿWe find it frustrating to communicate with cover-more and feel they are simply trying to avoid payments.

Bad customer service, bad record keeping, difficult to communicate with and expensive

body: Glad we didnt need it but will use it again. Going on another trip next year and definitely will book with budget direct again. My friends will definitely book with budget direct again too.

title: Very satisfied.
body:
Have used 1Cover many times for travel insurance and will use them again. Unfortunately have made 2 claims & 1Cover was very good & prompt. Thankfully no claims this time.
I recommend 1Cover.

title: Easy to purchase and to make a claim
body:
These were one of the few insurers I found that would insure us as a group rather than insisting on different policies for different families.   Purchase process was quite straight forward.  
A few weeks before travelling one person in our group required urgent surgery and was not able to fly while recovering.  On return from our holiday we claimed for costs we couldn't get refunded from the vendors.  There was a little bit of back and forward requesting further medical information, but nothing too onerous.  Once they had all the information our claim was paid in about 10 days.  
I'd certainly look at InsureAndGo for group or family travel again.

title: Travel protection
body: Yes good value. used this company 2-3 times now. I had a phone damaged this time where it smashed but haven?t lodged a claim not sure if I can now?

title: Great value insurance - top cover at a great price.
body: I've had TID insurance for years and always found it easy to take out, extremely well priced and with great coverage.  I finally had to make a claim this year and their claims service is top notch.  I got everything back (minus my excess) and the process was quick and easy.  I highly recommend Travel Insurance Direct.

title: Allianz Travel Insurance Review
body: I always use Allianz Travel insurance when we travel.. it is easy to set up and quite good value. I will definitely be using it for our next trip in November.

title: My thoughts.
body: Have no problem with the cost of insuring, was simple to set up, and as far as a proper review I am unable to comment as I have had no need to make a claim and talk to any of your personnel.

title: Have to have insurance to travel
body:
The policy is good value. It is easy to set up. Didn't use Customer Support, so I have no idea how it is.
The company we use is dependent on which country we are going to.
The bad part is being hounded for the review. They should ask 1 time only, not every day until they get it.

title: Excellent
body:
During our trip, my son was hospitalized because of Noro Virus
for one week.
The experience was all covered and the payment was really quick.
I will not travel overseas without this product!
Very cheap but reliable.
Nothing in particular.

title: Terrible
body:
My luggage was stolen in Chile. After flying back to Australia, the airline paid a minor amount so I made a claim with InsuranceandGo.

After 5 months of emails and calls, InsuranceandGo paid around 10% of what I lost.

In my case, InsuranceandGo was a massive waste of time and money.

title: Customer service representative hung up on me when I was asking questions about the PDS
body: I have never used this travel insurance company nor would I recommend them due to their extraordinarily poor customer service. After ringing 1Cover and asking my first question about when the insurance policy should be taken out I then asked the customer service representative about the terms and conditions associated with cancellation as it is not clearly described in the PDS. The Customer Service Representative then asked for privileged private information that is protected by the Privacy Act. When I objected to the extraordinarily prying questions and stated that I was no longer interested in obtaining travel insurance from 1Cover the customer service representative hung up on me.  This is extraordinarily unprofessional and shows contempt for a potential customer who asked legitimate questions about the terms and conditions and was within their lawful rights to refuse to divulge privileged information that is protected by the Privacy Act.

title: Used them before but this time was a little disappointed.
body:
If you have a relative that is hospitalised or passes away and they are over 80 you are not covered to return.  We extended the cover a couple of times and even though I explained the problem we were experiencing, they never queried the age of our ailing relative. They should mention the age limit in the appropriate places in the PDS not just at the end.  Although I accept responsibility for not reading all the fine print I still felt conned!
Had good experience before hand.
Age limit for relatives getting ill/dying should be mentioned in all the appropriate sections.

title: Good Value
body:
We felt the Alliance Insurance was very good value after we had checked out several others. I had a pre-existing condition and Alliance was the very accomodating and reasonably priced.
It was easy to set up and had several emails to make sure everything was checked before we left on our trip.
We would definitely use Alliance again.

title: Rockies & Alaskan Tour 2016
body: The policy was easy to set up with the correct approach to existing medical conditions. The policy coverage was comprehensive , self explanatory and exactly covered our needs.The Allianz customer support service was very good which is why we are existing customers for house and car insurance coverage. We will use Allianz for future travels.

title: Not happy with claim
body: Had an expensive GHD hair straightener that a hotel staff member broke overseas, I found it on the bathroom tiles which is not where I left it. I could only claim $4 on it when a new one cost me $300 which I am very unhappy about and refuse to waste my time on $4

title: Worst insurance ever!
body:
After a trip to the hospital in the USA back in Feb I have been stung with a $10,000 medical bill as cover more will not cover the cost due to having alcohol in my system (who doesn't have a drink on holidays?) 
it has also taken them close to 3 months to process the claim to make a decision. 

A word of advice make sure you read the fine print over and over again !! 
After sending me another copy of the PDS when denying my claim I was SHOCKED to see how much is NOT covered by this company. 
Was a waste of time and money even getting travel insurance with cover more and I would NEVER recommend them. 

If your claim has been denied also consider legal advice, you'd be surprised at how dodgy they are with their policies.

title: Never made a claim
body: I cant give a worthy review as I have never made a claim and hope that it stays this way. I have used this company numerous times when traveling

title: Satisfaction
body:
Have had two instances to claim one due to earthquake in N.Z. one due to ill health could not fault this company very professional , can not stress enough the need for travel insurance.When I contacted Cover-More they could not have been more helpful as sometimes can be very hard dealing over the computor rather than face to face .
both inexpensive and professional.

title: Good cover at good rate
body:
Policy, compared to others was good value and easy to set up
A claim was lodged and dealt with professionally. I was concerned with the 7 day deadline to lodge my claim because of the difficulty in gathering information but this was sorted out and I am grateful for the assistance
I have used this company 3 times for annual cover

title: PLEAS REVIEW PREMIUMS FOR HEALTHY OLDER CUSTOMERS

Yes very to set up.

title: Referred to by friends not yet used it.
body: We have only just taken out our first policy with Insure and Go so think the policy is good value.  It was extremely easy to set up and we found the people we spoke to very professional and nice.

title: Very good customer service and prompt attention
body: I have not had to deal with many insurance claims but the few that I have were usually very stressful InsureandGo was so good to deal with. I had a death in the family and they were compassionate, prompt and easy to deal with. I travel regularly and will definitely use them again.

title: Difficult to rate
body: It's very difficult to judge a policy when I haven't had any cause to use it...... but it was easy to set up and at a reasonable cost. I guess I counted upon Budget Directs high profile when I chose your firm

title: Entrapment!
body: Good value if you spotted the drop down box for cancellation. The default for couples  is $5000 with a $200 excess. For $7 extra the cover is $25,000.  I was caught!! We should have cancelled our trip on medical grounds but would have been $7000 out of pocket so we went. Our trip was marred as my husband could not fully participate. PLEASE DELETE THE DROP DOWN BOX and give automatic full cover and charge the extra minimal cost.

title: great easy insurance
body: easy to take out a policy and no issues. very good value. quick to take out online. i would recommend TID to anyone considering taking out travel insurance. this is our 3rd time.

title: Excellent
body:
I've used TID everytime I've gone overseas and never had to claim until now. I got a throat infection when I was in San Francisco and needed to go to a doctor for antibiotics. I went to the doctor, called the emergency assistance to let them know and when I got back to Australia sent them in a claim form. It took them less than a week to get back to me and say that the claim had been approved I was just out of pocket for the excess, as you'd expect. Highly recommended.
easy, quick, reliable

title: devastated
body:
Have had my first claim with TID declined after they ferreted out a loophole in order to avoid covering my costs. I am appalled at the result and devastated to find I am so let down by a company that makes it so easy for clients to part with their premiums without any real hope of being covered in an event. It's a discrace.

title: Necessary Evil
