title: Click n Go
body: Easy to set up, adequate cover for non recurring medical conditions, this will be the third time I have used this insurer, so far I have had no need to make any claims so I cannot comment on the effectiveness of the insurer's claim processing.

title: Very poor effort from Travelcard
body:
My first time with this company.  Submitted a small claim for only $36 for medical costs and included invoice.  Got a reply by email that I need to include an invoice to prove the claim.  Called them up, they checked and said yes we found your invoice, we will call you back within 2 hours.  Days later, nothing.  I called again and the person said they couldn't tell me anything.  At this point I gave up ... how much stuffing around is justified for $36!?  A month later a refund was paid.  This was a simple and small claim that should have been straight forward to process ... do i feel confident if needing a larger claim ... No!
I usually insure with Teachers Health and have had zero problems.  Travelcard was recommended by Teachers Health as their preferred partner, so I will be lodging my disapproval there as well.

title: Easy to set up, extremely difficult to make claim for stolen items
body: Police apprehended the thief who stole the items who also made a confession and was subsequently jailed. Claiming for the stolen items was so difficult and had to be addressed by insureandgo internal disputes resolution department as per required procedures. The claim was paid out in part only after many emails. Insurers required original receipts or copies as proof of ownership and that the EDMI number for the mobile phone (which I had not heard of before) to be blocked and photos of items stolen were not accepted as proof either. The insurer also claimed an excess for each of which they termed different categories. I would not take out a policy with insureandgo again.

title: Excellent service and prompt payment of claims.

title: The Worst - Bad Experience Travelling = Bad Experience recuperating losses
body:
Let me tell you how exactly unhappy i am with the service.
 
?First of all, All of my luggage and possesions where taken out of our car boot inbetween destinations in a secure car park.
?When I called your company I was given no advise or help what so ever.
?I ended up finding my own way at my own expense $900 interstate in America to get a new passport that was stolen at the same time.
?I called your company again to see if they could help me out financially in anyway. They simply told me no and that it was all up to my own expense and I would be able to claim it back when I got home. Now that I am home i am being told that they COULD have helped when I was overseas obtain a new passport and help me get to embassy so I can get a new passport. On top of this looking into my policy now I can claim $250 worth of clothing and expenditure per day that my luggage is missing, unless it is missing over 72 hours and then this is not covered. I would have assumed if luggage is missing for more than 72 hours than MORE cover would have been available.
?I had a macbook stolen with the rest of my effects. I am now reading the fine print in the policy and it says that I am not able to claim a laptop if it is left unsupervised. This is fair enough but my macbook was stolen with my bags in a locked car boot, and a supervised car park. I find this a really poor interperatation of the word supervised. The only way then you would be reimbursed for this would be if it where mugged off your own person. All other ways of losing your laptop overseas will not be covered with this insurance claim. This is highly unfair as most of the reason insurance is purchased is for these big ticket items. But you dont say anything about this in the first place! 
?Most of all i am upset is the service I have received. When i returned home I made a list of everything that had been stolen and sent away. I was told my claim would be looked at within 10 days.
?2 weeks later I followed up with the list of things that I was claiming for with receipts, photos and any proof of purchased i had of my items I had stolen.
?I received another email saying It would now be another 10 days to get back to me.
?I phoned a customer service officer who said they would have done it by the end of the week.
?When i chased the customer service officer back at the end of the week, he told me that it would not be paid as there was no evidence of anything stolen. It took me 10 minutes to explain to him that I had sent it and at this point he finally found what I was talking about.
?He found this and said he would have an answer to me by the middle of the following week.
?Again i had to follow him up the following week and he said that my claim from having theft in San Diego would not be put through as i had no police report. I explained to him that I had never been to San Diego and there was a police report that I had already sent to him. 
?At this point it was over a month since i had the incident occured and I  had enough so I have been put on to two different customer service officers since.
?nearly 7 weeks later and I am yet to receive a phone call from anyone at the office and rarely an email let alone any money.
 
I have had approximately $7000 worth of possesions stolen including luggage, possesions, an imac, and extra money spent on flights, passports, accomodation and I am yet to see any worth of the $170 I spent on using your company for insurance. It makes me feel sick that I had such a terrible experience overseas and have been treated just as poorly as the people that are meant to be covering me. 
 
I have recomended to all of my friends never ever to use your company for insurance, i would suggest this to anyone else reading.
 
Fingers crossed i can get what i am intitled too soon and be done with your company and the whole ordeal for good.

title: Reasonable Prices.....
body: Great on all 3 accounts.....I am very impressed with the extra cover for Pets, as I leave my dog in a kennel, everytime we go away & knowing his fees are covered in unforeseen circumstances of us being late getting back because it was out of our control, is very reassuring...

title: Quick and easy application
body: Great value. Online application is quick and easy to do. I always use Allianz. Thankfully I have not had to make a claim. But it is better to be safe than sorry.

title: Don't want to pay
body: I bought a trip for my parents to Europe including a Covermore policy as the flights were not all ticketed together. The flight into Rome was delayed so they missed the connecting flight to Sicily. They then had to purchase new return flights Rome-Sicily-Rome. We immediately advised and were told that we could claim the ticket price back on insurance. After claiming upon return to Australia we have now been told that Covermore will not pay because the Transport Provider caused the delay. So through no fault of their own they have had to pay for four extra flights despite taking out insurance to cover that exact contingency. With the original flights, extra flights and insurance costs we are well out of pocket and the trip was ruined.

title: Unhelpful and poor service
body:
Refuse to refund our insurance when all international travel cancelled by government even though our travel date is 2 months ahead. So uncooperative and same letter sent to everyone!!
Sent email to Complaints department and was returned unknown!! Very shonky company.

title: They made me feel like a real person.
body:
I chose TID after trawling around the net. Their price was great and their policy looked comprehensive and honest. 

Before I left they sent me a helpful email suggesting things I might want to think about before leaving. It was actually practical, and was also friendly, so it left me feeling good about them. Then they followed up afterwards as well. 

I feel like I was an actual person to them, not just a source of revenue. I didn't need to make a claim, but I definitely plan to use them next time.

title: Perfect
body: I made a claim for a camera that was water damaged and it was settled easily and promptly.  I felt that the policy was good value and the customer support was excellent.

title: Quick and relatively easy.
body: Provided good peace of mind when booking far in advance. Inquired about a claim for doctor consultation & script but with the exchange rate, it did not exceed the excess amount, so no claim.

body: Claim was finalised in 2 business days! Easy process also I needed to ring their call centre and the person who answered my call was very helpfull.  Plus they were the cheapest when comparing with other insurance companies.

title: Highly recommended
body: Was recommended by a family member after having issues with another travel insurance company who would not claim costs of accommodation from a previous trip due to a delayed flight. While I did not need to make a claim, would recommend 1Cover - cheap, easy to do online & excellent communication.

title: Perfect! Affordable and easy to set up
body: I have used this travel insurance once, and only heard about it through family. But it has been good to use and easy to set up. I will be using again in future

body: Had our flight times changed by the airline causing us to miss our connecting flight. Had to rebook different flights at a higher costs. Had our claim with cover-more denied, despite having all receipts and emails from airline proving flight time changes as the airline couldn't give cover-more the exact reason as to why our flight was cancelled. Would not use again.

title: Great Travel Insurer
body: I have used this insurer for at least two trips and found them most economical. I'm using them also again next year.

body: Nice people to talk with, very patient with my English accent, hassle free claim, have been using this company for a while and never have had a problem, very satisfied with their service.

title: Never again
body:
After having my cancellation claim rejected i put in a review stating they could access my medical records 16 working days on they decided they would contact my doctor even though i was meant to have an answer within 15 working days now 6 weeks later i am still being given conflicting information and the run around i will not stop , legal advice today advised me i have a case im sure a current affair and the ombudsman and my local member of parliament will all be willing to listen to me unlike covermore

poor service , do not do what they say they will , deadlines mean nothing

body: Very happy with the insurance you provided will insure with you again and in the event of a claim we hope that you will honor our ongoing commitment to your insurance company

body: The 1Cover Travel Insurance was extremely good value - particularly when you factor in covering the car rental excess, which would have actually cost more than the total value of the cover. title: Great Travel Insurance
body: Very happy with the service and great value for money. Lodged my claim and was approved the very next day and then had the money in my account the next. Will definitely use again.

body: InsureandGo was good value compared with other companies, I did comparisons with three other insurers. I found it easy to apply on line very easy to set up. I didn?t need to claim so can?t comment.

body: While travelling in Spain I had a GI tract infection and an episode of syncope and attended an ER at a small regional hospital in western Spain. The claim was settled efficiently and promptly when the paperwork was submitted upon my return to Australia.

title: Exactly the right cover for me and my family
body:
We chose Covermore Travel Insurance due to the ease of reading the booklet, its sets out exactly what is covered.  On arrival in Bali I had itchy eyes that ended up swollen, the hotel called a doctor who diagnoed conjunctivities and gave me drops, my eyes came good within hours.  2 days before we left bali my 5 year old son was running near the pool and slipped (cant tell kids) another doctor was called, an anesthetic administered and then stitches to his head.  This would have cost us the same amount as another holiday if we didnt have cover.  When claiming Covermore were more than helpful and the claim was settled promptly.  We always travel with Covermore we wouldnt feel safe without it..
Ease of reading the booklet, ease of internet site, great claim process.

title: Claim for personal effect refused by public place explanation
body:

In a nutshell the loss was defined as leaving the item in a public place and public place has so many definitions that you will never succeed. Now I understand you need another person to steal something from you and so unless you claim something was stolen from your room or home you will have no chance of success. Not buying another policy from them.

title: Beware of credit card complimentary travel insurance.
body:
We have used this company with our ANZ travel insurance a number of times since they changed over from QBE. We go to Bali four times a year, we use our ANZ insurance, we notify them of my wife's Pre existing medical condition each time, they charge us a further $75 Aus for this and they accept the application each time. On the PDF it states to notify them if there are any changes, my wife got a cold which went to her chest, she got some antibiotics which cleared it up before our trip, I duly informed them, they said they couldn't change the policy, but they would issue another one and add it,they cancelled the existing policy, and then they refused her further cover. Now if we had already been in Bali, they would have cancelled, and we would have had no cover because of the extra condition.
I told them they could not cancel an already approved policy, as it was legally binding in Australia, it was taken out before the illness and accepted by them, which covered us from the time of issue and the end of the holiday. They told me the ANZ insurance was complimentary and only covered up to a point, but, if I paid another $435 they would cover us with a $500 excess. We had no choice, we paid and they issued a new policy number ALZPC50186284, Receipt number 906102194507. We went to Bali but we didn't feel confident with the company, we will not go with the ANZ travel insurance again. If you've got a bankcard which you pay extra for, so you can get the travel insurance, BEWARE this insurance company underwrites a number of different bankcard insurances.

title: History of pre medical conditions
body:
Received an email today from Cover-More Travel Insurance regarding my claim for hospital treatment whilst I was in USA three weeks ago. 
They informed me today via email that they are not going to pay for the six day hospital stay, operation on my left foot or pay any other out of pocket expenses that I have occurred. 
Not happy with the outcome, l rang the 1300728822number that was supplied at the end of the email .
After waiting on hold for 70 minutes I was able to speak to a chap. 
I stated that l was not happy with the outcome. 
His reply to me was ? that I was too inform them of my pre medical conditions ? 
Which I did (diabetic) but I didn?t realise or informed by the travel agent that was not enough, the Insurance company wanted to know much much more.
As stated in the email I received, they wanted to know what pre medical conditions I had three years ago including any surgery, podiatrist, foot specialist and who ever else I may have seen over that time. 
In their PDF they do not mention how far back they want you to go with the medical history. 
I traveled to USA with no medical conditions. Clean as a whistle. 
My wife and I walked around Las Vegas for two to three hours taking in the sights.
Next morning l awoke to find that l had a blister on the side of my foot which warranted me to go to hospital. 
With iv antibiotics pumped into me for five days and an operation to remove a small almond shaped bone just under the big toe. 
I was told that if I had any concerns about the rejected claim, I had to reply to the email I received and state that I was not informed of the history of my medical conditions had too got back so many years. 
So my advise to anyone travelling overseas and taking out travel insurance make sure you supply at least three years of medical history supplied by your doctor no matter how small or how large it may be and then supply this too the insurance company and THEY WILL charge you extra premiums for your past conditions. If they think that you are a insurance risk they could drop you like a hot potato. 
BE VERY CAREFUL WHEN CHOOSING TRAVEL INSURANCE because it all could turn to crap and leave you with a very large bill too pay at the end.
Graham McAleese 
claim # 1233486

HOWEVER, because we didn't leave the country on the date intended, the policy did not cover those delayed expenses. Are you serious?! We couldn't leave the country. There was no other way to get to where we wanted to go on the same day! We even considered flying to another city and driving down but wasn't an option for the same reason.

Never been so disappointed with a company before. We would never recommend Budget Direct/Allianz whoever it uses, based on this experience. Such a negative customer experience with this company, very unsatisfied. Didn't offer to help or provide a solution as a gesture of goodwill. Be careful if you're even considering them...

title: Poor Contact and Support in a Medical Emergency
body:
My wife sprained her ankle in Dubai. We believed it to be broken, and ended up in hospital. We did not have a mobile telephone.

1. There was no contact option other than telephone. We did not have access to a telephone, other than through the hotel, which as it turned out would have cost more than the medical treatment to telephone Australia. One cannot call reverse charges from Dubai. In the end I called the Australian Consulate for assistance - it called 1Cover. 1Cover called me at the hotel. The cost of three local calls to the consulate from the hotel room was $UE54 - about $20AU. When I spoke to the 1Cover rep in Australia she gave me an email address to use. Why cannot that email address be listed as one of the contact options? Alternatively, create a Skype account so we can call on Skype. I still do not know if 1Cover would cover the telephone call costs if I had called from the Hotel to 1Cover in Australia.

2. It was agreed with 1Cover we would go to a particular hospital. The rep said she would phone ahead and advise the hospital we were coming. We arrived at emergency department of the hospital and the hospital had not been advised. 

3. The hospital wanted a guarantee of payment. We passed on 1Cover details and the hospital contacted 1Cover. By the time we left and had paid the bill (which as it turned out was only $150AU because the ankle was not broken) the hospital still had not received a guarantee of payment from 1Cover. If the ankle had been broken and required surgery there could have been several thousand dollars in costs. After leaving the hotel to go to the hospital there was no contact or support from 1Cover - we were left dealing with a hospital in a country with a foreign language, foreign culture and customs, no idea of potential costs and no support from 1Cover.

While I understand our policy provides for the insured person to pay up to $2000 and reclaim, and 1Cover will pay directly amounts above $2000, the hospital was loathe to start treatment until it had a guarantee of payment, whatever the cost. Of course, until it commenced treatment and determined the extent of the injury, we had no idea of potential cost, so GOP was vital. As it was, we had no idea of what a simple X-Ray would cost in Dubai, for example.
Easy to arrange the cover on line.
1Cover too difficult to contact in an emergency. No contact or support from 1Cover in an emergency following initial contact.

title: Do It Now
body:
Was invited to travel with friends to Hong Kong and my family had a cruise organised some time after this. Rang to get a quote and the operator was more than helpful, advising to take cover out for both trips immediately, explained everything in easy terms and then sorted the best price option for me.Forgot all about it really and had a wonderful time in Hong Kong.

Months later we were off on our South Pacific cuise. Second last Island stop over and we were all swimming at Champagne Beach, Santo, a pristine perfect beach. This was after a fairly intense couple of island stop overs with much happening, we had even been snorkelling right out near the ship over the reef away from everyone that morning.

Then I trod on something in the water. Showed everyone a shell. A snail. Thought nothing of it.After all been doing so much more than this all week. About an hour later, my foot was stinging so I went to the medical tent. They cleaned it and checked. All good.

Later back on board, I was experiencing intense pain. I had to go the Medical rooms. Luckily it was open ( after hours costs are alot more I discovered while there) Several hours later, with much anti preventitive medicines and still not realy sure if I was ok, as the Dr had not experienced my snail shell. We heard all about the most extreme worse case scenarios. 

A very uncomfortable night, I forfeited my visit to the last stop over. My mother came back on board and took me off to meet her local taxi driver. He spoke with me and even exaimined my foot. He explained the exact pain I was in and smiled. I would live!! Just 2-3 days of very uncomfortable symptoms.

So I lived to tell the tale of how I went simply swimming at an amazing beach and then had a large medical bill to pay, with the thought of being admitted over night or longer if the symptoms didn't abate.

Upon returning home, we got online with Cover-more. Uploaded all my medical records and filled out a very easy online form. within days I had my money back! 

So pay your travel insurance today, don't wait. Too easy to forget and then the simplest of things happen.
Ease of claiming.

title: Do Not Insure with this company
body: I purchased a Gold Cruise Travel insurance in May 2019. For a cruise departing 10th March 2020 from Dubai. There was a Travel Ban issued for overseas travel on the 18th March 2020. Unfortunately we were in the middle of a cruise that had all but 1 port closed due to COVID 19. We indicated by email we were going to make a claim for missed ports and additional emergency expenses on the 18th March 2020. This was accepted by this company and we were given a claim number. Eventually the cruise was able to disembark passengers in France (Marseille) which was not on the itinerary . This cut the cruise short and we were flown to London by the cruise company. We had to stay 2 days before securing a flight home as emirates had ceased flying. On return to Sydney we had to quarantine for 2 weeks and then hire a car to drive home to Qld. The insurer then only paid for 1 missed port $200 and refused to pay for the cost of all the other missed ports after the 18th March, the 2 nights accommodation in London, food and other necessities and then failed to pay for the new flight home and the car hire to get from Sydney to Gold Coast. Their reasoning was we failed to comply with the travel ban issued on the 18th March which was 8 days after we had departed Australia and we were on a cruise ship that was looking for a place to actually stop? I then complained to their internal complaint dept as advised by them who to this date 13th July 2020 have not replied. In their charter it gives them 15 business days to investigate the refusal of the claim and make a decision on whether to pay or not with their reasoning. So as they failed to compIy with their own rules I was made to make a complaint to AFCA ( Australian Financial Complaints Authority) who requested I try to resolve the issue with this insurance company. I tried but they stated that since I have made a complaint to AFCA they would no longer correspond with me. They have since failed to reply to AFCA themselves. I have used this company on many occasions but never again hence the warning to other consumers. You cannot retrospectively change dates to suit yourself and advise customers that they are not covered in my view and there is no mention when purchasing the policy in their own T&C that the word pandemic appears . I am extremely disappointed with their customer care and service. I have not asked for anything that a normal person would be entitled to under the circumstances. I am especially disappointed in their their lack of communication and when a company breaches its own protocols and procedures that about sums it up. Take your chances.

title: Travel insurance is worth it
body:
I am writing this review because I saw a couple of reviews here which talked about travel insurance not being worth it. I just wanted to give my 10 cents worth. I was travelling with friends of mine approximately 5 years ago in South Africa when my mate and his wife were in a terrible car accident. 

My mate ended up a being a paraplegic and his wife had multiple broken bones. I was there and saw the care and service that they received from Covermore. It was a terrible time for them and I'm not sure how much they realise Covermore did even today but it was pretty amazing. 

My mate was in hospital in SA for a few months prior to being brought home with a nurse or doctor escort (can't remember which) and their medical bills I know were over $100 000. Travel insurance is worth it. There are exclusions in policies but they are there when you buy the policy.

Just make sure you read the policy when taking out insurance and compare against other policies and you will know what you are and aren't covered for before you even go anywhere. There's no excuses for not knowing the policy coverage really.
Service and care provided. Huge bills all paid for by Covermore

title: Their own mistakes create even more hoops to jump.

I did not receive even a read receipt and knowing that there was a 30 day limit on lodging claims and nearly a week later, I sent them another email. Only then did they acknowledge receipt of my claim and advise me of other requirements. The representative acknowledged that their own email was deficient and a mistake, however, despite it only being around a $100 claim, she still insisted on other documents. Again, I sent them the additional documents and still days later I have no read receipt or acknowledgement that all the documents required had been received. 
I plan to travel overseas regularly, this was a small simple claim, I can only imagine if I was in an accident overseas and incapacitated, urgently needing help, how this group would rather than act quickly and help, would be busy doing what they do best and creating hoops. 
I won't be insuring with them again.

The only problem we had is that we wanted to extend our policy for another few months and we missed the deadline by a few hours (in our Timezone it was still the date included in the policy) and there was absolutely no flexibility around this. This was problematic for us as we were already overseas and to get a new policy at this point for 3 more months was almost as much as we had already paid for the previous 9 months. We understand that in some cases getting insurance mid trip is higher risk for insurance companies, but our previous policy hasn't technically even expired in our Timezone. I recently made a claim for a camera that was damaged and I'm sure I would never have bothered with the claim if I'd been better informed. The camera was 25 months old, originally cost $348 and there was a $100 excess on the policy. In order to have the claim processed I had to provide a report re the damage. After going to a few camera chain stores I was told to go to the only camera repairer I could locate in central Melbourne and the inspection and report cost for $50. I added this cost to my claim believing it would be covered. Once depreciation and the excess were removed I received $39.20!!!

Why don't 1Cover provide details of depreciation rates for equipment, details of asset life for common travel gadgets and let people know any costs to prove your equipment is broken aren't covered. I was unable to find any information re any of this in the PDS or claims section of the website. When I questioned staff re the cost to inspect the camera I was told I should have found somewhere that didn't charge.I'm still down a camera and out of pocket $10.80 because I chose to make a claim. 1Cover you need to do better and supply customers with accurate and relevant information.

title: DISGRACEFUL company! Apparently a cancer diagnosis is not enough for them. BEWARE!
body:
My partner was very unexpectedly diagnosed with cancer in July after taking out our policy with TUD in May. After months of back and forth, providing all relevant documents and having to follow up EVERY time continuously after no returned calls or emails, we found out that our case manager [name removed] had declined the claim on the basis that the condition was 'pre-existing'. This was because my partner had visited the GP earlier in the year for a small lump expected to be a mere infection and treated as such. A cancer diagnosis was not ascertained until July 2018 and we have medical letters that state that there was absolutely no concern for the lump until surgery was completed and results came in. 

We are absolutely DISGUSTED by the lack of compassion, failure to get back to us time and time again and extremely unjust decision in what has been the most stressful and tragic experience of our life. As if cancer is not hard enough to deal with, the last thing we need is a drawn out process in obtaining the compensation that is rightfully ours. If we can't have our claim approved for something so genuine and unexpected, good luck to anybody else dealing with this terrible organisation. 

We are currently building a case against TID to the Ombudsman where we have no doubt our claim will be heard. It's a shame we have to jump through hoops just to seek what is rightfully ours. My partner and I both work for financial organisations and we will make sure we share this experience with our clients, colleagues, friends and family so that they too don't have to deal with the stress TID has caused us. To anybody reading this, I urge you to re-consider taking out any insurance with TID.

title: Regretting our choice of Travel Insurer
body: The reason we purchase travel insurance every time we go overseas is for the most part to cover any medical expenses overseas, and secondly to cover unforeseen cancellations or travel hiccups. ?If you can?t afford travel insurance you can?t afford to travel? has always been our motto. When news broke of the COVID-19 virus and there were initial travel alert updates shown on the 1Cover website, I contacted 1Cover to ask specifically about the cover our policy would include for our upcoming cruise to the South Pacific.  I was told very plainly there would be NO COVER for any cancellation as a result of the virus (either government enforced travel bans or if we contracted the virus prior and could not travel), and NO MEDICAL COVER if we contracted the virus while overseas. Their website has now been further updated to reflect exactly that statement. I understand that they would not cover something that is already known at the time of taking out the cover, but considering we purchased our policy months ago, I feel it is very unfair to exclude something that could not be predicted at the time of purchase (Epidemic - as of what date?  By the definition of whom? For travel to which countries?). Is that not the purpose of ?comprehensive? travel insurance? It also means that by the time we realised we would have no cover from our policy, it would have been useless to take out travel insurance with another provider, so we are stuck with no cover for anything related to COVID-19. Our travel companions are with another insurer who have assured them they will be covered for medical assistance should anything unforeseen occur, due to the purchase of their policy prior to the outbreak being publicised. Unfortunately for us, this is also the insurer we have gone with every other time we have travelled, but because of the ?superior? cover offered by 1Cover for cruises we purchased their Comprehensive Cruise plan this time and are regretting it very much. The result is that we are very uncertain what will happen in regards to how we would pay for medical/evacuation expenses (like in the case of the Diamond Princess), and should our travel be cancelled by government orders we are solely reliant on our cruise company to offer some sort of compensation. In all our travels we?ve never had to claim anything so far, so fingers crossed we don?t need to this time. We will never buy 1Cover Travel Insurance again! It is disgusting that they would purposely include wording in their PDS to avoid them having to provide cover for the reason the cover is purchased, and that this company is legally allowed to sell such ?cover?.

She recognised my distress and anxiousness and was very reassuring. She had to consult her supervisor who was going to send an addendum to my policy. body: I have used 1 Cover Travel Insurance on a number of occasions because it is excellent value for money and easy to take out a policy. After my recent cruise I had a need to make my first claim and I could not believe how easy it was to complete the claim form and find the information I needed to ensure I provided all the necessary paperwork to process my claim. body: First time and had to make a claim.  Very poor customer service, was given conflicting advice, not able to speak with person handling my claim, made 5 calls without any luck.  Long wait on hold (up to 25 mins!). Finally received my money after much angst.  Never use again!

Super easy to set up - great email communication as well.

title: False Misleading Deceptive
body: Great at selling their policies but don?t expect them to pay you what they promise in their product policy. Making a claim is like being trapped in an episode of American Horror Story!  Do absolutely everything to not pay on their policy provisions. Be warned, what you see is not what you get .... if anything. Deceptive. There are better insurers around.

title: Worst experience ever! Scary!!
body: Never take this travel insurance if you want peace of mind. I'll explain. We were on holidays in Spain when my husband had an accident and broke his foot. He had to go to the hospital in another country, wait for 2 weeks in hospital until the swelling went down, had an operation there, had to be in hospital for another week and resting for another week before he could be put on a plane to come back to Australia (all in all 5 weeks). When he had the accident and I contacted TID, the first thing they told me was that we were not covered at all until they studied the case and accept it (exactly what you need to hear when you're in hospital facing an operation in a different country!!!). The day of the operation TID hadn't confirmed anything yet and I had to sign a paper in the hospital committing to cover for the cost of the whole process in case they didn't hear from the insurance (more reassurance!!!). Eventually TID agreed to pay for the 30,000 dollars the whole thing cost. I had to mediate between the hospital in Spain and TID since TID did not contact the hospital at all during the whole time. On top of everything, six months later I received a letter from the hospital in Spain threatening us to sue us because the expenses hadn't been paid yet!! I nearly die. After lots of pain and sorrow, we managed to get hold of TID and get it fixed but believe me, all this uncertainty and recklessness is not worth at all. Never again. Do not even try this one.

title: TID ski cover
body:
TID seems to have a better handle on skiing, clearly stating the cover, 'within ski area boundaries', not just groomed runs within an artificially contrived date window for skiers of quite limited ages, like some insurers.  It works best for me.
I only want  medical cover for skiing, essential in the US, not all the other bits and pieces as I figure I've already paid out and in 27 overseas ski holidays only made one claim and that one a medical one with TID, handled well, thankyou.
So why only a 4 star rating? The cost difference after turning 70 for my last 2 trips, no claim, a doubling in cost from age 69 to 70. Can't see it's based on real facts and figures.
Oh, and why not no claim bonus for travel insurance, 27 trips with one claim when others I know seem to claim something every year.
I know, I've said it all before.
Thanks.







Oh, well. TID next year, I guess.

title: Ease of obtaining

Great value.
Easy to obtain what you need.
Have used for many years and although not claimed this time, have done in the past and found the claims process very easy and efficient.

title: Great options for people with pre existing illness.
body:
I have pre existing medical conditions. Most companies simply won't cover me or want an Assessment fee of $100 to determine IF they will cover my condition.
Insureand go do it with simple questions online when applying for the cover and cover me for the conditions!!. 
Simple and easy to set up.

title: Great Cover and Service
body: This is the first time I've used 1Cover and was very happy with the range of cover given through policy.  I was extremely happy with pricing of my cover.  Also very happy with reminder sent prior to completion of cover regarding extending policy date if needed.  Will definately be using 1Cover again.

title: Best Travel Insurance
body:

title: Didn't have any issues.
body: Compared to other policies I found this one the cheapest. I did not claim but would have liked more email while I was over there to see how I was going.

title: Never Again
body:
We have had three or four Annual Travel Insurance Policies with Insure and Go (the result of the positive assessments by Canstar) and had no complaints - but then we had no claims either.

Tonight, I went searching for a single trip policy, again using the assessments by Canstar.  The first offering on the Insure and Go web site was Get a Quote, so I followed that and spent twenty minutes filling in the information required.  Got to the end of the form where I had to fill in the acceptance of conditions before I made my payment for the policy.  Buried in the wording of the acceptance of conditions was notification that the policy does not cover Zimbabwe where our tour was taking us for a couple of days.  Spoke (after a long wait on the line) to a CSO who gave a response that the whole policy would be invalid if we were going to Zimbabwe.

So, I went off and found another company which provided the required cover including Zimbabwe, and for a lower price.

Strange thing - the UK arm of Insure and Go advertises that they provide cover for Zimbabwe.

title: Excellent in every way
body: Certainly good value. On line screening for pre existing conditions was simply. My experience, given my age, was that insurance became more and more difficult, especially with pre existing medical conditions. SureSave just made it quick and stress free. Thank you.

title: Expensive and don't cover for a large range of complications
body:
So it is in my inexperience that I purchased this through a third party (as I had little experience with booking insurance policies). Now that I have more experience, I would like to say; please read fine prints. It is obvious but please do.

I paid for the most expensive policy but it does not even cover half of what other insurance companies, such as Budget Direct does. And that was just a quick search after realising my error. 

Customer service is fine, (though I had to wait over an hour to talk with someone) however, just check fine prints as they cover a lot of what they DON'T cover (e.g. cancellation or delays from epidemics as per my case).

Basically, expensive policy don't mean a thing. It's obvious but check it. Whatever travel agency / company you end up with, their policy may not necessary be in line with your needs. Just check people.

title: Amazing Expirence - Changed my view on insurance claims
body:
Took out insurance as we travelled to the Philippines. I got ill and had to pay $300 in medical bills. 
When I returned to Sydney I lodged some paperwork on the site and within 3 days, the claim was approved.

title: With out a doubt the best
body: Travel about 5 times a year and only use Travel Direct. My Daughter and partner went to Bali last year so I told them to use Travel direct which they did, unfortunately partner got very ill 2nd day in bali and ended up in Hospital for the next 10 days over there. As you can imagine it was very stressful for my daughter alone over there traveling every day all day at hospital and going back to hotel alone every nite. Partner got dengue fever and was very ill. Travel direct rang me every day to update me with what was happening. Had Doctor from Aust talking every day with Bali hospital doctors. They are amazing! Had to pay excess 1,000 at bali hospital at beginning and would be refunded after insurance kicked in. 3 months later trying to call bali hospital and get my money back was impossible, called travel direct and had my money back in 24 hours. I would never use anyone else, they are so professional, kind and caring. Thank you for such one on one service, The care and understanding, constant professionalism was outstanding.

title: run far away from this company
body: Paid a ridiculous amount for travel insurance for our group. Did everything properly, eg did not do any hazardous activities so as not to have any problems. Unfortunately one of our group had his bag stolen with wallet, passport, mobile phone, ipad, etc. the day before we were due to leave for home (there was no safe for security in the hostel). Contacted security immediately, lodged police reports, contacted consulate...in other words, if we had to do it...then we did it. Group members paid for all the taxi fares to/from police stations,etc and paid for all his needs....cos he had no money at all. Lodged a claim for the items in the bag. Multiple photos proving the items not only existed but were in his possession on the trip, Immediately there was an investigation launched as apparently, there was a lot in the bag. Yes we know...we we all out of pocket. Nasty nasty investigation, lots of stalling, ombudsman involvement, any hoop you can think of....allianz said jump through. It has been weeks and we are now at a pathetically low offer which doesn't cover half the items in the bag. Should have claimed for stress involved, additional costs that we had to outlay on his behalf but all we actually claimed was what was in the bag (probably a little less as we didn't bother with some of the small tourist stuff bought). Next trip is planned but hell no will allianz be involved in the travel insurance. Would have been better off taking the money and having a campfire....at least we would have been warm for a few minutes and had some sort of positive rather than the nightmare they are putting us through.

title: Feeling safe and well covered
body: Excellent Value. Perfect for my needs. Covered my partner and my self adequately and economically. I have used 1Cover several times, excellent service. I refer friends who now use it.

title: Unless you have receipts for everything you own DON't insure with these guys.
body: I had my wallet stolen in Iceland.  I reported it to the police and got a police report.  I-N-Go refunded the money that was in the wallet but refused to cover the wallet as I didn't still have the receipt for its purchase even though I obtained a statuary declaration (which every other insurance company would accept).  A stat dec is a legal document stating that what it says is true and they should have accepted it.  I would not insure with them again as who keeps receipts for everything in their suitcase?

title: Stranded in hospital in Thailand
body:
I travelled to South-East Asia with my boyfriend and a group of friends. I got sick in Laos and had to be medically evacuated to Thailand. We called the emergency assistance number provided by TID and informed them of the circumstances as soon as we knew what was happening. We stayed in constant contact with them the whole time I was in hospital, but when the time came for me to be discharged, they were excruciatingly slow with arranging flights home for me. We asked if we could arrange our own flights but were told if we did that, they would not pay for it and we would not be reimbursed. We were stuck an extra 3 days in a town we didn't want to be in, in a hospital that couldn't discharge me until they had confirmation that I had somewhere to go and a flight home, but TID wouldn't arrange flights for me because I was still in hospital. They required my doctor to send them a comprehensive daily medical report on my condition, which didn't change much from day to day and therefore seemed unnecessary, and were slow in confirming with the hospital accounts department that they would cover the cost of my treatment. When we called trying to get answers we were told that they were 'working on it' but nothing was happening. When I was sick in a foreign country, all I wanted was to go home, and none of the stuffing around with TID was helping. I called them in tears several times only to receive the same response over and over. It was the most frustrating experience of my life, and one I wouldn't wish on anybody.  We finally had flights arranged for us 4 days after I had been cleared to be discharged from hospital.
Inexpensive to buy the policy
Bad customer service, lack of urgency when providing emergency assistance, seeming lack of care for customer wellbeing

title: Please go elsewhere for your travel insurance. You are not safe with this company.
body: Whatever you do do not insure with this company!! I went overseas and had my bag stolen in the shop. Thought it was a straight forward claim but no they refused my claim. title: SCAM! STAY AWAY AT ALL COST!
body:
Booked a travel insurance with Budget Direct for a 9 months holiday trip visiting several countries since had been happy with our Budget Direct car insurance (will never that with budget direct either after this). We just wanted to be covered for medical expenses on our trip if and when we need to see a doctor.

Just a week into our holiday our 1.5 years old daughter was clearly unwell and rubbing her ear. We took her to a doctor and sure enough, she had a mild ear infection. Made sure to ask all the documents and receipts from the clinic and the pharmacy for insurance.

Then the nightmare started. I tried finding a budget direct claim form for travel insurance claims. Nothing. I contacted the customer service through the chat. First person was from the car insurance and didn't know and forwarded me to the next one. She provided me with a direct link to an online form. I asked how I can I find it the next time since it's unlikely that we wouldn't need a doctor again in 9 months. She told me you can't find it. I have to store the link or contact them again. When claiming is made difficult it's never a good sign.

Then I proceeded to fill in the form. They don't have a form for travel medical expenses. It's a form when you needed to postpone or cancel a trip for medical reason and incurred expenses therefore. Thus it was very cumbersome to fill in and had a lot of not relevant fields that were compulsory. Also a medical certificate was compulsory was is obvious if you postpone or cancel a flight. I had al the documents AND receipts from the clinic and the pharmacy. But obviously I didn't ask the doctor to spend extra time to write a document just that we've been there since I had all the other documents.

Now they have declined the claim because their PDS require a medical certificate. I actually compared several insurances and read PDS thoroughly but failed to see that. It's a pure scam and the insurance is useless. I'm not going ask every doctor to waste their valuable time to write each time a document that we've been there. I've travelled 25 years and had a lot of travel insurances but never had any issues or heard anything so ridiculous. That combined with the fact that it takes about half an hour to make a claim, I will fight Budget Direct all the way to the courts if I need to, to get the policy cancelled and remaining 7 months refunded.

STAY AWAY AT ALL COST!

We Will Not Pay For:
Claims caused by:

1.	Transport Provider caused cancellations, delays or rescheduling other than when caused by strikes.

In order for a claim to qualify under the ??Amendment Or Cancellation Costs? section of the policy, the reason for the cancellation must not be caused by a ?Transport Provider caused cancellations, delays or rescheduling other than when caused by strikes?
The assumption we were insured

title: Buyer Beware!
body:
I was a loyal TID customer until my latest OS trip. I had some personal effects broken in my luggage & when I made a claim upon my return to Australia, was told I needed to have lodged a complaint with the airline or police authority. This is despite the fact my travelling companion is a current serving member of the NSW police force & has offered to provide a statutory declaration that my personal items had been damaged, to support my claim. Yet no-one from TID is actually interested in gathering information to support my case, instead I receive emails to say my claim is being 'reviewed' & forwarded onto the next desk-jockey. My favourite email so far is the one stating that a representative from TID will call me within 2 working days of my latest email. I'm glad I'm not holding my breath as its been ongoing for 4.5months now. 

I've now lodged a formal complaint with the Office of Fair Trading as I seem to be getting nowhere with this company. Normally I wouldn't bother chasing a claim for such a small amount of money, but the principle of the matter is if I spend valuable money on travel insurance I expect to have my claim honoured. Or at the very least have my claim dealt with appropriately. 

I'll never buy travel insurance through TID again & urge all other travelers to also shop elsewhere!!

title: Travel Agents Cancellation fees Not Covered By travel Insurance?
body:
We had a family trip booked for United States in February 2018. 2 weeks prior to departure my son broke his leg and was unable to travel. Covermore acknowledged the legitimacy of the claim and covered some of our expenses but has refused to cover the $1200 of cancellation fees charged by Flight Centre. We knew Flight Centre charged these fees but naturally assumed they would be covered by travel insurance. According to Covermore it is clearly stated in there PDS that these cancellation fees are not covered. I have included below the 2 separate sections of the 60 page PDS that i was supposed to put together to conclude that they do not cover these expenses. I have spoken to many, including a sales consultant who sells these policies and know can believe that these fees are not covered. Makes you wonder what else isn't. I have taken this as high as i can with Covermore but still no joy (don't get me started on the appalling service and misinformation). I actually bought the policy through NRMA who were very quick to pass the buck to Covermore who are apparently behind most policies. 
The sections of the PDS I was directed to were
We refer you to the section of your ?Comprehensive? Travel Insurance Product Disclosure Statement (PDS) and specifically to the section 3 titled ?Amendment or Cancellation costs?, where it states: 

If due to circumstances outside Your control and unforeseeable at the Relevant Time: 

2. You have to cancel the Journey (where You cannot rearrange it prior to leaving Home) We will pay You 
a) The non-refundable unused portion of all travel costs prepaid in advance including the travel agent?s commission (the travel agent?s commission is limited to the lesser of $4,000 or the amount of commission the agent had earned on the pre-paid refundable amount of the cancelled travel arrangements). (Writer emphasis) 

We now refer you to the section of the policy headed ?General Exclusions? were it reads: 
We will not pay for 
17. Claims involving consequential loss of any kind including loss of enjoyment or any financial loss not specifically covered in the policy.

Clearly from this i should of realised.

body:

body:

title: Everything that it should be!
body:

We had to make a claim 3 years ago and the process was simple and positive and settled without any dispute - that is the test I believe of any insurance company.

title: Peace of Mind
body: We always use this service when we travel as we have peace of mind and no worries while travelling, which is perfect. We would recommend Allianz to family and friends.

title: Trustworthy Travel Insurance
body:
1Cover Travel Insurance offers value for money, reliable travel insurance ..
My policy was purchased online, and I made a phone call to make sure I had everything covered.  
I have had occassion to make a claim, and this was handled quickly and efficiently.
I have used 1Cover Travel Insurance several times now, and would certainly recommend them.

title: Thanks for the quick and caring help when we needed it.
body: We have used Cover More for many years but had never claimed. Last month we had a 6 week mostly mini bus trip around England Scotland and Wales Back Roads. While in remote Mull in Scotland one of us noticed a large bruise on the back of the thigh. We were especially concerned whether that would lead to DVT on the long plane flight home in 2 weeks. Perhaps because health care is "free" in the UK with reciprocal rights to Aussies, no doctor would see us as new patients - they were all too busy! When we rang the Cover More help line in the UK, they immediately helped us find a very expensive ( $250) private only doctor but also how to manage the simple paperwork at the surgery so we could claim it all back. Luckily the excellent doctor cleared our concerns , but we did appreciate the cover more nurses call to check on the outcome and make sure we were happy. When we finally arrived home in Australia it took 10 minutes on the website to claim, and the refund was received in 2 days. Well done!

body: Thank you cover-more.  My claim was professionally dealt with and promptly assessed.  Would recommend you to any one travelling.  We were on a boat cruise around New Zealand when I fell ill. title: Claim process easy and in line with policy
body:
Following a trip, I had the need to lodge a claim with TID for damage to my camera and lens. It was made a little awkward by the fact that I (a) extended my travel and (b) when I returned to Australia, I was leaving 5 days later so only had time to lodge my claim but not seek the necessary quotations to progress the claim immediately. Also, I was reluctant to travel to my next holiday destination without my camera, which was still limping along.  Well, TID were very accommodating and clear in their communication. I lodged the claim prior to my departure and sought their approval to take my camera with me and then to progress the claim on my return. I again extended my travel plans.  I made sure that I kept TID up-to-date every time I changed my plans and they continued to assure me that, provided I met the conditions of the insurance policy I had purchased, that they would proceed with the claim.
My claims officer, at all times, exceeded the time expectations set out in the automated email response. Once my claim was settled, the payment was made into my account on the same day. (I was also fortunate enough to get great service from the camera shop I used; but that is another review!).
I use TID because I am able to purchase ? or extend - travel insurance while I am overseas (as well as they meet my requirements). I am pleased to say that I have been satisfied now by both the policy offerings and claim settlement process. Definitely a recommend.

body: I am someone who never thinks they will need insurance. But prudently I took it out. Had a major fall off my bike a week before departure robbing me of London marathon! Having heard the stories of Commonwealth Bank insurance I wondered what excuse Covermore would use not to pay. But they paid up promptly and efficiently. Very happy with the service.

title: Felt reassured the whole time
body: The policy was the best value available and covered more than anyone else. So easy to do all online. Fellow travelers had the same insurance and were required to make a claim and they were very happy with their experience.

title: Not worth the paper it is written on!
body: I recently travelled to Bali and left my bag in a taxi. Hindsight is a great think! I placed a claim with 1 cover and unsurprisingly after being held on the line for the obligatory 1 minute silence the claims officer came back and advised under section blah blah blah I was not covered! The contents of my bag was minimal and luckily my phone was covered by Telstra, which I had advised the CO, so the balance of thinks stolen was basically a pair of reading glasses and a wallet, no money was claimed! I requested the CO send me a email stating the reasons for there refusal to pay and she responded with its on the PDF document with policy! title: Easy to deal with you
body: I was very  busy prior to departure to arrange a travel cover witch  is  very essential  for aged person, but there  were no problems at all with 1Cover. The website was easy to manage, price was acceptable, done, flew no worry's, thanks god return back home no claims, 1Cover is the best.

title: Honoured 100% of my claim without debate
body: While others have criticised this insurance, I only have high praise. I travel frequently and always read the PDS carefully whenever I purchase insurance. This time I took the free travel insurance as it offered everything we needed. When my father sadly died requiring a sudden return from our trip the call centre staff were sympathetic and helpful. Yes you have to book and pay your own way home, but I expected that, and yes the claim form is a little arduous to complete, but they did not dispute any of my expenses and paid promptly once the death certificate was provided.  If you read the PDS and it has what you need then I highly recommend this travel insurance.

title: Unbelievably bad experience
body:
Insured with InsureandGo prior to Covid19 era and exceptions, for a short Bali hop 8-22 march 2020. unfortunately was informed by my return carrier a week prior to my return that return flight had been cancelled (Malindo air) due to order of Malaysian govt (origin of return flight) KUL-DPS-MEL... attempted to contact airline however un-contactable...was able to secure a one way return via Jetstar on the 20 march and took the opportunity as flights were filling fast due to the covid19 growing panic... after my return contacted them and was told to lodge online... none of the options on their system fulfilled the circumstances so had to make do with the options available on their online claim form...original claim denied told to provide extra documents...did so despite duplicating most of original claim... took weeks and many apologies from insurer re the time it was taking and finally claim was denied due to original flight originating in a country that closed flights???? appeared assessor really had been told to disallow claim under any pretext... more obstruction than help and told to appeal etc...currently appeal made but appears to have disappeared in the bureaucracy of this organisation with no result... I can not believe a company where a claim would be this little approx $600 for a flight would be this obstructive and deny when I had no alternative. Never would I use this group again and i note a large number a similar grief has been handed out to other clients... Even their reasons to deny claim quoted a reason that had not occurred... Stay clear of this insurer.
RE: InsureandGo Claim # 120010308

update 19june2020, insure&go has just emailed me to state they would pay amount of claim minus excess...gave them bank details however still awaiting payment... the hardest $300+ i have ever had to pursue

They quickly appointed a case manager who helped us every step of the way. Would highly recommend  InsureanGo as a travel insurance company .

title: Efficient, helpful, caring staff - great travel insurance company!
body:
I was bit by a dog while trekking in a remote location in Nepal on both my hands. I required rabies treatment as soon as possible (took 3 days to reach nearest medical care). At the clinic I was quoted over $1500 USD for the treatment - as a student this figure was horrifying - however, after calling 1cover travel insurance (would love to know the name of the lady who helped me so she may get some recognition), they had organised guarantee of payment within 15 minutes and I was able to receive treatment right then and there. 
I couldn't believe how efficient, helpful and caring all the staff were! They even made numerous follow up calls to check that I was doing well. Exceptional travel insurance company & I'm so grateful for their assistance! Most certainly recommend and will use them for my future trips!

body:

After a couple of emails back and forth the company still denied my claim. Claiming that my additional travel expense was not a part of their policy.

body: Too many exclusions, it makes me feel like I'll be travelling without insurance at all. title: Terrible Experience with Travel insurance
body:
My Husband & I booked travel insurance through Insureandgo prior to our cruise in April. We picked this company because it said on our booking that we would be covered for any medical expenses. While away my husband picked up a virus on board the cruise that saw him confined to his room a lot of the time and costly doctor bills from on board the ship doctor. When we returned we put in a claim to insureand go for those expenses we were told that the cruise component was not covered, we returned to the booking page and it definitely states that Cruise medical is fully covered. We wrote to I&G stating these facts only to be told again that they would not be covering any claims.
I would advise anybody looking for good travel insurance not to deal with Insureandgo as you cannot be guaranteed any satisfaction should you need to make a legitimate claim. Never again will we book any insurance with them.
Our next step is to take our grievance to the ACCC.
K & K Booth Tasmania

title: TID were excellent to deal with
body:
Not only were TID excellent to deal with in the initial stages of taking out insurance, they actually delivered on their promises when it came to the crunch. Due to a death in our family we had to postpone a holiday to the Gold Coast with our 2 children at very short notice. Within 1 quick & easy phone call our holiday, exactly as we had booked it had been moved forward 7 days to allow us time to deal with what had happened and travel interstate for the funeral. The best $72 I have ever spent. I will only use TID again in the future and have already shared my experience with family and friends. Thank you and keep up the great work.
they actually delivered on their promises when it came to the crunch.

title: love covermore
body:
any past experiences i have had dealing with covermore have been easy, friendly, quick and efficient communication. I recommend covermore to everyone i know. We will always use covermore for our travel insurance. Thanks for all the past service i couldn't ask for a better travel insurance experience thats easy to access and communicate with.
Fast, reliable, friendly, it does what it promises to do, easy to communicate with and a pleasure to do business with.

title: Easy, Competitively Priced Peace of Mind
body:
This is the easiest interactive quoting system I have ever used. That is a stand out in itself.
My sister whom can always be counted on to get the best deal around, told me about Cover More online. She also made a minor claim after having an item stolen from her hotel room and another for an unforesee flight cancellation and found it effortless! Also a stand out in the insurance field. I have now used Cover More twice this year and am happy that my finace and I have competitively priced, reasonable medical coverage when away from home. I can relax knowing that if anything untoward occurs we will have a helping hand to call on.
Easy to choose inclusions and eclusions and see the rate change back & forth immediately

title: We would not attempt  to travel without Travel Insurance
body:
To determine 'value for money' I feel it would first be necessary to be put in a position of having to lodge a claim. My pre-existing medical conditions were covered fully, without a great deal of fuss and without the premium being excessive.
Relatively so, with the assistance of the a member of the Customer Support team. 
The Customer Service people were courteous and very helpful.

title: Terrible
body: Classic PDS stitch up. They'll cover stolen luggage and personal effects, but not valuables, if stolen from a locked vehicle. 'Valuables' being the items actually worth money. I guess thats what insurance companies do.

title: Greatness price no fuss travel insurance!
body: Such a great price and was such a simple process to set the policy up. Will definitely use this provider again

title: No response!!!
body:
Took out Covermore Insurance for travel to Singapore departing 14th March. On the 13th March the Federal government directed people to not travel out of the country unless essential. Cancelled trip and sent Covermore an e-mail requesting a refund if possible. 
Zero response.

title: No problems
body: Insurance policy was good for peace of mind. Didn't use so hard to rate in the part of process that counts but I liked the reminder before I went on holiday with contact info should I need it

title: Value for money
body: I compared the products and found it was best suited to my needs and value for money. The product was easy to get online with an ease of use of the web site.

title: So easy
body: Dealing with 1Cover Travel Insurance is such a breeze. It is so easy to fill out the form and well priced for travel insurance. Do not go overseas without insurance. These guys are great. I have never had any problems & your time away is covered and you can enjoy your well earned holiday of rest & recreation in peace

title: Was a good price for what I required
body: I liked that I could put curser over each item I needed online to see  in detail what I was covered for.  Made it simpler to use then having to download a booklet etc.

title: Easy and no fuss
body:
The website is easy to navigate and the prices are great.  Since my lat trip, I am now considered to have a pre-existing medical condition and the ease of completing the application online was great. The cost increase for the extra cover was still cheaper than other insurance agencies.  I am very happy with the level of cover.
Ease of use, level of cover

title: Policy set up
body: I've just done the Policy set up which was quick and straightforward.  Husband has a pre-existing medical condition which has been accepted with a small extra cost for cover.  Hopefully there will be no claims!  Thank you.

title: Wont refund insurance due to COVID-19 restrictions
body: Advised today that unused insurance premiums won't be refunded. How can TID not refund insurance premiums when the policy was not used.  $$$ paid without receiving a service!!! Hopefully TID can change their refund policy during these unprecedented times.

title: Travel more with Cover-More, you can only afford a luxury holiday if you have top class insurance!
body:
Cover-More is a breeeze and after a couple of minutes on line, you are assured of the best cover for your holiday that you can get.  I have used Cover-More for all my overseas travels and whilst I have been fortunate enough to never have to claim to date, I know for sure that I am covered by the best there is!
Covermore is reliable, you get what you want, and you know that you are covered from start to finish.

title: Excellent
body:
KISS principle in action. Clear information and quick to complete.Good options. Confidence in the company (Allianz) allows us to enjoy the holiday, knowing if anything goes wrong, help will be close at hand.
Easy to use website, reputable insurer and great rates. Too easy!
No problems

title: Excellent for oldies with pre-existing conditions
body: I am in mid 70s  with pre-exisitng medical conditions....who else is like this? Many travel insurance companies have age restrictions, or immediately wipe you on medical grounds. The point is, I would NOT travel if I had concerns. Insureandgo has a very reasonable approach to travel insurance and I will henceforth use them exclusively.

title: Your go to for travel insurance
body: It was a good rate with excellent cover. Extremely easy to navigate the website and get the quote then to purchase the cover required. When I contacted the customer service the service provider gave me the information I requested using straightforward English that was easy to understand.

title: Take the worry out of travelling!
body:
Traveling to the US is exciting, but if anything were to happen the thoughts of potential medical costs was terrifying. I shopped around on line, and Allianz was very competitive, and having used them before, felt 
very safe in choosing them again. Didn't make a claim, but the peace of mind was worth it!

title: Expert backup service
body:
It was great having our travel to New Zealand backed by our car insurance company.

Excellent peace of mind whilst we were on our honeymoon so far from home.

Thank You Allianz.

title: All admin pre trip done promptly and professionally.
body: I am not able to comment on much of the policy as I had no reason to claim against it.  I am perfectly happy that the setting up of the policy was easy and straightforward. I will use this service again.

title: First and last experience with InsureandGo
body: The policy was competitive and seemed to be reasonable until we made a claim, and found out about the fine print! Our claim (for less than a $1000) for accommodation expenses because of a 15 hour delay from an (airline caused) missed connection and subsequent 2 day delay because of lost luggage was rejected - on the basis that there was no claim under the policy for delay costs resulting from a missed connection flight where the scheduled stopover was less than 6 hours. Who would intentionally schedule a stopover of more than 6 hours!

title: Excellent Value & After Care
body: The Comprehensive + Cruize policy was good value,  very easy to choose & simple to purchase online.  We have just arrived back from our cruise I had a query regarding a missed port day and 1Cover let me know all the details of a claim I was entitled to.  That is Genuine Customer Service! Thank you 1Cover.

title: Great cover for family
body: After booking a much needed family holiday to FIJI this year we decided to purchase Cover-More insurance for all of the family. We purchased additional cover for our daughter who also has allergies and asthma. We were very impressed by the competitive rate, comprehensive cover and prompt online service. When you purchase cover, you hope that you don't have to use it - but great to know that it's there when you need it! The day before we were due to depart on our holiday, our eldest child ended up having appendicitis and needed to have his appendix removed. Thankfully he recovered well! Our insurance claim was straight forward - I scanned all of our documents and sent them via email. I did phone Cover-more to discuss information relating to the claim and each time I spoke to a customer service officer who was easy to understand and helpful. Our claim was processed and paid out in the 10 business days that we were expecting. I would purchase travel insurance through Cover-More again.

title: Decent cover
body:
Was quite Easy to set up online on mobile phone 
Some medical questions not well worded but mostly elderly could understand them .
Price was a little higher than others but overall acceptable

title: Always follow up
body: We took out an annual multi-trip travel insurance policy with Cover More through Flight Centre in March 2017. We had to cancel a November trip to Norfolk Island as I was unexpectedly diagnosed with a heart issue, which required implantation of a pacemaker in October 2017. Formal notice of cancellation of the trip was provided in advance of the date of travel and the completed insurance claim form submitted through our Flight Centre travel agent in mid-November 2017. As we had heard nothing from Cover More by mid-April 2018 further investigation showed that a Flight Centre staff member had made a mistake and our claim has not in fact been submitted.

title: Peace of mind
body: It gave peace of mind and thus gave good value, when setting policy up over the phone customer service officer was very knowlegeable  about the product ands would most likely take out another policy

title: Easy and set up - great cover with gold
body:
Good value good coverage easy to set up.
Great product . Accessible customer support .
Would recommend the product and definitely will use again .
Favourite option is world wide cover

title: Don't use 1 Cover
body:
I recently took out annual travel insurance for myself and family. 1 cover was cheap and appeared ideal. However, don't be fooled. Had a couple of items stolen abroad- what I thought insurance is for. Well, not with 1 cover. They won't cover this. The small print (only found if you dredge through the PI) is they don't cover if anything is left unattended, in hotel room, left in taxi, left out of site, left at airport, lost at airport etc etc.- basically all the ways you might loose something while travelling. There isn't much point in having cover. Complete waste of money!!

A complete con>

title: Pleased to find Insure and Go
body: Yes was ok once I sorted out the cruise bit. We have used another company for all of our travel but are now trying Insure and go as my husband has a pacemaker,and  is well but other insurers want to double our premiums.  Hope we never need to use it!
