body:
This is the first time I hve Insured with the company.
I was empresed by the manner of Radha who sole me the Policy.
I am not sure about the last question.

title: Good policy that provides peace of mind when travelling
body:
The Policy is competitively priced and is easy to set up. However we (2 persons) need 3 policies a year and will continue to look for best price and especially loyalty discounts from Insurance Companies. 
N.B., We have not yet made a single claim.

title: Cover-More is good
body:
Last year we took out travel insurance for a trip to Bali. Sadly I needed back surgery and had to cancel the trip. Cover-More handled my claim and we got our money back. This year we booked a cruise and got travel insurance. 4 days later I fell and broke my ankle in 3 places!! Again we had to cancel our trip, Cover-More helped us out again, this time even faster. We are very happy with Cover-More and will go with them again. We looking at our next cruise for next year. Third time lucky I hope!!!
Good service

title: Amazing, easy to deal with & reliable!
body:
I have actually unfortunately had to lodge a claim through Cover-More when I broke my leg overseas & could not be happier with the efficient service they provided.  They made it easy for me to make a claim & assisted me along the way with any queries I had.  I could not be happier with their service level.  I would recommend Cover-More and I would use them again.
Efficient, reliable and user-friendly (no hidden clauses)

title: Good insurance for travelers
body: I have used this company more than 5 times and been happy with the range of cover, price and acceptance of preexisting medical conditions. I had to make a claim on my last trip and found the process took longer than it should have for a straightforward claim, however I would recommend this insurer and will be using them again.

title: Ok but needs to improve electronic claim process
body:
Policy was good cover at competitive price.
Made claim through electronic lodgement system but was required to complete additional form that was largely a repeat of information already provided.
This could be easily fixed and if it was I would rate this product much higher.

title: Asked for a credit toward future Travel for covid 19 cruise cancellation
body:
I and my family always used ICover insurance for my trips primarily based on cost and reviews.
I  had my cruise cancelled by the cruiseline due to the virus.
I contacted 1Cover one week ago to ask if the travel insurance fee paid to 1Cover could be credited toward future travel insurance with 1Cover. I received an automated reply like so many others, saying that they will be in contact soon. Reports in the news are that the government requests that travel companies cannot charge excess cancellation fees. The time spent by 1Cover in initiating the online insurance cover I believe would be minimal. If the travel insurance were taken with the cruiseline the insurance premium would be refunded. I will follow the reviews and replies from 1Cover prior to purchasing future travel insurance.
A reply would be appreciated.

title: Happy with TID
body:
Have not needed to make a claim.
Have been pleased with response and follow ups.
As I am very,very, old I'm hoping TID will continue to allow e to have insurance for travel-especially as I have made no claims.

title: Very customer-friendly
body: As my wife and I are both over 70, I believe Allianz is one of the best travel insurers for our age group. The premiums are reasonable, and the questions are clear and easy to understand.

title: Simple, Easy and No-Fuss
body: As the title says, it's simple and easy to apply, make a claim and reach TID any time you need them!  They have great benefits, tailored to the person's needs and you can easily made additions.

title: Took months and lots of paperwork but they paid my claim
body: The policy was cost effective but when a claim was lodged they were efficient in handling the claim but wanted us to substantiate in writing every fine detail, but they paid the claim in full after some month

title: Bad decision
body: Took out a policy for my travel but got seriously ill before the holiday so couldn't go. Put in a claim with medical certificate but was rejected as it was a cruise. Nowhere on the form I filled out online did it ask if it was a cruise. To me travel means any mode of transport. Wouldn't use again or recommend.

title: Highly Recommend
body: Very affordable peace of mind. Would highly recommend and will use again! We are so glad we purchased this policy because it removed the worry from our holiday. 5 Stars.

title: Very Poor Customer Loyalty and Service
body:
I have held a cover more Annual Multi Trip Policy for 4 years since 2014. Prior to this single trip policies. Staff when taking your money always very nice. It came to light just recently that they do not cover flying to Bali and any effects of Mt Agung Volcano that erupted in 2017. I was concerned with this as I've renewed twice and never been told. I take it I'm just renewing a continuation of my annual 2014 policy. It appears Cover more hides behind something being Travel Alerts. Not the ones you would expect the Federal Government to issue but there own. Anything they list on this they can dodge a claim for as long as they wish. Me thinking I'M covered apparently am not if I was in Bali and Mt Agung Erupted again, this is even though there is NO CURRENT Risk from any Volcanic Ash Cloud monitoring centers.
My Policy as far as Im concerned is a continuation as there has been no breach in period of dates and it just proves the fact of what they will get out of when or if a claim was to arise. Now I have a trip booked April 2019 and am in a problem as they will not cover this? Why as they feel they can. Very upset as loyalty should mean something.

title: Poor - don?t recommend
body: Not good value at all - have already advised they won?t cover us despite corona virus not being declared a pandemic as yet. Typical insurance rip off. All insurance companies promise the world & have a get out of providing cover clause!

title: Good value travel insurance
body: Policy gives great coverage at a competitive price. Much cheaper than Cover More. InsureandGo website easy to navigate including medical conditions

title: Excellent
body: Easy to set up and in the event of a claim 1Cover were extremely helpful at looking after all of the medical expenses overseas. They were also very supportive during the period of hospitalisation to make sure that we were being looked after. I would (and have) recommended 1Cover to others.

title: Family holiday
body:
First time used travel insurance  
Very easy website to use

Hope it lives up to our expectations 
And no claim will be needed 
Thank you Budget direct

title: It was great with peace of mind!
body: It was great and good value and easy to set up and had peace of mind whilst away! I would definitely use Allianz Travel again! Thanks again for the easy use and quick response to a pre existing querie!

title: Do not trust cover-more. You have been warned
body:
We took out Covermore as part of Virgin Australia ticketing process. Turns out our Virgin flight to LA was delayed by 10 hours and we missed our connecting flight to San Francisco. We booked a later flight to San Fran and Covernore refused to pay any of the $700 costs. They claim that because the plane was delayed due to mechanical/ engineering issues that the policy has an exception for that.

So if you book with Virgin and take out Virgins preferred/ recommended cover and the Virgin flight is delayed, you are not covered. Ironic!!!!

Avoid this mob and go with someone like TID instead.

title: Excellent Claim Process
body: We needed to claim after cancelling our holiday due to relatives being seriously sick. The claim process was simple and the claim was paid very quickly with no problems at all. I would recommend to everyone and will use again.

title: Card did not work
body:
Card would refuse to put money on it via the internet page I tried more than 10 times and even contacted customer service. They said it was a bug and would be fixed within 24 hours, anyway it got to the day of my flight and I tried again and it would not work so I was stuck paying fees for 4 weeks in another country. 
Sort your web page out. 
It's an important thing and if people are having the same problem as me then your going to have trouble running your business.

title: CBA Travel Insurance - Stay away
body: They are the only bank that require you to go out of your way to activate your insurance.  Activation is not automatically done by purchasing airline tickets; so many people are caught out.  It?s basically not worth the paper it?s written on.

title: Great cover easy to obtain
body: Great value, easy to apply for , easy to understand what was covered. Great cover in all areas of the policy. Easy to understand how to make a claim with a number of options to make contact.

title: So far so good!
body: Iv used TID twice it was very quick and easy to apply. They even have a phone app! Although I have never made a claim.

title: Very easy process

title: Very affordable and easily organised.

Policy and customer support provided little to no value.
Couldn't even claim for items damaged in your suitcase and processes and staff impossible to deal with.
Would never use again.

title: Good value and good service

title: My trip to Bali

title: Travel

In good health .You didn't have a issue insuring her ..
I am an airline employee and use you guys all the time when I travel for pleasure 
Thank you for making your web site very easy to use

title: Excellent!
body: Fantastic policy, always use Cover-More. Claims are processed quickly and efficiently, the online system for claims is excellent.  Always look after us and we have peace of mind when we travel.

title: Excellent
body:

The website was very user friendly, even for a computer illterate like myself! and it only took a few minutes.
Nothing really

title: Great very responsive with claims no onerous paperwork
body: Annual multi trip policy - had to make claims twice; both were a breeze and easy to deal with .

title: Poor customer service
body: Received a quote which included a 15% discount. When I went to finalise the quote (within 7 days) they would not honour the discount code, dispute me forwarding them a PDF copy of the quote. Took 2 phone calls and an internet search to find the latest discount code which they reluctantly honoured.

title: No help with claims
body: Recently took out a policy for travel to Bali, I lost a pair of $300 Oakleys and my luggage was damaged on the return. I initiated a claim with photographs of the damaged luggage and a picture of the original packaging that came with my glasses. I could not provide receipts of purchase and only estimate of what I paid. I was told that I could not claim for the glasses and that they could only offer me $100 for the luggage due to no receipt and depreciation on it. I was further informed that I may not bother making a claim as the excess would be $100 and it would cancel itself out as they could only offer me $100. Poor customer service, I asked that any correspondence be done via phone. I received an email on Saturday morning with the excuse that it was too early to call. I would highly recommend you reconsider taking out insurance with 1Cover. I could only imagine the issues with claiming if you would required a medical flight etc. Shop around and don't use 1Cover.

title: Great product
body: Easy to use website, reasonable price, easy to set up. Used it 3 times. Very happy with the insurance product.

title: Excellent package and very good value
body: Hard to find a insurance package with adult children travel together. This is the best I can find and easy to understand and easy to choose online. No claim made.

title: Don't leave home without it
body:
I have used CoverMore insurance over the last several years. I won't go on holiday without it. It is very easy to understand and pick the policy you need. The coverage and price is great. I have had a couple issues that happened to me and the claims process while strict it is understandable and fair. I can't say enough about this insurance. Good stuff.
Easy and reasonably priced. Also has multi-trip policies.
I would like longer vacation coverage (max 60 days)

title: Allianz insured me when my long-term company cancelled my policy due to a pre-existing condition.
body: I was delighted when Allianz provided travel insurance for me when my long-term 20 year plus insurance company decided to cancel my policy due to a pre-existing medical condition.  It was easy to apply for online and the premiums with Allianz were less than three other quotes I received. I'm generally healthy and was travelling with the full support of my doctor so I was very puzzled (dismayed) that my usual company wouldn't cover me.  I didn't need to make a claim on this trip.  I will be using Allianz for future trips - usually at least 2 per year.

title: Good
body:
No claims experience so can't comment on that; Covermore couldn't cover me for a preexisting condition but I still took out cover with them for everything else because neither could anyone else and I appreciated their quick response to my enquiry (the country I was travelling to had reciprocal medicare rights with Aus so I would have been ok if I had needed treatment). The online form was very helpful and I got a written response. I find with insurance that unless you have a very straightforward history you never know if you are really covered until you have to claim and therefore prefer to make the request in writing rather than over the phone as phone information is harder to verify. I believe the people assessing my information were actually in that part of the organisation rather than salespeople which was very reassuring.
Can get an assessment of preexisting conditions by filling in online information and they respond very quickly
More expensive than a lot of online operators - if buying through a travel agent I believe they get a very large commission; Trying to understand the terms and conditions without assistance is pretty challenging as with all insurance

title: Easy as !!
body:
I have never had an insurance claim settled so promptly & fuss free. I lost my reading glasses near the centre of Australia. To find them was impossible, so I completed a claim on line. Next day Covermore emailed me advising the funds to replace my reading glasses were in my account. Thank you Covermore.
Prompt, courteous, caring and fuss free.

title: Low cost travel insurance
body:
Policy was good value 
Haven?t lodged a claim, so no feedback on that
First time using the company
Chose this company base on low cost. Our risks were low - we used a large airline & going to the UK, with reciprocal health care arrangement.

title: Great
body: First time.  Very happy with the pricing and and the cover.  Easy website to use. I Have not had to make a claim as yet so only time will tell if and when the need arises.

title: Would use Allianze Travel Insurance again!
body:
Policy was easy to organise, as it?s internet based

Was it good value? As I didn?t need to access travel insurance I can?t really comment on that. However being a health care professional I have an understanding of treatment required if one becomes sick or an accident occurs and medical attention is required.

title: Be sure to understand what you are covered for
body: We got our claim so our policy was of good value. Our travel Agent at Flight Centre facilitated the setting up of our policy. However, when we had to make a claim, it took 3 months before the claim was finalised and paid by Cover-More Travel Insurance. So be prepared for a long waiting period, and lots of following up yourself by inquiring about your claim regularly and chasing further information for Cover-More.

title: Excellent cover. Feel safe abroad
body: Excellent value, easy to setup and even though I didn't need customer support, I sure the team a 1Cover would be able to assist 24/7. I recommend 1Cover to all travellers.

title: Travel Insurance for NZ - Claim Made on Campervan hire
body:
Had a good experience with TID about 2 weeks ago. We got a windscreen crack when travelling around the south island of New Zealand. Our excess was $5000 on the campervan but we had taken out travel insurance.
This is the 5th time we have got travel insurance with TID and this was our first claim. Found TID very reasonably priced Was suprised that the claim was hassle free. We got paid within 7 days. Would defintely use them again.

title: Best Travel Insurance Company ever!
body:
We have used Insure & Go for 4 previous trips - each time we had to make a claim (twice before this one) we were amazed at how easy it was to do so and how fast it was resolved.
This last trip was different in that we had to delay our actual departure due to an unexpected operation. 
We informed Insure & Go of our position. They immediately were helpful and allowed us to delay the claim application until our return.
We would really like to acknowledge the speedy efficient way this claim was handled, particularly as there were some difficulties that we encountered getting all the information to Insure & Go.
We would especially like to thank Brett Hassell for all his assistance along the way.
We would never insure with another company.

title: Easy  to purchase appeared to cover most things
body: Didn't have too make  a claim so cant comment on that but the  policy is easy to purchase online  and appeared to cover most things  and events . Reasonable prices

title: Great Value - can it be beaten?
body: Great Value Policy. We bought a multi trip annual insurance as we have plans for 3 trips in the next year.   I did try to do the application over the phone (I had a previous expired quote I wanted to confirm), but I was left hanging on the phone line for 4 minutes, so gave up.  However, process was simple on line.

title: TID - perfect for those on a budget
body:
I have recently returned from Bali and this is the second time that I've used Travel Insurance Direct. I found them to be the cheapest and they had lots of inclusions. When you have insured with them once they send you a discount code which makes it even better. I've found their customer service to be excellent. I emailed them a couple of questions and within a few hours they had responded. They send emails to you before and after you travel which is great. I will use them again.
Cheap, reliable, great coverage

title: Insurance cover
body: I was recommended by a friend that has used you for some time, thankfully I have not need to claim from you so all is good, the only trouble was this time I had to ring after a few weeks as I hadn't received my card to take with me, but all if fine otherwise.

title: Very disappointed - look elsewhere for insurance
body: I have been a customer of Medibank (travel and health insurance) for many years now and thankfully have never had to make a travel claim. However, due to Covid-19 outbreak I?ve had to cancel my upcoming trip. I tried emailing and calling numerous times to get some answers and nothing. I finally got through and a customer service operator just kept reading the travel alert on their website that had not been updated since 23 February. Told me I couldn?t speak to anyone in the claims until I actually made a claim and told had to actually cancel everything to do so. It was a lose-lose situation. Despite all their online FAQs and online advice suggesting that they do pay for cancellation when DFAT issues DO NOT TRAVEL advice, this is actually not true as my claim was denied. This is despite having purchased a policy in December 2019 before even WHO knew about the outbreak. Have contacted with evidence from their website but have not heard back. Very disappointed and should it not be resolved I will be taking the matter up with the Australian Financial Complaints Authority. Their payment of claims is arbitrary and advice is misleading.

title: Left on a cruise received email backdated before the cruise date
body:
Left on a cruise received email backdated before the cruise date saying Covid 19 a pademic so no coverage?
The question is why didnt they contact before we went interstate on our cruise not gpod value in those circumstances and no offer for a full or partial refund given we paid long before in GOOD FAITH.
Why wait until after the ship sails 27th Jan to find out we had no cover from the 24th January. Not acceptable is it......?

title: Very easy to get a quote for what was required

title: The cover for what I wanted was value for money

title: Disclosing pre existing condition via telephone made it easy

I was very satisfied with the customer support I received when apply for the insurance.

title: Great Insurance Cover
body: Have just returned from our holiday and however did not need to make a claim this time (thank goodness) I have found previously when I have they have been great.  Quick response and return of money.  Easy to do online and one of the best coverage's of insurance there is.

title: Excellent Insurance for Domestic Travel
body:
Last September I travelled from Brisbane to Perth for a wedding with my 5 year old daughter. I took out domestic travel insurance because it was cheap and it covers so much. After shopping around 1Cover proved to be the best value travel insurance. 

I never imagined that I would need to use my travel insurance, but the morning that I was due to fly home from my trip, I woke up with a terribly tummy bug. I wasn't able to make my flight. I called 1Cover and spoke to staff in a call centre in Brisbane. They were extremely kind, caring and compassionate. Once I got a medical certificate, they arranged everything for me - extra nights at my hotel, flights home for my daughter and myself. The only things that they didn't arrange were food expenses, car hire and other incidentals but I could have claimed for those things later if I needed to. 

They rang the day after I got home to check that I was okay and that I had made it home. 

1Cover made a huge difference to me in that time. They took the stress out of a very stressful situation and I will never travel again without travel insurance. They were amazing!
Spoke to an Australian call centre, things were organised quickly, great communication, caring staff.

title: When it comes to claims forget this company!
body:
When the travel insurance found this insurance for my holiday I thought it seemed reasonable. In my third week of holiday in Malta I rolled my ankle and broke my fifth metatarsal of right foot. To begin claim we rang gave details what happened. The communication was very hard as tried mostly through emails which was very hard finding Internet. Everyday I received a letter requesting me to go to doctor for more information they wanted to get seat upgrade to fly home to Australia. How the hell they expected a person with foot in plaster on crutches and foreign country to do this amazed me. Was also very hot at this point also. 

I never found out I was upgraded on flight till checked into airport two hours before flight. We turned up at airport expecting to be stuck in Malta. Upon arriving back home in Australia never got one phone call to see if got home ok nothing. Attempting to claim for medication X-rays crutches etc I tried numerous time online it would not send through to them. I rang asked for form to be posted out and bloke wanted to email me form! I finally received form to fill out after getting information copied I express posted it to them to still stuff around to pay me what I am owed. They truly don't care about you or the undue stress they put on injured people. And once you get back to Australia they pay nothing so I should have stayed in Malta and truly got what I believe I paid for in getting travel insurance!

title: Not worth
body:

They have speedy service and applying for the insurance is easy. 
Policy sounds good until to need to claim for travel delay.  For 12 hours delay, the claim limit is $100 , this didn't even cover the re-booking change fee for flights.  In the end, my out of pocket on missed flights (as it was in transit), re-booking, meals when stranded overseas was way more.  

Travel Delays is such a crucial item to cover and the average traveler is easily susceptible to risk of travel delays.  For the price of the premium, and the $100 limit, you could find another annual policy that could cover ALL costs incurred due to the delay.  

Conclusion, will not be using this again.  Will likely treat this policy as a sunk cost and purchase another one for upcoming trips.

Overall: 
Service 5 stars
Speed of claim 4 stars
Value of the policy 1star

title: Full Refund Received
body:
I am writing this review after receiving a full refund of my travel insurance policy taken out in December 2019 for travel to the USA in August 2020. One would think that receiving a full refund would result in a positive review, no way!  
This company uses a number of tactics to try and avoid providing refunds.
 I have detailed the practice?s and how I responded in the hope others will persevere and also experience favorable outcomes.
Ensure all communications with I&G are in writing. 
Set time frames for in which you would like them to respond, 14 days is reasonable. 
Once the time frame expires escalate as a complaint, initially with I&G internal dispute resolution team and then the Australia Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA). 
Don?t be fooled by I&G reference: ?Recently the Australia Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) has also updated their website to confirm that an 18 month credit is acceptable and their methodology for calculating the amount is consistent with that used by InsureandGo.?  I&G also include a screen shot of the AFCA calculation to try and validate this. 
Be aware that I&G may try and negotiate a partial refund, Do not engage in debate or discussion around the purchase of the policy, time frames, cancellation etc.  
Adopt the broken record technique. ?My trip has been cancelled, I will not be travelling, my policy is therefore not serviceable and I request a FULL refund please.?     
Be aware that I&G will tell you their actions are aligned with AFCA, if in doubt contact AFCA yourself before agreeing to anything less than the desired outcome.  
If a satisfactory outcome has not been received by this stage you can progress the case to AFCA for case management.
For future reference we should all remember -  Mitsui sumitomo insurance company limited.  I can only imagine the nightmare if I ever had to make a claim! 
For anyone reading this with a policy with Tick Travel Insurance, they are also underwritten by the same company.  
I have written to AFCA expressing my concern that Insure and Go are purporting that their actions are aligned with AFCA to provide partial credits or refunds rather than a full refund.  
Please share this information and your experiences in the hope that the practices of this company can be exposed.

title: Great travel insurance
body: We have been with 1Cover regularly and they have always looked after us. Their rates are very competitive for what they offer. I would highly recommend them to others. We made one claim a few years ago and we could not have been looked after better.

title: Easy to arrange and great value
body: It was easy to arrange 2 policies for my family and grown up son. The cover is good although we didn't need to make a claim. The person I the phone was excellent

title: Great Cover For Snow Skiing.
body:
The online quote is quick and easy. I have used 1cover a number of times because they specialise in snow ski cover where other policies don't. Luckily I have not needed to make a claim so I can't personally judge the claim process. I will continue to take out 1 cover insurance every time I go on a snow ski holiday.
Quite inexpensive.

title: No Issues
body:
Policy was good value, very easy to set up and although it was not required, I will utilise in the future and trust the claims are as efficient as the rest of the process.
The only insurance policy to date that has reminded us of our holiday with some travel tips and welcomed us back. Maybe computer generated but still way in front of any other company we have used.

title: Customer Service Experience - Still on the phone waiting after 2 hours :) !!!
body: Purchased a policy, and after 10 days (within the cancellation time frame) wanted to cancel for refund. Called several times but cant get through, now waited for 2 hours - just plain music going and no updated or how long it may be.  No other way to put the cancellation through - EG online, online chat, call back etc. Appreciate they are being slammed for the Corona queries but need to get a plan B up and running. If this was a real emergency .... what then.

title: Happy Again With TID
body:
I have used TID a few times since I wrote a review and one of my group had to make a claim after she fell and lost her GO PRO in a deep muddy fish pond. Her claim was processed and approved with minimal effort. This was great and reaffirms my intention to keep using them for both myself and my groups. 
Below is my previous review

Great price / great when claiming!
 5 out of 5, reviewed on Jan 29, 2017,
I made claims on behalf of people travelling in my groups in October and again in November 2016. I did not need to make a claim! The first claim - In October 2016 - was following the person being injured in a bus accident in Cambodia. When the hospital contacted TID re guarantee of payment for treatment - it was instantly granted. TID assistance kept in constant touch to make sure we were Ok and to see if we needed anything. When a waiting period was needed (airline rules) following treatment TID were happy for my friend to stay at the hospital - so she could continue to improve.
The second time was a claim made for a student who I had to seek Medical advice for in Vietnam in November 2016. The student had a throat infection and then an allergic reaction. All treatment and Medicines were paid by me -when I returned home in Decemberthey were submitted and TID paid the claim within a week. I have been using TID for about 10 years and have recommended it to others but had never made a claim (I still haven't). My experience with these 2 cases was very positive and, especially in the case of the Bus Accident - it was very reassuring and appreciated.

title: Excellent Service!
body:
In 2010, we flew to Paris, for New Year's Eve.  That night, my wife and daughter went down with a bout of food-poisoning.  I rang Cover-More, and got straight through to a representative.  I was advised to keep all medical and chemist dockets, so I could lodge a claim upon returning home. The next day, I received a call from Cover-More, to enquire how my wife and daughter were. That was excellent service!    Once home, I lodged a claim, and within 10 days, I was fully reimbursed!  I would not contemplate using any other travel insurance company!  Thank you, Cover-More!
Superb friendly service, fast efficient processing of claims, inexpensive cover for peace of mind,

title: Fantastic, fast, easy, efficient service.
body:
We have been using 1Cover for all our short trips and/or holidays for years, but recently made our first claim when our son was travelling around Europe and had his phone pick pocketed.
The entire process was painless and efficient. I was very impressed. There was some devaluation on the phone (a very fair amount, I thought) and settlement was made without any complications, as well as quickly.
Thank you, 1Cover!!!!

title: Did not need to use
body: Didn't need to use it so that's always a good thing, so I am assuming that the policy is a good one. The policy was easy to set up.I wouls use Allianz again

title: Comm bank travel insurance 10 months of nasty people
body: Hospitalised on ship 1st day 4 days, transferred nz hospital one week one week rehab fly back to Aus under doctor supervision until arriving home total cost $13500 1st offer $900 second offer about $6000 3rd offer $10500 we were forced with comment that's it accept or we withdraw and we would have to go to arbitration this took 10 months to get final offer. They refused to discuss the $3000 short payment. To obtain the money we were forced to sign a release form stating we were happy with result [we had no option, no sign no money] and to drop rest of claim .. paid to have platinum card paid premium to travel agent for booking using card. We were worn out after arguing with alliance for months ? result cancel alliance insurances $4000 approx. wipe comm bank completely both for ourselves. One daughter two grand sons 3.grand daughters and 4 t0 go  ..advice don't.

title: Satisfaction guaranteed
body:
I have had covermore insurance for many trips now after being recommended to use them.  Only ever had to make 1 claim and could not believe how easy and quick the whole process was.  No questions, simply provide the information and documentation and the claim was processed very quickly. Experience counts and so do experiences.  Covermore is an experienced company and I had a very good experience making a claim.  Very professional.
Ease of making a claim which was processed immediately.  No fuss.

title: Simple to use and affordable
body:
Didn't need to claim anything.
Was incredibly simple to complete the application form, took less that 5 minutes and the cost was very affordable. I liked that the application process was very straightforward and simple. Will definitely use 1Cover next time I travel. Friends I travelled with went through another company, they couldn't find their policy easily, weren't sent it via email, had to ring multiple people to try and get information about their cover and were still unsure what they were covered for which made them quite stressed. I loved the simplicity of 1Cover and the security it gave me knowing exactly what I was covered for and not having to jump through hoops to find out the information.

title: Very effective travel policy
body:
Policy was good value and relatively easy to set up online.
I have only lodged one claim and it was handled in a timely and efficient manner.
I have used this company 5 times for various overseas holidays.
Policy coverage (Gold) is good and quite competitive in the market.

title: Refund promised, not received
body: We booked tickets to Bali for Dec 2017, our insurance was done through Allianz. Mt Agung erupted and no flights went out. Eventually the whole trip was cancelled because we could not get other flights/the hotel during the required time. After endless phonecalls with Allianz we were finally promised a refund as we did not cancel by choice. It's been 3 months and we still have not received that portion of our money back.

title: Cover MORE - Stress LESS!
body: My family and I have used Covermore for years and on countless different trips. I recently made a claim on a camera lens that was damaged in transit - in the hand luggage compartment of the plane. I thought the claims process was going to be painful - but it was really efficient and straightforward. Cover More kept me  well informed throughout the process, and were remarkably understanding. I couldn't be happier with the service and outcome!

title: Forced to miss Flight, Not Covered !!
body:
Spent 1 hr on tarmac Melbourne awaiting take off, 
Missed connecting flight Singapore to Phuket
Spent 3 weeks sending/receiving emails to be finally told,       "Extra Cost of New Ticket (S$360) Not Covered" 
Been satisfied till date, giving them great business, but now that has come to an abrupt halt, !!
Now using Southern Cross Insurance

title: Competitively priced travel insurance
body: I have used Allianz travel insurance a few times now due to the competitive pricing and cover. I have never had to claim so cannot comment on that part but overall very happy and would highly recommend.

title: Excellent response,
body: I found 1 Cover Travel insurance very excellent company, very supportive when made a claim. Unfortunately I had to make a claim due to illness and after sending all the requirements form my claim was accepted and money was into my account immediately. I will recommend 1One insurance to anyone that is travelling to any part of the world.

title: Awesome
body: Always use 1 cover for my trips. Had to make a claim for my stolen phone Nd was pretty simple.

title: Very helpful when you have medical issues, not that we have made any claims to come across any probl
body: Product is very good, hard to find good insurance when you have a few medical issues. Not that we have made a claim against policies to have any issues. You don't really know what is like until you make a claim though.

title: Easy cover
body: Good value and easy to do online.  I have used cover-more several times and luckily haven?t needed to claim. Nice to know we are covered though. Thank you for providing an easy experience.

title: Usually good but...
body: 5 in total for 3 family members. Great service but they appear to currently be victims of their own success and good pricing as they cannot address my small claim from September due to lack of resources, for which they did call to apologise. The Cerberus person did not appear to have read my claim or documents provided. I can only assume they will reject my genuine) claim for admin reasons but it would be nice to know...

title: Premium cost
body:
Customer support excellent! Loved the ease of contacting a team member with my queries.
 One thing I don:t understand is paying a much higher premium for someone who has had heart surgery to make them 'new' again and taking meds to keep it that way with an all clear from doctor and sympton free. Curious.
 In general how many sudden heart attacks victims were symptom free beforehand?
Liz Stewart

title: Fast easy and honest
body: Fast and easy to set up. Great value and peace of mind using TID. The app is well designed and easy to use and understand. I recommend TID to all.

title: No loyalty for returning customers
body: I use 1Cover at least 1 -2 times a year. I have never had a problem or a claim however as an ongoing returning customer I would expect some sort of loyalty discount when arranging a policy online. The system should recognise my details as a returning customer & adjust my policy with a loyalty discount.  Otherwise it might be time to look around.

title: A must get
body: The website is very easy to use and is in plain English. A policy is created in a matter of minutes. It is very well priced. I will definitely use again

title: Super simple to book and straight forward.
body: I've now used TID for 3 overseas trips in the past year and while luckily I have not needed to make a claim as yet, the process of purchasing a policy is super easy, and the PDS is actually straight forward to read!! For my first holiday I did the run around with quotes, but TID seemed to offer equal if not better cover for a cheaper price!

title: Always use 1Cover.
body: I've always used 1Cover and found them exceptional. I've only needed to claim once before due to flights delayed due to weather. 1Cover paid up no problem. This trip everything went smooth & It's good to have the peace of mind.

title: Good Policy for me
body: Policy was good value and very easy to take out,I have used this insurance cover for many trips abroad and have always found the process of taking out insurance Allianz quite simple

title: Australian Based Travel
body:
I'm pleased to have found an on-line service that is competitive, easy to use and helps add value and peace of mind to our travel. The process is easy to use, covers the basics and stacks up when compared against other offers. The follow through adds a personal touch that is appreciated.
Ease of purchase at a competitive price.

title: I have learned one thing from my experience - make sure you keep all your receipts no matter what.
body: No real issue with the policy - ease of setting up and reasonable value. Customer support was ok except that my major claim was inadvertently closed because I added another one (which I said I would do when I put in the first one). The delay in getting recompense was protracted and only completed because I rang up and pushed the issue. The whole exercise was quite convoluted and frustrating - for example my stolen passport had my USA and China visa stamped inside it (which was the only proof I had). Getting the money back for these has proved to be particularly difficult. I still have not had time to get my USA visa replaced as I need to fly to Sydney and that takes time and money which I have precious little of. I will probably not be able to get this money back. The whole claiming experience has taught me to make sure you keep all your receipts no matter what and to make sure you keep harassing the claims department as to where things are at. In the end I was thankful that what iCover did give me back was reasonable given my inability to locate receipts. I will be renewing my travel insurance with your company. :-)

title: Its great insurance cover
body: Once, I was happy with the cover because I had  pre existing conditions, I did make a claim and it was very well handled and very happy with the outcome, Only disappointment was that when I went to extend the policy before it expired ( I am still overseas ) I was not able to get the same conditions because I had a claim in the system. They would not cover my pre existing conditions. I was offered cover but not including my pre existing conditions.The premium quoted was approximately the same as when I originally took out the original policy..

title: Fantastic cover and easy to claim!
body:
No issues at all with this provider, I would highly recommend them to anyone needed travel insurance.

I did a lot of comparisons and found 1cover were not the cheapest but they where the best!

title: Simple!
body: After comparing numerous policies, Insure and Go proved to be the best value for money. The policy was easy to set up and the website is simple to navigate. Health screening was also quick with just a few questions has per condition. I have not yet needed to make a claim however, if the set up is anything to go by, then I would expect the process to be simple!

title: Complete cover and peace of mind
body: So glad our friends referred you to us. Peace of mind whilst traveling and saved on hire car insurance. Will be using you again very soon on our next travel.

title: Great experience
body: Policy was easy to set up. Website is easy to navigate. Value for money. Customer support was good and we were surprised at how easy it was to make a claim.

title: Excellent service
body: I have used InsureandGo several times and have recently taken out two more policies.It was very easy to set up, the service was excellent. Wouldn't go anywhere else for travel insurance.

title: Read the Small Print!! Ripoff!!!
body:
Very disappointing!
A flight cancellation, admitted by the airline in writing, causing me to miss connecting flights and having to rebook was DECLINED because flight cancellations are only covered if due to Strike, Riot or Civil Commotion!! (Not Technical reasons as in my case).
I am now out of pocket, even though I bought insurance in good faith and have what I believe is a fully legitimate claim.

title: Cheap compaire with other compagnies.
body:
Never knew About this insurance. Good value.  Some of the questions asked were a bit over board and dubble asked. Policy was easy to set up. Up till now no experience with customer support. Never made a claim by any travel insurance, so if I would claim, then I Will see how the customer support is.

November 4th 2018 Update: Het was good to have the insurance

We have used the insurance one time. One claim did not make it, because we could not proof with a receipt that the suitcase was ours???? (suitcase was a few years old and who is still keeping the receipt after a few years???) But the travel sticker was still on the suitcase, so they could see it was used by us.  That was disapointing.  Unfortunately this was our first claim EVER.  We were just unlucky this time.

title: Excellent service
body: Great value and very easy to arrange online. A bit involved to make a claim  but satisfied with the end result. Will use insure and go on our next adventure.

title: Extremely unhelpful.
body: Asked for travel quotes from Medibank and HCF Got a sensible response from HCF which I accepted. Medibank nonsensical and unhelpful despite being a medibank private member for 20 years.

title: Travel Insurance - A must have!!!
body:
I was in Ho Chi Minh City recently and had the misfortune to have a gastro attack for 2 days - told it was due to some seafood 
I had eaten and that I should have been told not to eat seafood in Vietnam.  Had I been told to look at the colour of the rivers where the seafood comes from - may have chosen a different dish!   Might add, I was not the only one in a group of 20 that was sick.  

Really is bad luck as I have been in Asia many times over the last 40 years and eaten from street stalls to the best restaurants and never been sick before.

Needless to say, Cover-More were quick to pay my small claim.

Happy travelling!

title: Good Product, lets hope I don't need it!
body:
Easy to use web site and great value compare to other sites I looked at.
I have used this company before and hopefully will use them again.
Hopefully never have to claim from them!

title: What's not to love about 16% discount for us girls?
body: Stoked about getting a discount to cover the pay gap. The policy (I bought Lite) covered everything I needed on my tight budget. Will def use Jane again for my travel insurance.

title: i would use you again
body: first time I have used your company and it was recommended by a friend and luckily didn't have to use

title: Excellent service
body:
Had planned a cruise through the Antarctic peninsula with my elderly parents and mother in law. Flights from Australia to Argentina and then a 11 day cruise.  After more than 18 months planning, just 6 weeks prior to the trip my parents had to cancel due to back surgery for my dad. Due to the late cancellation of their travel, we got none of the fares refunded for my parents.

While the process for the claim took some time in terms of gathering the correct information, once all the documentation had been received by Insure and Go, they turned the claim around very quickly and paid our claim in full.  It definitely pays to have the right insurance.

title: A necessity for travel
body: Easy to set up on line was good value for my sister and l because of our age. When I made a mistake it was easily rectified so it was valid for the countries we were travelling to

title: Excellent value for money
body: 1cover offered the same cover at a much lower price than what my travel agent quoted me. It was very easy to set up and fortunately I didn?t have to make any claims.

title: Easy Cover.
body: The policy was easy to do online, very quick and easy. It  provided you with multiple covers from basic to full cover, The choice is your's on the type of cover you require.

title: Excellent service
body: Very good value, and easy to obtain information. Have been using every time I've travelled and would recommend to anyone. Coverage for claiming is excellent and the policy is easy to understand.

title: Helpful & obliging
body: Customer service obliging and helpful other than that pricing was reasonable but not cheap, but our age probably had consequences. Will get quote again for next year

title: Too much paperwork to claim
body: Air Berlin lost our case for two days so we had to buy clothes etc. not much $300 or so. Insurengo wanted so much paperwork, and statements that it was impossible to meet their demands.

title: Worst Insurance Company I?ve ever dealt with. We had our backpack stolen with 5,000 worth of items
body: Only once and were recommended by Helloworld. We were so badly treated and still waiting on our claim to be finalised after 2 months.

title: Insure and Go
body: Good service, especially for those with pre-existing conditions.  Also easy having this insurance finalised by telephone.  The Customer Service employees are polite and efficient.  I have insured myself for the second time with Insure & Go. Carolyn

title: Set up was good and price competitive.  Would rather rate after trip completed.
body: See above. Online setup was simple and easily understood. It would make sense to complete a review following the trip.

title: Very poor service and long response time
body:
I used their service once. First it took them more than 10 days to respond to my claim. When I did get my claim assessed, it missed my taxi fare despite the receipt being included. When I rang them with the enquire, I was put on-hold for 30mins with no luck to speak to my claim officer. The email address I was given was not my claim officer's email, it's a generic email address. I was told once the claim is closed, it will be another 10 days to get my enquire answered due to the generic email address. And it's their claim officer's choice to give out their work email address. 

Overall, it's a frustrating experience. It's awful enough when you have to experience travel interruptions. You felt a sense of comfort of having the insurance cover. However, the wait time on the phone, no direct work email or phone number of your claims officer means any enquires keep going to this 10 days waiting loop. Not sure if it's Cover more's strategy to discourage their customers to contact them for the claims enquire.

title: Great value for money!
body: Excellent value for money and great coverage for travel. Especially recommend the cruise pack for those traveling on a cruise. We did not make a claim, however would definitely choose to go with Allianz again next time we travel.

title: Overseas Insurance
body: I found the operator very polite and certainly was extremely patient with me. The questions were very good and I found taking out the insurance easy. As yet I have not made a claim and hopefully I will not have to.
